reviews.name: Zac Kwek
reviews.text:
The Ultimate Oasis: Pure Relaxation at Nature Thai Massage & Spa!

If you are looking to completely unwind and escape the hustle of the city, **Nature Thai Massage & Spa** delivers an absolutely flawless, top-tier wellness experience. From the moment you step through the doors, the transition into pure tranquility begins.

### 🌿 The Vibe: Pristine, Calming, and Clean

The environment here is exceptionally well-maintained. The space is beautifully minimalist, soothingly lit, and completely spotless. Cleanliness is clearly a top priority throughout the entire establishment, from the pristine reception lobby to the private massage rooms and crisp linens. The calming aroma drifting through the air immediately sets a relaxed, peaceful tone before your treatment even begins.

### 💆‍♂️ The Treatment: Comfortable and Deeply Rejuvenating
The massage itself was incredibly comfortable, intuitive, and thoroughly satisfying. The therapists are highly skilled professionals who know exactly how to listen to your body, effortlessly dialing in the perfect amount of pressure to release deep muscular tension without any unnecessary discomfort. It strikes that perfect, elusive balance between therapeutic relief and pure, blissful relaxation. You leave feeling incredibly light, loose, and completely refreshed.

### ✨ The Service: Welcoming and Warm

What truly elevates the experience at Nature Thai is the stellar hospitality. The staff are genuinely friendly, polite, and attentive without being overbearing. They greet you with a warm smile, take the time to understand your specific preferences or areas that need extra focus, and guide you through the process with immaculate care.

A spectacular combination of warm service, an impeccably clean space, and a masterfully executed massage. It is the perfect sanctuary to rest, reset, and treat your body to some well-deserved recovery. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Britney Torreon
reviews.text:
🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬TLDR: Friend was sexually assaulted here! DO NOT COME HERE

Came here with a group of friends because it was reviewed very high and walking distance from Central Market. However, after the massages, as were waiting for each of us to come out and one of our friends did not look ok. She just was in shock. We were discussing our massages and how they went only to learn that she was sexually assaulted during her massage. She was the only one with a male masseuse and he did not give her any cover ups that the rest of us were given before laying down for our massage. She stated that he groped her breasts and even tried to put his hand down her panties. We told the person at the front desk and she tried to call the manager multiple times and was not able to reach them. She gave us his name, Cai but no last name, she said they only had nicknames whatever that means. The receptionist tried to tell us he will “probably” get fired but not sure what else she can do. Anyway, not sure what will come of this as my friend is traumatized but if you see a male masseuse with tattoos still working there, please give this place 1 star for NOT doing anything and do NOT support this place. reviews.name: Mohazz Ie
reviews.text: Our family has arrived in Thailand and I was very tired from the journey, so I searched for a massage shop. This shop had the most reviews, so I came based on them, and it lived up to expectations. The reception staff were helpful and provided good advice. My wife chose a 5/1 massage for 1hour at 690THB, and the shop offered a 20% discount for massages of 90 minutes or more, but I opted for only one hour. I had an aroma oil massage for 1hour at 1290 THB, which was also excellent; the masseuse was very professional. However, the oil massage room on the 3rd floor where I had my massage smelled very sour; you could smell it just by walking in. I showered before the massage and found the smell coming from the drainpipe and the slippers I had to wear to shower, which smelled terrible. If the owner improves the drain odor and provides new slippers, everything would be perfect. My wife also mentioned that there was a constant noise downstairs, like someone opening a shoe drawer, throughout the entire hour. Despite all that, I will definitely return for a massage.((I hope you improve))

reviews.text: Right beside Siam square! It was soooo good! I took a 90 mins massage aromatherapy. Comes with your own shower after massage, hairdryer as well. Definitely will recommend to this place! Thank you for the service !

reviews.name: Sanmi Adaramoye
reviews.text:

The whole team is warm and welcoming, but Bobo at reception deserves a special mention. She made the experience feel personal from the moment I walked in and was so hospitable throughout.

Highly recommend if you’re looking for a proper massage in a calm, well run space. I’ll definitely be back.

reviews.text: We had so much fun doing the foot and neck massage! They made us feel at ease while doing the massage. Super love this doing with my mom sister and nephew. Will definitely go back🥰

So we booked 90 minutes Head back shoulder and legs.
This was by far the worst massage I’ve ever had (for this price especially). 4,9 stars out of 5 is ridiculous! reviews.name: Tracy Zuopin Soo
reviews.text: A hidden gem right in the heart of Siam Square! After walking around all day, this was the perfect place to recharge. The atmosphere is calm and clean, which is a nice escape from the hustle and bustle outside. The staff was incredibly welcoming, and the massage was exactly what I needed. Highly recommend if you’re in the area and need some relaxation!

reviews.name: Fahad AlQahtani
reviews.text: Excellent foot and neck massage. The therapist knew exactly where the tension was and worked it out properly—no rushed moves, no fluff. Pressure was just right, very relaxing but still effective. The place was clean, calm, and professional, and I walked out feeling noticeably better. Definitely coming back and would recommend it to anyone who actually wants results, not just a quick massage.

reviews.name: Beatrice Sng
reviews.text: We did 1.5 hrs of Full Body Massage and it was fantastic. The masseuse was professional, knows the sensitive part of the body that requires lesser pressure and vice versa without having to remind her. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Holy
reviews.text:
This was the best massage I’ve ever had in my life. Nothing I’ve experienced before even comes close to what I felt today.

The technique was incredibly precise and attentive — the therapist worked so deeply and accurately on each muscle, finding every point of tension and releasing it. It was not just relaxing, it felt truly healing.

My boyfriend and I came together, and he loved his massage just as much as I did. We both left feeling completely relaxed, refreshed, and happy.

From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed by a very kind and friendly woman who took the time to ask about our preferences and what kind of experience we wanted. She helped us choose the perfect massages, and her care and professionalism made us feel comfortable right away.

My therapist was extremely polite, gentle, and attentive. Her hands were pure magic. Every movement felt confident, professional, and full of care.

This was an unforgettable experience, and I will definitely come back again. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a truly high-quality Thai massage.

title: Dahra Spa Sukhumvit
subTitle: Dahra Beauty Spa
ownerDescription: A day spa in the heart of Sukhumvit. Visit us for a high quality treatment in a professional and clean environment.
address: 400 1-2 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlongton, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Ahmad Almoosawi
reviews.text:
I had a very pleasant experience at Dahra Spa Sukhumvit. The spa has a relaxing atmosphere and provides a comfortable environment to unwind after a busy day exploring Bangkok.

The service was professional and attentive, and the overall experience was calm and enjoyable. The staff were welcoming and made sure I felt comfortable throughout the visit.

The location in Sukhumvit is also very convenient, making it an easy place to visit if you’re staying or spending time in the area.

Overall, a great place for anyone looking for a relaxing spa experience in Bangkok. I would definitely consider coming back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ahmad,

Thank you so much for your kind review. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere at Dahra Spa Sukhumvit and felt well looked after by our team.

Creating a calm and comfortable space where our guests can truly unwind is very important to us, so it’s wonderful to know you had such an enjoyable experience.

Thank you for choosing Dahra Spa during your time in Bangkok. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back again on your next visit!

reviews.name: Suci Fransiska
reviews.text:
We’ve tried quite a few massage places over the years, even in different countries, and Dahra is honestly the best we’ve ever been to.

The therapists really knew what they were doing and got all the right pressure points. The service was so friendly, and the place was clean and comfortable. They provide massage clothes for you to change into, and it’s a dry massage, so you don’t leave feeling all oily afterward.

I’d recommend booking an appointment before you go because they can get quite busy. It’s a bit pricier than your usual Thai massage, but it’s 100% worth it.

Thank you, Khun Amy, Khun Alice, and Khun Mali for such a wonderful experience. We’ll definitely be back next time we’re in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Suci, 

Thank you so much for your wonderful and thoughtful review. We are truly delighted to hear that your experience at Dahra Spa stood out among the many places you have visited over the years.

Khun Amy, Khun Alice, and Khun Mali will be very happy to know that their care, technique, and attention made your visit so memorable. We also greatly appreciate your kind comments about our service, cleanliness, and comfortable atmosphere.

Thank you for recommending us. We look forward to welcoming you back to Dahra Spa the next time you are in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Natasha
reviews.text:
My first impression of this spa was the calming scent and peaceful atmosphere.

The therapist had great technique and knew exactly where the tension was. My therapist was Khun Bum. I have body scrub, deep tissue massage and jacuzzi.

I walked in stressed and left feeling completely refreshed. Thank you
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Natacha for your kind words about our khun Bum and our spa! We hope you will soon have a chance to visit us again!

reviews.name: Carmen Ho
reviews.text: clean, quiet, relaxing! Discounted prices at $1080 for two for 1hr Thai Massage. Couple room available
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Carmen Ho for your review of our spa! We hope to welcome you back soon!

reviews.name: Chui
reviews.text: I actually can leave 4 reviews as I came for 4 times in a row. Their therapist were all so good ! They massage all the point I needed. I always have massage in my home country as I have prolonged neck and back pain but she was just so so so good! I tried different therapist and they are all good. Pooh and bum were both good ! And my partner one was good. That’s why I guess all are good. Highly recommended but better call to make a reservation. They are quite full. Oh I tried Thai massage and head and shoulders.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your 5-star Google review and for coming to our spa several times. We are delighted to hear that you had consistently great experiences and that the massages helped your neck and back. We will be sure to share your kind words with Pooh, Bum, and the rest of our therapists. Thank you for the recommendation, and we look forward to welcoming you back again.

reviews.name: Sili DXB
reviews.text:
An incredible experience from start to finish!
The atmosphere, cleanliness, and overall experience at this massage salon in Bangkok are absolutely amazing. The staff are extremely friendly, everything is spotless, and the place smells wonderful.

From the very first moment, you feel pampered with cold water, refreshing towels, and calming aromas. The treatment rooms are beautifully clean, comfortable, and welcoming.

Communication is smooth and professional, and you truly get great value for your money.
I can warmly recommend this beauty and spa. We got Tea after the treatment.
I’ll definitely be coming back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Sili for your kind words about our spa! Really appreciate that you took the time to write this review and reward us with a 5 star rating! Hope you will soon have a chance to visit us again!

reviews.name: Cecilia Sit
reviews.text:
This was my second time visiting Dahra, and the experience was very smooth from start to finish. I made a reservation in advance, and the process was seamless with prompt follow-up from the staff, which I really appreciated.

The environment remains excellent—calm, clean, and perfect for relaxation. Even though we had to walk up three flights of stairs to reach the couple’s room, it was worth it, as the setup was comfortable and inviting.

We booked a 90-minute Thai massage, and overall, it was a satisfactory experience. My therapist was attentive and skilled, and I felt relaxed throughout the session. My husband’s therapist, however, could have been a bit friendlier, but it wasn’t a major issue, just a small area for improvement.

What I particularly loved about this visit was how cost-effective it was. We even received a discount, which made the experience feel like great value for money.

I’m very happy with this visit and will definitely return for another session.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Cecilia Sit for your kind words about our spa! I am glad you enjoyed your visit and we strive to offer very good value for money. So I am glad you mentioned that in your review!

reviews.name: Lulu Lu
reviews.text:
Location: great, nearby emsphere and Asoka

Environment: nice smell, good sense of Thai luxury interior design, zen style, staff grooming and uniform are discreet, love it.  One opinion, we went to one of the room to have massage and inside is a Buddha picture. As a Buddhist, to change clothes in front of a Buddha picture is not so comfortable and polite for me. Other than this, everywhere is clean and nice.

Massage techniques: I would say as a lover of massage, they provide high standards of masseurs, most of the time I feel very satisfied.  This time I went I had a surprise cuz my disc was slipped out a bit and I felt very uncomfortable for over a month already. But the masseur today helped me to stretch and really I’m so surprised I’m able to bend forward at night.  Thank you.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words about our spa and rating us with 5 stars. Also a big thank you for posting the photos! Reviews like this is what keeps us delivering the best we can.

reviews.name: Scott Jones
reviews.text: ve just visited Dahra Massage for the third time, and each visit confirms I really wish I’d discovered it sooner. The facial massage is absolutely beautiful — incredibly relaxing and so professionally done. The staff are lovely, welcoming and attentive, and the ambience is calm, soothing and well thought out from the moment you walk in. It’s the kind of place where you can truly switch off and unwind. Highly recommend and I’ll definitely keep coming back.

Your compliments about our team and the ambience will be shared with our staff, who will be very happy to hear them. Thank you again for your recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you back for many more relaxing visits in the future!

The Dahra Spa Team

reviews.name: A “Hannahita” Che
reviews.text:
Nothing to complain unfortunately about the massage, very good and professional not super smiley and no interaction with no problem I came for a massage .
But Very very bad customer service , one girl at the reception was super rude and not friendly at all,almost like a robot ,in the country of smile not ones from the beginning to the end, Service was really poor not professional with customers.
She told me :
Name /time of massage /soft medium strong / seat down.
And the same when I paid never look me in the eyes counting the cash.
I thought I was in the line of a supermarket without any kindness.
So it made a really disappointing experience, that's a pitty because I came 5 years ago and it was the best experience massage I made in Bkk.
I went out disturbed by this behaviour that why I put one star and I don't recommend.....
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear A "Hannahita" Che,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

We’re very pleased to hear that you found the massage itself to be very good and professional—that’s something we truly value. At the same time, it’s clear that the experience at reception fell far below expectations, and we take that seriously.

The receptionist you encountered is new to the team and is currently very focused on following procedures correctly and avoiding mistakes. That said, this should never come at the expense of basic courtesy, warmth, and professionalism. What you describe is not the experience we want any guest to have, and we will address this directly with her to ensure the right balance between accuracy and genuine hospitality.

It’s especially disappointing to hear this given that you had such a positive experience with us in the past. We would really appreciate the opportunity to understand more about your visit and to make this right. Please feel free to contact us at office@dahra-spa.com directly with any additional details.

Thank you again for your honest feedback—it helps us improve.

reviews.name: TP HN
reviews.text:
We came here because we got recommended by my husband’s student. I didn’t expect much at the beginning, but it turned out to be the best massage I’ve had.
We both had 2 hour Asian blended massage, got to select one of the 4 oils available, and they took note on any special requests as pressure level, or which part of the body needs more attention.
Overall very calm, professional service, clean spa, worth the price.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear TP HN,

Thank you for your 5 star review! Reviews like this keep us motivated to deliver the best we can!

reviews.name: Juliet Lucky
reviews.text: Feeling like you need a serious escape? Imagine a place that's all about peace, quiet, and pure indulgence. It's the ultimate spot to unwind and recharge your batteries. Honestly, you might want to think about getting a yearly pass – it's a game-changer for regular visits. Treat yourself, you totally deserve it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Juliet Lucky,

Thank you for such a thoughtful and uplifting review.

We’re really glad you felt the sense of peace and relaxation we aim to create—it means a lot to us. Creating a space where guests can truly switch off and recharge is exactly what we strive for every day.

And we appreciate the mention of the yearly pass (Privilege Card)—it’s indeed a great option for those who want to make regular relaxation part of their routine.

We look forward to welcoming you back again soon.

reviews.text: INCREDIBLE A MUST TO VISIT IN BANGKOK!. I came for the Thai massage and ended up upgrading to herbal Thai massage at no extra cost! Dear John,

reviews.name: desi tjhiong
reviews.text:
I can’t recommend Dahra enough! It’s my go-to spa every time I visit Bangkok, and I always treat myself to a 2-hour Royal Thai massage or Herbal Massage every day whenever I am in the city! It felt like a perfect blend of yoga and relaxation, with a lot of stretching that makes me wish it would never end. As a massage addict who has tried countless places, I can confidently say that nothing compares to this.

I could really feel the difference after the massage—the boost in circulation made my face look and feel refreshed, and any puffiness disappeared. The place is clean, and the therapists are not only experienced but also incredibly professional, making every visit a luxurious escape. This is definitely something I always miss when I return to my home country. If you’re in Bangkok and looking for a top-notch Thai massage experience, Dahra is an absolute must-visit!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Desi Tjhiong for your 5 star review and kind words about our spa! We have just finished renovating our Thai Massage Rooms and I am glad you posted a photo of our new couple room! The whole team of Dahra Spa is looking forward to welcome you back soon!

reviews.name: Carsten Pütz
reviews.text: Dahra Spa is a great spa- the reception is super friendly, the therapists are very skilled. The massage was very relaxing. The spa itself is very stylish and so quite, I really enjoyed the visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Carsten for taking the time to review our spa! I will share your comments with our staff. Reviews like this is what keeps us delivering the best we can.

reviews.name: Kenny
reviews.text:
I had such an unbelievable time here! I've been to other big spas in Bangkok, but Dahra has topped them all. I came here for a spa package and was looked after by Mai and felt SO pampered. Every little thing she did had so much care, intention and skill behind it. I haven't experienced that anywhere else, where each touch and action is like, "wow!" I've got a bit bored or underwhelmed with longer treatments at other places, but I didn't want it to end, here. I think the atmosphere really helps, it's such a relaxing and beautiful place.

And the service is just top tier. Eve at reception was incredibly friendly and helpful... and Mai, Eve and Ice even came in at the end with birthday cake and sang happy birthday for me! So nice, I'm going to remember that forever! The staff got everything right here, and the price was so good for what you get! Can't recommend Dahra enough, and very happy I came for my birthday :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Kenny Duggal,

Thank you so much for sharing this amazing review. We’re really honoured that you chose Dahra for your birthday, and it makes us genuinely happy to hear that your time with us was such a good one.

Mai will be over the moon to know her care and attention made such an impression. She really puts her heart into every treatment. And I’m glad to hear Eve and Ice made you feel so welcome — the small birthday surprise was something they were excited to do (and I think they enjoyed it almost as much as you did!).

We always try to create a calm, beautiful atmosphere, so it’s great to hear that you felt relaxed from the moment you arrived. And thank you for mentioning the value — we work hard to keep the quality high without overpricing things.

Thanks again for choosing Dahra and for recommending us. We hope the rest of your birthday was wonderful, and we’d love to welcome you back again soon.

Warm regards,
Dahra Spa

My boyfriend is a foreigner and quite big in size, while I’m small. The therapist who massaged him had almost no pressure at all, he said it felt more ticklish than relaxing. It was honestly the biggest waste of time massage experience for the both of us!

As for me, my therapist pressed way too hard, especially on my shoulders. The pain has continued until today. She was so rough that I had to tell her to skip my head and neck because I was afraid she would press too hard there as well.

There was no balance at all! one was too soft, the other was too strong. We decided not to tip this time (we normally always tip), but the experience was genuinely disappointing.

Pick your poison guys.

reviews.name: Marco Hekel
reviews.text:
**5 Stars for Us, But Why?**

The main reason we gave this place 5 stars is that we visited Bangkok outside of peak tourist season. If we had gone during the busy season, I doubt we would have enjoyed it as much, because it becomes overcrowded with tourists who often expect to be catered to like royalty. Locals live calmly, while tourists sometimes behave entitled—this can be quite disappointing.

**Location (4 stars):**
Located in a side street at Wang Lang Market, you need to know what you’re looking for, as there’s no flashy sign drawing you in.

**Prices (4 stars):**
Average compared to other places. For foreigners, it's still very affordable, but in comparison to other local stores, it’s just in line with the norm.

**Service (5 stars):**
For us, the service was great—friendly and helpful. True, the staff don’t speak much English, so having a translator app like ChatGPT, Gemini, or Google Translate will make communication smoother. There’s no need to complicate things.

**Payment (5 stars):**
No issues with payment—both credit cards and cash are accepted.

**Professionalism (3 stars):**
There’s a noticeable variation in their professionalism. While we had a positive experience, I can understand why others might feel differently. The lack of personalized assessments for massages means the service could be better tailored to individual needs. This is an area where they could improve.

**Appointments (5 stars):**
First of all, avoid peak season. Second, some comments about booking appointments are a bit misguided. Why expect the same rigid planning and organization you're used to? This isn’t a highly structured company. Just show up, and if they’re free, great! If not, move on. For us, there were no issues, but again, we avoided the peak times.

**Final Thought:**
If you behave like other foreigners, rushing or being demanding, you might run into problems. But if you adopt the local calm attitude, everything will flow smoothly, and you’ll enjoy the experience even more.

reviews.text: It was an incredible experience, a very complete massage, excellent service, my friend and I left feeling renewed, we recommend it 100%.

reviews.name: Bosco Tong
reviews.text:
Very good place.
Very good massage skill.

reviews.name: Li Pin Poh
reviews.text: We were really glad to have had an hour of foot massage here. The ladies have great skills, every stroke was spots and helped relieve our fatigue in no time.

reviews.name: Kavitta Mangotra
reviews.text: Went after seeing the reviews but This is by far my worst massage experience ever in Bangkok!!! One Elderly lady did the massage n clearly she was not at all trained. Didn't feel like telling her anything to avoid being rude so I left 15mins early before completing  my 90mins.. it was that bad.  Never going back again! Complete waste of 450thb.

reviews.name: Roman Kondratiev
reviews.text: Amazing massage, one of the best in Bangkok so far. Very calm atmosphere and professional staff. They know what they doing 👌🏻

reviews.name: Thomas Powney (Tom)
reviews.text: Excellent 2 hour Thai massge by the lady owner. Got straight to my stiff shoulder and lower back. Very relaxing and feel much better. Great value at 500 bht.

title: The Home Massage and Spa
ownerDescription: “Home” is not just a place to live, it is a feeling of relaxation and happiness. Nothing is better than having the best massage with green music and professional therapist at “home” after the end of journey. We would like to treat you as our family members. Welcome to experience the true relaxation at our home!
address: 17 Ragang Rd, Tambon Hai Ya, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
plusCode: QXHV+VJ Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Natalie Hall
reviews.text: Great price point and wonderful services. Erin took great care of me after a long few travel days! Very grateful for my time here. I did the herbal bath, facial, and massage.

reviews.name: Mike Wu
reviews.text: One of the best massage experiences I had in Chiang Mai. The atmosphere was peaceful, the facility was clean, and the therapists were skilled and attentive. Great value for the quality of service. I would definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Laurie Montes
reviews.text: I'm truly impressed by the professionalism and top-notch quality of this spa's service. The online booking system is smooth and user-friendly, and the pickup service arrived a little early, with everyone being warm and welcoming right from the moment we arrived. The facilities are spotless, and Kathy did an amazing job with the 2-hour Lanna Massage. The hot tea and pineapple cookies added a special touch, making it one of the most memorable experiences I've had.  Thank you!

reviews.name: Chan Chris
reviews.text: Found this gem during my trip. The Home Massage has a very calming and clean atmosphere. I tried their oil massage and it was excellent—the therapist really knew how to work on the tension points. The prices are very reasonable compared to other spas I've visited. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a high-quality massage without the hefty price tag!

reviews.name: 陳陽軒
reviews.text: The atmosphere is incredibly relaxing, and the staff is both professional and welcoming. The massage was perfect and really helped relieve all my muscle tension. Highly recommend this place if you're looking for a top-tier spa experience!

reviews.name: Francis Arnold Jr
reviews.text:
A reset. My experience was just short of super fancy and right above too lack luster. I enjoyed everything from start to finish. The staff is extremely welcoming, joyful and calming all in one. The staff member that took care of my back packer massage is the definition of MEDIUM pressure. That’s pretty much 75% of the massage for me, nailing the pressure and then 25% is calming the mind and letting the expert take care of me, which she did (because I fell asleep). I will come back here before I move on from Chiang Mai.

Thank you to the team for making this a mid-day experience that added much needed value.

reviews.name: Gail Chen
reviews.text: My husband and I tried the [Couple Package] Office Syndrome Remedy (90 mins). The experience was absolutely wonderful! The upper body massage combined with the herbal compress effectively relieved our muscle tension. We felt deeply relaxed afterward. Highly recommend this place and will definitely come back again!❤️

reviews.name: Prae BHG
reviews.text: Loved my experience at The Home Massage Chiangmai. Great atmosphere, friendly staff, and Tukta was amazing—perfect pressure and really hit the right spots. Left feeling refreshed. Will definitely be back!

reviews.name: Amina K
reviews.text: I decided to have a chill day on my travels in Chiang Mai and started with a mid-morning Thai massage. This salon is modern but homely and the service is excellent: it's not your standard high street salon! Depending on the treatment you're having, they will ask questions to tailor the pressure level and where you'd like them to focus or avoid. My therapist was Tukta and she was very attentive, and checked on me through the treatment. The pressure and treatment plan was spot on. I was alone and given a private room which had a shower (though I'm not sure if this is available in all rooms). The place was super clean and it was great to be able to wash the balm off before hitting the midday sun and there was no rush to push me out.

reviews.name: Prakash Nambiar
reviews.text: Highly recommend this place. The massage was fantastic and the set up was beautiful. We got a couple room with an en-suite bathroom. Just the right amount of pressure used. Very professional.

reviews.name: Kirsikka Kirvesmäki
reviews.text:
I took an one hour head massage and it cost 550 baht and my parter took an one hour upper body massage and it was also 550 baht. He had bad experience earlier in Chiang mai of upper body massage but in this place it was good! 5/5

Prices are reasonable If you are looking for really professional massage for yourself. Our massages were from the cheapest part of the choices they offered. I recommend you to ask them to raise the room temperature a little bit higher if you are sensitive because the room can feel a bit cold. They will cover you with a blanket so it will help you to stay warm during the massage.

Massage techniques can feel a bit different at first you've been used to but it's worth it. You will feel relaxed after the session. At least we did! Khop khun kha The home massage for having us and giving a good experience. 🙏

reviews.name: Tari Van den Nest
reviews.text: Really nice experience for our first Thai massage. They take into account the pressure level you prefer and adjust the treatment accordingly. The staff are very professional and friendly, making us feel comfortable throughout the session. After the massage, we were treated to tea and cookies, which was a lovely finishing touch. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: minji choi
reviews.text: I had such a relaxing time here. The staff were incredibly kind, and I enjoyed a refreshing massage in a clean and comfortable environment. I feel like all my fatigue will be gone for the rest of my trip. Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Anastasiya
reviews.text:
I found this spa once, and since then I come only here. I love the atmosphere, the staff, service. I love it !! 😻 they make you forget who you are, where you are. My body tells thank you 🤩

This time I had 3 hours of spa. Best place for time for myself 🫶🏽☺️

reviews.name: Julie Ufberg
reviews.text: This spa exceeded expectations! I got the relaxing whole body mix and I feel rejuvenated and relaxed. The staff is inviting and friendly. The massage technician was incredible and it was my first Thai massage. They give you a welcome drink and tea at the end. The price is very reasonable. Thank you!!!

reviews.name: Lara Ovčar
reviews.text: The classical Thai massage was excellent. I had a wonderful experience and felt very relaxed afterwards. The staff were extremely kind, friendly, and professional, which made the whole visit even more enjoyable. I would definitely come back and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great massage. 🫶🏼

reviews.name: J F
reviews.text: Truly amazing massages and packages! The staff is wonderful—very kind, attentive, and highly professional. I really appreciated the detailed consultation beforehand to discuss health conditions and customize the massage pressure. It shows a high standard of care. A fantastic experience in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Momay Khanintha
reviews.text: I had Aroma therapy oil massage with K.Tukta. It was utterly amazing. The staff were so welcoming and nice. This place is so relaxing. I'd love to revisit this place.🤍

reviews.name: Irina Karabashidi
reviews.text:
Had such a lovely experience here today. I chose the Warm Candle Massage and it was absolutely amazing.

The atmosphere is cozy, calming, and very professional — you instantly feel relaxed. Everything is beautifully organized and they offer a great selection of aromas.

My therapist, Nok, was excellent — very skilled, attentive, and professional. The massage was smooth and deeply relaxing.

Highly recommend! 🌿✨

reviews.name: Khant Soe Naung
reviews.text: An absolute sanctuary of calm. I treated myself to the Warm Candle Massage today, and it was a revelation. The transition from the busy streets to this cozy, beautifully organized space immediately lowers your heart rate. The selection of custom aromas adds a lovely personalized touch before the session even begins. The massage itself was seamless—the warmth of the candle wax provides a level of deep relaxation that traditional oils just can't match. Highly professional, impeccably clean, and worth every cent. 🌿✨

title: Varalee Massage
ownerDescription: สปา นวดเพื่อสุภาพ Spa & Massage For Health
address: 12 Siri Mangkalajarn Rd Lane 7, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXWC+3J Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: TK Kajoranun
reviews.text:
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Authentic Skill Meets Serene Atmosphere
Varalee Thai Massage delivers an absolutely authentic and professional experience. Located just off the main road on Soi 7, it's a peaceful haven. My therapist exhibited exceptional knowledge of anatomy and traditional techniques, applying precise pressure that was both challenging and deeply relieving. It felt like a true healing session, not just a rub-down. The price for this level of expertise is almost unbelievable. For anyone seeking a legitimate, therapeutic Thai massage in Chiang Mai asking for P' Yu, this is the place. 10/10!

reviews.name: Amy Heinrich
reviews.text:
Just had an incredible head-back-shoulders massage for an hour from Yoh! I was in the neighborhood and saw all the good reviews, and I now understand why! The hour flew by and I feel like I’m standing taller now. The tea and snacks afterwards was a nice way to end the day.

Note that you might share a room with 2 other clients, but you are wearing clothing and there is music to draw attention away

reviews.name: Jessica Chernila
reviews.text:
wonderful! Pearand anx Aor so amazing!!!
Ive come everyday eo far .. I do thai masaage in America and I am so grateful to the motherland !! These therapists are thr best .. no wonder VARALEE gets SUCH GREAT REVIEWS!! I highly recommend!!

reviews.name: Aaron Tillema
reviews.text: Very nice experience. More thorough than any others I have gotten and this is maybe #12? Movements were a tad speedy but I only booked 1 hour and that allowed time for a head, neck and face portion which I was not expecting! Big bonus. Definitely worth booking.

reviews.name: Dean Bajwa
reviews.text:
Amazing Thai Massage!

I went together with my wife and we both had the 1 hour head, shoulders and back massage for 300 baht. They massaged us in the same room. The massage itself was a perfect way to unwind after a busy day.

At the end of the massage, we received watermelon, tea, and some cookies.

Would definitely recommend!

reviews.name: Tan.W
reviews.text:
Popped by a few massage places on our list without booking, but were unlucky as they didn’t have enough therapists and had to turn us down. We eventually came here after being rejected by their other outlet.

It’s a simple, no-frills massage place. We did the 1-hour Foot + Head, Back and Shoulder massage at ฿300. They asked us to change into their outfit, washed our feet, and then brought us up to level 2 where the mattresses are.

The one hour felt a little long for me, and I didn’t like that there was no face hole in the mattress. When we had to flip to face down for the back massage, my head felt a bit awkward, though the massage still continued. My favourite part was the head massage — unfortunately, it felt a bit too short!

After the session, they served a small cup of tea, a slice of watermelon, and a tiny bag of biscuits, which was a lovely touch.

Best of all, they accept credit card payment!

reviews.name: Vicky Zhang
reviews.text: Had a really great experience here. The foot massage was amazing and exactly what I needed after a long day of walking. The staff were friendly and professional, and the whole place felt clean and relaxing. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Marco Barile
reviews.text: Very nice massage. My favorite place in Chiang Mai. Clean, reasonable price, nice stuff, good quality massage. After massage they give you tea 😊.You can also pay with card (Visa). Very Recommended

reviews.name: Tyler Haugen
reviews.text:
Chai is a master!

He's extremely strong, but that can only be comfortably and therapeutically delivered, with flawless technique, which he has. I very much enjoyed the precision and power he dug into my body's soreness/pain. He literally found a knot in my right shoulder, and got a little excited to dig into it... absolutely heavenly. A master of human anatomy, his force was precisely delivered. If you like deep/strong massages, Chai is a master of the craft. One of those full body resets that comes with the pain of proper deep tissue massage, this is therapeutic greatness. In simple terms, he's an elite masseuse. Definitely recommended, and the place offers fair competitive prices to the market.

Will repeat a few days after a gym sesh, to get therapeutically destroyed again. Exceptional.

reviews.name: Inyoung Park
reviews.text: The massage was so good. It was done as what I wanted with moderate pressure. I also tried the hot ball massage, it was very relaxing and good. The tea and snack after massage was very delicious.

reviews.name: 구혜은
reviews.text:
The massage was great and the price was also very good.

I received a kind and appropriate massage. I think I'll come often because it's close to the hotel.

reviews.name: Nimai Piazza
reviews.text: Very relaxing environment, the masseuses are very good. I tried: Oil massage, Top treatment, massage and finally tea. They make you feel at home🥰

reviews.name: evan
reviews.text: It's a good experience! I recommend it to everyone! The environment is very good, and the service attitude is also very good!

reviews.name: Angeline
reviews.text: Availed the foot, back, shoulder, and head massage. The therapist was great! 10/10 overall experience. They gave free snacks too! The price is affordable and you really get what you pay for.

reviews.name: Daniel Lazicki
reviews.text: I did the 2 hour, foot and back, neck, shoulder and oil massage combo and it was amazing. My masseuse, Napa, was the best. She used the perfect pressure and got all my sore muscles loosened up. I will be back for sure and your should try this place too!

reviews.name: Hoifung L
reviews.text: The service is very good, and the massage is also very comfortable. The masseur is very kind and will ask you if the strength is appropriate.

reviews.name: Chris Chin
reviews.text:
Best massage I’ve ever had in my life. Chai is unbelievably strong — 2 full hours and he never slacked off once. The pressure stayed consistent the entire time. I like really deep pressure, and he was perfect. You know someone is truly skilled when they press so hard but it doesn’t actually hurt… it’s that “good pain” that makes your whole body feel amazing afterward.

Thank you so much, Chai!!!!! And thank you Bee for recommending the perfect therapist for me. I’ll definitely be coming back here every single time I’m in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Natalya Lazurka
reviews.text: I had high hopes after seeing the shining reviews for this place. I am not sure if the reviews are inauthentic or I just got the worst masseuse in this establishment, but I would never go back here again, nor recommend it to anybody. My masseuse uncomfortably pushed on my back and legs very lightly, thumped her fist on my feet for a total of 15 seconds, attempted a very awkward stretch, and proceeded to try to continue to lightly push on my extremities before I stopped her and had to leave early. This is the first time that I have left in the middle of a massage. I have received Thai massages before and this was not it. I was so uncomfortable and it felt like a total waste of my time to continue to lay there. Also, there was another masseuse in the room massaging a gentleman and her and my masseuse would started talking and giggling and I cannot understand why anybody would do that in a place where we come to relax and unwind? I do not trust the high reviews for this establishment and cannot recommend it to anybody.

reviews.name: CY Tan
reviews.text: Highly recommended! One hour of foot and back massage for only 300 baht. Excellent value and very skilled massage therapist.

reviews.name: Marta Sterna
reviews.text: Finally I found a place to go to. Really good massage tailored to your needs. Located in a trendy district but this place offers a real local experience. Not too fancy, good prices. Lovely staff that speak communicative English. For me Ms. Kae was a perfect masseur.

title: Relaxing Day Massage
ownerDescription: massage
address: Soi Inthawarorot 3 Old City Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXQM+Q3 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Vanessa
reviews.text:
Very nice and professional!!!🥰
The massage therapist was very friendly and professional, making me feel comfortable throughout the entire session. The environment was clean, well-maintained, and had a pleasant, relaxing fragrance. Overall, the experience offered outstanding value for the price — highly recommended!

reviews.name: Heldy Nicola Bagas Saputra (Nico)
reviews.text: After trying massage services in several countries, I can confidently say this place offers excellent value for money. The environment is peaceful, clean, and well-maintained, while the therapists are skilled and professional. The treatment was consistent, relaxing, and effective in relieving travel fatigue. The complimentary tea and snack after the session added a thoughtful finishing touch. A great place to recharge after exploring Chiang Mai. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Molly Weinberger
reviews.text: I had a wonderful Thai massage here, the space was clean and relaxing and the staff are fantastic, very attentive and kind and provided me with water and tea on top of a great massage!! The private massage area was very comfortable! Would definitely recommend this place!

reviews.name: Leek Li
reviews.text:
Won‘t even give one star! This is the worst spa I’ve ever been to.

Bottom line: Don't come here! This place is a total trap. If I could give zero stars, I would.

The massage technique was embarrassingly bad. The therapist didn‘t hit a single pressure point the entire time. It felt like she was just randomly rubbing my skin — the pressure was lighter than a pat on the back, with zero technique. I asked for deeper pressure, but all I got was an elbow poking me randomly. A 50-baht foot massage from a street stall is ten times more professional than this.

The environment was a disaster. The so-called massage room was basically a dormitory-style space with just thin curtains between beds. You could hear every conversation and footstep from outside. There was no way to relax. Even worse, it was co-ed. I could see the curtain gap next to me where a male customer was being massaged. Zero privacy. The whole experience was deeply uncomfortable.

The service was also dismissive. The front desk staff couldn‘t care less. When I said I wasn’t happy afterward, they just smiled and said nothing — no apology at all.

This place can‘t even compare to the proper spas in Chiang Mai. A random street stall is miles better. Strongly not recommended — a waste of money and time. If you’re hesitating, take my advice: go somewhere else. Don‘t do this to yourself.

---

reviews.name: Emery Dittmer
reviews.text: Wonderful massage. You start with changing shoes outside. The front desk man was kind and very helpful. Foot wash and then 69 glorious minutes later we felt like melted butter. we got oil shoulder and back and asked for head massage as part of the 60 minutes and it was amazing. 90 minutes is the right about of time don't skimp out unless you do this multiple times during your trip.

reviews.name: Jerine Goh
reviews.text: I had the foot + neck and shoulder massage. The entire experience is good! Just that the foot massage is average. The place was nice & clean.

reviews.name: Alina Kabirova
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my massage! I pulled my back recently but still wanted a Thai massage, and it was wonderful that both the receptionist and masseuse listened to my request and adjusted the massage accordingly. It was still a firm Thai massage, but they avoided deep twists to accommodate my lower back. The salon is clean and comfortable. Will definitely come back

reviews.name: Марина Алексеева
reviews.text: I’ve had a foot massage here twice and was very satisfied both times. The treatment is incredibly relaxing, helps relieve fatigue after long walks, and reduces swelling. After each session, my legs feel light and comfortable. The pleasant atmosphere and attentive service make the experience even better. I will definitely come back again!

reviews.name: Zeinab Ruhomauly
reviews.text: I had a back, shoulder, head and foot massage. It was very relaxing and pressure was just right on the tough knots. The spa is very clean and has a relaxing ambiance. The spa therapists paid good attention to comfort as the AC made the room cold - provided loose pajamas and cosy blanket! Herbal tea at the end was a lovely touch!

reviews.name: Marta Dafne Cabañero
reviews.text: This was my first Thai massage and could not have been in a better place. Very relaxing and calm. Just loved it! Many thanks 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Hooi Koon Lee
reviews.text: Nice ambient with calming environment. Staff is friendly and feel welcoming here. No pressure and rushing while choosing the package. Masseur is observing while doing the massage. They make sure you are comfortable along the way.

reviews.name: tania
reviews.text: Staff is really accommodating you get welcome water bottles and tea and biscuits at the end of the massage. Atmosphere is very relaxing and prices are affordable. I got the thai massage with oil would recommend!!

reviews.name: Noëlle Verheijde
reviews.text: I had a great experience and would totally go again! The staff was extremely nice and welcoming and the massage itself was amazing as well! Also very affordable!

reviews.name: Maryneth
reviews.text: Probably one of the coziest massage spa with affordable price. Definitely, worth the price. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Karla Tuason
reviews.text: massage was soooo good, highly recommended. they are serious about PRESSURE! can choose any pressure you like but when you say hard, it’s hard! place is also vibin - high ceiling, calming atmosphere, staff are so friendly and accomodation g. they also give bael fruit tea which keeps body warm after massage which is a lil extra, love it!! they also give free small bottle of water!!! really affordable! worth your money!

reviews.name: Yasmine A
reviews.text: I had a lovely experience at Relaxing Day Massage. A super relaxing environment with a lovely interior. I enjoyed a 60 minute Thai massage and the masseuse was very good, I felt very relaxed afterwards. Normally I don’t find enough pressure is applied for massages, but this masseuse was excellent! All the staff were very friendly and professional, I would definitely go back.

reviews.name: Maja Miladinovic
reviews.text: Most authentic Thai massage I had on my travels across Thailand. My therapist Mam was professional and very knowledgeable. The Spa was clean and serene. Thank you and I will be back.

reviews.name: Rita akach
reviews.text: The spa was very clean, well organized, and relaxing. I tried the mix spa package — 40 minutes Thai massage and 20 minutes oil massage — and it was really great. I truly enjoyed the experience and highly recommend this place.

reviews.name: Nathan Yu
reviews.text:
PSA: if you want heavy pressure you must ask for a male therapist.

I explicitly asked for heavy pressure before walking in and was assured by the manager it would be OK and just tell my massage therapist. I asked repeatedly maybe 10 times without much improvement. I was basically just getting light brushing against my body and when we moved to the back she basically just lightly rested her elbow for long periods with no movement. I was going to just get up and go because it was a waste of my time. She had the audacity to tell me she knew what she was doing and it was the thai massage technique. I have been to over 100+ massages in Thailand and 200+ worldwide and her massage ranks in the lowest 5. She then told me she couldn’t apply any more pressure and I should have asked for a man. I have received miles better massages with 5x more pressure from women less than HALF her size. It was a pretty rough time.

The redeeming factor moving from a one star to a three star is because they swapped in a male therapist and the rest of the massage was above average. Still not amazing — too much use of low surface area touch points (thumb) and did not pay attention to directional force causing some skin friction and pain. But I appreciate the adjustment and effort.

reviews.name: PY Liew
reviews.text: The female receptionist was really friendly. The place is also great. The masseur I got also accommodated to my requests. Overall, it was a really good experience.

title: Antique Massage Chiangmai
subTitle: Antique Massage and spa ( Garden house branch ) Chiangmai

.

reviews.name: Ooi Jou Fen
reviews.text:
Super amazing experience! From the moment I arrived, the service was excellent and everyone was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and professional.

A special thank you to Mr. Foam, the receptionist, who was very polite, helpful, and attentive. He made the whole experience smooth and comfortable from the beginning.

A big thank you to the two wonderful masseuses, Wadde and Fon. They were both extremely professional and skillful.

The entire team provided excellent service, a welcoming atmosphere. They even provide pick up and drop off services from hotel. Even the driver was very nice and friendly.

Highly recommend this place. I will definitely come back again on my next visit! 🙏❤️

Thank you again, Mr. Foam, Wadde, Fon and the friendly and nice driver for making my visit so enjoyable! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.name: Yin Mon Myint
reviews.text: I found this place through googling and the antique look small building attracted me and I contacted them via WhatsApp. Promptly replied and arranged for free transportation within 30 mins. Cozy and calm environment with their welcome drinks and friendly and attentive staffs made me so comfortable. I have spent 3 hours there for body scrub, oil massage and facial. Every single minutes worth the spent and the therapist “Cam” was so patient and very professional. I would fully recommend if you want to feel relaxed, calm and satisfied on what you spent for your money and your precious time.

reviews.name: Ivy Li
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience at Antique Massage Chiang Mai! The environment is quiet and cozy with classic vintage style, super clean and relaxing. Therapists are professional and skilled, perfect pressure to release muscle tension. Staff are friendly and attentive, great value for money. Highly recommend to everyone visiting Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Karina Alcaraz
reviews.text:
This is one of the best spas I’ve ever been to! First, they welcome you with fresh local coconut water, which immediately sets the tone for the experience. I did a 60-minute foot massage (honestly, I should have booked 90 😭) and it was absolutely amazing.

This place truly takes care of every little detail, and on top of that, they serve local tea and kalamare at the end. Just wow — such a relaxing and thoughtful experience. Highly recommend if you’re in Chiang Mai!! I’m thinking of comming back later for an additional massage 🫀

reviews.name: Dayday Dai
reviews.text: This was hands down one of the best massages I’ve ever had. The hot stone treatment felt incredible and melted all my tension away. The masseuse was extremely kind, patient, and highly professional throughout the whole session. I left feeling completely relaxed and rejuvenated. Will definitely come back!

reviews.name: Jocelyn Eccles
reviews.text:
Had the most amazing massage here! Been backpacking south east Asia for 2 months now and have been on the go constantly so really wanted to relax.

Upon arrival I was warmly greeted by the staff (Foam, May and Nam) where they gave me a fresh coconut and a menu to choose a massage from. I went for a herbal oil back, neck and shoulder massage.

I then had my feet scrubbed and changed into sliders before going upstairs to change into garments, which were super comfy and I didn’t feel exposed at all.

My therapist (Fon) was excellent. She made me feel so comfortable and she gave a wonderful massage where I could talk to her about areas to work on and where to apply more or less pressure. Really tailoring the massage to my needs.

I also had a minor injury on my toe which was bandaged up and she very kindly cleaned and redressed the wound. She even braided my hair at the end of the massage!

At the end I had a warm herbal tea and a dried banana before sorting out payment. They take both card and cash. In total it cost THB 650 which is 14.87 in GBP! Super affordable!

I also got given a complimentary balm which they used during my massage. Before getting free transportation back to my accommodation.

No need to book! Would 100% recommend this place.

reviews.name: Azin B
reviews.text:
Super nice place. One of the best massage place. They have pick up drop of service. The massage was super nice
We chose 4hand oil massage and was spectacular. They receive you by cold coconut drink and they offer you final warm tea plus small balm as the gift. Super recommended.

reviews.name: 김가연이이이
reviews.text:
Very relaxing atmosphere and clean place.
The staff were very kind and the massage was amazing!
I had Thai massage for 1 hour and felt so refreshed afterward.
Definitely one of the best massage experiences in Chiang Mai. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Ana Lucía Vindas

reviews.text:

reviews.name: Cuphead Boomerang

reviews.name: Jessica wan
reviews.text:

The welcome drink is the coconut, I tried the hot stone and the facial,it's really relaxing. Recommend the facial, it hydrated my skin and relieved the stress.

You can choose pressure levels and also pick where to focus the massage on a piece of paper. You can tell them to use different pressure in different areas, basically customise your session. Do tell them where you're sore or injured so they can accommodate. Very neat! They supply you with drinking water, tea and snacks before and after your session.

I had 90 minutes of deep tissue massage and it was wonderful. They will tell you where your knots are.

A 90-minute deep tissue session sounds like exactly what you needed — we hope those knots have been well taken care of! 😄 We hope you come back and see us again 🌿 💚

The staff managed everything really well and we didn't have to wait long before being taken to our massage room. One thing I really appreciated was being able to choose the massage oil scent before the treatment. The shop was also very clean, they washed our feet before the massage, which made us feel comfortable and refreshed.Another thing I loved was the consultation form before the massage. We could choose which areas we wanted the therapist to focus on, how much extra time to spend on those areas and even which areas we preferred to avoid. It made the whole experience much more personalized and we didn't have to keep reminding the therapist during the massage.
Overall, everything was well set up and the massage was both professional and relaxing.. I’d happily recommend it to anyone who wants a good, chill experience.

Experience Breakdown
1. Start off with a welcome drink - Aroma butterfly tea
2. Select treatment option and pay at front desk. They take cash or credit card with a small fee.
3. Your therapist will kindly wash your feet before starting the treatment
4. Go upstairs and change into massage outfit that’s provided for you. Put your belongings into a basket.
5. Rest, relax and enjoy! Don’t be afraid to speak up and let your massage therapist know if you want your massage to be more strong.
6. Enjoy post massage tea and snack

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Absolutely phenomenal massage experience — the best we've had in years!
My wife and I visited Dellie Relax Spa and Massage after seeing their glowing 5-star reviews, and for once, the reviews truly lived up to the hype. From the moment we walked in, the hostess was warm, welcoming, and attentive to our specific request for strong foot massage pressure. She made sure we were paired with the right therapists — a gentleman for me and a lady for my wife — and both turned out to be absolutely exceptional.

My masseuse (the gentleman with the mustache) delivered deep, consistent, and incredibly strong kneading for the entire hour. I was amazed at the strength and stamina he maintained throughout. My wife shared the exact same sentiment about her masseuse (the lady with a tattoo) — both were clearly highly skilled and gave us massages that were therapeutic, relaxing, and deeply satisfying.

We've had massages across Thailand for years, but this experience easily tops them all. We left a generous tip as a token of our appreciation, but I also want to personally thank and recommend these two outstanding therapists. We truly hope to return again soon!

Highly recommend Dellie Relax — the 5 stars are well-earned and fully deserved.

reviews.name: Yu Wen
reviews.text:
Disclaimer: This review is entirely my own honest opinion — I was not offered, incentivised by, or promised any discounts, cashback, or freebies in exchange for leaving a positive review.
I cannot recommend this place highly enough! From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel genuinely welcomed. They are super friendly, incredibly caring, and completely professional — a rare combination that really sets this place apart.
The Thai massage itself? Absolutely out of this world. Hands down the best massage I have ever experienced in my life. The therapist was skilled beyond belief, hitting every pressure point with precision and care. I left feeling like a brand new person.
If you are on the fence about booking — just do it. You will not regret it. I will 100% be coming back!

reviews.name: Ramir De Castro
reviews.text:
If you are in Chiang Mai and need a break from the heat, the crowds, or just the general hustle of the Nimman area, do yourself a favor and head to the 4th floor of Maya Mall. I popped into Sakulthai Massage for what I thought would be a quick foot rub, but I left feeling like a completely new person.

The location is incredibly convenient (especially if you want to combine it with some shopping or a movie), but don’t let the mall setting fool you—the interior is clean, tranquil, and beautifully scented. The moment you walk in, the noise of the mall fades away.

I opted for a combination treatment: a Foot Massage followed by a Shoulder and Back rub. And here is where the real magic happened—I was lucky enough to get Tim as my therapist.

The Foot Massage:
Tim has incredible hands. She started with a thorough wash and scrub, but the real star was the pressure. She has an intuitive way of finding the exact knots in the arches of your feet. She doesn't just poke; she works the tension out methodically, moving from the heel up to the toes. It was firm enough to release the tightness from walking all day, yet gentle enough that I completely zoned out within the first ten minutes.

The Shoulder & Back Massage:
This was the game-changer. I carry a lot of stress in my upper traps, and Tim tackled the tightness with the precision of a surgeon. She used her thumbs and elbows to dig deep into the shoulder blades and the base of my neck, using just the right amount of Thai-style stretching. She clearly knows anatomy. She asked if the pressure was okay (it was perfect), but she also knew exactly when to push a little further to release a stubborn knot. I could literally feel the tension melting away.

The Vibe:
The overall ambiance was very relaxing—dim lighting, soft music, and a clean scent in the air. The best part? Tim works quietly but with a warm energy. She doesn’t chat excessively, allowing you to just drift off. By the end of the 90 minutes, I was in a blissful, hazy state of relaxation. My shoulders felt lighter, my feet felt brand new, and my mind was quiet.

Final Verdict:
Sakulthai at Maya Mall is a gem, but Tim is their secret weapon. If you go, I highly recommend requesting her specifically. Whether you are a tourist needing a break or a local looking for relief, this is a top-tier massage experience at a very reasonable price.

I left walking on clouds and will 100% be back before I leave Chiang Mai. Thank you, Tim!

reviews.name: Lee Chang Kai (Ck)
reviews.text: Had an amazing massage here today. The staff was incredibly welcoming, and the place was very clean and relaxing. The therapist really knew what they were doing and helped relieve all the tension in my shoulders. Highly recommend if you are in the area!

reviews.name: Lady Snow
reviews.text: Great massage with a skilled and professional therapist. The pressure was perfect, the place was clean and relaxing, and I felt completely refreshed afterward. Highly recommended if you’re around Nimman!

reviews.name: Santiago Gómez Mejía
reviews.text:
Really good place we found online! We will happily come back, it’s perfect after a day of walking around Chiangmai or any outdoor trip you are having here.

This location is convenient because there’s a lot of food options around or for shopping.

reviews.name: L W
reviews.text:

The massage was inconsistent, the place is old. I had to cut my own massage 10min early because it was just not nice. There therapist was kind but she just didnt do a good massage. In my opinion, this place doesnt deserve 4.9 rating with so many reviews. It’s not terrible. But maybe 3.9.

reviews.name: Jinq Shiuan Teng
reviews.text: Very nice experience! Walk for a whole day and had a really lower back pain. After the massage, it feels so much released! Friendly staffs!

reviews.name: MK Leong
reviews.text: Was searching for top rated massage place and found this. From photos they looked good. So we took a 10 minutes taxi over. The staff are very welcoming and they explained in detail the different packages offered. Then come to the real experience. My masseur was good, she's professional and the strength is top notch, right on point 👉🏻 👍🏻. I was placed in an individual room and changed my attire. Overall experience was awesome. I love it. We were served with cold drink and wet wipes when we enter while leaving, they served us hot bael fruit drink and also rice crackers! Really good service and importantly the massuer is good. Will come again when I am in chiang mai. For the price they offer vs the service, is worth. My shoulder & back massage for 1.5 hours is 525bath. Worth 👍🏻

reviews.name: Ryan Ren
reviews.text: Had very good body message with herbal balm. I really like the tiger balm smell, relaxing and chilled. Highly recommended if you stay nearby.

reviews.name: Stella Hu

reviews.name: Ekaterina Maksudova

reviews.name: Ann

reviews.name: Supharoek Laophong
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Had a wonderful experience at Zira Spa Chiang Mai. From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by the beautiful and peaceful atmosphere. The place is elegantly decorated in a Lanna style, very clean, and perfect for relaxation.

The massage was excellent. The therapist was highly professional, with the perfect pressure, helping to relieve my muscle tension completely. I felt so refreshed and relaxed afterward.

The staff provided outstanding service, very attentive and welcoming throughout the entire visit.

Overall, it was definitely worth it. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Chiang Mai and looking for a high-quality spa experience.

reviews.name: Phongsatorn K.
reviews.text:
I visited Zira Spa for two days — on the first day I had a 2-hour Thai & hot oil massage, and on the second day a 3-hour body scrub & hot oil massage. Overall, the experience was quite good and relaxing.

However, on my first visit, the reception area was quite busy, and the staff didn’t seem to know what kind of base oil was being used. There was also a small mix-up with the room assignment, and I was brought to an occupied room due to miscommunication. Despite that, the receptionist remained polite and gentle.

For the therapists, even though I had the same spa menu on both days, the massage styles and procedures were noticeably different, with some steps missing. The treatment rooms were also a bit too cold — I asked the therapist several times to adjust the temperature, but it didn’t improve much.

On the positive side, both therapists I met were skilled, kind, and made me feel relaxed. The overall ambiance was pleasant. The only small detail was the goodbye drink and amenities — on the first day I received a drink, cupcake, and towel, but on the second day, the cupcake was missing without any notice.

In general, I still recommend Zira Spa for its good service and professional therapists, but a bit more consistency and attention to small details would make the experience even better.

reviews.name: Lennin
reviews.text:
I had such a great experience at ZIRA SPA. The place is very aesthetic and relaxing—the ambiance really helps you unwind the moment you walk in. The staff are all friendly and welcoming, making you feel comfortable right away.

I especially want to mention Tee, who did an amazing job. You can really feel the authentic massage techniques, and the level of care and professionalism is impressive.

Overall, their service is excellent, and I would definitely recommend this place if you’re looking for a quality and relaxing spa experience.

reviews.name: Stuart March
reviews.text:
A lovely experience at Zira Spa, receiving one of the spa packages.

Came the day before to discuss treatments options, very professional, knowledge and helpful staff. Explain what each step of the treatment would look like to make sure I was happy and comfortable.

Following day I had the treatment. Beautiful decor and building, staff are highly skilled and every part of the process what clear and gave you choice and discussion to make sure everything was comfortable and enjoyable.

Highly recommend visiting this spa when you’re in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Daniel Blanco
reviews.text: Amazing experience!!! FANTÁSTICO. The place is gorgeous, the treat is superior. The therapist Nice is great ! What a fantastic experience for your travel to Chiang Mai! If you visit the city do not forget to visit Zira Spa! 10 out of 10!

We had a massage from Phueng and Ya for 90 min and 120 min. From the reception & booking to the actual massage, everything was satisfactory. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: jiaqi Jiang
reviews.text: Great Thai massage by Ya! Her technique was strong and firm, which was exactly what I needed. My back feels so much better now. Highly recommend her if you like a deep, powerful massage. A perfect experience before leaving Thailand!

reviews.text: From the moment you walk in and all the way to the end the experience is exceptional. We were greeted with juice and fruit before meeting our therapists who were generous and kind. Nana was very gentle which was requested and I appreciated her kindness throughout the experience. My boyfriend and I were able to get our treatments in the same room. He was with Wawa, who gave him a thorough massage and he was very satisfied with the experience given he is an athlete. Definitely recommend this place for a relaxing and refreshing escape!

reviews.name: Clarice
reviews.text: We had a 3.5 hour spa session here for my mum’s birthday and it was truly a luxe experience! The receptionist explained our treatment well and the masseuse did a great job ensuring we were pampered and relaxed. I appreciate the small touches like putting a small cushion for our feet when facing down or preparing the warm water before we showered, as well as checking in to ensure we were comfortable. We did a body scrub and Lanna Colonial, and our favourite part was definitely the thai massage. It kneaded away at our fatigued bodies but it was not as intense as the Bangkok style, and we even dozed off! Highly recommended, do make a booking in advance.

reviews.name: Kacper Grabski
reviews.text:
If you are currently scrolling through Google Maps in Chiang Mai trying to figure out which massage spot to pick (because there are literally hundreds of them), you can stop looking and just come here. We honestly chose Refresh Thai Massage simply because of the sheer volume of positive reviews we saw online, and I am so happy to report that we were not disappointed in the slightest.
I went for the traditional Thai massage, which was priced at 300 Baht—an incredible value considering the quality of the treatment I received. I have to give a massive shout-out to my therapist. The massage was very intense, exactly how a real Thai massage should be, but it wasn't just brute force. She worked with amazing intuition and "feeling." It was almost as if she knew exactly where my problem areas and knots were without me having to say a word. She applied pressure precisely where it was needed, finding that perfect balance where it hurts a little bit but feels absolutely amazing afterwards.
Beyond the massage itself, the service was top-tier. The staff were genuinely friendly and welcoming from the moment we walked in. The atmosphere is very relaxing, and I particularly appreciated the music selection; it was soothing and really helped me zone out, which isn't always the case at some other busy shops.
To top it all off, after the session ended, we were treated to some lovely warm tea and cookies. It was such a nice, gentle way to wake up and "come back to earth" before heading back out into the heat. We will definitely be coming back before we leave Chiang Mai!

reviews.text:
Long Trekking Recovery – 90 mins:
Really enjoyed my experience at SAMA Onsen. The place was beautiful, clean and very relaxing from the moment we arrived. I chose the Long Trekking Recovery massage and it was exactly what I needed after a few days of travelling and walking around Phuket. The therapist was professional and the pressure was just right. I felt so much lighter and more relaxed afterwards. The staff were also very friendly and welcoming. Definitely worth the visit and I would happily come back again!

Body Scrub & Aromatherapy Massage – 90 mins:
Such a relaxing experience! The body scrub left my skin feeling really smooth and refreshed, followed by a very calming aromatherapy massage. Everything felt well organised and the treatment room was clean, comfortable and private. The therapist was attentive and professional throughout the session. I also really loved the peaceful atmosphere of the spa. A lovely place to unwind in Phuket and definitely one I would recommend.

I was also on my period during the treatment, and I really appreciated that I could still go ahead with it comfortably. Everything was handled professionally and I felt completely at ease throughout.

reviews.name: srujana Srujana
reviews.text:
🌿 For Indians Visiting Phuket & Unsure About Thai Massages — My Honest Review
If you’re visiting Phuket and feeling scared or confused about which spa is safe and genuine, I totally understand — I was the same! But I found Sama Onsen Massages, and it turned out to be one of the best experiences of our trip.
We took the Couple Onsen Relaxology Massage, and the whole environment was super clean, peaceful, and classy (sharing pictures for assurance).
What I loved the most is that we could choose the oil type and the pressure level exactly the way we wanted.
I was SO happy with their service that I even took an extra 60-minute foot massage, and honestly that was amazing too!
If you want a safe, respectful, and truly relaxing Thai massage in Phuket, this place is a big YES from me. 💯✨

reviews.name: Catarina
reviews.text:
I booked a 100-minute Head Spa treatment and didn’t really know what to expect, since it was my first time — but it turned out to be an amazing experience.
Besides the head treatment itself, I also received a full facial cleansing including a face mask. There were also short massages on my arms, hands, shoulders, and neck.

My therapist, May, was fantastic — kind, gentle, and she checked in several times to make sure everything was okay.
After the treatment my hair was completely wet, and I initially thought I would have to leave like that — but I was wrong. They blow-dried and styled my hair just like at a hair salon.

At the end, I was served tea and a small, delicious snack.
100% recommended.

reviews.name: Phillip
reviews.text:
I booked a head massage expecting mainly a scalp treatment, but the experience turned out to be much more than that — in a very positive way. A large part of the session was actually a full facial treatment, and even though it wasn’t what I initially imagined, it was incredibly relaxing.
My skin looked clean, fresh and glowing afterwards.

The atmosphere is calm and beautifully designed — perfect for switching off and enjoying the moment. We had two therapists, May and Ning, and both were fantastic: attentive, skilled and very gentle throughout the entire treatment.

One small thing to mention: at the end, they used cold facial massage tools (almost like ice globes). They were extremely cold, and a quick heads-up beforehand would have been nice. Apart from that, everything was perfect.

To finish the treatment, they served a small dessert, which was delicious — such a thoughtful touch.

Overall: a great experience, super relaxing, and I left with my face feeling incredibly clean and refreshed. Definitely worth the visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review!
We’re so happy to hear that you enjoyed the full head and facial treatment experience with our therapists May and Ning. We truly appreciate your kind words about our atmosphere and service.

Thank you also for your helpful feedback regarding the cold facial tools — we’ll make sure to inform our guests in advance next time. We’re so glad you loved the dessert and thoughtful details too.

Hope to welcome you back again soon for another relaxing moment at SEA Massage & Head Spa 🌿
