reviews.name: Daniel Palmer
reviews.text:
burnt me three times with gel heater

over priced did no foot care  just cut nails ( badly ) and still left with dry feet absolute wast of money

* added to review after response

Here is a firm, professional, and educated response you can post. I kept it clear, factual, and authoritative, especially since you work in the beauty industry

Thank you for responding, however several points in your reply are not factually correct.

At no point during our visit were we offered, or informed about, any optional add-ons such as a foot scrub or dead skin removal. If that had been explained or offered, we would have absolutely added it to the service. The description you have provided in your response does not reflect what actually occurred during our appointment.

Additionally, your interpretation of how the service proceeded is also inaccurate. During the gel curing process the lamp burned my skin multiple times. I informed the technician each time this happened, however the issue continued. This is not a minor discomfort, it is a safety concern and should have been addressed immediately.

There was also a further safety issue when we were leaving the premises. The hallway floor was flooded with water and extremely slippery, to the point where we nearly slipped and injured ourselves.

As someone who works in the beauty industry myself, I have a very clear understanding of professional service standards and client care. Unfortunately the experience we had did not meet those standards.

Your response continuing to deny these events only reinforces the unprofessional nature of the experience we encountered.

I hope you take this feedback seriously and use it to improve both your service procedures and your approach to client communication moving forward.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are genuinely sorry to hear that you left feeling disappointed, as this is never the experience we want for our customers.

We would like to respectfully clarify the details of your visit. The service selected was Pedicure + Gel Removal + Gel Color. We have informed you that our pedicure service includes trimming, shaping, and cleaning the nails. It does not include foot scrub or dead skin removal. At the beginning, our team clearly explained this and offered the option to add a foot scrub treatment. You confirmed that you wished to proceed without adding this service.

Regarding the gel nail dryer, our receptionist had informed the technician that you may have sensitive skin, so extra care was taken throughout the process. Our technician double checked with you to ensure you were comfortable, and each time you confirmed that everything was okay. That said, we truly appreciate your feedback and will take it as a valuable reference to further improve our service and communication in the future. 

Thank you again for your feedback and have a nice day

The masseuse (Lucky) was so professional. From her massage, you can tell that she had years of experience. No regrets looking forward to her massage. Special mention to (May) and (Toi) too.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! We are absolutely thrilled to hear you had a tremendously wonderful experience with your oil massage and body scrub at CCare! Thank you for having no regrets—we are already looking forward to your next massage! 🙌✨

reviews.name: Shida Hisham
reviews.text:

reviews.name: Lyn de Cadiz
reviews.text: I always walk here to have a massage because it's not too far from my location. But if you're in the area, try it out. The ladies provide great service. Had never been disappointed. Would recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback and recommendation. We’re pleased to know you consistently enjoy our service and appreciate your continued visits.

reviews.name: swetha
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at C Care Massage! Poi was my therapist, and she was absolutely outstanding. She is incredibly skilled, professional, and has such a fun sense of humor that made the whole experience even more enjoyable.

Everyone on the staff was warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind. The massage was relaxing, therapeutic, and exactly what I needed after a long day of traveling. If you’re looking for an authentic Thai massage in Bangkok, I highly recommend C Care Massage. I’ll definitely be back the next time I’m in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely appreciate your thoughtful feedback and recommendation. It’s wonderful to know that Poi provided an excellent massage experience with both professionalism and genuine care. We’re also pleased that our team created a warm and welcoming atmosphere for your visit. We look forward to welcoming you back for another authentic Thai massage experience in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Akshay Nandakumar
reviews.text:
I got the relaxing oil massage. Honestly the place is very good place to get a relaxing massage. The masseuse ‘Som’ really put in so much effort to give a relaxing massage.

She was careful while doing every part of the body and also asked before doing it. She also stretched me after asking. Which was really welcome as I had gone to the gym.

Really good and relaxing experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Like calm waves washing away fatigue, Som’s careful touch brought you back to balance 🌿💫 We’re so happy her gentle strength and mindful care made your visit so refreshing 💖 Thank you for the beautiful words!

reviews.name: Mary Love Gayta
reviews.text: This place is wonderful, it was very clean!! The staff were very good, therapist listed to your request. I will recommend this place if you want a massage in Asok area.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It means a lot to hear that you had such a great visit! We’re happy our team made you feel comfortable and took care of your requests. Thank you for sharing your recommendation—we’d love to see you again whenever you’re in Asok! 😊

we visited without any appointment and they said they're fully booked and they asked different massage shops to call two massagers to support us. my bf began and I was still waiting my turn but they said one massager is not enough at that time and I needed to wait for more than 20 mins -I guess it might be the peak time- so I gave it up and I told them no worries and was waiting for my bf but they cared me and said sorry a lot, even they provided me extra service...🥹 I was really okay, and I understand they're so busy, famous and popular shop but cared the customers with real warm heart. thank you so much for the warm service!!!

Thanks a lot all!! 😙
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Even when the chairs are full and the clock is ticking, we believe there’s always time for warm care 💖 Thank you for your patience and kindness — and for recognizing Ms. Nok’s heart 🌿✨ We can’t wait to welcome you again, hopefully with no waiting at all!

reviews.text:
We went to try Thai massage after seeing their good Google reviews, and it was great!
The women use their elbows and so many different techniques to massage your whole body.

We actually went back the very next day for foot massage, and it’s been so amazing!
Great place to get massage at very affordable price!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Two days in a row—that's the ultimate compliment! We are thrilled our team could work their magic on your lower back and give you a fantastic foot massage. Thanks for loving the value and service, and see you next time!

reviews.name: Ankur Shukla

Annie did my massage and her technique is so good. I felt relieved and relaxed. Bonus points - she talks well and is a sweet person.

C care salon is hygienic and welcoming.
Keep up the good work girls

Consider your battery 100% recharged—the girls and the entire C Care team will be right here waiting to welcome you back for your next refresh! 🚀

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re so glad you had a great experience with the body scrub and oil massage! Thank you for recommending us—we hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Sandy
reviews.text: The massage centre is clean and masseur Aning is very attentive and good. I had a long day with neck and shoulder pain.. her massage release all the tension on my neck area, very good. Will recommend my family and friends here

reviews.name: Duy Đăng
reviews.text:
So good I was literally crying while getting it done 😭😭

Shoutout to the two insanely adorable girls working the 10:30 PM shift on August 15th. We were probably the most annoying customers ever because my friend and I have dangerously high levels of silliness, so we kept laughing way too loudly during the foot scrub 😭 And my face is so long that I probably used up half the shop’s cucumber supply for the face mask, and every time I laughed, I literally shook all of them off 😂 When one of them tied my hair up, I even took a selfie pretending I was about to lose my damn eye from how good it felt 😭😭

We were THAT annoying, yet they were still so sweet, patient, and supportive the whole time. And honestly, I’m from Vietnam, where massages are already pretty good, but these girls somehow gave me what felt like THE BEST MASSAGE OF MY LIFE.

I don’t even know their names, but I LOVE this place so much. I’m 100% coming back next time 😭🫶

And I’m SO sorry because the last order was at 10:30 PM and I literally walked in at 10:32 PM… I genuinely thought you guys were gonna slap me in the face during the massage just to get some revenge but you were still SO CUTE about it and took me in anyway 😭

I loved it. Hihi. Thank you so much 🥹❤️

reviews.text: Came here 3 out of my 4 nights in Bangkok! Such a hidden gem; Every single masseuse worked their magic and did wonders for my sore feet and achy shoulders. The bael tea after the massage is such a treat! Can’t recommend this place enough. Great pricing and great ambiance.

reviews.text: Tucked in the middle of the residential estate, the price is affordable + has very good service! They open till late at night and there wasn’t a huge crowd. Lovely place to get massage, 10/10! Not to forget the cats around the area!!

reviews.name: Kristy AKI Oshiro
reviews.text:
Got a 1.5 hr Thai Massage for 350 thb and it was AMAZING. They wash your feet first in warm water and then lead you upstairs to change into a top and bottom clothes to wear during massage.

The masseuse uses their whole body to massage and stretch your whole body while lying on back, lying on front, lying on back while resting on pillow on masseuse's lap and then sitting up.

They serve you a delightful hot and sweet tea after. Will definitely return! The sweet tortoise shell kitty cat is a nice bonus to the experience if you're lucky to meet them. : )

reviews.name: Artur Pytel
reviews.text: I found this place based on Google reviews, it was just 50m from my hostel. Place is simple, massage was done on a mattress by a women, she was small but pretty strong, she used her body to make lever during massage which was very efficient. After spending almost 1 month in Laos on treking and other physical activities, I really needed such strong massage. After massage they offer you very tasty and sweet tea.

People in the lobby and walking by on the stairway kept talking to my massuse and so she would talk back to them.  It was the least relaxing massage I have ever had.

reviews.name: Catcat Meowmeow
reviews.text:
I came here with my partner. I got oil massage and she got Thai massage, from professional young ladies. I got it from Waii, and she got it from New. We both thought it is the best massage we had in Thailand. We tested a few more massage places around Thailand (Bangkok, Phuket and Chiang Mai), and found some great massages from some very experienced women, and we did a massage course. However, on our last day we had to come back again to JJ One Thai Massage and get another massage from New and Waii. We both got a foot/oil 2 hour combo. My opinion is Waii is the best! Gentle personality, young, tall, and very strong, she uses more techniques than all the other masseuses I had. My partner was also happy with her masseuse, New.

The atmosphere in the shop is perfect. The music is very quiet and soothing acoustic cover songs, and not that annoying water sound effects on repeat in so many shops. The lights are very dark, so you can relax your eyes. The aircon is not too cold. The shop is in a quiet alleyway so there is not much noise outside. The staff all whisper, and speak softly, rather than yell and laugh as in some other places. I would come back often if I was living in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Ariadna Fuentes
reviews.text: Highly recommended! Great massage, nice people and very good prices! You can easily go by walk from the old town, don’t get discouraged about the streets where it’s located, the place is really nice. We got a feet massage and a head/neck massage, it was probably the best ever!

title: HEAD FEEL GOOD
ownerDescription: Nestled in the heart of Bangkok, Head Feel Good is a sanctuary for those seeking ultimate relaxation and rejuvenation. Indulge in transformative Thai head spa treatments, skillfully designed to alleviate stress, promote restful sleep, and restore vitality to your mind and body. Our expert therapists utilize premium products from Philip B and Phyto to nurture both scalp and soul. Immerse yourself in our soothing atmosphere, enhanced by luxurious amenities such as OSIM massage chairs and the latest Dyson air systems. Located in the Chitlom district, Head Feel Good provides an oasis of serenity, inviting you to experience tranquility, release tension, and embark on a blissful journey of wellness from head to toe.

reviews.name: Joycelyn Teh
reviews.text:
Husband stumbled upon this salon and told me about it. Went in to check, prices I think were reasonable but they do charge based on length of hair. My medium length hair was priced at THB 1,670 for a 60-minute session. Made a reservation to visit for the next day.

It probably wasn’t too busy on a weekday so I was able to reschedule my 8pm slot to a 2.30pm on a Thursday. Upon arrival, was told to make payment in full after being served a glass of cold Butterfly Pea Tea.

Then was brought in to a room to start my head spa session. Although it was just hair wash and blow, this was luxury. The therapist was incredible with her fingers. The massage includes your head, scalp, neck, shoulder and hands.

After the massage and wash, I was led to another room for my blowout. Another tea of my choice was served together with some sweet bites. There was also an iPad brought to you with Netflix on so you can watch a show while the hair stylists blow your hair.

The place smells great and all rooms were tiny and clean! Definitely will visit again.

title: Space Waterpark
address: XV3P+9VM, 888, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

reviews.name: Linor M
reviews.text: The Space Waterpark is a great water park located inside the hotel, making it very convenient for families. It's especially ideal for children up to around 11 years old, with fun water slides, tube rides, splash areas, and plenty to keep them entertained for hours. Our kids absolutely loved it and didn't want to leave! The park is clean, well-maintained, and the staff were friendly. A great addition to the hotel and highly recommended for families with young children. 🌊🎢💙

reviews.name: PTT NBL
reviews.text: The space hotel is truly out of this world! The unique design really captures the essence of feeling like you're in outer space. The quality of the materials used in the rooms is excellent, and the public spaces are thoughtfully designed. The water stream feature adds a nice touch, creating a relaxing atmosphere. The Kids Club and Game Room are fantastic amenities, especially when traveling with children. The fun gimmick of receiving coin tokens adds an extra layer of enjoyment to our stay. Highly recommended for a memorable stay!

reviews.name: Irene B
reviews.text: This water park is situated within Grand Center Point Space hotel. I believe it is only accessible to hotel guests - u will need a fabric wrist band to enter the water park, to be worn at all times. The water park size is bigger than average hotel pools but smaller than a stand alone water park. Highlights are  lazy river, foam pool and water sliders for kids (taller than 120cm). There are different activities all day e.g. rafting, bingo game in the pool. The water park is kept clean and has good security - plenty of life guards and life jackets. Overall, a joyful experience for everyone in the family!

reviews.name: Vu Nguyen
reviews.text:
This is a great water park. Better than most I’ve been to. It’s a great achievement considering it’s inside the city and vicinity of the hotel.
As guests you have access, they give you disposable bands to wear to get in.
Lots of options to play around including a lazy river. Good breeze and airflow through the park.
Part of the park could be taken for event. From here you can also access Astro room and there is kids room.
Don’t miss this one if you staying here.

reviews.name: LJ
reviews.text:
Great waterpark.  Definitely check in on time to maximize your time here!
Lazy river has a great current that pulls you along and you can actually relax and float.
Lifeguards are actively watching and engaging with kids.
Parents can rent a "Nest" from Let's Relax Spa and hang out in a cooled pod with a massage chair :)
Clearly separated young child waterplay area + sandbox + small play ground.
2 slides.
Space Pirate Beach area has wave pool and snack bar.
Mini golf area costs 1 token (receive a few with room checkin).
Tokens can also be used at snack bar and space shop.
Adding: might sound silly but I was impressed that the tiles used around water park did not get too hot. Perfect for walking barefoot between areas. Hard to find in Thailand lol.

reviews.name: BB Thanitsara
reviews.text: Went there on holiday, the service is great you will get free token to exchange for gifts! Kids would definitely love this place!! The (fake)wave is so good!! Safety guards are everywhere, breakfast line is huge, bed is comfy, its just perfect for family trip

reviews.name: Marc Chow
reviews.text:

If you are a family with kids, you may need to spare much more time to enjoy the park.

Will be back for next time.

The price is definitely worth the stay and if you like to go out, the Pattaya night-life is just a short taxi ride away.

reviews.name: Vachintha Piyadasa
reviews.text: MBK Center is one of the most iconic shopping destinations in Bangkok and a great place for both tourists and locals. The mall offers a huge variety of shops ranging from fashion, electronics, mobile accessories, souvenirs, cosmetics, and much more, all at reasonable prices. It’s a perfect spot for bargain shopping and exploring different local products under one roof. The food options are excellent as well, with plenty of restaurants, cafés, and food courts serving both Thai and international cuisine. The atmosphere is always lively and energetic, making the shopping experience enjoyable. The mall is spacious, clean, and directly connected to the BTS National Stadium station, making it very convenient to visit. Whether you’re looking for shopping, food, entertainment, or simply a place to spend a few hours in Bangkok, MBK Center is definitely worth visiting. A classic Bangkok shopping experience that never disappoints.

reviews.name: Anova Fatimah
reviews.text:
The last time I visited was in 2024, and coming back in 2026 felt like visiting a completely different place. The biggest change is the new pedestrian area in front of the mall, above the highway and beneath the train tracks. It wasn’t there before, and now it brings the area to life with street performers singing and playing instruments.
Inside, the mall is packed with hundreds of small shops selling everything from clothing and accessories to electronics and unique souvenirs. The magnets especially stand out for their creativity and affordable prices.
If you enjoy exploring, bargain hunting, and discovering unique finds, this place is definitely worth visiting.

reviews.name: Ro han
reviews.text:
MBK Center is honestly one of my favorite spots in Bangkok. With over 2,000 shops spread across 7 floors, you can easily spend half a day here without even realizing it. From clothes, phone accessories, souvenirs to street food — everything is under one roof and the prices are really wallet-friendly.
The best part? You can bargain! Unlike most malls, haggling is totally normal here and if you do it with a smile, vendors are usually happy to give you a good deal.
The Thai Food Court on the 6th floor is a must-try — super affordable, authentic, and delicious. Great for a quick sit-down between shopping rounds.
Getting here is easy too — just hop off at National Stadium BTS and you're basically already inside.
Not the fanciest mall in Bangkok, but that's not the point. It's fun, chaotic in the best way, and full of character. Definitely worth a visit!

reviews.name: Neville Chesan
reviews.text: Highly Overrated Now! Back in the days it was a one-stop mall for everyone and everything... but as of today it's just hotspot for tourist shopping. Prices are marked up by almost 10x on all items, and tourists get ripped off royally.

reviews.name: OnSite
reviews.text: Came here to shop and ended up spending way more time than planned. There is a huge variety of stores selling everything from clothes and souvenirs to electronics and random finds. Prices are generally reasonable and you can still bargain in some shops. It gets crowded, but that is part of the experience. A good place to explore if you want a mix of shopping, food, and people watching.

reviews.name: Samin Fardin
reviews.text: Honestly, MBK is an absolute classic. It’s not your typical high-end, shiny luxury mall like Paragon across the street—it’s more like a massive, air-conditioned street market split across several floors. If you're looking for cheap elephant pants, souvenirs, or random clothing, the 3rd floor "Shopping Street" is gold. Make sure you head up to the Food Legend food court on the upper floors for a cheap, authentic Thai lunch. It gets a bit chaotic and it's easy to get lost, but that’s honestly half the fun. Directly connected to the National Stadium BTS, so it's super easy to get to.

reviews.name: Mohammed Sohail Ahmed
reviews.text: It's truly one of Bangkok’s most iconic shopping destinations and a place that offers far more than just shopping. Spread across multiple floors, the mall houses an enormous variety of stores, ranging from fashion, accessories, and souvenirs to electronics, gadgets, cosmetics, and everyday essentials. Whether you are looking for affordable items, unique gifts, or branded products, the sheer range of options makes the experience enjoyable and engaging. What makes MBK stand out is the balance it offers between variety, convenience, and value for money. Unlike many malls that focus only on luxury brands, MBK caters to all kinds of shoppers and budgets. There is always something interesting to discover, and browsing through the different sections never feels monotonous. Many stores offer competitive prices, making it an excellent place for bargain hunters as well. Despite the constant activity and large crowds, the mall remains well organized and easy to navigate. The atmosphere is vibrant and energetic, reflecting the fast-paced charm of Bangkok itself, yet it never feels overwhelmingly chaotic. The facilities are well maintained, clean, and comfortable, allowing visitors to spend hours exploring without inconvenience. The dining options are another major highlight. From quick snacks and cafés to full meals featuring both Thai and international cuisine, there is no shortage of choices. It makes the entire visit even more enjoyable, especially after spending hours walking through the many floors. Its central location and excellent connectivity through Bangkok’s public transport make visiting extremely convenient for both tourists and locals. MBK Center delivers a complete experience by combining shopping, dining, entertainment, and convenience under one roof, making it a destination that genuinely lives up to its reputation.

reviews.name: Sachin Kundra
reviews.text:
MBK Center in Bangkok is one of the most vibrant and budget-friendly shopping destinations in the city. Unlike the more upscale malls, MBK offers a lively, local-market vibe combined with the comfort of an air-conditioned shopping complex. It’s especially great for tourists looking for affordable fashion, accessories, souvenirs, and electronics all under one roof.

The mall has multiple floors, each dedicated to different categories, making it easy to explore. You’ll find everything from trendy clothes and phone accessories to luggage and handicrafts. Bargaining is common in many shops, which adds to the fun if you enjoy negotiating prices. The electronics section is particularly popular, though it’s important to compare prices and check product authenticity before buying.

Food options are also excellent, with a large food court offering a wide variety of Thai and international dishes at reasonable prices. It’s a great place to try local flavors without spending too much.

Overall, MBK Center is perfect for budget shoppers and those looking for a more authentic Bangkok shopping experience. It may not be as polished as luxury malls, but its energy, variety, and affordability make it a must-visit.

reviews.name: Kostas Sarakinos
reviews.text:
Great shopping mall with an impressive variety of stores and excellent value for money. You can find everything from electronics and clothing to souvenirs and local products, all in one place. The atmosphere is lively and enjoyable, making it a great spot to spend a few hours browsing and exploring.

Prices are very reasonable compared to many other malls, and there are plenty of food and drink options to take a break and recharge. Convenient location with easy access, and overall a very pleasant shopping experience.

Highly recommended for both tourists and locals looking for good deals and a wide selection.

reviews.name: AL Franklin
reviews.text:
4⭐️
The malls here are next level. MBK is definitely a place you will not leave without buying something. Each booth is trying to call you over and get you to spend money there. But that’s to be expected. You will find any and everything you need though. Definitely recommend stopping by here!

reviews.name: Mohamed Aslam
reviews.text: What an amazing mall MBK is! This was my first time visiting, even though I’ve been to Bangkok more than a dozen times. I really liked it mainly because of the cheap clothing options and the huge variety of food choices. I ended up coming here five times during my stay in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Octavia Ridgeway
reviews.text: MBK Center really feels like a classic stop for anyone visiting Bangkok. I liked how much variety there is in one place, from souvenir stalls to custom clothing and all the usual tourist shopping options. It can get a bit overwhelming, but that is part of the fun. If you want a busy, packed shopping experience, this is definitely worth checking out.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Review for MBK Center, Thailand

A must-visit shopping destination in Bangkok! MBK Center has a huge variety of shops, from clothes and electronics to souvenirs and local products. Prices are reasonable, and there are plenty of food options to choose from. The mall is spacious, easy to explore, and conveniently connected to the BTS Skytrain. Great place for shopping, dining, and experiencing the lively atmosphere of Bangkok. Highly recommended! 😊🇹🇭🛍️

reviews.name: abpa2010
reviews.text: Huge mall with absolutely everything. Can spend the whole day here. Lots of food outlets. Diverse range of merchandise high end and budget friendly. Easy access from national stadium bts.

reviews.name: Nanda Sundri
reviews.text:
MBK Center in Bangkok is a popular shopping mall known for its affordable prices and lively market atmosphere. Open daily from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM and directly connected to BTS National Stadium station, it offers a convenient shopping experience. The mall has 8 floors: the Ground Floor features restaurants, cafés, and cosmetics; the 1st and 2nd floors focus on fashion, accessories, and Thai handicrafts with common bargaining; the 3rd and 4th floors are dedicated to electronics; the 5th floor offers lifestyle services like salons and massage centers… we had a massage at Labella and were very happy with the price and service.
The 6th floor hosts a food court with diverse Thai dishes… we tried the hotpot at Shudaxia 😋
The upper floors provide entertainment with a cinema and gaming areas. MBK Center combines shopping, dining, and entertainment, making it a must-visit destination in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Farang Orry
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for designer-inspired bags, watches, clothing, and other replicas, MBK Center is definitely one of the best places in Bangkok to browse. One tip: shop around before buying anything. I was quoted 8,000 baht for a bag at one stall, but found the exact same one just two floors down for 2,000 baht. Prices vary wildly, so don’t be afraid to negotiate and compare.

The only downside for me was how pushy many of the vendors can be. Walking through the aisles often meant being repeatedly called over or encouraged to come into different shops, which took away from an otherwise fun shopping experience.

Overall, it’s a great place to explore if you enjoy bargain hunting—just be patient, compare prices, and don’t jump on the first offer.

reviews.name: Ahmad Almoosawi
reviews.text:
MBK Center is one of Bangkok’s most popular shopping destinations and a great place to experience a more local and lively side of the city. The mall has an enormous variety of shops, from fashion and souvenirs to electronics, mobile phones, beauty products, restaurants, cafés, and local Thai products.

I especially liked the wide range of choices and the lively atmosphere. It’s also conveniently located right next to the BTS National Stadium, making it very easy to reach.

It can get quite crowded and busy, especially during peak hours, but that is also part of the MBK experience. Overall, a great place for shopping, exploring, and finding good deals. Definitely worth a visit when in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Alicia Brant
reviews.text: This mall is huge. It is decorated outside allowing for photo opportunities. Inside there are several escalators to help you get from floor to floor as well as elevator s. There is plenty of shopping: a floor for electronics, clothes, and jewelry to name a few. They also have a floor for salon and massage services. We even found a post office to mail our postcards home.

reviews.name: Tara Vallenius
reviews.text:
MBK Center is a fantastic shopping destination with an incredible variety of stores. Whether you're looking for clothes, electronics, souvenirs, beauty products, or great food, there's truly something for everyone. It's easy to spend hours exploring, and the prices are often very reasonable.

The only downside was the aggressive sales approach from some vendors selling imitation designer bags and other counterfeit products. Being constantly approached and pressured to buy took away from an otherwise enjoyable experience.

The so-called "Secret Room" for designer bags felt awful. It's definitely something I would skip on a future visit.

reviews.text:

Thank you so much 🙏🏻❤️

Small tip:
Don’t listen to the random stories some tuktuk drivers across the street like to tell - such as claims that Serene works with hotels or that the massages here are “not good.”
That’s simply not true. Do yourself a favor and come here directly.

reviews.name: lijing wang
reviews.text: I came for an aroma oil sport massage. I regularly go to the gym so I wanted something to relax my muscles. During the massage, the masseuse was too rough when maneuvering my back, and I could hear cracking noises in my spine. The next day, my lower back was so painful that I couldn’t sleep, sit, bend or move properly. It was quite unbearable. When I got to the next destination, I couldn’t handle the pain so I had to seek out a physiotherapist who diagnosed me with a herniated nucleus pulposus. After three visits and having to spend 5000 Baht, my lower back is starting to feel better. Had I not gone for a massage at this place I would have avoided all the pain, not had to spend all this extra money, and be able to enjoy my holiday and do the activities I planned. Because of this, I was not able to swim, walk far or go hiking which meant I spent most of my holiday in bed. Really inconvenient. The masseuse seems to be untrained, so I wouldn’t recommend going here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
I am sorry to hear that. As usually we will provide normal level as per standard. And no one has been hurt after massaging.
If it is too hard you could tell our therapist to adjust the level of massage while we were massaging. We are willing to adjust as per your request. 

After massage, little painful may be occur if body have muscle problem but usually It will be better within 2-3 days. 

Thank you so much. I am apologize for this issue.

This place is Highly recommended and I will be back again for sure!! Thank you so much for your kind and great hospitality🙏🏻❤️

reviews.name: Aliaa Zulkifli
reviews.text: The best massage you’ll ever get, hands down! The ladies are so kind and they will keep asking if the pressure is up to your liking. They speak good english, as much as you can understand. Very clean space. Try them and if theres a wait, its worth the wait, the space is small but they are so good. Tell them where you’ll having your stress and they’ll work it out. I didnt tell her but from what I can gather, she knows where my tension point was and really helped me to ease that pain, its the best.

reviews.name: Mini
reviews.text: The best massage I ever have (so far) in Bangkok and I'm thai. After massage we got really good coconut icecream and tea. It was amazing experience and good price. Of course we will come back again.

reviews.name: Travelling Scientist
reviews.text: One of the better massage places I’ve been in the area of China town! The 1 hour Thai massage set me back 350 which is very reasonable. In too it that, they offer herbal tea, coconut icecream and even a free gift as a token of appreciation! Would definitely come back here when next in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Mametish
reviews.text:
Hands On, Brain Off

The worst back and neck massage I've EVER had in Thailand, and that's saying something. I spent a full hour repeating "stronger" like a broken record and got back nothing but a slightly warmer version of someone resting their hands on me. There's a difference between a massage and just... touching a person with oil. This was the latter. Save your money.

P.S. don't get massaged by her. You're welcome.

reviews.name: Lis Horning
reviews.text:
This is a small massage shop located near Chinatown. Although the space is limited and there are only a few seats—meaning you might have to wait—the environment is clean and beautifully decorated, giving off a “small but charming” vibe. The masseuses are skilled (I'd give the technique 4 stars), and the owner is very friendly.

After the massage, you’ll be served a small cup of tea and a scoop of ice cream. They also let you pick a small gift, such as a hair clip, mini mirror, or hair tie—little surprises that make the experience more enjoyable.

The price starts at 350 baht per hour, which is slightly higher than some cheaper street massage places that charge around 200–250 baht. However, considering the service quality, pleasant atmosphere, and thoughtful extras, it still offers good value for money.

They accept local Thai payment methods and cash (both Thai baht and US dollars), but do not support Alipay, WeChat Pay, or Apple Pay. Wi-Fi is available. Overall, it’s a cozy and welcoming spot worth visiting if you're in the Chinatown area.

reviews.name: Yan7975
reviews.text:
Very good experience here❤️❤️
It’s worth to do massage here ☺️ Phi Phi are nice and friendly 🫶🏻I will bring more friends to visit next time

reviews.name: Jas Lee
reviews.text: Amazing! Seriously great massage - she asked about any tightness and was in tune with the heaviness I needed. Felt super relaxed and refreshed afterwards. They also give water on arrival, coconut ice cream and tea afterwards and a little departure gift too! Outstanding service, nice classical background music. Super reasonable prices (350THB for 1hr Thai massage). Would recommend!

reviews.name: jo spence
reviews.text:
The oil Thai massage I received was excellent value for money. Of course, the person performing the massage will not always be the same, so experiences here will vary but if they are practicing the same then it’s a very high standard. The massage I received was the absolute best and most thorough I have ever been given. The masseur could clearly tell which areas needed more work than others and gave more attention. I was also given guidance on stretches to do at home and massage techniques explained for my feet and neck should I need to do them myself. I was grateful that she took extra time after the massage to do this. Regular check ins for pressure adjustment (noted I had ticklish feet and dealt with this well) and made me feel very comfortable which is important as it’s an exposing experience in many ways.

The oil smelt lovely, the room is clean and cool, the ice cream at the end is a nice touch.

I had a massage somewhere else earlier in the week and it felt like they were just having a good guess all other my back. This place demonstrates the difference between having knowledge of massage techniques and actually providing a personalised and effective massage.

I don’t think I’ll go anywhere else in Bangkok now. Very professional and kind.

reviews.name: Siham Rahou
reviews.text: I really want to say that it was the best massage I've ever had. I went with back pain, and the professional Phorn knew exactly where to touch me without saying anything. If you're in Bangkok, I highly recommend you go. I'm sure if I return to Bangkok, I'll return to this center. Everything was clean and new. The sheets and towels smelled wonderful. At the end, they gave me tea and coconut ice cream. Thank you so much for taking care of me.

reviews.name: Ian Rusli
reviews.text: I went to this massage place with my Thai friend for the first time. The massage was so amazing! They fixed my stiff shoulders. Then they gave us a tea and coconut flavored ice cream after the massage 💚 I loved it! Definitely will go back here again on my next trip to Bangkok! ☺️

reviews.name: Juan Crous
reviews.text: One of the best massages we have ever had in Bangkok. And what a warm and welcoming experience! 🙏🏽♥️

reviews.name: Mike C.
reviews.text:
One of the best spas in Bangkok. I was in town on business for several weeks and ended up visiting this Let’s Relax location 4–5 times. I had both the foot massage and the aromatherapy oil massage.

My masseuse, Lamai, was the best!! She was so friendly, kind, professional, and gave the best aromatherapy massages I’ve ever had. They welcome you with tea and a cool towel, and after your treatment you’re served tea and mango sticky rice.

The staff is super welcoming and professional. The spa is very clean, and I never felt rushed or shorted on time for my treatments. The location is also really convenient if you’re staying in a hotel near Central Embassy. I highly recommend this spa. Will be my first stop once I return to BKK!

reviews.name: redcherry redcherry
reviews.text: We had a Thai massage here and could definitely feel the difference compared to another popular brand in Bangkok. Overall, it was a really nice experience. The service was friendly and pleasant, and we left feeling relaxed.

reviews.name: Arlene P. T.
reviews.text:
Went in for my redeemed privilege massage from a certain credit card.  Couldn’t fault the place. Bright and look vibe.  Compare to another spa which is dark vibe, here it’s more spacious.  However there’s not foot cleansing beforehand (whereas there are at another spa).
Masseuse was good and polite.  After the massage, customers are all served with mangoes and sticky rice and hot tea.
I was surprised to find out their regular 1 hour massage price is 1,300 baht with 15% discounts for some credit cards.

Happy with the experience

reviews.name: HoGeon Jeong

I had a massage every day during my Bangkok trip, and ‘Let’s Relax’ truly satisfied me.
We are returning to our country today, but we will definitely visit again soon.
I feel relieved of stress and fatigue. Thank you for the perfect massage!

reviews.text: I tried two types of massage: Thai massage and foot massage. It was a truly wonderful and relaxing experience. The facilities are clean and well-maintained. There are several branches in Bangkok. The prices are very reasonable compared to the service you receive, but you have to book in advance. I highly recommend trying it.

reviews.name: Hamad Maz
reviews.text:
I regret to inform you that my recent experience was highly unsatisfactory. The therapist assigned to me did not demonstrate the qualifications or professionalism expected, even at a beginner level of massage. Furthermore, she failed to follow the pre-assessment instructions that were provided, which raised concerns about both the quality and safety of the service.

During the session, I felt uncomfortable and dissatisfied with the technique, to the extent that I had to request for the massage to be stopped before it was completed. This not only disrupted the session but also left me with the impression that the service lacked proper standards of training and client care.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Let's Relax Spa, Sawasdee Ka.

We deeply apologize that your treatment did not reflect the level of professionalism and skill we strive to maintain. Both technique and therapist presence are essential to true relaxation, and we regret that these standards were not met during your visit. The therapist has been scheduled for additional training focused on technique and service mindfulness. We truly appreciate the opportunity to improve and are fully committed to using your feedback to enhance the experience for every customer at Let’s Relax Spa.

reviews.name: Chanyanat S.
reviews.text:
Been here a few times and just realized I’ve never written a review. If it’s Let’s Relax, you can already trust the brand. Every branch is consistently up to standard, and the staff are always professional. The atmosphere is also one of the best.

This branch is located on the B1 floor in the Thai Market area, at Emquartier. You’ll need to get a pass from the counter to walk through, but it shouldn’t be any trouble.

I really, really like their Dream Package: 45 minutes of foot massage, 15 minutes of hand massage, and 30 minutes of back and shoulder massage.

Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Philip Tsui
reviews.text: my girlfriend experienced the worst massage of her life and upset her really much. We had a 2hr session and she just ordered a thai traditional massage. She has already told the massage lady not to do it so hard but yet she still use her elbow to make the hardest shot on her body!! Its totally unacceptable. They even put some unknown stuff on her hand and now she feel itchy. We did not even have appedite. What kind of shop would put toxic stuff on customer hand!! For a luxary massage, please do avoid!!

reviews.text:

Had one very good massage here, one very average massage. I know what to ask for now to get a really good massage. Very firm is what I like.

I tipped 1000bht for the man who did my 2 hour Thai massage - he was excellent and listened well despite the language barrier.

Recommend to book in advance.

I also had a foot massage. The young therapist used a lot of pressure, but never uncomfortable,  it was an outmost relaxing experience.
I can recommend this place to everyone. The prices are very reasonable.

I go weekly to a Thai massage place at home and the assisted stretching, longer stroke, use of pressure with no oil was what I wanted.

Therapist was nice, but with the language barrier, I was not able to communicate my expectations and needs. If you don't get regular body work, then this place isn't the worst. But, not for me. No, thank you.

Will not come here again.

reviews.name: Joseph

I will definitely be coming again.

reviews.text: I always go here when I was living nearby and still go even I am now living in Bangna, because they really do good massage in a reasonable price. I most of the time add more time. But last night, I could say that the lady who massaged me didn’t do great. Especially that in the price increases. I mean for how many time, I was thinking it’s okay to drive even though it’s far and they increase the price because they really do a great job. But last night, the lady didn’t massage me well, I told her for how many time that I didn’t want her to massage too hard and always on my neck because I can feel too much pressure and not on the right area that others usually massage and that it seems not relaxing. I’m thinking it was on my veins already. I also told here to massage my shoulders and head that I knew these need more massage, but she just said. ‘Relax’ I thought she will go back on these parts and massage. But the time just done and nothing. Also, I can most of the time felt her putting the balm and that’s it. I was trying to think that maybe she was tired already. but my purpose again is to pay for me to feel relieved a, but nothing. Now, I feel like I just paid and came there for nothing.

I’ll definitely recommend this place and visit again in the future if I get the chance.

reviews.text: Worst Thai massage, in the world. I’ve had maybe 30 Thai massages so far. Some good some bad. This is the only time I needed to leave a review. This was the lightest Thai massage I ever had. I asked the lady to push harder and she didn’t understand. She continue to use her forearm to touch me, not massage me but lightly touch my skin like a Swedish massage. She didn’t use her thumb that much and didn’t use elbow at all. Half way I couldn’t take it anymore and took out my phone to translate that she was going too light. Then she laugh and continued but touching my slightly harder. Yes touching, not massaging. Was unprofessional and waste of money. Don’t come here. There’s plenty of other options.

reviews.text: This is probably the best place for an affordable massage in Bangkok. Everyone here is very friendly. The massages are very good. They're open really late, too. It's across from the Centric Hotel. You have to go to the second entrance, because I think the first one doesn't work. It's called Okay Massage after the owner, since her name means Okay in Thai.

reviews.name: KingFishQueenFishTravels
reviews.text:
From the moment I walked into Loft Thai, I knew the experience was going to be special. Khun Mheow was my masseuse and she was amazing!! I received my spa package from her which included a foot massage, full body, and facial. She was very attentive - asking if I was alright throughout the session. I think I fell asleep during the facial because I can’t recall some of it - that’s just how gentle Khun Mheow’s massage felt.

We received a refreshing drink when arriving and tea before departure. We were asked if we were pleased with the services received and if we were alright. This is how a massage experience should be!!! Thank you so much for the special treatment for my birthday too!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for celebrating your birthday with us at Loft Thai Spa Bangkok! We are delighted to hear that Khun Mheow made your experience so relaxing and memorable.

It is wonderful to know that you enjoyed your complete spa package, including the foot massage, full-body massage, and facial treatment. Falling asleep during the facial is certainly one of the best compliments we could receive! We will be very happy to share your kind words with Khun Mheow and the entire team.

From the welcome drink to the farewell tea, we always aim to create a warm, attentive, and deeply relaxing spa experience for every guest. Thank you again for choosing our award-winning spa in Sukhumvit, Bangkok for such a special occasion.

We look forward to welcoming you back soon—perhaps to discover our signature Thai Warrior Massage or our relaxing Aesop Head Spa experience next time. 🙏✨

reviews.name: Linara Z.
reviews.text: I had the best massage in Bangkok. I came asking for tension relief in my neck and shoulders. I feel great again. The therapist paid special attention to specific areas, relieving tension and stretching. I chose the 1.5-hour aromatherapy massage. At the end, they gave me delicious tea with sweets. I'm so happy 😊 Thank you so much. I'll definitely be back again 🙏🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Linara for your 5-star review. We are so glad your massage helped release neck and shoulder tension and made you feel great again. Next time, a facial treatment can nicely complement your spa visit in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Chris Diddit
reviews.text:
Looking for amazing treatment in the heart of Bangkok? Look no further!

From the time I began the booking process til the very moment I left I knew I was in good hands… literally!

They messaged me to confirm my appointment within 30 minutes of submitting my request online and had me booked an hour later for the Mahanakhon Package for 120 minutes!

Upon arrival, I was greeted with a warm smile and felt instantly comfortable while enjoying the provided refreshments.

I then got to meet my massage therapists  Ja and Saran who were light hearted and fun which brought even more comfort.

They work in tandem while providing consistent pressure and movements between the two of them. It felt like one person with four hands which I thought stood out as unique solely to Loft Thai.

If you’re looking for a one of a kind experience with true professionals then this is the spot for you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Chris for your lovely review. We are delighted you enjoyed Loft Thai Spa & Massage Sukhumvit 38 in the heart of Bangkok. Next time, a facial treatment after your massage would make the spa experience even more complete and refreshing.

reviews.name: Jazz Brown
reviews.text:
Of you don’t want a stressful street Massage offer you must come here!
The place is very peaceful and the service was very very good!
Also the massage was a dream! I had 90 min cbd and I am sure every service here will be great! Also the robe and the towels all smelled very nice and fresh washed and gave a cosy feeling as well!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere and your 90-minute CBD massage at Loft Thai Spa Bangkok.

We pay close attention to every detail, from our treatments and therapists to fresh towels, robes, and the overall comfort of our guests. It’s wonderful to hear that these little touches made your experience even more relaxing.

We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing spa experience in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Anjeez
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of getting an aromatherapy oil massage and facial here and both were outstanding! The spa is beautiful and the staff is so kind! Not to mention, my skin was left shiny & soft and every knot and kink in my shoulders and arms was melted away. Amazing! Can't wait to come back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your wonderful feedback. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed both the aromatherapy oil massage and facial, and that you left feeling relaxed with refreshed skin. Our team will be very happy to know their care made your visit special.

We look forward to welcoming you again—next time you might enjoy experiencing our HydraFacial. 🙏

reviews.name: Bambi Ko (柯小鹿)
reviews.text: Professional Thai massage! Revisit and love it. I like the small treats after the massage as well, not too heavy and authentic Thai desserts. Satisfied with their service and prompt replies from their WhatsApp. Highly recommended! 😻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review!

We’re truly happy to hear that you enjoyed your professional Thai massage at Loft Thai Spa and that you chose to revisit us—it means a lot to our team. We’re also glad you appreciated the small treats after your massage; we carefully select authentic Thai desserts and premium tea to complete the experience in a light and refined way.

At Loft Thai Spa, we aim to deliver one of the best spa experiences in Bangkok, combining expert massage techniques, attentive service, and seamless communication through WhatsApp for your convenience.

Thank you again for your recommendation, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing experience soon 😻🙏

reviews.name: Katherine Dienes-Williams
reviews.text: The best massage of my life. Outstanding service from start to finish including an extra cake provided for our forthcoming wedding anniversary. My husband and I had a couples massage - do not go anywhere else in Bangkok but rush here at your earliest opportunity and bliss out!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Katherine for your beautiful 5-star review. We are so happy the massage and service at Loft Thai Spa & Massage Sukhumvit 38 in Bangkok felt so special, including the cake moment. For your next visit, our Thai Warrior Massage would be a wonderful deeper spa experience to try.

reviews.name: Elizabeth Prasansouk
reviews.text:
i received an Ultimate Hydrafacial and loved everything about my experience at Loft. the lady who worked on me was very gentle and always checking up on me if things were too hot, cold, harsh but i did not need to ask for any adjustments because it was already perfect. the facility was very neat, clean, and beautifully decorated. they give you butterfly pea tea as you’re checking in then some coconut snacks + tea as you leave.

just a tip for foreign travelers, traffic in bangkok is no joke. it’s comparable to Los Angeles or New York so please give yourself an extra 15-25 minutes to get here. i was a little late to my appointment but the staff were still very kind which i was grateful for. also, it’s located down a narrow-ish alleyway, so also be mindful of that.

would highly recommend and would also be coming back next time i visit bangkok :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review. We’re truly happy to hear that you enjoyed your Ultimate HydraFacial and that our therapist, facilities, and small welcome treats helped make your experience special. Your tip about Bangkok traffic will definitely help other guests as well!

We look forward to welcoming you again on your next visit to Bangkok — next time you might enjoy trying our Thai Warrior Massage for another unique and memorable experience. 🙏

reviews.name: Michelle Chen
reviews.text:
For $80 USD, you receive excellent value and truly wonderful service. My massage therapist, Lady Peach, was incredibly kind and attentive. I initially thought I might prefer stronger pressure, but the medium pressure was actually perfect—very comfortable and relaxing, to the point where I fell asleep.

They also provide complimentary butterfly pea tea, hot tea, and a local treat after the massage, which was a lovely touch. I highly recommend the oil massage in particular.

The staff were extremely flexible and understanding as well—they allowed us to store our suitcases and were very patient when we were dealing with stomach issues. Overall, a warm, professional, and thoughtful experience. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Michelle Chen for your wonderful 5-star review. We are delighted you found excellent value and truly wonderful service with Lady Peach at Loft Thai Spa & Massage Sukhumvit 38 in Bangkok. For your next visit, a facial treatment would beautifully complement your massage experience.

reviews.name: Jeanette Perez
reviews.text: Sarah and the staff at the front desk were incredibly accomplished and extremely helpful. I had never gotten a Traditional Thai massage let alone a massage in general. Their hospitality is truly unmatched, they made my friend and I feel at ease and checked up on me while i waited for my friend to be sone with her services. I hope to come back before leaving Thailand in a few days.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review!

We’re truly delighted to hear that you had such a great first experience with a Traditional Thai massage at Loft Thai Spa. Sarah and our front desk team will be very happy to know their hospitality made you and your friend feel comfortable and well taken care of.

At Loft Thai Spa, we are committed to delivering one of the best massage experiences in Bangkok, combining authentic Thai techniques with attentive service and a welcoming atmosphere. It means a lot to us that you felt at ease throughout your visit.

We sincerely hope to welcome you back again before you leave Thailand for another relaxing and memorable spa experience 🙏

reviews.name: Pauline Wong
reviews.text: Very enjoyable treatment with excellent service. All the staff know English pretty well. The only complaint is the location is quite remote and as a female, i dont feel too safe walking alone from the main street to that shop.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Pauline for your 5-star review. We are happy you enjoyed the treatment, excellent service, and English-speaking staff at Loft Thai Spa & Massage Sukhumvit 38 in Bangkok. We also appreciate your feedback and hope to welcome you again for a facial treatment or Thai Warrior Massage.

reviews.name: HimeSan Aricia
reviews.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at Loft Thai Spa (Sukhumvit 38)!
The atmosphere was calm, luxurious, and relaxing from the moment I walked in. The staff were extremely friendly and professional, welcoming me with a refreshing drink before the treatment.

I booked the full body scrub treatment, and it was amazing. The therapist used warm milk with a gentle scrub that made my skin instantly smooth, soft, and glowing without any irritation. The private room was spacious, with both a bathtub and a shower, beautifully decorated with plants – it felt like a true retreat in the city.

After the treatment, they applied lotion that absorbed quickly, leaving my skin nourished and refreshed. I also loved the little details, like finishing the session with Thai desserts and warm tea.

If you’re looking for a place to truly relax and pamper yourself in Bangkok, I highly recommend Loft Thai Spa. A perfect balance of comfort, luxury, and professional care.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your beautifully detailed review! 🌸✨
We’re delighted to know that your visit at our Sukhumvit 38 branch gave you such a calm, luxurious, and relaxing experience from beginning to end. From the warm welcome drink to the final touch of Thai desserts and tea, our passion is to create a retreat in the city where every detail matters.

We’re so glad you enjoyed the Full Body Scrub with warm milk, designed to leave the skin soft, glowing, and nourished. Your kind words about the atmosphere, our facilities, and our team’s care truly mean the world to us.

Thank you for recommending us—your feedback inspires our commitment and devotion to world-class spa experiences. We can’t wait to welcome you back for more pampering on your next visit to Bangkok. 💛

reviews.name: Dani
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Loft Thai Spa & Massage! The atmosphere was calm, clean, and very relaxing from the moment we walked in. My partner and I did a 3-hour couples massage, and it was absolutely worth it. The therapists were very professional, attentive, and made sure the pressure was perfect throughout the entire session.

The spa itself is beautiful and peaceful, which made it easy to fully relax and enjoy the treatment. Everything felt very high quality and well organized. After traveling and walking around Bangkok, this was exactly what we needed.

If you’re visiting the Sukhumvit area and looking for a great massage or couples spa experience, I definitely recommend this place. We left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and already talking about coming back next time we’re in Bangkok!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Dani for your amazing 5-star review. We are happy you enjoyed the calm, clean, and relaxing atmosphere at Loft Thai Spa & Massage Sukhumvit 38 in Bangkok. A facial treatment would be a perfect complement to your next spa massage.

reviews.name: Gabrielle Serrano
reviews.text:
We availed the 1 hour body wrap here. Was welcomed warmly by Sitti at the reception. Refreshing welcome drinks were served prior to the session. Aside from the body wrap, the session also includes a really good head, neck, and a bit of back massage. After the session, we were served with traditional Thai dessert and hot tea.

My only regret is we came here on my last day in Bangkok. Wish I could go back sooner.

We can't recommend this place enough.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Gabrielle for your wonderful 5-star review. We are glad you enjoyed the body wrap, warm welcome from Sitti, and refreshing drinks at Loft Thai Spa & Massage Sukhumvit 38 in Bangkok. Next time, a facial treatment would complete the spa experience beautifully.

reviews.name: Pasha Shobeiri
reviews.text: Great spa for couples and special occasions. They are very responsive and accommodating for special requests (we got flowers and a whole cake for Valentines day!). Overall, we had a great experience and will be back next time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review. We are truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed your couple experience with us and that our team was able to make your Valentine’s Day celebration special. It is always our pleasure to personalize each visit and accommodate special requests so that every moment feels memorable and meaningful.

We’re very happy that the flowers, cake, and overall experience met your expectations. Creating beautiful memories for couples and special occasions is something we are very passionate about.

We look forward to welcoming you both again on your next visit. Next time, we would love to recommend our award-winning Thai Warrior Massage for couples or one of our signature facial experiences to make your celebration even more relaxing and unforgettable. Thank you again for your trust and support. 🙏

reviews.name: Charlotte Hazelwood
reviews.text: Unreal 90 mins Thai massage, thank you Om for such a magical treatment! I feel like a new woman leaving. The refreshments at the start and end were a magical touch on top too - definitely come here if you’re visiting Bangkok :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Charlotte for your wonderful 5-star review. We are thrilled Om gave you such a magical 90-minute Thai massage at Loft Thai Spa & Massage Sukhumvit 38 in Bangkok. Next time, a facial treatment would complete the spa experience beautifully.

reviews.name: Batty On Tour
reviews.text:
Batty’s Gentlemen Spa Dispatch from Bangkok 🦇✨

Alright folks — before anything else: Loft Thai Spa has THREE branches! Make sure you head to the right one on Sukhumvit 38 — I, your fearless mini-Batman, went to the wrong one first. Classic Batty move. 🦇😅

Once you find the right spot though… oh boy — it’s spotless, calm, and beautifully designed. The place smells like serenity and luxury had a baby. 🌿💆‍♂️

The team? Super professional, polite, and genuinely kind. From the moment I walked in, they made me feel like a VIP guest who just landed from Gotham on a business trip to Bangkok. 🛩️

I’m extremely picky when it comes to spas in Thailand — there are far too many “meh” or “mystery” places — but this one is the real deal. Everything is clean, structured, and done with Japanese-level precision (and Thai charm).

Yesterday, I booked a manicure, pedicure, and facial — no full massage this time — but it was honestly top-tier. Gentle, detailed, and not rushed at all. The facial was amazing: relaxing, refreshing, and zero awkwardness for guys.

And that’s the best part — Loft Thai is perfect for men too. They have proper gentlemen’s packages, clean facilities, and staff who know what they’re doing. You don’t feel out of place — you feel upgraded. 🚀

⭐️ Batty’s Verdict:
If you want a clean, elegant, and genuinely professional spa in Bangkok — this is it.
Even if you’re just going for grooming treatments like me — you’ll walk out feeling like James Bond after a mission.

📍 Loft Thai Spa & Massage, Sukhumvit 38 —
Book ahead, go to the right branch, and prepare to look suspiciously good afterward. 😎🦇
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Batty On Tour for your fun 5-star review. We are happy you visited Loft Thai Spa & Massage Sukhumvit 38 during your Bangkok spa dispatch. Next time, a facial treatment or Thai Warrior Massage would be a perfect complement to your massage and wellness experience.

reviews.name: abrar hussain
reviews.text:

They focused on every sensitive area with care and worked thoroughly on the spots that truly needed attention.
I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you abrar hussain for your wonderful 5-star review. We are delighted Loft Thai Spa & Massage Sukhumvit 38 was a perfect way to enjoy your transit time in Bangkok. For your next visit, a facial treatment or Thai Warrior Massage would be a beautiful complement to your massage and spa experience.

reviews.name: pega mangkornchaiya
reviews.text: Good massage quality & lovely service. Relax atmosphere. Good location with limited car parking. Various packages.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Pega for your 5-star review. We are happy you enjoyed the massage quality, lovely service, relaxing atmosphere, and convenient Bangkok location at Loft Thai Spa & Massage Sukhumvit 38. reviews.name: Kellie Abley
reviews.text:
A HEAVENLY experience. Amazing products; excellent customer service. Staff were clearly
well trained and experienced with massaging pregnant women.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Kellie for your 5-star review. title: Absolute Home Spa
ownerDescription: At Absolute Home Spa, we offer a blissful escape from the hustle of everyday life. Our serene ambiance, coupled with our skilled massage therapists and exceptional treatments, will transport you to a state of pure bliss.
address: 33/6 Soi Langsuan, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

reviews.name: Howard Cohn
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible massage. A little difficult to find as it's down a side road next to a little multi story building which has an excellent Sushi restaurant. The staff are very professional and helpful with a very good understanding of any muscle issues you might have. My masseuse was a lady of 50 plus and I received the best massage I have had in a week of trying many different massage spas in Bangkok. I highly recommend this Spa

reviews.name: Patrick Plumeier
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at this massage studio. The classic Thai massage was absolutely awesome — deep, energizing, and incredibly relaxing at the same time. The therapist was highly skilled and really knew how to find and release all the tension in my body.

The studio itself was clean, peaceful, and welcoming, which made it easy to fully unwind. From start to finish, everything felt professional and well organized.

A lovely extra touch was that they offer complimentary tea and snacks after the treatment, which made the whole experience feel even more special and relaxing.

reviews.name: Mo Swe
reviews.text:
I stayed in center point chit lone and noticed about Absolute Home Spa while I walked around. I came one of the afternoon and did oil massage for 90 minutes and I really enjoyed it.
So when my friends came, we came for Thai massage and I was so impressed but I just did one hour only.
I want more massage before I go back home. I stopped by around 9pm on last Friday night and unfortunately I can’t make it. But I told them that I’m going back tomorrow, so they said that pls come back around 10pm and they did 90 minutes Thai massage for me even though they close on 11pm.
Really appreciate for your service and whenever I came to visit, never disappointed.
I will come again whenever I visit to Bangkok.
The place is beautiful and they serve the tea and snacks after massage too.
Really nice place and people. ❤️

reviews.name: Eli V
reviews.text: My favorite massage spa in Bangkok that I keep coming back to. The space is extremely clean, cozy, and beautifully designed — very zen from the moment you walk in. The atmosphere instantly puts you at ease. The masseuses are excellent: professional, attentive and skilled. On top of that, the prices are surprisingly reasonable for the quality of service. I left feeling completely relaxed and refreshed. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: marikasingh8910
reviews.text: We had a full oil body massage. We loved the fact that the place was very private and not overcrowded with people. Great service, high quality oils and a beautiful service. The lady could feel every single knot on my body and she had focused on body parts which needed extra focus. Thank you so much to the lovely lady called LEK I hope we will be blessed to go back there xxx marika

reviews.name: Miao Qi Tan
reviews.text: My husband and I did the absolute Thai relaxation for 120 minutes. It was amazing, the massage and heat ball compress felt really good. The strength is just nice for us. When I feedback that the heat compress felt abit too hot, they adjusted immediately and kept checking in. That was very sweet. The place is clean, serene and nice. All the staffs here are friendly and welcoming as well. Must come! We will come back again :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review! We're so happy you and your husband enjoyed the experience. Hope to welcome you both back again soon! 🧡

reviews.name: Candy and Jason “Candy and Jason”
reviews.text: This place is so good we went twice. The first time I got a 60 minute aromatherapy massage and my husband had the deep tissue massage. The second time, I got 60 minutes foot massage and my husband got a 60 minutes head neck shoulder massage. Our massage was fantastic. Very calming very relaxing. We received excellent customer service. The spa itself is very aromatic very calm and peaceful. We will definitely be back.

reviews.name: Nryn Fyrz
reviews.text:
I recently had an amazing experience at Absolute Home Spa, where I indulged in a Thai massage. It was absolutely fantastic! The masseuse was attentive and focused on my problem areas, providing just the right amount of pressure. I felt such relief afterward—it was exactly what I needed.

From the moment I arrived, the service was top-notch. They welcomed me with a refreshing drink and a wet towel, which set a relaxing tone for my visit. I also appreciated the thoughtful touch of a sea salt scrub for my feet before the massage—it felt wonderful!

To top it all off, the experience concluded with some delightful traditional Thai desserts, which was a lovely surprise. Overall, I found the service and quality to be worth every penny. I highly recommend Absolute Home Spa for anyone looking to unwind and rejuvenate!

reviews.name: Xue Yuhai
reviews.text:
Quite cozy spa, we are the only customers when we visit, even feel relaxing when entering the store because of the settings, quiet and comfortable.
But the masseur is not as good as the settings, not able to guide customer what to do next. After washing my feet, she just left to get towel or something and left me standing there for a while don’t know what to do. Until another masseur led me to the massage room.

reviews.name: kelly kerh
reviews.text:
Happen to walk past Absolute Home Spa, is a really nice and quiet location. One of the best massage we have. The service staffs were friendly. I have the aromatherapy full body massage and my girl had the foot massage. The masseuses were good.
We loved the snack they served.

reviews.name: qyueen
reviews.text: Highly recommended to come here to get massages. Booked in advance for 5 people, everything went smoothly and masseuse were gentle yet good with their massage skills! Would definitely come back when we come to Bangkok again! Do give Absolute Home Spa a try when you need a good massage and some time to unwind with the amazing ambiance of the place! Staff were also nice and they are able to converse in english! you’ll be well taken care of here and this will be an unforgettable experience! ❤️

reviews.name: Jason Lee
reviews.text: Local SPA shop, elegant environment, very thoughtful decoration, many photo spots! The reception staff named Lemon is very nice, polite with passion and smiling face! The massage therapists are very attentive, and the massage is very comfortable! The post-massage snacks are delicious and special, and they are also very exquisite! The location is about an 8-minute walk from Chit Lom BTS station! Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Nachpatcharawee Pim
reviews.text: 1 of the spas that I have been to and really like, feel like home, both the welcome and the service. The masseuse provides very good service. Then you'll fall asleep after a good massage. And the highlight is the desserts. When you see them you're shocked. Come get a massage or eat afternoon tea. After the massage, you can eat and go home ready to sleep.

reviews.name: Aarish Matcheswalla
reviews.text:
This place will give you one of the best massages ever. The place itself has such a lovely vibe. And right from the host to the therapist, everyone is so warm and professional. The Thai massage will open up your body and relax you in ways you would have never thought.

Take my word and just go for it. Exceptional.

reviews.name: Nana
reviews.text:
✅ 😍 Relaxing space 😌 tastefully decorated.
✅ Couple room for foot reflexology on recliner chairs available.
✅ 🍵 Tea served before and after the massage.

📱 Line or WhatsApp booking. The front desk girl (owner?) speaks fluent English.

😁 Our masseuse were Jane and Aui. Both had their own style. Jane's Thai massage was 9/10 but her foot reflexology was 5/10. Aui was a 9/10 in both areas and had great pressure.

💰 Course taken:
600.- 1 hour Thai massage
600.- 1 hour foot reflexology

❌ Thai massage rooms communal, separated by thin curtains.

🚽 Gender seperated toilets on site.

❓ We weren't asked to fill in any forms or asked about our preferences. Not sure if that's the norm.

📍 Located in a quiet residential alley near Chit Lom station.

reviews.name: clara may
reviews.text: Their service, technique and cleanliness is over beyond. There is a tea and some snacks after massage is pretty cute.

reviews.name: Joseph Albert Meñez
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience with this branch last night. First of all, massage was great, easily 10/5! Really really great! We all slept like a baby!

But what set this apart was the customer service. We arrived via a tuktuk and we lacked BHT to pay for it. We asked for help from Manow the manager and she lent me BHT without any hesitation. From the reception up to the snacks in the end, this is easily a must-visit for locals and tourists alike.

reviews.name: Sheila Lam
reviews.text: I stumbled into this little sanctuary and surprised by the friendly staff and relaxing environment. It’s very clean and comfortable, had a lovely relaxing foot massage with a very reasonable price. It comes with tea and cookies after the massage. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Yau Sarah
reviews.text:
I have an 2-hour Thai massage, the therapist has good skills and very caring.
The environment is very cozy which make me very relaxed.
I will definitely come again next time.
Strongly recommend.

reviews.name: Yusuf Alromaihi
reviews.text: A wonderful experience. I did the Thai massage for 90 minutes. Would definitely come again.

title: KAYA MASSAGE AND BEAUTY
ownerDescription: Modern Thai Spa
address: 3, 1 Sukhumvit Soi 18, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Jonie Kang
reviews.text:
Although I had a good therapist, the pounding noise from the next door construction site was hard to ignore. It does not look like it will be completed in the coming year so in case anyone is looking for a relaxing time, do bring earplugs or completely give this place a miss at least in 2026.

That said, the beds were cool. At the end of it turns into a foot bath basin and at the top it turns into a hair wash basin. I like that I didn’t have to move around to have different treatments.

The  sheer curtains between beds meant that if you were unlucky like me, you would hear word for word the loud customers on near by beds.

Overall, decent value for a nice massage but ruined by its unfortunate surroundings.

reviews.name: Tom N
reviews.text: So impressed with this massage shop. Today I went spontaneously for a foot massage after a lot of walking in Bangkok but decided to get back massage also and Bporn was really amazing. I’d say it’s one of the best massages I’ve had, and I go very often in Thailand. Really clean and luxurious shop too and all the staff are kind and welcoming.

We walked in without a reservation and they were able to see us straightaway. We enjoyed tea and biscuits after our treatments. Don’t miss this great spot!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you vey much.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much

十分推薦！！
