Have been Makkha for few times with disappointment but Felix did give me excellent experience than others, highly recommended Feliz massage, for everyone especially for those living Eastin Grand!!!

reviews.name: Max N
reviews.text:
Found this place near our accomodations, and was pleasantly surprised.

Located a short throw away from Phaya Thai ARL/BTS station, in a quiet soi. The store front stated that they're a massage parlor, hostel and cafe, though I'm not sure if they are still operating the latter 2.

The place is clean and bright, front desk lady is very welcoming and speaks English. The masseuses were also able to converse in some English. The price was also very reasonable.

Upon welcome, you're served a cold roselle drink and cold towel (did not manage to capture a photo). Much needed cooling in the Bangkok heat.

Then we were asked to fill up a form to indicate the preferred strength for the massage. After which we were brought to the 2nd level to have our feet's washed.

My partner and I first did full body massages on the first day and decided to come back again for another massage before our flight. This time, I opted for a foot massage.

The massage chair was big and cushy, a bear for you to hold while the stress melts away. Though the air conditioning can get a little cold, the blanket was a great addition to the experience.

The masseuse applied consistent strength throughout the massage, and was gentle with my sensitive area. It was so good I fell asleep. At the end, the used a hot towel to wipe down your lower limbs and feet. Once done, jasmine green tea and pineapple jam biscuits were served.

On both occasions, we did not make an appointment. We were able to get a massage immediately at walk-in. On the 2 separate days, I also didn't see anyone else in the shop. So the whole place was quiet, unlike other places that's swarmed by noisy tourists who do not know how to observe silence.

Overall, I would recommend Feliz Massage. Quiet place, great experience from start to finish.

reviews.name: Annette Hillis
reviews.text: I have had the most amazing massage head,  shoulders,  arms, hands,  legs and feet. 💯 recommend.  I feel like I'm floating.  Just amazing.  I'll be back before my trip ends. Beautiful tea before and after also.  Thank you.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the incredible 5-star review, Annette! We are absolutely thrilled to hear that our head, shoulders, arms, hands, legs, and feet massage made you feel like you were floating! It's wonderful to know you also enjoyed our complimentary tea service. Our professional team at Feliz Massage near BTS Phaya Thai works hard to keep a beautiful, clean, and relaxing oasis for everyone looking to unwind. We cannot wait to welcome you back for another amazing session before your trip ends! Safe travels!

​We hope to welcome you back again soon

reviews.name: Maryam Madani
reviews.text:
We chose this place based on the great ranking and reviews. We asked for an aroma 90 min massage and despite it being pretty expensive comparing to the ones we got in Phuket, this place terribly failed all the expectations. After they got the money upfront (which was unusual because we always paid afterwards) and started with feet washing and from very beginning it felt so rushed rather than relaxing.
The bed itself was not comfortable in terms of the head place. The pillow was leather and kept slipping away. I thought it was just me but after the massage I realised it was the same for my partner.
During the massage, I was frizzing as the air con was directly on me. I asked them twice about this and it worked for a few minutes and again it would start. They didn't care at all that I kept getting goosebumps from the cold.
The massage itself was not bad but it didn't feel relaxing at all.
After the massage they served us with some herbal tea that was supposed to be warm but they didn't even wait for us to take the shower and then serve it.
Overall I feel like I wasted 2000 bats and I won't be back and don't recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re truly sorry to hear your visit didn’t meet expectations. We understand how disappointing it must have felt, and we appreciate you sharing these honest details. Your feedback about the room comfort, temperature, and service has been shared with our team so we can improve. We care deeply about our guests and hope you’ll give us the chance in the future to provide the relaxing experience you deserved.

reviews.name: Charmaine Joan Ang
reviews.text:
Decent massage here! Found this quiet massage parlour that could accommodate us immediately as we went to another two before this and they were fully booked.

The lobby area looks unassuming and run down but the service area upstairs is decent as shown in the pictures. Cold tea and towel served as before the service commences then you head upstairs. Hot tea and some biscuits served after service completes.

450 baht for an hour of foot, back and shoulder massage - decent for the price!

reviews.name: Tem Tem
reviews.text: We went twice, tried 2 hours and 1 hour Thai traditional massage. Experiences were great both times. I like they wash our feet before the massage start instead of just clean by warm towel that many other massage houses do.  Despite it is not a large scale massage house, they can give us private room rather than just curtain separated space.  The masseurs are professional. They massaged me with different strokes and stretching movement with appropriate strength.  I enjoyed it a lot.  The environment for foot massage is very cute though they are relatively open.  Will come again when I visit Bangkok next time!  Thank you very much 🙏

reviews.name: Yu Zhang
reviews.text: This place has the best massage experience I've had in Bangkok! It's clean, with lovely tea,  biscuit and towels provided. The most important being, their therapists are very professional and know exactly which part of body needed to be relieved. Aumporn is the lady who dis the foot massage and traditional Thai, and she's very helpful! So are the lovely young gentleman who speaks decent English and other staff! I will definitely come back here again during my next visit to Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your review, Yu! We are glad to be named your best massage experience in Bangkok. One of our priorities is to maintain a clean, welcoming space and providing those little comforts like tea and biscuits. I will definitely pass on your lovely words to Aumporn and our young gentleman; they will be so happy to hear this! 

At Feliz Massage, we strive to offer the highest quality foot massage and traditional Thai massage. Since we are located near BTS Phaya Thai, we can't wait to welcome you back on your next visit to the city!

reviews.text: Had a very good Thai massage. I got quite a bit of twisting, turning, stretching, bending and standing on my back, and a lot of the knots on my neck were being pressed on, and it was really comfortable. I hadn't felt like I had my whole body loosened for a while, and could really turn my neck to each side, it was really good. Still stretching my neck as I'm typing this, it was really helpful. Am really thankful to the auntie for putting so much effort into the massage and doing such a good massage.

reviews.name: Neels Boshoff
reviews.text: 30 min foot massage after a long flight by Tane Mo. The therapist was highly professional, checked in on the pressure level, and really knew how to target areas of tension. The environment was clean, calm, and relaxing. I left feeling completely rejuvenated. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Tan.W
reviews.text:
Did the 1-hour foot + shoulder & neck massage, and I must say — it was excellent!
My masseur, Ru Dee, was fantastic and made the entire experience very enjoyable.

The foot massage wasn’t just about the feet — it included leg stretches and targeted pressure on the thighs just before wrapping up each side, which made it feel thorough and satisfying.

For the shoulder and neck massage, we moved downstairs to a bed area, which was surprisingly busy. The massage bed had a head hole, but it was covered by a pillow. I usually don’t enjoy back massages with my head on a pillow, and the hole wasn’t too comfy either, so I stuck with the pillow. Despite the name, the massage covered more than just the shoulders and neck — it included the waist, thighs, and neck. Lotion/oil was used for the neck portion, and Ru Dee’s strokes were so good it honestly felt heavenly. My only complaint is that this part didn’t last long enough!

Towards the end, you sit up and get a final shoulder massage, which finishes with the classic Thai-style back crack. After the treatment, they serve you a cup of tea to wrap things up.

Highly recommend this massage place — and definitely ask for Ru Dee if you go!

reviews.name: Alex
reviews.text: I had an excellent foot, back, and shoulder massage with Top. He was very professional, attentive, and skilled. He knew exactly where my muscles were tight and adjusted the pressure perfectly. I felt relaxed and refreshed after the session, and the pain and stiffness in my shoulders and back were greatly relieved. I highly recommend Top to anyone looking for a high-quality massage. Thank you for the wonderful experience!

Only downside I I dint like was I had requested 1 hour massage and wanted  to do extra 30min as I liked the therapist and told will pay them after my 1 hr service for next 30 min as I was in middle of a massage relaxing but they insisted to be paid in middle of my massage which was kind of annoying and disturbing . Wow,was awesome,

reviews.name: Ryan Kristomuljono
reviews.text:
After days of walking non-stop—especially following the ladies around Platinum Mall and the surrounding shopping streets—Suthathip Massage was exactly what I needed. I tried the 60-minute Thai massage, and it was absolutely awesome.

The place is clean, calm, and professionally run. The staff is friendly, and the therapist really knew what she was doing. The massage hit all the right spots—firm, focused, and super relaxing without being too intense. You can really feel the tension melt away, especially after hours of being on your feet.

It’s not one of those overly flashy spa places, but it offers great quality, a peaceful atmosphere, and fair pricing. Everything was neat, hygienic, and well-maintained, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

If you’re around the Pratunam area and need to recharge after a long day of shopping or sightseeing, Suthathip Massage is a hidden gem worth visiting. I left feeling refreshed, lighter, and ready to walk some more (or maybe just nap). Highly recommended and definitely worth five stars!

reviews.text: Its about individual therapist but I asked for good since I live in Thailand and had many Thai massages. Yet I got one that was her turn. Tourists usually have no idea about proper massage but I recommend to owner - if anybody ask for better service - provide the best therapist.

reviews.name: Syera Zaki
reviews.text:

reviews.name: Emmanuel Chang
reviews.text: Best massage I ever had. Thai massage 120min at 600baht with zero queue and open till 1.30am. The lady that served me really did a good job. She was so deeply passionate to massage. The first hour was focusing on leg, particularly on pelvic area. The next hour would be hand and body. Body first start with hand massage then followed by the leg massage on top of my back. The steeping massage on my body is another level of experience. She definitely know where and not to step on the body. It end with a double tap jump with her feet on my center back body. Lastly, she gave a good rubbing on my neck and head with some ointment. The aroma and smell of the shop is wonderful, very minty and refreshing. The entire massage was so relaxing and my colleagues beside my cubicle was all snoring including me. After massage, I got presented with a tea. reviews.name: Andre
reviews.text:
We've been bringing our Thai ridgeback puppy Pumi to Trail & Tail every week, and we couldn't be happier with the experience. Our trainer, Fabia, is knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely passionate about dogs. She explains not only what to do, but also why it works, making it much easier to continue the training at home.

Thanks to Fabia's guidance, we've seen clear improvements in Pumi's focus, self-control, and our communication with her. The training methods are practical, respectful, and tailored to both the dog and the owner, making every session valuable.

The training facility is in downtown Bangkok with plenty of space for dogs to learn and practice in a safe environment. The atmosphere is friendly, the classes are well organized, and it's clear that the team truly cares about helping both dogs and their owners.

We can confidently recommend Trail & Tail to anyone looking for professional, modern, and thoughtful dog training.

Only registered, fully vaccinated dogs free of ticks are allowed inside, and the staff checks for any diseases or parasites on the dogs before letting it in. I also like, that the staff, that is responsible for the daycare dogs take care that the bigger daycare dogs don't intimate the small dogs too much and stop them if they get too close for too long to my small dog, who is a bit scared of big dogs. reviews.name: Andrew Wesselmann
reviews.text:
This place offers a lot for dog/dog owners, so I'm limiting my review only to what we used today: the outdoor dog "park" grass area, the dog cafe, and the pet store. We live in the area and have wanted to visit this place for a while, and ultimately it's great that it's there, but it could be so much better.

The dog cafe and pet store were both great, I was impressed by the diversity of selection in both places. The dog cafe had creative foods for dogs, while the store had a better selection of dog foods and toys than I've seen in many other stores here in Thailand.

The off-leash grass area was a bit disappointing. It was just small. We live in central Bangkok and are happy to have any grass for our dogs, but the empty parking area was at least 3-5x larger than the dog park (and I'm guessing parking is free?) How much sense does that make??? And yes, honestly, 300THB (day pass) for that small area is quite expensive. It's probably a one-time visit type thing for us, just not worth it.

My advice to owners is to greatly expand the green, off-leash area for dogs, have a monthly membership option that is much more reasonable, and then charge more for parking by the hour.

reviews.name: Wisanu Tuntawiroon
reviews.text:
Golden Place สาขาชวนชม is a delightful small restaurant nestled inside the market, offering a cafeteria-style dining experience. The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, making it an ideal spot for a quick and satisfying meal. The menu features a variety of tasty dishes, all prepared with fresh ingredients and bursting with flavor.

One of the standout aspects of Golden Place สาขาชวนชม is the speed of service. Despite the busy market setting, the staff is efficient and friendly, ensuring that you get your food quickly without compromising on quality.

Moreover, the prices are very reasonable, making it an excellent choice for anyone looking for delicious food that won't break the bank. Whether you're a local or a visitor, Golden Place สาขาชวนชม is a must-visit for a great dining experience inside the market.

reviews.name: Jittima S
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience at this clinic from the moment I walked in. The facility was clean, well-maintained, and professionally run. The staff were warm, welcoming, and attentive throughout my visit.

They explain every step of the procedure and answered all my questions with patience. I truly appreciated that there was no pressure to purchase additional treatments, which made me feel comfortable and confident in my decision.

Especially, The doctor and staff were very transparent and professional. They showed me the product’s serial number, packaging and details of the product before the treatment, which gave me complete peace of mind knowing that only authentic products were being used on my face. That level of honesty and attention to detail really built my trust.

reviews.name: Xin Ling
reviews.text:
I did a number of treatments and surgeries with this clinic - Lower Blepharoplasty, Alarplasty, lips filler, Pico plus laser and CO2 factional laser for resurfacing.

The communication to the procedure itself, everything was very comfortable and assuring. The staff are quick to answer my questions and attentive to my needs all the time.

The doctor and surgeon are experienced and very knowledgeable. They were patient and explained what I wanted to know, address my concerns, and advise which treatments suit me best, and how the results would look on my face.

I felt well taken care of throughout the entire process. I am in my recovery phase and everything seems well so far.

Highly recommended to anyone looking for a reliable and experienced clinic. Will visit again for other aesthetics procedures when I am in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Follow Fauzia
reviews.text:
After about two hours of walk at Lumpini Park and The La Lai Saap market our feet were super tired and we thought why not just go for a rejuvenation and get a nice foot massage and get all of the tiredness out of our feet and legs!
We always walk by this place and never tried it so we thought we try it this time !

So we got a foot massage for a 60 minutes it was very reasonably priced and unfortunately I got the opportunity of getting someone that was really into giving a proper foot massage !
Halfway through the foot massage the guy decides to go to the bathroom  (yes I know when you gotta go you gotta go) in all my years of living here I’ve never had anyone go to the bathroom mid massage .. whether be at Foot 🦶 or whether it be at full body!

Anyway it was kind of disturbing because it lost the momentum of my foot massage I asked for someone else but by that time he had already come back but his movements of doing the foot massage showed he was doing a really deep massage but it was all just movement in his body and not really on my legs  🦵 or foot 🦶!  I had asked him to go strong on my legs like not on my feet but on my legs and he did it momentarily and then went back to just basically rubbing my legs!

Anyway I didn’t say anything I just basically went had it done I don’t know if I’ll try this place again !

It’s very nice it’s clean hygienic !
We were the only two at this foot 🦶 massage and then one other person came ! We were almost done! ✔️

Anyway I might have to give this another try maybe with a different masseuse ? 🥸🤠

Follow Fauzia for more amazing reviews in and around Bangkok and beyond you can follow us here as well as all our social media channels such as Facebook Instagram TikTok and of course YouTube and you can follow us on our blog and Follow Fauzia  dot com! 💦💦💦
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Follow Fauzia,

Thank you for sharing your experience. I sincerely apologize for the interruption during your foot massage; this is not the standard of relaxation we strive for at Lek Massage. I will address this with my team to ensure seamless recovery for all guests. We remain a trusted wellness destination since 1997 near BTS Chong Nonsri, and I hope you'll visit us again.

Regards,
Lek Massage

You can easily communicate how much pressure you prefer. I personally like it on the lighter side, and they got it just right. The place is clean, the staff are skilled and super friendly. Really nice experience overall!

reviews.text: 8 elements spa is soooo amazing!!! It's a good stop after a long tiring day. Definitely one of the highlights of our Thailand trip! 🤍 Khapun kha! 🙏🏼

reviews.name: Cece
reviews.text: I walked in around 8:00pm on a weekend. My therapist was Wi, and her pressure was just perfect. She helped release tension and fatigue in my body that I didn’t even realize I was carrying. I usually don’t like very strong massages, but her style wasn’t just pressing hard on one spot—it had a flow, as if she was spreading and dissolving the pressure. If it hadn’t been closing time, I would have happily extended my session. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Mark G
reviews.text: This review is for the 8 Elements Cafe that is part of the spa. The cafe was added about 5 months ago? It is a great little place to relax and enjoy  a drink and a snack. I have stopped in a number of times to get some coffee and try one of the bakery items in the case. Last visit was some banana bread and a mango melt muffin for take away. All was delicious.  Also, there are some beautiful photos on exhibit in the cafe as you can see from the pics I have posted here. Full disclosure, I am one of the three photographers with work on display in the cafe. I think the cafe is worth a visit and may be seen by some that it and the spa are together.

reviews.name: Sowmya Suryanarayanan
reviews.text: The massage was good. Extremely relaxing. I first did the foot massage. Love it so much that I went for the full body massage. The aroma oil.

reviews.name: Vyber
reviews.text:
The treatment room was very narrow, and the massage bed did not have a face hole. I had to turn my head to the side throughout the session, which was very uncomfortable.

The masseur also did not seem professional. During the session, she kept pausing for a few seconds, which made it feel like she was unsure of what to do next or she just falling asleep. I repeatedly asked her to use lighter pressure. Although she kept apologizing, she continued to use very strong force.

Overall, the experience was unpleasant. To make matters worse, at the end of the session, we even saw a very large cockroach on the wall. I would not recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
​Subject: Sincere Apologies Regarding Your Recent Visit
​Dear Vyber,

​Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us. I was deeply concerned to read about your experience, and I would like to offer my sincerest apologies for the discomfort and frustration you felt during your session.
​What you described falls far below our professional standards. We strive to provide a relaxing and hygienic environment, and it is clear that on this occasion, we failed to meet those expectations in several ways:

​The Facilities: We understand how uncomfortable a massage can be without the proper equipment, such as a face hole. We are currently reviewing our treatment room setups to ensure guest comfort is prioritized.

​The Service: It is unacceptable that your requests for lighter pressure were not honored and that the therapist appeared distracted. We are addressing this with our team immediately to ensure our therapists remain attentive and responsive to every guest’s needs.

​The Environment: We maintain strict cleanliness protocols, and I am horrified to hear about the pest sighting. We have scheduled an immediate professional inspection and deep cleaning to ensure this never happens again.

​We value your patronage and would like the opportunity to make this right. 

​Please let us know how you would like to proceed. We are committed to regaining your trust.
​
Warm regards,
8 Elements Spa

reviews.name: Ras U-Ahk
reviews.text:
Title: A Healing Oasis: 8 Elements Spa Massage Review

Nestled in the heart of tranquility, 8 Elements Spa has truly become my sanctuary of rejuvenation and relaxation over the past few weeks. My daily ritual of indulging in the traditional Thai massage, expertly administered by the gifted Nia, has been nothing short of exceptional. Each session felt like a symphony orchestrated by skilled hands, tailored to eradicate every ounce of tension and stress from my body. Nia's meticulous techniques and profound understanding of the human body seem to elevate the experience beyond mere physical therapy, fostering a deep sense of healing and rejuvenation within me.

As I ventured to explore new treatments at 8 Elements Spa on my final day, I opted for the head, neck, and shoulder massage, expecting nothing less than excellence. The skilled hands of Nia once again worked their magic, unraveling the knots and stiffness that plagued my upper body. However, it was the innovative use of a heating pad during the massage that truly left me in awe. The soothing warmth combined with Nia's expert touch created a harmonious fusion of relaxation and relief, truly unmatched by any massage experience I've had before. I can wholeheartedly recommend this unique addition to anyone seeking a transcendent massage experience.

The ambiance of 8 Elements Spa plays a significant role in enhancing the overall experience. From the moment I step through the door, I am enveloped in a cocoon of serenity and tranquility. The soft lighting, gentle fragrances, and soothing music transport me to a realm of pure bliss, preparing me for the healing journey that awaits within. The attention to detail in creating a peaceful oasis is evident in every corner of the spa, reflecting a commitment to providing a holistic wellness experience for every guest.

What sets 8 Elements Spa apart is not only the exceptional quality of their treatments but also the genuine care and attentiveness of their staff. Throughout my visits, I felt truly valued and understood as an individual, with Nia's personalized approach leaving a lasting impression on me. The staff members are not just skilled professionals but compassionate souls who take pride in curating an experience that goes beyond mere relaxation, aiming to restore harmony and balance to both body and mind.

Beyond the physical benefits of the massages at 8 Elements Spa, I have also found profound mental and emotional rejuvenation during my time here. The holistic approach to wellness embraced by the spa goes beyond surface-level relaxation, delving deep into the realms of inner peace and mindfulness. Each session feels like a spiritual journey, guiding me towards a state of profound tranquility and self-awareness that lingers long after I leave the spa. It's not just a massage; it's a transformative experience that nourishes the soul and uplifts the spirit.

In conclusion, my time at 8 Elements Spa has been nothing short of extraordinary. The exceptional quality of the treatments, the serene ambiance, the dedicated staff, and the transformative effects on both body and mind all contribute to creating an unparalleled wellness sanctuary. Nia's magical hands, coupled with the innovative use of heating pads, have redefined my perception of what a massage experience can be. If you seek a haven of healing, relaxation, and rejuvenation, look no further than 8 Elements Spa—it's a five-star experience in every sense of the word.

reviews.name: Mr Fazh F
reviews.text:
I visited Tara Sauna in Pattaya and had a very relaxing and positive experience. The place is clean, spacious, and well maintained, with a calm atmosphere that makes it easy to unwind.

The sauna and steam room are both excellent, with strong, consistent heat, and the pool is perfect for cooling down between sessions. Everything feels well organized and comfortable.

The price is very reasonable for what you get, especially compared to other wellness places in Pattaya. The staff are polite and respectful, and the overall environment is quiet and relaxing, even during busy hours.

If you are looking for a good-quality sauna in Pattaya with great value for money, Tara Sauna is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: David W
reviews.text:
The pros:
1  It is clean and reasonably new and appears to be well maintained with the exception of the scales that were not working in the gents.

The negatives:
1. The hotpool was just warm not hot
2. I could only stay in the steam room for a few seconds because it made me cough. Everyone else seemed to enter, cough and leave quickly. Maybe it is the chemicals used for smell?
3. The biggest negative by far is the male/female segregation by a large wall to the sauna, steam room, hot and cold pools. Why? In Thailand you can find female cleaners in male toilets but at Tara Sauna I cannot go into a sauna with my partner?! Instead as a male I have to go to a crowded male sauna whilst the ladies side is virtually empty

reviews.name: Maew CNX
reviews.text:
Above is an outstanding wellness spot in Pattaya, offering a top-notch sauna and hammam experience that leaves you feeling completely rejuvenated. From the moment you step inside, you’re greeted by a warm and inviting atmosphere that instantly puts you at ease. The facilities are well-maintained, ensuring a hygienic and comfortable environment for all visitors.
One of the highlights here is the surprisingly delicious cuisine, offered at very reasonable prices. Whether you’re taking a quick break or spending the whole day indulging in self-care, the variety and quality of the dishes make the experience even more enjoyable.

reviews.name: Paul Smith
reviews.text:
I visited Tara Sauna this Saturday afternoon. The place was completely packed with no parking available, not even for motorbikes. There was only one space left next to the kitchen, where staff also park their bikes. I was on my big bike and took that last space—only to have a staff member from the kitchen come running out, aggressively telling me not to park there because it was "for the big boss." I explained there was nowhere else to park and I just needed to meet my friends already inside. She didn't care and repeated that the space was only for the "big boss."

If the so-called boss really told her to chase away customers for the sake of reserving one special spot, that's unacceptable. If not, then the boss should urgently remind their kitchen staff to focus on cooking and cleaning, not harassing customers. Either way, this is a perfect example of how not to treat people who actually pay to be there.

Ridiculous and unprofessional. I will never return and wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone until they get new management that understands the basic principle: customers come first.

reviews.text:
Very good facilities here,  although a bit dated. Swimming pool (salted) about 20 metres plus one end is shallow and partitioned off for little kids about 5 metres. They have a small cold pool and then a very hot jacuzzi, a steam room and sauna ( x 2). The thing is except for the swim pool ,everything is separate for male and female. So if you go along with your wife or girlfriend you cannot share the facilities together which I find very bizarre. So come on Tara make the facilities Gender Neutral the year is 2022 these regulations are from the victorian era.
There is also a  full menu of good reasonably priced food available.

reviews.name: Tori Do
reviews.text: I got a massage yesterday and it was so good that I visited again today. It's not an affordable place, but it was such a good massage time. I've relieved the fatigue of my trip here. It's a place where you can get moderate intensity and great massage.

reviews.name: Sontia
reviews.text:
Here’s a polished, balanced version of your review that keeps it honest but fair and constructive:

The price was reasonable and the massage itself was good. The facility was very clean, and I enjoyed the tea afterward as well.

However, the overall experience wasn’t as relaxing as I hoped because the therapists talked to each other throughout the massage in Thai. While I understand that language barriers exist, the ongoing conversation made the experience feel less calming and a bit uncomfortable. When I go for a massage, I’m really looking for a quiet, relaxing environment rather than a conversational one.

I’m not sure if this is something that happens regularly, but aside from that, the massage itself was enjoyable.

If you want it shorter, more direct, or softer in tone, I can adjust it easily.

reviews.name: JOSH VERZOSA
reviews.text: The Massage is very hard and soothing.  I think i stretch the heck out if me.. Good stretching and bone cracking. The tension was release

reviews.name: Sumonta N.
reviews.text: I truly enjoyed my massage session today. The therapist was skilled and attentive, focusing on the areas where I had tension and stiffness. The pressure was perfect — not too strong, not too soft. The environment was peaceful, clean, and very comfortable. After the session, my body felt lighter and my mind felt calm. I will definitely come back again and recommend this place to my friends!

reviews.name: Joey Ty
reviews.text: Visited last night,I had a male therapist (named King), he had great massage skill and I really recommend to those who like hard massage and who likes to relieve all body stress after days of tour in bangkok.

reviews.name: Jorgen Frohlich
reviews.text:
Excellent massage!
The place is clean and the ladies are professionals. I have problems with my right shoulder and “Wina” took good care of me 😊🙌🏻
I would have preferred a more comfortable proper massage bed with hole for the head instead of just a mattress on the floor but with a few pillows it became quite comfortable.
I had traditional Thai massage combined with some western massage for my shoulder.
They use balsam which warms up the muscles.
Moon massage is easy to reach since it’s located right next to the Siam train station.

reviews.name: Ayal Solav
reviews.text:
Worst experience I had in Thailand (and I've been in like 30-40 massage places all around Thailand)
I took an oil back & shoulder massage and my wife a regular thai massage. The prices are significantly higher than most places in Bangkok so we expected a better experience.
The person who did my massage didn't understand what I ordered and started to do a regular thai massage on my back (I thought maybe it starts dry and then moving to oil) it was just a terrible massage. I waited for it to maybe get better and also I felt really bad to even say something but after 40 minutes I just stopped it in the middle and requested for her to leave.
After talking with the receptionist the best they offered is that someone else will do the remaining time and suggested a discount for the next time. We just left very angry. (I'll add that my wife's massage was ok but mine was so bad I can hardly describe)

reviews.name: Wong Man Kwan
reviews.text: I've been there for 2 foot massage and 1 body massage. All therapists are nice and professional. Good Environment, close to Siam BTS station. I will be there again.

reviews.text:

Skill of masseuse: 5 stars
Cleanliness of the place: 5 stars
Staff manners: 5 stars

I would love to go back there again.

reviews.name: UWAY CHUAH
reviews.text:
So glad I found this place.. it had this Spa like environment.. everything was so clean and tranquil.. blankets are cleaned and wrapped. you can see it from its pristine cushy white chairs to the cups serving tea. Massage beds had the cleanest face cushions I’ve had. It’s very clean and makes you feel relaxed.

I’ve tried foot. Thai. Aroma massage.
The masseuse are also exceptional.. Song. Kik.Pai.Deya. Of course.. each has their own skills. But everyone of them was very thorough from start till end. Khung at the counter was also friendly. I would definitely come again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review! We are so glad to hear that you enjoyed your experience with us and we would love to have you back soon!

reviews.text: We came for a head massage and back/shoulder/neck massage and found the prices to be very fair. There was a bit of language barrier and I wished they would use a bit more concentrated pressure versus just pressing with their forearm. Whilst the mattress was fine for me, it was too firm for my partner who was quite uncomfortable by the end.

reviews.text: Their daytime special packages are affordable compared to the other massage parlours in the area. Convenient location next to Siam station and very modern and clean on the inside. reviews.text: This is the first time of trying thai massage and it was excellent.  The therapist are professional and resonable price. reviews.name: Dennis Xing
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting moon massage for a much-needed food massage and I must say it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. From the moment I stepped into their serene and inviting establishment, I felt a sense of tranquility wash over me.

The atmosphere was soothing, with soft lighting, calming music, and a delightful aroma filling the air. The reception staff warmly welcomed me and guided me through the process, ensuring that I was comfortable and well-informed about the various massage options available.

The massage was deep and thorough. They washed my feet in the back and scrubbed it thoroughly, then proceeded to massage my feet in the front. It was a beautiful massage and I felt way better after.

reviews.name: Mi Mi
reviews.text: I was looking around for some activities and I saw that this spa also has a Thai herbal inhaler workshop. It was a hot day but they greeted us with cold Pandan water when we entered. I didn’t expect too much since it was 300 baht but I had an amazing time with the staff named Pin. She taught my friend group through all the different herbs and menthols used to create the herbal inhaler and I ended up with my own personal blend! I didn’t have the time but they also have another workshop where you can make your own balm which I would highly recommend.

reviews.name: Kari Lena Möhring
reviews.text:
I was twice at Klais. One day for herbal inhaler and Thai balm workshop and 2 days later for an herbal oil massage.

This place is like its own little relaxed universe. The staff is outstandingly friendly and respectful, and extremely calm. You get cold butterfly pea and pandan leave tea before treatments. The workshops were very informative and well organised, and the massage was extremely good.
Pressure, focuses, everything very well put including a form you fill out beforehand to let them know what you need or don’t need.
Their place is very clean, well put and also quiet and after an oil massage you can take a shower. You do not need to bring anything, all necessary amenities are provided.
After treatments you get hot mulberry tamarind tea.

Whenever I’ll be in Bangkok, I’ll return. Thank you:)

The location is along a busier area, so it isn’t the most serene setting if you’re looking for a completely quiet, spa-like escape. That said, it didn’t take away too much from the overall experience, and the convenience more than made up for it since it’s just a short walking distance from our hotel.

Overall, a great value massage in the Asoke area and a solid choice if you want quality treatment without the luxury spa price.

Our Services
Traditional Thai Massage: Restore your energy and relieve tension with authentic Thai massage techniques.

reviews.text:
I chose this massage shop because it’s Korean-owned and allows easy reservations via KakaoTalk, which was convenient. They promote having over 10 years of experience, but unfortunately, the massage itself didn’t live up to the expectations.

The therapist had a very strong touch, but instead of applying skillful pressure, it felt like she was just using her body weight — which made it painful and uncomfortable rather than relaxing. She also attempted several stretching techniques, but they mostly felt like my skin was being pulled instead of providing any real stretch or relief.

The balm used during the massage was also too strong, leaving my skin slightly irritated. The facility itself was more of a basic local shop than anything upscale, and while the staff was polite, the overall experience wasn’t something I’d want to repeat.

Wouldn’t recommend, and I won’t be returning.

——

I’m writing this follow-up review in response to the comment left by the management. Frankly, I found their reply quite unprofessional and disappointing. Rather than addressing the issue or trying to understand what went wrong, they seemed to shift the blame onto the customer.

I understand that massage is a personal experience and results can vary, but when a customer expresses dissatisfaction, the appropriate response should be to listen, show empathy, and aim for improvement — not to dismiss their experience by saying “what you experience and think is not everything.”

This type of response only reinforces my negative impression of the service. A truly professional establishment takes feedback seriously and uses it to grow, instead of invalidating a paying customer’s concerns.

Originally, I had given two stars, trying to be fair despite my disappointment. But after seeing the management’s response, I’ve decided to lower it to one star.

Even after visiting some higher-end spas in the Nimman area, none of them compared to Ziri. Since our hotel was located nearby, we asked them to arrange another session for us so we could enjoy the experience again.

They scheduled our second — and final — oil massage treatment in the morning, which also came with a special promotion. We were both extremely satisfied. The level of relaxation we experienced was truly unprecedented. It was the happiest and most memorable part of our Chiang Mai trip.

We even agreed that next time we visit Chiang Mai, we’ll book this place every day instead of risking disappointment elsewhere.

reviews.name: Lory Melendez
reviews.text:
What an incredible experience at Ziri Spa!

I started my day with the 3-hour “Vacation by Som” experience, and it was absolutely heavenly. From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere was peaceful, elegant, and welcoming. Every detail was thoughtfully designed to create a sense of relaxation and tranquility. Som’s care, professionalism, and attention to detail made this one of the most memorable spa treatments I have ever experienced. After weeks of planning, traveling, and sightseeing, it was exactly what my body and mind needed.

The experience became even more special when I returned to enjoy a 1-hour Royal Thai Massage with my two daughters. Sharing this traditional Thai experience together created a beautiful memory during our family vacation in Thailand. The therapists were skilled, respectful, and attentive, helping us release all the tension from our adventures throughout Bangkok and Chiang Mai.

The combination of exceptional service, talented therapists, a serene environment, and genuine Thai hospitality made Ziri Spa one of the highlights of our trip. We arrived tired and left feeling completely refreshed, rejuvenated, and grateful.

Thank you to the entire team at Ziri Spa for giving us an unforgettable experience and a beautiful memory that we will carry home with us.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Highly recommended for anyone visiting Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Melanie Hansler
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience at Siam Serene Surawong Massage in Bangkok.

From the moment I arrived until the moment I left, everything felt professional, welcoming, and relaxing. I especially appreciated that payment was made before the treatment, allowing me to fully enjoy the experience without having to think about it afterward.

I appreciated being given the choice between a male or female therapist. Having that option made me feel even more comfortable and showed their attention to customer preferences.

My feet were washed before the aroma massage, and I was then guided to a private room where I had plenty of time to change comfortably. My therapist, Tai, provided a wonderful massage from start to finish. Her pressure was firm and exactly what I was looking for. She mentioned that she could apply even more pressure if needed, but for me, it was absolutely perfect.

To finish the experience, I was served a lovely cup of tea. My girlfriend was waiting outside for me, and the staff kindly invited her inside so she could enjoy a cup of tea as well. It was a small gesture, but it made us both feel genuinely welcome.

Overall, this was a fantastic experience with great service, a relaxing atmosphere, and thoughtful staff. I would happily recommend Siam Serene Surawong Massage to anyone looking for a quality massage in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Rahma Hesri
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Excellent massage & very Muslim-friendly

I had a wonderful experience at Siam Serene Surawong Massage and would highly recommend it, especially for Muslim travelers. The atmosphere is calm, clean, and very professional, which made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived.

What I really appreciated is how respectful and Muslim-friendly the place is. They are understanding about modesty and privacy, and it’s easy to request a female therapist, which made the experience much more comfortable. The staff were polite, kind, and never made me feel rushed.

The massage itself was amazing — very relaxing and done with great care and skill. You can tell the therapists are well-trained and genuinely want you to feel better, not just finish the session quickly.

The location is convenient, the prices are reasonable for the quality, and the whole place feels peaceful and safe. It’s a great spot to unwind after a long day exploring Bangkok.

I would definitely come back again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a professional massage in a clean, respectful, and Muslim-friendly environment.

reviews.text:
Chris would he my second time visiting this spa. I decided to try the Gaysorn location as I haven’t been yet. I was paired with P’Chaba as my therapist. She was extremely knowledgeable about pressure points, showed incredible professionalism and very thorough with the treatment as a whole.

I really didn’t know how much I needed that facial treatment until afterwards when all the tension was drained my mind body. I’m going to sleep amazing tonight.

Aside from that, all the staff are incredibly kind and accommodating as usual.

While this is a more premium service, I’d say it’s worth every penny if you can spare it.

reviews.name: Suzana Crasto
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful experience at Maison Ysae. The Signature Plus face sculpting treatment was incredibly relaxing, professionally done by Kain, and left me feeling completely refreshed. The ambience is luxurious, fresh, and yet so calming — the perfect place to unwind and pamper yourself.

What made the experience even more special was how kind and welcoming the staff were throughout. I even had my little toddler sleeping on me during the treatment, and the team was so warm, patient, and accommodating, which made me feel completely comfortable and cared for.

The refreshing hibiscus tea with honey and lemon served after the massage was such a lovely finishing touch. Every detail of the experience felt thoughtful and premium. I’m so glad I experienced it — absolutely worth every penny and highly recommended for anyone visiting Bangkok!

reviews.name: Serena Masand
reviews.text:
My skin is glowing!!! This is now my 3rd time and every single time I leave feeling so relaxed and with the best results!
The staff are fantastic and the products are extremely high quality. I strongly recommend going here over and over again. I also tried the Buccal add on and it was great! Thanks to the whole team for such a wonderful experience always ❤️

reviews.name: Théo Lavergne
reviews.text: Came for the first time to Maison Ysae at the Gaysorn Amarin branch. I’d heard a lot about the brand in Bangkok and now I get why — the place is spotless, the vibe is really nice, and the staff are super welcoming. Tried their signature facial massage and it was amazing, so relaxing I almost fell asleep. Walked out feeling fresh, light, and completely recharged. Definitely coming back.

reviews.name: Grace Siow
reviews.text: Had a wonderful first facial experience in Bangkok. I chose the 90-minute treatment with bucca massage and eye contouring in a private cabin. Therapist Far was skilled, gentle, and never rushed, making the session deeply relaxing. The salon was clean and cosy, with honey lemon juice served before and hibiscus tea after. I left feeling refreshed, with lifted, radiant, glowing skin. Highly recommended!

reviews.text: I’ve done 90-minute Mu Signature treatment with Therapist Khun Karn today. The session is amazing - multiple techniques used to lift and sculpt face muscles, relieve tensions, and calm skins.  Good ambient and services. Highly recommended!

reviews.text:

Place is beautiful though and elegant. The therapist K LukPoon is strong but delicate in the same time; she is just perfect and I recommend her as you can feel the flow and how professional she is.

reviews.name: LJ
reviews.text: What a lovely salon. I visited twice when in Bangkok and each time had the Signature facial. The staff are super welcoming and helpful, they speak English although I did try to speak a little Thai.  The salon is spotlessly clean, fresh and beautifully decorated.  It is located in the newly refurbed Gaysorn Amarin - wonderful vibe.  The facials felt dreamy and relaxing. The results were clearly visible afterwards and my skin felt amazing.  My facialist recommended the gau sha and I bought one at reception.  There is a Maison Ysae tutorial which has been great.  The gua sha is now part of my facial routine and I love it! I highly recommend this place and can't wait to return when Im in Bkk next year.

I enjoy getting the red light therapy and eye contouring add-on’s.

reviews.name: Laura (Global Gym Bunny)
reviews.text:
Avoid. The massage therapist was grumpy from the outset and didn't even greet me with a smile. I selected a Thai massage which I've had many times before at various locations around the country, so I know what to expect. The masseuse's style was "fast and furious", working quickly and aggressively and there was nothing relaxing about it at all. It was often painful as she would use too much pressure. After I turned over, no-one had spoken until this point but suddenly she spoke, telling me i should have booked an  oil massage instead because i wasn't relaxed! I tried to tell her I wasnt relaxed because she was working so fast and hard on my body! And that it would be nice if she slowed down
She didn't and just seemed generally annoyed. It's frustrating because she definitely had skills and (having previously worked as an osteopath myself) I could tell she knew anatomy well and was in all the right places. She just seemed like an angry person with a bad attitude, taking her frustrations out on my body, which was very unpleasant. She finished 5 minutes early too.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We are very sorry to hear that your visit did not meet the standard of service we aim to provide.

We take your feedback seriously, especially regarding the massage technique, communication, and the attitude of the therapist. This is not the experience we want our guests to have, and we will review the matter internally with our team at the Wachiratham 4 branch.

We sincerely apologise for the disappointment and discomfort you experienced. Your comments will help us improve our service and ensure that all guests receive the professional and attentive treatment they expect.

We hope you will give us another opportunity in the future to provide you with a much better experience.

reviews.name: Semson Berhana
reviews.text:
I’ve been here twice with my wife the first time we went was very good we had very good massage therapists who were very professional.

The second time we went which was today at around 3:00pm my massage therapist was talking for the whole two hour appointment.

She was complaining to the other therapist about how she doesn’t get paid enough or get any tips from clients and also talking poorly about other clients.

She was also complaining about how tight I was and saying how she didn’t know what to do.

I was shocked about how she was openly talking poorly about clients and me, as my wife who is Thai and was right next to me could understand everything she was saying. She also completed the massage 5 minutes early so she could go prepare her papaya salad so I had to sit there waiting while my wife finished her massage .

While the massage was ok, the therapist had an extremely bad attitude and caused us not to want to return.

On the other hand the massage therapist my wife had was very good and professional and gave a great massage. Before we left I let her know she did a very good job. If I return I will be requesting this massage therapist as she did an excellent job.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Semson

Thank you very much for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. First of all, we're truly sorry to hear about your recent experience and that it fell short of your expectations — especially after your first visit went so well.

We are very concerned about the behavior you described. Professionalism and respect are fundamental values in our practice, and we deeply regret that this was not reflected during your session. Please rest assured that we are taking this matter seriously and will address it internally with the therapist involved.

We are grateful that you still took the time to recognize your wife's therapist for her excellent work — your positive feedback for her means a lot to us.

We would really appreciate the opportunity to make things right. If you’re open to it, please contact us directly at [your contact info] so we can personally apologize and discuss how we might be able to improve your experience moving forward.

Thank you again for your honesty — it helps us grow and serve our clients better.

Warm regards,
Owner

reviews.name: Suleeporn R.
reviews.text:
An afternoon well spent in a space designed for calm and quiet luxury.

From the moment I walked in, the warm wood tones, soft lighting, and thoughtful details created an atmosphere that instantly slowed everything down.

I started with a Himalayan pink salt dry foot soak—a grounding ritual that felt both simple and deeply restorative. Then moved into facial yoga, where every movement felt intentional, lifting not just the skin but the entire mood.

The experience was beautifully elevated with Jurlique—organic, gentle, and perfectly aligned with the spa’s natural philosophy.

And just when I thought it couldn’t get better… a delicate dessert to end the session.

A place where every detail is considered, and every moment feels like a reset.” ✨

reviews.name: Janine
reviews.text:
I had such a beautiful experience here from start to finish. I booked their signature programme, including the facial and organic hair treatment, and it genuinely felt like a full reset.

The facial was incredibly relaxing and left my skin feeling fresh, lifted, and glowing. The hair treatment was just as impressive — the organic products felt gentle yet effective, and my hair felt noticeably softer and healthier afterwards.

What really stood out, though, was the level of care. The staff were attentive without being overwhelming, making me feel completely looked after throughout. The whole environment felt calm, professional, and thoughtfully designed to create a truly special experience.

This wasn’t just a salon visit — it felt like a proper treat. I left feeling relaxed, refreshed, and genuinely taken care of. I would absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for something a bit more unique and high-quality ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.text:
Came as a walk in for a facial and scalp combo. Initially I was only going to be able to get the facial, but after it was done they were able to accommodate my scalp massage as well which I was very grateful for!
The facial was excellent, I was so sleepy and relaxed by the end, all the smells were great and Kate had great pressure while working on my skin.
Later I had the scalp massage, I caught myself lightly snoring a few times 😅 ultimate relaxation. It was my first time getting a scalp massage and my experience was 10/10.
Despite the language barrier, the therapists did an excellent job and I felt well taken care of. I was planning on walking around after, but I got so sleepy that I had to go back to my hotel for a nap!
The place is also located in a very cute area, I think next time I'll take a stroll first then go in for my massage 😆
Thank you so much! I feel reset now ☺️Definitely recommend this place!

reviews.name: Kelly L
reviews.text:
Great service and I did enjoy the signature facial. The staff was friendly and the overall experience was relaxing. That said, at 1,499 baht (~$41 USD), I personally felt it was a bit on the higher side for what was a fairly basic treatment. Similar services in the U.S. can sometimes be found for around $20.

Although the session was 75 minutes, parts of it felt a bit drawn out. For example, I was given a brush and salt to scrub my own feet and dip in pink salt, which was unexpected. They called it salt therapy, I felt it would have been better if it was warm or heated. The neck and hand massage were very nice, but the facial application itself was done very slowly, which made the pacing feel a bit stretched.

Overall, still a pleasant experience—just something to keep in mind if you’re considering value and treatment style.

The setting also seems to cater more toward tourists, and I was offered a small piece of facial mask in exchange for leaving a Google review, which caught me a bit off guard.

I originally came in looking for a scalp treatment but decided to try the facial instead, so that may have influenced my expectations.

Overall, still a pleasant experience—just something to keep in mind when considering value and expectations.

reviews.text: I had an incredible 1-hour foot reflexology session at Doctor Feet and can’t recommend it enough. The spa is very clean and quiet, and the staff is kind and skilled. My therapist knew the reflexology points extremely well. He gave me a labeled pressure point chart at the beginning and during the session, when I asked, he pointed out the exact spots on my feet where he found the most tension, explaining what body parts they mapped to. Super personalized touch and an amazing value for the price!

reviews.name: Władysław Korecki
reviews.text:
Best massage ever. Really. No kidding.
This isn’t for everyone — it’s for real connoisseurs. For those who have tried many different types of bodywork and actually know what a good massage feels like.
Dr. Neng is a true master. He understands all the important pressure points and how they’re connected throughout the body. He works with the body like a musician playing an instrument. His massage feels like a unique “melody” he has composed himself — something clearly refined over many years. Every detail, every movement, every press and stroke is perfectly connected.
It feels as if he personally senses every touch, or as though he has spent years carefully asking people exactly where they feel pressure and what they experience — then targeting those precise points. Other massage therapists may follow similar patterns, but they’re usually just adapting a standard approach to each person’s needs and body.
Highly recommended!

Normally someone injured like this would get compensation, but all I asked is if they could help and maybe’s pull the tendon back into the right place. I didn’t want to leave a review, it’s just so unethical to charge for help for an injury they caused.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Full Story below:
Dear Customer

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We are truly sorry to hear that you continue to suffer from foot pain and feel disappointed by the outcome of your visit.

As the owner of a massage shop that has proudly served the community for over 25 years, we always strive to provide safe, professional, and healing treatments to our clients. We are grateful for the many positive reviews we have received over the years, and we take every concern very seriously.

Regarding your case, we would like to respectfully clarify that when you first visited us over a year ago, no injury was reported during or immediately after the massage. When you returned more than a year later and mentioned ongoing pain, we did our best to offer a gesture of goodwill in the form of a complimentary half-hour massage, even though so much time had passed. However, long-term medical issues can have many causes, and we are not qualified to diagnose or treat medical conditions. For your safety, our staff recommended that any serious or persistent pain should be examined by a licensed physician or physiotherapist.

We sincerely regret that you feel we did not meet your expectations. We never intend to cause harm or show disrespect to any guest. Your feedback will be shared with our team to further improve how we communicate and handle concerns in the future.

We wish you healing and comfort moving forward, and hope you are able to find the care that best suits your needs.

Our licensed therapists blend traditional techniques with modern expertise to deliver a deeply therapeutic experience in a clean, elegant setting.

reviews.name: Aravindh R.
reviews.text:
Amazing experience. Would definitely recommend to anyone trying for an authentic Thai genuine massage experience. Me and my wife did Warm oil aromatic massage for 1850 Bhat per person.

They started with cleaning the leg and put us both in the same sound proof room with pleasant ambiance.

With face down- started with Back- neck & shoulders - right leg with stretch - left leg with stretch - left hand with stretch- right band with stretch- face up- neck & shoulders - right leg with stretching - left leg with stretching- right hand with stretch- left hand with stretch - body - face.

Finished with Thai back stretch in seated position. Amazing experience.

Gave us Tea with Mango sticky rice as complimentary.

Would recommend to anyone. Must try if you visit Pattaya walking street.

reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my visit! Special thanks to Fon — she is a true professional and clearly knows her craft. The massage was excellent, and she was very attentive to my preferences. The language barrier was not a problem at all — we understood each other perfectly.

The atmosphere is very relaxing, with pleasant music and friendly, welcoming staff. The small gift after the massage was also a lovely touch and a perfect way to end the experience.

I definitely recommend this place. If you’re in Pattaya, don’t miss it — you’ll be missing out if you pass it by!

reviews.text: After a long day exploring several islands, this massage was exactly what I needed. The place absolutely lived up to its extraordinary reviews. Easily one of the best massage experiences I’ve had in Pattaya. Highly recommended.

reviews.text: This place is incredible for the price, they welcome you with some water and wet towels. I did a foot massage and it was so relaxing! reviews.name: Oswald Gerard
reviews.text:
Coming in to this my friend and I were sceptics. Thinking if this massaag might be legit or not, and if it would be worth the cost. But how wrong were we. We were introduced to all the types of massages very eloquently by Sandy, who was extremely patient in explaining all the essential oils to us, and which would be the most beneficial. We chose an hour massage, and it was incredible. Incredibly relaxing, and we hugely regretted not choosing 1.5 to 2 hours instead. Special thanks to our masseuses Nooch and Ya, who did such a great job for my friend and I respectively. The back pain which bothered me for months was gone after this.

Not forgetting to mention the service standard post-massage. The mango sticky rice and all the other items were incredible. 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.text:
10/10 The best in Pattaya.

The staff at reception spoke good English, which made everything easy, and I had absolutely no trouble finding the location on Walking Street. The shop was very clean, the music was relaxing without being too loud, and the air conditioning was perfect after being out in the Pattaya heat.

Overall, it was a professional, comfortable experience from start to finish. I'll definitely be coming back the next time I need to recover after a hard week of training. Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
In A Nutshell:

-This place is a good deal for 700 baht (around $20).
-You get an ear cleaning, foot cleaning, feet/hand nail trim, hair wash, facial & a short Thai massage.
-This place can get booked up.
-I walked in without a reservation & only had to wait 10 minutes, but some others who walked in after me had to wait an hour or two.

Overall, its a good experience but like many others who've compared it to Vietnam, theres no comparison, Vietnam has better ones but this is still okay bc its a good value.

reviews.name: John Solitude
reviews.text:
Like many tourists I found this barber shop due to some popular YouTube traveler videos. This barber shop fully met my expectations. It's the pampering heaven you need when you arrive in Bangkok or the heat is wearing you down.
For 700 BHT you get a shave, a hair wash, a facial treatment, ear cleaning AND a traditional massage. To avoid misunderstandings: they do NOT cut your hair here.
It's not the most fancy classy place but it's clean, offers excellent price/quality, the staff is friendly and the service impeccable.
The only downside is: due to the popularity of the YouTube traveler videos, you'll have to be lucky there is a free seat and no waiting time. I advice to make a reservation before making the trip here.

reviews.name: Larry Cortez
reviews.text: I wanted a haircut but unfortunately it was a whole total experience for a man I did not expect. First, girls dressed in school outfit was interesting. I felt like I was in a private school with classmates ready to do unmentionable things to you. However, all kidding aside, it was the most entertaining and relaxing (sometimes nervous) attention all guys should get. Probably why it was so packed. Once inside you are assigned a girl (school girl) who quickly exchanges your shoes for slippers. You sit on a barber chair and the first thing she does is clean your feet. You feet is propped up over the sing and does a thorough cleaning between your toes and scubs your heel. Afterwards, I had my beard shaved. Yes, she used a straight edge and skillfully paid a lot of attention to every inch of my face. It was impressive. My face was then wrapped in what I thought was fruit strips. I couldn't tell but it smelled good. After my shave, I was given a very relaxing face massage. I can't count how many times I kept myself from passing out and putting myself to sleep. She was that good and my face felt so relaxing. After the face massage, she trimmed up my eyebrows and next did the unexpected...deep dive into my ear canal to clean them. Yes, she did a deep cleaning in my ear canal. I was totally nervous but she was careful with probing and removing a lot of my own wax. I had to relax. Next, we proceeded to go upstairs for a thai massage. Yes guys, there is more. This is more like what women do in several segments, nails, pedicure, massage, hair etc. This my friend is all-in-one for men! Yes, she cut my toe and finger nails too! Upstairs she got on my back and did a terrific massage. She did traditional walking on my back technique and I appreciated the cracking of my back to relieve my personal tension. She must of done 30 min of massage, but as I said she was making me so relaxed I felt I was going to sleep and start snoring. Lastly, she washed and massaged my hair. Again, I wanted to fall asleep with her hands running through my hair. Shortly after the massage and hair wash I was done. I didn't want to get up. I could of passed out and slept on that bed. Service...excellent. Girls, very nice and friendly. Place is very clean. Highly recommended and I will make it a regular thing to do.

reviews.text:
🗺️😻 Map Diary: แวะไป **เรือนพยอมมหานคร (สาขาตลาดงามวงศ์วาน)**
🏷️ เป็น **ร้านนวดเพื่อสุขภาพที่คุณภาพเกินราคา** ที่แมวส้มให้ **⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5 ดาว)**
🗓️ ไปเมื่อ: **ช่วงเงินเดือนออก คู่รักวัย 30 ไปนวดผ่อนคลายร่างกายค่ะ**

ชาวออฟฟิศวัยเลข 3 แบบเราๆ ถ้าร่างกายประท้วงหลังแข็งปั๋งต้องรีบมาที่นี่เลยนะคะ เมี้ยว 🚗 แมวส้มตั้งใจมานวดมากเพราะนั่งทำงานหนักมาทั้งเดือน บอกเลยว่า **ราคาดีงามมาก** ไม่ทำร้ายกระเป๋าตังค์แน่นอน 💸 แมวส้มเลือกโปรแกรม **นวดเฉพาะจุด คอ บ่า ไหล่ ราคา 350 บาท (1 ชั่วโมง)** ส่วนคุณแฟนเลือก **นวดผ่อนคลาย แค่ 250 บาท (1 ชั่วโมง)** ค่ะ ร้านสะอาดสะอ้าน บรรยากาศดี ตกแต่งสวยงามจนลืมไปเลยว่าอยู่ในตลาดค่ะ ✨🌿

สิ่งที่ประทับใจสุดๆ จนอยากป้ายยาคือ **ฝีมือของหมอนวด** ค่ะ แมวส้มได้ **นวดกับพี่บัว** คือที่สุดของความฟิน! พี่เขานวดตรงจุดเป๊ะๆ น้ำหนักมือพอดีมาก แถมมีความพิเศษตรงที่มีการ **ใช้หินร้อนนวด** ให้ด้วยค่ะ 🪨🔥 ความอุ่นจากหินช่วยให้กล้ามเนื้อที่ตึงๆ คลายตัวได้ดีมาก สบายจนอยากจะครางเมี๊ยวออกมาเลยค่ะ บริการสุภาพ จริงใจ ไม่ผิดหวังเลยจริงๆ ค่ะ 😻🧤

📌 บันทึกประสบการณ์แมวส้ม / คำแนะนำ: **สรุปว่าควรมามากค่ะ! ใครอยู่ย่านงามวงศ์วานแล้วปวดหลังต้องแวะมานะ แนะนำโปรแกรมนวดคอบ่าไหล่และขอคิวพี่บัว รับรองว่าตัวเบากลับบ้านแน่นอนค่ะ** 😻🍽️ (แอบเติมอีโมจิอาหารเพราะอารมณ์ดีหลังนวดเสร็จค่ะ!)
reviews.textTranslated:
🗺️😻 Map Diary: Visited **Ruen Payom Mahanakhon (Ngamwongwan Market Branch)**
🏷️ This is a **health massage shop with quality exceeding its price** that I, the orange cat, give **⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5 stars)**.
🗓️ Visited on: **During payday, a couple in their 30s went for a relaxing massage.**

For office workers in their 30s like us, if your body is protesting with stiff backs, you have to come here! Meow 🚗 I, the orange cat, came specifically for a massage because I've been sitting and working hard all month. Let me tell you, the **price is amazing** and won't hurt your wallet at all 💸. I chose the **spot massage for neck, shoulders, and back for 350 baht (1 hour)**, while my boyfriend chose the **relaxing massage for only 250 baht (1 hour)**. The shop is clean, the atmosphere is great, and the decor is so beautiful you'll forget you're in a market! ✨🌿

What impressed me the most, and what I want to recommend, is the **skill of the masseuses**. I had a **massage with P' Bua**, and it was the ultimate bliss! She massaged the exact spots, and the pressure was perfect. Plus, it's extra special because they **use hot stones for the massage**! 🪨🔥 The warmth from the stones helps to relax tense muscles really well. It's so relaxing you'll want to meow! The service is polite, sincere, and you won't be disappointed. 😻🧤

📌 Orange Cat's Experience/Recommendation: **In short, you should definitely come! If you're in the Ngamwongwan area and have back pain, you have to stop by. I recommend the neck, shoulder, and back massage program and ask for an appointment with P'Bua. You'll leave feeling light and refreshed!** 😻🍽️ (I added food emojis because I was in a good mood after the massage!)

reviews.textTranslated:
The place is clean and has a luxurious, upscale feel (the prices are comparable to other places). The staff are polite. Before entering the massage room, there's a foot-washing area with comfortable soft cushions (they even use spa salt).

The air conditioning is so cold it's freezing (I didn't take a picture). You can tell the staff what level of massage intensity you prefer.

title: The Zenith Clinic คลินิกพญาไท
ownerDescription: Skin, Aesthetic Clinic and Wellness center
address: 69, 14-16 Phaya Thai Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

reviews.name: Angela Angel
reviews.text:
Zenith Clinic is truly in a league of its own! From the moment I walked in, I was met with a level of professionalism and warmth that immediately put me at ease. The facility itself is pristine and modern, creating a high-end atmosphere that matches the quality of care provided.
The staff and doctors are truly amazing. They took an incredible amount of time to sit with me, explain the science behind the treatments, and ensure I was comfortable with every step. I never felt like "just another patient"; they were thorough, patient, and clearly dedicated to achieving the best results. I underwent a combination of Sculptra, Juvelook, and a Profhilo neck biostimulant, and the experience was flawless. Most importantly, I felt no pain. The doctor’s technique was so gentle and precise that I was able to relax through the entire session.
What really makes Zenith Clinic stand out is the combination of highly skilled practitioners and an exceptional support team. The doctors are experts in advanced biostimulants, knowing exactly how to layer treatments like Sculptra, Juvelook, and Profhilo for the best possible rejuvenation. Every team member was attentive, kind, and professional from start to finish, going above and beyond to ensure the procedures were as stress-free as possible.
I am so impressed with the results and the care I received that I’m already looking forward to going back for my CO2 Fractional face and neck treatments. If you are looking for a clinic that combines medical excellence with a patient-centered, painless approach, Zenith Clinic is the gold standard!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for a great review see you again soon ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

Great clinic! ✨ I switched to their YAG laser and I'm so glad I did. The good cooling system makes it completely painless, and you can even get it done with a tan. It's a truly effective method, the hair actually stops growing😌

I sincerely recommend this place)) Now I come here for laser hair removal.

1. Co2 laser - fantastic!!! I definitely see the result after few days and I appreciate the entire process from the doctor! Gentle and efficient.
2. Hair removal on my face - not sure what machine but I can definitely see the effect, and most importantly is painless. I tried many hair removal laser and I still get hair most of the time but in zenith, it’s literally just one session to see result.

I did these about 3 weeks, decided to only leave reviews after seeing the results myself. Will definitely be back again!

reviews.name: Mia Ybanez
reviews.text:
I just happen to see the clinic in tiktok while I was days away to fly to BKK.  I made a reservation through their whatsapp contact number.  They were responsive even in the middle of the night (I was surprised).

I arrived in the clinic and the staffs in the reception are friendly and helpful.  They made me feel comfortable, offered some refreshments and help.

The Doctor arrived and he directly explained to me the procedure.  He offered the filler instead of my planned Eyeglow; but due to time constraints I couldn’t do the eye filler.  I always have insecurities with my eye bags and dark under eyes.  This has been a struggle to me.  I was surprised when the Doctor gave the first injection on my right under eye; the effect was instant (in a few seconds).  I can easily tell that it was highly effective.  The Doctor was assuring me that it wont be painful; and true enough I didn’t feel any pain at all.

I will be back for the filler soon enough when in Bangkok.  I highly recommend this clinic.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for great review ❤️

reviews.name: Chuang J.
reviews.text:
I visited the zenith clinic for a weight loss related course involving GIP/GLP-1 (Tirzepatide) injections, specifically Mounjaro (Eli Lilly). I am extremely satisfied with the entire experience.

The service was excellent and very quick, but the best part is the price, it is significantly more affordable compared to other clinics offering the same treatment.

They also offer to securely store your injection pen at the clinic and schedule weekly appointments for the shot without any additional charge.

Furthermore, Dr. Nat provided truly outstanding and thorough consultation. He was very helpful and knowledgeable.

I highly recommend this clinic for anyone considering GLP-1 treatment.

title: Body Heaven Massage
ownerDescription:
Welcome to Body Heaven Massage , your ultimate destination for relaxation and rejuvenation in Bangkok.
Located at MBK center , one of the famous shopping malls in Bangkok, We specialize in a wide range of relaxing treatments, including traditional Thai massage, foot massage, full body massage, oil massage, aromatherapy oil massage, deep tissue massage, and anti-aging facial massage.
We use only the finest products to ensure you leave feeling refreshed.
Whether you’re a local or traveler looking for the best massage in Bangkok, we provide a clean & comfortable environment for self-care.
address: MBK Center, 5th floor, zone B, shop 23/24, 444 Phaya Thai Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand
street: MBK Center, 5th floor, zone B, shop 23/24, 444 Phaya Thai Rd

reviews.name: A Google user
reviews.text: I saw 4.9 ratings in Google but was deceived. I had terrible experience. Ordered 60min foot massage 350B, omg the therapist no skills and strength despite reminded her few times. The way she massage also not consistent. I did not enjoy my massage. You will know if the therapist is experienced and skillful. Will not visit again. Plenty out there in the row. And I dont like the system, why must we pay first before massage?
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry that your experience did not meet your expectations.

At Body Heaven Massage & Beauty Spa, guest satisfaction is very important to us. If a customer is not satisfied with the therapist, they may request to change the therapist by informing the cashier or supervisor. This policy is clearly displayed at our reception area.

Unfortunately, we did not receive any request during your visit. If our team had been informed, we would have immediately arranged a different therapist to ensure a better experience.

Paying before the massage is also a standard policy in many professional spas and helps ensure smooth service for both customers and therapists.

Nevertheless, we would be happy to welcome you back and offer you a complimentary session, so you can experience the level of service our guests normally enjoy.🙏🏻
