reviews.name: Spencer Greenwood
reviews.text: Ask for Noi,  she was really strong and knows her massage. Really friendly and experienced. Would have given it 5 stars but the noise from the talking, next bed along spoiled it and also the little timer clock took away the feeling of a personal touch.  Other than that Noi saved the day with her skills. Thanks Noi.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Spencer,

Thank you very much for your kind review and for recommending Noi — we’re really happy to hear she made such a positive impact on your experience. We’ll be sure to pass your compliments on to her.

We truly appreciate your feedback and hope to welcome you again for an even better, more relaxing visit next time.

reviews.name: Simone Perciaccante
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience. The massage beds didn’t even have a face hole, which made it uncomfortable to lie down for any length of time. There were no proper supports for the legs either, so the whole setup felt poorly designed.

The massage itself lacked any clear technique or structure—it felt random and not relaxing at all. On top of that, the staff kept talking continuously, which completely ruined the atmosphere.

Overall, not a place I would recommend if you’re looking for a proper, professional massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback, and we’re sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

We would like to clarify that we do have massage beds with an open face area; however, these are specifically used for oil-based treatments. In your case, you requested a Thai balm massage, which is traditionally performed on a firm Thai mattress to allow proper technique, stretching, and pressure application. This setup is standard and essential for delivering the treatment correctly.

That said, if you had informed our supervisor during your session, we would have been more than happy to adjust your setup or move you to a high bed with a face opening to improve your comfort.

Regarding the massage quality, all of our therapists are professionally trained and certified. We also have a clear policy displayed at reception informing all customers that they may request to change their therapist within the first 10 minutes if they are not satisfied, and our team is always ready to assist with this.

We truly value your feedback and hope you might consider giving us another opportunity to provide you with the experience we are known for.🙏🏻🤍

Kind regards,
Body Heaven Massage & Beauty Spa

reviews.name: LIZA K
reviews.text: Body Heaven is truly heaven as its name implies. We as family went for foot massage and really loved the experience. The ambiance is neat and clean. Staff is very polite and experienced. I got foot massage by Dwang and she is really an amazing person. Magic in her hands. Every staff is well trained and the sound of the music enhanced the experience. I wished to go back for face facial. I had taken their facial service for which I m really disappointed. The amt they charge was really high and service was really not great. I suggest this place for foot and Thai massage. I was willing to give 5 star but after my second visit for facial I was not that impressed as I thought to be.

reviews.name: Sarah Newman
reviews.text: Great service and very good customer service service. I recommend anyone visiting  MBk Central Thailand to go for a great massage at BodyHeaven massage and beauty spa
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: On behalf of all our staff at Body Heaven Massage we would like to thank you Four your kind words. We are really happy to hear this. Thanks again and we hope to see you back soon.🙏🏻💙🙏🏻

reviews.name: Alounie Somsana
reviews.text:
A wonderful experience at this salon! The masseuses were welcoming, friendly, and very professional.

The atmosphere is warm and relaxing, and you immediately feel at ease. The massage was both gentle and effective, exactly what I needed to unwind.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a true moment of well-being!

reviews.name: Sherief Soror
reviews.text:
I loved the place, stuff and the environment.
Very good people and professional, the owner also is very helpful and friendly….i highly recommend it for a professional cheap and amazing spa.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much Sherief for your kind words, we appreciate your visit and we hope to welcome you again soon and Body Heaven Massage & spa 🙏🏻❤️

reviews.name: Zarrina Dolphirina
reviews.text: Had my massage with masseur Noi. I had a very bad ache at my back, and she knew what was wrong and corrected it. I felt immediately better after the massage. Would highly recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are so happy Zarrina that we managed to make you pain relief, thanks for your visit 🙏🏻🤍

reviews.name: Chef Parsi
reviews.text: Amazing massage. I also got the foot massage with facial combo and it was fantastic!! The facial was sooo much better because they actually massage all the facial muscles and not just use a machine. You won’t regret going here!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It give us a great pleasure to know that you enjoyed your massage and facial, thank you so much for your visit and hope to see you soon again 💙🙏🏻

reviews.name: Missy E
reviews.text: Such an amazing experience. Noy was a magician with her hands, came out of there feeling like a new person. The place is cleaning and the stuff are kind. I recommend this place if you want a good massage
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks a lot for passing by our shop. It gives us a great pleasure to know that you enjoy your time and left feeling better. Hoping to see you again soon.

reviews.name: HRK KN
reviews.text:
I found a great massage place!
“ONE” is the best masseuse 🫶🙍‍♂️
Strong and kind.

The store is clean.
The staff are all kind and friendly.
I will definitely visit again!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: “We truly appreciate your support! Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed your visit. See you again soon!”

reviews.name: Saadet Etik
reviews.text:
I had a terrible experience. The entire “massage” was just constant pressure from her elbow for nearly an hour with no real hand work. It was painful, uncomfortable, and honestly felt nothing like an actual massage. There was no head or foot massage included either, which was disappointing. Overall, easily one of the worst massages I’ve had and I left feeling more tense than when I walked in.

Update**

Thank you for taking the time to explain all that in detail. I’m actually very familiar with Thai massage and how it normally works, so none of this was new information to me. That’s why my review said it was the worst I’ve had — because my experience was nothing like a proper Thai massage.

A traditional Thai massage isn’t just one hour of constant elbow pressure with no variation. There was no foot or neck work at all, even though I paid for a full Thai neck, back and shoulder massage. So while what you wrote is correct in theory, it’s not what I actually received.

I’m sharing my experience because people like me do read reviews before choosing a place, and I would have appreciated knowing this beforehand. I hope it helps future customers make a better choice, and hopefully helps you improve the quality of service as well.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are genuinely sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

We would like to clarify a few important points for accuracy. In traditional Thai massage, the use of elbows and forearms is a standard technique, especially for back treatments. Some guests find this very effective, while others may prefer lighter pressure. At any point during the session, guests are encouraged to inform the therapist if the pressure feels uncomfortable so it can be adjusted immediately.

Regarding your comment that no hands were used, we would like to state clearly that all our therapists use hands as part of every treatment, and a massage without hand techniques would not occur at our shop.

You specifically selected and paid for a neck, back, and shoulder Thai massage, which is a dry massage performed without oil and focused on pressure techniques. This treatment does not include foot or head massage, as those are separate services. All of this is clearly described in our menu.

We always recommend reviewing the service description before choosing a treatment to ensure it matches your personal preference. Nevertheless, we appreciate your feedback, as it helps us continue improving our communication and service quality.

Thank you again for your visit, and we wish you the best.

reviews.name: Anna Bellorbí Vilaplana
reviews.text: Fon is fantastic. Really good massage!

title: Jidapa Thai Massage
address: 1160, 3 Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Saranya Moungsila
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing! 💆‍♀️✨

I original is Thai but I live in Australia and don’t even live in Thailand anymore, but every single time I come back, visiting Auntie Su is a must. Before I fly home, I always make sure to see her one last time.

This is not your average massage — she genuinely knows how to find and fix the root cause of pain and tension. Every session leaves me feeling like a new person. Her skill, experience, and healing hands are simply unmatched.

If you’re looking for the best therapeutic massage around, look no further. I cannot recommend her enough.

Hands down the BEST Thai massage experience I’ve ever had. ❤️🙏

reviews.name: Thomas Achermann
reviews.text: Amazing Thai Massage in a very authentic atmosphere. The massage therapist knew perfectly well what she was doing. She was super attentive and I felt that all my tension were completely relieved. The price is very reasonable and I will go back for sure.

reviews.name: Paul Solo
reviews.text:
This is my third visit to Jidapa Massage
Previous visits have been great with experienced therapists who new what they were doing.
This gave me confidence to come back for another session.
Unfortunately todays session was terrible. The therapist was inexperienced and did not know what they were doing.
Even 12 hours later I'm still experiencing pain in my hips.
I've had many, many Thai Massages so I'm more than aware what constitutes good and bad.... I've had worse but this was not good at all.
Hopefully this was just a staffing issue
and I will try again but do proceed with caution.
Next time I may try the branch across the road.

reviews.name: top dog
reviews.text: This place is a gem!!! I’ve been to many massage joints in Thailand, and Jidapa is number one. Meaw-Meaw (Saifon Sangansatta Meaw Yakorn) gave me the best set of massages, ever, 3 weeks ago; Meaw-meaw really is an excellent masseuse; highly recommended. Next week I fly back to Bangkok and this’ll be my first stop.

reviews.name: YC Jun
reviews.text: I visited this massage shop because its score is so high. However, I experienced totally different. I took one hour thai massage and one hour for head, neck, and shoulder massage. First, massage skills were much lower than I expected, and secondary, I couldn't enjoy the massage at all because the staff kept talking and talking.

reviews.name: Yuner Liau
reviews.text: Normally when you go to a 300B/hr massage, it'll depend on your luck if the masseur is good or not. But this one is very worth coming all the way here. The masseur are very professional, their way of massage is very straight to the point, and put effort when massaging.

reviews.name: JW
reviews.text:
I have visited this massage shop before, and this time my five-star rating is especially for Teacher Su.

Although my initial session was just okay, I later had the opportunity to receive a 1.5hrs treatment from teacher Su, and it truly elevated the entire experience. Her technique is extremely precise — every pressure point and level of force felt accurate and well-controlled.

Even though we don’t share a common language, we were able to communicate through simple gestures. She also kindly showed me a few stretches and techniques that I can practice at home, which I really appreciated.

I originally hoped to book with her, but she was busy when I arrived. I’m very glad I eventually had the chance to experience her treatment. If possible, I highly recommend booking with Teacher Su.

reviews.name: Flupperoni
reviews.text: This was one of the most effective massages that I ever had. I feel relieved and I will come back to this place. The quality is very high and they know very well what they are doing.

reviews.name: Yu Zgurskaya
reviews.text:
It was the best foot massage in Thailand. My legs were hurting very much from my long walking 3 days.
I visited this place right before closing time.
And I felt so welcomed and was served with much patience and attention.
❤️❤️❤️

reviews.name: James Chuang
reviews.text: Relaxing and professional massage.  My wife and I both had a great foot massage, and the therapist really made sure my leg muscles got worked out.  We went back for an oil massage next day, and it was extremely relaxing.  Thank you!

reviews.name: Alex
reviews.text: I feel the Thai massage here is authentic and my masseuse is skillful. She literally stand on me and gave me some hard massage. Be ready to feel really painful if you have never experienced the real Thai massage. After my session, the lady boss checked on me by bending both my arms behind my back. Immediately she knew that there's some problem with my shoulder area and she proceed to do some more pressing for a few minutes to relieve the stress area. Even though she speaks very little English, she told me my problem is my sleeping posture. I was really blown away by how she's able to diagnose my condition without me saying anything. I can say she's indeed skilful and the numerous certificates hung on the wall further proved that. I'm sure her masseuses are will trained too. I'll definitely go back again. This is not a fancy place like those bigger establishment. I do hear some road noise from outside but overall the place is quiet. The massage beds are placed closely but are partitioned with curtains, so no problem with privacy and comfort. From the conversation I heard around me, I can see most of their customers are Thai. Hot tea are served after the massage. One suggestion I've is that maybe they can play some relaxing music in the background.

reviews.name: Sergei R
reviews.text:
One of few authentic massage places, where staff really knows what they are doing.
In many other places they'll just apply brute force without understanding. Here they try to better understand your muscle & joint problems.

So come here not for relaxation but for therapy

Things i missed though:
- not enough breathing space, the massage couches are very close to each other (divided by curtain) so sometimes your hand goes to the space occupied.
- no relaxing music/sounds and whole decor is not very calming. More like a doctor treatment (which is partly true)

reviews.name: Dom Stockdale
reviews.text: I used to live just around the corner from Jidapa Massage and would come here regularly. At the time, I thought it was just a great local spot—but after living in other parts of Thailand and trying countless massage places across the country, I now realise just how exceptional this place truly is. Every therapist I’ve had here has been deeply experienced, professional, and attentive. The consistency and quality of the massage is honestly unmatched. Without question, this is the best massage place I’ve found in all of Thailand.

reviews.name: Brendan Hung
reviews.text:
Went to the old shop last week, it's cozy and masseuse is professional and friendly.
Introduced to the new Jipada shop which is just 100m opposite to the right, and went there yesterday. The new shop is even better - newly decorated and more comfortable, masseuse are also very good.
As a tourist, highly recommdend is no-frill  massage shop.

reviews.name: Trisai Theppatipat
reviews.text: Very very good. As a local, this place is in my top rank. I had 3 hrs session with the owner(Su). She knows very well how to unlock my tight hips, shoulders. I felt like I have new body the next morning. I will revisit again very soon. Happy that I found this place :)

reviews.name: Patrick
reviews.text:
Not the most sophisticated place and not the greatest variety of massage options but the foot massage delivered by a male masseur yesterday was excellent and therapeutic.
No doubt one of the best I have ever had.

reviews.name: Anastasia Petrakova
reviews.text: The best massage I got in Thailand. Seriously, just on my way back home I stumbled upon this place and it was better than any special advanced massage place in Chiangmai. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Dominik Kočíř
reviews.text: That was an “aha moment”. Never had a better massage in my life. They even called for their teacher Su and I honestly didn’t expect it to be so life-changing. Even though she didn’t speak English, she managed to show me things no one ever did before – she located very specific muscles in bad condition, explained (by showing) how everything is connected in the body, and taught me techniques to strengthen them. On top of that, she shared literally another 20 insights that helped me understand my body much better. Truly unique experience.

reviews.name: ian zhu
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing massage. I am hefty guy and I find it tough to find a good masseuse who can target my knots. I am in agreement with the other reviewers that this team is legit! 5 stars 100% recommended

reviews.name: T C
reviews.text: Was able to receive treatment from boss lady herself. So thankful for restoring my body’s alignment from head to toe. Had been dealing with chronic pain in lower back and glutes from over a week of non-stop driving. Range of motion for legs/hips and arms/shoulders are back and better than before.  First time ever a masseuse pulled my fingers on three separate occasions throughout the session. First time ever scratching my back and shoulders to release toxins. I left rejuvenated beyond feeling good. I faced the facts of bad posture and the need to improve my workouts with focused range of motion movements and specific stretches she demonstrated. If serious about a healing massage, just get the “balance” and let the experts do their job.

title: Baan Dalah MindBody Spa
ownerDescription:
The vision and goal of Baan Dalah MindBody Spa is to offer high quality, “5 Star” spa services in a beautiful, peaceful environment at affordable prices. We believe that spa style services should be a regular part of one’s personal health care and that this care should be professional, ethical, sensitive, cost-effective and “family-friendly”.
The Menu of Services includes a full range of Advanced Massage & Spa Therapies as well as the Classic Thai Services. The Massage & Spa Therapies are significantly less expensive when compared with hotel and resort fees. The prices for the Classic Thai Services are also equal and competitive with the small street shops found throughout the central Sukhumvit area.
address: 2 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: KC Weaver
reviews.text: This is the place you’re looking for. Bangkok is big and loud and after a long day a relaxing sensual massage is magic. Not the street massage which focuses on “extra” this spa is not that. I visited “Q” (easiest way to pronounce her name) each time and I left feeling 1000% better after walking all over the city. They also take cards with a small charge. Ask for Q and thank me later!

reviews.name: Tfarang
reviews.text: Very good Thai massage. First time ever that I have been asked if I prefer soft, medium or hard. I opted for medium hard and know that was a tough job. But she delivered and took extra care of my stiff shoulder muscle.

reviews.name: Martina
reviews.text:
Was to this spa already last year and the experience was fantastic. Went again this year and it didn't disappoint. Their service is really good and the massage done professionally. This place is clean, proper and professional and not like most of the so-called Thai massage places.
Here they do everything from traditional Thai massage to facials, manicures and pedicures. I am coming back here again and can recommend this place without hesitation.

reviews.name: Mike
reviews.text: Absolutely loved every minute. Fabulous traditional Thai massage. Wish I could go there weekly.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your feedback. We glad you had a great time here.

reviews.name: Andrew Walker
reviews.text: Great service with friendly staff and a very clean premises. Try the oil massage it is so relaxing and really gives your aching muscles the relief they need.

reviews.name: Alson
reviews.text: Was here for a foot massage. The therapist name is Wan. She is so skillful and gave me one of the best foot massages i ever had in Bangkok.

reviews.name: KatSven
reviews.text: Great little massage place. Their best feature is he beds for food massage, super relaxing and be Swedish massage on the side! Gets the glutes, shoulder and neck muscles in a very efficient way. Try it!

reviews.name: Marylinda Motiup
reviews.text: Come for 60/60 classic Thai massage, all i can say is, probably one of the best massage places in Nana which is only 10m walk from Terminal 21. Request Fah as my masseur ( Recommended by my Boss ) and she’s very good. Definitely will come again when i come to thailand again.

reviews.name: Sakthi Ganesh
reviews.text:
I'll begin by saying that the foot massage I got first time was a perfect 5/5. But the second fully body aromatherapy massage was a total disaster.

Booked for 10.30 but was informed that it was delayed until 10.45 and it finally started at 11. The room was hot and masseuse didn't know how to control the temperature.

Coming to the massage, it's easily the worst I've had. The masseuse was not even putting in effort and kept of talking and gossiped when I said my leg was painful when tried to stretch it. No pressure at all. I get more pressure from the toilet shower. And did not wipe the oil with hot towel after the massage was done. But did this for the foot massage.

The receptionist just thanked is for giving the negative feedback. Didn't try to convince us or even ask sorry. All for 1300 baht.

reviews.name: Andy Kuiper
reviews.text: I had one of the most helpful deep-tissue Thai massages I’ve ever had. The practitioners name was ‘My’ (spelling?), she was just an absolute expert. A very experienced massage therapist. If you want a real traditional Thai massage, I recommend this spa.

reviews.name: jason Tan
reviews.text:
A decent massage shop with experience masseuse. Did a 1 1/2 Deluxe Foot, Back & Head Massage worth 550Baht.

The only issue was that I came around 1045pm. The pub next door was producing tremendous music that could be heard clearly in the massage shop.

Nothing much the staff could do, although they have the Silence Rule, where even the masseure don't even talk to each other. Which I greatly appreciate ❤️

I hope the owners could find a better location, or even maybe invest in a little, making the shop entrance area soundproof to the outside environment.

reviewContext.Noteworthy details: Not your typical quiet ambience massage shop. As there are several pubs nearby producing loud music.

reviews.name: Mimi
reviews.text: First time in Bangkok and we were looking for a place with private rooms and experienced staff. Luckily we found this very close to our hotel. Nice atmosphere, clean place, friendly staff and mostly experienced! We enjoyed it so much that we went a second time. We had Thai massage and body scrub. We didn't leave disappointed. We relaxed a lot and masseuses showed extra care on areas that were stiff.

reviews.name: Michi Todd
reviews.text: I always visit here when I’m in Bangkok, they are my go to for personal waxing and I’ve come with friends that get pedicure and manicure 💅. Really good environment that feels a bit more private, highly recommend for a full pampering session starting with a foot massage then wax or pedicure.

reviews.name: Prathamesh Narode
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience here. Absolutely professional. It was my parents first trip to Bangkok and they were truly impressed by the quality and skills of the masseurs.

reviews.name: Tiffany
reviews.text: I’ve been coming here for many years and have tried numerous other massage shops in Bangkok, especially in the Asok area. This shop stands out for its cleanliness, good air conditioning, and nice, relaxing background music. The prices are reasonable, and the massage therapists are skilled and very polite. The receptionist provides excellent hospitality service. The location is convenient, just a few minutes from BTS Nana station. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Varun
reviews.text: Great place. Interiors are not amazing but clean and very consistent massage quality. Only issue i find usually is they play some sort of slow piano similar to spa music but sounds more like kids lullaby. i always have to request for it to be turned down - which they always do.

reviews.name: Juan Gallera
reviews.text: Good Thai massages, I have been going there for a decade now. Good profesionales

reviews.name: Brianna Sanden
reviews.text: They really are the best for deep-tissue Swedish massages. I always go and get the two-hour, and I feel like I’ve gotten a sports massage the level is so good! Suffer from office syndrome and they just can tell what places hold tension and get after it. Really great! 5 Stars

reviews.name: Vy
reviews.text: We end up walking until our feet hurt most days so we come here for foot massages quite often. I also tried a facial and really enjoyed that treatment. Have had the classic Thai massages too where they crack your back, I love it all.

reviews.name: Emilie Van Look
reviews.text: I had the Deluxe foot +shoulders/head massage of 1.5 hours, but it was not very deluxe. While the masseuse was really good, I was not comfortable at all because I was being massaged in the front room, which was loud (at least 15 people came in and out, some leaving the front door open and talking loudly) and super cold. Even after asking an extra blanket/towel, I was too cold the whole time. Also the lady next to me complained about the AC. They also do pedicures, so while I was trying to relax, someone was cutting toe nails, just the seat next to me. My boyfriend took at the same time a more expensive massage (1300 baht) and he was put in a seperate room, and he was happy with the massage as well as the silence.

reviews.name: Lawunn Kabyar
reviews.text:

Big thanks to our amazing tour guide Ah Wei and our friendly, safe driver Pee Thie for making this trip unforgettable! 🙏

Pee Thie was always on time, patient, and drove so smoothly through both the cities and countryside. We felt safe and comfortable the entire journey. 🚐✨

Highly recommend this team if you’re planning to visit Kanchanaburi or anywhere in Thailand. They made our experience meaningful, fun, and stress-free.

Thank you both so much

reviews.name: Hsu-Min Wang

reviews.name: Abigail Chen

reviews.name: Belinda Lim

Nice to know Ah Hua can speak Mandarin and his sharings & details explanation.  Appreciate his patience , friendly guidance and gentle care toward all of his guests.

reviews.name: Gerald Tan

reviews.name: Prisca Marie

reviews.name: Charles W

reviews.text:
Ah Hua and John were patient and accommodating

Great Service by Vacio and Team

reviews.text:
這次的泰國兩日遊，真的非常充實又愉快！

第一天走訪水上市場、火車市集和海鮮市場，沿途感受到非常濃厚的泰國庶民生活與人情味。特別要謝謝導遊阿威，熱心又幽默，每天一上車都會先簡單介紹當天的行程，以及景點背後的歷史與文化，再帶著我們實際走進當地。更喜歡的是，他不會一直緊迫盯人，而是留給遊客很大的自由與隱私空間，相處起來輕鬆自在，是一位讓人非常舒服的導遊。

第二天來到古城與大佛，天氣雖然有點熱，但走在一棟棟老寺廟建築之間，彷彿穿過時光隧道，看見過去的泰國重新出現在眼前，還是讓人非常興奮。虔誠的媽媽也特別在佛像前祈求，希望今年全家人身體健康、事業順利，一切平安。

短短兩天，既看見泰國熱鬧的市井生活，也感受到歷史與信仰的沉靜。是一趟非常充實、舒服又愉快的旅程。

謝謝 Vacio 和 Monica 的安排，也謝謝阿威這兩天的陪伴。期待不久的將來，我們能再次在泰國相會！

（照片是導遊阿威拍的，很不賴呢！）
reviews.textTranslated:
This two-day trip to Thailand was truly fulfilling and enjoyable!

On the first day, we visited floating markets, train markets, and seafood markets, experiencing the rich tapestry of Thai everyday life and the warmth of its people. A special thank you to our guide, Awei, who was enthusiastic and humorous. Each day, he would begin by briefly introducing the day's itinerary and the history and culture behind the attractions before leading us into the local areas. What I appreciated most was that he didn't constantly monitor us, giving us ample freedom and privacy, making him a very comfortable and enjoyable guide.

On the second day, we visited the Old City and the Big Buddha. Although it was a bit hot, walking among the old temples felt like stepping through a time tunnel, seeing the Thailand of the past reappear before my eyes – it was incredibly exciting. My devout mother also prayed before the Buddha statue, hoping for good health, success in our careers, and peace for the whole family this year.

In just two days, we witnessed both the vibrant everyday life of Thailand and felt the tranquility of its history and faith. It was a very fulfilling, comfortable, and enjoyable trip.

Thank you Vacio and Monica for the arrangements, and thank you Awei for your company these past two days. I look forward to seeing you again in Thailand soon!

(The photos were taken by our guide Awei, and they're pretty good!)

reviews.name: Lior Sela
reviews.text:
At first glance, this place looks very impressive. The lobby is beautiful and gives the impression that you’re about to receive a high-quality spa experience. Unfortunately, the experience quickly went downhill.

I booked a foot massage, but the setup upstairs was more like a full body massage. There were no massage chairs, only a mattress on the floor. The massage area also was not air-conditioned, which is very uncomfortable in Bangkok’s heat. When I asked them to turn the AC on, they said other customers preferred it off. That made no sense considering how hot it was.

Instead, the therapist moved me to another room where the AC could be turned on. Later, when I went to pay, I discovered they had added an extra 200 baht charge for a “VIP room.” This was never explained beforehand and felt very misleading.

The massage itself was also disappointing. The therapist was inconsistent, repeating some areas multiple times while completely skipping others. She asked if she could walk on my hamstrings. I clearly said no, but she did it anyway. When I asked her to stop, she insisted that she knew what she was doing.

It also didn’t feel like a proper foot massage at all. It felt more like a random Thai leg massage.

To make things worse, the therapist spent a lot of time talking in Thai with another therapist in the room during the massage, which felt unprofessional and uncomfortable.

Overall, I left feeling very disappointed. The place looks nice, but the service, transparency with pricing, and professionalism were lacking.

I would not recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear, Mr.Lior Sela
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We are truly sorry to hear that your visit did not meet your expectations, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and discomfort you experienced.

Your feedback regarding the room setup, air conditioning, communication about the VIP room charge, as well as the professionalism during the massage has been taken very seriously. This is certainly not the standard of service we aim to provide to our guests.

Please be assured that we have shared your comments with our management and therapy team to review the situation and improve our service process, including clearer communication about service details and charges, as well as reinforcing our service standards and professionalism.

We truly value your feedback, as it helps us improve and provide a better experience for all our guests. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future and provide you with the quality experience you deserve.

Kind regards,
Healthcare & Spa Srinakarin Team

reviews.name: Justin Dong
reviews.text: One star is the lowest rating the system allows; otherwise, I wouldn’t even give that. As a massage enthusiast, I came here with high expectations, but the experience was extremely disappointing. First, the price is higher than other places, yet the therapist’s technique felt completely unprofessional. Every movement missed the right spots, and she even trembled when applying pressure, making it impossible to relax. It felt like she was just mechanically following a routine. If this is a training ground, you shouldn’t be charging full price for it. The foot massage was done using tools, which was very uncomfortable. On top of that, there’s no restroom available. Overall, I do not recommend this place at all, and I seriously question the authenticity of the positive reviews.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Justin,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We sincerely apologize that your experience did not meet your expectations, and we deeply regret any discomfort you encountered during your visit.

We understand your concerns regarding the price and the massage technique, and we take this feedback seriously. Our goal is to provide a relaxing and professional experience for all of our guests, and it is clear that we missed the mark in your case. We will be addressing the issues you raised with our team to ensure that our services align with the high standards we aim to maintain.

We also apologize for the inconvenience caused by the lack of restroom facilities and the discomfort you felt during the foot massage. Your input is invaluable as we continually strive to improve and enhance the guest experience.

We appreciate your honesty and will use your feedback to make necessary improvements. We hope you’ll consider giving us another chance in the future to show the true quality of our services.

Best regards,
Watapo Massage Management Team

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: If you are looking for luxury this isn’t it, but if you want a clean room, comfy bed and really hospitable staff then yes. Amenities aren’t much but the room has a TV, kettle and you get the teas at check in or when you get cleaning service with 2 bottles of water. There isn’t much of a view but there, is anyways someone there to help you carry your bags. There is street food outside if you are willing to walk. It is safe and everyone is friendly. It was close to the regent condo my friend stayed at so it was convenient for me.

reviews.name: S9355COsimonb
reviews.text: My Thai wife and I stayed here for 7 nights in Aug 2016. We were referred to this hotel by a local business as it was closeby. An older complex, it is tucked away off the noisy, hectic main road (Ngamwongwan Rd) and is relatively quiet. The staff were very friendly and courteous at all times - obviously it is a family run business with very nice young people helping on the weekend. English was limited other than front desk but not a problem for us. Not many Westerners stayed during the week we were there but plenty of school and sporting groups from other parts of Thailand, making for a nice atmosphere. We had our own car so the 24/7 secure car park and attendants were very much appreciated, as was the free internet which worked ok. Aircon was old and noisy but effective. Minibar was reasonable and refreshed promptly.||||If you are after a full English breakfast you have obviously come to the wrong place, however the daily Halal breakfast spread was delicious, with changes to the dishes each day. There are plenty of street food stalls nearby in Soi 9 but they close early. Bus stop and motorcycle taxi stand are just down the road, or it's a short walk to Pantip Plaza, The Mall and the newish Esplanade (can see from the room). Plenty of excellent eating options nearby if you have your own transport. Service Station and 7-Eleven on the corner so very handy.||||Rooms were simple but pleasant enough. The larger deluxe rooms on the Northwest corner of each floor feature traditional furniture and an extra window - much brighter. I will make one complaint regarding the cleaning staff - they were very friendly and did an ok job, but they constantly chattered on their 2-way radios in the hallways, making a bit of a racket for jet-lagged farang trying to sleep during the day. Some floors did not appear to be in use at the time, and we were on the top floor with a reasonable neighbourhood view from the very small balcony.||||There was also a day spa on site where we received an excellent traditional Thai massage. Overall a pleasant stay and very good value if you have business nearby or have your own transport to visit more attractive sights nearby.

title: DECOMMUNE

ownerDescription:
Social music club located minutes away from Khao San road. Hosting array of Indie and Electronic music, well known amongst music lovers, designers, creative sharing common fans around the world since 2017.

DECOMMUNE is also for rent to host selected events and always open to new ideas and concepts with a capacity of 200 plus. Rigged with a large LED wall, Meyer Sound sound system, artists green room, ultrawide interactive projections wall and fair crafted room acoustics for an unforgettable social experience.

Customers can sit and relax at the cosy bar section before their musical journey begin throughout the night with ranges of cocktails and many more drink selections. Overlooking Bangkok canal balcony for smokers with art wall.

Absolutely loved it here.

So sad to hear it’s closed now, but thank you, Decommune, for all the amazing nights and memories. You’ll be missed.

reviews.name: PK PTD
reviews.text:
Siri Sap Market Rangsit is one of those local markets that feels chaotic at first, but quickly turns into your personal food playground 😎🍜🔥 The moment you walk in, you’re hit with rows of stalls, loud vendors, and nonstop cooking sounds that make it impossible to stay calm. It’s busy, energetic, and very local, which is exactly why it’s so fun to explore 😂

The food variety here is insane, from street food classics to full meals, snacks, desserts, and drinks all packed into one place 🍢🍛🍧 You can start with grilled skewers, move to rice dishes, then somehow end up with dessert and a drink without even realizing it. Prices are affordable, portions are generous, and everything feels made for quick, satisfying bites 😋

Walking space can get tight and the heat is real, especially during peak hours ☀️😅 Parking can also be a bit of a challenge depending on timing. But if you’re here for the food and the vibe, it absolutely delivers. A proper local market experience where you come hungry and leave very full 💚🛒

The market is clean and has a parking lot at the back, with the front parking area well-organized. The food stalls are neatly arranged, with tables and chairs in the center for customers to sit. Most stalls sell ready-made meals and snacks, made-to-order dishes, drinks, tea, coffee, fried chicken, ice cream, and the famous satay pork stall. There's also grilled fish, noodles, roast duck rice, kebabs, pizza, fresh fruit, an Amazon coffee shop, a hair and nail salon, a massage parlor, etc.

I tried the satay pork; it was delicious, clean, freshly made, and reasonably priced.

reviews.text: สถานที่กว้างขวาง ร่มรื่น สะอาด และสงบ แม้คนจะเยอะมากแต่บรรยากาศก็ยังสงบ เหมาะวิ่งออกกำลังกาย ไหว้พระเพื่อเป็นศิริมงคลยามเช้า บรรยากาศตอนเย็นคึกคัก คนออกกำลังกายกันเยอะ นั่งพักผ่อนเอาบรรยากาศ มีลานจอดรถกว้างขวาง และมีห้องน้ำบริการ มีคุณแม่บ้านคอยดูแลตลอดเวลาทำการ อยากให้ผู้ใช้ช่วยกันรักษาความสะอาดนิดนึงในส่วนของการใช้นอกเวลาค่ะ รับผิดชอบต่อตัวเองและสังคม ไม่เกินความสามารถเราเลยค่ะ ถึงจะเป็นหน้าที่ แต่ก็เห็นใจคุณแม่บ้านที่ต้องมาทำความสะอาดในวันรุ่งขึ้น เป็นภาพที่ไม่น่ามองจริง ๆ
reviews.textTranslated: The place is spacious, shady, clean, and peaceful. Even with many people, the atmosphere remains calm, making it ideal for jogging and paying respects at the temple in the morning for good fortune. The evening atmosphere is lively with many people exercising or relaxing in the atmosphere. There is ample parking and restrooms available. Housekeeping staff are always on duty. We would appreciate it if users could help maintain cleanliness outside of business hours. It's within our capabilities to be responsible for ourselves and society. While it's our duty, we also sympathize with the housekeepers who have to clean up the area the next day; it's truly an unsightly sight.

reviews.name: นิรุต วัฒนพงษ์
reviews.text:
เพิ่งมีโอกาสได้ไปร่วมงานพิธีที่หอประชุมพุทธมณฑลมา ต้องบอกว่าประทับใจมากกว่าที่คิด ตัวอาคารใหญ่ โต๊ะเก้าอี้จัดระเบียบเรียบร้อยดี บรรยากาศโดยรวมเรียบง่าย แต่ดูสงบ เหมาะกับการจัดงานทางศาสนา พิธีราชการ หรือกิจกรรมที่เน้นความเป็นทางการ

ภายในหอประชุมกว้างขวาง แอร์เย็นสบาย เสียงจากเวทีชัดเจน ไม่มีเสียงสะท้อนมากนัก ถึงคนจะเยอะก็ยังไม่รู้สึกอึดอัด ข้างในมีจอโปรเจกเตอร์และระบบแสงเสียงที่โอเคเลย รองรับงานขนาดใหญ่ได้สบาย ๆ

รอบนอกหอประชุมมีต้นไม้เยอะ ร่มรื่น เดินสบาย บรรยากาศเหมาะกับการพักผ่อน มีจุดให้นั่งพักผ่อน และเดินถ่ายรูปได้แบบเงียบ ๆ ชิล ๆ ที่จอดรถกว้างมาก มาเป็นรถตู้หรือรถบัสก็จอดได้สบาย ไม่ต้องแย่งที่กัน

ถ้าใครมาร่วมงานหรือผ่านแถวพุทธมณฑล อยากแนะนำให้ลองแวะดูหรือเดินเล่นรอบ ๆ พื้นที่ บริเวณนี้เงียบสงบ เหมาะกับการมาใช้เวลาแบบสบายใจจริง ๆ
reviews.textTranslated:
I recently had the opportunity to attend a ceremony at the Phutthamonthon Auditorium, and I must say I was more impressed than I expected. The building is large, the tables and chairs are well-organized, and the overall atmosphere is simple yet peaceful, perfect for religious ceremonies, official events, or formal activities.

Inside the auditorium, it's spacious, the air conditioning is comfortably cool, and the sound from the stage is clear with minimal echoes. Even with a large crowd, it doesn't feel crowded. The projector screens and sound system are excellent, easily accommodating large events.

The area outside the auditorium is lush with trees, making it pleasant to walk around. The atmosphere is ideal for relaxation, with plenty of seating areas and quiet spots for taking photos. The parking lot is very spacious, easily accommodating vans and buses without any competition for parking spaces.

If you're attending an event or passing by Phutthamonthon, I highly recommend stopping by or taking a stroll around the area. It's quiet and peaceful, truly ideal for spending some quality time.

reviews.name: Shuxin Wu
reviews.text:
We had a great time at the Sompong Thai Cooking School!

Our teacher, Ant, was so friendly and adorable, she brought us to the morning market and showed us the common Thai ingredients, even giving us recommendations on which shops at the market sell the best snacks and fruits!

Ant was also extremely informative and positive during the cooking class, demonstrating all the steps with so much passion and explaining all the steps to us. She also gave us alternatives to the local ingredients so that we can swap them out if we can’t find them in our home country!

It really was a memorable experience and I recommend this to anyone visiting Bangkok! The food is also really good and may be even better than what you get at restaurants! ;)

reviews.name: Toby Thomas
reviews.text: Highly recommend visiting Sompong Thai cooking school! The market tour was short and sweet to show the differences in Thai cooking, and our teacher Ant was so lovely, funny and helpful. The steps were easy to follow, with a lot of ground work from the team ahead of time, so we could enjoy the cooking - and the delicious food afterwards! Definitely worth a visit if you're interested in learning good Thai cooking basics and going away with some lovely recipes

reviews.name: Angel Honda
reviews.text:
The most amazing experience in Thailand. Nancy was such a talented teacher and cook. It will forever change the way we look at Thai food, eat it and feel more inspired to make our favorite dishes at home. If you’ve ever wanted to learn how to cook Thai food ~ don’t miss this opportunity. 진짜 재미있고 맛있어용^^

reviews.name: Gordon Higgins
reviews.text:
Amazing staff. Amazing experience. Smooth but informative. You are making the real dishes. Starts with  trip to the
Market with a knowledgeable guide explaining everything about Thai ingredients fruits and delicacies. After you will learn a four course meal. Everything is explained from prep, cooking to plating and presentation. The guide (Nancy an experienced chef ) was fun, kind and informative and their helpers will make sure each person cooks his meal properly.

reviews.name: Marah Walsh
reviews.text:
We had such a fun and delicious experience at our Thai cooking class! June was our instructor and she was absolutely adorable—so friendly, and full of energy. She made everyone feel comfortable right away and explained everything in a way that made it easy for all of us to follow along.
Together we prepared three classic Thai dishes: curry chicken with eggplant, Pad Thai, and the perfect sweet ending—mango with sticky rice. June guided us step-by-step, sharing helpful tips about balancing flavors and how Thai ingredients come together to create those amazing tastes we all love.
Not only did we learn how to cook these dishes ourselves, but we also laughed a lot along the way and left with very happy, very full bellies. It was one of those experiences that’s not just about the food—it’s about the fun, the culture, and the memories made together.
Highly recommend this class if you want a hands-on taste of Thailand!
We even got a recipe book !!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

reviews.name: Vanessa Loi
reviews.text:

The team coordinating the class was also wonderful — very organised, friendly, and supportive throughout the session. The lessons were structured in a way that made it very easy to pick up, and I never felt lost at any point.

Highly recommend this school if you want to learn Thai cooking in a fun, supportive, and beginner-friendly environment!

reviews.name: Hei Wan Natalie Leung

reviews.name: Leslie Born
reviews.text: The most wonderful experience. Next time I'm here, I'm coming back for another session. The food was fresh and delicious. The class was so fun, too! Our teacher had lots of knowledge and the cutest personality. I highly recommend taking a class. Made cooking fun and easy.

reviews.name: Andie Acurantes
reviews.text: This was the highlight of my trip to Bangkok!! I had an amazing time learning about Thai ingredients and cuisine :) We first took a short trip to the market, where they taught us important things to look for when cooking Thai food. Thank you so much for making us feel at home here!

reviews.name: Lim Yong Siang
reviews.text: Fantastic cooking class! The setup at Sompong is highly organized, and the teacher did an excellent job explaining all the ingredients and techniques clearly. A definite must-do, five stars!

reviews.name: Gabriel Ricard
reviews.text: On our honeymoon in Thailand, and took my wife here for Valentine’s Day. It was really fun and also informative. Not only did they show you how to cook, they also explained why ingredients are used for certain dishes. I really recommend, especially if you’re on a honeymoon.

reviews.name: Giada Acurantes
reviews.text: Wonderful staff, great lessons, and AMAZING food!! Ms. Ant was the best, most welcoming and most entertaining instructor to have for this little piece of Thailand. reviews.name: Arthur Kueh
reviews.text:
One of the place where you don't just get authentic Thai but learn how to make it the way how the local does it. The best part is that you get to eat what you cook.

Nancy our instructor is really engaging, energetic and entertaining turning a cooking class an enjoyable one.

Would definitely recommend people who want to have a great experience aside from just a holiday.

reviews.name: Ana Charmaine
reviews.text:
Sompng Thai Cooking School is indeed a hidden gem.  I asked to do the Daily Menu, because I had wanted to learn how to make Thai Yellow Curry, and the school accomodated me even when it was full.

For the cost of the class, it was worth the price, I spent the morning learning 4 dishes, which was a lot od food for one person. Come with an empty stomach because you get to eat your own cooking.

Thanks to June a great instructor, and Mint, the assistant who had made learning Thai Cooking so easy even a non-chef person can learn to cook. I had a great time, definitely recommend, two thumbs up.

He explained everything calmly and clearly, and we could repeat every exercise as many times as we needed. We never felt rushed and always felt safe and comfortable throughout the course.

The dives were amazing, and Chris made the whole experience really relaxed and enjoyable. We felt very well taken care of from start to finish and would definitely recommend doing your course here. Thanks again, Chris! 🤿

reviews.name: Guillermo Rubio
reviews.text:
We are a couple of Advanced certified divers and we did 3x recreational dives in one day with Big Blue Diving in Koh Tao, including Sail Rock, South West Pinnacle and White Rock, and overall it was a great experience.

Conditions at Sail Rock and South West Pinnacle were challenging that day due to low visibility and lots of plankton in the water, but the team handled it well and made good decisions by changing sites.
The third dive at White Rock was absolutely fantastic, much better visibility, a beautiful reef and amazing marine life.

Our guide, Nadine, truly made the day special. Her briefings before each dive were excellent, very clear and specific to what we could expect on that particular dive. She was incredibly kind, professional and enthusiastic. Honestly one of the best dive guides we’ve ever had.
We would definitely recommend Big Blue Diving, especially if you’re lucky enough to dive with Nadine. :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Guillermo,
Thank you so much for this fantastic review and for choosing Big Blue Diving for your day of diving with us!
We're glad our team made the right call in adapting to the challenging conditions at Sail Rock and South West Pinnacle – safety and your experience always come first. It sounds like White Rock more than made up for it with that beautiful reef and marine life!
Nadine will be absolutely thrilled to read your kind words. She takes great pride in her briefings and ensuring every diver has the best possible experience, so knowing she's one of the best guides you've had means the world to her (and to us!). We're lucky to have her on our team.
Thank you for the wonderful recommendation, and we hope to welcome you both back to Koh Tao's waters again soon. There's always more to explore!
Safe travels and happy diving!

reviews.name: Sebastian Amberg
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience with Big Blue.

Especially with Jason as my Dive Master for two Days and five dives in total.

With his joyful nature he immediately created a comfortable setting to feel save and enjoy the boat trip and the individual dives. After a short while it felt like diving with a friend i met along my travels rather than a paid dive master.

He communicated very well and made sure that I was well informed about everything regarding equipment and the boat.
He also made sure to properly brief and de-brief the dives. He listened to feedback, took concerns very seriously and allowed open discussion about his decision. He explained very well why and on what base he took each decision under water. As a rather fresh and inexperienced AOWD I learned a lot from him.
At no point did I feel unsafe or doubtful about his ability or training.

What really made Jason stand out though was the fun you can have with this guy. He loves diving and he absolutely infects you with it.

To close this review out:
Big Blue as a whole seems like a well organized dive school with good equipment and a well thought out routine in handling the dive trips.

I highly recommend choosing this Dive School and diving with Jason if you get the chance.

As someone completely new to diving, I went into the course not quite knowing what to expect, but she inspired confidence from day one and made it easy to trust the process and fully embrace the experience.

I asked what felt like a million questions throughout the course and always received thoughtful, thorough answers backed by an impressive depth of knowledge. Every answer came with a big smile that showed just how much she genuinely loves diving and sharing that passion with others.

She brought great energy to every session and made the whole experience fun, relaxed, and safe.

The same can be said for Big Blue as a whole. The attention to safety, equipment maintenance, boat operations, and overall professionalism was exceptional throughout. Dive sites were carefully assessed each day, and decisions were clearly made with safety as the priority, even when that meant last minute change of plans due to weather or sea conditions. It was clear that safety was never compromised, and the entire team of instructors and dive masters was always there to support students in any way they could.

I left not only with two certifications, but with a much deeper appreciation for diving and the ocean. Thank you, Big Blue and Carolina, for the energy and for making this such a memorable experience. I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.name: KRZ M0NKey
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ A huge experience and a pro team, with just a few logistical hiccups!
Overall, Big Blue Dive Center is a fantastic choice on Koh Tao. Although there were a few minor shortcomings and one annoying incident, the great community and the quality of the dives make the experience absolutely worth 5 stars.
What we loved:
Professional organization: The pick-up service from our accommodation to the pier worked perfectly, exactly on time and seamlessly. No issues there at all!
Brilliant guides: The divemasters are incredibly kind, sweet, and highly trained. I have to give a special shoutout to my favorite, Luchi from Argentina – if you can, definitely ask for her to be your guide, she is simply super!
Spacious and comfortable boat: The main boat is huge, featuring a massive covered area where you can comfortably relax on benches and at tables between dives. The atmosphere on board was very chilled and fun the whole time.
Things to be prepared for (the less good parts):
Condition of the equipment: The rental gear at the dive center isn't exactly the newest or in the best condition. However, a huge positive is that if you bring up an issue, they replace it immediately without a word, so this didn't cause any major disruptions in the end.
The "hijacked" tank incident (needs more attention!): I knew I would need a 15L tank instead of the standard 12L for a specific dive. It was noted next to my name at registration, but somehow it was left off the morning checklist. The requested larger tank did make it onto the boat, but some incredibly disrespectful fellow diver went ahead and set up their own gear on it (I'd like to send a message to them from here: your mom is waiting for you at home!). I reported this to the crew, but since we were already out on the water, they couldn't resolve the issue. The dive center needs to monitor much more strictly so that nobody can set up on a specially requested tank that isn't theirs.
Adventurous boarding: Getting to the boats involves crossing a rocky, uneven shore, and the wooden pier is quite rickety. Morning departures are super crowded, and getting onto the transfer boats with heavy bags is a bit chaotic.
A few suggestions for the dive center for the future:
At least for the full-day trips, it would be great to provide ice and some sugary soft drinks on the boat (even if we have to pay for them), as they would really hit the spot between dives.
For the meals, it would be awesome to have a minimal choice—for example, just being able to decide whether you want a spicy or non-spicy dish.
All things considered, despite the things mentioned above, diving with them was a massive experience, and the positives totally made up for the rest. I highly recommend them!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your detailed and thoughtful review! 💙 We really appreciate you taking the time to share both the highlights of your experience and your constructive suggestions.

We're delighted to hear you enjoyed diving with us and that our team, especially Luchi, helped make your trip such a memorable one. We'll be sure to pass your kind words on to her. It's also great to know you enjoyed our spacious boats, relaxed atmosphere, and the organisation of your trip.

Thank you as well for your honest feedback. We're sorry about the mix-up with your 15L cylinder. While it was loaded onto the boat as requested, another guest mistakenly set up on it before the crew noticed. We understand how frustrating that must have been, and we'll discuss ways to better identify reserved cylinders before guests begin assembling their equipment.

We're also grateful for your suggestions regarding refreshments and meal options. Feedback like yours helps us continue improving the experience for future divers.

Thanks again for choosing Big Blue and for your recommendation. We hope to welcome you back to Koh Tao for many more fantastic dives in the future! 🌊🤿🐠

reviews.name: Nat Green
reviews.text:
I just completed my 3-day Open Water SCUBA certification with Big Blue Diving in Koh Tao, and I had an absolutely fantastic experience from start to finish.

The entire Big Blue team was professional, friendly, and incredibly well organized. From the classroom sessions to the pool training and open water dives, everything felt structured, safe, and well explained, which made a huge difference as a first-time diver.

A special shout-out to my instructor and guide, Zoe, who was truly incredible. She was patient, calm, and extremely encouraging, and she constantly checked in with me and the other students to make sure we were comfortable and confident. Skills like fully removing and clearing a mask underwater, regulator recovery, air-sharing, buoyancy control, and emergency procedures can feel intimidating at first, but Zoe explained everything clearly and made sure we practiced until it felt natural. Her positive energy and professionalism made the whole experience fun rather than stressful.

Over the three days, I gained real confidence underwater — not just learning the required skills, but actually feeling relaxed, aware, and in control while diving in the ocean. The open water dives were an unforgettable experience, and I always felt safe and well supported.

I originally chose Big Blue because a good friend of mine Jay from Canada did his Advanced Open Water training with them and highly recommended them. After this experience, I completely understand why... and I’m now recommending Big Blue to anyone considering diving in Koh Tao.
If you’re thinking about getting certified or continuing your dive training, I couldn’t recommend Big Blue Diving (and especially Zoe) more highly.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We're absolutely thrilled that you had such a fantastic experience completing your Open Water certification with us, and it's wonderful to hear that everything from the classroom sessions to the pool training and open water dives felt structured, safe, and well-explained.
Zoe is an exceptional instructor, and she'll be so happy to read your kind words! Her ability to make students feel comfortable and confident while mastering skills like mask removal, regulator recovery, and buoyancy control is exactly what makes her so special. We're delighted that her patient, calm approach helped you go from learning the skills to actually feeling relaxed and in control underwater – that's the sign of truly great instruction.
It's also fantastic to hear that your friend Jay's recommendation led you to us, and now you're passing that recommendation along to others. That kind of trust and word-of-mouth means the world to us!
Congratulations on your certification, and thank you for choosing Big Blue. We hope to see you back in Koh Tao for more diving adventures in the future!

reviews.text:
A Must-Do Culinary Experience in Bangkok!

I took the morning class at Tingly Thai Cooking School in Bangkok on April 24,2026, and it was easily one of the absolute highlights of my trip!
The Class Offering
The setup is incredibly well-organized and generous. We got to prep and cook a full four-course meal from scratch, which included making our own curry paste. We made Thai classics like Tom Yum Kung, Pad Thai, a flavorful chicken curry, and finished with Mango Sticky Rice. Everyone gets their own personal wok and cooking station, making it a truly hands-on experience. They even send you home with a recipe book so you can recreate the magic in your own kitchen.
The Market Tour (My Favorite Part!)
My absolute favorite part of the day was the morning market tour before the cooking began. Our instructor didn't just point out what to buy; they took the time to deeply explain the *"why"* behind each item. Learning about the specific herbs, spices, and fresh produce—and understanding how they balance to create that signature Thai flavor profile—made the actual cooking process so much more meaningful and educational.
The Instructors & Staff
I cannot say enough good things about the staff and our instructor. They were incredibly welcoming, funny, and deeply knowledgeable. They walked us through every single step with so much patience and positive energy. They made sure everyone—regardless of their cooking skill level—felt confident, supported, and engaged the entire time.
If you love Thai food and want to understand the heart and soul of its flavors, you have to book this class. **Pro tip:** Make sure you go with an empty stomach because the food is as abundant as it is delicious!

title: Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School
ownerDescription:
Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School – A Taste of Thailand with Heart

Discover the joy of Thai cooking in a warm, welcoming space led by our founder Gayle, who personally ensures every guest feels at home.

Choose to cook in the city or at our peaceful farm. Visit a local market, walk through our herb garden, and learn to cook 5–6 Thai dishes from scratch — with fun, laughter, and step-by-step guidance.

Cook, eat, laugh, and take home not just recipes, but memories.

Founded and directed by Gayle. Always cooked with love.
Chiang Mai, Thailand 🌿

plusCode: QXQR+VF Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text: From the market basket to the sizzling wok! 🌿🔥 Discover the true heart of Thai cuisine with Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School in Chiang Mai. Our Cooking Ambassadors take you through every essential step 100% hands-on—strolling through colorful local markets, hand-picking fresh herbs, pounding classic dishes in traditional mortars, and mastering the heat of the wok before gathering around the table like family. Ready to turn local ingredients into culinary masterpieces? Book your cooking station today!

Experience genuine cultural immersion alongside traditional culinary arts! At Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School in Chiang Mai, our warm and friendly instructors go beyond recipes to share everyday Thai culture, including teaching travelers how to speak and count in Thai. Enjoy an interactive, joyful, and family-style environment where learning feels completely natural and fun. Reserve your authentic Chiang Mai cooking class with us today!

Discover the signature bold aromatics and balanced acidity of genuine Northern Thai soup making! At Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School in Chiang Mai, travelers learn step-by-step how to prepare authentic Tom Yum Kung from scratch—infusing broth with fresh garden lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves, balanced with roasted chili paste, fish sauce, and freshly pressed lime juice. Enjoy interactive culinary instruction in our warm, family-style pavilion. Book your hands-on Chiang Mai cooking adventure with us today!

Pure culinary perfection! 🥥✨ Watch our students turn freshly pounded green curry paste into a velvety, aromatic curry using coconut cream, fresh herbs, and Thai eggplants. Experience the authentic, relaxing, and family-style cooking class at Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School in Chiang Mai!

Discover the professional techniques behind authentic Northern Thai stir-fry cooking! At Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School in Chiang Mai, our experienced teachers reveal key culinary secrets—such as using water to regulate wok temperature, release excess oil, and generate impressive wok hei flames for light, fragrant noodles. Our hands-on classes combine culinary education with a fun, supportive, and family-style atmosphere. Reserve your authentic Chiang Mai cooking class with us today!

From Chiang Mai to Nanjing 🇹🇭🇨🇳
Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School was honored to be invited to Nanjing, China, to share the flavors and stories of Thai cuisine through a hands-on cooking experience.
For us, Thai cooking is more than following a recipe. It is about sharing our ingredients, techniques, culture, and the joy of cooking together.
From Chiang Mai to Nanjing, we were proud to represent Thai food and bring a little piece of our kitchen to new friends in China.
Thank you for the warm welcome and for giving Asia Scenic the opportunity to be a Cooking Ambassador beyond Thailand. 💛

"Ever wondered why authentic Thai stir-frying needs that giant burst of flame? 🔥🥘

It’s not just for the show—it’s the secret behind 'Wok Hei' (the breath of the wok)! When high heat kisses the oil and vaporized moisture in a seasoned carbon steel wok, it creates an intense, smoky aroma and locks in the fresh crunch of vegetables and juicy tenderness of meats in seconds.

At Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School, our Cooking Ambassadors guide you through the safe, traditional techniques to control the flame yourself. Experience the thrilling rhythm of 100% hands-on Thai wok cooking right here in Chiang Mai. Ready to fire up your own station? Book your class today! ❤️🌿"
A lively cooking class day at Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School in Chiang Mai, with fresh ingredients, kitchen tools, group learning, and friendly class moments.
From class demonstration to curry paste ingredients, guests at Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School in Chiang Mai learn the foundations of Thai flavor through hands-on practice.

Asia Scenic in Nanjing, China 🇹🇭🇨🇳

From Chiang Mai to Nanjing, Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School was invited to join FoodTalks@XINTIANDI – iFCX Cook House and share an authentic Thai cooking experience with guests in China.

During the event, Gayle and the Asia Scenic team introduced four dishes that represent different sides of Thai cuisine:

Pad Thai, Som Tam, Chiang Mai Khao Soi and Mango Sticky Rice.

More than simply demonstrating recipes, our goal was to share Thai ingredients, cooking techniques, local culture and the joy of learning together.

One of the most meaningful parts of this experience was seeing guests actively cook, ask questions, learn Thai words, laugh together and connect with Thai culture through food.

For us, this is what being a Thai Cooking Ambassador means.

We are grateful to the team in Nanjing for the warm welcome and for giving Asia Scenic the opportunity to bring a little piece of Chiang Mai to China. 🇹🇭🤝🇨🇳

Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School — Chiang Mai, Thailand
Authentic Thai cooking, real learning and real experience.
