We’re so glad you enjoyed making your five spectacular dishes and dessert (and yes, we always make sure there is plenty of food to go around!). 🥘🌿

Thank you for taking a piece of Thailand home in your hearts. We hope these delicious memories stay with you both forever. We’d love to welcome you back to Chiang Mai again someday!

reviews.name: Fauziah Ahmad
reviews.text:
Olive was an absolutely wonderful instructor and guide! Her energy is infectious, and she has a gift for making the entire session feel like a fun afternoon with friends rather than a formal lesson.

The experience was so much more than just a cooking class. We started with a walk through the herb garden and a fantastic market tour, where we learned how to identify the fresh ingredients that make Thai food so special.

What really set this class apart were the expert tips and kitchen secrets Olive shared that you just won’t find in a cookbook. I loved her philosophy: “If you know how to cook Pad Thai, you can cook anything else.” It gave us so much confidence to understand the balance of flavors!

We walked away with full bellies and the skills to recreate authentic dishes at home. If you are in Chiang Mai, Olive is the best in the business—don’t miss out!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We appreciate you taking the time to visit Asia Scenic. We hope you had a pleasant experience and enjoyed learning about Thai cuisine in our kitchen. If there is anything we can do to make your next visit a 5-star experience, please let us know. We hope to see you again!

reviews.name: alex wedd
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful day today with our host, Noon.

We walked through the local markets and the host’s herb garden, which was a great way to understand the ingredients before cooking with them.

I love cooking, and I learned a lot about the aromatics of Thai food and how to balance sweet, salty, spicy and sour flavours while bringing out the core flavour of each dish.

We chose five courses to cook and were also served a traditional starter, so six dishes in total. The only small comment I would make is that five cooked dishes was more than anyone could realistically eat, and towards the end it felt a little rushed. Cooking four dishes would have allowed a bit more time without reducing the experience at all.

I highly recommend this class for anyone — whether you are an enthusiastic home cook, a curious tourist, or even a cooking professional. There is something here for everyone.

Noon was happy, energetic, informative and very knowledgeable. She managed the group really well and was respectful of the different nationalities and experience levels.

We look forward to showing off some new dishes at the family table when we get home.

Thanks, Noon. 🥰
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
What an incredibly thoughtful and detailed review! Thank you from the bottom of our hearts! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

It is music to our ears to hear that as someone who loves cooking, you found our class so insightful—especially regarding the balance of the four key Thai flavors and aromatics! Noon will be absolutely beaming with pride when she reads your wonderful words. She truly loves bringing high energy, knowledge, and inclusive care to every single guest, no matter their culinary background. 👩‍🍳✨💖

We also truly appreciate your valuable feedback regarding the 5-course pace and feeling a bit too full. We always want our family of guests to feel comfortable, and we will certainly take this into consideration to make our kitchen flow even better!

Thank you for choosing Asia Scenic and for highly recommending us to everyone from home cooks to professionals. We can't wait for you to show off your amazing new skills at your family table back home!

reviews.name: Karen Cheung
reviews.text:
What a wonderful experience! We knew more about Thai cuisine and the herbs. Had great time in the market and the farm. Can’t believe that we could make such delicious dishes on our own.

Noon is very funny and helpful, we enjoyed the class very much.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
"Thank you so much for the 5-star love! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Believe it! You are now a Thai chef! 👨‍🍳✨ We are so proud that you discovered your hidden cooking talents with us. Noon will be absolutely thrilled to hear your kind words—she loves making sure everyone has a good laugh while creating something delicious. 👩‍🍳😂💖

We're so glad you enjoyed the journey from the market to our farm. Keep practicing those new skills at home, and we hope to see you back at Asia Scenic soon! 🙏🍲🌿"

reviews.name: Abbie Freeman
reviews.text: Had a great experience cooking 5 different Thai dishes. Our teacher Sue was lovely, very patient, explained everything clearly. We were so full afterwards but were able to take dessert home. Top tip - don’t eat anything beforehand!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are absolutely thrilled to hear that you had such a great time cooking those 5 Thai dishes with us! Sue will be over the moon to read your lovely compliments—she always puts her whole heart, patience, and clear explanations into every class to make sure everyone feels right at home. 👩‍🍳✨💖

Haha, and thank you for sharing that legendary 'Top Tip' with future guests! We always love making sure our family leaves with happy hearts and very full bellies (and we're so glad you got to enjoy your dessert at home later!). Thank you for choosing Asia Scenic, and you are always welcome back to cook with us again!

reviews.name: Honey Badger
reviews.text:
It was a great experience learning from Tommy! You are a legend! :)
I loved eating Thai food and attending a cooking class with Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School made me fall in love more about Thai cuisine. It is one of the best experiences in Chiang Mai. It is a very well organized class, and to all the staff that helped made it easy for us to learn, thank you very much! I highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Wow! This review truly brought the biggest smiles to our faces! Thank you from the bottom of our hearts! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We are so incredibly touched to hear that our class made you fall even deeper in love with Thai cuisine. That is exactly why we do what we do! Knowing we were one of your 'best experiences' in Chiang Mai makes us feel so proud and happy! 🥹💖🌈✨

Our legend, Tommy, will be absolutely walking on sunshine after reading this! He (and our entire hardworking staff) sends you a huge thank you for recognizing their effort to make learning easy and fun. You were a wonderful student! 👨‍🍳🔥🙌

Thank you for the high recommendation. We hope every time you cook Thai food at home, it brings back the warmth and joy of our kitchen. We can't wait to welcome you back to the Asia Scenic family!

reviews.name: Basile d'Hauthuille
reviews.text:
We had an incredible experience learning how to cook authentic Thai food with Sue! She taught us how to prepare a delicious Fried Rice and an unbelievable Laab
Sue is a fantastic, patient, and fun instructor. She walked us through all the essential techniques and secret skills
The food turned out absolutely delicious! If you're looking for a memorable, hands-on cooking class in Thailand, I highly recommend booking here!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your incredible review! 🌿🍳

We are thrilled to hear that you had such a wonderful time cooking with Sue! She will be absolutely delighted to know that you loved learning the techniques behind the Fried Rice and Laab. Knowing that you found her teaching patient and fun truly makes our day!

Thank you for your high recommendation, and we hope to welcome you back to Asia Scenic anytime you're in Chiang Mai again!

reviews.name: Marie Chr
reviews.text:
I chose the farm cooking experience (200 baht more than the city option) and I absolutely don’t regret it. I highly recommend paying the little extra. We were surrounded by vegetation and had a detailed tour of plants grown on the farm, it was really nice to see where the ingredients we eat actually come from. The cooking area is also well ventilated so it doesn’t feel too hot.

What truly made the day special was Tommy, who led the class. The energy, humor, and good mood of Tommy made the whole experience fun, lively, and very engaging! As someone who works in training and facilitation in France, I can say Tommy has a real talent for leading a group. Congratulations and thank you for such a great day.

With 5 stars and around 3000 reviews, it’s clear this place has a great reputation and it’s absolutely deserved. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your incredible review! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We are absolutely thrilled that you enjoyed the Farm experience. It’s our passion to show our guests the journey of ingredients from the soil to the wok, and we're glad the extra bit was worth it for you! 🌿👩‍🍳

Coming from a professional in training and facilitation, your praise for Tommy means the world to us. He’ll be beyond honored to hear that his energy and group-leading skills made such an impact. He truly loves what he does, and it shows! 👨‍🍳✨

Thank you for being part of our 3,000+ review journey and for confirming that our reputation is well-deserved. We hope to see you again for more cooking fun!

reviews.name: Ian V
reviews.text:
Simply brilliant Thai cooking school that will have you cooking food that you didn't think you could in the first hour.

You get to choose a starter, soup, curry, pudding and first dish snack. You also make the paste used for the curry.

It was made so easy, and everyone in our group was blown away by the food they made.

My partner, who used to run a pop up vegan bistro, said it was the best Pad Thai she had ever made.

Thank you to Olive who took us through step by step andade it easy.

There is also a walk around the kitchen garden and the local market to talk you through ingredients.

We has so much fun and ate so much food that we cooked ourselves.

Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Khob Khun Ka! 🙏😊 Wow! This review just made our day!
Thank you for calling us a "simply brilliant Thai cooking school". 🌟
We are absolutely honored by your partner's comment. Hearing from someone with professional experience (running a vegan bistro!) that it was the "best Pad Thai she had ever made" is the highest compliment we could ask for! 🏆🍛 We are so proud that our authentic techniques stood out to a pro.
Olive will be beaming to hear that her step-by-step guidance made it easy and fun for everyone. We are also glad you enjoyed the market tour and kitchen garden visit—it truly completes the experience.
Thank you for the high recommendation!
Warmly,
Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School

reviews.name: Dawn Pumpelly
reviews.text: What a great experience! We loved our Thai cooking class and think we really learned some things to take home. “Thai” was a wonderful leader and so informative. He really managed the cooks and dishes so well. We couldn’t possibly eat everything we cooked but loved trying everything. Thank you, Gayle, for such a special experience. One of our top moments in chiang mai! Highly recommend!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
hank you so much for this incredible review! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We are absolutely delighted to hear that our cooking class was one of your top highlights in Chiang Mai! Thai will be so proud to read your compliments—he always works hard to make sure everyone feels guided, informed, and comfortable in the kitchen. 👨‍🍳✨🍲

And thank you for the special shout-out to Gayle! It truly means the world to our whole team to know you had such a memorable time and enjoyed trying all the dishes. We hope you bring these recipes and happy memories back home with you. See you again at Asia Scenic!

reviews.name: Michael Otto
reviews.text: The morning we spent at Asia Scenic Cooking School (including market and Farm visit) was really worth it. Olive did a great job of teaching us how to cook in a fun and entertaining way. We had done different cooking classes earlier but this was way better in the content taught. I highly recommend you to join the farm cooking class. Almost forgot..the food prepared with the fresh ingredients was delicious!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Khob Khun Ka! 🙏😊

Thank you so much for such an incredible and detailed review! ❤️

We are beyond thrilled to hear that our class was the best experience compared to others you’ve taken. 🏆 Olive will be so proud to know that her fun and entertaining teaching style, along with the content she shared, made such a big difference for you! 👩‍🍳✨

We are also glad you enjoyed the market and farm visit. 🌿 At Asia Scenic, we believe that using fresh ingredients is the secret to making Thai food taste truly delicious. Your high recommendation for our farm cooking class means the world to us! 🚜🍲

Thank you for choosing us, and we hope to see you again for another "way better" cooking session!

Warmly,
Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School

reviews.name: Leahsa Fisher
reviews.text: Highly recommend this cooking class. Instructor was excellent.  Facility was great. Received a cookbook with all the recipes. The food was delicious. The best part…… we didn’t have to travel outside of Chiang Mai on a bus to participate as it was right in Chiang Mai.   We were able to see the garden as well as walk to the market.  I’ve done cooking classes before, and this one rates the best so far.  HIGHLY recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for the HIGH recommendation! ❤️
We are so glad you highlighted the best part—our convenient location! Being right in Chiang Mai means no long bus rides, leaving you more time to enjoy the garden tour, walk to the local market, and actually cook! 🌿🚶‍♂️🥘
It is a huge compliment to hear that this cooking class rates the best compared to others you have done. We hope you enjoy using your cookbook to recreate these delicious memories at home. 📖👨‍🍳
Warmly,
Asia Scenic Thai Cooking School

reviews.name: Yunadil Nugraha
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Serene Sense Spa during my stay at Avani Ratchada Bangkok.

The aromatherapy massage was absolutely excellent, very relaxing, with the perfect pressure, and exactly what I needed after exploring Bangkok. The therapist was professional and attentive, creating a truly calming and rejuvenating experience from start to finish.

What made the visit even more memorable was the thoughtful hospitality after the treatment. I was pleasantly surprised to be served delicious mango sticky rice, which was such a lovely Thai touch and the perfect way to end the session.

The spa atmosphere was peaceful, clean, and beautifully designed, making it easy to unwind the moment you step inside.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a relaxing spa experience in Bangkok. I will definitely return on my next visit!

reviews.name: Candice Bull-Tennant

reviews.name: Athira Syafiqah
reviews.text: Walked in to the spa as we looking for a goood spa. The Lady Manager (sorry forgot her good name) assisted us from the lift itself. Very kind of her! My masseuse, Mrs Joy (if im not mistaken) are the best. Love her massage so much. Definitely will repeat again once i come visit bangkok again!

reviews.text:
I recently visited Sense Serene Retreat Spa and had a 90-minute aromatherapy massage—and honestly, it was just what I needed!
The spa is really easy to get to, and the moment I walked in, I noticed how clean, calm, and beautifully decorated everything was. It has such a peaceful vibe that you start to relax even before the massage begins.
The staff were super friendly and made me feel very welcome. My therapist was gentle but knew exactly where to work on, and the aromatherapy scents were so soothing. I felt completely relaxed and recharged afterwards.
If you’re looking for a nice place to unwind and treat yourself, I totally recommend this spot. I’ll definitely be back! 💖

reviews.name: ritata chen
reviews.text: Why are honest consumer reviews deleted as soon as they're posted???! To warn fellow Chinese - seems like all the promotions on Xiaohongshu are bought ads. Went there a few days ago, and an hour and a half of aromatherapy for two people cost a total of 3980 Thai Baht. That's about 430 RMB per person, and we thought we'd get at least a decent experience. But the aromatherapy wasn't even in a private room, just separated by a curtain in a normal streetside-shop-style room on the floor. Don't know what's so high-end about that. For that price, the service was just terrible. And there weren't even disposable mats provided for the aromatherapy. Super, incredibly disgusting. Plus, the floor and curtains offered absolutely no privacy. The technicians' skills were just awful. At the beginning, they used the same technique on the same area for a very long time until I asked them to switch. The replacement technician's skill level was also average. Privacy was extremely poor. My friend who went with me also had to switch technicians. By the end of the massage, we just wanted to laugh.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely apologize and hope to serve you again.

reviews.name: Minyang Le
reviews.text: We like this spa in that it has a peaceful vibe. Booking is best made through Line. They communicate well in English. reviews.name: Vera Huang
reviews.text:
This store’s manager was extremely unfriendly and didn’t smile at all. I’m a hotel guest, and after finishing the hot spring, I had to change out of my clothes, then change back into my own clothes, and then go to the spa next door and change again into their outfit. The service is very inconsiderate — they could have simply given me the spa outfit while I was at the hot spring, but instead they made it unnecessarily inconvenient.

On top of that, the card payment took a very long time and still didn’t go through. I’m certain my card works, as I had just used it successfully during lunch. Throughout the entire process, the manager never smiled, and when I asked questions, she often chose to remain silent.

I honestly don’t understand the role of such a manager in this establishment. The overall experience was extremely poor.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. Your feedback is well taken for immediate improvement, and we hope to have the chance to welcome you back.

reviews.name: Nannapus Wattanaporn
reviews.text:
The shop itself is nicely decorated, but the massage therapist was extremely unprofessional. She used her elbows excessively, and even after I told her it was painful, she continued.

The program was advertised as a neck, shoulders, and back massage, but nearly half of the session was spent massaging my legs.

Before applying the herbal compress, there was no warning at all. It was placed on me while still very hot, which made me jump. I mentioned 2–3 times that it was too hot, but received no response whatsoever. She also kept rubbing the compress against my skin until it felt like it was burning.

Overall, I did not feel relaxed at all. It was a very unpleasant experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. Your feedback is well taken for immediate improvement, and we hope to have the chance to welcome you back.

title: House of Taste Thai Cooking School, Sukhumvit 4
ownerDescription:
House of Taste Thai Cooking School provides the best hands-on experiences of cooking authentic Thai food. We are a group of people with keen interests in food and culinary arts.

We provide various cooking classes including Half-day Group Classes (4 dishes in 3.5 hours), Private/Advanced/Team Building, and DTV courses.

Group class starts with a local market tour to buy daily fresh ingredients. You’ll get to experience Thai culture and local lifestyle in Sukhumvit, Bangkok. Take Tuk-Tuk back to the air-conditioned cooking class. Cook and dine 4 authentic Thai menus made from scratch. This course is the perfect way to explore the traditions of Thai food and prepare you for skills needed to prepare the mouth-watering dishes at home.
address: 147/4, Sukhumvit 4, Samahan Aly, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Ashley Christine Dyer
reviews.text: This was the most AMAZING cooking experience! My husband and I had never taken any cooking classes before and the food we made was legit the best food we had ever cooked in our entire lives! Bense was an amazing cooking instructor and was all about helping us document our cooking adventure through photos and videos. We also had so much fun going to and experiencing the market beforehand. Would highly recommend. Definitely a highlight of our trip to Thailand!

reviews.name: Scott York
reviews.text:
Our cooking class at House of Taste was one of the highlights of our trip to Thailand! Our instructor, Bense, was absolutely fantastic—patient, knowledgeable, and made the entire experience fun from start to finish.

We learned how to prepare four authentic Thai dishes, including a rich and flavorful Thai curry, an excellent shrimp stir-fry, and the perfect mango sticky rice for dessert. Bense explained each step clearly, shared great cooking tips, and made sure everyone felt comfortable, regardless of their experience in the kitchen.

The ingredients were fresh, the atmosphere was welcoming, and the class was hands-on from beginning to end. Best of all, we left with the confidence to recreate these delicious dishes at home.

If you’re visiting Thailand and want an authentic, memorable experience, I highly recommend House of Taste. Ask for Bense if you can—you’ll have an amazing time!

reviews.name: Molly Howie
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience at House of Taste in Bangkok! Jay was fantastic, friendly, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. The experience started with a visit to the local market where we learned about and selected fresh ingredients, which made the class even more authentic and enjoyable.

Back at the cooking school, we prepared three delicious Thai dishes and a dessert, with clear instructions and plenty of hands-on cooking. Everything was well organised, and the atmosphere was relaxed and fun.

For the price we paid, the experience was exceptional and great value for money. We left with full stomachs, new skills, and wonderful memories. Highly recommend House of Taste to anyone visiting Bangkok and wanting an authentic Thai cooking experience!

reviews.name: Ashish Kumar
reviews.text:
I came to Bangkok with my girlfriend and planned to take a cooking class with House of Taste. Our host, Bense, was absolutely amazing! She was such a fun and friendly person, and she made the whole experience enjoyable from start to finish.

We had a great time learning, cooking, and enjoying the food together. Bense made the session really relaxed and entertaining, and we genuinely enjoyed every moment of it.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a fun and memorable cooking class in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Autumn Wong
reviews.text: This was such a great experience! Don’t eat before you go, though. We made 3 delicious dishes and a classic dessert. Our instructor/chef was Bense and she was amazing! She took the time to answer our questions, she was highly knowledgeable, and really funny and down to earth. The staff were kind and worked in a seamless rhythm. Also, make sure you give yourself extra time to get there if it’s a weekend because the traffic is unreal. Highly recommend this class!

reviews.name: Marissa James
reviews.text: One of the highlights of our trip! The House of Taste team had us laughing the entire class while teaching us how to cook some of Thailand’s most iconic dishes—Tom Yum Goong, Pad See Ew, Panang Curry, and the best Mango Sticky Rice. The atmosphere was so friendly and welcoming that it felt like cooking with friends rather than taking a class. The instructions were easy to follow, the food was incredible, and we learned techniques we’ll actually use at home. If you’re visiting Thailand, don’t miss this experience!

reviews.name: Bethany Noble
reviews.text: Had such a fun experience at this cooking school! Jay was an amazing teacher – so funny, friendly and made the whole class really enjoyable. We learned to make mango sticky rice, curry, soup and other delicious Thai dish, and everything tasted incredible. Be warned though, there’s so much food, so come hungry! I’d definitely recommend this to anyone visiting Bangkok and wanting to learn authentic Thai cooking.

reviews.name: Veronica Toth
reviews.text: Lovely cooking course for our family of three . It began with a detailed tour of a vegetable market followed by a tuck tuck trip to the school. Jay described every step with great detail. She allowed us to taste the ingredients, which were all fresh and delicious. In all we made 4 dishes including yummy red curry and my favourite mango curry. Highly recommended 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

reviews.name: Sarah Doherty
reviews.text: An amazing experience. Cooked and tried new dishes and loved every one.  Our teacher, Bense, made it fun and informative. The market tour was cute with a short tuk tuk ride back to the cooking school 💞 10/10 recommend.

reviews.name: Kelly Lim
reviews.text: Fun and interactive hands-on experience! Bense is a very knowledgeable and patient instructor, guiding us through each step of the cooking process meticulously. This is a fun experience that I would recommend to everyone interested in Thai cooking!

reviews.name: Illya Church
reviews.text: Very fun and enjoyable experience. Everyday it's a different dish and you can meet lots of people from all over the world. They also work with DTV visa and approved  by the thai government to work with DTV visa so you won't have any issues at immigration from soft power side of things. Chefs are fun and energetic, always smiling. I know it's very hard job, working almost everyday and still smile. I also want to shout out to those guys that clean after every meal we cook and prepare other dish. They work hard as well. Everything was always prepared and ready, no delays. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: xCharles P. Kielkopf
reviews.text:
This was the best time that we had in Thailand!  Bense was our cooking instructor and she was informative and incredibly knowledgeable and helpful.  They food that we made was great.  I learned a lot and the others in the class were great! She set such warm and inviting environment.  Just cannot say enough good things about the experience.

This sets the standard for having a great cultural experience.  Learned not just about Thai cooking but the culture itself.

reviews.name: Giovanni F.
reviews.text: That was a true, authentic, amazing cooking experience. I attended with my son during our trip to Thailand and we loved it. April, the teacher, was very nice, spoke a very good English and explained to us every step, adding some interesting facts or tips. We started off shopping for ingredients at a local market and then reached the school with a Tuk Tuk. We cooked some signature Thai dishes like Pad Thai with prawns, green curry, a soup and mango sticky rice. It took a good 4 hours to cook and eat all of our cooking masterpieces, which ended up being much better than I expected. They even adjusted the recipe for some of us based on diets or allergies. Overall she made it seem such an easy task, I just hope it will seem as easy this evening when I will attempt to cook my own Pad Thai at home, using the recipe they provided after the class. Some ingredients are not really easy to find outside of Thailand, but I hope I can get away with a surrogate…

reviews.name: Pengkun Hou
reviews.text: Wonderful experience! The recipe here is absolutely AMAZING. Our teacher May was very helpful, and she taught us a lot about Thai ingredients. Worth spending half a day to pay a visit here😊

reviews.name: Ritu Patel
reviews.text: We had a great experience. I love doing classes when I travel and this was so fun. It was from 1-4pm. We made tom kha soup, green curry, pad thai, and mango sticky rice. They had lockers to hold our belongings if needed. They also have AC, just have to tell them to turn it on if you want it on.

reviews.name: Dominika Zaranska
reviews.text: It was great! We took the sunday class and all the dishes were very yummy. We took the class with 6 people in total and there was plenty of time for questions, and the instructor could help everyone separately. The vegetarian option was also great!

reviews.name: Agent Coconut
reviews.text: Absolutely perfect experience with our guide and chef April. Everything was well arranged, from the market visit to the cooking class. The ingredients were fresh and delicious. The guidance was great and easy to follow. If you are vegetarian it’s no issue to change some of the ingredients. All dishes are cooked from scratch means that you’ll make your own coconut milk and curry paste. In total the event took around 3.5 hours 🙏 a must do in Bangkok!

reviews.name: JL Cruz
reviews.text: Really enjoyed this Thai cooking class! It was hands-on, fun, and easy to follow even for beginners. The instructor explained everything clearly and shared helpful tips along the way. The dishes we made (especially pad thai!) tasted super authentic. Definitely worth trying if you’re in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Aishwarya Saini
reviews.text:
We had the best time learning how to cook Thai food. Had so much fun cooking with Bense. She was so much fun and entertaining through out the class. 🫶🏻

Must experience when in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Eugene Tan
reviews.text:
I applied my DTV thru House Of Taste because they have 2 locations and flexible arrangements.

My reviews, staffs communicate in English, remembers my diet preferences, no hidden charges and pretty much hassle free DTV applications.

They staffs go out of their way to assist me which includes my personal trivial questions such as parking around their office without attending their cooking class. This is how amazing their help is to me.

Besides DTV they do offer cooking lessons as well.

For those whom are interested, both of their locations are close proximity to tourist’s attractions/popular shopping malls.

title: Heavena Wellness & Spa – Phloen Chit
ownerDescription:
Escape the city's rush and indulge in true relaxation at Heavena Wellness & Spa, a 5-star day spa located inside Sivatel Hotel, Ploenchit. Experience signature Thai massage and aromatherapy treatments designed to refresh both body and mind.
Recognized among Bangkok’s Top 10 Spas and a recipient of Tripadvisor’s Traveller Choice Award, we offer exceptional service and serene surroundings — a luxury retreat made comfortably within reach.
address: 8th Floor, of Sivatel Hotel, 53 Witthayu Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand
street: 8th Floor, of Sivatel Hotel, 53 Witthayu Rd

ownerUpdates.text: Escape the Bangkok afternoon with a moment of calm at Heavena Wellness & Spa, Phloen Chit — on the 8th floor of Sivatel Hotel, a 3-minute walk from BTS Phloen Chit (Exit 5). Choose from Royal Thai Massage, warm-oil aromatherapy, or our exclusive Heavena Signature Massage: 90 minutes blending warm-oil aromatherapy with traditional Royal Thai techniques. Couples treatment rooms, free parking validation, and service in Thai, English, Mandarin, and Korean. Open daily 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM (last booking 90 minutes before closing). Reserve via LINE @heavenawellness or book online.

reviews.name: Mariues Thanakorn
reviews.text: Heavena at Sivatel is the perfect spot to unwind. Beautiful and quiet rooms, friendly staff, and amazing treatments. The welcome drink and post-massage treats are a lovely touch. Finding a high-quality hotel spa right off the BTS is a game changer. Will absolutely be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Mariues, thank you for the warm words. We're so glad the quiet rooms gave you the calm you came for, and that our therapists looked after you well. Until we meet again at Phloen Chit.

— Heavena Wellness Team

reviews.name: Nariokung
reviews.text:
I visited Heavana Wellness & Spa and had a wonderful experience, even better than I expected. The staff were warm and welcoming, and I was served fresh tamarind plum upon arrival, which helped set a relaxed mood before the treatment.

I had a 90 minute aromatherapy massage with Khun Pha, whose technique was very comfortable and well balanced. The session began with a salt foot bath and gentle foot scrub, followed by a hot sand bag and a warm compress on the neck, which immediately helped me relax. The therapist also checked that the room temperature and the warmth of the blanket were comfortable.

The massage flowed smoothly, and I fell asleep for a short while. I woke up feeling refreshed and relaxed. The session ended with coconut ice cream and sticky rice, which was a pleasant and enjoyable way to finish. Overall, the experience was well worth it.

reviews.name: Pimthong Dhangwatnotai
reviews.text:
"A Wonderful and Relaxing Experience!"

I booked the 120-minute signature treatment and really enjoyed it. The place was clean, cozy, and had a nice, calming vibe. The staff was super friendly and made sure I felt comfortable from start to finish.

The treatment was very relaxing, and my therapist did a great job—just the right amount of pressure to ease tension. Everything felt well taken care of, which made the whole experience even better.

To top it off, I got a delicious dessert after my session, which was such a nice touch! Overall, a great place to unwind, and I’d definitely recommend it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the great review! We're thrilled you enjoyed your experience.

reviews.name: Cindy Lai
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve ever had! The spa was very clean, and the staff were incredibly friendly and professional. The service was excellent from start to finish, and the dessert at the end was to die for. It’s also super convenient—just a few minutes’ walk from Park Hyatt Bangkok, where we’re staying. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Cindy, thank you for such a lovely review. Our team at Phloen Chit will be very glad to hear this feedback. We hope you will return for another Royal Thai or Warm Oil session when you are next in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Nuttida Homjai
reviews.text: My boyfriend booked a lovely massage for me as a birthday gift, and it was absolutely wonderful! The spa has a relaxing atmosphere, professional therapists, and excellent service. Truly the best spa ever!🥰✨️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Nuttida for your wonderful review! We’re so happy to hear that you enjoyed your birthday massage and had such a relaxing experience with us. It was our pleasure to make your special day extra memorable. Hope to see you again soon at Heavena Wellness & Spa! 💆‍♀️🎂✨

reviews.name: Pawangnittra
reviews.text: Location is 5 mins walk from BTS Ploenchit. Nice service staff, smile and warm welcome. Therapist Tina is polite and very detailed for massaging. The place is new and clean, they just opened for 6 months. Good value for money!

reviews.name: 이상호
reviews.text: It was the best massage I had during my trip to Thailand—so good that it made me feel genuinely sad to be leaving tomorrow. Everything was exceptional: the facilities, the kindness and professionalism of the staff, and the therapist’s massage skills. I honestly could not find a single thing that was less than excellent
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for such kind words! There's no higher compliment than being the best massage of your trip — we're truly touched. We hope Bangkok, and Heavena, will be calling you back before long. 💛

reviews.name: NApMIp
reviews.text: I tried the VIP package and I really loved it! They served snacks and drinks while I was soaking in the jacuzzi, which was such a nice touch. After that, I had a body scrub and massage — both were amazing and super relaxing. I felt so refreshed afterwards! The ice cream they served at the end was also delicious. Such a great experience overall! 💆🏻‍♀️🍨✨

reviews.name: Woody T.
reviews.text: The massage was excellent and very relaxing. They also have male massage therapists here. I recommend booking 1–2 days in advance.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Kaito, thank you so much for the 5-star review and the lovely recommendation! We are very glad you enjoyed the massage and found the experience relaxing. Yes — we have both male and female therapists, and pre-booking 1-2 days ahead is excellent advice for our peak hours. Looking forward to welcoming you back to Heavena Phloen Chit! 🌿

reviews.name: Adhiambo Oyier
reviews.text:
Hands down one of the best Spas in Bangkok. I loved the Royal Thai Massage which had me equal parts wincing and snoring, followed by a scoop of delicious coconut ice cream.

The place is clean, quiet and the service is excellent.

The price is more midrange for bkk, with treatments starting from 950 bhat.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Adhiambo, thank you so much. The Royal Thai (นวดราชสำนัก) tradition is what we built the brand around, so hearing that it landed for you means everything. Warm welcome back whenever you are in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Premsook Prem
reviews.text:
"A Flawless Spa Experience – Pure Relaxation for Mind & Body!"

I booked the 120-minute signature treatment at Heavena Wellness, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. From the moment I arrived, the serene ambiance and pristine surroundings made me feel instantly at ease. The spa was spotless, with every detail carefully maintained, adding to the sense of tranquility.

The treatment itself was exceptional. My therapist was incredibly skilled, using just the right techniques to melt away tension and stress. Every aspect, from the calming aromas to the perfectly set temperature, was thoughtfully designed for ultimate relaxation.

To top it all off, I was served a delicious dessert after my session—a thoughtful and delightful touch that made the experience even more special. If you're looking for a luxurious, rejuvenating escape with top-notch service and immaculate facilities, [Spa Name] is the perfect choice. I can’t wait to return!

reviews.name: Nonglek Phi
reviews.text:
Heavena spa is a new retreat in a heart of city. I love the welcome drink and the signature coconut ice-cream at the end.

The message was awesome with free mobile phone charger. The staff is very nice and knowledgeable. To my surprise, i thought the price should be higher but turned out i was shocked to pay less than a thousand for Thai message which was cheaper comparing to high rental fee in a beautiful and decent atmosphere.

I will definitely come back!

reviews.name: Tatsanee Kaew
reviews.text: The shop is clean, calm, and professional-truly great value for money considering the premium service. It‘s so convenient being right next to BTS Ploenchit.

reviews.name: Arati arati
reviews.text: This spa is pure heaven! The ambiance is calm and elegant, with soft music and a refreshing aroma that makes you forget all your stress. The massage was incredible with excellent herbal conpress— firm where it needed to be and soothing throughout. The premium products they use feel amazing on the skin. Ending the session with a scoop of ice cream was the sweetest surprise! Truly a five-star experience from start to finish. 🌸💆‍♀️🍦
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the great review! We're thrilled you enjoyed your experience.

reviews.name: Supapon Bernjobsuk
reviews.text: The service was amazing! From the moment I walked in, I felt so relaxed. The whole place smells wonderful, and the soft music makes you feel calm. The therapist has gentle hands but really knows how to hit all the right spots. After the massage, I felt so light and refreshed. I absolutely loved it and will definitely come back again! 💆‍♀️💖

reviews.name: Inji Yoo
reviews.text: That was a 10/10 experience. Everyone was so friendly and welcoming and the massage therapist was so strong. I can tell how experienced she is, she knows where to put extra pressure and where to be gentle. The welcome drink and the ice cream after the massage were delicious as well. Can’t wait to be back and try other services they offer!

reviews.name: Tracy Ngo
reviews.text: Had a lovely visit to the spa — great hospitality from the moment we walked in. The front-desk staff were warm and welcoming, and the refreshing tamarind drink on arrival was a nice touch. The facility itself felt clean, calm and inviting. The masseuses were skilled, friendly and attentive, and the post-massage treat of coconut ice cream was refreshing and delicious.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Tracy for your wonderful and thoughtful review! We’re delighted that you enjoyed every part of your visit — from the warm welcome and tamarind drink to the relaxing massage and coconut ice cream treat. It’s our pleasure to make your experience as comfortable and refreshing as possible. We look forward to welcoming you back to Heavena Wellness & Spa again soon! 💆‍♀️🍨✨

reviews.name: Paveena Jaicham
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed the hospitality from the moment we checked in until the end of our service. The coconut ice creams waiting for us upon completion were a delightful touch. The luxurious, pleasant, and relaxing atmosphere, coupled with the helpful messages that assisted us in unwinding and relaxing, made our experience truly memorable.

reviews.name: Tu Bui
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful 2-hour Thai massage with herbal press and it was an amazing experience. The luxury décor and atmosphere made me feel relaxed from the moment I stepped in. My service maid was very skillful, attentive, and knew exactly how to release all the tension in my body. The herbal press added a soothing warmth that made the massage even more relaxing.

It is a bit expensive, but honestly worth the price for the quality of service and the overall experience. I left feeling refreshed, recharged, and deeply relaxed. Definitely recommend to anyone looking for a high-quality massage experience.

reviews.name: Reallssp
reviews.text: Really nice spa! I tried the coconut body scrub and massage — my skin feels super soft and smooth. The massage was relaxing and the place is cozy with a calm atmosphere. Easy to find and I’d love to come back again! 💆🏻‍♀️🌿
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Reallssp for sharing your experience with Heavena Wellness & Spa (Ploenchit, Sivatel Hotel) — I’m truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed the coconut body scrub and massage, and that your skin feels soft and smooth. I’m also glad the relaxing atmosphere and cozy space made your visit even more enjoyable. Hope to welcome you back for another calming escape soon! 🌿💆🏻‍♀️✨

title: 반타이마사지 BanThai Masaje
ownerDescription: 66 Banthai masaje 반타이마사지 (Buddy boutique Inn) Pranakorn
address: 66 Chakrabongse Rd, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

reviews.name: Britt Ayling
reviews.text:
What an extraordinary little place. ❤️ I honestly don’t think I’ve ever had a massage experience quite like this.

From the moment I walked in, it felt like stepping into a colourful little sticky-note palace of wonders — messages everywhere, tiny details to discover, gifts, warmth and so much personality. It’s quirky and completely unique, but also incredibly personal. You can feel the heart that has gone into creating it.

And the massage itself… genuinely one of the most wonderful I’ve ever had. So intuitive, caring and deeply relaxing. I felt completely looked after and walked out lighter, calmer and genuinely restored.

Even the beautiful little gifts made the whole experience feel so thoughtful and special. One of those magical travel finds you stumble across and know you’ll remember long after you leave. So very glad I found this place. ✨❤️.

reviews.name: Al Hussein Albusaidi
reviews.text: I recommend visiting the place. The service is very strong and the staff is more than wonderful. I have come to them more than three times. Anyone who comes to stay in this area does not look for any other place, they just come here because it is the best place to relax and rest.

reviews.name: Anna Buchbauer
reviews.text:
What a lovely experience. Amazing massage therapists and a beautiful ambiente. 🧡✨
We even got a small purse as a gift after the massage. 🥰

reviews.name: ECEM KURTULUŞ
reviews.text: A hidden gem just a few minutes away from Khao San Road. The place is not flashy or luxurious — its only focus is truly good massage, and you can feel that the moment you walk in. The staff are incredibly professional, the atmosphere is full of memories with thousands of notes and messages from people all around the world covering the walls. It has such a warm and authentic soul. Definitely one of those rare price/performance places where the quality stays surprisingly high. Highly recommended to everyone.

reviews.name: Teli
reviews.text:
It was an extraordinary experience taking a massage with Mem, super pro and extra involved. The whole place is surrounded by a great vibe, everything extra clean.
And what can I say about the decoration of the place which seems taken from a Disney movie!
They gave me a clean & hot Thai clothes and the plus of the welcome cold juice and the hot tea plus fruit and banana chips were the cherry of the cake!
I highly recommend this awesome massage place!
I’m going back to Bangkok in some days and don’t doubt about taking either 1 or massages per day! 🧚‍♀️

reviews.name: Katie Burch
reviews.text: Great massage at this little place in Bangkok right near our hotel. Staff are very friendly. 60 min massage was only 300 TB which was great! If we had been here longer we would definitely have gone back. Little notes make it super cute too!

reviews.name: manideepa chaudhury
reviews.text: Very cute, cosy little massage shack run by the most charming Thai guy running it for 18 years and very skilled and attentive massage therapists. Woukd highly recommend the Thai massage and the overall experience of being taken care of from the beginning to end. They serve lemon grass tea and give you a free coin purse and a plate of fruit and some cookies after the massage. Very warm and unique vibe.

reviews.name: София Пешкова
reviews.text: The place is amazing, the host is very kind and attentive, the massage was great, everyone is very kind and professional! Extremely recommeneded! They treated me with tea and fruits after massage and even filmed some content for me without asking! Also, better to prebook as they may not have walk in availability

reviews.name: Agni Foscolou
reviews.text: Terrific experience! Pat is an excellent host and the Thai massage we had was very authentic and relaxing! We have had many massages in Thailand since we have visited the country many times - this was one of the best ones!!! 🥰🥰

reviews.name: Michael Sangil
reviews.text: This was a very different experience from my first Thai massage a year ago. It was relaxing, the stretches were not painful and the masseuses are not noisy unlike from the other spas I've tried. The staffs will make sure that you will have a great time. There's also free tea and fruits after the massage session. And I was also given a free coin purse. Thank you so much! I will definitely go again whenever I am in Khaosan.

reviews.name: Hey, Nazro
reviews.text: Sticky note heaven with a great massage included. Fun experience by Khao San Road where i enjoyed some relaxing massage and more gifts then i can carry. Good experience. Just came in and they attended me bo problem. I got tea and fruit after. Good times thanks

reviews.name: Frederik Hartmann
reviews.text: Amazing massage place, with friendly and happy (and competent!) personnel! Love the energy here and you are beigk treated like a king/queen with some little gifts and snacks all around. I will come back when I return to Bangkok!

reviews.name: Ulises Gándara
reviews.text: Best massage ever! The attention was just outstanding and yhe massage great. Perfect pressure, plenty of techniques and stretching ways. I would do it once a week if I could. Thank you

reviews.name: Maneet Madaan
reviews.text: Best massage experience ever , the host pat is super friendly and has been in the industry for over 18 years , its a very authentic thai experience you’ll ever have in Bangkok ! Will visit again on my next trip for sure !!

reviews.name: Melissa
reviews.text: My friend and I came here for a massage and had a great experience. You can safely store your belongings in a locker during the massage, so there’s no need to worry. The owner is incredibly kind and smiles the whole time, which makes you feel very welcome. After the massage, you’re treated to tea, fruit, and cookies. Greetings from Germany! :)

reviews.name: Daphnée Dieriex
reviews.text:
We had a very pleasant experience at this massage salon. The staff were extremely friendly and welcoming. The massage was high-quality, relaxing, and professional.

On top of that, we were served fresh watermelon and pineapple as a thank you, and we even received a small gift at the end, which was a really nice surprise.

We highly recommend this place and will definitely come back again!☺️

reviews.name: Sophia Kian
reviews.text: just had such a good thai massage, really strong and feel amazing after!!! i had a bad neck and told the lady and she was working on it for ages, feels so much better. thank you!!!!

reviews.name: Kritkamon Cece
reviews.text: I’ve had so many massages in Bangkok , especially in this area ถนนข้าวสาร but BanThai was exceptional. First I opted for a 30-minutes foot massage it helped me minimize my foot soreness and swelling so I went back for 90-minutes traditional Thai massage and it was exactly what my tired muscles needed. The therapist was incredibly skilled, moving seamlessly from deep acupuncture along my energy lines to gentle, yoga-like stretches that released tension I didn’t know I had. The pressure was perfect, but they was attentive, checking in and adjusting when I said “Nak Nak” ( harder). The environment was clean , cozy and calming, with soft music and proper curtains for privacy. A great find especially the owner was very nice and friendly , handing out Thailand 🇹🇭 cute souvenirs was a warming welcome. The experience was worth every Bath for the quality and professional service. Highly recommended for genuinely restorative experience!

reviews.name: Lara Kürschner
reviews.text: This was truly amazing!! The massage technique was so good it felt like she really found every stressed muscle in my body!! 1h full body massage for only 300. Overall a perfect experience. Best massage ever ❤️

reviews.name: y x
reviews.text: Have a good foot massage and my partner a fantastic aroma massage. This is a very unique and interesting place. Recommend for massage and a must check out place when in Bangkok. It’s is uniquely design and very good hospitality from the owner. Thumbs up.

title: Urban Thai Massage สาขา 3
address: 111/1 Surawong Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: Alba Cheung
reviews.text: I had the best massage ever! I saw so many people saying this in their reviews, and now I have to say it too. Duen is absolutely amazing—she really knows how to find all the tight and sore spots. I had a 2-hour Thai and oil massage, and it was incredible. My God, it felt so good! If you’re coming here, you have to ask for Duen. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Tatiana G
reviews.text:
Stayed just on the corner from this place, seeing many people passing by every day and decided to try.
Came in the morning right after the opening, no reservation required.
Staff helped me to choose the right massage and we had the Urban set.

Foot massage is done at the main lobby, atmosphere is very friendly and calm.
The full body oil massage is cared upstairs in a private room, all the amenities are provided, shower is also available.

You can enjoy the tea after the procedure.

Lots of thanks to my therapist Anny , who was very caring, kind and professional. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Marco Calvello
reviews.text: I just had a wonderful foot massage at Urban Thai on Surawong Road and wanted to share how great the experience was. From the moment I walked in, the place felt calm, clean, and beautifully designed. A special thank you to Kaw, who gave me the massage. She was extremely professional, friendly, and clearly very skilled. The pressure was just right the entire time, and she made sure I was comfortable from start to finish. My feet feel completely relaxed now! Highly recommend 👍🏻

reviews.name: Lou Anna
reviews.text: Thank you so much! She did an amazing job on my nails. She took her time, paid great attention to every detail, and made sure everything was perfect. I’m so happy with the result. The service was wonderful from start to finish. Five stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Thank you again, I will definitely be back. 💕

reviews.name: Hoi Peng Hoe
reviews.text: Ing, my therapist has done a great job. I came twice and the first time for foot massage and I met Ing, and today I purposely ask for Ing for my foot and body massage. She is nice and lovely. Another thing to highlight is I love to have private shower (maybe I take package) and I can clean myself before leaving.

reviews.name: Sebastian G
reviews.text: Fon is an amazing therapist. I came for a foot massage, and I could instantly feel her strong, authentic Thai massage technique. Her shoulder and neck massage was equally impressive relieving all my tension. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a quality massage experience.

reviews.name: Guadalupe Villa
reviews.text: An incredible experience! One of the best experiences we had in Thailand. Everything was amazing, and Helen took great care of us from start to finish. She was absolutely wonderful, so kind, attentive, and professional. It was a real pleasure being looked after by her. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Claudia Molina
reviews.text: Kitty did a great job!! It was a really lovely atmosphere, peaceful Sunday morning and she did my pedicure. Highly recommend her!!

reviews.name: Euge 1111
reviews.text: I loved it! A lovely, calm, relaxing, and very professional place. We had a combined neck and foot massage. I was treated by Fon, and she was excellent. You can really tell she knows traditional Thai massage, her hands are strong and very skilled. A great experience, I would definitely come back. My friend was treated by Tuck and he was amazing, very gentle and patient. She felt completely refreshed and highly recommends him.

reviews.name: Maja Leden
reviews.text:
Today, my daughter and I had the perfect opportunity to enjoy some special mother-daughter time, so we decided to treat ourselves to a foot massage.

We were lucky to have two wonderful therapists, **Fon** and **Ice**—the perfect duo for such a special experience. Ice took amazing care of my daughter and made her feel like a real princess by the end of the session. She left with the biggest smile on her face!

Flo worked her magic on me, melting away all the tension and exhaustion that had built up from the fast pace of everyday life and spending so much time on my feet. To finish, they also gave us a short relaxing massage for our backs, arms, and necks.

We both left feeling absolutely amazing—as if several layers of stress had simply melted away. I highly recommend this place, especially if you're looking for a relaxing experience to share with your child. Thank you, Fon and Ice, for making our day so special!

reviews.name: Viktoria Izadi
reviews.text:
YES just do it.

The place is pretty cute and modern, it smells amazing, the people working here have the hands of angels.

TREAT YOURSELF. You will get a hot tea after.

reviews.name: Bonita van Lier
reviews.text:
Over the years I went here several times for a foot massage, and I was always happy with the service provided. Today I had my first appointment for a manicure and pedicure and I was blown away by the quality of the treatments and the results. Both Tik and Kitty did a wonderful job! They are skilled, professional, patient and most of all very friendly and caring. Kitty even walked me to my hotel with an umbrella when rain came pouring down (even though it was just a few meters away).

I highly recommend Tik and Kitty. Hopefully the owners of Urban Thai Spa realise how hard these two ladies and all of their colleagues work (from 10:30 am till midnight!).

reviews.name: Manon

title: Once Upon A Thai Spa (Phrom Phong)

Once Upon A Thai Spa focuses on professional aromatherapy. Our essential oils are carefully selected with 100% natural extraction from plants and is blended with rich nutritious Vitamins of sweet almond oil.

We bring a new perspective of relaxation to our guests by combination of different elements of well-beings. Guests can expect a modern and relaxing atmosphere with fascinating soft natural music, seasoned professional massage therapists and exquisitely presented a nutritious beverage.

Escape from urban life and enjoy a quiet moment at Once Upon A Thai Spa. Get yourself calm, breathe properly and find the intrinsic balance for essentials of life.

reviews.text: Had another wonder massage with my wife at this place (120 mins hotstone + aromatherapy), is called the floating away massage. Honestly one of the best massages I had in Bangkok! Our masseuse were very professional and used the perfect amount of strength to press away the knots on my back and legs. They even gifted us the hot compress used after the session so we can continue using it back at the hotel! Would definitely return again for another session!

A nice bonus is their homemade gelato, where you can choose from three flavors—it’s a perfect treat after the session. Overall, a reliable and enjoyable spa experience that I’d happily return to again.

reviews.name: Mel
reviews.text:
Unbelievably good, worth every penny.

I got the Shine on me treatment for 210 minutes at 4,000THB.
It was a combination of a thorough body scrub, aroma massage, and thai herbal compress with some stretching at the end. In reality it took about 4hrs in total and I loved every second of it.

The staff were ultra polite and helpful, with calm voices (they all spoke English).

The environment was cosy and clean, although you do have to go up a maximum of 4floors if you get the room with a shower.

The massage technique was insane - ive never done anything better than this. My therapist was clearly a seasoned professional. She was able to immediately sense my discomfort in certain areas and switched to another area or technique without me even needing to ask. I was so impressed.

No hard-selling of any products in the end either. Was able to relax throughout the entire experience, and never felt rushed during my visit.

Even the desserts were so great!!!

Totally worth your time and money, 100% recommend trying to get the longest treatment possible.
Im already looking forward to visiting the other outlet 🙋🏼‍♀️🙋🏼‍♀️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Thank you for choosing to spend your day with us and sharing such a detailed and valuable review. We are thrilled that 210 minutes of our Shine On Me Spa Treatment was worth every penny and moment. We are glad that the skills and techniques of our therapists have impressed you so much. Our team takes great pride in providing professional service without any pressure or hard selling. We are glad you felt relaxed and well cared for by our professional receptionists.

reviews.name: Fiona Hu
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience, not recommended.

As someone who regularly visits luxury spas across Thailand, this was by far my most uncomfortable experience. I booked a 90-minute aromatherapy oil massage at the Phrom Phong branch. The therapist maintained overly firm pressure throughout the whole session, even after I repeatedly asked to ease up.

After the treatment, I experienced a sharp stinging pain in my lower back, which is different from normal post-massage muscle soreness. The discomfort was severe enough to disrupt my sleep at night and has continued into the following day.

There were also other unsatisfactory details during my visit: the foot bath water was cold, and the scent of the essential oil was not pleasant. The overall service standard does not match the premium reputation of this spa.

Most importantly, after I sent a formal complaint to the management, I received no sincere apology. The team only provided evasive explanations to shift responsibility and declined to offer any form of compensation.

Think carefully before booking here to avoid an unpleasant experience.

Just reply to your reply:

I sent you an email right after the massage to tell you I felt unwell physically. This discomfort was not the ordinary soreness after massage, but sharp stinging pain that I have never experienced anywhere else.

You only replied to my message after I followed up repeatedly. Worse still, you did not apologize for the unpleasant experience at all, but blamed all the problems on my personal physical condition instead.

I am extremely dissatisfied and disappointed with your massage skills, service quality and attitude. Even after such a long time, my waist and back still ache from time to time. I am just sharing my real experience as a customer for everyone’s reference.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Fiona Hu,

Thank you for your feedback. We are aware of your concerns, which have already been addressed in our formal email correspondence.

At Once Upon A Thai, we maintain a high standard of service and transparency. Our internal review and session records confirm that the therapist followed all professional protocols, including regular inquiries regarding your comfort, and adjusted the pressure promptly throughout the treatment. Regarding the post-treatment soreness, as previously explained, this is often a physiological response to the release of muscle tension following a 90-minute session.

We have also taken note of your comments regarding the foot bath temperature and the essential oil scent. These details are being reviewed and will be maintained to ensure they consistently align with our service standards.

While we regret that you remained dissatisfied with our findings, we stand by the professional conduct of our team and the integrity of our service.

Once Upon A Thai Spa

reviews.text:
An absolutely incredible experience!

I had the pleasure of being massaged by Ning, and I honestly cannot recommend her highly enough! 🙏

She is extremely professional, attentive, and incredibly skilled. She immediately identified all of my tension points and worked on them with impressive precision and expertise. Some of these tensions had been bothering me for several years, and after the massage, I felt a remarkable difference.

You can truly feel Ning’s experience, technique, and dedication. This was not just a massage — it was a real therapeutic experience, carried out with great professionalism and care.

Thank you so much, Ning, for this amazing massage and for finally relieving tensions I had been carrying for years. ❤️

I will definitely be coming back and highly recommend her 100%! 🌸

reviews.text:
Just got a massage from Pui. Oh God, my shoulders must have been super tight I've been through hell then heaven😭 but feels so refreshing afterwards.

I got the 90 minute course with 30 minute foot massage, then 60 minute head/shoulder massage - for 800THB. Definitely worth it!!

The reception staff are super friendly and all speak perfect English. Menu is available to read outside, so introverted customers like me can take a looksie without being worried about getting ushered in.

Location is super convenient, right next to the Emporium (happens to be right in front of my hotel) with a lot of food choices to choose from afterwards.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊 We’re glad you enjoyed your experience with us.

reviews.name: Parag Jain
reviews.text:
I had a great experience at Lek Gold Massage in Phrom Phong and would happily recommend it. I tried both the Thai massage with balm and the aroma oil massage, and honestly, both were very good in their own way.

The aroma massage was relaxing and well-executed, perfect if you’re looking to unwind and de-stress. However, the standout for me was the traditional Thai massage with balm—it was truly extraordinary. The therapist clearly knew what she was doing, applied just the right amount of pressure, and worked through tight spots with real skill and confidence. It felt therapeutic rather than routine, and I walked out feeling noticeably lighter and more relaxed.
The place itself is clean, comfortable, and professionally run, and the staff are polite and welcoming. Prices are reasonable for the quality of massage you receive.

If I return, I would definitely go back specifically for the Thai massage with balm. One of the better massage experiences I’ve had in the area.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re very happy you enjoyed our service. Thank you 🤍

reviews.name: Ekta Pandey
reviews.text:
Had such a wonderful experience at Ying Yang The Original Massage and Spa. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was so calming, clean, and welcoming. The staff were incredibly kind and professional, and the whole experience felt relaxing from start to finish.

A special thank you to Pa, who looked after me so beautifully during my massage and facial. Her technique was amazing, she was so attentive and caring, and she made me feel completely relaxed and refreshed. The facial left my skin glowing, and the massage relieved so much tension and stress.

You can truly tell this place cares about their clients and the quality of their service. Highly recommend booking with Pa if you visit — I’ll definitely be coming back again next time !

reviews.text: P’Nhoi was really good at what she does. I feel like I’ve gotten a new pair of feet after the massage. Amazing hospitality from the front staff as well. LOVE IT HERE and will come back again for more!

reviews.text: Both therapists, Nuch and Wan provided an amazing mix of deep tissue and deep stretching full body oil massage. Went into some serious assisted asanas that did wonders thereafter. Would recommend this to anyone who wants the real deal.

reviews.name: Sunil Pasupuleti
reviews.text:
One of the most disappointing and misleading experiences I’ve had.

I was staying at Ramada Riverside and chose this spa based on its high ratings — which, after this visit, genuinely feel fake or paid.

The massage was shockingly poor — just random rubbing with no technique, no pressure, and no real understanding of massage. Despite repeated requests, nothing changed, and I had to walk out before even completing half the session.

The reception made it worse — there was zero interest in listening or resolving the issue, just an attempt to send me away.

The real reviews of this place are the many 1-star experiences like mine, which are clearly being masked by fake or paid positive ratings.

Highly overrated and not worth the money. Avoid if you’re expecting a professional massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sunil Pasupuleti
Thank you for your feedback, and we sincerely apologize that your experience did not meet your expectations.

We place great importance on service quality and customer satisfaction. As you chose to visit us for a second time, it reflects that you previously trusted and recognized our service standards. Therefore, we are truly sorry that this visit resulted in disappointment.

We would like to clarify that all of our reviews are 100% based on genuine customer experiences, and we have a strict policy against paid or fake reviews. Transparency and honesty are values we have always upheld.

According to our service record, you selected a warm oil massage for relaxation. Our reception team always asks about preferred pressure before the service begins, and after the massage, if you feel any discomfort or if the pressure does not meet your expectations, you may request an adjustment or change the therapist within 10–15 minutes at no additional cost. This is part of our policy to ensure the best possible experience for our customers.

However, we regret that we were not informed of your dissatisfaction at the time, which prevented us from resolving the issue immediately. We sincerely appreciate your feedback and will use it to improve our services.

If it is convenient for you, we would be happy to take responsibility and assist you further. Please contact us privately or visit our manager at the shop between 09:00–18:00.

We truly hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again and provide you with a better experience in the future.


Best regards,
Yin Yang Team

reviews.text:
I had the opportunity to take the Herbal Compress Massage Course at Wat Pho Thai Traditional Medical and Massage School, and it was an outstanding experience.

I would especially like to thank Instructor Kunwaree (Khun Kwan) for her excellent teaching. She explained every technique clearly, paid close attention to each student, and made both the theory and hands-on practice easy to understand. She was patient, professional, and always willing to answer questions, making the learning experience enjoyable and inspiring.

The course was well organized, the training was practical, and I gained valuable knowledge and skills that I can confidently apply in my professional practice.

I highly recommend this course and Instructor Kanjanawaree to anyone interested in learning authentic Thai Herbal Compress Massage. Thank you for such a wonderful learning experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

reviews.name: Lu Kristen
reviews.text:
The past five days at massage school have been one of the most memorable experiences I have had abroad. I got to study alongside Ruby from Mexico, Ning from the Netherlands, and my Chinese partner, all under the guidance of three wonderful teachers: Yak, Aey and Mol.
Teacher Yak appears strict at first glance, but he is actually kind and incredibly patient. Whenever I forgot the next step and looked at him awkwardly, he always guided me gently to correct it. I have watched him ease leg pain with his techniques, and I am always amazed at how he can be both powerful and effortless at the same time.
Aey is a graceful Thai teacher who never stops encouraging students, even when we only manage to nail one single step correctly. She turns every lesson into something joyful and engaging. Mol feels just like a gentle grandmother, always reminding me to take my time and not rush.
Living in a foreign country has often left me feeling lonely, but meeting all these lovely people filled my heart with warmth. Their dedication to mastering their craft over many years has inspired me deeply. Today, we all need to slow down, focus on the things that bring us joy, and stop being afraid to learn at our own pace.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for taking the time to share your kind review. We are truly delighted that you chose our school and had an enjoyable and valuable learning experience with us. Your positive feedback means a great deal to our teachers and staff, as it encourages us to continue providing high-quality education, attentive guidance, and a welcoming learning environment for all our students. It was our pleasure to have you as part of our school, and we sincerely hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back for further study with us in the future. Wishing you continued success and all the very best. 😊

reviews.name: Lisa Haggerty
reviews.text: What an amazing rest stop for the weary traveler. After a long day of touring Grand Palace and Wat Pho, we needed a place to kill time before dinner. But we were met with 8-10 very friendly masseuses in the lobby who were ready and waiting for walk-ins. We pointed to “30 minute foot massage” on a menu of options, and 680 baht and 30 seconds later, my husband and I were on cots in the massage room. We experienced intense but very relaxing massages. They gave us mulberry tea at the end of it. Many monks in the sitting room there, so you know the massages are good!
