title: Baan Farm Thai Cooking School
ownerDescription: Baan Farm Thai Cooking School sits on the rice farm Kru Ploy's grandmother has worked for generations - the same land whose garden you harvest from before you cook. Small hands-on classes: a local market tour with dessert and fruit tasting, a walk through the farm, then you grind your own curry paste from scratch and cook five dishes you choose yourself - appetiser, soup, curry, stir-fry and dessert. Free pickup and drop-off in the Old City, all ingredients, a recipe book and a welcome butterfly pea tea included. Vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free and allergy-friendly menus on request. Morning and afternoon group classes, private classes for 1-6, and a custom Northern Lanna menu. Book direct by phone, WhatsApp or LINE.
address: 150, Nong jom, San Sai District, Chiang Mai 50210, Thailand
plusCode: R2XM+V9 เทศบาลเมืองแม่โจ้ San Sai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
So many Thai favourites, all made from scratch.

From fresh spring rolls and Som Tam to Pad Thai, Massaman curry, Tom Yum Goong, and mango sticky rice, every dish has its own story, flavour, and technique to discover.

Join us at Baan Farm Thai Cooking and learn to create a colourful Thai feast to share and enjoy.

From our garden to your Som Tam 🥗

One of the most memorable parts of a cooking experience at Baan Farm is picking fresh ingredients straight from the garden.

Green papaya, crisp long beans, chillies, lime, and peanuts come together to create Som Tam - Thailand’s bright, fresh, and wonderfully flavourful papaya salad.

Come and discover where great Thai food begins.

A little taste of farm life at Baan Farm Thai Cooking 🥭

Our guests love getting closer to the ingredients that make Thai food so special. From the garden to the kitchen, every visit is a chance to discover the fresh flavours and local traditions behind Thai cooking.

Come and create delicious memories with us.

Great Thai food begins with fresh ingredients and careful preparation.

From fragrant lemongrass and kaffir lime to fiery chillies, garlic, galangal, and banana blossom - each ingredient brings its own character to the table.

At Baan Farm Thai Cooking, we celebrate the flavours, colours, and traditions behind every dish.

Sweet, creamy, and unmistakably Thai 🥭

Mango sticky rice is one of those simple pleasures that always feels special: ripe golden mango, warm coconut sticky rice, and a little crunch on top.

Come and enjoy this classic Thai dessert with us at Baan Farm Thai Cooking.

Golden, crispy, and ready for that first bite! 😋

There’s something extra satisfying about enjoying Thai food you’ve made yourself. These spring rolls capture the joy of cooking together at Baan Farm Thai Cooking - and the delicious reward at the end.

Ready to put on an apron and join us? 

Book your Thai cooking experience and bring home more than a holiday memory. ❤️ 😍🙏

Since 2017, Baan Farm has welcomed guests onto land our family has farmed for generations.

Kru Ploy learned to cook here — from her grandmother and her father, on the same rice farm where she teaches today. Part of that land is now the garden you'll walk into to pick your own herbs and vegetables before you cook with them.

A day with us goes market, then farm, then kitchen. You grind your own curry paste from scratch and cook five dishes you choose yourself. At the end we all sit down and eat together.

Small groups. Free pickup from the Old City. Everyone goes home with a recipe book.

Come and cook with us:
+66 94 626 2942, WhatsApp or LINE.

reviews.name: Penelope Jones
reviews.text: We have just finished our fabulous cooking class with Poly and cannot speak more highly of our experience. We were picked up at our hotel by the smiling Poly, taken to a local market where her family run a fruit store. We were taken on a tour, tried a range of fruits and had a chance to do some shopping. After gathering herbs and edible flowers from the farm, we were taken through the cooking of our 5 dishes. Each person was able to select their own menu. We were assisted through every step of the way, given useful tips to elevate our own efforts back home. The atmosphere was friendly and supportive. We highly recommend this experience!

reviews.name: 荞麦
reviews.text:
My daughter and I had a wonderful half day here. It's not one of those "Instagram-famous" cooking schools everyone recommends on social media. The teachers and staff were genuinely warm and friendly. The dishes we cooked turned out so plentiful that we couldn't finish them all — we packed the leftovers and took them back to the hotel. We also visited the morning market where they buy ingredients. The fruits there are quite fresh, and you can buy small portions.

Plus, the people we cooked with today were all really lovely.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing such a lovely review! We’re so happy you and your daughter enjoyed your time with us. It was wonderful to have you in class, and we hope you both took home some delicious memories!❤️😊🙏🏼

reviews.name: chouchou Z
reviews.text:
An absolutely amazing cooking experience!
The teaching was incredibly patient and friendly. Every single dish we made was absolutely delicious, and the portions were so huge that we had to pack the leftovers to go!
The whole experience was fantastic—someone was there to guide us through every single step, and they even helped us take photos along the way. On top of that, the pricing is very reasonable and offers great value for money. The farm environment is also beautiful and relaxing.
If you are a non-native English speaker, there’s no need to worry at all. The instructors use very simple and clear English to guide you through everything. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Jerome Schoffler
reviews.text:
As soon as the chef picked us up, we were off to the local market in Chiang Mai sampling some of the local fruits and vegetables that we’d be cooking with; then off to the cooking school to their Herb garden to cut the fresh herbs and flowers that we’d also be cooking with!  The whole experience was a true farm-to-table culinary journey!  You get to select several courses from appetizers to soups and mains then desert, so there is a very large variety in Thai cuisine that you will learn to cook.  The chef instructor is patient and accommodated everyone’s tastes and pace, the kitchen was clean and orderly, and the staff was great.  From the cooking lessons, memories and the recipe book and pictures to go with it, it truly is a first class experience!
We’ve already picked up the same flowers we used in the class so we can make Butterfly pea flower tea when we get back to Texas!

reviews.name: evooo crocker
reviews.text: This class was an amazing experience! You’re immersed in authentic Thai food, you get to go to the Thai food markets, pick plants from the garden and cook it all together. It’s not too challenging as they’re there to assist you. Would recommend to give it a go as it’s not too performative as other classes i’ve come across

reviews.name: evy schoonhoven
reviews.text:
I just had my cooking class here and even though i was the only one it felt really inclusive, paint was super kind and explained everything well and answered all the questions i had. You get to choose the entire menu aswel which is great and you get the instructions in a document after.
There were two students who were there to learn english and they were the cutest so nice and excited! Overall i highly recommend this class.

reviews.name: Layla G
reviews.text: Baan Farm Thai Cooking School is great! It was one of my favorite experiences in Thailand. My friend and I signed up last minute and ended up being the only people in the class which was so special. I was hesitant at first to do a cooking class but now I am planning on returning to the same one when I come back. The food was amazing, you get to choose your own menu from some options and the staff were also fantastic. We started off at a local market and got to sample some fruits and learn about the ingredients. We even got to pick our own veggies on their farm and then cook with it. It felt fun, simple, and was seriously better than any street food or restaurant food I have had through any of my asia travels.

reviews.name: Lindokuhle Nxumalo
reviews.text:
What an amazing experience. Friendly team. Very welcoming, Helen, Fin and Peter were brilliant. Coordinated all the experience and made it, even for someone who has never cooked, it became an enjoyable and fun experience.

Really enjoyed the whole arrangement. From visiting the fresh market to picking up the ingredients from the garden to cooking the food and eating what we prepared.

Also made friends in the process.
Highly recommend the service.

reviews.name: Lily Flower
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic cooking class today. It was fun, informative, and very well organised.

The team managed a large group of us cooking different dishes at the same time, and everything still ran smoothly.

We always felt supported and guided, and the atmosphere was relaxed and friendly.

We are very grateful for the opportunity and loved all the dishes we prepared.

Thank you for such a memorable experience. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Alex Chung
reviews.text: Had a lovely experience this evening! I've done a lot in Chiang Mai, from seeing the sunrise at Doi Suthep and the peak of Doi Inthanon to exploring Chiang Dao Cave and climbing up the sticky waterfalls, and this class is a MUST when in the area. Our instructor, Helenn, was very helpful, and the site itself was beautiful. I enjoyed harvesting  herbs from their garden, and going to the local market to purchase goods. Despite my lack of experience cooking Thai cuisine, my food still turned out great! Overall an excellent and enriching experience, and a highlight of my time in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Cernily San Diego
reviews.text:
A very complete Thai cooking experience. The class started with a local market visit, where we learned about fresh Thai ingredients and what to look for when buying them. After that, we went back to Baan Farm to pick fresh ingredients ourselves before cooking.

We cooked a wide variety of Thai dishes, including curry, soup, stir fried dishes, and dessert. The instructors explained everything clearly and guided us step by step while keeping the session relaxed and hands on.

We were welcomed with blue butterfly pea tea, which was a nice touch. Portions were so generous, the setting was peaceful, and the whole experience felt authentic and well organized. Highly recommended for anyone wanting to learn real Thai cooking.

reviews.name: Shanna Lim
reviews.text: A great experience that I highly recommend! The tour includes a hotel pick up, local wet market visit, picking your own herbs and getting to cook 5 dishes! Session was engaging and the guides were all friendly and helpful. A must do in Chiangmai!

reviews.name: Alex Porter
reviews.text: We absolutely loved our cooking class. Jumpee was an absolutely joy & so knowledgeable. We learned so much and the food was absolutely yummy! Thank you so so much❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review! We’re thrilled you had such a wonderful time, and Jumpee will be so happy to hear your kind words. It was a joy to cook with you! ❤️❤️❤️😄🙏

reviews.name: שיר אלעזר
reviews.text:
‏We had an amazing cooking class with Paint and it was absolutely wonderful!
‏The team was incredibly kind and welcoming, and they explained everything about the food and dishes in a clear and easy to understand way.

‏The day started with a tour of a local market, where we learned about traditional ingredients and enjoyed tastings along the way. After that, we arrived at the cooking class, picked fresh plants ourselves, and started cooking.

‏The food was unbelievably delicious, and everything felt accessible, relaxed, and enjoyable. The atmosphere was great, full of smiles and patience.

‏We had the best time and highly recommend this experience! 🌟

reviews.name: Shaquille Shelby
reviews.text: Came here on a date with the wife and man had a blast. The rice picked us up, the whole crew that chose the same day as us were really kind and we were all chatting it up by the time we got to the market. The market was amazing and the guide was very kind and knowledgeable. We got to see all the ingredients we would be using and when we arrived at the farm, the real treat began. We ended up cutting ingredients for everyone no matter what we were cooking, and the learning experience was undefeated. Also. The knives are so amazing.

reviews.name: Amit maayan
reviews.text:
We had the best experience with Ploy! The whole experience from the market, to the herb garden and the cooking itself was amazing. Everything was so tasty and authentic. I learned so much.
Don't miss!

reviews.name: Alonso ben yacov
reviews.text:
Great school that makes a day an amazing experience for Thai cuisine. We start with a tour of the market to get to know the spices and things that make up the food. We go to school and everything is neat and clean there!
We pick leaves and vegetables and then start cooking according to dishes 1 to 4 + dessert.
Highly recommend to everyone, individuals, couples and small groups

reviews.name: Mary Francyne Castroverde
reviews.text: It was such a fun class! Our cooking instructor and guide was amazing. She speaks English very well and her instructions were very easy to understand. The class pace was great and the food was delicious. The portions were big. Would do it again. 10/10

reviews.name: Star
reviews.text:
I’m so happy I found Baan Farm Thai Cooking School! This was a last-minute booking, and I honestly didn’t know what to expect—but it exceeded my expectations. Transportation was provided with both pick-up and drop-off, which made everything easy and stress-free.

We visited a local market where the instructors explained the different ingredients we would be using. We were also given about 10 minutes to walk around and purchase any additional produce we wanted outside of our class, which was a nice touch.

The staff was very communicative and spoke English well, which was a big plus for me. I learned how to make a 5-course meal, and it was incredibly fulfilling—more than enough food, too!

I’ll definitely be telling all my friends and family about this experience. Highly recommend!

Watpo Thai Traditional Medical School is the First traditional school in Thailand since 1946 under the name “Wat Pho Medical and Chetawan Massage.”
address: 392, 33-34 Sanam Chai Rd, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand
locatedIn: Wat Phra Chetuphon Wimon Mangkhalaram Rajwaramahawihan

reviews.name: Steven Neyer
reviews.text:
I visited Wat Pho yesterday and had the opportunity to experience a traditional Thai massage at the birthplace of this ancient practice.

The temple itself is absolutely stunning and full of history, especially the famous Reclining Buddha. After exploring the complex, we decided to try a massage at the Wat Pho Traditional Medical and Massage School. Knowing that this is where Thai massage originates made the experience even more special.

The massage was very professional and authentic. It is quite different from typical spa massages as it includes stretching and pressure techniques, but it felt incredibly refreshing afterwards. The staff were friendly, skilled and respectful throughout the entire session.

If you visit Bangkok, Wat Pho is a must-see not only for its beautiful temple complex but also to experience a traditional Thai massage at its true origin.

Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Alan Tan
reviews.text: There are many spas in Bangkok, but this comes close to perfection in terms of service, experience, value and comfort. From the moment I stepped into the reception and waiting area, I just feel that I was brought to a 5-star spa in a hotel even though the price point is below that. Very nicely decorated and new spa located just below the BTS station so location is definitely +++. The treatment room is big, quiet, comfortable and the masseurs are professional, know what they are doing and we were both into deep sleep during the massage itself. Post massage they served a decent sized mango sticky rice and warm tea which elevated the overall experiences too. Remember to make online booking and pre-payment is required. Saw some walk-in guests turned away because they were that busy.

reviews.name: Dr. Terry KSYee
reviews.text: I had an excellent 90-minute Thai massage here. The level of hygiene was impressive, and the service was top-notch. I particularly loved the hospitality—they served tea and rice biscuits before the treatment, and treated me to mango sticky rice and hot tea afterward. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for leaving us a review.

reviews.name: Shanen Lam
reviews.text: Been to different Makkha branches atleast 3 times. This has a fancy design and luxurious looking. Booked my usual 90mins aromatic massage and always trusted it will be always a good one. Disappointment this time; pressure not good and less experienced. I didn’t even get relaxed….
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Shanen Lam,

Thank you for visiting several of our branches and for continuing to trust Makkha for your massage experience. We truly appreciate your support and are very sorry to hear that this visit did not meet the standard you expected from us.

We’re glad you enjoyed the luxurious atmosphere and design of the branch, but we sincerely regret that the massage pressure and overall experience left you feeling disappointed and not fully relaxed. Your feedback is very important to us, especially as a returning guest who is familiar with our usual service quality.

Please accept our sincere apologies for this experience. We will share your comments with our team for further improvement in therapist training and service consistency. We truly hope to have another opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with the relaxing experience you rightfully expect from Makkha. 

Best regard,
Makkha Team

reviews.name: Jill Hong
reviews.text: It’s my second time here. I tried the Thai herbal ball massage this time, and it was great! The massage therapist was very professional and skilled. I really enjoyed the experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind words! We’re really happy to hear you had a good experience with us. Hope to see you again soon.
Have a good day!

reviews.name: Matthew Lee
reviews.text:
Came across this on social media and decided to give it a try.
Went online to make a reservation had to choose the branch (there are a few branches in Bangkok) and then the treatments I wanted and paid everything online to get a confirmation email.
Booking process was rather fuss free and quick. I managed to get their contact and requested for a male masseur and they told me they couldn't confirm until the day itself and asked me to message them again on the day of the massage.
Arrived on time and was asked to sit at the sofa area to fill in some particulars and preferences for the massage including areas to focus on and avoid and the strength of the massage. Was then also told that they arranged a male masseur for me.
Did a 2 hours session and was very impressed with the massage in terms of the strength and the professionalism. Felt so relaxed after and also was served some mango sticky rice after the treatment.
All in all a very big, spacious and clean environment which looks very new and has very elegant interior decor. Nothing much to fault about except that one thing I didn't like was the massage was done on a mattress on the floor. Usually this kind of arrangement I don't like it as there is no hole to put the head on and  it makes the head quite uncomfortable to be positioned. Not sure if I saw some rooms having the bed style but would have preferred that.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for choosing our spa and for the rating. We really appreciate it. We are looking forward to seeing you again!
 Have a nice day!

reviews.name: Samson Lawless
reviews.text:
Brilliant experience! Therapists were lovely - recommend the neck back and shoulders and the foot massage!

Definitely consider coming here if you have some time spare in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your rating!
We are happy that you were enjoy our place.
We look forward to welcoming you again.
Have a wonderful day.

We truly hope to welcome you again and provide a much better experience next time.

Warm regards,
Makkha Health & Spa

reviews.text: The ambiance was great. The hospitality was good. But the massage itself was just okay for me. I asked for strong pressure and he gave me that just for a few mins and back to medium if not soft. But that’s probably just me. The mango sticky rice was good.

reviews.name: Sarah Salim
reviews.text: I went to the Heritage Asoke branch with my husband. We had fun being picked up by the private tuktuk! When we arrived we were greeted and served promptly, however, this branch is right by the main road and because of the traffic, the lobby/reception area is very noisy, therefore a bit hard to feel relaxed. However, the private room is very spacious, also equipped with shower and amenities which we appreciate. My therapist is really really good, she took notes of everything that I asked for, and she had good techniques and the right pressure level for me. I feel so relaxed after because of her and 90 minutes feel so fast! Overall, I had a pleasant experience still. Thanks Makkha :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for choosing our spa and for the rating. We really appreciate it. We are looking forward to seeing you again!
 Have a nice day!

reviews.name: Allen & Lisa
reviews.text:
Massage: 3/10
Style:
-Compression - applying steady, downward pressure, holding it for a few seconds before releasing
-Elbows for pressure points
Service: 10/10
Cleanliness: 10/10

My partner and I booked a 60 min Neck, Shoulder, and Back massage.
We checked in and paid upfront. We were given a wet cloth, snack, tea, and slippers. We filled out a form that asked about existing health conditions, strength level of the massage, and areas to focus. We were guided to an area and a staff rinsed our feet. Then we were guided to our room and asked to be changed. For the massage we selected, the area we laid on was a mattress on the floor. My partner and I found it uncomfortable because when we laid on our stomach, our face was against the towel making it hard to breathe unless we turned our head to the side. Although we paid for a neck, shoulder, and back massage, the therapist still massaged our head, arms, and legs which is not entirely a bad thing but I was confused. For my experience, I felt like the strength level was inconsistent. The massage on the back was standard, but then it was extremely strong on my neck. For my partners experience, his massage therapist was being lazy when massaging his head. She used one hand and was scratching rather than applying pressure and massaging. I think we had high hopes and were disappointed especially because it’s more on the luxury end of massage places, and we felt like they weren’t skilled or had strong expertise. After the massage, we were then provided tea and mango sticky rice.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Allen & Lisa,
We sincerely apologize for this unpleasant experience during your service.
The team has taken note of the issue that was reported and will talk with the employees to find a solution.

We are urgently working to improve and train massage therapists to strengthen their skills.
We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future.

Have a pleasant day!

reviews.name: Marga Uy Baula
reviews.text:
Because it was new, I chose this over the ther older Makkha Spa across the street. The facility was great- very new! We had tea before a d mango sticky rice after the massage.

But the massage wasn't so good. Maybe because it was new, the therapists were also new? I don't know.

They made us fill out the paper which says which part you want to concentrate on? They didn't concentrate on it.

Much room for improvement.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

reviews.name: Sandra
reviews.text: Beautiful ambience and facilities. We had to try this place after reading all the reviews. We both had the aromatherapy massage and boy were we disappointed. I thought it was only my masseuse but found out my partner’s masseuse was just as disappointing. Painful and inconsistent pressure though I did ask her to be ‘softer’ - she just said sorry and continued. My masseuse could have tested the temperature of the hot towel (like others do) before putting it on my decollatage. It was super hot. My chest was pinkish after that! Have tried way better spas/massages around the region with professional masseuses. Anyway, love the hospitality, ambience and facilities. Not forgetting the yummy mango dessert after the massage. You can a free gift if you complete a Google review by the way!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sandra, thank you for sharing your experience. 
We apologise for the disappointment you.
 
We take your feedback seriously and will address the issue with our massage therapists. Your comments about the need for better training or hiring more skilled professionals are duly noted. 

We appreciate your feedback, and we’ll strive to improve our services. 
If you have any further concerns, please feel free to reach out.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention.
Have a good day
Makkha spa Team

reviews.name: Krisl Gopal
reviews.text: I booked a 2 HR session for my wife on her Birthday. The place was very easy to find since it is just off the stairs from the Asoke BTS station. Upon arrival we were greeted with cold towels, a rice biscuit and a drink for everyone while we waited for the therapist. That didn't take long and off we went while she was being pampered. She enjoyed the experience so much she said she was revitalised. "I'm back" she said after the session, she had been a bit tense because of an injury the last couple of weeks prior. Her skin glowed and she kept talking about how much she enjoyed the session and how good the therapist was. She did the oil massage plus a facial cleansing. After the session they give you some mango sticky rice. Now I want to try it on our next trip to Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind review!
We're so happy to hear you had a great experience. Thank you for your visit, and we hope to welcome you again soon!

reviews.text:
Price not cheap: Aroma 60 min 1390b and head 30 min 700b so altogether about 2100 baht for 1.5h.

Service good: Before that it’s a snack and mango sticky rice after.

Bad skill: However, my therapist is tired and was trembling when she presses

Also my shower suddenly had no hot water

No warning for changes like suddenly pouring hot oil on head, suddenly having hot towel

But I was very tired and still fell asleep

We truly hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again and provide a much better experience on your next visit.

Best regards,
Makkha Team

reviews.name: Nancy Chu
reviews.text: Second time visit with my sister and friends. Decor is calming and pleasant, staff very attentive. Tea before massage and changing shoe into slippers. We choose the hot stone massage for 90mins with add on head massage 30mins. I felt the place is inconsistent with routine on same massage chosen. The hot stone massage was ok but not great with a lot of time spent on changing stones and as for the add on extra head massage, it was a rip off because the masseuse did not spend time in massaging my head at all instead was pushing and rubbing so hard on the spot just above my ear. I had to tell her where to massage before she knew she was not doing it right. First time visit was great, I had a good masseuse so that’s why I return. But really I felt the consistency wasn’t there for the price charged. Quite disappointing because this massage place is considered to be on the top for pricing comparing to a lot of massage places and therefore you would expect quality results. Also I think the choice of oil is minimum and the aroma given the option was quite unpleasant, there was only 5 to choose from. Lucky there was one I felt ok with. Compare it to other massage place I’ve been to with the same price range in BKK. I may not return again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Nancy Chu,  thank you for sharing your experience. 
We apologise for the disappointment you and your group encountered during your visit. We take your feedback seriously and will address the issue with our massage therapists.

Your comments about the need for better training or hiring more skilled professionals are duly noted. We appreciate your feedback, and we’ll strive to improve our services. If you have any further concerns, please feel free to reach out.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention.
Have a pleasant day!

reviews.name: Larry Cortez
reviews.text: Are your feet tired? Well, stop here and get good work done on your tired feet. After walking a full day on your feet you can be fully relaxed in an air conditioned room with very excellent masseuse. They are priced reasonably and offer all the traditional services including something I’ve never seen before: Fish Spa where you dip your feet into a fish tank of particular fish that feed on any dead tissue you stick under water. I saw a family try to get their toddlers to stick their feet in and it was a joyous laughter watching them giggle with amazement. That may be something I might try at a later time. This place gets very busy and like I said, if you find your feet tired and in need of attention, find this place. Highly Recommended!

reviews.name: Leo Doan (linhmip)
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience at Pela Thai Massage near Siam Paragon. The full body massage was very professional, perfectly balanced between relaxing and therapeutic, and really helped release all the tension after a long day of walking. The foot massage was equally amazing—strong where needed, but still super comfortable.
The therapists are skilled and attentive, the place is clean and calm, and the overall atmosphere makes it easy to fully relax. Prices are reasonable for the quality you get, especially in this area. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a great Thai massage experience in central Bangkok. Will definitely come back!

reviews.name: ardilla novia
reviews.text: I booked through whatsapp first few days before coming. They can give couple room if we take aromatherapy oil massage, so I book 2 hour Pela dream relax for 2, it is a combination of thai signature massage with head masaage and oil massage with thai herbal compress, I love this treatment. The staff is very friendly and can speak english well, we need to pay in advance when we arrive there before the treatment start, can pay by credit card if over 1000 THB. The treatment start with washing feet then they show us our room, I forgot to take the picture of the room, but the room is so spacey, there is a shower inside the room with shampoo and body wash provided so that we can directly wash our body after the treatment. They start with thai signature massage (dry massage) the pressure is so strong, but after that the tension on my body is so released, so relaxing. Overall I love the massage, it really help to refresh my body and my feet after a long walk

reviews.name: Eisen Cabusas
reviews.text: Had such a relaxing experience here! The service was excellent from start to finish, and the staff were very accommodating and professional. The massage was super worth it and very relaxing and they really know how to target body pain and tension. Special mention to the masseuses (name: Bear) very skilled, gentle, and made us feel comfortable throughout the session.

reviews.name: Juliana Lim
reviews.text: I love my masseur Pim. She is an excellent masseur. When I asked for more pressure on my feet, she adjusted perfectly and kept checking in to make sure I was comfortable. I felt completely relaxed after the session. My family members were also very satisfied with the experience.

reviews.name: khalid Benhmida
reviews.text:
From the moment I walked in, I was warmly welcomed by the manager, Piyaorn, whose kindness, professionalism, and genuine hospitality made me feel comfortable right away. The atmosphere is peaceful, clean, and beautifully designed, creating the perfect place to relax.

My therapist was incredibly professional, highly skilled, and attentive to my needs. She adjusted the pressure perfectly and helped relieve all the tension in my back, shoulders, and neck. Every technique was performed with care and expertise, making it one of the best Thai massages I have ever experienced.

The entire team is friendly, the service is outstanding, and the attention to detail is exceptional. I left feeling completely refreshed, relaxed, and rejuvenated.

I highly recommend PELA Thai Massage to anyone looking for an authentic, high-quality Thai massage experience. Thank you, Piyaorn and the wonderful therapists—I will definitely be coming back

Massage@Le (Lounge) is a peaceful Thai massage spa located near Wat Arun, Wat Pho and the Grand Palace in Bangkok.
Only 4 minutes from our Massage@Le (Tha Tian) branch, our Lounge offers Thai massage, foot massage, oil massage and herbal compress massage in a quiet and relaxing atmosphere.
It is a perfect place to relax after exploring the historic temples and riverside area of Tha Tian and Wat Pho, Wat Arun and the Grand Palace.

Thai Massage / 마사지 / マッサージ
address: 394/35 Maharat Rd, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
💎Hidden away in a quiet little alley of Tha Tian, our sanctuary might be a little tricky to spot at first—but missing us means missing out on the best relaxation in town!

🕊️Step inside, and you will instantly find a spotless, welcoming haven run by a team of highly skilled, certified professional therapists with warm hearts. 

💵We pride ourselves on top-tier expertise and genuine hospitality, all at the most reasonable and best value prices in the entire Tha Tian area.

😊Escape the busy streets, find our hidden gem, and let us melt your stress away. 

🙏🏼We cannot wait to take care of you!❤️

📢 Important Notice: Our New Facebook Page
Dear valued customers,
Due to issues with our previous Facebook page, Massage@Le has moved to a new page.
Please follow and contact us through our new page for service enquiries, appointment bookings, and updates.
👉 New page:

THAI MASSAGE
DOESN’T HAVE TO HURT.

Our Thai massage preserves the traditional techniques of pressure, stretching, and muscle relaxation—without excessive force or unnecessary pain.

Our standard pressure is medium:
firm enough to release tension,
yet comfortable enough to relax.

Prefer stronger or gentler pressure?
Simply let your therapist know.
We’ll be happy to adjust the pressure within a safe and comfortable level for you.

AUTHENTIC THAI MASSAGE,
WITHOUT UNNECESSARY PAIN.

What Is Thai Massage with Balm?

Thai massage with balm combines traditional pressing, kneading, and gentle stretching techniques with balm applied to tense areas such as the neck, shoulders, back, waist, arms, and legs.

The balm creates a soothing cooling or warming sensation, temporarily relieves muscle tension and soreness, and helps the body and mind relax.

Please inform our staff before treatment if you are pregnant, have wounds or inflamed skin, a recent injury or surgery, a serious medical condition, take blood thinners, or are allergic to any balm ingredients.

When Robots Begin to Give Massages, Where Does the Value of the Human Touch Remain?  

Technology and AI are becoming part of almost every aspect of modern life—even massage therapy, a service once thought impossible to replace.

Today, robotic massage systems are already being used in Germany, offering adjustable pressure, speed, and heat. We are not here to decide which is better, because technology will continue to evolve.

At the same time, we believe traditional Thai massage is an art worth preserving.

The warmth of human touch, the ability to feel muscle tension, adjust pressure, and respond to each guest’s needs are qualities that machines cannot yet fully replace. Beyond technique, there is also care, attention, and genuine human connection.

We invite everyone to experience authentic Thai massage from skilled therapists, offered with attentive service and at a fair price.

Because true relaxation does not always come from the most advanced technology—it can come from skilled hands and genuine care.

Neck and Shoulder Tension: Your Body’s Way of Asking for a Break

Many people don’t realize how much stress they carry in their neck and shoulders. Long hours at a desk, looking down at a phone, driving, or daily stress can cause muscles to become tight and uncomfortable.

A professional massage helps relax tense muscles, improve circulation, and reduce stiffness, allowing your body to move more comfortably. Taking care of muscle tension early can also help prevent it from becoming long-term discomfort.

Sometimes, the best way to feel better isn’t to work harder—it’s simply to give your body the care and relaxation it deserves.

We wash every guest’s feet before treatment—not because you’re having a foot massage, but to ensure hygiene, comfort, and the best massage experience from the very beginning.

At Massage@Le, we believe great massage begins with cleanliness and care. Washing each guest’s feet before treatment helps maintain a hygienic environment, enhances comfort, and supports the well-being of both our guests and our therapists.

It’s a small step that reflects our commitment to professional standards and exceptional service.

Great service begins with mutual respect.

At Massage@Le, we believe that an exceptional massage is built on more than just technique—it begins with mutual respect.

Every guest is welcomed with genuine care, professionalism, and attention to their individual needs. At the same time, our therapists are dedicated professionals who deserve the same kindness, courtesy, and respect they extend to every client.

When guests and therapists treat one another with respect, trust grows naturally. It creates a calm, comfortable atmosphere where every massage can be tailored with care, allowing guests to truly relax and enjoy the experience.
At Massage@Le, we believe exceptional service is created when respect is shared by everyone. And nothing reflects that better than the words of our guests.

Discover Ultimate Relaxation at massage@Le (Lounge)
Looking for the perfect place to unwind after exploring Bangkok’s historic Old Town? Welcome to massage@Le (Lounge). Nestled in Soi Pansuk (marked by the Bangkok Bank at the front of the alley), our lounge offers top-tier relaxation with unmatched travel convenience.

Getting to us—and heading to your next destination—is an absolute breeze:
 🚇 By MRT (Subway): Take the MRT to Sanam Chai Station (Exit 1 or 2). From there, it is just a short 300-meter stroll (about 5 minutes) straight to the shop.

 🚢 By Boat: Rajinee Pier is located just 500 meters away (a 7-minute walk).
 Hop on the Blue Flag Tourist Boat to easily visit iconic attractions like Wat Arun, Tha Maharaj, Tha Phra Athit, ICONSIAM, or Sathorn.
 The Orange Flag Chao Phraya Express Boat is also available from this pier for standard commuting.

 🛺 By MuvMi (Electric Tuk-Tuk): Want to explore nearby hotspots like Song Wat Road, Yaowarat (Chinatown), or Khaosan Road? Simply download the MuvMi app and summon an eco-friendly electric tuk-tuk at a very reasonable price. You can set your pickup or drop-off pin right at Soi Pansuk.
Whether you are starting your day or wrapping up a sightseeing tour, massage@Le (Lounge) is your perfectly positioned urban oasis.

reviews.name: Raz
reviews.text:
After reading the reviews, I decided to give Healthy Massage Sukhumvit 33 a try. Made the booking online via Line app. I arrived 10 minutes late and the receptionist ICE was very welcoming. She quickly got me sorted, asked about focus areas and paired me with my masseuse NANA. I opted for the 2 hour Thai massage with balm. I did tell them that I need very strong pressure, focus on my legs, thighs and lower back. I must say, the massage is excellent ! It did test my pain tolerance but it's exactly what I asked for. NANA always checked on me and also stretched me out till properly.

I had to wear the usual 3/4 massage shorts for this as required for normal Thai massages, although i feel it would have been better with just the disposable underwear. The temp in the room was ok, I usually complain about it being too warm in some massage rooms but it was just right here. The linen was clean and the mattress was dry and comfortable. There is a basket in the room (near your head but not in the way) that you can keep your belongings. You have sight of your belongings all the time, not that it's a problem here. The Thai balm was of good quality. They do pride themselves with good quality massage and service.

After the massage, I got my gear back on, headed down for some Bael Fruit tea (unsweetened) which was nice. I booked my next massage and scrub right away. Highly recommended!!!

The technique definitely has its own “character” — with some unexpected pressure here and there, plus the occasional bonus of your hair getting pulled, just to remind you that yes, you are still in a massage.

The one thing that really stood out was the welcome tea — genuinely very good, probably the highlight of the whole experience.

If you’re curious what a “minimal-effort” massage feels like, this is actually a pretty good place to find out.

reviews.name: Vo Tung
reviews.text:
⭐ Calm Massage – Deep Tissue Thai Massage Review (Singharat Branch)

I’m someone who absolutely loves massage and get treatments every week, so I’m quite particular about technique and pressure. During my visit to Calm Massage (Singharat branch), the receptionist recommended the Deep Tissue Thai Massage after I mentioned that I prefer very strong pressure.

What impressed me immediately was that the receptionist asked in detail about which areas I wanted the therapist to focus on. Many spas ask this but don’t really follow through — Calm Massage actually did exactly what I requested, and that already made the experience stand out.

My therapist was Khun Phai, who is incredibly experienced and exceptionally strong. She applied deep pressure consistently throughout the session, targeted every area I mentioned, and maintained the perfect balance between strength and technique.
She is honestly the strongest female therapist I have ever had, even compared to many therapists I’ve tried in other places.

Overall, I was extremely satisfied with the quality of the massage. If you enjoy strong, professional deep tissue treatments, Calm Massage is absolutely worth trying when you visit Chiang Mai. They have four branches, and I personally visited the Singharat location, which I highly recommend.

reviews.name: Manman
reviews.text:
Do the massage therapists at Calm Massage fall asleep on the job？🤬🤬🤬

Seriously, this was hands down the worst massage I've ever had.

1️⃣ Walked in and there were literally flies buzzing around inside!!!!!!!🪰🪰🪰🪰❓
2️⃣ Session was cut short—by like 5 minutes.🤬
3️⃣ The therapist was SUPER UNPROFESSIONAL!!!

She straight up dozed off while massaging me! (Like, for real? Having sweet dreams on the clock?)
Kept snagging my hair—pulled some strands right out!
Zero effort, just jabbing my back with her elbow the whole time—no kneading, no technique. I swear 40 minutes of that hour was pure elbow torture 🤡

Felt like I was being punished, not pampered. Only after I insisted did she finally move to my head and shoulders. Honestly makes me miss the Thai massages back home...

How did I catch her sleeping? 🤭She just... stopped mid-motion. I turned to look, and she instantly snapped awake and started pressing like crazy. 🤭🤭I almost laughed! After all that, zero relief—and she couldn't even hit the right pressure points. Total waste of time and money.

title: Dang Muay Thai Gym & Muay Thai Gear Shop
ownerDescription: Dang Muay Thai gym, located in the heart of Chiang Mai, is dedicated to providing quality instruction and training in the traditional martial art of muay thai. Our experienced trainers will guide you through an intense, full-body workout that will improve your fitness, strength and self-defense skills. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced fighter, our state-of-the-art facilities and dynamic class offerings will help you achieve your goals. Whether you want to get in shape, learn self-defense or compete, Dang Muay Thai gym is the perfect place for you. Come join our community and train with the best in Chiang Mai.
address: 43, 1 Arak Rd Old City Si Phum, Amphoe Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXQH+89 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Freddy Wm
reviews.text:
I’ve been wanting to check out this Muay Thai gym in Chiang Mai for quite a while. I finally made it, and it was totally worth it! I first saw them on social media, and it’s seriously an amazing spot for a Muay Thai class.
I loved their time management, everything was super disciplined and they have plenty of trainers. Everyone there was so welcoming and happy! If you don’t have gloves, you can rent them for 50 baht. I’d recommend this gym to anyone visiting Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Goh T
reviews.text:
My wife and I just started Muay Thai not long ago and decided to take a private training lesson during our trip to Chiang Mai. We came across Dang Muay Thai Gym on the internet and thought to give it a try.
We were not disappointed.
The gym is clean and spacious and well equipped.
We had Kru Den for our 1 hour private lesson for the 2 of us. I remember the price being very reasonable.
Training was pretty good, started off with some easy warm up and did some pad work. Instructions were made in English that we could easily understand. We learnt some new moves and corrected the stance of some of our moves that we learnt before.
Our Kru Den is patient, encouraging and knowledgeable, always smiling even when I made mistakes repeatedly, correcting, showing and explaining with utmost patience.
We had a good time there, even got to talk with Mr Dang when we popped by the equipment shop which had a good range of products with prices better than Bangkok.
We are planning to go again later this year! Thank you and see you again soon!   - From Singapore

reviews.name: Ben Skidmore
reviews.text: We visited from Texas (USA) with a family of 7 and we had so much fun. The staff immediately put us to work and had us learning the basics.  The staff was very patience and worked with everyone’s skill level. Whether you’re seriously training or want to have a new experience in your international travels (like us), Dang Muay Thai is definitely a place to experience!

reviews.name: Exmortis
reviews.text:
One of the best Muay Thai gyms that I have ever seen/trained in. I immediately noticed that the vibe was excellent, and that each trainer is an expert of their craft.

As a beginner, they knew exactly how to read my current skill level and ensure that I was able to achieve the most amount of progress in each if the 12 sessions that I trained there.

I primarily trained with Kru Big and Kru Nut who were both fantastic teachers, but I can wholeheartedly say that each and every person at this gym is super friendly, enthusiastic, and super approachable.

I will never forget my time here, and I will 100% be returning to Chiang Mai in future, just to train at this gym.

reviews.name: aban bhattacharya
reviews.text:
I joined dang muay thai for a 3 week program during my stay in chiang mai. This has been a wonderful experience right from the start. The rates are reasonable, the coaches are fantastic! This gym accommodates for all fitness types and is very welcoming to absolute beginners like myself. Would definitely come back.
Thank you dang muay thai for giving me this wonderful experience.

reviews.name: Frequency 9
reviews.text:
What an amazing place to learn Muay Thai!

From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed by the wonderful ladies at the reception. They’re always smiling, friendly, and ready to help—whether you need to buy towels, training clothes, or anything else to make your session more comfortable.

The trainers are absolutely amazing. I trained with Coach Bank, and I couldn’t have asked for a better coach. He understands your limits but also knows how to push you in the right way to improve your stamina and technique. I still remember when he asked me to throw 20 kicks—I honestly didn’t think I could do it, but he made it feel so simple and kept motivating me throughout.

A big thank you to the entire team, especially Coach Bank and all the reception staff, for making every session such a great experience. Your professionalism, positive energy, and encouragement made my time here unforgettable.

I’ll definitely be back soon. Miss you guys already! 🥊❤️

reviews.name: Omar Lopez
reviews.text: Amazing gym. I did a private lesson and a group lesson. First time doing Muay Thai. I loved it. The instructors are awesome. Intense and high quality. My coach Shu was great, fun, funny and intense. I only wish I had more time to do more sessions. They tailor the lessons to your experience level. Definitely recommend it if you are in Chiang Mai! These guys are the best.

reviews.name: Johnson Nieh
reviews.text:
This must be THE BEST Muay Thai gym in Chiang Mai.
I’ve trained MMA for more than one year in Taiwan. This time I traveled here and took 4 days to join private classes in Dang Muay Thai.
I super appreciate to my trainers (kru) Den, Nut, and Chok.
They are not only great fighters but also great coaches, with great energy. They corrected my fundamental footworks,   posture, and skills like how to do real elbow and knee, and also make the classes fun.
The gym is clean. There’re shower rooms for us to take a quick clean and change clothes. They provide shampoo and hair dryers.
All staffs here are nice and friendly.
This is my best part of experience and memory in Chiang Mai. Khob khun khrap🙏

reviews.name: Louisa Chong
reviews.text: The facility is clean and tidy. The coaches are experienced, friendly, and very patient in guiding students of different fitness levels. The training session was well-structured, fun, and challenging at the same time. I felt welcomed from the moment I arrived, and the overall environment was positive and encouraging.

reviews.name: 02 mac
reviews.text:
I’m basically a beginner in Muay Thai, and this was one of my first private Muay Thai training sessions. My trainer taught me everything clearly and patiently, and adjusted the training well to my level.

Before the session, I wondered if one hour might feel a little short, but it was more than enough. The training was quite intense and really got my heart rate up, so I was able to get a great workout in a relatively short amount of time.

I think having some basic English would help you understand the trainer’s advice better and get even more out of the session.

Thank you for a great training experience!

reviews.name: chelseasylvia
reviews.text: This was one of the best and hardest workouts of my life! The gym is beautiful , with lots of space to workout and didn’t feel too crowded at all. I did the one hour private class with Kru Big- he was so patient with the fact I was a complete beginner that had no idea what I was doing. They wrap your hands for you and have gloves to rent for super cheap if you don’t have your own. Would highly recommend.

reviews.name: Justin Pirrie
reviews.text: Came over to check the gym out as I want to come train in Chiang Mai for a couple of months. I had a great first impression in the store and their online booking is super easy. I had a private lesson here and the trainers are professional and very understanding of experience levels, I learned a lot and it was truly the best experience I have had in a Muay Thai gym. Thank you

reviews.name: Bori
reviews.text:
Trainers and everyone else are friendly and always having that positive nice energy!
Trainings are a mix of fun and serious and adapted to all skill levels
You'll enjoy your experience, I absolutely recommend it!

reviews.name: nulaorfhlaith
reviews.text: I adored training here everybody was beyond welcoming and kind. All the coaches are incredible and so professional. Myself my husband and two children trained here and my kids said it was one of their favourite parts of our vacation and they have trained around the world in gyms. I will return for sure when I am back in Chang Mai. Thank you for everything x

reviews.name: Mollie Robinson
reviews.text: The best experience, I wish I could go here all of the time!! Learnt so much in the group Muay Thai class and the people running it are soo lovely. Would 100% recommend!

reviews.name: samera oulkadi
reviews.text:
I was really apprehensive about booking a class because I had read a review from another woman who had a bad experience and said she felt uncomfortable. I actually booked a session, cancelled it, and explained to the gym why I had done so.

They were so kind, welcoming, and reassuring that they completely put my mind at ease, which gave me the confidence to rebook. Everyone made such an effort to make me feel comfortable and included.

I don't want to take away from anyone else's experience, as everyone's is different, but I wanted to share mine. Once the team knew I was feeling anxious, they went above and beyond to make me feel welcome. It was also really reassuring to see so many solo women training there who looked happy, comfortable, and confident.

My advice would be to experience it for yourself. Thank you all so much for making me feel so welcome. I'll definitely be booking another class when I'm back in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: angelica teazis
reviews.text:
Hands down one of the highlights of my time in Chiang Mai. As a solo  traveler training in an unfamiliar place, I felt genuinely welcome, safe, and supported from day one. Dang Muay Thai is an incredibly clean gym with skilled, attentive trainers and an environment that feels comfortable whether you’re brand new to Muay Thai or more experienced.

I had such a positive experience that I’ve decided to return to Thailand after my Cambodia trip specifically to train here for another month. I’m not a professional fighter by any stretch of the imagination, but I left every class feeling strong, confident, and energized. I can’t recommend this gym enough.

reviews.name: Maxime V
reviews.text:
I’ve trained at several gyms, and this one is definitely one of the best. The facilities are great, the training is serious, and the coaches are truly professionals
The atmosphere is amazing too. Everyone is friendly, supportive, and motivated, which makes every session a pleasure, even the tough ones.

Whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced fighter, this gym is the perfect place to train hard, learn real technique, and enjoy the authentic Muay Thai spirit.
Highly recommended !

reviews.name: Sofia Boulamrach
reviews.text:
My first go at Muay Thai was at Dang Muay Thai and I couldn’t be more pleased. This gym is fantastic. The coaches are competent, serious about their craft, but also kind and super funny. I took the beginner class and it challenged me without crushing my confidence. Will definitely come back here whenever I am in Chiang Mai.
If you were to try just one gym in this lovely city, make it Dang Muay Thai ❤️

reviews.name: Tara Nautu
reviews.text: Came here for my first ever Muay Thai session with my partner. We did a private session with Den and we had a great time. ! Den was kind, patient and funny. We felt very comfortable in the environment and were taught the basics of Muay Thai. Had a blast and wish we could’ve done more sessions but we had to leave for Phuket :((

reviews.name: Stuart March
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I visited Candice Facial Spa in Chiang Mai for a HydraFacial treatment and came away really impressed.

I booked based on the strong reviews, and it’s clear why they’re so consistent. The space is calm and well presented, with a peaceful, clean environment that feels more clinical than your typical spa. It’s obvious they focus on results-driven, dermatology-style treatments rather than just relaxation.

The treatment itself was high quality and felt thorough from start to finish. Everything was explained clearly, and the therapist worked with care and attention, which gives you confidence in what they’re doing. It also felt like good value for the level of service and expertise you’re getting.

One small piece of feedback from my side as a man with a short beard is that the facial hair area wasn’t really incorporated into the treatment, so it didn’t feel like my whole face benefited equally. It’s not a major issue, but something worth being aware of or discussing beforehand.

Overall, I was very happy with the experience and would definitely recommend it if you’re looking for a more results-focused facial in Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for such a thoughtful and detailed review! We’re delighted you enjoyed the treatment and appreciated our results-focused approach ✨ We also appreciate your feedback on the beard area and will keep it in mind to improve the experience.. Hope to welcome you back again soon 😊

reviews.name: Finding Norrie
reviews.text:
It was my very first facial treatment ever after all these years! 😂

From the moment I walked in, everyone made me feel so welcome. The staff were incredibly friendly, and my therapist was professional, attentive, and truly mindful throughout the entire experience. 🧘

reviews.name: Val
reviews.text:
I recently visited Candice Spa for a HydraFacial and had a positive experience overall.

I had originally booked only the HydraFacial, but the staff also recommended a Gua Sha facial massage. I had already been considering trying it during a future visit, so I decided to add it to my treatment. At no point did I feel pressured into purchasing additional services, which I appreciated.

My facial therapist, Luktan, was gentle, professional, and very thorough. She carefully followed all the steps included in both the HydraFacial and Gua Sha treatments, and I felt well taken care of throughout the session.

I intentionally waited a few days before writing this review because I have extremely sensitive skin and wanted to see how my face reacted after the treatment. Three days later, I am happy to report that I experienced no irritation, inflammation, or breakouts. For anyone with sensitive skin, that is a huge plus. The products used appear to be of good quality, and my skin still looks fresh and glowing.

The spa itself is clean, well-maintained, and easy to book with. The appointment process was quick and straightforward, and the facilities are comfortable and well organized.

The only drawback for me was the noise level during the treatment. The treatment areas are separated by curtains rather than enclosed private rooms, so sounds from neighboring treatments, machines, staff conversations, and guests entering and leaving the spa can be heard quite clearly. If you are looking for a deeply quiet and meditative spa experience, this may be something to keep in mind.

That said, the quality of the treatment, the professionalism of the therapist, the cleanliness of the spa, and the results I achieved outweighed the noise issue. Overall, it was a very good experience, and I would consider returning for future treatments.
