The ambiance, with the decor of trees and plants, were incredibly soothing.
The private room was spotless, with clean towels, shampoo, shower gel, and even a hairdryer!
The spa's overall atmosphere was so relaxing, enhanced by the lovely scents.
The body scrub and massage were top-notch – I slept like a baby during the session!
Afterward, I enjoyed a delicious Bael Fruit Tea with Thai Crispy Coconut Rolls.
Highly recommend! 10/10 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

reviews.name: Jessica Moyer
reviews.text: Fantastic massage experience! If you’re looking for a top-tier therapist, book with NOONA! She gave me the best massage I’ve had in Bangkok. The spa is conveniently located in the heart of Bangkok and the experience starts with a cool towel, water, and a quick preference/medical form before a relaxing foot wash. The rooms are spacious, well-ventilated, and even include showers, safes, and robes, which is a great touch if you want to rinse off after. After the session, you’re welcomed back downstairs with tea and coconut cookies. My only recommendation is consistency, as my first massage was good but the second with Noona was truly exceptional. All therapists should follow the preference sheets, as customers request certain areas that need focus for a reason. Overall, an excellent experience!

reviews.name: T Lee
reviews.text: Place was nice, masseur was ok. I did a 5 in 1 therapy for 60 mins at 690 baht. It was ok, didn’t quite hit the spot for me. A little expensive as compared to others by the road… The masseur was pressing on the bones rather than the muscles. Felt a little off. Perhaps it was a long day for her..

reviews.name: gunduz berk once
reviews.text:
Here is the most clean place in Bangkok. Quality 10 out of 10. Everyone must visit here at least twice for best quality massage.
100% recommend 🥂

reviews.name: Chanisorn Kasemsuth
reviews.text: I had an aromatic stress-release massage and body scrub for the first time. My masseuse was very gentle and applied just the right amount of pressure on my neck and shoulders to help relieve the office syndrome I have. Excellent customer service and friendly staff. I had a very nice experience and will come back again!

reviews.name: Neil Tonkon
reviews.text: This is the real Thai massage !! They have great service and are so friendly . Noi gave the best Thai massage I’ve had … will be back for 2 hour session next time !

reviews.name: Junmin Ye
reviews.text: this is my second time back at Nature Thai, love the place! very clean and professional look. Did a foot massage + back and shoulder massage and the masseuse did not disappoint. Good pressure all around, and you can let them know if there are certain areas you prefer to be more firm or not. Recommend to try!

reviews.name: Preben Finnestad
reviews.text: While the massage itself was a solid OK+, the overall experience was amazing. The moment you walk in, you feel a sense of total relaxation. The receptionist welcomed me warmly, and the entire team is professional, friendly, and truly goes the extra mile. Comfy chairs and great vibes. I left feeling fantastic. Huge thanks to the receptionist for the impeccable service!

reviews.name: Young
reviews.text:
I liked the quiet and private room. Despite being in a busy neighborhood, the shop was peaceful. I booked thru klook once nature signature and once tiger balm thai massage- both 90minutes.  There was a shower stall to rinse off the oil.

The staff will ask you frequently if you are ok during the massage. You can always adjust your preference then, whether you want it stronger or lighter.

It is near emsphere so if you are around, it is a must visit.
Discounts are given during slow hours.

reviews.name: Maria Grace
reviews.text: First time here and the experience (5in1 theraphy) was amazing! The staff in front were helpful with all my questions and my masseuse Noi was very friendly and thorough! She did amazing with all my shoulder and neck pain, all my pain gone by the time the massage ended. I will come back again for sure~

reviews.name: Wint Wah
reviews.text:
I went for foot massage with my mom,
The experience was 10000/10.

Very relaxing and the Satff are so experienced.

reviews.name: Leigh Foley
reviews.text:
Best massage I’ve ever had, and I’ve had plenty over the years. I had a full 1-hour traditional Thai massage with tiger balm from Tree and it felt completely tailored to me rather than just a standard routine. She checked throughout to make sure the pressure was okay, and the medium to hard level was absolutely perfect.

Professional, attentive, and really knew what she was doing.

Left feeling looser, lighter, and genuinely relaxed. Highly recommend and I’ll definitely be back. Thank you Tree!

Leigh

reviews.name: Moon Li
reviews.text: My masage was fabulous they did the right pressure and spots for me i would highly recommend. After my masage they brought me some tea and coconut wafers. The atmosphere was realy relaxing,even with the language barriers it was great. Would go again if I come back to Bangkok!

reviews.name: Jordan Hammersley
reviews.text: Most amazing full body massage ive had in a long time! They focused on specific areas that needed the most attention and you were able to choice your own oils. At the start you choose massage intensity and they were perfect at keeping it at the right pressure! We were then able to shower after and they allow you all the time you need to get ready, at the end give you a lovely cup of tea. 10/10 service.

title: Captain Quint Paradise สาขาราชพฤกษ์ Pet Shop, Dog Pool, and Pet Grooming & Spa
ownerDescription:
Captain Quint Paradise สวรรค์น้อยๆสำหรับคุณและสัตว์เลี้ยง เราให้บริการทั้งหมด 3 ส่วน ได้แก่

Café สำหรับเพื่อนๆที่รักน้องหมา หรือต้องการบรรยากาศสบายๆในการพบปะสังสรรค์ ร้านของเราไม่ใช่คาเฟ่น้องหมา คาเฟ่ที่ร้านจะเน้นให้เพื่อนๆสามารถพาน้องหมาของตนเองมาทานเครื่องดื่ม ทานขนมด้วยกัน และใช้เวลาด้วยกันได้มากกว่าครับ

Pet Shop สำหรับเพื่อนๆที่กำลังมองหาอุปกรณ์สำหรับสัตว์เลี้ยงแสนรัก มีหลากหลายไม่ว่าจะเป็นอาหาร แชมพู ข้าวของเครื่องใช้ รวมไปถึงสินค้านำเข้า Accesories เก๋ๆ ก็เข้ามาหาได้ที่นี่ (จำหน่ายทั้งหน้าร้านและออนไลน์)

และปิดท้ายด้วย Spa สำหรับน้องหมาน้องแมวให้ได้ผ่อนคลาย เข้ามาอาบน้ำ กรูมมิ่ง ให้สัตว์เลี้ยงหล่อสวยตามต้องการ
address: 222 Ratchaphruek Rd, Tambon Maha Sawat, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand
plusCode: RF42+53 Maha Sawat, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi, Thailand

reviews.name: CHAYANAN DINSAKUN
reviews.text: The staff is very caring and hospitable. There will be excretion in the out door section, and we can see every step while the staff bathe the pet. And while waiting, you can also order food and drinks to eat while waiting. 🩷❤️🧡💛💚
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words about our team! We’re glad you enjoyed being able to watch your pet’s grooming and relax with food and drinks while waiting. We’d love to welcome you and your pet back again.

reviews.name: C.H.A.N. VEERAPHATTARAKUL
reviews.text: If you’re looking for exceptional pet care, look no further than Captain Quint Paradise. This pet shop truly sets the standard for grooming and spa services for  dogs and cats. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted by a warm and friendly staffs who clearly adore animals.The grooming services are top-notch, with a keen eye for detail that ensures your furry friend looks and feels fabulous. Their spa treatments are a hit with pets, offering a range of services that pamper and rejuvenate, making every visit a special experience. What stands out the most is their genuine passion for pets and their commitment to high-quality care. Whether it’s a routine grooming session or a spa day, Captain Quint Paradise goes above and beyond to ensure your pet’s comfort and happiness. Highly recommended for anyone wanting the best for their beloved companions!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for such a thoughtful review! We’re delighted that our team’s warm welcome and attention to grooming details stood out to you. We appreciate your recommendation and the trust you place in us to care for your pets.

reviews.name: Phoom Satutham (Puma)
reviews.text: Dogs and cats are not just pets but family members. I am so impressed by their professional grooming performance, cleanliness of the facilities, pet safety, and services. The price is reasonable when compared to the quality of work.

reviews.name: Panarat Suvannarat
reviews.text: Favorite grooming place and groomer P’Nini

reviews.name: Dino S.
reviews.text: Bring 2 dogs here every month. Dogs get clean and thorough. Always come home with clean paws and long lasting smell.

reviews.name: him Omac
reviews.text: Good service, nice and clean workplace, best grooming ever

reviews.name: Ratana R.
reviews.text: Cozy. Food is nice too :)

reviews.name: Pimnara Kitprasan
reviews.text: Good

reviews.name: Usawan Jalasup
reviews.text: Good service

reviews.name: Being Journal
reviews.text:
เรียกใช้บริการ Grooming delivery ครั้งแรก รู้สึกชอบ และเห็นถึงความใส่ใจของเจ้าหน้าที่ ฝ่ายแอดมิน และช่างตัดขน ทำหน้าที่ได้ดี ช่างตัดขนได้สวยและดีมาก เปลี่ยนลุคไปเลย ช่วงแรกหมาเราจะดื้ออยู่ไม่นิ่ง จนช่างต้องจูงมาคืน แต่เราได้แก้ปัญหา จนช่างสามารถทำงานต่อได้ งานออกมาเรียบร้อย สวยงาม ดูใส่ใจรายละเอียดดี ตั้งแต่ใช้บริการอาบน้ำตัดขนมา มีที่นี่ที่ตัดไม่โดนอุ้งเท้าน้อง หลังอาบน้ำตัดขนวันนี้ น้องไม่มีอาการเจ็บเท้าหรือเดินกระแพกเลย แค่น้องยังไม่มั่นใจที่ขนหายไปเยอะเท่านั้นเอง ข้ามคืนน้องก็ลืมแล้ว

แต่มีอย่างนึงที่อยากให้ทางร้านคิดถึงค่าเดินทาง ระยะทางไม่ถึงเกณฑ์ที่แจ้งมา แต่ก็ยังคิด ฿100 ควรจะบวกลบกับที่ใช้น้ำไฟที่บ้านลูกค้านิดนึง

โดยรวมพอใจมากๆ ค่ะ มีโอกาสจะพาไปว่ายน้ำ
reviews.textTranslated:
This was my first time using the grooming delivery service, and I really liked it. I appreciated the attentiveness of the staff, both the admin team and the groomer. The groomer did a great job; the haircut was beautiful and completely transformed my dog's look. Initially, my dog ​​was restless and wouldn't stay still, requiring the groomer to lead him back, but we resolved the issue so the groomer could continue working. The result was neat, beautiful, and showed great attention to detail. Of all the grooming services I've used, this is the only place that didn't cut my dog's paws. After the bath and haircut, my dog ​​didn't experience any paw pain or limping; he's just a little self-conscious about how much fur was gone. He'll forget about it overnight.

However, one thing I'd like to suggest is considering the travel fee. The distance didn't meet the stated threshold, but they still charged ฿100. There should be a slight adjustment for electricity and water usage at the customer's home.

Overall, I'm very satisfied. I'll definitely take my dog ​​swimming there in the future.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากครับที่ลองใช้บริการ Grooming Delivery กับเราเป็นครั้งแรก และขอบคุณสำหรับรีวิวละเอียด ๆ ด้วยนะครับ 😊 ดีใจมากที่คุณลูกค้ารู้สึกถึงความใส่ใจของทั้งทีมแอดมินและช่าง Grooming ครับ ทีมงานทุกคนตั้งใจให้น้องได้รับการดูแลอย่างดีที่สุดถึงหน้าบ้านเลยครับ 🚐🐶💙 หวังว่าจะได้ดูแลน้องอีกเรื่อย ๆ นะครับ

reviews.name: Supen Nokk
reviews.text: เพิ่งใช้บริการครั้งแรก เนื่องจากที่เดิมช่างเก่าของคุมะลาออกแล้วไม่ใว้ใจช่างคนใหม่ค่ะ เลยเสิชหาที่ๆดูแล้ว เจ้าของ,ช่าง และบรรยากาศ รักน้องหมา ..ใช้เวลาจนมาเจอที่นี่ ..ช่างนินี่ ที่ตัดขนน้องคุมะ,พนง หน้าร้าน และแม้กระทั้ง ครูสอนว่ายน้ำ ดูแล้วรักน้องๆสี่ขา คิดว่าจะให้เป็นร้านประจำคุมะ.(ถึงปกติจะตัดขนคุมะ ปีละ1-2ครั้งเท่านั้น 😁) ว่ายน้ำนี่ก็น่ามาลอง แต่ติดที่น้องไม่ชอบว่ายน้ำ ..แต่คิดว่าจะพามาลองสักครั้ง
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time using their service. My dog ​​Kuma's old groomer left, and I didn't trust the new one. So I searched online for a place where the owner, groomer, and atmosphere seemed to love dogs. It took me a while to find this place. Nini, who grooms Kuma, the front-of-house staff, and even the swimming instructor – everyone seems to love four-legged friends. I'm thinking of making this Kuma's regular grooming spot (even though he usually only gets his hair cut 1-2 times a year 😁). The swimming lesson looks interesting, but Kuma doesn't like swimming... though I plan to bring him to try it sometime.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบคุณมากนะครับที่ไว้ใจพาน้องคุมะมาใช้บริการกับเราเป็นครั้งแรก และดีใจมากที่คุณลูกค้าประทับใจทั้งพี่นีนี่ ทีมหน้าร้าน และทีมสระว่ายน้ำครับ 😊
ยินดีมากที่ได้ดูแลน้อง และหวังว่าจะได้เจอน้องคุมะบ่อย ๆ นะครับ ส่วนเรื่องว่ายน้ำ ค่อย ๆ ลองกันใหม่ได้เลยครับ ทีมงานพร้อมช่วยให้น้องคุ้นเคยและสนุกกับน้ำมากขึ้นครับ 💙

reviews.name: Anja Asavavajrasmith
reviews.text: ประทับใจในการบริการมากๆเลยค่ะ พี่ๆทุกคนต้อนรับอย่างดีตั้งแต่หน้าประตู ครูบอลพาลีโอน่าเล่นน้ำสนุกมากบิ้วน้องดีสุดๆ พี่นีนี่ตัดขนน้องไฟเซอร์เนี้ยบสุดๆเลยค่ะ ขนนุ่มละเอียดไม่มีพันกันซักจุด มีแต่คนทักว่าเหมือนตุ๊กตาเลย ที่สำคัญร้านไถขนท้องน้องทั้งสองตัวดีมากค่ะ ไม่คมเป็นตอระคายเคืองแบบร้านอื่น ไปร้านไหนก็ไม่ดีเท่านี้ค่ะ ♥️
reviews.textTranslated: I was very impressed with the service. Everyone was so welcoming from the moment we arrived. Teacher Ball and Leona had so much fun playing in the water; they were so good at hyping her up! Sister Nini gave Pfizer a perfect haircut; his fur is so soft, fine, and tangle-free. Everyone commented that he looks like a doll! Most importantly, the salon did a great job shaving the belly fur of both dogs. It wasn't sharp or irritating like at other salons. I haven't found a salon that does it as well as this one! ♥️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณสำหรับรีวิวละเอียด ๆ นะครับ ดีใจที่ลีโอน่าสนุกกับครูบอล และทรงขนของไฟเซอร์ถูกใจจนมีคนทักว่าเหมือนตุ๊กตาเลย 😊 คำชมถึงพี่นีนี่และทีมงานเป็นกำลังใจให้มากครับ แล้วพาน้องทั้งสองมาหากันอีกนะครับ

reviews.name: พรนิภา ศิลปศร
reviews.text: ร้านสะอาด พนักงานน่ารัก พาลูกสาวมาอาบน้ำทำสปากับพี่เพชรเป็นประจำ (ตามมาจากสาขา cdc น้องยอมพี่เพชรคนเดียวจริงๆ😅) พี่เพชรใส่ใจมากๆ อาบเสร็จลูกสาวตัวหอมขนสวยสุดๆ
reviews.textTranslated: The shop is clean and the staff are lovely. I regularly bring my daughter to get a bath and spa treatment with Petch (I followed them from the CDC branch; she only trusts Petch 😅). Petch is very attentive, and after the bath, my daughter smells great and her fur is beautiful.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณที่ตามมาให้พี่เพชรดูแลกันถึงสาขานี้นะครับ ดีใจที่ลูกสาวไว้ใจพี่เพชรและกลับบ้านพร้อมขนสวยตัวหอมทุกครั้ง 😊 ขอบคุณสำหรับความไว้วางใจที่มีให้กันเสมอครับ

reviews.name: S P
reviews.text:
เตือนคนที่ใช้บริการ!
อาบน้ำไถขนที่ร้านนี้ ก่อนพาน้องกลับอย่าลืมเช็คอุ้งดท้าน้องด้วยนะคะ ว่ามีแผลมั้ย

เคยพาน้องไปอาบหลายครั้ง ซื้อเมมเบอร์ด้วย
พอมีแผล แจ้งกลับไปทางร้าน เจ้าของติดต่อกลับมาว่า ต้องขอตรวจสอบก่อนว่าแผลเข้าได้กับปัตตาเลี่ยนของเค้ามั้ย เสียความรู้สึกมากๆ

อย่าลืมตรวจสอบลูกๆเราก่อนออกจากร้านด้วยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
A warning to those who use their services!
Before taking your pet home after grooming at this shop, don't forget to check their paws for any wounds.

I've taken my pet there several times and even bought a membership.
When I noticed a wound, I contacted the shop, and the owner said they needed to check if the wound was compatible with their clippers. I was very disappointed.

Remember to check your pets before they leave the shop!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขออภัยสำหรับความไม่สบายใจที่เกิดขึ้นนะครับ หลังได้รับแจ้ง ทางร้านได้ตรวจสอบกับช่างผู้ดูแลน้องโดยตรง ซึ่งพบว่าบริเวณเท้าน้องมีอาการผิวเปื่อยและระคายเคืองได้ง่าย จึงไม่สามารถยืนยันได้ว่าเกิดจากปัตตาเลี่ยนครับ
ทางร้านได้เสนอให้พาน้องไปพบสัตวแพทย์เพื่อตรวจเพิ่มเติม และนำข้อเสนอแนะนี้ไปปรับปรุงขั้นตอนการตรวจเช็กและการสื่อสารของทีมงานให้รอบคอบยิ่งขึ้นครับ

reviews.name: Annie Reechaivijitgul
reviews.text:
ครูฝึกสินดีมาก ใจเย็น คุยและคอยปลอบน้องตลอดเวลา
ส่วนพนักงานดูแล บริการยิ้มแย้มมาก คอยหยอกเล่นกับน้องมากๆคะ
ไว้จะมาใช้บริการอีกนะคะ ✨
reviews.textTranslated:
The trainer was excellent, very calm, and constantly talked to and comforted my child.
The staff were also very friendly and cheerful, and kept playing with my child.
We will definitely use their services again! ✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากครับ ดีใจที่ความใจเย็นของคุณครูและการต้อนรับของทีมงานทำให้ประทับใจครับ อยากให้น้องรู้สึกสบายใจทุกครั้งที่มา แล้วกลับมาเล่นด้วยกันอีกนะครับ

reviews.name: Zuzan Pro
reviews.text:
เป็นสระว่ายน้ำหมา อาบน้ำตัดขน ที่น่ารัก บรรยากาศภายในดี ทางเข้าเดียวกับ รพ.สัตว์อยู่ด้านในสุด พาน้องเดินเข้ามาผ่านโซน pet shop ติดต่อเคาน์เตอร์ อยู่ด้านในติดโซนสระว่ายน้ำ นั่งดูเด็กๆได้ หรือจะนั่งดูในโซนคาเฟ่มีที่นั่งสดวกสบาย มีเคริ่องดื่มหลากหาย (มีคูปองเครื่องดื่มฟรี สำหรับคุณผู้ปกครองที่ให้น้องๆทำสปาขนด้วยนะคะ)พร้อมทั้งเบเกอร์รี่ และขนมน้องหมาน้องแมว ระหว่างรอได้คุณแม่นั่งทำงาน สบายเลยค่ะ
ที่นี่ สะอาด บริการดี เราเคยพาคุกกี้มาอาบน้ำก่อนนี้ 1 ครั้ง เพื่อทดสอบว่าน้องชอบที่นี่มั้ย สรุปว่าผ่านค่ะ ครั้งนี้เลยมั่นใจ จัดชุดใหญ่ อาบน้ำ ตัดขน แปรงฟัน สปากุหลาบ ให้พี่ช่างตัดขน ให้สั้นๆ คุกกี้เป็นสายพันธุ์คาวาเรีย ปกติดไม่ต้องตัดขน แต่ยังไงนะ 🤣 ขนเยอะจัง เลยให้พี่ช่างช่วยออกแบบให้ จะได้ดูแลง่ายๆ
reviews.textTranslated:
It's a lovely dog ​​grooming and bathing place with a great atmosphere. The entrance is the same as the animal hospital, located at the very back. Walk your dog in through the pet shop area and contact the counter, which is inside, next to the swimming pool area. You can sit and watch your dog, or you can sit in the cafe area with comfortable seating and a variety of drinks (there are free drink coupons for owners who get their dogs' fur spa treatments!), along with bakery items and dog and cat treats. While waiting, you can comfortably sit and work.
The place is clean and the service is good. We brought Cookie here for a bath once before to test if she liked it, and she passed the test! So this time, we were confident and got the full treatment: bath, grooming, teeth brushing, and a rose spa. We asked the groomer to cut Cookie's fur short. Cookie is a Cavalier, and normally doesn't need a haircut, but she has so much fur! So, we asked the groomer to design a style that would be easy to manage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณที่เล่าประสบการณ์ของคุกกี้ให้ฟังอย่างละเอียดเลยครับ ดีใจที่ครั้งแรกผ่านจนคุณแม่มั่นใจพามาดูแลกันอีก 😊 และระหว่างรอก็ได้นั่งทำงานสบาย ๆ ด้วย หวังว่าจะได้ต้อนรับคุณแม่กับคุกกี้อีกนะครับ

reviews.name: Phattraphan Bunnag
reviews.text:
ร้านอาบน้ำประจำของลูกสาว น้องๆอาบน้ำหวีขนละเอียดมากกกก หอมมากๆ แล้วยังรายงานตลอดถ้าเจอแผลหรือผื่นแดงๆ

นอกจากอาบน้ำตัดขนแล้วยังมีของให้ช้อปปิ้งเยอะแยะมากมายด้วยค่ะ

ร้านอยู่ติดถ.รัตนาธิเบศน์ มีที่จอดรถ 4-5 คัน

ใครหาร้านอาบน้ำดีๆแนะนำเลยค่า
reviews.textTranslated:
This is my daughter's regular dog grooming salon. The staff are incredibly thorough with their baths and grooming; her dog smells amazing! They also report any sores or rashes they find.

Besides grooming, they also have a wide variety of items for shopping.

The salon is located on Rattanathibet Road and has parking for 4-5 cars.

I highly recommend this place if you're looking for a great dog grooming salon!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณที่ให้เราเป็นร้านอาบน้ำประจำของลูกสาวนะครับ ดีใจที่ประทับใจทั้งการหวีขนและการแจ้งรายละเอียดระหว่างดูแลน้อง ขอบคุณที่บอกต่อให้ด้วยครับ เป็นกำลังใจให้ทีมงานมากเลย

reviews.name: G G
reviews.text: พาน้องมาใช้บริการที่นี่เป็นประจำ ทั้งอาบน้ำ ว่ายน้ำ Day care วิ่งเล่น พี่ๆ ทุกคนดูแลดีมากๆ เลย น้องอาบน้ำกับพี่ฝ้ายประจำ พี่ฝ้ายดูแลน้องดีมากๆ มาทีไรน้องวิ่งเข้าประตู ดีใจเหมือนได้มาสวนสนุก 😆  พามาที่นี่แล้ววางใจว่าพี่ๆ ดูแลน้องดีมาก เปลี่ยนประสบการณ์อาบน้ำให้เป็นเรื่องสนุก น้องชอบที่นี่มากค่ะ 🥰
reviews.textTranslated: I bring my dog ​​here regularly for everything – bathing, swimming, daycare, playtime. All the staff are so kind and caring. My dog ​​always gets bathed by P'Fai, who takes excellent care of him. Every time we come, my dog ​​runs through the door, so happy, like he's at an amusement park! 😆 I trust that the staff here will take great care of my dog. They've turned bath time into a fun experience. My dog ​​loves it here! 🥰
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: อ่านว่าน้องวิ่งเข้าร้านเหมือนได้มาสวนสนุกแล้วอดยิ้มไม่ได้เลยครับ 😄 ขอบคุณที่ไว้ใจให้พี่ฝ้ายและทีมงานดูแลทั้งอาบน้ำ ว่ายน้ำ และวันมาฝากเล่นนะครับ ดีใจที่การมาหาเราเป็นเรื่องสนุกของน้องครับ

reviews.name: Phakwan Laohathai
reviews.text: มาว่ายน้ำกับครูบอล ครูบอลใจดีมากๆ ค่อย ๆ ผูกมิตรกับน้อง และสอนให้น้องว่ายน้ำ หลังว่ายน้ำได้อาบน้ำตัวหอมฉุย~
reviews.textTranslated: We went swimming with Coach Ball. Coach Ball is very kind. He gradually made friends with the kids and taught them how to swim. After swimming, they had a shower and smelled wonderful!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณที่พาน้องมาว่ายน้ำกับครูบอลครับ ดีใจที่การค่อย ๆ ทำความคุ้นเคยช่วยให้น้องได้ลองว่ายน้ำ แล้วจบด้วยอาบน้ำตัวหอมกลับบ้าน 😊 ครั้งหน้ามาสนุกด้วยกันอีกนะครับ

reviews.name: Khun Chanaporn
reviews.text: อาบน้ำดีมาก พี่นีนี่เข้าอกเข้าใจเด็กขี้กลัว ดูแลพีทเป็นอย่างดี ใจเย็นเล่นด้วยจนน้องสบายใจ หวีไปเล่นไป อาบกับพี่นีนี่ตั้งแต่อายุ 4-5 เดือน ตอนนี้สองขวบครึ่ง เจ้าหน้าที่ทุกคนน่ารัก เจ้าของร้านน่ารักให้คำแนะนำตลอด ครูบอลสอนว่ายน้ำเชี่ยวชาญ น่ารักใจเย็น เลิฟที่นี่มากๆค่า
reviews.textTranslated: Bathing was great! Nini is very understanding of scared children and takes excellent care of Pete. She's patient, playing with him until he feels comfortable, even grooming him while playing. Pete has been bathing with Nini since he was 4-5 months old, and now he's two and a half years old. All the staff are lovely, the owner is wonderful and always gives advice, and swimming instructor Ball is highly skilled, kind, and patient. We love this place so much!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณที่ไว้ใจให้พี่นีนี่ดูแลพีทมาตั้งแต่เล็กเลยนะครับ ดีใจที่พีทค่อย ๆ สบายใจและมีเวลาเล่นไปด้วยระหว่างดูแลขน คำชมถึงครูบอลและทีมงานทุกคนทำให้ชื่นใจมากครับ ฝากกอดพีทด้วยนะครับ

title: Makkha Health & Spa Bangkok (BTS Asok)

Spanning over 800 square meters of light-filled space, we offer more than 17 spacious treatment rooms. Our skilled therapists provide exceptional Thai massage and spa services using 100% natural essential oils to engage all five senses, allowing customers to experience true peace in a serene location.

Makkha Health & Spa combines traditional Thai techniques with modern wellness practices, making it a premier destination for Thai massage in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Tammi - Luxury Travel
reviews.text:
Makkha Asoke-

Beautiful spa and a really relaxing experience. Makkha Spa is very popular, so definitely book in advance through their website, they stay busy.

Everything was very well organized with plenty of staff, and the service felt smooth from start to finish. Just make sure you’re selecting the correct location when booking since they have multiple branches around Bangkok.

The spa itself is very clean, and the massage tables are noticeably more comfortable than most, softer and easier to fully relax on.

I did the 2-hour hot stone massage and it was excellent. You get to choose from several oils. I chose lavender. My therapist was very skilled, and the whole experience felt high quality.

They also finish with mango sticky rice and tea, which was a really nice touch.

Highly recommend if you’re looking for a quality spa experience in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind review!
We are glad to know that you found our message very comforting.
We appreciate it, and we hope to see you again soon.
Have a nice day!

reviews.name: София Шевчук
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this spa experience in Bangkok. The atmosphere was calm, elegant and very relaxing from the moment we arrived. The staff were kind, attentive and professional, and every detail felt thoughtful — from the beautiful interior to the tea and snacks after the treatment. The massage itself was amazing, one of the best experiences during our trip. Perfect place to relax and recharge after busy days in the city. Highly recommend 🤍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for leaving us a review. 
Glad that you had an amazing experience during your visit. We appreciate the kind words, and we are looking forward to your next visit. Have a nice day!

reviews.name: Larry Cortez
reviews.text: Looking for a luxurious place to relax and treat yourself to a massage. Makkha Health spa is one of the nicest places to go. Besides the common chain of massage shops throughout Bangkok and the malls, Makkha is more of a boutique. They have really nice rooms and they know how to massage. They offer many packages. Our party of 3 had different ideas what to address and I chose the 90 minute oil aroma massage and foot massage. You are given the chance to undress into a pair of sheer underwear and you lay on the comfortable table. When you choose your oil fragrance downstairs, that is the product that will be infused into your body when they massage. Choose wisely because all of the fragrances are all good. You will be mesmerized into unconsciousness, drifting into the unknown sleepy state as they rub up and down your body. My friends tell me they fell asleep and another forgot where they were. It is a stress release and relaxing. The staff and masseuse are highly technical and know the technique of massage. Never rushing and always checking if the pressure is ok. Some of us are now repeat customers because they offer so many other packages. I loved it and I highly recommend Makkha Health Spa.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for this review. We appreciate the kind words and we are thankful for choosing us. We are hoping to see you again soon. Have a nice day!

reviews.name: M&M Mitch & Mimetto
reviews.text: Stayed at a local 5 star hotel - and the concierge recommended this place as they also came to pick you up from the lobby . Over all pretty decent clean place with very educated staff . Welcome tea and reception were good . Unfortunately the massage was so so - the therapist was a bit in experienced as even after asking for the strong massage in the form and verbally confirming it was so so . Also the head massage was mediocre . Anyways finished with a nice mango sticky rice so kept me happy . But will have to try other places for massages in Thailand for sure it’s very rarely I’ve been disappointed so this was a rarely considering the pricing . Over all clean rooms and professional staff so good for international standards
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Topman bloke,

Thank you very much for taking the time to share your feedback with us. We truly appreciate your kind words regarding our cleanliness, professional service, warm welcome, and the overall experience with our team.

We sincerely apologize that the massage experience did not fully meet your expectations, especially regarding the pressure and head massage. Your comments have been shared with our management team and therapists so we can continue improving our service and ensure a more personalized experience for every guest.

We are glad that you enjoyed our welcome tea and mango sticky rice, and we truly appreciate your understanding and valuable feedback. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again and provide you with a more exceptional massage experience in the future.

Warm regards,
Makkha spa Team

reviews.name: Amanda S
reviews.text: This placed was searched randomly online by hubby. We were lucky enough to get an 1hr slot each without reservation and walked in at 11pm. We waited 1hr to start at 12am. I had leg massage and hub had body massage. They were very professional and the entire place was so clean, nice and smells good. It’s a little pricey comparing to the low end massage parlours sprouting in Bkk but the service makes up for it. A questionnaire before starting and everyone gets a little treat of mango sticky rice after the massage. Me and my hubby was given a couple room despite I was only doing foot massage. Will definitely be back next time. Rem to Make appointment to avoid disappointment

reviews.name: 宝宝季
reviews.text:
I visited this place twice. The first time, I came with my white friend,she got a Thai massage while I got a foot massage. I watched her session and it looked really good, so the next day I came back alone to try the Thai massage myself.

However, the experience I received was completely different. The therapist just went through the motions,kneading and rubbing my neck, legs, and back with none of the traditional Thai stretching techniques I had watched my friend receive the day before. I would have never known the difference if I hadn’t seen a proper session the day before n plus myself had 10+ Thai massages before.

It was clear I was being treated differently. As soon as they saw I was Chinese, they started cutting corners. When I asked for a refund, they refused. 850 baht for 60 minutes was a complete rip-off. I wish ppl would take this review seriously n don’t be fooled by their marketing stuff. A good service is standardized and well-trained service, not fooling around ppl especially tourists.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear 宝宝季,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are genuinely sorry to hear that your second visit did not meet your expectations.

At our spa, we strive to provide professional and consistent service to every guest, regardless of nationality, ethnicity, or background. We take your concern very seriously, particularly your impression that you were treated differently because you are Chinese, as this is absolutely not in line with our values or standards.

Regarding Thai massage, techniques may vary slightly depending on the therapist’s assessment of the guest’s physical condition, flexibility, and comfort level. However, we understand that your experience felt significantly different from what you observed during your friend’s session and from your previous Thai massage experiences.

We regret that we were unable to reach a satisfactory resolution during your visit. Your comments have been shared with our management team for further review and additional staff training where necessary.

We appreciate your feedback, as it helps us improve our services and ensure a better experience for all guests in the future.

Best regards,
Management Team

Have a pleasant day.

reviews.name: mas
reviews.text: Had a lovely experience at Asok Makkha Spa. Staff is very patient, kind and well trained. I had the milk bath as well, which makes my skin feel all like a baby again! :) Would definitely recommend this to my friends! <3
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are glad that you had a best massage experience during your stay. We appreciate the kind review, and we are looking forward to welcoming you back again. Have a great day!

reviews.name: Dominique Läser
reviews.text:
I had the Facial and Atoma Oil Massage Package for 120min

The atmosphere is very nice, but the Facial wasn’t good at all. Compared to other places no real facial massage and just a tone of Creams they oit on your face with no real concept.

The massage was ok but far from the best I had in Bangkok. Based on my experience I wouldn’t go again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Dominique Läser,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us.

We are pleased to hear that you enjoyed the atmosphere of our spa. However, we are genuinely sorry to learn that the Facial and Atoma Oil Massage did not meet your expectations.

Your feedback regarding the facial treatment process and the quality of the massage is highly valuable to us. We have shared your comments with the relevant team for review as we continuously strive to improve our service standards.

We sincerely apologize that your experience did not reflect the level of quality we aim to provide. Thank you again for your honest feedback, which helps us enhance our services for future guests.

Best regards,
Makkha Team

reviews.name: Essa Al Ali
reviews.text:
From the moment I stepped into MAKKHA Health & Spa, I was welcomed into a sanctuary of calm and professionalism. The ambiance is serene, the space immaculately maintained, and the attention to detail speaks volumes about the team’s commitment to excellence.

A special thank you to the staff and management—your warmth, courtesy, and skill made my experience truly exceptional. Every interaction was respectful and genuine, and the service was delivered with both precision and heart. You’ve created more than a spa—you’ve cultivated a space where guests feel valued and restored.

Highly recommended for anyone seeking not just relaxation, but a reminder of how thoughtful hospitality can elevate the entire experience. Keep up the outstanding work. You’ve earned my respect and gratitude.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for this review. We appreciate the kind words and we are thankful for choosing us. We are hoping to see you again soon. Have a nice day!

reviews.name: stephanie halim chandra
reviews.text:
I had a 60-minute Thai massage here and unfortunately it was the worst Thai massage experience I’ve had in Bangkok. The therapist clearly needs much more training.

The pressure points were completely off, the pressure was very messy and inconsistent, and the stretching and handling were extremely rough. Instead of feeling relaxed, the massage was very painful in a bad way. I’ve been to 10+ Thai massage places in Bangkok, and this one was by far the worst in terms of skill.

I almost let it go, but I woke up the next day with pain, which is why I feel I need to write this review so others are aware before going.

The place itself is clean and looks nice, but the therapist’s skill level is close to zero compared to other Thai massage places. Training quality and consistency really need to be checked and improved.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear stephanie halim chandra,
Thank you very much for taking the time to share your experience with us. We sincerely apologize for the discomfort and dissatisfaction you experienced during your Thai massage.

We are truly sorry to hear that the treatment did not meet your expectations and that you experienced pain afterward. This is certainly not the standard of service we aim to provide.

Your feedback has been taken very seriously and has been shared with our management team. We will be calling the therapist involved for further review, guidance, and additional training, as well as reinforcing our overall training standards to ensure better consistency and quality going forward.

Thank you again for your honest feedback, which is extremely valuable to us. We truly hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future and provide you with a much improved experience.
Have a pleasant day!

Best regard,
Makkha spa Team

reviews.name: Constance Kim
reviews.text:
This establishment was very clean and aesthetically pleasing. I went with my husband for a two-hour massage, and the room was very nice. It had a tub (not for use unless you purchase that package), as well as a nice shower to rinse off the oil after the massage.
They also provide mango sticky rice and a drink. I believe the cost was around $65 USD, which is on the more expensive side if you’re used to a regular Thai massage place. However, if you’re looking for somewhere nice, clean, and calming, I would definitely recommend coming here for an amazing two-hour massage!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for rating us 5-stars!
We are glad that you enjoyed your stay with us. We are looking forward to welcoming you back soon. Have a nice day!

reviews.name: Rachael Tan
reviews.text: This experience was the best I’ve ever had. The environment was so serene and clean and service was amazing. They provide a sheet of paper for you to indicate your preferences and any medical conditions to really customise the treatment for you. Before treatment, they provide a tea drink and rice cracker. After, one of the staff introduces the name of the therapist to you and the therapist addresses you by name. During treatment, she was very professional and attentive, often asking me if pressure was sufficient and adjusting accordingly. After, they offer you a plate of mango sticky rice to wrap up the treatment. It was a truly amazing experience, would definitely visit again when I’m in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the review. We are glad that you enjoyed your stay with us. Thank you for choosing us and we hope to see you again soon. Have a nice day!

reviews.name: Christina
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful 60m foot massage (600 baht) this evening. The spa is clean, the staff friendly and professional. I felt very safe and welcomed here.

My masseuse did the foot massage on a table (Thai style, I suppose). It was nice and relaxing though some parts of it (while massaging the bottom of the feet) felt slightly off the acupressure points. I would give the massage a 7.5. However, the masseuse kindness, how she addressed/focused on my area of concern and the head & shoulder massage towards the end is a 10!

The spa offered a free, small vial of oil in exchange for an honest review. This is important for me to say because they never told me that I must give them a good review / a 5* review - they just want an honest Google review, which I appreciate.

Thank you, Grand Spa. I will return 🙏❤️

reviews.name: Jay
reviews.text: Very friendly receptionist and great masseuse. I came in for a 1h long foot massage and it was so relaxing. Perfect amount of pressure and hit all the right spots after walking Chiang Rai throughout the day. All the staff was very friendly and accommodating. Had tea and snacks before and after as well. I would recommend this place and also come back

reviews.name: Ilja Oostenenk
reviews.text: This was definitely the best massage I had in Chiang Rai. From the minute you walk through the door you are greeted warmly and professionally, and never rushed. The whole salon is very clean, and feels serene and peaceful. I received my luminous massage from Ying, and she was amazing. You receive a welcome drink, and also a warm tea and cookie when you're done, which are lovely extras. I do not hesitate to recommend this spa to anyone!

reviews.name: Esme Lisanne
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience, and would highly recommend! Wonderful massage, lovely and friendly staff and a very comfortable venue. Best massage I have had in a long time. Thank you, and hope we can come back again in the future!

reviews.name: Ward Bal
reviews.text: Me and my friend went for a scrub and massage. Very friendly receptionist. The two therapists were very gentle, kind and very professional and knew exactly what they were doing. I’d come again when in Chiang Rai. Thank you for a great experience!

reviews.name: Netnapha Win
reviews.text: We were around town when we stumbled upon this massage parlour. Both husband and I requested for 1 hour foot massage and was greeted with a welcome drink and cold towel! The skills of the masseuse was impeccable and the pressure was just right! We love that they gave us a private room too! Will highly recommended!

reviews.name: Tara Lhamo
reviews.text: We had Thai massage for an hour. It was a great and feel painless afterwords. Service is great and they are very experienced in massage and were focused on the area that I have requested.

reviews.name: Purcellclan
reviews.text: Amazing Thai massage. Very friendly staff, clean and felt great afterwards. Very professional. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Sam The man
reviews.text:
After trying several other in the area it was ok but a little bit over price and not as exciting as the other we’ve done in the area but if he would have be 400 for an hour and 600 for 1.5hr he would have been 4 star since the small attention for starter was there.

I took a Swedish massage (90 min at 1300 baht each person ) the special attention we had was ( the choice of 4 different oils ,shower in the room for after massage, privated room for 2 guess with my wife, confortable table for massage ) and i Got Nancy and my Wife got Daisy. 7/10 for massage 10/10 for the location, for the local: from the entrance 10/10 after the entrance 6/10. Quality price 6-7/10

I hope it will help

reviews.name: Sandy Lan Hing Ting
reviews.text: It was an amazing experience. The foot and head massage were very relaxing and the staff very extremely nice and welcoming. Definitely recommend and will visit again when in Chang Rai.

reviews.name: Lucy-906 Bro
reviews.text:
Had the most amazing scrub and oil massage here, I picked my favourite scrub and oil. The staff are so lovely and the massage tables are comfortable, the rooms are very clean and tidy.
Highly recommend 🙏

reviews.name: Jodi Webb
reviews.text: We had an amazing and throughly relaxing time with a one hour Thai massage. It was our first one so we didn’t know what to expect but we loved it! Thankyou.

reviews.name: Lorenza Minini
reviews.text: We booked on the spot for 30 minutes later, very helpful staff to find the place for a one-hour massage for two people. Excellent reception, friendly staff, as soon as we arrived we were welcomed with a cold tea. The massage was beautiful, rejuvenating! Medium pressure throughout the body rejoiced! At the end of the massage we were delighted with hot tea and a cereal biscuit. Recommend! Value for money 5 stars!

reviews.name: Nataliya Gavrilenko
reviews.text: Very good experience , we took a package of a Bose polish and the oil massage. My therapist was Pookie and she is brilliant , good pressure but very careful at the  same time. Taking a star off for the facility itself. But still very pleasant  experience overall. Would recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Grand Spa would like to sincerely thank our valued customers from the bottom of our hearts for being impressed with our service. We will continue to strive for improvement and hope to serve you again in the future. With respect.

reviews.name: nelson torresmon
reviews.text: A relaxing and very professional massage! I have felt very well cared for. Respect and professionalism distinguish the Place and service!

Dear Nelson Torresmon, 

Grand spa Chiang Rai team would like to thank you very much for using our service and your all 5/5 review score of our spa. reviews.name: Thiha TK
reviews.text: Excellent Service! Honestly, it was the most comfortable massage that I ever Had. Thank you for your professional service! Will come to the shop for sure!

reviews.name: Elizabeth Sanchez
reviews.text: Grand spa was incredible! From the friendliness of the staff to the actual massage! I would definitely recommend! Reju was incredible and super nice!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Grand Spa extends its gratitude for your enjoyment of our signature menu. We hope to serve you again in the future.

reviews.name: Foua Xiong
reviews.text: I got a facial. It was do relaxing that I fell asleep. I like the complimentary drink and cookie. Face looks bright and clean.

reviews.name: Aloysius Goh
reviews.text: Easy to reserve appointment on google. Staff is polite and well versed in English. Place is clean and quiet. Very tranquil and have private room for couple, including shower facilities which is good and convenient for a place like Chiang Rai.

title: TREASURE Spa & Massage @BTS Siam - SQ1
ownerDescription: Treasure Spa - recognized by guests with TripAdvisor Travelers' Choice 2026 and 2025. Boutique Thai wellness spa, Floor 6 Siam Square One, two minutes from BTS Siam. Traditional Thai therapists, private rooms, where Bangkok's pace slows the moment you step inside. The Gentle Head Spa - a deeply relaxing scalp and hair ritual most guests have never experienced before. Our Scrub and Aroma program - scrub, shower, and full body massage - leaves you genuinely restored. Curated treatments built on craft, refined over time. Signature programs from a single session to a full half-day. Couples packages available. Pre-booking recommended - same-day bookings subject to availability.
address: Siam Square One, Floor 6 Room SS6009, 388 Rama I Rd, Bangkok 10330, Thailand
street: Siam Square One, Floor 6 Room SS6009, 388 Rama I Rd

reviews.name: sultan alfalasi
reviews.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at TREASURE Spa & Massage @BTS Siam - SQ1. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt calm, luxurious, and very welcoming. The place is super clean, beautifully designed, and smells amazing which instantly helps you relax.

The staff were professional, friendly, and really experienced. The massage itself was incredible they knew exactly how to relieve stress and muscle tension. I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and full of positive energy.

The location is also very convenient near BTS Siam, making it easy to visit after a long day of walking or shopping. Definitely one of the best spa experiences I’ve had in Bangkok, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for quality massage and relaxation.

reviews.name: misc
reviews.text: The service from beginning to end was amazing. Their rooms are peaceful and quiet. The calming music and soothing lighting makes it feel more relaxing. The entire spa has clean facilities, professional staff, and a relaxing atmosphere that leaves you completely refreshed. I recommend that you do not pass on this one.

reviews.name: Sazrina
reviews.text:
I booked this head spa treatment expecting relaxation, but I didn’t expect to fall asleep almost immediately!

The therapist has incredibly strong hands and the pressure was perfect—firm, thorough, and exactly what my tired scalp needed. I was so comfortable that I basically slept through most of the session.

When I woke up at the end, my scalp felt unbelievably clean and refreshed. The best way I can describe it is that my whole head felt lighter. The massage, cleansing, and overall experience were amazing.

If a treatment can knock me out and leave me feeling this refreshed afterward, that’s probably the highest compliment I can give. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Lisa Harris
reviews.text:
Do it!  Such a great head spa.
A luxury experience in hair/ head & relaxation.
&
This was very Special family spa time!

Quality spaces, staff were highly skilled, quality products used, very good blow wave and style at the end, I’m feeling the effects days afterwards and so glad we went.

So many lovely personal touches by the team.
Highly enjoyed.

reviews.name: Kass R
reviews.text: Amazing experience! Place was clean and pretty. They were very welcoming once I got here. I got the call treatment. Loved how they had plants in the washing station. The dry Thai  massage was better than I expected! I was also going to be late than my original appointment and they were flexible and able to change my time. Even gave a nice little treat after! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Soso “Soso” Life
reviews.text: One of the highlights of our stay in Bangkok. Warm welcome, spotless private room, and an incredibly relaxing scalp massage — I fell asleep. The waterfall wash left my hair soft and shiny, and the blow-dry at the end was perfect. Excellent value and a lovely team. Highly recommend, we’ll be back.

reviews.name: Kristin MW
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my Deep Tissue Massage with Ann. The room was really peaceful with nice music. I was in a private room with a sink and shower and safe for belongings if you want to use it. I requested firm and it was very good. The receptionist was very nice also. I was a morning walk in and they were able to accommodate me. 6th floor, use the elevator. If you come on BTS at Siam stop, use exit #4. Easy to get to.

reviews.name: Tif
reviews.text: Had a wonderful prenatal massage experience! The therapist was gentle, professional, and made me feel comfortable throughout the session. My back and hip pain felt much better afterwards. Highly recommend for any expecting mum looking to relax and relieve pregnancy aches!

reviews.name: Naamphuenk Unyarat Intharaprasit
reviews.text:
I really liked this place. The atmosphere was very well thought out, and I felt relaxed as soon as I walked in. It felt very different from the busy city outside. The place was clean, quiet, and comfortable.

The massage was really good. The therapist was professional, attentive, and used the right pressure. Overall, the service was very nice and I felt much lighter after the treatment. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Larry Cortez
reviews.text: Want a full body experience that is really good, well the Treasure Spa & Massage at Siam is the place to go. Yes there are thousands of places to get a massage for foot or shoulders, there are massages for full body and even just the hands. However, where can you get a scalp treatment, foot treatment, body scrub with lemongrass and a lavender warm oil massage? This package had all of this. Cost is worth it since this is Thailand. The staff are very nice and understand english very well. Everyone is cordial and always asking how you are and how was the experience. The rooms are clean quiet and comfortable. Located in the Siam building across from the mall next to the BTS Siam. Up on the 5th? floor top floor this location is worth visiting. First you fill out a sheet that tells them what areas to work on or pay attention to then you are ushered into a quiet room and they dim the lights and leave so you can dress into the appropriate sheer cloth. You ring the little bell and the masseuse enters and starts. You try not to nod off and fall asleep because the massage is so relaxing but you do want to be aware of the oil aroma that she'll cover you with. The whole treatment is wonderful. Highly Recommended!

reviews.name: Sean Knickerson Delubiar
reviews.text: Went for the Forest Calm package for 60 minutes. Everything looked clean and calming. The staff are respectful and accommodating. The massage felt great and helps me sleep easily. I recommend this place, the price is worth it.

reviews.name: Angga Adhitya Fritz Aradhana
reviews.text: Just had one of the best Head Spas! Located in the sixth floor of Siam Square One (another mall opposite of Siam Paragon), the Spa offers a range of treatment, with the Gentle Head Spa as the signature. 60 minutes is 1,500 Thai Baht—totally worth it!

reviews.name: Ragul Thiyagarajah
reviews.text: So professional and courteous. Must try out if you are in Bangkok for the head spa ever. I was welcomed and explained what are the steps in the spa. My hair feels different and soft after the spa. My therapist was exceptional—professional, attentive, and incredibly skilled. She had the perfect touch, knowing exactly how to release all the built-up tension in my scalp, neck, and shoulders.

reviews.name: Tiger Yotsawat
reviews.text:
Really relaxing experience here. Did the Gentle Care 90 mins programme.

Really good quality shoulder massage, just the right pressure and hitting all the right spots.

The head spa was good too although water temperature might have been a little cold at some point. Or it felt a little cold when the water stopped. However, you end up with perfect looking hair afterwards.

Come here every morning if you want your hair looking perfect for the rest of the day ;)

reviews.name: Kent S
reviews.text: Great service from Jeb right from the start at the reception and not forgetting my massage therapist Pui who is not only amazing but highly skilled. I don’t often fall asleep during a massage session but her masterful skills and the right amount of pressure and force helped relieve my stiff shoulder and it was so comfortable throughout the whole session. Highly recommended and will definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Yasmin Anderson
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience at Treasure Hair Spa. From the moment I arrived, the staff were welcoming, professional, and attentive. The atmosphere was relaxing and beautifully presented, making it easy to unwind.

The head spa treatment itself was exceptional. The scalp massage was incredibly relaxing, and my hair felt noticeably healthier, softer, and refreshed afterwards. The staff took their time and made sure every part of the experience was enjoyable and comfortable.

If you’re looking for a high-quality hair spa experience with excellent service and a peaceful environment, I would highly recommend Treasure Hair Spa

reviews.name: Anastasiia Primak
reviews.text: I had such a relaxing experience at Treasure Spa Bangkok. The head spa treatment was incredibly calming and professional from the oil massage to the hydro therapy. My hair feels soft and refreshed. The staff were very attentive and the atmosphere was beautiful. Highly recommend 🤍

reviews.name: Sammy
reviews.text: Got my 1st head massage/treatment, it was amazing. Great amount of pressure I chose medium and was very relaxing. Once I was done I was treated to some mango and tea! Would recommend!

reviews.name: Adan Switat
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience at Treasure Spa & Salon. My body scrub was fantastic, and the staff were so friendly and professional. Thank you for the wonderful service. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.name: Jenny
reviews.text: Third time here! Got a warm oil massage and it was such a lovely experience. This place feels underrated. My therapist was incredibly sweet and made me feel so comfortable throughout. Relaxing yet still relieving muscle tension. Would recommend!

title: City of Massage
ownerDescription:
Finding massage near you? Experience an exceptional collection of facial, body and beauty treatments with Thainess vibe at City Of Massage. we located just in the heart of Bangkok. Opposite to Central World Shopping mall, Near Go-Ang Pratunam Chicken Rice and 7-11. Near Platunam, R walk(Ratchaprasong).

Inspired by the Asian mythical and amazing culture, visit us and get your urban spa retreat where ancient traditions meet Modern systems.

Our services: Thai massage, foot massage, body scrub, hot oil massage, and more. Check out now at City of Massage Bangkok!

ร้านนวดใกล้เซนทรัลเวิร์ด City of Massage ที่คุณต้องลอง พบกับคอร์สนวดสปา ผ่อนคลายแบบสุดๆจากผู้เชี่ยวชาญ จองเลย!
address: 23 Ratchadamri Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

reviews.name: Mehdi Khani
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience at this massage center before heading to the airport. It was the perfect way to end our trip to Bangkok.

A special thank you to Mai and Sao, who took care of me and my wife. They were incredibly skilled, professional, and so kind throughout the entire session. Their attention to detail and warm hospitality made us feel completely relaxed.

The experience became even more memorable when they served us a delicious traditional dessert and a wonderfully fragrant cup of tea after the massage. It was such a thoughtful and lovely way to end our visit.

Everything was clean, peaceful, and welcoming. We left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and very happy. We highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Bangkok. Thank you, Mai and Sao, for making the end of our trip so special. We will definitely come back on our next visit!

reviews.name: G M
reviews.text:
Big thank you to Indy for the amazing massage! Apart from the massage salon being convienently located right beside Big C and along the sky walk, as well as clean and calm, what makes a difference is the masseur! Indy is very meticulous and thorough with her massage and very importantly knowing how to read and react to customer’s body signal! I have personally been to Panpuri and Healthland frequently, its nice to see a smaller salon like this being equally consistent in their steps!

Gonna be back for more massage!

reviews.name: onqqstuffies
reviews.text:
Great Targeted Relief at Siam City of Massage
We stopped by Siam City of Massage in Bangkok for their one-hour Office Syndrome package, focusing on the back, neck, and shoulders. Overall, it was a solid experience that provided much-needed tension relief.
The standouts were definitely the therapists. My therapist, Tik, and my friend’s therapist, Kai, were both very professional and skilled at targeting deep knots. The pressure and technique were spot on. In fact, my friend was so impressed by Kai's work that she kept wishing she could go back for another session even a full week after we left Bangkok.
If you're dealing with neck and shoulder tightness, it's worth a visit, and we would certainly consider going back on our next trip to Bangkok.

reviews.name: AZ BEAN
reviews.text:
I normally avoid massage places in tourist areas because they tend to be overpriced and average. But this time, I was pleasantly surprised.

City Massage, near CentralWorld Bangkok, gave me one of the best foot massages I've had. The trick is to tell the therapist exactly what you want. Once I explained where to focus and how much pressure I preferred, the whole experience was a game changer.

If you don't say anything, they'll usually just follow their standard routine, which didn't really work for me. But after I spoke up, the massage was excellent.

So don't be shy—tell them what you want, and you'll probably leave much happier than I did on my first visit. 👍🦶

reviews.name: Koko JIN
reviews.text: Really enjoyed the massage here! Sopha and Na were both lovely and very professional. They made us feel comfortable and relaxed, and the massage was perfect for a relaxing afternoon break. We left feeling refreshed and recharged.

reviews.name: Gio
reviews.text: We visited this shop last night on the strength of the reviews. As in every other shop, it is hit and miss.  No guaranteed good massage at all.  We all had a full body hour massage and each one had a different experience.  All of us concur our experience from a shop that is not too far is better.  This shop don’t have hawker’s trying to grab every passers by.  Won’t come back, i’m afraid but still massive thank you to the polite staff.

reviews.name: HappyBunny
reviews.text:
I was in the area and decided to see if I could get a massage before my seafood buffet dinner. It was very busy when I walked in but luckily I was able to get my Thai massage with herbal press for 90 mins (750 bhat cash only). The receptionist was very friendly and asked if I'd like to go to the toilet first. I thought that was very considerate - better than other more expensive massage places I've been.

The masseur was excellent - probably my best thai massage so far. I was very impressed. The herbal press smelled lovely but it was occasionally too hot on the skin. Overall, the massage had a great combination of proper work out (Thai bit) and relaxation (herbal press).

However, the masseur finished 7 mins earlier. Nevertheless, I was surprised that there was a nice treat waiting for me. The lovely frensh coconut water with tea and biscuit. Really love the quenching coconut water - it was exactly what I needed!

I will be back again! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Rachelle Toh
reviews.text: Walked by this massage centre and checked, the review looks good. So just give it a try for the 90-min back & shoulder massage at 600baht. 70mins out of 90mins, the lady used her elbow to massage and now my shoulder is getting more pain for the whole night till now (the next day). And while using her elbow, she will use her body weight to press on my back, and she is actually quite a big size lady. Maybe the good review is for their foot massage because there are alot of them and the staff cant use their elbow on the foot. Please read this before you decide what massage to choose

reviews.text: I have been twice it really depends which massage you pick. In the busy timings they would say they cannot accommodate you if you pick the package which costs less then 1000 bath. The lady wasn’t helpful and she didn’t want to book my later visit she said come and try but what if’s not available I wouldn’t waste the time coming if I am not sure if you could accommodate me. reviews.name: Li za
reviews.text: The therapist Sopha Cwas incredibly skilled and attentive. It was such a relaxing and rejuvenating session. I felt completely at ease throughout the entire treatment. She was so good at addressing all my tense areas. I would highly recommend this service to anyone seeking a great massage. It was truly a highlight of my week.

reviews.name: i Zam
reviews.text: Had a relaxing experience by Masseur Jane. Attentive to my needs. The place is clean and they gave a cold coconut juice at the end of the massage.

reviews.name: Liyan Kian
reviews.text:
Been to Bangkok countless times, and with City of Massage located at such a prominent location, I can’t believe I’ve been missing out all this while. Why didn’t I patronize this place on my past trips here? City of Massage offers one of the best massages I’ve ever had in Bangkok!

We walked in at 10:30pm and it was already packed.  It is a clear sign of how popular it is. Even with a 35-minute wait, it was completely worth it. From the moment my therapist began the 90-minute Head-to-Toe massage I chose, I could tell that this place has some standard in place.

Im typing this review while doing the massage. The massage is incredible! My therapist - Jab was skilled, knowing exactly how to target the pressure points and ease away all the tension, especially those knots I had on my shoulder for the longest time. It was honestly one of the best massages I’ve ever experienced, and I can’t recommend City of Massage highly enough!

Setback - The salon is located right next to the main road hence it can be disturbing.  Nevertheless, the good massage can make up for this!!

reviews.name: hiuman fung
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had an amazing massage session with Pha, and I highly recommend her services! As a professional massage therapist, she has a fantastic understanding of the body and applies the perfect amount of pressure to target tight muscles without causing discomfort. My legs and shoulders feel so much better—relaxed and rejuvenated. Pha is skilled, attentive, and creates a calming atmosphere. I’ll definitely be back! Thank you for the excellent service!

reviews.text:
Great massage and definitely worth coming back! I’ve been here more than twice now, and I really feel that the full-body massage is the best value for money. It’s genuinely relaxing and a great way to unwind.

For the foot massage, just keep in mind that you may hear loud music from the nearby bars and clubs. If you don’t mind the noise, it’s totally fine. Overall, highly recommended!

reviews.name: Debashree G
reviews.text: Massage was good but not that exceptional as to what the reviews said. We had better massages recently. We paid 1300 Baht for a Thai massge with heat compress for 2 of us and found the receptionist blunt. There was no discount as we took for 60 minutes, discount is only applicable for longer massage (90 mins and above). The parlour was clean and Fha, my masseuse was a sweet lady who kept asking if the pressure was okay and if I was comfortable. She later on even offered tea as she knew I had some bodypain going on.

reviews.name: Mubin Mohammed
reviews.text: Hands down one of the best massages I’ve ever got in my life. Day 1 in Bkk me n wife booked the 90 min aromatherapy and it was bliss. Next day I went for the foot, neck, shoulder massage. Amazing again! Ann was my masseuse… she is just brilliant! Knows exactly how to tackle pain and relax your muscles at the same time! Highly recommended!!

reviews.text: Reasonable priced massages with discounts offered before 6pm. The place is clean and the ladies apply serious pressure 😂. It’s not a place to relax, the whole experience is in fact rushed because they want to assist as many patrons as possible. It’s good enough for the stretch your body needs to keep up with the travelling after long flights etc.

reviews.name: Nikita Agrawal
reviews.text: Tooooooo expensive. They need to invest some earned money in infrastructure mainly the upper floor where expensive massages happen. The pics you see are from the finely built ground floor. The massage was fine but it was charged alot for both of us. I wont recommend. There are way better places than this.

reviews.name: Yvonne E
reviews.text:
Did not have a good experience there.  It was nothing like all the rave reviews on google.
We were a party of 4.
They started out with a foot scrub with tepid water.  I wish the water was hotter.
Then we went upstairs to rooms for the massage.  There were no massage tables with an opening for your face.  We laid on a mattress on the floor.  When I left my neck hurt from laying on my belly with my face on its side.  I'm sure she knew how uncomfortable I was because I kept moving and she finally brought me a folded towel to put my head on.  Slightly better but still uncomfortable position for a massage for 2 hours.

When we left, I saw massage tables.  I wish I had known.  Perhaps our party was too large for them to put all of us on a table.
A member of our party had to request a different masseuse and they offered to switch her with another member of our party.  She kept pressing on her spine and did not stop even though she was asked to.  She said no, she's not good why would I want to give her to another member of our party.
I am sure the masseuse worked up a sweat. By the end it was so freezing in the room I was shaking and discombobulated by the awful experience.  Go around the corner to the Rain massage place.  100% better.

reviews.name: BhataktiAatmaWasHere
reviews.text:
Tucked right in the heart of Sukhumvit’s famously… lively red-light district, Thai Thai Massage was one of those places I approached with a raised eyebrow and a slightly overactive imagination. But curiosity (and tired feet) won — and I’m glad it did.

First things first: any hesitation melted away the moment I walked in. The place is clean, calm, and refreshingly no-nonsense — a little oasis of sanity in a neighbourhood that’s anything but subtle. If anything, the surrounding buzz makes it feel oddly discreet, like a well-kept secret hiding in plain sight.

The therapists? Absolute pros. They somehow struck that magical balance between “this is relaxing” and “wow, I didn’t know that muscle existed.” The pressure was spot on, and the whole experience felt polished yet unpretentious. The staff were polite, efficient, and didn’t try to upsell every five minutes — always a win.

Thai Thai Massage turned out to be the kind of place you almost don’t want to recommend too loudly — not because there’s anything wrong with it, but because you’d quite like it to stay exactly as it is: reliable, low-key, and just a little bit unexpected.

reviews.name: EatSleepPlay
reviews.text:
Great massage place. Clean and pleasant. Offers a discount before 6pm, so it fairly affordable.

The massage as properly done a bit more detailed on the head and back massage which was great.

Edit - I came back here for a full body massage and it was great. I spotted that they had this tiger balm massage (which replaces normal massage oils) and went for it as I am pretty active and appreciate tiger balm. It was great. Unique product. Props to the team for this .

reviews.name: Jenn CruznWant
reviews.text: Amazing scrub and massage! The staff were friendly and the experience was so relaxing. My skin was amazing after the scrub massage! I would definitely come back to this parlour. Very professional and clean.

reviews.name: Brittany Glasnow
reviews.text: I have been to other Thai Thai locations that are better,  this one is in a very wild and lively night life area so not very relaxing. We went at 1030pm and it felt that the massage therapists were less skilled, felt like the same thing over and over and was very firm pressure, not always equal attention to both sides of the body.

reviews.name: Ebonne Ugbo
reviews.text: We went to Thai Thai Massage near our hotel right after our flight, and it was amazing! The massage was so relaxing that we both fell asleep during it. The service was excellent, and the place was spotless, with a beautiful, minimalistic aesthetic that made us feel instantly at ease. Highly recommend for anyone looking to unwind in a clean, calming space with top-notch service!

reviews.text: Absolutely not recommended. The masseuse is not much experienced. What's weird is that the rooms only had some bedding on the floor. This cannot be a professional thai massage place. How can you not have a proper massage bed with a face hole? Also the masseuse laughing at your pain is not a good feeling. Take this from a health professional: Avoid this place. Paying for a 90 minute massage was an absolute mistake and it was surely overpriced.

reviews.name: Lee Cheong Tai
reviews.text:
Here is a positive review for the THAI THAI Massage parlor in Bangkok, Thailand:

"I had an amazing experience at THAI THAI Massage during my recent visit to Bangkok. The spa is located in a convenient and central part of the city, making it easy to find and access.

Upon arrival, I was warmly greeted by the friendly staff who provided excellent customer service. They guided me through the check-in process seamlessly and made sure I felt comfortable throughout my visit.

The massage itself was exceptional. The therapists were highly skilled and intuitive, tailoring the massage technique to my specific needs. I opted for a traditional Thai massage and was impressed by how rejuvenated and relaxed I felt afterwards.

The facilities were clean, modern, and well-maintained. The treatment rooms provided a serene and tranquil environment perfect for unwinding.

Overall, I cannot recommend THAI THAI Massage enough. It is the perfect spot to indulge in an authentic Thai massage experience while in Bangkok. I left feeling refreshed, renewed, and will definitely be returning on my next trip to the city."

reviews.name: Tia Puthran
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed with the service.

I had clearly asked for a foot massage and even double-checked if it included neck and shoulder. The lady at the reception confirmed it did. But instead, they gave me only neck and shoulder, completely skipping the foot massage.

My husband and I were waiting the whole time for the foot massage to follow — it never came. And when I asked about it, they casually said, “Your one hour is up. You’ll need to pay more.”

It was already closing time, and instead of acknowledging their mistake, all they kept repeating was “pay more”.
No empathy, no ownership.

All I wanted — even just a 10-minute foot massage to ease my sore feet — and they refused. Absolutely unprofessional and careless service.

Would not recommend unless they fix their communication and customer handling.

reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I visited together and had quite different experiences with the massage.

His therapist was very attentive .he checked if the water temperature for the foot wash was comfortable, used warm water, and regularly asked if the pressure was okay during the massage. He also helped him stretch a lot, which made him feel very relaxed and satisfied.

Unfortunately, my experience was not as comfortable. The foot wash felt rushed and the water was still cold. During the massage, my hair was accidentally rubbed several times, and at some points the therapist’s nails scratched my skin a little. Compared with my boyfriend’s session, there was also much less stretching involved.

I understand different therapists may have different massage styles, so perhaps this is normal. Still, because we were having the same type of massage at the same time, the difference in experience was quite noticeable.

That said, the staff were polite overall and the atmosphere was nice.

reviews.textTranslated: Clean, convenient, and not crowded. They have both large and small rooms to choose from. I think it's not too far from Don Mueang Airport; a Grab ride costs around 176-224฿, which is a good distance. There's a coffee bar, breakfast includes coffee, Ovaltine, and bread, and there's parking available, which is quite convenient. Plus, there's a spa downstairs! I recommend the "exfoliating scrub" treatment for only 890฿ (less than 1000฿) for a 2-hour massage (including the scrubbing time). I loved it! Or if you have aches and pains, they have a Thai massage and foot massage area, but you have to walk down towards the parking lot; it's in the same corner, about two buildings away. It's separate for Thai massage, foot massage, and more. It's great for those staying for several days. Delivery is available for everything, and the food in this area is excellent, especially the grilled prawns. We ordered through Grab and got a discount, reducing the price from over 500฿ to just over 360฿ for huge grilled prawns! Give it a try! 😊👍🏻

The staircase from the 1st floor was littered with dust and hair; there was no sign of sweeping or cleaning. The room itself was old and run-down. The bidet was leaking, dripping water all night. The walls were quite thin; we could hear outside noises clearly. We could hear doors opening and closing or cars driving by.

reviews.name: Koushik Krishna
reviews.text:
Please don’t judge based on the fact that its on a narrow gully, the space inside was large and had more rooms.
It was actually very clean and tidy. The masseuses were quite professional. They had different packages available there, we chose the first one (I don’t remember the exact term).
We went in as a couple. They started with washing our foot, then took us to 1st floor where where they have like 10-20 beds.
Put us both on 2 separate massage beds adjacent to each other with 2 separate masseuses. It was a full body massage and it was done to the maximum professionalism possible.
We had chosen to take different oils for massage. Also they actually take like away 90% of the oil away once done with the massage. Don't worry if you are planning to go out right afterwards.
I’ll tell you the highlighted part. Basically for the 60 minutes package we took, we were given massage for the entire time. They hardly took 30-50 seconds break.
Definitely worth a try. This was the first time for me to get a massage ever, so Iam giving a 4 star. I would probably collect more experience and review this further later.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are truly grateful for your thoughtful review. At Sansabai Massage1, our team works with great care and dedication to ensure each guest leaves feeling refreshed and renewed — and feedback like yours reminds us why we do what we do. We hope to have the pleasure of your company again in the near future.

Sansabai Massage in Phuket provides a satisfying and effective experience. The 90-minute Thai massage by Aun was well-executed. He demonstrated good skill and applied the right amount of pressure throughout the session, which helped relieve physical tension.
The treatment left me feeling noticeably more relaxed afterward. For those seeking a reliable and straightforward traditional massage, this is a practical and dependable choice.

Our team works hard to provide quality service and a relaxing environment for every guest. We hope to welcome you back again soon!

reviews.name: Tino Richter, Local Guide
reviews.text:
We had a very positive experience at Sansabai Massage & Spa in Patong. From the start, everything felt professional and well organised.

I had a Aloe Vera massage and later a Thai deep issue massage both were excellent performed.

Prices are clearly displayed on detailed service menus, covering traditional Thai massage, oil massage, aroma therapy, foot massage, body scrubs, spa packages, as well as beauty services such as manicure, pedicure, nail extensions and eyelash extensions. This level of transparency immediately builds trust.

The front desk is managed by a very professional lady who also appears to be the lead manager. She explained the services clearly, offered helpful advice based on our needs, and did not apply any pressure or upselling. We were admitted quickly to our appointment without any waiting time.

The facilities are clean, well maintained, and pleasantly scented. Before the treatment, foot washing is included free of charge, with clean sinks, fresh towels and proper hygiene standards. Complimentary drinking water is provided, and personal belongings are handled responsibly, with reminders to double-check items before leaving.

The massage rooms are quiet, well sound-isolated, and air-conditioned with a comfortable temperature throughout the session. The massage beds are sturdy and clean, and the overall atmosphere is calm and relaxing.

In addition to the massage area, there is also a separate spa salon located next door, offering a more spa-style environment with comfortable seating and additional treatments, which is a great option for guests looking for extended relaxation.

Overall, this is a reliable, transparent, and professionally run massage and spa location in Patong. High hygiene standards, clear pricing, friendly management, and a calm atmosphere make it easy to recommend. I would definitely return.

reviews.name: Scott Theggie
reviews.text:
My wife and I had the best massage we've ever experienced at Sansabai Massage, and we can't recommend them highly enough!

We were looked after by Lucky and Pai, and they were absolutely amazing. Their professionalism, skill, and friendly service made the whole experience incredibly relaxing.

My wife originally asked for a Hot Stone Massage, but they recommended the Hot Herbal Compress Massage instead, explaining that it would be more comfortable and relaxing. They were absolutely right—my wife said it was one of the most relaxing massages she's ever had! Even though the Hot Herbal Compress Massage is normally more expensive, they didn't charge us any extra, which was such a thoughtful gesture.

The experience was so good that we've been back two days in a row, and we'll definitely be visiting again before we leave Phuket.

If you're looking for an outstanding massage in Phuket, do yourself a favour and visit Sansabai Massage. Ask for Lucky and Pai—you won't be disappointed!

We had the most amazing couples massage at Thai Thai Sukhumvit 11! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was calming and welcoming. The staff was incredibly professional and attentive, making sure we were comfortable the entire time.

The massage itself was absolutely perfect,relaxing, rejuvenating, and exactly what we needed. Every detail, from the pressure to the techniques used, was spot on. You can tell they really care about providing a high-quality experience.
