reviews.name: Alexander Cillan
reviews.text:
Our most premium massage experience in 45 days in Thailand.

It’s definitely more expensive than the average massage places, but you can immediately feel the difference in quality. The therapists are clearly more professional and well trained, and the whole process feels much more refined and intentional.

The place itself is super clean, well maintained, and very comfortable, which adds a lot to the overall experience. The staff were also friendly, welcoming, and always smiling, making everything feel even more enjoyable.

I’d highly recommend trying at least one massage here during your trip, just to experience what it feels like when everything is done properly.

Totally worth it.

reviews.name: Aruun Thavabalan
reviews.text:
I don’t usually leave negative reviews, but I take massages seriously because I book them to relax and unwind. Unfortunately, this turned out to be the worst massage experience I’ve ever had.

My fiancé and I made a reservation in advance. I booked the 90-minute 5-in-1 package (head, neck, shoulders, hands and feet), while my fiancé booked a 90-minute foot massage. We arrived on time, made payment, and were assigned our respective masseuses, who began with the usual foot wash.

Unfortunately, the experience went downhill from there.

1. Most of the session was spent on one leg.
The masseuse spent almost 60 minutes massaging only my left leg. Throughout the session, the pressure was extremely light, and she appeared to be dozing off on several occasions. Instead of feeling relaxed, I was left feeling frustrated.

2. They realised an hour into the massage that they had assigned the wrong treatment.
About 60 minutes into the session, both my fiancé and I realised that our treatments had been mixed up. The masseuse assigned to me had been treating me as though I had booked a foot massage, when I had actually booked the 5-in-1 package. Once she realised the mistake, she rushed through my right leg in about five minutes before moving on to my head and shoulders.

3. Parts of the package were completely missed.
Despite paying for the 5-in-1 package, my hands were not massaged at all. She only did a brief head and shoulder massage before ending the session.

I genuinely tried to be understanding throughout the experience. I can imagine the masseuses may be overworked, and I believe management should seriously look into staffing and workload. Overworking employees not only affects their wellbeing but also compromises the quality of service customers are paying for.

I’m incredibly disappointed because I came here expecting to leave feeling refreshed, but instead I left feeling frustrated and shortchanged. Based on my experience, I would advise others to visit with caution.

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience at Thai Thai Massage on Sukhumvit 11! We did the 90-minute couples aromatherapy massage and it was honestly one of the best massages we’ve ever had. The ambiance was so peaceful, relaxing, and beautifully set up from the moment we walked in. The staff were incredibly kind, welcoming, and professional, making us feel comfortable the entire time. The massage itself was perfect — relaxing, soothing, and exactly what we needed. The location is also super convenient and easy to get to in Sukhumvit. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a relaxing couples experience in Bangkok!

reviews.text:
Beautiful, spotlessly clean facility and comfortable rooms with private shower. I would give it five stars only if the massage wasn’t so light / soft. We got there quite late—so I can only assume the lady massaging me was falling asleep or tired. I had to explain to go harder on certain areas and to stop lightly pulling my hair/touching my head without technique. There were constant pauses during my massage. I honestly felt really bad for she seemed exhausted and it was difficult for me to complain mid way; but I paid decent money to come here. After complaining, she did much better and the last 20 minutes felt great. She was experienced but I couldn’t tell until I complained.

I can only hope this establishment treats their staff well. Service was superb by everyone but could tell how busy and fatigued they all were. I hate to say it but I’ve had many better and cheaper massages 😭

Regardless, Thanks kindly for serving us well 🙏 Hope this honest review can help support improvements.

My trip ends in the morning, but I returned to Bangkok, independent of my friends, a day early to get another 90 minute session with Tar!

I can't speak for anyone else, but Tar is EVERYTHING. The location is perfect. And the service, atmosphere, ambiance, cleanliness and decor are top tier. TOP TIER!! SET APART! There is no one sitting outside with signs and thirst. Just a beautiful center located within the heart of everything with wonderful, welcoming ladies and even at least one gentleman waiting to answer any questions and assist you. I travel pretty frequently, but I KNOW I'll be back sooner than later for a few more sessions with my new sister and healer, Tar. From the first step in to the last step out, expect nothing less than excellence. A 90 minute Thai with balm is the perfect send-off! I feel amazing!!

A well-deserved 5 stars — I will definitely be returning on my next visit to Sukhumvit!

reviews.name: Natda CT
reviews.text:
The staff here provided exceptional service with a friendly demeanor and demonstrated impressive massage skills that made my experience truly enjoyable. The ambiance of your establishment is incredibly relaxing, which contributed to my overall satisfaction.

Upon my arrival, I was welcomed with a refreshing cold towel and a glass of cold water, which was a lovely touch.

However,i was informed that the massage room behind the cashier counter had an air conditioning issue, making it warmer than I would have preferred. While it was still bearable, it could enhance the experience even more if it was cooler.

Additionally, I suggest placing a visible sign regarding silence or no phone conversations in the massage area. During my visit, a guest spoke loudly on her phone in Chinese with the speaker on !! ? for about 3-5 minutes, which was quite disruptive to the serene environment and other guests looking to unwind.

Overall, my experience was wonderful, and I appreciate the great service provided. Thank you for considering my suggestions for improvement!

reviews.name: brenda chan
reviews.text:
I do not understand how this spa location has a 4.9-star rating.

I paid for a 90-minute deep tissue massage, but for about 60 minutes the therapist was using only her elbows to massage me. When I finally asked if she could use her fingers instead, she told me that her fingers “have no power.” She offered to change to a male therapist, which I agreed to, but in the end the male therapist was not available. As a result, I decided to stop the massage at the 60-minute mark. To be fair, the therapist had a good attitude and was apologetic that she could not perform the massage using her fingers.

The 90-minute session was on promotion for 1,510 THB. Based on this price, 60 minutes would be 1,000 THB, so the refund for the remaining 30 minutes should have been 510 THB. However, when processing the refund, the staff gave me only 120 THB, claiming they would charge the full price for a 60-minute session instead of using the promotional rate.

I explained that the refund should be based on the agreed promotional price, but she refused. Eventually, I asked to speak with the manager. After she called the manager, they agreed to refund 700 THB and a bottle of body oil.

Although the issue was eventually resolved, it came with unnecessary back-and-forth. I now have to find another massage elsewhere, as my body aches are still not resolved. In fact, I feel worse than when I arrived at the spa.

Very clean and modern yet cozy and pleasant! Menu with price as well as promotions can be found on their Instagram page.

reviews.name: Donna Francis
reviews.text: The experience was amazing. They were attentive,  courteous and friendly. Their knowledge of pressure points was outstanding. Would totally recommend as a must place to visit for one of the most heavenly massages ever.

reviews.name: Hiroshi Tanaka
reviews.text: I visited this massage place recently. The massage itself was okay, but my overall experience was disappointing. When I called ahead, I asked if there was a queue, and I was told there was. However, when I arrived, the room was full, and only a chair was available, which limited my access to the full menu. Additionally, I had asked about a promotion for 20% off before 17:00, but I was charged the full price instead. Unfortunately, due to these issues, I won’t be returning.

reviews.name: T B
reviews.text: We chose this massage parlour due to a 6 hour transfer time at BKK airport. It is located at the Glass Market Bangna Food Market, only a 20-30 min drive away from the airport and only opened in 2024. I went there with my husband and our adult son for a treatment. It is a little more expensive than other parlours, but defenitely worthwhile. Everything is well maintained, the service is very good and all three of the therapists were doing an excellent and very professional job. Before the treatment we were asked if we had any medical issues or if we wanted certain areas of the body to be handled in a more careful way and so on.  Thus, I can highly recommend the parlour and we'll defenitely be back next time. So thank you for that, we had a very relaxing flight back home afterwards:-)

reviews.name: Marcus Petermann
reviews.text: Good concept, high-quality facilities. Excellent, professional, and well-trained customer-oriented staff. High-quality, well-thought-out services. My wife and I feel very welcome and well-treated here. We were truly able to relax, and my wife's back pain is even decreasing. Taking advantage of the membership was a great idea. The price, the standards, and the results are all perfectly balanced. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Brandon West
reviews.text: A lovely Thai massage, I think my favourite bit was that back crack was like magic 😂 got the 90 minute one and luckily had a promotion going so it was less that $50 aud or around 870baht I can't remember but definitely worth it and the tea after is quite the treat! Feels luxury 😝💜

reviews.name: Natnida Janjua
reviews.text: Good environment, The place is really clean, it's time for relaxing , service ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.name: SIRIKUNYA CHEEWAKOSET
reviews.text:
Spiritual , mindfulness, place for relaxation.

Premium quality, staffs and equipment

reviews.name: OneTaRmY feels good
reviews.text: We came 6 people and we really enjoyed, really relaxing & professional. Very recommended probably the best so far & you get a superb quality.

title: NARA MASSAGE & SPA PHUKET (Chalong, Patak Rd.)
ownerDescription:
NARA Massage & Spa, a wellness providing professional massage and spa treatments including nail service by highly experienced therapists. At NARA we have the relaxing decor, a hygienic environment, as well as pleasurable service. We are certified by SHA Plus+ (Amazing Thailand Safety & Health Administration) that 100% of our staff are fully vaccinated.

ร้าน นารา มาสสาจ เป็นร้านที่ให้บริการนวดโดยพนักงานที่มีใบทะเบียนอย่างถูกต้องและมีประสบการณ์สูง นอกจากการนวดที่มีคุณภาพแล้วเรายังเน้นในเรื่องของการบริการทุกระดับประทับใจ รวมถึงการตกแต่งสถานที่บรรยากาศที่สวยงามผ่อนคลาย โดยเฉพาะอย่างยิ่งเราเน้นเรื่องความสะอาดที่สุดเป็นอันดับหนึ่งและปฏิบัติการป้องกันควบคุมโรคอย่างเคร่งครัดมาโดยตลอด ที่สำคัญที่สุดพนักงานของเราได้รีบวัคซีนโควิด-19 อย่างครบถ้วน
address: 75, 159 Patak Rd, Chalong, Mueang Phuket District, Chang Wat Phuket 83130, Thailand
plusCode: R8FQ+54 Chalong, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Sissi L'impératrice
reviews.text:
We came here for a relaxing mother-daughter experience and booked a one-hour massage. It was absolutely amazing.

The massage was done by true professionals who really focused on the areas we asked them to. We both left feeling completely relaxed, and the pain we had was noticeably relieved.

I’ve had massages at other massage centers before, but this was by far the best massage I’ve had since coming to Thailand. It was truly exceptional.

The place itself is beautiful, with lovely decor, and every member of the staff is incredibly kind, respectful, and calming. They create such a peaceful atmosphere.

I will definitely come back!

reviews.name: Tsang Ching Jing
reviews.text:
Amazing classic Thai massage! The therapists are truly skilled. Every press is on point and you can tell they know what they're doing. This isn't one of those places where they just lightly rub your skin and call it a day. My whole body felt completely relaxed after the session.
The price is incredibly reasonable for the quality you get. Highly recommend booking in advance as it can get busy. Will definitely be coming back on my next trip to Phuket!
One small tip : they sell Phutawan roll-on essential oils here at 260 baht each, but I'd skip it as it's cheaper at the malls.

reviews.name: Raashika Raghuwanshi
reviews.text:
Amazing experience! I went for the glowing skin treatment that had an hr each of Organic body scrub and Aromatherapy massage.
Nan did a fantastic job and overall the amenities were great too. The hot towel at the end for a shoulder massage was a wonderful surprise. Definitely recommended! 💯💯

reviews.name: Анна Тимошенко
reviews.text:
I really love this place. Anyone who has lived here for a while will definitely tell you it has the best massage.

I often come here specifically for an oil relaxation massage, and it truly feels like deep relaxation for me. After the session, my body feels rested, the caring hands tone the muscles, stretch them, and allow the body to breathe in fresh new energy.

I also really enjoy the relaxing atmosphere and the service.

reviews.name: Fm Chen
reviews.text: I had such an amazing massage experience here! The environment is super cozy and tranquil, with soft lighting and gentle Thai music that instantly calms you down. The masseuse was incredibly professional—she perfectly adjusted the pressure, targeted all my tense shoulders and back muscles without any discomfort. Everything was clean and well-maintained. Definitely the best Thai massage I’ve tried in Phuket, will come back again!

reviews.name: Sachin Gola
reviews.text: My experience at Nara Massage & Spa was truly exceptional! 💆‍♀️ The pedicure and manicure services were top-notch, leaving me feeling refreshed and pampered. The ambiance was so relaxing, and the staff were incredibly skilled. I definitely recommend this place for some well-deserved self-care! ✨💅💖

reviews.name: Jess Woo
reviews.text: Nara Spa was great! They treated me very well. A very warm welcome on my first night in Phuket. They were so good I came back a second time for an even longer massage. I got the signature message 60min and then 90min. Well worth it. The staff are great. The facility is clean. The atmosphere is peaceful ☺️☺️

reviews.name: Татар Татарин
reviews.text:
We visited Nara Spa on Patak Rd - the place stands out against the background of typical tourist salons with its cleanliness and level of training of masters.

• Sports massage: Ideal for recovery after loads. The master deeply worked out the trigger points, using the right pressure (strong pressure). Perfectly relieves muscle clamps without unnecessary trauma.

• Classic Thai massage: All canons are observed - from high-quality stretching to acupressure. The technique is confident, you can feel the knowledge of anatomy, and not just mechanical execution of movements.

Bottom line: Pleasant interior, polite staff and, most importantly, a real therapeutic effect. I definitely recommend you to visit if you are in the Chalong area.

reviews.name: Manfred Herrmann
reviews.text: We had a wonderful massage for 550 baht. It was a Thai massage with oil and the ladies were super kind regarding the intensity as I am quite sensible. At the end a tea was served. Very professional

reviews.name: Erdinc Özkuscu
reviews.text: That was the worst massage I've ever had in Thailand. The woman had absolutely no clue about the human body or muscles. It was a complete disgrace. Her nails hurt me the whole time, and she clearly didn't know what she was doing. 800 baht down the drain for 90 minutes. That's why I left the massage early.

reviews.name: Anoop Thomas
reviews.text: Very good experience. Me and my wife went for the 60 mins organic body scrub, followed by 60 mins aromatherapy massage. We went here after a whole day of island hoping tour and it was so relaxing.

reviews.name: M A
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Nara Massage and Spa. From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere was calm, welcoming, and very relaxing. The spa was clean, comfortable, and created the perfect environment to unwind.

What impressed me most was the quality of the massage. It was the first time I’ve met a masseuse who was able to consistently maintain the same amount of pressure and strength throughout the entire session. The massage felt balanced, professional, and incredibly effective from start to finish, which made it one of the best massage experiences I’ve had.

The staff were friendly and attentive, and the overall service was excellent. I left feeling completely refreshed and relaxed.

Overall, I highly recommend Nara Massage and Spa and will definitely return in the future.

P.s I wrote this on my own accord not after I got home and tried 3 different massage and spa in Phuket.

reviews.name: Iqbal Kamarudin
reviews.text:
Haven’t had a good massage in a while then I found this magnificent place…. Ohhh what a time to be alive after my first massage. It was so good I booked another session 2 days later

Definitely would recommend coming 10/10

If you are looking for someone strong you could ask for Master Salee. I went for the total relieve treatment for both sessions, she knows the right spots to hit and the massage was heavenly

reviews.name: Ivy Hsiang Ting Cheng
reviews.text: I did a 120 minutes oil massage, it was such a great experience. Even before the massage started, you can feel the care from the staff already. You can also choose the oil that you like! Worth it!

reviews.name: Janne Färm
reviews.text: An excellent massage experience in Phuket! The place was very clean and high-quality, with friendly and professional service. The price was also surprisingly affordable for the level of quality. Our whole family was able to get treatments at the same time, which made the visit even better. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Valeria Färm
reviews.text:
We visited your massage studio for an aroma massage as a whole family, and we were very pleased with the experience. The atmosphere was calm and relaxing, the staff was friendly and professional, and the treatments were very enjoyable. We left feeling refreshed and relaxed.

Thank you very much — we would be happy to come again and can warmly recommend your services to others.

reviews.name: Cy Wakeman
reviews.text: Great way to begin our stay in Phuket. Friendly staff, great massage and scrub. Herbal treatment is heavenly. Will return in a couple of days for more.

reviews.name: Sonya Z
reviews.text: I keep coming back to Nara every time I’m in Phuket. It has become my little ritual. The experience is always fantastic. Amazing facilities and ambience, and truly professional masseuses. I highly recommend the traditional Thai massage and post-burn with aloe Vera — helps a lot with skin recovery.

reviews.name: Meldra Vebere
reviews.text:
I had an aromatherapy massage for 1h and it was so relaxing!
In the beginning I could choose from 4 different oils and choose the strength of the massage - either gentle or medium, then they gently washed my feet, gave me slippers and new towels.
The lady that massaged me was really professional and attentive.
The atmosphere was and the setting was equally perfect - clean, relaxing music and a good temperature in the room. In the end I was even treated with a cup of tea.

reviews.name: Maverick 10
reviews.text:
I came here for a massage on my birthday and it was honestly one of the best experiences I’ve had so far. The place itself is very cozy, with dimmed lights, a beautiful relaxing atmosphere, and an amazing smell as soon as you walk in.

The staff are unbelievably kind and make you feel completely at home from the moment you arrive. Everything felt professional, relaxing, and genuinely welcoming.

I would highly recommend this place to anyone wanting a real full Thai massage experience while in Phuket. Definitely a place I’ll come back to again.🙏

Along with award winning spa pampering and treatments, guests will also enjoy outdoor rain showers, a Thai herbal steam cave and the outdoor swimming pool. Free round trip transportation is available in Patong, Surin and Kamala area.

reviews.name: Richard Lai
reviews.text:
We booked a last minute 60min foot massage for two people, and had an experience that was so far beyond our expectations!

We were greeted warmly by lovely Aris at reception, and shown to a private couples room. Our massage therapists were attentive and very skilled. The 1hr foot massage was so much more than that! They focused on our feet and legs at first, then moved to an excellent head, neck, scalp and shoulder massage. The staff were even kind enough to organise free transport back to our hotel in Patong for us.

Would definitely recommend, and we’ll certainly be back again!

With online booking discount, total was 1920THB + tax and service. On the slightly pricier side for Thailand, but absolutely worth it for the quality of experience, skill, environment and hospitality.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your fantastic experience at Oasis Spa! We’re thrilled to hear that Aris and our therapists provided attentive service and skilled techniques that exceeded your expectations. It’s great that you enjoyed the comprehensive foot massage along with the complimentary head, neck, and shoulder treatment. Your feedback on our hospitality, private couples room, and transport service is greatly appreciated. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing visit soon!

reviews.name: Quincy Tan
reviews.text:
We booked the buy-one-get-one-free massage package, and it was absolutely worth it. Since we were staying near the pickup area, Oasis Spa arranged complimentary transportation from our hotel — and to our surprise, it was a free round-trip service.

From the moment we entered the spa, the atmosphere felt instantly calming and relaxing. The staff were warm and welcoming, and we were escorted to a private treatment villa complete with its own bathroom and shower, which made the experience feel very exclusive and luxurious.

The massage itself was superb. The therapists were highly skilled, knew exactly where to apply pressure, and clearly had professional training and expertise. Every part of the treatment was deeply relaxing and therapeutic.

Overall, this was easily the best massage experience we’ve ever had.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your glowing 5-star review. We are thrilled that you had such a positive and memorable visit to our Turquoise Cove Spa.Hearing that you found the massage superb and the atmosphere instantly calming is truly a wonderful compliment to our dedicated team. We take great pride in delivering exceptional and professional service.
We can't wait to welcome you back for another rejuvenating treatment.

reviews.name: Tetiana Rokhman
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at this spa, thanks to a gift voucher from my friends for a 4-hour treatment.

The package included a four-hand massage, body wrap, and facial care — everything was perfectly organized and incredibly relaxing. The four-hand massage, in particular, was a unique and unforgettable experience.

The staff were very attentive and professional, making sure I felt comfortable throughout the entire visit.

Overall, I truly enjoyed every moment and would highly recommend this spa to anyone looking for a high-quality, relaxing experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are so grateful for your wonderful feedback regarding your visit to Oasis Spa Turquoise Cove. It’s fantastic to know that your treatments, especially the four-hand massage, provided such a high-quality and relaxing experience. We are passionate about creating serene and memorable moments for our guests, and your review affirms that we are succeeding. We look forward to your next visit and the chance to provide another exceptional spa day.

reviews.name: kamisha jordan
reviews.text: Really great experience! Staff was amazing very friendly and kind. One thing i will say is that they asked for where i wanted to avoid on my body and still massaged. No big deal but if you have special needs on where not to be touch just double check with the staff!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your 5-star review and for sharing your experience. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed your visit to Oasis Turquoise Cove Spa and appreciated the warm hospitality from our team.

At the same time, we sincerely apologize that your request to avoid a specific area was not fully followed during your treatment. Your comfort and preferences are very important to us, and we regret that we fell short on this occasion.

Please be assured that your feedback has been shared with our spa management team to reinforce the importance of carefully following each guest's treatment preferences.
Thank you once again for your valuable feedback. We truly appreciate your understanding and look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing experience.

reviews.name: M Lee
reviews.text:
We called from our hotel concierge and able to speak to the spa directly, they answered all my questions before we made our decision to have a spa day here.

They offer hotel pickup, and it was on time and smooth. Once arrived at the spa, we were welcome by staff immediately with drinks and cooling towers, plus explanation of the menu. After we chose our treatment, we proceed to the treatment room with 2 beds so my partner was with me. The treatment room has a full bathroom so we can shower and use the toilet. The spa is very clean, front staff are attentive and speak good English, our treatment staff were Keena (strong and on point) and Cheetar (gentle and relaxing), the whole experience was wonderful. Definitely recommended this spa!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to leave such a thoughtful review. We’re delighted to know that every aspect of your visit to our Turquoise Cove Spa, from the hotel pickup to the treatment experience, met your expectations. It’s especially rewarding to hear your kind feedback about our therapists, Keena and Cheetar. Your support truly means a great deal to us, and we remain committed to providing exceptional experiences for every guest. We look forward to welcoming you again on your next visit.

reviews.name: Sonia Adams
reviews.text:
The ambience of this spa is absolutely beautiful. The staff are very friendly. This has truly been the best massage I have ever had. It was three massages in one and took about 2 hours. I came out feeling so relaxed and my skin felt refreshed and smooth.
If you are looking for something that is an upgrade from the 'normal' massage that you can get from the local shops, please pay this place a visit. I promise you will not be disappointed.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Your review truly made our day! Thank you for sharing such kind and heartfelt words about your visit. It brings us so much joy to know you found our Turquoise Cove Spa beautiful and that we could provide you with a relaxing, refreshing, and memorable experience. We are so thankful for your support and for recommending our spa so highly. Our promise is to create moments of perfect relaxation for our guests, and we're thrilled we could deliver that for you.
The entire team in Kamala looks forward to pampering you again soon!

reviews.name: W Rachel
reviews.text: I really love this place. Everyone is so friendly and welcoming. The environment is great, the massage pressure is just right, and the courtyard is truly beautiful. I'll definitely recommend it to my friends～
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It was a pleasure to read your lovely comments, thank you. We're thrilled you enjoyed the friendly service and the beautiful setting of Oasis Turquoise Cove Spa, from the courtyard to the treatment room. Your recommendation is the highest compliment we could receive, and we are truly appreciative.  We would be delighted to welcome you back whenever you need another moment of tranquility.

reviews.name: Alina Domenig
reviews.text: We had a massage at Oasis Spa in Phuket and the experience was excellent. The team was welcoming and attentive from the very first moment, which made us feel comfortable right away. The treatment itself was high quality, relaxing, and professionally delivered. We would happily come back and can recommend it to anyone looking for a great spa experience in Phuket.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your 5-star review truly made our day! We are absolutely delighted to hear that you had an excellent experience at our Turquoise Cove Spa in Phuket. It brings us great joy to know that our team made you feel welcome and comfortable from the very first moment and that you found your treatment to be relaxing and professionally delivered. We truly appreciate your kind words and your recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you back for another amazing spa experience soon!

reviews.name: Kimberly Hall
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience at Oasis Spa Kamala Phuket. This was our first Thai massage, and it truly exceeded our expectations.

We booked a couples treatment and both therapists were excellent—very professional, attentive, and skilled. I had a male therapist and my husband had a female therapist, and we both left feeling completely relaxed.

The experience was well-paced and never felt rushed. We started with a body scrub, followed by time to shower, and then a 90-minute massage that was incredibly relaxing. At the end, they served us hot tea and sticky mango rice, which was such a nice touch.

The only minor downside (and not the spa’s fault) was that we could occasionally hear loud music from outside, which was a bit distracting at times.

Overall, we would absolutely recommend this spa—such a special and memorable experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Reading your review has brightened our day. It is wonderful to hear that we were able to make your first Thai massage a truly special and relaxing occasion. We are particularly proud that our therapists’ professionalism and skill stood out to you. We sincerely appreciate you choosing Oasis Spa and sharing your experience. We look forward to welcoming you back for another moment of tranquility.

reviews.name: Elise Benoit

title: Ton Mai Spa & Massage Rawai Phuket
subTitle: ต้นไม้สปาราไวย์
ownerDescription:
Ton Mai Spa & Massage in Rawai Phuket offers a sanctuary of rejuvenation for weary travelers. Est. 2016, Ton Mai Spa provides a tranquil escape in a peaceful garden with traditional Thai massages, pampering body scrubs, and a variety of hydrotherapy options including a sauna, steam room, ice bath, and refreshing swimming pool.

Please note, we only allow access to customers 10 years old and older!
address: 6 11 Wiset Rd, Rawai, Amphoe Mueang Phuket, Phuket 83130, Thailand
plusCode: Q8HH+QC Rawai, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Isa travel
reviews.text:
Ton Mai Spa & Massage in Rawai is hands-down one of the best spa experiences I’ve had anywhere in Phuket and I say that as someone who’s tried more than a few! From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is completely transporting: calm, quiet, beautifully designed, and just the right kind of tranquil that makes you exhale the second you sit down.

I booked a Thai massage with Napi and honestly cannot recommend her enough. Her technique is incredible, the perfect balance of strength and precision, hitting every knot and tension point without ever feeling harsh. She clearly has years of skill and genuinely cares about tailoring the pressure to what your body needs. I left feeling like a completely different person, loose, recharged, and floating on air.

What really sets Ton Mai apart, though, is everything beyond the massage itself. This isn’t just a spa, it’s a full wellness retreat under one roof. They have a proper steam room, a sauna, an invigorating cold plunge, and even a treadmill built into the pool for a low-impact workout, it’s such a thoughtful and unique touch I haven’t seen anywhere else. You can genuinely spend half a day here moving between treatments and facilities and never get bored.

And then there’s the food. I wasn’t expecting much from a spa menu, but the dishes were fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented, a perfect way to relax afterward without having to go anywhere else.
Impeccable service, a stunning range of facilities, and a genuinely talented therapist in Napi make this a must-visit if you’re in Rawai. I’ll absolutely be back on my next trip to Phuket, and I recommend booking with Napi specifically if you want a truly exceptional Thai massage. Ton Mai Spa is a hidden gem that deserves every bit of recognition it gets. Thanks to Dan for making sure that my friend and I had a great experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Isa travel for your amazing and detailed review! 🙏🏻💗 We’re truly delighted to hear that you and your friend had such a wonderful experience at Ton Mai Spa & Massage. 💚

We’re especially happy to hear your kind words about Napi and her massage skills. We’ll be sure to share your compliments with her—she’ll be thrilled to know she helped make your visit so special.

It’s also wonderful to hear that you enjoyed our wellness facilities, pool, cold plunge, sauna, steam room, and food. Thank you for recognizing the care we put into creating a relaxing experience for our guests.

reviews.text: A beautiful and peaceful spa with exceptional service. The massage was amazing, and every detail made the experience feel luxurious and relaxing. I left feeling completely refreshed. Highly recommended!

reviews.text:

I especially like that there are little houses outside — it adds a special charm to the place. As a vegetarian, I also appreciate that I can find vegetarian food here, which is not always easy.

Overall, there are two saunas, a large swimming pool, a beautiful garden, and even sun loungers upstairs. I think many people come here for the atmosphere — it’s truly unique. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed the wellness spa. The combination of the sauna, steam room, and cold plunge left us feeling relaxed and refreshed. The staff were also warm and attentive.

reviews.name: Jack Farley
reviews.text:
Ton Mai Spa is probably the best place I visited on my trip to Phuket. The spa facilities are next to none, and the attentiveness of the staff was amazing.

The atmosphere of the spa is beautiful. Centred around a large tamarind tree, the facilities are airy and bright. Despite being located on a busy main road, the spa was very peaceful and quiet.

I paid 500 baht for a Thai Massage and
unlimited pool and sauna/steam room usage and I believe the value for money here is unmatched. The massage was very thorough; it was obvious that the masseuses knew what they were doing. The facilities were very clean too. I would 100% recommend a visit if you are in the area :)

reviews.text:
For the past 4 years, Tonmai Spa Rawai has been my absolute favorite spa in Phuket. Every time I visit, the service is consistently wonderful. The staff are professional, friendly, and always make you feel relaxed from the moment you walk in.

The atmosphere is peaceful and clean, and the massages are always excellent. You can really tell they care about quality and customer experience.

If you’re looking for a place to truly relax while visiting Phuket, I highly recommend Tonmai Spa Rawai. It’s a place I keep coming back to again and again. 🌿✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Nessy Arnett, for your wonderful review and continued support ❤️ We’re so happy to be your favourite spa and look forward to welcoming you back again 🙏 💕

reviews.name: ceejay
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Exceptional Experience at Ton Mai
​Ton Mai Spa & Massage is a true gem in Rawai. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is incredibly peaceful and welcoming, providing a perfect escape from the heat and busyness of the main roads.
​Here is why this spot stands out:
​Professionalism: The therapists are highly skilled and attentive. They take the time to understand exactly which areas need focus, and the pressure is consistently perfect throughout the session.
​Ambiance: The spa is immaculately clean and beautifully decorated. The soothing music and subtle scents create an immediate sense of relaxation.
​Value: For the level of service and the quality of the facilities, the pricing is very reasonable. It feels like a high-end luxury experience without the exorbitant price tag.
​Hospitality: The staff is genuinely kind and professional, often providing a lovely herbal tea before or after the treatment which adds a thoughtful touch to the visit.
​Whether you are looking for a deep tissue massage to work out some tension or a relaxing oil massage to unwind, I cannot recommend Ton Mai enough. It is easily one of the best massage experiences in Phuket.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Ceejay for your kind words! We’re so happy to hear that you had a great experience with our service. We look forward to welcoming you back again 🙏 💕

reviews.text: I really love this spot. It feels so relaxing to hit the sauna after a tiring day. I'm a regular here, and it's definitely my top choice. Access to the pool and sauna is only around 200-300 baht, which is very reasonable. Plus, the service is excellent!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Nan Thidar Win. For your kind review and visiting 💓 We’re thrilled you enjoyed your time here. Hope to see you again 😊 🙏

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Gert for the fantastic review! We’re absolutely thrilled to hear that you were impressed with our spa. We hope to see you again soon 💕

reviews.name: Khayla W
reviews.text: amazing experience! 15usd for one hour massage use of pool steam room, sauna, and cold plunge pool

reviews.name: Paul Melvin
reviews.text:
Since moving house, Ton Mai Spa has become my go-to place to relax, and I honestly wish I'd started coming here sooner.

The facilities are excellent. Everything feels modern, well maintained, and exceptionally clean. You can constantly see the staff cleaning and taking pride in keeping the whole place looking its best.
The food is also outstanding. I've now tried several different dishes from the menu, and every one has been cooked perfectly and tasted delicious.

The staff are another highlight. Everyone is friendly, welcoming, and provides excellent service, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. The location is beautiful, and the atmosphere is peaceful and relaxing.

One thing I particularly appreciate is that this is an adults-only facility. Even as a parent myself, I think it's a real benefit. There are plenty of other places nearby for families with children, but having somewhere you can genuinely switch off and enjoy the peace and quiet is something I really value.

I would highly recommend Ton Mai Spa to anyone looking for a clean, relaxing spa with fantastic facilities, great food, and excellent service. It's quickly become one of my favourite places to unwind.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much🙏, Paul Melvin for your wonderful and thoughtful review! It truly means a lot to us to know that Ton Mai Spa has become your go-to place to relax. We’re delighted you enjoyed our facilities, food, peaceful atmosphere, and the service from our team. Your kind words and recommendation are greatly appreciated, and we look forward to welcoming you back for many more relaxing visits. See you again soon! 💚 🙏🏻

title: Blessed Hands Thai Massage
subTitle: Blessed Hands Thai Massage - Chinatown (Yaowarat)
ownerDescription: Blessed Hands Thai Massage is a modern Thai massage spa located in the heart of Yaowarat–Songwat, Bangkok’s Chinatown, just a short walk from MRT Wat Mangkon. Our government-certified Thai therapists provide Traditional Thai Massage, Foot Massage, Office Syndrome Massage, Aroma Oil Massage, Deep Tissue Massage, Head Massage, Herbal Compress and Body Scrub treatments. Private couple massage rooms are also available. Guests are welcomed into a clean, peaceful and minimalist space, with attentive care from a welcome drink upon arrival to hot tea and Thai snacks after each treatment. An ideal place for local guests and international travelers to relax and recharge after exploring Yaowarat, Songwat and Chinatown.

I chose the aromatherapy massage with a scrub, and it was absolutely amazing. The massage was incredibly professional, perfectly balanced between therapeutic and soothing, and the scrub left my skin feeling soft and refreshed.
The atmosphere is very cozy and calming, making it easy to fully switch off and relax. The staff are extremely kind, attentive, and highly skilled, creating a sense of trust and comfort throughout the entire experience. Everything feels thoughtful and refined without ever feeling forced or artificial.
Conveniently located in Chinatown, it’s the perfect escape from the busy city. This was truly a one-of-a-kind experience and totally worth it. I loved every moment and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommended. 🤍

If I wait there and they can’t get any, I will be wasting time.
My advise to everyone as they grow bigger, service is worst now. Do not top up member credit with them anymore.
Go to other massage shop is better and much cheaper, with much better service.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for supporting Lek Massage Residence Thonglor Hotel, a leading Thai massage Thonglor and nail salon near BTS Thong Lo.

title: Yuubi Clinic 优美诊所 ゆうびクリニック
subTitle: Yuubi Clinic ยูบิ คลินิกเสริมความงาม Botox Filler Hifu โบท็อกซ์ ฟิลเลอร์ ติด BTS ปุณณวิถี ทางออก 4
ownerDescription:
ยูบิคลินิก ให้บริการดูแลผิวหน้าและความงามโดยทีมงานวิชาชีพ ใช้ผลิตภัณฑ์และเครื่องมือที่ได้รับการรับรองจาก อย. ตั้งอยู่ใกล้ BTS ปุณณวิถี มีที่จอดรถ

Yuubi Clinic offers professional skin and aesthetic care using Thai FDA-approved products and equipment. Conveniently located near BTS Punnawithi with parking available.
address: 2296 2298 2300 Phra Khanong Tai, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand
openingHoursBusinessConfirmationText: Confirmed by this business 11 weeks ago

reviews.name: Sara
reviews.text:
​I visited Yuubi Clinic for the first time on the recommendation of my best friend, and the experience was truly beyond my expectation!

​I opted for the Ultraformer III (800 shots) package, which also included a free area of Botox and a complimentary YB Bright treatment as a bonus for paying a deposit after my reservation—a great deal!

​From the moment I arrived, the clinic was notably clean and cozy. The service was absolutely amazing. I must give a special shout-out to Nong Noon & Nan; we had a delightful, non-stop chat, which made the whole process so much more relaxing and fun. They deserved bonus end of this year!!

They also went the extra mile, serving a lovely drink and snack after applying the numbing cream.

​This was my first time getting an aesthetic treatment, and I chose to celebrate my recent birthday with it. I couldn't be happier with my choice of clinic. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Benyathip Thungguay
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Youubi Clinic. The staff were very nice and welcoming, and the atmosphere was clean and relaxing. The doctor gave me a detailed consultation and made me feel comfortable before the Botox treatment. Everything was professional, and I’m really happy with the result. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Aon Krittiya
reviews.text: Such a nice place with excellent services. The staff are very nice, the place feels relaxing and clean. The price is clear with no hard selling or rush. I will back again for sure ka☺️

reviews.name: Klodiana Prendi
reviews.text:
I discovered this clinic by chance while passing by. From the very first visit, the staff was very courteous, and the doctor did an excellent job analyzing my face and recommending the best personalized treatments for me.

I decided to choose this clinic before leaving because I had a great experience.

reviews.name: Sornpapat Papat
reviews.text:
HIGHLY RECOMMEND ❤️ I really made the right decision to do it here. The doctor here has a very gentle hand and doesn't take long. They apply numb cream at no additional charge. While waiting, they serve snacks and drinks to make me feel refreshed. Before the injection, the doctor brought a botox box for me to see and opened it in front of me.

The results were very satisfying. I saw the change from the next day until I thought, "I should have done it a long time ago." And the tightness of the face is just right, not too hard (I was disappointed with injections from other places in 2020. At that time, my face was stiff and my eyebrows pointed up too high and made me afraid of Botox).

reviews.name: Leslie Hihi
reviews.text: The staff was professional, friendly, and gave me personalized skin care advice. The clinic was clean, modern, and super relaxing.

reviews.name: natcha w
reviews.text:
Nice atmosphere and good service.
Staff and doctor shared a great advice with no rush and hard selling. Recommend.

reviews.name: บรีส
reviews.text: Thank you for the amazing service! The clinic is beautiful and people so friendly!

reviews.name: Nok LastShelter
reviews.text:
I went to Yuubi Clinic at BTS Punnawithi (exit 4). It is a door step near to Soi Sukhuvit 64. It is so nice inside & better than my expectation. Nice decoration and sofa is super comfortable. It feels very chill. People working there are super friendly. They smile a lot and make sure I am okay.
My skin looks so good after I go there. Also, not too much money. I went for facial treatment and Vitamin drip (I forgot what it called) which was my first time for this kind of treatment. I think it's a good deal for how my skin looks now. I decided to buy a treatment package too LOL.
They also provided a tiny cake with chocolate drink just in case you feel hungry after treatment 😊 it’s awesome service!

reviews.name: E. Wu
reviews.text: โดยรวมประทับใจมากค่ะ บริการดี พนักงานน่ารักและใส่ใจรายละเอียด บรรยากาศก็โอเคเลย ที่ชอบคือมีชาไทยกับขนมให้ทานด้วย ขนมอร่อยมาก 😊 ครั้งนี้ได้เจอคุณหมอเก่ง มีความรู้ ประทับใจค่ะ ไว้มีโอกาสจะกลับมาใช้บริการอีกแน่นอน
reviews.textTranslated: Overall, I was very impressed. The service was excellent, the staff were lovely and attentive to detail, and the atmosphere was great. What I especially liked was the complimentary Thai tea and snacks, which were delicious 😊 This time I met a very skilled and knowledgeable doctor, which was a great experience. I will definitely come back again if I have the opportunity.

reviews.name: Farng M Wong
reviews.text:
มาตามคำแนะนำของเพื่อนว่าที่นี่ พี่หมองานละเอียด แนะนำดี ไม่เน้นขายของขายคอร์ส

และก็เป็นแบบนั้นจริงๆ พี่หมอค่อยๆทำ แล้วให้เราดูว่าโอเคไหม ตึงไปหย่อนไป ค่อยๆเติม ไม่รีบ หน้าออกมาไม่ตึงไม่โป๊ะ หน้ากระชับดูเป็นธรรมชาติ
ปกติไม่ค่อยเข้าคลินิก แต่มาที่นี่รู้สึกสบายใจ ไม่มีใครมากดดันว่าต้องซื้อ ต้องจ่ายเพิ่ม

ภายในสะอาดสะอ้าน โอ่โถง ไม่อึดอัด พนักงานบริการดีมาก ระหว่างรอยาชาออกฤทธิ์ มีขนมมีน้ำหวานจัดเซ็ตมาอย่างดีให้ทานด้วย ประทับใจกับการใส่ใจลูกค้า

เห็นว่าที่นี่รองรับลูกค้าต่างชาติด้วย ฝรั่ง จีน ญี่ปุ่น อินเตอร์มาก
ใครมีเพื่อนพามาได้เลย ตอบโจทย์สุด
reviews.textTranslated:
I came here on a friend's recommendation. They said the doctor here is meticulous, gives good advice, and doesn't push sales or courses.

And it was true. The doctor worked slowly, letting me see if it was okay, gradually adding to any tightness or looseness without rushing. My face looked naturally firm and toned.
I don't usually go to clinics, but I felt comfortable here. No one pressured me to buy anything or pay extra.

The interior is clean, spacious, and comfortable. The staff provided excellent service. While waiting for the numbing cream to take effect, they offered a nice set of snacks and drinks. I was very impressed with their attentiveness to customers.

I heard they also cater to international clients – Westerners, Chinese, Japanese – very international.
If you have friends, bring them here! It's perfect.

reviews.name: P porr
reviews.text: คลินิกเดินทางมาง่าย กลิ่นหอมสะอาด ด้านในตกแต่งได้สวยมาก พนักงานน่ารัก ให้คำแนะนำดี ดูแลดี คุณหมอให้คำปรึกษาดีมาก มีของทานเล่นให้ระหว่างรอยาชาออกฤทธิ์ ประทับใจมากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The clinic was easy to get to, smelled clean and pleasant, and the interior was beautifully decorated. The staff were lovely, provided good advice, and offered excellent care. The doctor gave a very good consultation. They even offered snacks while I waited for the anesthetic to take effect. I was very impressed.

reviews.name: 林秋月
reviews.text: 第一次做醫美，來打抬頭紋肉毒，效果很好😊😊環境優美，護理人員跟醫生也很細心，會用英文解說～～推薦！！
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time getting cosmetic procedures done – I had Botox injections for forehead wrinkles, and the results were fantastic! 😊😊 The environment was beautiful, and the nurses and doctors were very attentive and explained everything in English. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Podchara Worasunthararom
reviews.text: คลินิกสะอาด บรรยากาศดี สะดวกสบาย คุณหมอมือเบามาก ให้คำปรึกษาตรงจุด ประทับใจตั้งแต่ครั้งแรกที่มาเลย
reviews.textTranslated: The clinic is clean, the atmosphere is pleasant and comfortable. The doctor is very gentle and gives precise advice. I was impressed from my first visit.

reviews.name: Dar Y
reviews.text: บริการดีมากค่ะประทับใจ มีแพทย์ผู้เชี่ยวชาญให้คำปรึกษาปัญหาผิวหน้าได้ตรงจุด มีอาหารว่างให้หลังรับบริการเสร็จสิ้นด้วย สถานที่เป็นส่วนตัว น้อง ๆ พนักงานน่ารัก  ที่สำคัญเดินทางสะดวกมากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The service was excellent, I was very impressed. There were expert doctors who provided precise consultations on my skin problems. They even offered snacks after the service. The place was private, the staff were lovely, and most importantly, it was very convenient to get to.

reviews.name: ธนารัตน์
reviews.text: คุณหมอและเจ้าหน้าที่ทุกท่านเป็นกันเอง ให้บริการดีมากค่ะ คุณหมอมือเบามาก คลินิกสะอาด เข้ามาใช้บริการแล้วรู้สึกผ่อนคลาย ประทับใจมากๆค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The doctor and all the staff were very friendly and provided excellent service. The doctor was very gentle, the clinic was clean, and I felt relaxed after visiting. I was very impressed.

reviews.name: raritafey fey
reviews.text:
คลินิกบรรยากาศดีมากๆๆ ติด bts เดินทางสะดวกมากๆๆ พนักงานบริการดีมาก มีบริการอาหารฟรี ระหว่างรอมีโซนทำงาน เรามาฉีดฟิลเลอร์ปากครั้งแรก คุณหมอแนะนำดีมาก มีการแกะกล่องให้ดูก่อนฉีด  คุณหมอมือเบาสุดๆๆๆ
หลังจากฉีดเสร็จมีการโทรถามอาการ ประทับใจสุดๆๆ 🤩🫶🏻
reviews.textTranslated:
The clinic has a great atmosphere and is conveniently located near the BTS, making it very easy to get to. The staff provides excellent service, and there's free food available while you wait. There's also a work area. This was my first time getting lip fillers, and the doctor gave great advice. They even opened the box in front of me before the injection. The doctor was incredibly gentle.
They even called to check on my condition after the procedure, which was very impressive! 🤩🫶🏻

reviews.name: KS “佳碧”
reviews.text: คลีนิกสะอาดมากกก ครั้งแรกทำultraformer และ ฉีดโบลดกราม คุณหมอบอกว่าหน้ายุงชัวร์ รอดูกันนะคะ แฟนมารอทำหน้าชมว่าเก้าอี้นั่งสบาย กาแฟดี เหมือนมาคาเฟ่เลย 🤭
reviews.textTranslated: The clinic was super clean! My first time getting Ultraformer and Botox injections for my jawline. The doctor said my face looks like it's going to get messed up, so let's wait and see! My boyfriend, who was waiting for his treatment, commented on how comfortable the chairs were and how good the coffee was, saying it felt like a cafe. 🤭

reviews.name: ピクン
reviews.text: 診療所はとてもきれいで、駅の近くにあって、交通の便がいいです。素晴らしいサービスです！私は毎年タイに帰りますので、ここへ行くつもりです。おすすめ！！
reviews.textTranslated: The clinic is very clean, located near the station, and easily accessible. The service is excellent! I return to Thailand every year and plan to go there. Highly recommended!!

reviews.name: Per Fume
reviews.text: ลองมาฉีด NCTF ครั้งแรกที่คลีนิค คุณหมอมือเบามาก คลีนิคมีความเป็นส่วนตัวให้หลายมุม พนักงานดูแลดี เอากล่องยาให้เช็คก่อนฉีด ประทับใจมากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I had my first NCTF injection at the clinic. The doctor was very gentle. The clinic offered many private spots, and the staff were attentive. They even let me check the medication box before the injection. I was very impressed.

ownerUpdates.text: Booking now!!!

reviews.name: Appreciated Images
reviews.text:
I saw the option for a 4 hands massage and went for the 90min option. I was given a cold towel and welcome water. My feet were washed, then i was lead upstairs.

I was in a very luxurious looking room. The massage bed was extra soft. The headrest was accompanied by an arm rest underneath. My therapist both did continuous work for 90 mins, giving  me hard pressure and making me repeatedly pass out from comfort.

I loved this massage and want to come back. They were very professional and the room had a clean shower for you to take your time in after your service.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a detailed and wonderful review!

​We are overjoyed to hear that you found your 90-minute 4-hands treatment so transformative and relaxing. Ensuring our guests feel completely at ease—from the moment they are greeted until they step out feeling fully refreshed—is our top priority. 

We truly appreciate your kind feedback regarding our therapists' professionalism and the quality of our amenities. 

​We are already looking forward to your next visit and will ensure your next experience is just as perfect as the last. See you again soon! ✨🙏😊

reviews.name: Hakan Simsek
reviews.text: This is my fourth time visiting Bangkok, and I can honestly say this is the best massage and the best service I’ve experienced here. The staff were incredibly professional, friendly, and attentive. I left feeling completely relaxed. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a top quality massage in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review ✨
We're truly honored to hear that, after four visits to Bangkok, you consider us the best massage and service you've experienced. 🤍
Your kind words about our professional, friendly, and attentive team mean so much to us, and we're delighted that you left feeling completely relaxed. 😊
Thank you for your recommendation. We can't wait to welcome you back on your next visit to Bangkok for another wonderful massage experience! 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Rare Cookie
reviews.text: I had a foot massage here and it was amazing! The staff were so kind and welcoming, and the atmosphere was clean, peaceful, and relaxing. The massage was the perfect pressure and really helped after walking around all day. They also served biscuits, fresh mango, and tea afterward, which was such a thoughtful touch and made the whole experience even better. I left feeling refreshed and relaxed. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Thailand, and I’ll definitely be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Guest, thank you for sharing such a detailed and glowing review. We are delighted that our foot massage helped soothe your tired feet and that you found our environment clean and relaxing. It is wonderful to hear that our complimentary tea, biscuits, and fresh mango added a special touch to your visit. Your kind recommendation means the world to our team. We look forward to providing you with another refreshing experience in the near future.

reviews.name: Vachintha Piyadasa
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at AThai & Massage, and it’s definitely a place I’d recommend to anyone looking to unwind and recharge. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was calm, clean, and inviting. Exactly what you’d expect from a quality massage spa. The staff were warm and professional, making the entire experience feel comfortable and well organized. A special mention goes to Miss Yaya and Miss Nuch, who provided exceptional service. Their skills, attention to detail, and genuine care really stood out. They took the time to understand what I needed and delivered a perfectly balanced treatment. Both relaxing and therapeutic. You can tell they are experienced and truly passionate about what they do.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful and detailed review .
We’re truly happy to hear you had such a relaxing and enjoyable experience with us! 

Your kind words about our atmosphere and team mean a lot, and we’ll be sure to share your compliments with Yaya and Nuch 🙏
We’re glad their care and professionalism made your visit special.

Thank you for your recommendation, and we hope to welcome you again soon 🙏

reviews.name: Miracle Jide-Adebayo
reviews.text: Came here with my bestie for a massage first time in Thailand and for sure I will be coming back again, the lady really massage me thoroughly. I got an hour full body massage that I booked easily on Klook, and they communicated very clearly. Understanding and good communication throughout the massage, I am really grateful to feel so so relaxed and looking forward to coming back again for sure (10/10) ✨❤️✨!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review ✨
We’re truly happy that you and your bestie had such a relaxing first massage experience in Thailand with us 🤍

It means a lot to hear that the massage, communication, and overall service made you feel comfortable and well taken care of 😊
We’re also glad the Klook booking process was easy for you and that you left feeling fully relaxed ✨❤️✨

Thank you again for your kind words and perfect 10/10 rating 🙇🏻‍♀️
We can’t wait to welcome you back again on your next visit to Bangkok 🌿🙏🏻

reviews.name: Jelane Payne
reviews.text: Just an absolutely wonderful experience from the moment we stepped in. Lovely, clean & beautifully presented spa with a lovely scent. From the welcome water, cold towels & feet washing before to the tea & fresh mango afterwards - an all round great experience with lovely people
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review ✨
We're truly delighted to hear that you had such a memorable experience from the moment you arrived. 🤍
It's wonderful to know that you enjoyed our relaxing atmosphere, the cleanliness of our spa, and the little touches—from the welcome drink, cold towel, and foot wash to the tea and fresh mango after your massage. 😊🥭🍵
Your kind words mean so much to our team, and we look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit to Bangkok 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Vishakha Rai
reviews.text: Had a short foot massage but it was so relaxing. The music soothing and silent room. My neighbour just snoozed off. Other than his snoor the room was fairly quite ;)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the wonderful review! It sounds like our relaxing atmosphere worked a little too well for your neighbor! 😂 A snoring guest is honestly the ultimate compliment for us, but we are so glad you still managed to enjoy the soothing music and peaceful vibe. We would love to welcome you back for another relaxing foot massage soon—hopefully with a quieter neighbor next time! 😉✨

reviews.name: Philippa
reviews.text: Wonderful 1-hour facial! Cleansing, exfoliating massage and cooling mask. Ideal for sun-damaged skin after the beach. My skin felt calm and smooth after treatment. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the wonderful and detailed review! We are thrilled to hear that our 1-hour facial was exactly what you needed after a day at the beach. It is fantastic to know that the cooling mask and massage helped soothe your skin, leaving it calm and smooth. We truly appreciate your high recommendation and hope to pamper you again soon!

reviews.name: Seungah
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my Thai Massage + Thai Balm Massage. The pressure was perfect strong but comfortable and the masseuse was very skilled and professional.
Overall, it was relaxing and effective. Highly recommend! Will definitely return
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the lovely review! We are thrilled to hear that you thoroughly enjoyed the Thai Massage + Thai Balm combo. It is wonderful to know that the pressure was perfect and that our masseuse’s professional skills hit the spot for you. Your high recommendation means the world to us, and we are already looking forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing session on your next visit! Safe travels! 🧡✨

reviews.name: Daniëlle Lala
reviews.text: We had a wonderful foot en head en shoulder massage with the whole family (4 persons) two Children (10-13). We had cold tea in the beginning and hot tea en biscuit en mango at the end! It was very nice! A good holiday activity!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! ✨🤍
We’re so happy to hear that you and your family enjoyed the foot, head & shoulder massage together 😊
It’s especially lovely to know that both the children enjoyed the experience too! We’re glad you liked our cold tea, hot tea, biscuits, and fresh mango as well 🥭🍵
Thank you for choosing us as part of your family holiday in Bangkok. We hope to welcome you all again on your next visit! 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Shana
reviews.text: Friendly staff providing great and skillful services, and even speak your languages. Heard the staff speak Korean with another customer, and English as well! Serving nice sweet mango and snacks after the session, value for money! Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review 😊 We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed our friendly and skilled service! We’re also happy that our multilingual staff helped make your experience even more comfortable 💛 Glad you enjoyed the sweet mango and snacks after your session too 🥭 Your recommendation truly means a lot to us, and we hope to welcome you again soon 🙏

reviews.name: Mabel Agyare
reviews.text: I loved my experience here so much that I came back for another massage. I had a 2-hour aromatherapy massage and a 30-minute foot massage, and both were exceptionally well done. I left feeling completely refreshed and relaxed. The ambiance was wonderful, and the staff were professional, welcoming, and attentive. I highly recommend this place and will definitely return when I’m back in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are honored by your kind feedback! 🌟

   It’s fantastic to know that you enjoyed the quality of our massages and the attentiveness of our staff. Combining a long aromatherapy session with a foot massage is the perfect way to recharge, and we're glad you left feeling relaxed. Thank you for your loyalty and for recommending us to others. We look forward to being your go-to relaxation spot in Bangkok! 🙏🌿

reviews.name: H H
reviews.text:
I came across this massage place on Klook after searching up n down for massage along Asok area. I had the 60 min aroma massage with Jinny and I loved the entire massage!

I am someone fussy over massages and she massage all the right spots on my back as per what I requested (focus on back). Solid massage! 🤩

There are 5 body oils to pick from - cherry blossom, lavender, thai herbs, refreshing and coconut. I chose thai herbs as it is more minty, good for my sore muscles.

They serve tea and desserts as well.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful and detailed review! 💖

    We are thrilled that your search for the best massage in Asok led you to us. It is a huge compliment to hear that we satisfied someone as discerning as yourself! We will be sure to pass your praise along to Jinny she will be so happy to know she hit all the right spots and provided the relief you needed. 

   We’re also glad you enjoyed the Thai Herbs oil and our tea service. We look forward to welcoming you back for another 'solid' massage soon! 😊🙏✨

reviews.name: Licca Ohnishi
reviews.text:
【First visit in Dec2025】
I enjoyed 120 minutes experience with Body scrub +Aroma therapy so much and absolutely recommend it to all visitors from all over the world who need relaxation. Clean room and amazing people can make all relaxing process special and amazing.
【Second visit in Feb2026】
120 experience with Aroma massage was wonderful from the beginning with comfortable foot massage to the end with some good snacks.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 🌿✨
We’re truly happy to hear that you enjoyed the 120-minute body scrub and aromatherapy experience.
It means a lot to us that our clean rooms and caring team helped make your relaxation special.

Date of visit : Thurs 18th Jan 2024
Time : 2 pm

My repeat visit after 2 years.
I opted for the same traditional massage.
Price has gone up slightly from 700 to 750 baht.

The masseuse is good.
I enjoyed the massage.
Served with hot drinks at the end.

Date of visit : Thurs 18th Aug 2022
Time : about 4 pm

My friend called ahead to check if it’s opened.
From the outside, it looks like a big grand palace upon driving in.

The interior is nicely decorated and looks high class and chic. We booked a traditional massage for 2hrs each. A masseuse washed our feet first in the welcome area and then we were each ushered to our own private room upstairs. Lights were dimmed down.
I was asked to change into the spa garment. I had some problem wearing the pants, so my masseuse helped me with it.
I can’t speak Thai. But with the help of google translate, we managed some small talk. Her hands are quite good, smooth and gentle or strong if need be. In between, I was thirsty and so asked for a hot drink.

At the end, we were served some hot tea in the ground level reception area before taking our leave.

A wonderful authentic experience in a top class establishment.

reviews.name: MeadeF2
reviews.text: The room itself was very large, well air-conditioned and had a nice balcony too. The bed was clean and comfortable. I could not complain about the price either to be fair, I would say it is fine for an overnight or 2 night stay at most though. There is a sneaky 300 baht key deposit which is not mentioned at all on the website so beware. The location is not central Bangkok which may not suit some travellers but it is situated in a quiet and secure neighbourhood only a 30 minute taxi ride to Khao San Road which suited us just fine. Perhaps my biggest complaint would be the wifi situation. WiFi is provided but only for the first 24 hours of your stay and limited to one device, then you have to pay quite a steep price. Overall, it wasn't a bad place to stay but I would advise you to weigh out the pros and cons of this place before booking.

reviews.name: Maximilian Vogt
reviews.text:
The hotel is conveniently located not far from the MRT yellow line, the waterboat taxi, the Bankapi mall and the international hospital. You can reach all of them by feet in 10-15 minutes.

The area is quite low cost and not filled with tourists. The locals in the area are friendly and respectful. You won't see any "Hey brother, do you want a new bag?" guys here.

When I checked in, the room had a light cigarette smell. Apparently, someone smoked on the balcony and some of the smell came in the room. The service immediately did a deep cleaning and sprayed some refresherant. Other than that, I have no complaints. The room is a bit old, but had lots of space, the shower was warm and strong, the air conditioning brand new and the bed comfortable.

They have delivery shelves for both food and goods delivery right in front of the elevator. That way ordering Grab food or stuff from Shopee is very simple.

Last but not least, they have a very friendly and welcoming reception. If you have any questions or issues, they will help you with a smile. Some of them speak very good English, too.

reviews.name: Isuru “Isuru B” Bodahandi
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at Grand Mandarin Residence and overall had a satisfactory experience.

Positives:

The staff members were excellent – always cheerful, attentive, and professional, even when they were clearly very busy. Their service really left me with a good impression.

The girls at the small coffee stall next to the hotel entrance were also fantastic – very cheerful and welcoming. Plus, they make a really good mocha. 😉

Location is very convenient – close to a laundromat, restaurants, pharmacy, 7-Eleven, and only about a 15–20 minute walk to The Mall Bangkapi.

Rooms are a decent size and the cleanliness all around the hotel is very good, which I really appreciated.

Negatives:

I didn’t realize this was a budget hotel when I booked via Agoda, so my expectations were a little different.

While the room had a kettle, cups, complimentary water, soap, and tissues, I was surprised that toilet paper was not provided.

Bedding was changed daily, but the quality felt cheap (nylon), which made it less comfortable.

I stayed on the 8th floor – the inside of the hotel was quiet, but at night there was noticeable noise from bikes and vehicles on the road, even though my room didn’t face the street. Light sleepers may struggle unless the hotel improves soundproofing.

Overall:
Despite some shortcomings, I would say my stay was satisfactory. The friendliness of the staff and the convenience of the location stood out as the best parts of the experience. With some small improvements, this hotel could easily become a stronger option for travelers looking to stay in Bangkapi.

reviews.name: Антон Устименко
reviews.text:
Good massage technique, but very disappointing service and professionalism

We recently visited this place and unfortunately had a very uncomfortable experience.

When we arrived, I kindly asked to turn off the air conditioning because I currently have a cold and AC makes it difficult for me to breathe. They turned it off.

However, about 5 minutes after we started the massage, the AC was turned on again without asking me. I asked once more to switch it off, explaining again that I have a runny nose and it’s uncomfortable for me. They turned it off again.

Around 7–10 minutes later, the AC was turned on again without any communication. Instead of properly resolving the issue, we were asked to move to different beds. This constant relocation made it very difficult to relax. Shortly after, the room became cold again.

All of these interruptions — switching the AC on and off and moving us between rooms — significantly disrupted the session. In total, these interruptions effectively reduced my massage time by approximately 10 minutes.

Additionally, almost throughout the entire session (with only very brief pauses), the therapists were talking to each other about unrelated matters. This made it extremely difficult to relax and felt unprofessional in what should be a calm and quiet environment.

To be fair, the massage technique itself was not bad.

After the session, I asked for the contact of the manager or owner because I wanted to provide feedback directly. The receptionist said there was no phone number. When I asked for her name, she replied that she “didn’t know.” This response felt very strange and unprofessional.

Overall, while the massage technique was acceptable, the service, communication, and professionalism were disappointing.

hotelDescription:
This upscale hotel with landscaped gardens is 11 minutes' walk from Kata Beach, 3 km from the Khok Chang Kata Safari and 8 km from the Wat Chalong temple.
 The posh rooms come with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and iPod docks, plus tea and coffeemakers, minibars, and balconies with garden views. Luxe villas have whirlpool tubs and direct pool access.
 Breakfast and a beach shuttle are complimentary. Other amenities include an elegant Thai restaurant with fountains and ponds, plus an outdoor pool, a poolside bar and a spa. Cooking classes are offered.

reviews.name: Emmelin Larina Tvedt Nilsen
reviews.text:
This was honestly the most beautiful hotel we’ve ever stayed at.

If you’re looking for a more authentic Thai experience, away from the busiest tourist areas, Sawasdee is absolutely worth it. It feels like a hidden gem where you can really enjoy the culture while still having a peaceful and luxurious stay.

We stayed in the Cabana Suite with access to one of the swimming pools, and it was stunning. The room was spacious, beautifully designed, and the entire property was incredibly well maintained. It’s a bit old sure, but you could really tell that the staff take great pride in keeping everything clean and looking its best.

We did have a small issue with the air conditioning, as there was some condensation dripping occasionally. It wasn’t a major inconvenience for us, and the staff did everything they could to help. They came by every day to check on it and tried several times to fix the issue, which we really appreciated. Since it didn’t bother us much, we didn’t ask to change rooms.

The staff were kind, welcoming, and always happy to help, making us feel at home from the moment we arrived.

We would happily stay here again and would recommend Sawasdee to anyone looking for a beautiful, relaxing, and authentic place to stay in Thailand. Thank you for making our trip so special!

reviews.name: Clay Ca
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at Sawasdee Village for 3 days and 2 nights, and this was my second time returning. Honestly, the fact that I chose to come back already says a lot — but what made this stay even more special was that the staff actually remembered me from my previous visit.
That small but meaningful detail truly touched me. Not every hotel takes the time to remember returning guests, but here, I felt genuinely welcomed back. From the moment I checked in, there was a sense of warmth and familiarity that made the experience even more personal.
The hotel remains as beautiful as I remembered — rich in Thai character, peaceful, and full of charm. The atmosphere feels like stepping into a hidden sanctuary away from the busy streets of Phuket. The pool area is stunning both in the daytime and at night, and the overall ambiance is perfect for relaxation.
The room was clean, well-maintained, and very comfortable. Housekeeping was attentive and detailed every day. Most importantly, the service throughout the stay was sincere, friendly, and professional without ever feeling forced.
This place doesn’t just provide accommodation — it creates an experience. I will definitely return again on my next trip to Phuket.

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: We really enjoyed staying here. The architecture and the pool area were honestly one of my favorite parts. During daytime the hotel already looks very pretty, but at night it becomes absolutely stunning. The lights and the atmosphere make the whole place feel very special.  The hotel has everything you need — pool, gym, spa, bar, restaurant, and also a room where you can have tea, coffee, and snacks 24/7, which was actually very convenient after coming back late. The reception works all day and night, and every time we needed something, the staff helped us very fast. Everyone was friendly and welcoming during our stay.  I also really liked the breakfast. There were salads, fruits, muffins, omelettes, eggs in different styles, and honestly a lot of options. What surprised me the most was the coffee. Usually coffee from hotel coffee machines is not that good, but here it was actually very delicious. I took a macchiato almost every morning and really enjoyed it.  For me, this is one of those places that looks even better in real life than in pictures. Very aesthetic, relaxing, and perfect if you enjoy beautiful architecture and good atmosphere.

Breakfast each morning was amazing. The food was fresh and tasty and catered for everyone. We particularly loved the egg station.

The swim up bar was a welcome treat on some very hot days in the pool. The pool itself was impressive, even more so at night when lit up.

Our room was a highlight. The night lights created a calm atmosphere before sleeping in the comfiest bed. The little touches such as mosquito repellant and bathroom essentials were very thoughtful.

We had such a lovely time here and would love to return someday.

reviews.text:
Highly Recommended – A Truly Magical Stay in Phuket
Staying at Sawasdee Village Hotel, there is absolutely no doubt that you are in Asia. The hotel is beautifully decorated, with incredible attention to detail everywhere you look. From the beautiful flowers and swimming pool to the stunning artwork, Buddhist decorations, fountains, and relaxing meditation music playing softly in the background – everything creates a truly magical atmosphere.
The surroundings are simply breathtaking, and the whole place feels peaceful, authentic, and special.
The staff are incredibly kind, welcoming, and helpful – from the manager to the housekeeping team and the gardener. Everyone contributes to making your stay feel warm and personal.
A special thank you to K2 and Boy, who were always there with a smile and provided some of the funniest moments of our stay. 😊
And a big thank you to the lovely lady in the breakfast kitchen, who made the most delicious fried eggs and omelettes every morning. They were absolutely perfect!
We can only give Sawadee Village Hotel our very highest recommendation. A beautiful, magical place with wonderful people – we would happily come back again! ❤️

reviews.name: Jacinda Pappas
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, Sawasdee Village felt completely magical. Every detail the lush atmosphere, beautiful design, warm lighting, peaceful surroundings and incredible attention to detail made the entire stay feel so special.

The service was absolutely exceptional. Every staff member we encountered was warm, attentive, kind and genuinely welcoming. Nothing ever felt like too much trouble, and the hospitality had that rare quality where you feel truly looked after rather than simply accommodated.

The food was consistently delicious, fresh and beautifully presented, with so many wonderful Thai flavours throughout our stay. The entire property was also impeccably clean and maintained to an incredibly high standard, which made everything feel even more luxurious and relaxing.

And the spa and massage services were honestly to die for. The treatments were deeply relaxing, professional and beautifully done easily one of the highlights of our stay. The whole spa experience felt calm, indulgent and restorative from beginning to end.

Sawasdee Village is so much more than just a hotel. It feels like a hidden tropical sanctuary, full of character, beauty and genuine Thai hospitality. We left feeling completely relaxed, very spoiled and already wishing we could stay longer. An unforgettable experience and somewhere we would recommend without hesitation.
