It really is a must stay experience. The staff are very friendly. The place is clean and the rooms are beautifully presented. Highly recommend! 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for staying with us and for your review 🌺🙏! We are happy to hear that you enjoyed your time here and we hope to welcome you back to Sawasdee Village again in the future 🌞!

reviews.name: Karan
reviews.text:
Absolutely gorgeous hotel! From the moment we arrived, we were made to feel incredibly welcome. Every member of the staff was super friendly, always smiling, and genuinely helpful throughout our stay. Their warm hospitality really made a difference.

A special shout-out to the porter, Boy, who went above and beyond to make our stay feel like home. His kindness, attentiveness, and willingness to go the extra mile were truly exceptional. Thank you to the entire team for such a wonderful experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for staying with us and for your review 🌺🙏! We are happy to hear that you enjoyed your time here and I will pass your kind compliments to Boy and the team 🥳. We hope to welcome you back to Sawasdee Village again in the future 🌞!

reviews.name: odette coates
reviews.text: What a fabulous hotel! Super friendly staff who went out of the way to ensure you have everything you need for a great stay. The grounds are extensive with some lovely spaces to relax (outside of your room). Everything very clean and well maintained - and magical in the evening with all the lights. The pools are beautiful and the breakfast substantial and delicious. The beach shuttle is really handy (on the hour) - with the walk to the beach being an easy 10 minutes. Thank you to all staff at Sawasdee Village for such a wonderful week.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for staying with us and for your lovely review 😊🙏. We are very happy to hear that you enjoyed your stay and we hope to welcome you back to Sawasdee Village again! 🌺

reviews.name: Jerz
reviews.text:
Stayed at Sawasdee with my partner for 9 days, and I can honestly say it was nothing short of fantastic. The staff really looked after us, and the facilities, room, and food were all excellent.

The only minor comment I have is that the gym facilities could use a bit of an update. Other than that, I would definitely return to this hotel the next time I'm in Phuket.

A special shout-out to KJ for being so attentive and helpful throughout our stay. Thank you for making our experience even more enjoyable!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for staying with us and for your review and feedback regarding the gym facilities 🌺🙏! We are happy to hear that you enjoyed your time here and I will pass your kind compliments to K2 and the team 🌟. We hope to welcome you back to Sawasdee Village again in the future 🌞!

reviews.name: Hello Little Dance
reviews.text:
My husband and I have just spent a wonderful stay at Sawasdee Village while celebrating our 26th wedding anniversary, and we honestly didn’t want to leave.

We stayed in Room 315 and absolutely loved it. The swim-up pool and the privacy it offered made our stay feel so peaceful and relaxing. The room was beautifully maintained, the air conditioning worked perfectly, and we especially loved the amazing shower! It was also wonderfully quiet and dark at night, so we slept incredibly well every evening.

The staff were genuinely warm and welcoming, always greeting us with a smile and making us feel at home. We also took one of the resort’s cooking classes, which was a real highlight of our stay. Our chef and the whole team were fantastic, making it such a fun and memorable experience.

The location in Kata is perfect too—close enough to everything, yet it feels like a peaceful oasis. By the end of our stay, it truly felt like a home away from home.

To make our anniversary even more special, the team surprised us by decorating our bed with beautiful orchid petals, swan towels and a lovely handwritten note. It was such a thoughtful gesture and one we’ll always remember.

We’re visiting from Australia, and Sawasdee Village has been one of the highlights of our trip to Thailand. Thank you to everyone who made our anniversary so special. We can’t wait to come back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for choosing us for your 26th anniversary and for your lovely review 🌺. We are really happy to hear that you enjoyed your time here and I will surely pass your kind compliments to the whole team 🌟 - it means a lot to us to read such uplifting reviews. We hope to welcome you back to Sawasdee Village again in the future ☺️🙏!

reviews.name: Alexandros Kyrgiopoulos
reviews.text:
Our stay at Sawasdee Village was truly wonderful from start to finish. What stood out most was the kindness and professionalism of the staff — everyone was so warm, polite, attentive, and always ready to help with genuine care and a smile.

The hotel was spotless throughout our stay, with everything beautifully maintained and cared for. The service was excellent in every area, and the attention to detail made the whole experience feel smooth, comfortable, and relaxing.

Sawasdee Village has such a beautiful, peaceful atmosphere and feels like a little hidden oasis in Phuket. The design is stunning, full of character, and every part of the property feels calm and thoughtfully curated.

A charming and memorable stay with exceptional service, true hospitality, and a wonderfully relaxing atmosphere — we would happily return.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for staying with us and for such a thoughtful, lovely review 😊🙏. We are very happy to hear that you enjoyed your stay and I will pass your kind words to the team 🥳. We hope to welcome you back to Sawasdee Village again! 🌺

reviews.name: Hassan Akhtar (HASALI)
reviews.text:
It was a very nice resort, I really liked the Baray Villas, they were impressively decorated and you could probably fit 2 people sleeping on the sofa. Not sure if you would be allowed, but it was very comfortable. If I were to bring up the negatives, I would say the bed is quite firm, the shower should be thermostatic so that the temperature doesn’t fluctuate so much as it would be cold one minute and hot the next. I think a little bit of modernisation could be needed. Although all in all it was a very comfortable stay, although do bring insect repellents as there are a tonne of mosquitoes. Especially when you are swimming or lounging outside the in the Baray Villa shared pool.

Lastly I just want to mention that the staff were amazing and super friendly at all times, they really made the place feel special.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for staying with us and for your review feedback 🙏! We are happy to hear that you enjoyed your time here. I will forward your feedback to the management team - we always want to improve and your feedback helps us do so 🌞. Should you return to stay with us again, please let us know that you prefer a softer bed and pur housekeeping team can add another layer of soft topper for you 🌺. We hope to welcome you back to Sawasdee Village again in the future 🌞!

reviewContext.Safety: Very safe, the staff do look out for you.
reviewContext.Walkability: Not too far from the beach if you want to walk it, although you do have to go around the hotel in front, otherwise a shuttle leaves every hour.
reviewContext.Food & drinks: They do not offer halal food as the concierge mentioned. So we only stayed for breakfast which has a decent  buffet.

reviews.text:

I had a massage twice on the day we arrived and on the day before we left. The massage was excellent, especially the foot massage! We will definitely come back here.

I forgot the name of the woman masseuse, but try to find her. She can speak English and gives the right amount of pressure.

Their LINE account also replies very fast.

reviews.text:
Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Fitriatul Munawaroh
reviews.text: Amazing experience with Only! Best Thai massage I've had in a while. Very skilled, friendly, and attentive. Will definitely come back!

reviews.name: Jose Dahan
reviews.text: I originally came in just for a foot massage, but my therapist kindly included some neck and shoulder massage as well. I really appreciate his generosity and thoughtfulness. Great service and a very relaxing experience. Would definitely come back!

reviews.name: Oviya Cp
reviews.text: We had a body scrub with aromatic oil massage at Nikko Thai Spa and were really happy with Atom, our masseuse. She gave a firm massage that really worked out the knots, and the ambiance was super relaxing too. Would definitely go back!

reviews.name: Tam Nguyen
reviews.text: We had Koi & Pun for our 90mins full body and foot massage with Tiger cream! They are so good! Thank you so much!!

reviews.name: Sena Liu
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed with my experience here last night. Four of us booked a 60-minute foot massage. Two of my friends started at least 5 minutes later than the rest of us.
One of them finished way earlier while the other three of us were still having our massage, and the other friend who started late ended at exactly the same time as us. It’s obvious they cut our session time on purpose.

We brought this up to the receptionist. At first she insisted only one minute was missing. When we disagreed, she checked the CCTV and tried to trick us by claiming foot soaking time was included in the 60 minutes. We pointed out that soaking time was separate and shouldn’t count, yet she refused to admit their mistake at all. Only after they confirmed they had shortened our massage did they offer an extra 10 minutes, which we declined as we didn’t want to continue the service anymore.

Besides, the foot massage quality was poor — the therapist just kept rubbing oil on our feet without any proper pressure or technique.
We only asked for a reasonable refund for 5 minutes of one person’s missed massage time, but the receptionist kept arguing and kept showing us the security footage to avoid taking responsibility. We gave up arguing and left eventually. Terrible service, definitely will not come back and do not recommend to anyone.

reviews.name: Jolijn vd L
reviews.text:
I booked the neck shoulder and head massage and Rit gave this to me. The staff was very nice and before Rit washed my feet, explained to me how it would work as it was my first massage ever and handled it very respectfully.
In the hour I booked he really went along my whole body. Very firm and at some point (because of many knots) quite painful but in a good way which was needed. He really found all the good spots and also worked amongst my arms and hands. Afterwords I got some tea. Very nice experience! Would come back for sure.

reviews.name: Andrew Alexeyev
reviews.text: Amazing service for your money. Really great massage 🙏🙏

reviews.name: wang wang
reviews.text: The massage was extremely relaxing. The YA staff were very nice and patient. They kept checking if I was in pain and focused on the areas where my body felt uncomfortable. The service was very thorough. I would love to come back again! Highly recommended, five‑star rating.

reviews.name: Jurn Chan
reviews.text: Great quiet spot in this neighborhood. Was served by Kan. Greatly recommended for those who love their massage strong, very strong.

reviews.name: 顾漠璃
reviews.text: 5 stars for therapist Aof! He is a talented male masseur with perfect massage pressure. He relieved all my body soreness carefully, very polite and thoughtful. Totally worth coming back, highly recommended!

reviews.name: Devaraj
reviews.text: Went for the foot massage and traditional Thai massage, and it was a great experience. The service was excellent, especially from Kan. She was attentive and adjusted the pressure perfectly—not too hard, making the massage very relaxing and comfortable. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ameline Lim
reviews.text:
I had Koi as my masseuse. She was strong and effective. Really released my muscles, I slept like a baby during the massage.

Came back tonight again and we had AU and PO as our masseuses. They are both very good. AU’s technique is different and I enjoyed it very much.

reviews.name: Erica Parulan
reviews.text:
This is my second time visiting.

I went for the traditional thai massage and Noy did a great job I felt so relaxed!

reviews.name: Sarah Kay Dela Cruz
reviews.text:
Ple and Only are the best therapists I needed!

The place was clean, the therapists were super professional, and the pressure was perfect not too light, not too painful. I walked in tired and walked out feeling brand new. Definitely worth it and would totally come back again. 🤍

Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Brian Lavery
reviews.text:
Extremely poor service.

We went here previously as a couple and we made a reservation for a specific time. We turned up just before our reservation.

One therapist came and took us to the room and then started to massage one of us. No explanation.

Eventually we asked and were told someone else would come. Another 10 mins past and my gf (who is Thai) went downstairs to speak to the "manager" who said that because we chose a Thai herbal compress it took more time... which does not make sense, and even if were true it was not explained. We booked as a couple and we asked for a couple room, obviously we want to get massaged at the same time.

My gf asked for a refund. The manager refused. My gf asked to speak to the owner. The manager refused.

I hope the owner does see this because if you charge this much for a massage you need to provide service too. If it were a 250B massage I would not complain. We paid >1,000THB per person for an hour long massage, which is a very high price for this area.

The therapists were good. This is purely a case of dreadful service.

reviews.name: Hunter
reviews.text: I just had the best massage here with Only! From the moment I arrived, everyone was so warm and welcoming. Only took her time during my aromatherapy oil massage and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire experience. I’ll definitely be coming back very soon and would 100% recommend both this place and Only as your masseuse!

reviews.name: Haziqah
reviews.text: The massage here are very nice and affordable. The masseur p’mai is very gentle and know the point to massage making it very comfortable

reviews.name: Jiggee Jon
reviews.text: Newest branch just down the street from the first massage center. Tastefully set in a house down an alley, mere footsteps away from Pullman King Power where I stayed. Decently priced in very comfortable settings. Can’t go wrong with some quintessential Thailand self pampering here!

HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

reviews.name: Sheryl Biangco
reviews.text:
We decided to try Napa Massage because the place looked big, clean, and quite decent from the outside. Unfortunately, the experience didn’t really live up to expectations.

The staff weren’t very friendly, especially towards kids and even customers in general, which made the atmosphere feel a bit unwelcoming. As for the massages, they were quite average and not very satisfying.

Considering the price — 500 baht for a foot massage and 600 baht for a Thai massage — we’ve definitely had much better experiences at smaller massage shops for the same or even lower cost.

Overall, it looks good on the outside, but the service and quality could definitely be improved.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us. We sincerely apologize that your experience did not meet your expectations.

We would like to kindly clarify that our spa maintains certain guidelines regarding children, as we aim to provide a शांत and deeply relaxing environment for all guests. Most of our customers visit us to unwind and enjoy a peaceful atmosphere, so we do our best to ensure comfort and tranquility for everyone As our location is situated near a lively entertainment area, it can sometimes be challenging to fully manage the overall environment and guest flow.

The employee who did my pedicure, Tik, injured my nails and caused pain during the treatment. When I asked to stop the treatment because I was hurt, they actually blamed me instead of trying to help or apologize.

The manager, Grace, was very rude and unprofessional throughout the whole situation and refused to refund my money even after I was injured during the pedicure.

I would not recommend this place if you care about hygiene, professionalism, or respectful customer service.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
First of all, we sincerely apologize that your experience did not meet your expectations.

Before starting the service, our staff explained the full pedicure process and confirmed everything with you beforehand, and you agreed to proceed with the treatment. However, we understand that the result was still not what you expected, and we are truly sorry for your dissatisfaction.

Please understand that our shop also has policies regarding completed services. Even so, in this situation, we refunded the amount for the unfinished part of the service that was not completed for you. Therefore, the shop has already taken responsibility in accordance with our policy.

We always value customer feedback and will use your comments to improve our service and staff training in the future.

Thank you for your feedback.

reviews.text: The place is absolutely beautiful, and the staff are wonderful and incredibly polite. They welcomed me warmly and treated me with great care. I will definitely return for a second time and will do so whenever I visit Phuket. At the end, they gave me a glass of water after the massage and a lovely gift that I absolutely loved. I'm so happy I visited! 🥰 Visit them; you won't regret it. You'll love them! 🌷

reviews.name: Hamed Saghafi
reviews.text:
When I asked for the 600 baht oil massage, the staff told me that this massage would be very soft and light, and that if I wanted a stronger massage, I had to choose the 800 baht Thai oil massage instead.
Normally, oil massage is done with reasonable pressure in most places. Pushing customers to pay the highest price like this is not fair compared to other massage shops.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for sharing your feedback with us.
We truly apologize if there was any misunderstanding and if our explanation made you feel uncomfortable.

Our intention was only to explain the difference between each massage option, as they are designed with different techniques and pressure levels. The oil massage is generally more gentle and relaxing, while the Thai oil massage is intended for guests who prefer stronger pressure.

We would never want our guests to feel pressured to choose a higher-priced service. Your comfort and satisfaction are always our priority, and we truly appreciate your honest feedback, which helps us improve our service and communication.

Thank you again for bringing this to our attention. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again and provide you with a better experience.

reviews.name: Travel_with_me 2022
reviews.text:
I’ve been to this massage shop three times, and that alone says a lot. From foot massage to shoulders, neck, back, and full arm/hand massage, every treatment was consistently excellent.
It’s always hard to say if something is the best in Phuket, but I was convinced enough to keep coming back.
Special recommendation for Ping – if you want a strong, professional massage done with real passion and effort, ask for him. You can clearly feel that he knows exactly what he’s doing.
Clear recommendation. Worth every visit.

reviews.name: Aly Aly
reviews.text:
Title: Disappointing Experience – Unprofessional and Commercialized

We were two couples who visited based on the “Tripadvisor Award Winner” sign displayed at the entrance — but unfortunately, our experience was extremely disappointing.

The service was very poor and felt overly commercial. One of the masseuses assigned to me was rude, unprofessional, and lacked basic courtesy, making it very uncomfortable to relax. After 15 minutes, we politely requested a change, but were told no changes or refunds are allowed — our only option was for her to continue or leave.

This is not the level of service expected from a supposedly “award-winning” establishment. Customer care and respect were clearly lacking. I do not recommend this place, and we won’t be returning.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your review. We’re sorry to hear that your experience didn’t meet your expectations.

We’d like to clarify that the selected service was a Foot Massage (500฿), and the session had continued for over 15 minutes before a therapist change was requested. As per our policy, changes or refunds are not possible after 15 minutes of service.

Please also note that our staff did not ask you to leave. It was your decision to stop the session and exit after being informed of the policy.

We appreciate your feedback and will continue working to improve our service.

title: Varalee Massage II
ownerDescription: บริการนวดแผนไทยและสปาแพคเกจ
address: 26/5-6 Nimmana Haeminda Rd Lane 13 Nimmanhaemin Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand

reviews.name: Nattkrita Juntapa
reviews.text:
I recently visited Varalee Massage and had a wonderful experience from start to finish. The atmosphere was calm, clean, and very relaxing, making it the perfect place to unwind after a long day.❤️❤️

The staff were friendly, professional, and attentive. My therapist was highly skilled and adjusted the pressure perfectly to suit my needs. I chose a traditional Thai massage, and it was both refreshing and deeply relaxing. I could feel the tension in my muscles gradually melt away.

The prices were very reasonable for the quality of service provided, and the overall environment felt welcoming and comfortable. I also appreciated how attentive the staff were to hygiene and customer comfort.

I would highly recommend Varalee Massage to anyone looking for a quality massage experience. I will definitely come back again!💕

reviews.name: WING CHUNG CHAN
reviews.text: It is the worst massage shop in chiang mai or even in thailand. The staff have no technique and too powerful to press my spine, i kept requesting him lower the strength but he ignored. I paid for 2 hours massage and finally i stop him in the middle. I feel my back and spine pain after the massage even it is already finished more than 12 hours after a sleep. I believe they buy for 5 star review to wash out real bad review. I took a look for 1 star review after the worst massage, i see there were very similar bad experience in google review. Very very bad experience and i will report them in google to check the 5 stars review they received are valid or not!

reviews.name: Yusuf’s Hotspots
reviews.text:
We took Package 5 and it was a wonderful experience! What I really liked is that they are very flexible — you can adjust your package to your own preferences. For example, you can swap a foot massage for a head, back & shoulder massage, or even a Thai massage if you prefer.

The staff is very kind and professional, the place is clean, cozy, and relaxing. The massage itself was excellent — they really know what they’re doing. We felt completely relaxed afterwards. Highly recommended! 🙏✨

reviews.name: Calvin Duong (The Goods)
reviews.text:
I recently had an amazing experience at Varalee Massage 2 in Thailand! My massage therapist, Ton, was fantastic. This was my first traditional Thai massage, and it was definitely different from what I'm used to. Ton worked on areas I didn't even realize needed attention, and I felt so relaxed afterward.

I took advantage of their special deal for 800 Baht, which included a 2-hour body Thai massage, a foot massage, and a Thai herbal ball hot compress massage. The herbal ball compress was a new experience for me, and it added a unique touch to the overall treatment. The service was exceptional, and I was pleasantly surprised with some tea, watermelon, and biscuits afterward. It made the whole experience even more enjoyable! Highly recommend checking it out!

reviews.name: Samson Y
reviews.text: Happy with the massage here, hoping to come back again. Masseur puts good pressure and was caring enough to ask if i was okay due the an unexpected cracking sound. . I have a weird back lol happy to have a watermelon and tea after too 😊😊

reviews.name: Dinos Moust
reviews.text:
Mr. Aui, I can’t thank him enough for the incredible Thai massage, finishing with some oil on the areas that needed extra attention. Truly one of the best massages I’ve had in years.

Very professional, intuitive, and knowledgeable — he knew exactly where to press to help release tension without me needing to explain anything. It genuinely felt like he could understand what my body needed.

All I had to do was relax and enjoy the experience. I’ll definitely be back.

reviews.name: Sai Mohan
reviews.text: Had a wonderful 2-hour oil massage at Varalee Massage II for just 700 THB. The therapists were very skilled — they found and released all the deep knots in our bodies. The place was clean, calm, and professional. Excellent value for money and one of the best massage experiences we’ve had in Chiang Mai. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: rhino pink
reviews.text: The price is quite reasonable; a two-hour package costs only 700 baht, and afternoon tea and fruit are included after the massage, so it's highly recommended.

reviews.name: Elena Izvekova
reviews.text:
I love this place, good location, kind receptionist, gentle and delicate master.
Fall in love with the decoration, a real Thai touch. There many details.
I got a package for 2 hours just for 900 bhat. Good scrub, body oil massage and head, neck and shoulders. After ceremony got a tea and snacks.
Recommend 🫶🏼🧡

reviews.name: Catherine
reviews.text: The massage here is absolutely amazing, and the place itself is beautiful. I’ve been coming here around 7 times already, and it never disappoints. The therapists are wonderful, I leave happy every single time. I also really appreciate that they provide clothing for the massage, it makes everything so much more comfortable. After the session, they offer tea, which is such a nice touch. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Cleidiane Soares
reviews.text:
The best foot and hand massage I’ve done
My husband did foot & hand with a male therapist and he loved it!
Very nice place

reviews.name: Liberato Martinez
reviews.text: Great spot!  This is now my regular go to in Chiang Mai. Clean and great massage. Air conditioning. I will return.

reviews.name: kaki
reviews.text: This was by far the best massage I’ve ever had in Chiang Mai! The therapist was incredibly tender, attentive, and thoughtful—her acupressure was spot-on, hitting every pressure point perfectly, and her overall techniques were impeccable. What stood out most was how I could feel both her professionalism and genuine care throughout the entire session. It was such a relaxing, rejuvenating experience that left my muscles loosened up and my mind totally at ease. I can’t recommend this place enough to anyone looking for a top-notch massage with precise acupressure in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Samia Kamel Mahmoud Hegazi

reviews.name: Luka C
reviews.text: Wow this was the best massage in Chiang Mai I had so far. Very relaxing and strong. I feel so good now. Will come back! They even gave me some melon after  :)

reviews.name: Mr. Steve Barber
reviews.text:
Great place for all!

I had a very relaxing experience at Varalee Massage II. The staff is incredibly skilled and professional, ensuring a comfortable environment throughout the session. The massage helped me unwind completely, and the prices are very reasonable for the high quality of service you receive. It’s a clean and peaceful spot that I would definitely visit again.

reviews.name: Scott Simmons
reviews.text: Very nice place with a comfortable atmosphere and fantastic massages. A 1 hour Thai massage was a great way to restore and relax me at the end of a long week. The watermelon and tea at the end gave me the boost I needed to finish the day!

reviews.name: Capri Isabel Gutiérrez
reviews.text: My first massage ever and it was so lovely! They are very professional and a great price. My masseuse made sure to check on me and make sure I was comfortable. Beautiful spa

reviews.name: Jocelyn Ramirez
reviews.text: Jean and Nun are truly exceptional masseuses, if you’re fortunate enough to receive their care, you’ll feel like you’re in the best hands imaginable. My friend and I walked in around 5 p.m. for a two-hour massage and, to our surprise, there was no wait at all. The service was seamless, the atmosphere relaxing, and the skill level outstanding. I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone visiting Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: benjamin Rav
reviews.text:
An excellent massage parlour. The welcome is very warm, with lovely staff. The place is quiet and clean. My masseuse, Chon, was very professional. Her massage was incredible.
Many thanks

reviews.name: Sudawan Pornpattanayut -
reviews.text:
มีอาการหมอนรองกระดูกคอทับเส้นประสาท เลยเข้ามาปรึกษาและลองทำกายภาพด้วยการดึงคอ ตอนแรกแอบกังวลและคิดว่าน่าจะน่ากลัว แต่พอได้ทำจริง ๆ รู้สึกสบายกว่าที่คิดมากค่ะ 😊

คุณหมอและพนักงานน่ารัก ให้คำแนะนำและดูแลดีมาก ไม่ยัดเยียดคอร์ส สถานที่สะอาด บรรยากาศดี ทำให้รู้สึกผ่อนคลาย หลังทำรู้สึกคอและตัวสบายขึ้นมาก ประทับใจมากค่ะ ใครที่กลัวการดึงคอเหมือนเรา อยากบอกว่าไม่น่ากลัวอย่างที่คิดเลยค่ะ 🤍
reviews.textTranslated:
I had symptoms of cervical disc herniation compressing a nerve, so I came in for a consultation and tried neck traction therapy. At first, I was a little worried and thought it would be scary, but in reality, it was much more comfortable than I expected. 😊

The doctor and staff were lovely, providing excellent advice and care. They didn't push any extra courses. The place was clean and the atmosphere was great, making me feel relaxed. After the treatment, my neck and body felt much more comfortable. I was very impressed. For anyone who is afraid of neck traction like me, I want to say it's not as scary as you think! 🤍

reviews.name: Wongduan Jaitengthum
reviews.text: มีอาการปวดคอบ่าไหล่ เป็นครั้งแรกที่ได้มาทำกายภาพกับนักกายภาพบำบัดโดยตรง และรู้ว่ามีความเสี่ยงที่เป็นกระดูกคอปลิ้นประมาณ 70-80% พี่โก้ให้คำแนะนำและให้ความรู้ในการดูแลตัวเองดีมากค่ะ นวดคลายเส้นตรงจุดสุดๆค่ะ แบบที่นวดแผนไทยให้ไม่ได้ 😂 มาซ้ำแน่นอนค่า คลินิคสะอาด บริการดีมากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I had neck, shoulder, and back pain. This was my first time receiving physical therapy directly from a physiotherapist, and I learned there's about a 70-80% risk of cervical herniation. Brother Ko gave excellent advice and information on self-care. The massage was incredibly effective at relieving tension points – something a Thai massage can't achieve! 😂 I'll definitely be back. The clinic is clean and the service is excellent.

reviews.name: Kanokporn Niamraksa
reviews.text: มาแก้อาการปวด คอ บ่า ไหล่ รักษาดีมาดค่ะ พนักงานดูแลดี อาการดีขึ้นเลยค่ะ ไว้จะมาซ้ำค่า
reviews.textTranslated: I came here to treat my neck, shoulder, and back pain. The treatment was excellent. The staff were attentive, and my symptoms improved significantly. I'll definitely come back again!

reviews.name: ek_haru
reviews.text: คลินิกสะอาด เครื่องมือทันสมัย หลังทำกายภาพแล้วอาการดีขึ้นมาก ราคาไม่แพง 😊
reviews.textTranslated: The clinic is clean and the equipment is modern. My condition improved significantly after physical therapy, and the price is affordable. 😊

reviews.name: tonefon poommila
reviews.text: เธออออ ชั้นมากายภาพครั้งแรก เพราะปวดมากกก วันสามสิบกว่าปวดไปทั้งร่างค่ะ วันนี้มา Shockwave ที่สะโพกและขา ดีมากก ผ่อนคลายขึ้นมาก บริการดีมาก มีสอนออกกำลังกายด้วยนะ คือกลับบ้านไปกายภาพตัวเองต่อราคาก็ดี ใช้ประกันได้ด้วย เริ่ด คุ้ม
reviews.textTranslated: Hey everyone! This is my first time at physical therapy because I'm in so much pain! My whole body aches in the 30s. Today I had shockwave therapy on my hips and legs, and it was amazing! I feel so much more relaxed. The service was great, and they even taught me exercises so I can continue the therapy at home. The price was good too, and they accepted my insurance. It's a great deal!

reviews.name: Surada S.
reviews.text: เจ้าหน้าที่ให้คำแนะนำดีมากเลยค่ะ บริการก็ดี ขั้นตอนการทำกายภาพบำบัดก็มีการอธิบายแนะนำอย่างละเอียด อุปกรณ์ทุกอย่างสะอาด รักษาอย่างสบายใจเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The staff provided excellent advice and the service was great. The physical therapy procedure was explained in detail, and all the equipment was clean. I felt very comfortable during the treatment.

reviews.text: หลังจากที่ได้รับการวิเคราะห์และคำแนะนำจาก คุณโก้ ผ่านทางวีดีโอคอล ทำให้ผมมีการพัฒนาขึ้นอย่างเห็นได้ชัด คือ กรณีเข่าทรุดไม่ค่อยแข็งแรง เมื่อทำตามคำแนะของคุณโก้แล้วทำให้เข่าแข็งแรงขึ้นไม่สั่นเวลาเดิน รู้สึกเชื่อมั่นและประทับใจครับ แนะนำสำหรับคนที่ทำกายภาพเองที่บ้าน มีประโยชน์มาก ๆ เลยครับ ขอบคุณครับ

I highly recommend this service for those doing physical therapy at home; it's very beneficial. Thank you.

Thank you so much!

title: Sabai massage and spa, Phuket airport branch
subTitle: Sabai massage,Phuket Airport branch

reviews.name: Maria Jade Tichepco
reviews.text:
Sabai Sabai Massage is one of those places that doesn’t immediately stand out from the outside. It’s very unassuming, and honestly, I’m usually skeptical of massage places with lots of five-star reviews because sometimes they don’t match the actual experience.

But I saw Sabai Sabai on Klook as well, and after reading the reviews, I decided to give it a try. Booking was quick and hassle-free, and they confirmed my reservation almost immediately.

When I arrived, it wasn’t overcrowded, but there were enough customers to know the place was popular. The best part was that there was no waiting time they have plenty of therapists available. I also noticed several guests with luggage, so I guess it’s a favorite stop for travelers either heading to or coming from Phuket Airport.

For context, I had just traveled from the Philippines to Singapore, then Singapore to Phuket, so my body was exhausted. I had already walked around 25,000 steps, and my feet were really sore.

I booked the 60-minute Foot Massage, and my therapist was Pong.

At first, I was a little shy, especially since I was traveling solo, but Pong immediately made me feel comfortable. She was gentle, professional, and knew exactly where to apply the right amount of pressure. By the end of the massage, the soreness in my feet was completely gone, and I felt incredibly relaxed.

If you’re a solo traveler like me, don’t worry you won’t feel out of place here. Everyone is warm, welcoming, and genuinely hospitable.

If you visit Sabai Sabai Massage, I highly recommend requesting Pong. She did an amazing job, and I can honestly say the excellent reviews are well deserved, they’re real.

Thank you, Sabai Sabai Massage, for making the start of my Phuket trip so relaxing.

reviews.name: 김진희
reviews.text: Probably the best massage shop near the airport! We stayed one night at Nai Yang Beach and were looking for a nearby massage place. We chose this one because it had the best reviews, and it definitely lived up to them. We had the 1.5-hour Herbal Ball Compress Massage, and it was absolutely worth it! I highly recommend it if you prefer a relaxing massage rather than a very strong, deep-pressure one. The facilities were also very clean, and we were completely satisfied. Would definitely come back!

reviews.name: Meenakshy JS
reviews.text: Very soothing massage experience.  Took their package for one hour and got an absolutely comfortable hospitality and head massage. The initial foot wash with some salt felt really nice. The chairs and whole atmosphere is very good feeling and ample space to sit and relax before and after the massage. The after massage refreshments are also good than other massage centers we have been to in Phuket 👍 💝 Well Done Team Sabai

reviews.name: Angel Kuo
reviews.text:
I’ve been to Thailand many times, and this is the first place that truly felt like an authentic Thai massage.
Ponsle was incredibly attentive and thorough — she massaged every part of my body, literally from head to toe. I could feel all my tight fascia and muscles being released.

What impressed me most was her professionalism and attention to detail: every time after massaging my feet, she washed her hands before moving on to other parts of the body. Very hygienic and thoughtful.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a genuine Thai massage experience. If time allows, definitely choose 90 minutes or longer — it’s worth it!

reviews.name: Supriya Muley
reviews.text:
I had a foot massage at Sabai and it was absolutely awesome. The atmosphere was relaxing, the service was professional, and I left feeling completely refreshed.

A special thank you to Laki, my therapist. She was attentive, skilled, and made sure the pressure was perfect throughout the session. One of the best foot massages I’ve had.

Highly recommend Sabai, and if you get the chance, ask for Laki! I’ll definitely be back. ♥️

reviews.name: Glopatra Mokgadi Ramalepe
reviews.text: Excellent experience,  From the front desk you get a warm welcome by a beautiful lady.  She took her time to explain services and offered me water while I wait for my turn. The massage lady was so good. After 5 days in Thailand and a tired body I really needed this and she outdone herself. Thank you for spectacular service

reviews.name: Махаббат Шаймерденова
reviews.text: Great massage salon Sabai! Clean, affordable, and with excellent service. The staff are very attentive the massage is amazing and relaxing, and they finish with a lovely tea ceremony. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Pink Merl Design Co.
reviews.text: Got an amazing 90 minute massage and facial! The staff is so lovely and attentive and the whole process was relaxing from start to finish. I had Penny as my massage therapist and she did a great job (sorry if I misspelled her name) 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.name: 미소
reviews.text: I got a foot massage for an hour, and they used tools to cool me down. They massage my shoulders after my feet are done, and that's amazing. They did a great job. The facilities are pleasant, air-conditioned, and I think I'll come back again next time.

reviews.name: Prakriti Gaur
reviews.text: We took the full body massage and it was really really great. Very professional and warm staff. Just a short drive from the airport. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Kyaw Maw
reviews.text: Excellent service and very relaxing atmosphere. The therapist did an amazing job releasing my muscle tension. I’ll definitely come back! Treated with refreshing towel and snacks and tea afterwards.

reviews.name: Jen
reviews.text:
I had a great experience here. The staff were professional, kind, and really listened to my concerns about chronic neck and back pain.

My masseuse, Pa, was incredibly skilled and able to relieve a lot of tension in my shoulders and back. I also appreciated that they respected my request not to touch my scalp after surgery.

After the session, I felt much more relaxed with far less pain and stiffness. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a professional and therapeutic massage. Thank you again Pa!

reviews.name: Janitta Horbutr
reviews.text: I did oil and foot massage for 2 hours after long trips of traveling and doing sports with P’ Luk. She is very professional at sport massage and relief tightness of my muscles. Will visit again !

reviews.name: dhouha ghribi
reviews.text:
My first massage in Phuket and wow — what an amazing start! 💆‍♀️ I did a 1-hour oil massage at Sabai Massage & Spa near the airport, and it was pure bliss. The place is super clean, the staff are so kind and professional, and the atmosphere instantly makes you relax. They also sell massage products, and I bought a cream and coconut oil for home use — love them!
I walked out feeling lighter, calm, and completely refreshed. ✨ Highly recommend this spot if you’re flying in or out of Phuket or if you have a short stay in Phuket — the perfect way to start or end your trip! 🙏🌿

reviews.name: Sharon Mark
reviews.text: Comfortable massage w use of essential oil to enhance the relaxing experience. Clean! Yummy snacks and tea. Good find in Phuket!

reviews.name: Sydney Ng
reviews.text: Can't get any better for a quick fix. Had the 60min foot and head massage and it was really good for the price. The massage chairs were in a room with a full length glass window facing the main road so its unnecessarily bright. Still dozed off mid-massage bcos it was that good! Worth a visit if u ready in the area.

reviews.name: Alina Camelia Musat
reviews.text:
I had such a wonderful experience here! The place is incredibly cozy and beautifully designed — you can feel the relaxing atmosphere as soon as you walk in. They welcome you with a refreshing cold lemongrass drink, which is such a nice touch. I loved that they let you choose the oil for your massage, adding a personal and thoughtful detail to the service.

The massage itself was fantastic, and everything about the space is spotless — very clean and well maintained. At the end, they complete the experience with a warm lemongrass drink and a small snack, which makes you feel truly cared for from start to finish.

This place is not only professional but also feels very warm and inviting. Highly recommend if you’re looking for massage in a beautiful setting!

reviews.name: Kamilla György Ullholm
reviews.text:
I went for a simple thai massage and got out releaved and so much better shape than before!

Hands down, the best thaimassage place I've been to ever. And that is no exageration. I had thai massage lots of times before and love it, but this time I  had a shoulder injury and was a bit worried, it might hurt if they are not cautious.  The condition I have is so called frozen shoulder and it means a lot of pain even just laying down on your belly. Shourosha, the massage lady who took care of me was so very knowledgable, understood directly the problem, even with very limited English, just by seeing and feeling with her hands as she did the massage so at some point she says "take away your pain, ok?" And as I agreed she started giving that shoulder extra attention. And it worked! After one hour with her I have gained more mobility in my shoulder than with two weeks of recovery training.
Also, as many others have mentioned before me, the variaty of their services is great. They have a package for every occasion.  Also the service is top notch. You'll see. No exagaration.

Once again, khap kun khaaa, Shourosha! This means a lot to me.

Update after second massage with the same lady: It was really hard to find her when I went back and tried to book a new massage with the same lady. I said her name, but the receptionists couldn't recognize the name. They showed me pictures, but I couldn't find her. Finally gave up and then happened to meet her on the street. Turns out, in the saloon they know her by the name PONG. So ask for Pong if you need help with frozen shoulder syndrome.

I got almost my complete movement range back. This is to.me completely unbelievable. I mean doctors and physiotherapiats tried to help me for months now ..  I was told it would take me years to recover. And now this old lady just made me feel better in two massage sessions, just by knowing which triggerpoint to assess. I am in awe and bow to this amazing tradition.

reviews.name: Ig1rka
reviews.text: Very nice place!!! I had a foot massage here, it was fantastic and unforgettable. If you want to get a massage, come here, the best massage parlor! The room is very nice and clean, as well as very comfortable chairs. The first is a foot wash, followed by a really relaxing massage, and at the end, a delicious tea with some food.

reviews.name: Greg Yap
reviews.text:
professional massage house offering a variety of packages..

clean, large and roomy rooms. relaxing back ground music.

reception staff speaks English.. masseuse experienced and professional.

overall, an enjoyable and relaxing experience

reviews.name: Putra Bagus

reviews.name: Pui Shan Kung
reviews.text:
This massage parlor was the worst I've been to in Bangkok in the past five years. If you want to experience lazy and rude service, go for this place. I was misled by its high 4.9 rating on Google reviews, thinking it was a great value. However, it was a completely terrible experience. The massage techniques were even worse than at JJ Market.

They had absolutely no skill, just using their knuckles to press on you. The entire back and feet were massaged with the same technique for 60 minutes. It was uncomfortable, and the masseuse chatted with the other masseuse. You could tell she was incredibly lazy. My partner's masseuse was the same.

Their masseuses were extremely lazy in their massages. We will never go back to this place. Even complaining to the front desk didn't get a satisfactory result; they just said that my masseuse had already been complained about three times. I don't know how they maintain the reputation of this place. We had a 90-minute full-body massage, and we really wanted it to end early because we felt it was a waste of my time. It was a huge waste of my time and money, because it was such a terrible and lazy experience.

I suggest you don't blindly trust Google's ratings; this is a genuine experience!

reviews.name: Narintra
reviews.text:
Disappointing Experience: Poor Management and Unprofessional Service
We decided to book this place based on its high 4.9-star rating on Google. We didn't hesitate to brave Bangkok's heavy traffic, spending over an hour on the road just to get here.

"A message to the owners: with such unprofessional management in place, your business's failure is inevitable."
We booked a 90-minute Oil Massage for one person and a 90-minute Warm Oil Massage for the other via Line. Upon arrival, the receptionist confirmed our choices. We were fully aware of and happy to pay the additional charges—200 THB extra for the warm oil and 150 THB per person for a private room—as clearly stated on the menu, for our own comfort.
While the reception and the therapists' actual massage skills were up to standard, the first 20 minutes were far from relaxing due to staff gathering, chatting, and laughing loudly right outside our room.
To make matters worse, the therapists ended the session after only 60 minutes. When we went downstairs, the manager simply told us it was a "therapist mistake" and offered a 30-minute foot massage or a 30-minute head, neck, back, and shoulder massage in a shared room as compensation. This solution felt completely rude and unprofessional, especially for a well-known establishment with multiple branches in Bangkok. There is a clear price difference on the menu between what we paid for and what was offered, not to mention we had already paid extra for a private room.
The most disappointing part was the complete lack of a sincere apology. The manager showed an unprofessional attitude and looked visibly annoyed when we raised our concerns. In the end, she handed us a 500 THB refund and walked away with a very unfriendly expression. On top of that, unlike typical massage shops, there was no welcome or post-massage hot tea and snacks provided.
A 4.9-star rating should come with 4.9-star management. Sadly, this was not the case.

reviews.name: Shalli Ang
reviews.text: This massage parlor in Ratchathewi has a nice exterior and a pleasant atmosphere. The presentation was well done. That said, the massage skills were average. The therapist was young and lacked strength, even after I asked for increased pressure. Overall, a nice ambiance, but the massage was just acceptable.

reviews.name: Duy Hao Tang
reviews.text: I had an amazing massage experience! The atmosphere was clean, relaxing, and very professional. A special thanks to Noon—her technique was excellent, the pressure was perfect, and I felt completely refreshed afterward. One of the best massages I've ever had. Highly recommended, and I'll definitely be back!

reviews.name: Natnicha T T
reviews.text:
I had the best massage experience of all time at Nikko Thai Massage. Even though I’m Thai and have had many Thai massages before, I can honestly say this is the best Thai massage I’ve ever had in my life.

The atmosphere is amazing the vibes are relaxing, welcoming, and comfortable from the moment you walk in. The employees are incredibly kind, funny, and professional, which makes the whole experience even better. They really know how to make you feel relaxed and taken care of.

I had my massage with P’Lek and P’Bow, and they were both fantastic. They were very skilled, attentive, and made the whole experience even more enjoyable.

I would 100% recommend Nikko Thai Massage to anyone. It’s a very safe and friendly environment for everyone, whether you’re a local or a visitor. If you’re looking for an authentic Thai massage with great service and great people, this place is definitely the one to go to.

reviews.name: Cary Cheung
reviews.text: I can take a good relax here, thank you Ms. Bow to bring me have a good relax.  The massage therapists were all very nice. I came for two days and had three sessions. Their techniques and skills were excellent.

reviews.name: Te Re
reviews.text:
I recently had a Thai massage at Nikko Massage in Ratchachewi branch and it was an amazing experience from start to finish. The space was clean, peaceful, and very welcoming, which immediately helped me relax.

My massage therapist, Na-ree, was exceptional. This was one of the best Thai massages I’ve had. She was very skilled with the stretches and pressure techniques, making sure everything felt comfortable while still being deeply effective. I felt a perfect balance of relaxation and muscle relief throughout the session.

reviews.name: Sydrich Avecilla
reviews.text:
First time doing a real Thai massage. Felt amazing and my masseuse Dreamy knew what she was doing. After doing daily 25,000 steps in Thailand, my body hurt everywhere. Dreamy hit all the right spots with good pressure, all the while asking if the massage's pressure was okay. After an hour of the Thai massage, my body felt great and my blood was circulating well.

Paid 350 Baht for the Thai Massage for 1 hour and it was definitely worth the price. Will come again before I leave Thailand.

reviews.name: Dr Dennis Chan
reviews.text:
I came here one day for the 90 sport massage
and then came back a few days later for 2 hrs signature massage.

Incredible experience that i had to come back.  By coincidence, i had the same massage therapist ( Na-Ree) which I appreciated as well.  Her fingers could feel what areas need attentions without you telling her.  She definately has passion for her job.

sidenote: I did try another place closer to my hotel but after that experience, I went back to Nikko for a 2nd time.  i could have gone more many more times if I had a longer stay in Bangkok.

reviews.name: 08 ณัฐสุรีย์ ตระกูลกิจเจริญ
reviews.text: I recently had a massage therapist in Nikko Thai massage. I booked an oil therapy appointment with Miss Bow as my massager. Consequently, I had a wonderful experience in this place. Moreover, the massage room is wonderful very quiet and relaxing. I would 100% recommend this massage place if you come to Thailand.❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥

reviews.name: Noviana S
reviews.text: We walked around the neighborhood and glad we found this place! We booked 60 minutes of foot massage and neck+shoulder which turned into an amazing experience! Aom and June were so friendly and the pressure was just perfect. The price is so decent too! They gave us hot tea after massage and it was really nice😊 worth the visit!

reviews.name: Vivienne Schaum
reviews.text:
Just finished the Massage there. My husband had the Thai 90 Min (500 Baht), I had the Neck/Back Hot Stone & Oil (1200 Baht). Two stars, because my husband was satisfied with his Massage - for me (having ~ 80 Massages in my life) one of the worst I‘ve ever had.
Long story short: No Expertise in Hot Stone, oil Part was only ok. Believe that Thai is their expertise - everything else is just to „look good“ on the menu. The Lady was a Bit oberwhelmed with oil and Stones and it felt as if they gave both of them to her to somehow „include“ it into a semi-Thai Massage.

Don’t make the same mistake as I did and spend too much money for something that is not worth it. I am happy to pay some Baht for a good Massage - but After that Massage now I am quite disappointed.

BTW: They wash your feet at the beginning, you get clothes to change and at the end you get a tea afterwards.

reviews.name: Stephanie Bracken
reviews.text: The massage by Yaya and Yelly was 10/10! Both my husband and I were so relaxed. Pressure was great & masseuse was able to adjust accordingly. The outlet was also a crosswalk away from the MRT station or easily accessible by Grab/Bolt.

reviews.name: Ngô Doanh
reviews.text: The massage was incredible! Ms.Naree is so talented and attentive. I walked in feeling exhausted and left feeling like a new person. Thank you so much and I love Thailand!

reviews.name: Elli
reviews.text: I went spontaneously on my last day here in Thailand and it was the best idea I could've had. Madam Bow massages every last knot out of my back + neck. 100/10 massage, these are professionals that know what they are doing.

reviews.name: Greta Järvling
reviews.text: Our first massage here in Thailand. Just amazing! I choose a 60 min back, neck massage with balm. It was so lovely. Boy (the massage therapist) was so professional and so kind! Felt really comfortable and relaxed here. I really recommend this place! I understand why the place has such high rating. Got served tea afterwards.

reviews.name: Chi Mai
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Nikko Massage in Ratchathewi, Bangkok.
The place is very clean, pleasantly scented, and has a calm, relaxing atmosphere. The staff are friendly and professional, from younger to older therapists are skilled and well-trained. I was especially impressed with how well they’ve been trained in customer service and etiquette; throughout the services, I felt genuinely cared for and looked after by all the staffs here.

I was especially impressed by therapist Aom, who has excellent technique and great hands. She was very attentive and adjusted the pressure perfectly to my needs. Mrs Aom made the whole experience deeply relaxing.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a quality massage in Bangkok

reviews.name: Nabihah
reviews.text: the service is very good from the beginning until the end. i got ying to do my massage and she’s really good and very gently. will definitely come again!

reviews.name: GillMouse227
reviews.text:
The salon is very clean with a quiet and relaxing atmosphere. The staff are friendly, professional, and the prices are very reasonable.

Our group of four was served by June, Bow, Nik, and Yumi. They were all extremely kind and skilled, and we were very happy with the massage.

I highly recommend this place if you are looking for a great massage experience. Definitely worth a visit

reviews.text:
I had a really solid experience at Lek Massage near BTS National Stadium. I went for a 60-minute neck, shoulder, and back massage with a herbal compress, and it delivered exactly what I needed.

The masseuse was attentive from the start—she checked in on my pain levels and adjusted the pressure accordingly, which I appreciated. It didn’t feel like a routine, rushed session. She actually worked into the tight areas, especially around my upper back and traps, where I usually carry a lot of tension.

The herbal compress was a nice addition. The heat helped loosen things up, and it made the whole session feel more effective rather than just relaxing. I walked out feeling noticeably lighter and less stiff.

The place itself is clean, comfortable, and well-organized. It has a professional feel without being overly fancy or overpriced.

Most importantly, I felt taken care of, not just processed as another customer. For the price I paid, it was definitely worth it—no complaints from me.

If you’re dealing with tight shoulders or back fatigue, this is a reliable spot to get proper relief.

Sorry for not taking picture inside to respect the privacy of others 🙏

reviews.text:
I work as a massage therapist and massage instructor in both Japan and France. Of course, this time I came here privately to recover from the fatigue of traveling, but I was truly impressed by Toi’s foot massage technique.

The precision of the pressure points and the perfect balance of strength honestly deserve to be recognized as a world cultural treasure. The way there was absolutely no hesitation in the application of pressure, and the way strong pressure was created through body weight transfer and rhythm… I could talk endlessly about how extraordinary the technique was.

Nowadays, with the spread of social media, more and more massage therapists have become like idols and have lost sight of the true purpose of massage itself. That is why I was genuinely happy to meet a true practitioner like Toi, someone who sincerely faces each client with authentic skill and care.

title: Thai Farm Cooking School
ownerDescription: The first and original Thai cooking school at an organic farm in Chiang Mai since 2001. You can only book direct for our cooking classes! Contact us via Whatsapp +66812885989 or thaifarmcooking@gmail.com See you soon! :)

plusCode: QXVR+JQ Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Katie Cousins
reviews.text: Raata, our teacher was fantastic, she explained everything clearly and also a little about Thai culture and cooking. The farm is beautiful and a little oasis and a nice contrast to city life. The dishes were all delicious. The kitchen is very clean and everything prepared very carefully. Would highly recommend.

reviews.name: Jodie Pouard
reviews.text: Raatta is an amazing teacher. She speaks very good English, loves to laugh, and explains everything really well. All the dishes we made were delicious, and the location is beautiful. I couldn’t recommend it more!

reviews.name: Sarah Booth
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time here on a half day cooking course (family of 4). Mod, our cooking instructor was exceptional. Very helpful, knowledgeable and patient. We learnt how to cook a number of Thai dishes and look forward to trying them once we return home. The setting is very tranquil and you get to visit a local market to pick up ingredients. We thoroughly enjoyed it! Also a big thank you to the ladies behind the scenes who helped with preparation and cleaning up after us! 👍

reviews.name: Kai Striegl
reviews.text:
Great cooking class! We had Pha (Sky) as our instructor and she did a phenomenal job explaining and helping us cook the different meals. We started off with a trip to the local market to understand the different ingredients and options we have for our meals. From there they took us on a 30 minute drive up north to the farm, where the actual cooking was done. Before cooking whatsoever, Pha showed us the organic farm and explained more about herbs and vegetables, which they grow organically on the farm. Eventually we cooked our meals, which turned out truly awesome due to the help of Pha and the local team in the background, who prepared everything, so that we only had to do the basic but important steps to understand how Thai dishes are meant to be cooked.
We chose the full day of cooking with 5 dishes in total. It was a lot of food, too much for some people, but they offered to pack them up for us.
Overall great cooking class with awesome and scenic atmosphere. Would  fully recommend to do it.

reviews.name: Alyssa rijsenbilt
reviews.text: We had an absolutely amazing experience at Chiang Mai Thai Organic Farm Cooking School and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chiang Mai! The day started perfectly with a convenient pickup from our hotel in the city. Everything was organized from start to finish, making the whole experience completely stress-free. Our instructor, Wass, was incredible. She has so much positive energy, is genuinely kind, and explained everything clearly and patiently. She made everyone feel welcome and was always happy to answer questions and help whenever needed. The program is very well thought out. We first visited a local market where we learned about the ingredients used in Thai cuisine. After that, we headed to the beautiful organic farm, where we walked through the gardens and saw many of the fresh herbs, vegetables, and other ingredients growing before using them in our dishes. The cooking itself was fantastic. Everything was perfectly organized, and the experience is very hands-on. You’re constantly preparing, cooking, and then enjoying the delicious dishes you’ve made before moving on to the next one. Time flies because you’re always doing something fun.The ingredients are incredibly fresh, honestly, they couldn’t be fresher, and you can really taste the difference. Every dish we made was absolutely delicious. Complimentary water and refreshing lemon tea were available throughout the class, which was a nice touch. The other staff members were also incredibly friendly and helpful, making the atmosphere even more enjoyable. This was one of the highlights of our trip to Thailand. If you’re visiting Chiang Mai, this cooking class is an absolute must-do. You won’t just leave with a full stomach, you’ll also leave with new cooking skills, great memories, and a much better understanding of Thai cuisine.

reviews.name: Ben Baur
reviews.text: My husband and I did a private class and it was such an incredible experience! Our instructor, Mod, was wonderful and funny. The farm itself is gorgeous. The class was insightful and informative. You even get to leave with a digital download of all the recipes they teach. Excited to cook some authentic Thai food when I get home! Highly recommend taking a class here, with Mod if you can!

reviews.name: thomas mills
reviews.text: Our group had a wonderful time at the Cooking class and shopping for ingredients at the local market.  The staff was very attentive and the food was absolutely the best tasting Thai food we’ve ever had.   Our instructor Mod took her time to make sure everyone understood each ingredient and recipe, she did demonstrations for each of the dishes before we actually made the dish, and walked around to make sure we were all doing it properly. We did the full day class, come hungry you’ll prepare and eat 5 plus dishes.  Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Eric Mason
reviews.text:
Loved my half day morning tour experience with Wass and company. I was so jazzed to make my own Pad See Ew noodles and Tom Kha soup (the Khao Soi curry I made was also sooo good!), and was NOT disappointed. SO MUCH FUN!

You start off with a quick stop at a local outdoor food market, which was a fun surprise I didn't expect! Wass explains typical ingredients used in Thai cooking (and also shares some secrets, such as interchangeability between tamarind and lime?!).

From there, it's off to the farm where you tour their GIANT gorgeous garden that would make any greenthumb jealous. Then it's cooking time in their big outdoor kitchen with their outdoor space as the backdrop!

Wass was a great host and gave us all confidence to make awesome dishes (and some pretty plating tips!). I can't wait to try cooking when I get back home.

Thank you so much, Wass and team!

reviews.name: Nancy Momoff
reviews.text: Thai Farm Cooking School is an amazing experience and highly recommended if you’re visiting Chiang Mai. Whether you are familiar with cooking or not, the food is super easy and delicious. There is a list of foods you choose from; a soup, a side dish, a curry (you even make the curry paste from scratch) and a restaurant quality dessert, every one with a unique and mouthwatering flavour. You are introduced to interesting new ingredients that grow on the organic farm and the whole setting is beautiful. The staff are very friendly and make the cooking a piece of cake! The cooking is super fun and easy and the food is so delicious - you feel like a real Masterchef! It really opens up your view of Thai food, and you even get to keep all the recipes so you can make them at home. Highly recommended! ( review co-written with 12 year old Michaela who loved the experience )

reviews.name: Emily Ramos
reviews.text: Food was amazing!!!! Wass was so fun and a great teacher. We were able to make 4 meals. The staff prepped most of the food for us. So all we had to do was chop and cook. Loved this experience and being on their beautiful farm!!

reviews.name: Giovanna Naves e silva
reviews.text:
This class was AMAZING!! Wass was such a ray of sunshine. We learned a lot and I loved everything, specially the panamam curry and the banana in coconut milk.
This experience is complete. They take you to the market and explain the ingredients. Then we go to the farm where we also learn more about the ingredients.
The farm is such a nice place and the whole team was really nice.
Everything is very organized and clean and ready for you. The only thing you have to do is cook and enjoy!
I learned a lot not only about the thai food but about their culture and people.
This was one of the best experiences in Chiang Mai for me and I can’t recommend it enough.
Thank you so much Wass!! You are the best!

reviews.name: Jessica York
reviews.text: This was an excellent experience.  Our guide, Wass was really knowledgeable and made the class fun and interesting.  The food was delicious and it was really interesting learning about Thai food and how it is cooked. The location was beautiful and peaceful. Definitely worth the money.

reviews.name: Deme B
reviews.text: This was such an amazing experience.  Wass was our instructor and she was very thorough, gave clear instructions, and had a great sense of humor.  We did the half day course and it starts with a tour of the local market and an intro to the ingredients.  Since we were staying in the city, they provided a shuttle to and from all locations.   I chose to cook the yellow curry, the tom kha soup, pad see ew, and mango butterfly pea sticky rice.  The dishes turned out amazing and Wass walks you through every step of the way.  The farm you cook on is beautiful and there are plenty of opportunities to take photos.  I would definitely do this experience again and take the full day class.

reviews.name: Maya B
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time!! Made so much food and learned a lot about the farm and the recipes. Wass was such an amazing instructor.

Would recommend bringing bug spray! The kitchen is outside (it’s beautiful) but it gets buggy.

reviews.name: Sheila Cromie
reviews.text:
What a fab day! We started off with a hotel pickup, then drove to the main market, a little way North of the city centre. There, our guide, Raatta talked us through various stalls and we had some free time to explore. Raatta was never far away if we needed clarification!
Then we drove (in a comfortable AC minibus) to the farm. It’s in the countryside North of Chiang Mai and is just beautiful. When on the bus, we’d made our selection of what we’d like to cook… one soup, one curry, one stir fry, one noodle dish, one desert. We also had a salad.
Raatta took us through each dish - and answered all our many questions! Because of the variety of dishes on offer, we also got to learn about the other dishes too!
You will be eating a lot, but they are happy to bag up leftovers for you to take home.
All-in-all, a brilliant day! Highly recommended!

reviews.name: J C
reviews.text:
We took an amazing cooking class at Thai Farm cooking school in Chiang Mai. Mod, our instructor, spoke English well & is very knowledgeable about Thai ingredients & cooking classical Thai dishes.

Prior to cooking, we got a tour of a local market & then a tour of their gardens to learn about the ingredients & fresh herbs and spices we used in our dishes. Beautiful property & organic garden.

Each student got their own cooking station to cook our dishes. Then we all sat & ate together 4 courses - soup, noodle dish, curry dish & dessert.

We took another great cooking class in Bangkok at a famous cooking school. The quality of the cooking class at Thai Farm was just as good quality at a more affordable price.

reviews.name: Maureen Johnson
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about Thai Farm Cooking School. My husband and I came 19 years ago, and just returned with our 13- and 16-year-olds. While it has grown, it still has a very personalized feeling, you're in a group of 12 and Wass, our guide/teacher, was fantastic. Everything was easy to follow, beautiful and delicious - even for our 13 year old. The short walking tour of the organic farm introduced us to all of the ingredients we weren't used to cooking with. Highly, highly, highly recommend the full day class.

reviews.name: Jankees Rovers
reviews.text:
What an amazing experience at Thai Farm Cooking School in Chiang Mai! 🌿🍜

Our fantastic Thai cooking instructor Mod started the day perfectly by picking us up at our hotel in a comfortable van. From the very first moment, she made us feel incredibly welcome — warm, friendly, and truly Thai hospitality at its best.

Our first stop was Ruamchok Market. Right in the middle of all the fresh ingredients, we received a great explanation about the herbs, spices and essential Thai flavor ingredients that make this cuisine so special. Think about Thai chili paste, tamarind paste, oyster sauce, fish sauce and palm sugar — the perfect balance of sweet, sour, salty and spicy that defines Thai cooking. 🌶️🥥

Lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, fresh chilies… everything looked beautiful and smelled amazing. Visiting a market among the locals makes the experience even more authentic. You really experience Thai cuisine the way Thai people do. Authentic to the max. 🇹🇭

After the market we headed to the farm, where we were welcomed with a delicious lemongrass tea. Wearing our Thai “sombrero” hats (which was quite funny 😄), Mod took us on a walk around the farm. She showed us all the fruits, herbs and spices that grow organically there. Of course we tasted many of them — and yes… that little bird’s eye chili was seriously spicy! 🌶️🔥

With her basket full of ingredients, Mod passionately explained what makes Thai cuisine so unique.

Then it was time for the real work. In a beautiful setting with our own cooking stations, we received calm, clear and step-by-step instructions on how to prepare the dishes.

👩‍🍳 Nina loved making a delicious Panang (Phanaeng) Curry 🌶️🥥👨‍🍳 Jankees went for the Northern Thai classic Khao Soi 🍜✨

It was hard work — pounding herbs and spices in the mortar until you literally see your curry paste being born.

Next dishes:🌶️🍋 Nina made Tom Yum Soup🥥 Jankees prepared Tom Kha Soup

The secret? Fresh herbsu and the perfect balance with real Thai fish sauce.

More dishes followed:

🍜🥜 Pad Thai Fried Noodles by Jankees — great to finally understand all the steps behind this famous dish.🔥🥢 Nina prepared authentic Thai spring rolls, cooking with the wok on high heat.

And for dessert:

💙🥥 Nina made Mango with Butterfly Pea Sticky Rice🌿🥭 Jankees prepared Mango with Pandan Sticky Rice

It was truly a celebration to experience this. For a moment we felt like real locals.

At the end we received a group photo and the full recipe menu with all the steps, and we were safely brought back to our hotel.

**A must-do experience if you love Thailand and its incredible cuisine

reviews.name: Win Win
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I did the half day evening cooking class. Everything was very well organized. We were pick up from Maya mall and driven to Mee Chok market to discuss some of the ingredients we would be cooking with. We were then driven to the farm about 30 minutes from the city.

At the farm there are large fully equipped kitchens with a stove for everyone. We were given a tour of the farm where we discussed the fresh ingredients we would be cooking with. We were provided with all the ingredients and instructions we would need for each dish.

My girlfriend cooked vegetarian options: Khao Soy, Pad Thai, Tom Yum and Mango Sticky Rice.

I cooked with chicken: Red Curry, Tom Kha, Spring Rolls and Banana in Coconut milk.

Everything turned out really well! And we were given a digital recipe book with everything we cooked today and more!

Big thanks to the instructor Wass! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Anna Bybee
reviews.text: The cooking class was such a cool experience. We learned about the plants on the farm, and how they are used in different Thai dishes. Our guide Raatta was engaging, and it was a lot of fun with her!

I wish this can improve as it’s the basic! The place is nicely renovated and kept. Receptionist Ms Pim and masseurs Ms Mam and Tar are very nice, polite and always put on smiling face! They are considerate to keep our drink and fruits which we brought to be put into the fridge and returned to us after the massage. That’s a good service! We have an hour back massage + 15 min back massage with herbal compress ball, also we have an hour Thai massage with herbal compress ball. It’s very relaxing and it heals our back and shoulder pain with the herbal compress ball. At the end of the massage, we are given the compress ball and to re-use it at home, this is very good as most massage shops don’t give it to the customer even thought we paid for the compress ball. Another disappointing part is we saw their website promotion advertisement which has a 14% discount from Tues to Thursday and we came on Thursday but after we arrived the shop, we are told that such promotion has ramped down so we are not able to enjoy, hope that the company marketing can revise the website so that the customers are no longer being mislead. I’ll keep my 5 stars to the massage shop for their awesome  service.

reviews.name: Sonia P
reviews.text:
This place is a true hidden gem. The pricing alone deserves an award. Foot and Thai massages at 350 baht? A brilliant hook to reel you in. Then, with the grace of a magician pulling a rabbit out of a hat, the aroma massage leaps to 950 baht—because nothing says “affordable luxury” like charging hotel-spa prices in a cozy little shop with fluorescent lighting.

The staff are equally impressive. One remarkable lady managed to upsell me on their “special promotion” while simultaneously massaging another guest. His dignity may have been collateral damage, but I was in awe of her dedication to multitasking. Naturally, I upgraded from my modest 500 baht plan to the 850 baht extravaganza—because who doesn’t love a surprise investment in themselves?

The massage itself was an absolute experience. Forget private, soothing rooms—here, curtains are an optional accessory, left tastefully ajar for that community feel. Why enjoy tranquil music when you can bask in the cheerful chatter of masseurs holding conversations over your half-nude body? It’s all about ambience.

The technique was nothing short of inspired. A symphony of repeated finger cracking, leg-arm-back rotations, and the innovative “smash-your-fingers-together” method kept me entertained throughout. When creativity ran low, she simply circled back to the legs routine—like a greatest hits album on repeat.

And the grand finale? My 90-minute massage wrapped up at a zippy 70 minutes. A thoughtful gesture, really—because when you’re having this much fun, why drag it out?

If you’re seeking an experience that combines luxury pricing, bold creativity, and an immersive social soundtrack, look no further. Five stars. Highly recommended.

reviews.text:
I recently visited Kayasiri Health Massage and had an amazing experience. My masseuse, Puipuyyy, displayed true mastery and knew exactly which parts of my body needed attention. She excelled in soft, medium, and deep tissue massage, pressure points, and increasing my range of motion. I highly recommend opting for the 120-minute Swedish massage when you have the chance.

The price was very economical compared to competitors, yet the quality of service was outstanding. The staff was very friendly, and while the environment wasn't as private as I'd like, it was very quiet and felt like a private experience.

One recommendation: communicate your preferred pressure level in advance, especially with pressure points and Thai massage towards the end, to extend the range of motion. Despite my high tolerance for pain, the pressure points became unbearable towards the end, and I had to ask her to stop.

Overall, it was an amazing experience, and I am likely to return in a few days.
