reviews.name: Stuart March
reviews.text:
Luxury spa experience in one of Chiang Mai’s most beautiful settings

I visited Makkha Health & Spa’s Colonial Gardens branch today for their 2-hour treatment package and it was one of the most polished and relaxing spa experiences I’ve had in Chiang Mai.

I pre-booked online and the process was very easy and straightforward. I also opted for the complimentary hotel transfer, which was a great added touch. My driver arrived exactly on time in a branded luxury Tesla, which immediately set the tone for the premium experience from the very start.

I chose the Colonial Gardens branch intentionally because of the design and architecture, and it was every bit as beautiful in person as I had hoped. The central water courtyard is the standout feature and creates an immediate sense of calm the moment you arrive. Combined with the beautiful colonial-style design, peaceful arches, floor-to-ceiling windows, and lush vertical nature wall, the entire space feels elegant, tranquil, and thoughtfully designed for relaxation before and after treatment.

The staff were warm, attentive, and very professional throughout. The consultation process felt thorough and personalised, and I appreciated being able to choose my preferred aroma oil from a selection of five. I chose citronella, which was fresh, uplifting, and a perfect choice for the treatment.

My 2-hour treatment included an aroma oil massage followed by a facial, and both were excellent. The therapist was highly skilled and the treatment felt refined and high quality throughout. A range of techniques were used during the massage, and the flow of the treatment felt very intuitive and expertly delivered. What really elevated the experience was the thoughtful use of both hot and cold compresses throughout, which made the treatment feel far more premium and luxurious than a standard spa massage.

The setting, service, and treatment quality all felt incredibly polished. Even the finishing touches were beautifully done, from the calm welcome tea to the beautifully presented mango sticky rice served after the treatment. Everything felt considered, relaxing, and high-end from beginning to end.

I left feeling completely relaxed and very impressed overall. I would absolutely return and already plan to visit their Ancient House branch for another treatment soon. Highly recommended if you are looking for a genuinely premium spa experience in Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed your 2-hour treatment at Makkha Health & Spa Colonial Gardens. It means so much to us that you appreciated the atmosphere, consultation, aroma oil selection, therapist’s technique, hotel transfer, and our small finishing touches like welcome tea and mango sticky rice.

Your kind words are a wonderful encouragement to our team. We look forward to welcoming you again soon at our Ancient House branch for another relaxing experience.🙏🏻🤍

reviews.name: Sam Liew
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely fantastic experience at this spa!

It was a complete reversal of our disappointing experience in another branch under the same brand.

From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was serene and welcoming, the indoor courtyard turquoise tiled pool and the vertical lush green wall caught our attention. The entire area exude a stylish, resort-like feel, giving the space a calm, tropical vibe

We had prepaid for 60 min package of (1) Body Salt Scrub and (2) Hot Aroma Oil Massage.

A car was despatched to pick us from our hotel of stay.

The staff were incredibly attentive and professional, when we were informed that our package was without head and shoulder massage, the staff encouraged us to get additional 30 min for the treatment which we agreed. The staff was very confident of the services to be provided by their therapists. She assured us to replace another therapist without charge if we’re not satisfied after 15 min into the session.

Of course, our therapists, Zai and Ang were excellent. The massage itself was divine-skilled hands worked out all the tension in our shoulders and back, leaving me feeling completely relaxed and rejuvenated.

We were treated to delicious mango sticky rice after the session.

The facilities were spotless, and the use of high-quality oils added to the luxurious feel. We both left feeling like a new person and can't wait to book my next visit.

Highly recommended!

Have a good day :)

To top it all off, I was treated to a delicious serving of mango and sticky rice at the end of the session — a perfect and thoughtful touch that made the experience feel truly complete.

Dear Nanxi Liu,

We completely understand how upsetting and uncomfortable this must have felt, especially when the room temperature was already quite cold. Please accept our heartfelt apologies for the pain and inconvenience caused.

Your feedback has been shared with our spa management team so we can immediately review our therapist procedures and improve temperature checks and guest communication during treatments to ensure this does not happen again.

Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention, and we truly appreciate your honest feedback. We hope to have the opportunity to restore your confidence in our service in the future.

Best regards,
Makkha Team

reviews.name: Sara Ackerman
reviews.text: Ng gave the best massage of my life! I've now been back again and will only be going to this salon for massages whenever I'm in Bangkok. Both times I got the neck and head massage. The second time she just focused on my neck, head, back and arms, likely because I have so many knots it really does take the whole hour. But this is where I feel pain so I did not mind at all! Note that she uses a LOT of pressure which isn't for everyone, but for chronic pain suffers, she's incredible. My husband also got a massage. He prefers a lighter touch than me and the person he had was great so no matter what type of massage you like, you will love it here.

reviews.name: Karweng Leong
reviews.text:
⭐☆☆☆☆

The massage room was extremely crowded with very little space between customers. People were constantly walking in and out, and my masseur had to keep stopping and moving aside to let others pass, which made the experience very distracting.

The massage itself was disappointing. There was almost no pressure, and it felt like it was being done just for the sake of finishing the session. It was mostly light touching without any real technique or effort.

Overall, the environment was neither comfortable nor relaxing. Honestly, even roadside foot massage shops in the city centre provide a better experience. I would recommend thinking twice before coming here.

reviews.name: KamchatkaDFR
reviews.text: If you know what a good massage is, avoid visiting this place. I’ve checked reviews and expected the good service, but had the opposite even though I’ve been there in the midday and seemed to be the only customer inside. The salon itself is nice, but the quality of massage… I have no words. I went for an oil massage, but it felt opposite to relaxing. The master was moving her hands so fast like we’re preparing for the F1 race. I thought okay, maybe it’s her technique. But then she just forgot to even touch my belly or my head AT ALL, she didn’t even touched it. No upper neck massage as well. Except for the relaxation I went out totally disappointed. And then, when I described the situation to the administrator, she tried to convince me that massage was done properly and master had done my head, neck and belly massage too lol. I just feel scammed, don’t believe good reviews.

reviews.name: Pintu S.
reviews.text:
This place is one of the cheapest massage options in the area, which explains why it’s always busy with a mix of international guests. Walk-ins are very convenient—there’s almost always availability, so it’s quick and hassle-free without needing a reservation.

However, the downside (and a major one for me) is the cleanliness. The bedsheets and pillowcases had an unpleasant smell—almost like stale saliva—which made the experience quite uncomfortable and hard to overlook.

Additionally, the massage quality was disappointing. The masseuse seemed to lack technique. Meanwhile, she used her elbows which felt abrasive and caused discomfort—almost like my skin was being scratched whenever she applied pressure.

Unfortunately, this might be my last visit here…

reviews.name: Yohanna Gonzalez
reviews.text: The hours advertised said they were open until midnight. When I went in to ask about a massage at 10:50 pm, I noticed they were in a hurry to leave. I can empathize with the tiredness of their employees, but they're not keeping to the hours they advertise. I thought it was still within the right time to get a massage since I was staying at the hotel next door. But the receptionist's response and attitude when I asked about a massage made me not want one, and I simply left. I figured if I got a massage at 11 pm, they'd probably do it half-heartedly because they were eager to leave and close up. I'm sorry, but we have to be mindful of the energy we give and receive in these kinds of places.

They’ll lead you to a dark room with I think about 10 massage chairs. The foot massage was light and very relaxing. The masseuse don’t talk and they play calming music so the entire environment is very peaceful and quiet. They provide WiFi if you want to scroll your phone during the massage. Even though I only got the foot massage, they still briefly massaged my head, neck and arms in last 10 minutes. It was overall a very pleasant experience! Would re-visit

reviews.text:
The massage was OK, but overall this was an extremely disappointing experience. The customer service was a disaster.

The room was freezing cold. I asked several times for the air conditioning to be turned off or adjusted, but the staff refused to do anything about it.

Because of the cold temperature I had to stop the massage. Even though I did not receive the full service, they still charged me the full price. I explained that I was willing to pay for the part of the massage I actually received, but they refused.

This level of service and lack of basic customer care is unacceptable.

reviews.text: We walked-in and they did service for us. Lovely ladies, zero English but they tried their best to accommodate us. We pointed the service we wanted to book, they washed our feet before they begun the Oil Massage. We got taken to the upper most floor, the room is a bit dark… so be careful when you walk-in. Would rate higher but cannot due to language barrier. Note, if you enjoy gentle-massage you might not want to book here, or learn how to say (soft-massage) in Thai before coming here.

reviews.name: paan zain
reviews.text: My experience at Chao 9 Massage in Bangkok was disappointing. The masseuse primarily used her elbow for the first half-hour, and despite my request for a change to hand massage, she persisted with the elbow technique. She focused on elbow massage for less than 25 minutes on my back, and even after flipping, she continued with the same approach. Despite my efforts to communicate my preference, I had to stop her before she finished "massaging" my right leg. When I explained my dissatisfaction to the counter staff, I received a brief apology. Regrettably, I still had to pay for the service. I share this feedback because I was genuinely disappointed with the overall service at Chao 9 Massage, Bangkok

reviews.name: Lok Yi Lau
reviews.text:

On the way I walk to Chao9, there are school, hotel and 3-4 massage shops. I go there in weekend, but not many people in this street.
Chao9 not big, the store design like home and it is clean.
Their staff wear the white tee in addition to the receptionist.
I think the price of their services is cheaper than the other but it is equal to what I get.
The most I like is the environment, their service and I don't need to book. So I visit Chao9 consecutive two days with my friend.
One more, after the service they will offer you a cup of tea~
16-17/2/19

reviews.name: Rhianna Tomlinson
reviews.text:
This is a very good place for a traditional Thai massage at a very reasonable price - highly recommended.

The staff here are all very kind and polite. They will start by gently washing your feet, then lead you to the main massage room where you will be asked to change into some loose clothing. For the massage itself, the masseuse will make sure to cover most areas of your body, working quickly but calmly and using traditional techniques to guide you into different stretches and work your muscles thoroughly. They are very good at finding tight spots and relieving tension. When you finish, you will be given some calming tea, a light snack and a cold towel to refresh yourself.

My body always feels so much more relaxed after a massage here and I will make sure to visit each time I am in Chiang Mai, thank you!

title: Siladon Spa
ownerDescription: Enjoy the complete spa experience with a range of massages, spa treatments, and spa packages, at Siladon Spa Phuket.

reviews.name: Mohit Kumar
reviews.text: Amazing spa experience in Phuket! The staff were incredibly welcoming, the waiting area is huge and comfortable, and the treatment rooms are spacious and relaxing. They even clean your feet before taking you to the room, which is a nice hygienic touch. Great service and absolutely worth the money. Highly recommend trying Siladon Spa if you’re in Phuket! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We are pleased you enjoyed your visit at Siladon spa. We hope to welcome you back again.

reviews.name: kelly kuo
reviews.text: My husband and I really enjoyed a wonderful massage. The ladies were incredibly sweet and caring, which immediately created a relaxed atmosphere. Because we had our daughter with us, they had made a special place for her. She was able to relax there and even fell asleep peacefully  just like her parents 😉. Highly recommended for those looking for relaxation and hospitality!

reviews.name: JASSIARA QUEIROZ DE LIMA
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at this massage place. From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere felt calm, welcoming, and very professional. The staff were incredibly kind, attentive, and clearly experienced—they made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire session.

The massage itself was excellent: relaxing, well-balanced, and tailored to my needs. You can really tell they know what they’re doing, and they genuinely care about their clients’ well-being.

I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and taken care of. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a high-quality massage and a peaceful experience.
Kop khun na kha 🙏🏾

reviews.name: Rajani Lama
reviews.text: We booked for a full body oil massage and facia. It was amazing from start to finish, staffs were so friendly and polite, ambience was nice and calm. I would 100% recommend it to everyone and will definitely be back.

reviews.name: Amitada A.
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Siladon Spa Patong. The spa is truly worth the money — everything from the service to the atmosphere was excellent. The staff are very professional and made me feel relaxed from the moment I arrived.

The room was clean, comfortable, and well-prepared, creating a peaceful environment. I was looked after by MAMA Tree for my body scrub and oil massage, and she was absolutely amazing — so skilled and relaxing. It was one of the best treatments I’ve had.

Highly recommend this place if you’re in Patong and want a quality spa experience!

reviews.name: Ryan GLOBETROTTER
reviews.text:
Very good massage place with an excellent zen atmosphere that makes it easy to relax from the moment you arrive. They offer various types of massages and the face massage was honestly the best I’ve ever had. The quality and technique really stood out.

They also offer packages as well as à la carte options, with some discounts available, which is a nice bonus. The treatment rooms are separate, offering good privacy and comfort, and there is a shower available as well. Staff are friendly, professional, and attentive throughout the experience.

Overall, a great place to unwind and enjoy a high-quality massage.

Update: my second three hours massage here: Body scrub + aroma oil + Spa facial. Excellent 👌

Enjoy 😎☀️🧘🧘‍♀️🙏

reviews.name: Buket Şentürk
reviews.text: It was an amazing experience! I had neck pain before the massage, and they used a special menthol cream that felt incredibly soothing. It really helped relieve my pain. I left feeling so relaxed and refreshed. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Shalini Lewis
reviews.text: Amazing experience and worth the money. Great hospitality and service. They are professional, and the place is clean. I did a full-body scrub and massage, and it was very good.

reviews.name: Normality Al
reviews.text: This place is beyond awesome. You can WhatsApp them to make an appointment. I had the body scrub and aromatherapy massage for 2 hours and it’s the best experience I’ve ever had. They welcome you with a foot wash and tea with a cold towel when you arrive. I fell asleep instantly during the massage. The scrub was refreshing and a hot shower ensued. Would definitely come back here again without a doubt. Incredible staff and great service. Beautiful place too, very luxurious and so lucky to find this gem of a place. At the end, they serve you with cookies and hot tea. What a way to end my night. Absolutely love this place and almost did not want to leave. 😂😍

reviews.name: jyoti singh
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful experience at Siladon Spa. The service was excellent and the staff were extremely professional, warm, and attentive. I especially loved the aroma oil massage — it was deeply relaxing and refreshing. 😇😇  The foot massage was equally amazing and done with great care.
Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a quality spa experience! 😍

reviews.name: Tahni David
reviews.text: Nancy and Diamond are wonderful! They’re attentive, accommodating, and very professional. All the spa staff are very kind. Our five hour spa day didn’t feel like five hours it was so enjoyable. Definitely recommend Siladon Spa!

reviews.name: Miranda Korniloff
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing… I have traveled the world and had great spa experiences but when I tell you BOOOK HERE you must. My sister and I booked the 5 hour package that included a foot massage, body scrub, herbal compress, aroma massage and facial. We never wanted it to end. We got a private room together and enjoyed every moment. The staff was professional, talented and kind. The facility is clean and well kept. The value is unmatched! Thank you for a great experience, I will be back whenever in Phuket.

reviews.name: Nina James
reviews.text:
Oh my goodness just had
The best Thai massage her by a lovely girl. I’d forgotten. How good a Thai massage is when
I normally have physio therapy. There was a lot of stretching and pressure points. I feel amazing now. Want one every day thank you so much

reviews.name: Renni Korniloff
reviews.text:
Hands down one of the best spa experiences I’ve ever had! My sister and I booked the 5-hour package and loved every minute—from the foot massage to the facial and everything in between. Having a private room together made it even better.
The staff was so kind, talented, and attentive, and the spa was spotless and calming. For the level of service you receive, the value is unbelievable. If you’re in Phuket, this is a must!!! Can’t wait to come back.

reviews.name: Nawacharee P
reviews.text:
Amazing Spa! We booked online and got a confirmation email within an hour.

P’Porn was incredible. She took care of me wonderfully. I’ve had many massages in my life and she manages to stretch me in a new way and takes care of my tense spots incredibly. Highly recommend.

They have very reasonable pricing and incredible service. The receptionist was super welcoming and sweet. They helped putting our small grocery in the fridge while we were getting our massage. Will find time to come back 🤍

reviews.name: Asanjee Fernando
reviews.text: Siladon Spa was an incredible experience from start to finish. The facility is spotlessly clean, quiet, and beautifully decorated, making you feel relaxed the moment you walk through the door. The staff greeted me warmly with a refreshing drink and a cold towel. My therapist was highly skilled and focused exactly on the areas where I had the most tension.

reviews.name: Jeremi Romero
reviews.text:
Awesome massage! She hit all the right places without even having to tell her. The pressure was perfect from start to finish, and you can tell the therapists here really know what they’re doing. The atmosphere was calm and relaxing the moment I walked in, and everything felt clean and well taken care of.

I went in pretty tense and walked out feeling completely reset. They paid attention to the small details too, which made the whole experience feel a step above your typical spa. Definitely worth it if you’re in Phuket and want a quality massage without feeling rushed.

Would 100% come back again.

reviews.name: Law Maggie
reviews.text: This is my second visit to Siladon Phuket since last August, and once again, it was a wonderful experience. The receptionist was warm, friendly, and cheerful, making me feel welcome right away. My therapist, Nam, was very skillful and attentive, she listened carefully to my requests and focused on the areas that needed more attention. The room was clean and spacious, and I appreciated being able to shower after my body scrub. Overall, I’m very happy with my experience once again and will definitely be back.

reviews.name: Jason Ng
reviews.text:
I recently visited Silapon Spa and had a wonderful experience. From the moment I stepped in, the environment felt calm, clean, and welcoming. The staff were polite and attentive, making the entire process smooth and comfortable.

My therapist was skilled and professional, carefully adjusting the pressure to suit my preference. I especially appreciated how they checked in to ensure I was comfortable throughout the session. After the treatment, I felt relaxed and refreshed.

Overall, Silapon Spa provides excellent service with a peaceful ambience. I would definitely return and recommend it to anyone looking for a quality massage experience.

reviews.name: peiyun kang
reviews.text: Extra attentive staff. My friend wasn’t feeling well and they made the extra effort to help her after the massage. Thank you for the great service!

title: Zabb E Lee Thai Cooking School & Organic Farm
address: P223+XC, Don Kaeo, Saraphi District, Chiang Mai 50140, Thailand

reviews.name: Justine Raoult
reviews.text: Really lovely experience! Jess our instructor was brilliant, very funny and very informative. She kept the tunes running and the energy high throughout the class! It was a lot of food but you can take away a couple of the last courses if you are too full. The surroundings are beautiful; like an oasis with lots of waterfalls. Definitely do this class!

reviews.name: Áine O'Sullivan
reviews.text:
What a day - we couldn’t have enjoyed the experience or the food more!

Em was a fantastic and hilarious instructor. She kept the good vibes going all morning while also somehow managing to keep all of us organised and cooking like chefs 👩‍🍳✨

The kitchens and the surrounding grounds are so beautiful, the perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of the city.

The dishes we made were delicious - there was so much food that we had to bring some home with us to enjoy later.

Would highly recommended, definitely a highlight of our trip!

reviews.name: indalore
reviews.text: This place was absolutely stunning, the perfect relaxing atmosphere for the cooking class. They were very also accommodating to allergies and dietary restrictions, and we made several dishes together. It was nice that we all had chances to cook and use our own stations instead of just being in groups splitting up the work for all of it. We had some time before and in-between the actual cooking to explore the grounds which had water features, swinging chairs, and more. Be a little careful of the flies, but they do have some covers for the plates.

reviews.name: Kiara Montiel Vite
reviews.text: AMAZING CLASS!! Really worth doing it! It’s so fun and our instructor Patty 🍔was so wonderful and sweet! She was very attentive and helpful of all of us when making the food and explained everything! Food was delicious (ZABB-E-LEE) Do come with space for food bc there’s so much haha Amazing experience!🤩❤️🥳

reviews.name: Leandra Gerndt
reviews.text: Cho was a really good teacher! We really enjoyed her class. She explained everything really well and helped everyone. The location also is amazing. Would 100% recommend cho was the best.

reviews.name: Olivia Anthon
reviews.text:
we had such a great time here.
i was worried that a cooking class would be a bit intimidating but cho made it a really relaxing experience. i am so impressed by her communication skills, she delivered the class with such ease. also, she is hilarious, so charismatic!
the food was yummy too, it was really cool to see how popular thai dishes are made. i would 100% recommend coming here when in chiang mai.

reviews.name: D A
reviews.text: We just finished the class with Som. It was amazing. Would definitely recommend and do it again. It was great experience, it's not what you would be expecting from a cooking class. Teacher is high energy. Very happy

reviews.name: Gambel Friesen
reviews.text: #CookingWithNana Great authentic Thai cooking class! The instructor is super friendly and patient, giving clear guidance throughout the session. The food prepared during the class tastes absolutely incredible — arguably even better than dishes at many local restaurants. A fun, worthwhile experience to learn about real Thai cuisine. Highly recommended for anyone visiting!

reviews.name: Maja Tuzinski
reviews.text:
We understand why so many people love this cooking school, but for us the experience was not fully satisfying.

The positives:
The visit to the local market was great, and we learned a lot about the ingredients used in Thai cuisine. Our guide Patty was wonderful. She was friendly, very good in English, and extremely knowledgeable, so we truly recommend her. The entire place is beautifully decorated, and the atmosphere during the cooking session was fun and lively. We also liked that you can take the last two dishes home if you’re too full. At the end, we received all the recipes, which was a nice touch.

However, there were 5–6 other tours at the school at the same time, which made the place feel less special and quite touristy. We also didn’t feel like we cooked much ourselves. The process felt very “hand-holding,” set up so that it’s almost impossible to make a mistake. While many people might appreciate that, both of us enjoy cooking, so we missed having more independence and the sense of truly creating the dishes on our own. In the end, we didn’t feel like we learned very much.
We would have preferred a focus on 2–3 dishes done fully from scratch, from chopping the vegetables to plating, rather than preparing five dishes where everything is pre-cut and pre-prepared.

reviews.name: Zoe richards
reviews.text:
WOW! This was an incredible experience. Luna was the most amazing tour guide and we loved every moment of it. She gave us such a great insight into Chiang Mai, then toured us around the market so well. The food was all so insanely delicious- please come with an empty stomach as wow it’s a lot of food!!!

She brought all the best energy to the cooking class and helped us foster good friendships with fellow class members we caught up the following night!

reviews.name: Niamh
reviews.text: We had the most amazing experience with Alice as our teacher. They picked us up on time and we got to go to a local market. Then we headed to the school and made 5 dishes. Alice made the experience so fun and her English was incredible. I loved that they gave us a little time at the market to explore and then more time at the school itself. The food itself was delicious, you got to pick which dishes you wanted to cook. The actual cooking part was ran so efficiently and smoothly, despite different dishes being cooked in the group at the same time which I was very impressed by. The overall experience was amazing I couldn’t recommend this cooking class more.

reviews.name: Shin Kang
reviews.text: Very nice and interesting experience to learn about Thai food in this beautiful cooking school🌹 Alice teaches us in a very good and energetic vibe~ If there’s anyone wants to learn cook in Chiangmai here is one of the great options for you.

reviews.name: Grace Bentley
reviews.text: Such an amazing cooking class! Not only was the environment beautiful to work in, but the instructor was so knowledgeable, welcoming and funny. And all of the food was incredible! Highly recommend. From pick up to drop off the whole experience was seamless.

reviews.name: Isabella Moss
reviews.text: I would recommend highly! The staff are so so lovely here and super helpful. The food is all really good quality and you are talked through everything properly. You go to a market before the session to see where everything is bought from and what it is. A super informative and fun experience. And to top it off you get the recipes after to keep!! Definitely worth a visit :)

reviews.name: Philine Sophie
reviews.text: This cooking class was great! The food was delicious, the instructions were really good and easy to understand. The vibe was so cool and it was very fun!! Best cooking class

reviews.name: 赵明
reviews.text:
I had an amazing cooking class with Ally today! She is such a wonderful teacher—friendly, responsible, patient, and incredibly lovely. She explained every step clearly and made the whole experience fun and engaging.
The cooking process was very enjoyable, and I learned a lot while having a great time. Most importantly, all the dishes we made were absolutely delicious!
Thank you, Ally, for making this such a memorable experience. I highly recommend this class to anyone visiting Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Niki Vasileiou
reviews.text: Alice made this experience amazing for our family! I recommend this cooking class if you are in Chiang Mai! We cooked 5 dishes and ate them!! Fantastic experience!

reviews.name: Kevin Mullaney
reviews.text: Excellent activity. Would highly recommend, Jess was amazing as a head Chef! We were a group of 4 and overall it was a great opportunity to try out some Thai Cuisine. She made the course so much fun and all of the instructions were extremely clear. I would definitely come back.

reviews.name: Dr. Lu YYZ
reviews.text:
We had such a wonderful experience at this cooking class! The biggest highlight was definitely our teacher, Alice. She was incredibly friendly, funny, and made the whole class so enjoyable.

Alice explained everything clearly and shared lots of practical cooking tips that are actually useful for everyday home cooking, not just for the recipes we made. She also speaks perfect English, so everything was easy to understand, and she made everyone feel comfortable regardless of their cooking experience.

Highly recommend this class if you’re looking for a fun, authentic, and hands-on cooking experience. Thank you, Alice, for making it such a memorable day!

reviews.name: Ben Stuart
reviews.text:
The location was amazing, so relaxing and it was very modern. The class was very fun and engaging, Nana was an excellent teacher!
I would recommend this to anyone wanting a Thai cooking class #cookingwithnana

Definitely coming back, highly recommended.

reviews.text: Popped in after coffee next door, big mistake. No one at the entrance, had to explore upstairs like it was an escape room. Paid upfront (never a good sign). Did 1 hr foot massage, but the therapist seemed to be on energy-saving mode. Asked for more pressure, she was like, “This is the hardest I can go,” with a look that screamed “take it or leave it.” Basically got lightly patted for an hour. Good thing I didn’t go for 2 hours—would’ve felt like a hostage situation. Never again.

reviews.text: A great no frills massage. Not fancy but clean and nice. They have Thai massage on mats or private rooms with shower on the upper floor for oil and herbal massage. Overall a great massage for the price, and a bit of a welcome upgrade from some other similar places nearby.

reviews.text:
This place is amazing!
Please mention PIM‼️

reviews.name: Nicholas Choy
reviews.text: Good location and good price. Was available at opening.

reviews.name: Absolutepurple
reviews.text: Joy gave one of the best massage I ever had. Highly recommended the Sports massage. Where it's similar to full body Thai massage, it's also a mix of head/shoulder massage. Will definitely go back again.

reviews.name: Jessy Page
reviews.text:
I've lived in Bangkok for 2 years, and I really don't recommend that place because I experienced something aweful:
Starting the massage, I told the lady who took care of me that I like strong pressure for the massage, she didn't reply anything. Starting the massage, she was already watching the clock. After 5 minutes, I asked her to apply stronger pressure because I honestly didn't feel anything, she was just rubbing her hands on my feet and she got very mad that I asked her. She started shouting at me that I don't know anything about massage. I felt sorry for the other clients that were here, probably disturbed by her loud voice. Then she said: "Where are you from? Me I'm from Thailand, I know what is a massage, you don't know anything". I was horrified by this attitude and didn't say anything. 5 minutes later, when she was on my left, she farted next to me and I had to cover my face with the towel they provided because the smell was unbearable.
The whole hour, she didn't want to apply any pressure.
At the end, I still wanted to give her a tip to make her day better, but she started again to scream about how I didn't know anything about massage and how much I disrespected her...
The manager witnessed everything and didn't care much. I left. Never coming again, good luck if you try that place.
Also, quite expensive compared to other places

reviews.name: Osama El Nazer
reviews.text:
Nice place to get a massage very professional and friendly staff. They provide you with slippers and store your shoes. Prices are average and very affordable.
One of the best massages I had in Bangkok.

reviews.name: John Tan
reviews.text: Good authentic massages and very affordable. The masseuse Joy is very experienced and skillful. Note that this is a wholesome massage parlour and not the sleazy type. So both male and female clients are welcomed. They provide light ginger drink and biscuits after massage. Staff are friendly and experienced.

reviews.name: parlinz pisitgu
reviews.text: I was also impressed that they proactively offered an excellent promotion, which added fantastic value to an already great service.

reviews.name: Laura Reviews
reviews.text: My partner and I went 3 times in the week we were in Bangkok ! We had the Thai massage and oil massage. Well priced. The staff were very professional, asked how we wanted the massage and took great care of us. Offered small bottles of water at the beginning and tea at the end. Do not recommend going around lunchtime as they might be understaffed which is understandable.

reviews.text: Located next to Starbucks and accessible via bts train system. It's actually located at 2nd floor and can seem a bit intimidating as lights are dim and we are the only customers but service is good. Foot massage is 400 bhat per person for 1 hour.

reviews.text: Attending this Thai cooking class was such a wonderful experience. The activities were simple, enjoyable, and fun, making it easy to follow even for beginners. The staff were very accommodating, friendly, and helpful throughout the class. It was definitely worth the money and became one of the highlights of my Thailand vacation. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable and authentic experience.

reviews.name: Donald Christian Boarao
reviews.text:
We had such an exceptional experience at White Lotus, Thailand! The place was beautiful, welcoming, and comfortable, and the staff were incredibly accommodating from start to finish.

Our cooking class instructor was amazing. The instructions were easy to understand, and she was incredibly patient with us throughout the entire class. She made the experience fun, relaxed, and enjoyable, even for beginners like us. You could really tell that she wanted everyone to learn and have a great time.

As Filipinos, we especially appreciated how warm and hospitable the staff were. Their friendliness made us feel right at home. And of course, the best part was getting to enjoy the Thai dishes we prepared ourselves! Somehow, the food tasted even better knowing that we made it from scratch.

Definitely a memorable experience, and one we would happily recommend to anyone who wants to learn Thai cooking while enjoying great hospitality!

reviews.name: Léo Meunier
reviews.text: Very nice class! The food was very good and they take the time to answer all the question and share the recipes. I had one of my best pad thaï and Tom yum soup there. Would recommend

reviews.name: Elizabeth Quezada
reviews.text:
Absolutely loved my experience here from cooking and also learning a little more about the markets on where this place is located!

Although this place is a relatively new cooking class it was fun and amazing experience! Everyone was very engaging and and our instructor was super fun but also super dedicated and is very attentive with the correct measurements (especially the mango sticky rice!!)

Would recommend coming in the afternoon booking because it’s not to early and not to late (you will miss the market if u book the night one)

reviews.name: Margherita Benussi
reviews.text:
Great experience!
They all speak good English and Khun Jeab is clear, patient and kind. 🙏
The food that we learn to prepare is so delicious and the place really clean.
I will definitely remember this class! 😋
Plus also they take care of me that I'm vegetarian ✨

reviews.name: Kang wei yun
reviews.text: The experience was absolutely amazing! If you come to Bangkok, you must try a Thai cooking class. The venue is lovely with a very clean kitchen. Teacher Sasi is wonderful — she’s beautiful and extremely patient!

reviews.name: Myat Thadar Kyaw
reviews.text: The cooking class was a fantastic experience! The instructor was friendly and knowledgeable, and the recipes were easy to follow. It was fun, interactive, and I learned how to make authentic Thai dishes. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ting Ting
reviews.text:
I highly recommend this cooking class! We were lucky to have Jeab as our instructor, and she was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and patient throughout the entire experience.

One of the best parts of the class was visiting a local Thai market, where we learned about a wide variety of fresh ingredients, herbs, spices, and beautiful edible flowers. It was a wonderful opportunity to experience authentic Thai market culture before we started cooking.

During the class, we made three savory dishes and one delicious dessert. The instructions were easy to follow, making it perfect for beginners, yet still fun and engaging for anyone who enjoys cooking.

Most importantly, every dish was absolutely delicious! Make sure you come with an empty stomach because you’ll get to enjoy everything you cook, and you’ll leave feeling very full and satisfied.

This was one of the highlights of our trip to Bangkok, and I truly think it’s an experience that’s well worth it. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: John Paul and Lady Dianne
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience at White Lotus Cooking School! The session began with a guided market tour where we picked out fresh ingredients, followed by a visit to the beautiful flower market, which was a great way to experience the local culture.

During the cooking class, we learned how to make mango sticky rice, tom yum (which was absolutely delicious), pad thai, and papaya salad. Every dish was fun to prepare and tasted fantastic.

Our instructor, Ms. Sasi, was incredibly kind, patient, and spoke excellent English, making the class easy to follow and enjoyable for everyone.

The experience was definitely worth the money. At the end of the class, we received a certificate with our names written in Thai, along with thoughtful souvenirs—an inhaler and dried butterfly pea flowers.

I highly recommend White Lotus Cooking School to anyone visiting Thailand. It was one of the highlights of our trip!

reviews.name: hazel tam
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience! The instructor was incredibly enthusiastic and passionate, making the session engaging and fun. Everything was well-organized and systematic, with clear instructions that helped me learn efficiently. The environment was spotlessly clean and beautifully designed, creating a relaxing and inspiring atmosphere. I felt refreshed and motivated throughout. I highly recommend this to all my friends — it’s definitely worth trying! You won’t regret it.

reviews.name: Patryk Siergiej
reviews.text: Great experience, knowledgeable teacher. And most importantly amazing food. Overall a fun experience! Definitely recommend it

reviews.name: Ma. Vallea Andal
reviews.text: Our first activity in Thailand and the best! Worth every penny. We did market tour in the morning first then cooked 4 dishes. The whole thing was so fun! Very easy to follow. Enjoyed every bit of it.

reviews.name: Jade Petit
reviews.text: I had a great time in this cooking class, there were six of us! We first went to the market to understand which ingredients are used in Thai culture and to see what we needed. The cooking class was really interesting, very well explained and really enjoyable. I would definitely come back and I recommend this place. Thank you for this wonderful shared experience 😍😍😍

reviews.name: Patricia Barbero
reviews.text: A great experience with family and friends. Worth the money. We went to the market first and learn a lot about the ingredients and did 4 dishes which is all so good.

reviews.name: John Jimwell Ibañez
reviews.text:
I honestly loved the White Lotus Cooking Class in Bangkok—one of the highlights of my trip.

From start to finish, everything just flowed so smoothly. The experience kicked off with a market visit, which I really enjoyed because it gave context to all the ingredients we’d be using later. It made the whole cooking part feel more meaningful instead of just following a recipe.

Back in the kitchen, the setup was great and super easy to follow. I’m not an expert cook by any means, but the instructions were so clear and simple that I never felt lost. Every step was broken down in a way that made it feel approachable, and somehow everything turned out really good.

Big thanks to Chef Jeab—he made the entire experience. Super friendly, patient, and just had a great energy that made everyone feel comfortable. She explained things in a way that actually stuck, not just something you forget right after the class.
And the food… honestly amazing. I didn’t expect to enjoy everything as much as I did, but every dish was a hit. It’s one of those experiences where you walk away thinking, “I can actually make this again at home.”

Overall, I loved everything about it—the vibe, the people, the food, the teaching style. Easily one of the best things I did in Bangkok. Would 100% recommend.

reviews.name: Aya Joy Ti
reviews.text: I love how Cream teaches us. She’s so patient and made sure that we all got taught properly but in our own time as well. The food we cooked all turned out great and delicious. And there was never a dull moment in the class. We didn’t know 3 hours had passed by and was sad that it had to end. You’ll meet new great people here just like I did with our group this session. I’m really grateful to have attended this class.

reviews.name: Frances Barwick
reviews.text: Went with my husband to this Thai cooking class this morning and really enjoyed it. Definitely recommend. Our teacher was lovely and had a lovely sense of humour and the food we cooked was so good .

reviews.name: Aditya Nambiar
reviews.text: Very good, it was a fantastic experience. I would recommend anyone wanting to do a cooking course in Thailand to do this one.

reviews.name: 林望書

reviews.name: Hands Experiences(Thailand)
reviews.text:
On behalf of Hands Experiences Thailand, we brought our guests to White Lotus Thai Cooking Class and had a wonderful experience 🙏😊

The program was well-organized and offered both valuable knowledge and a truly hands-on Thai cooking experience. The instructors were friendly, professional, and guided our group clearly through each step, making it enjoyable for everyone.

We especially appreciated the opportunity to explore the local community and learn how to select fresh ingredients before cooking. It made the experience even more authentic and meaningful for our guests.

From start to finish, everything was impressive. The staff took great care of our group and provided excellent service throughout.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for an authentic Thai cooking experience!

title: Dii Med Spa
subTitle: Dii Wellness Clinic
ownerDescription:
Dii. It is well-known in Thailand as the medical and aesthetic arm of the renowned Divana Spa brand.

A hybrid "Med Spa" that combines the relaxation of a traditional spa with modern medical technology. The branding often references "DNA" (Dii stands for Divana + Integration + Innovation).

Focuses on holistic anti-aging, facial treatments, vitamin IV drips, and body contouring, delivered in a high-end, futuristic spa environment

reviews.text:
We recently visited Dii Wellness Med Spa at Central Embassy Bangkok, and it was an amazing experience. As an office, we often bring and recommend this place to our clients from Singapore, China, Indonesia, Taiwan, and other countries and they always love it.

This is definitely one of the best spa and massage experiences in Thailand. The therapists are highly skilled and really understand how to identify and relieve tension in the body. You can truly feel their expertise.

Each Divana Wellness branch has its own unique concept, and this one stands out with its modern luxury design. The use of crystals and calming colors creates a very relaxing atmosphere that enhances the whole spa experience. I actually fell asleep during my 120-minute treatment it was that good!

Special thanks to the branch manager, Khun Angelo, who was very kind and attentive, along with the rest of the staff who provided excellent service throughout.

Highly recommend checking out this branch as well as their other locationsyou won’t regret it. Truly satisfying. 5-star service!

title: Natural touch massage @ Ratchathewi corner
ownerDescription:
Welcome to Natural Touch Massage @ Ratchathewi Corner – your go-to spot for relaxation and quality massage therapy in the heart of Bangkok. Conveniently located just 1 minute from BTS Ratchathewi, right on the corner of the Ratchathewi intersection.

We provide a wide range of massage services by skilled and experienced staff, all at affordable prices start at 200฿, Whether you need stress relief, muscle recovery, or a refreshing break, we’ve got you covered.

Come experience the natural touch – your body will thank you.

reviews.name: Shalli Ang
reviews.text: This was the second massage parlour we visited, conveniently located near our hotel. The reception was small, and the premises occupied only the ground floor. There were no private rooms—body massages were done on floor mattresses, separated from the main lobby by curtains. While the atmosphere was not ideal and the space felt tight and crowded, the therapists—mostly local, middle‑aged ladies—were skilled and delivered a good massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your detailed feedback—we really appreciate you taking the time to share your experience 🙏

We’d like to clarify that for traditional Thai massage, it is standard to be done on low bed with curtains for separation, as this allows for the full range of stretching techniques.

However, for guests who prefer more privacy , we do offer private rooms for services such as oil massage, aroma oil, deep tissue, and hot aroma oil massage. These rooms provide a more comfortable and relaxing environment.

reviews.name: Hannah B
reviews.text: Just had a really wonderful hour-long foot and hand massage. I have a really low pain threshold and I'm really ticklish but I hung in there and it's now a couple of hours later and I'm still feeling the benefit. At home I always tell them when it's too hard but I never really feel satisfied after. Here, it was definitely a bit painful at times (most people can take it, I'm just a big wimp) but I'm so glad because my muscles feel like they really needed it. The staff were lovely, we felt very well taken care of and the lady who massaged me was very polite and amused by how ticklish I was. 300 baht for an hour. If we're in the area again, I'll definitely go back.  We were given a little tea and watermelon afterwards and it just made the whole experience very relaxing.

reviews.name: Nguyên Trương
reviews.text:
29 MAY 2026

We tried this spa at our first day in Chiang Mai, it seems like the most favourable one due to its location (opposite with One Nimman) & affordable price (300THB for foot massage, which is the most cheapest in the area I believe as I did a lot research).

reviews.name: Jasmine K

reviews.text: Professional & in a clean,relaxing ambience. Except for some guests who speak on their phones, otherwise, it's a good relaxing session. Affordable too - 300 Bhat for an hour of leg, shoulders & head massage.

reviews.name: Hieu Quang
reviews.text: Awesome experience on my first day landing in Bangkok! Would like to recommend anyone visiting! You cannot beat the price. Fantastic service from the front to the back!

reviews.name: Yasmin Siqueira
reviews.text:
It was our very first time trying traditional Thai massage, and it was truly incredible. The experience started at the entrance, where we were asked to remove our shoes and sit by the hall. They washed our feet with a lightly scented exfoliating cream — a relaxing gesture that set the tone.

There were several massage options available, but we chose the 60-minute traditional Thai massage. After that, we were guided upstairs to change into the comfortable pajamas they provide. As a couple, we stayed in a cozy room with two beds on the floor. The atmosphere was peaceful, with relaxing music that made us feel at ease.

The massage itself was amazing — it helped us release tension, realign our backs, and dissolve muscle knots. We left feeling lighter, more relaxed, and deeply recharged.

At the end, after changing back, we were offered tea with cookies, a delightful way to close the session.

✨ From start to finish, it was a wonderful and memorable experience, and we definitely want to come back again!

reviews.name: Danil Yarovinski
reviews.text: My visit to Holme Thai in Bangkok was a truly rejuvenating experience. The atmosphere was serene and the staff were incredibly welcoming. My therapist was highly skilled, providing a traditional Thai massage that was both relaxing and effective. The salon was very clean and I left feeling completely refreshed. I highly recommend it for anyone seeking an authentic and high-quality massage.
