title: Rajadamnern Muay Thai Stadium
subTitle: สนามมวยราชดำเนิน
description: Historic sports arena showcasing Muay Thai kickboxing matches throughout the week since 1945.
ownerDescription:
Rajadamnern Stadium is the world's first Muay Thai stadium offering authentic fight experiences in Bangkok. Established in 1945, it is the birthplace of professional Muay Thai. Here, visitors from all over the world can witness world-class fighters showcase their skill and talent with events held 7 days a week.

Rajadamnern Stadium offers a one-of-a-kind experience that blends electrifying action with rich cultural heritage. The immersive Muay Thai experience awaits spectators, with traditional rituals, an original Muay Thai orchestra, and a spectacular dome projection showing the sport's 1,000-year history and journey. Enjoy top-tier, adrenaline-fuelled entertainment at the home of Thailand's national sport, Rajadamnern Stadium.
address: 8 Ratchadamnoen Nok Rd, เเขวง วัดโสมนัส, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand
neighborhood: เเขวง วัดโสมนัส

reviews.name: erbu360
reviews.text:
An absolute must-do in Bangkok – Top-tier Muay Thai with bonus fights!

A fantastic experience and an unforgettable night! The atmosphere in this historic stadium (established in 1945) is absolutely electric – from the traditional live music to the roars of the local fans, you can feel the energy in the entire arena. A massive highlight was the breathtaking light show projected onto the giant dome, beautifully animating the origin story of Muay Thai and the stadium’s rich history.

If you want to see authentic, traditional martial arts combined with modern entertainment, this is the place to be. The fighters show incredible respect, discipline, and top-notch technique. Everything was super well-organized and clean, and the staff was very helpful.

You definitely get your money's worth here – almost too much! The event was scheduled to end around 9:30 PM, but the program ran unusually long. Even after the official end time, there were two more thrilling fights, and who knows how many more came after we finally left because we just couldn't sit any longer. The view of the ring was excellent, and it provided a deep, authentic insight into Thai culture.

If you are in Bangkok, don't miss out on this.

Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Viki Lien
reviews.text:
Incredible Muay Thai experience at Bangkok’s oldest stadium! 🥊 🥊🥊
I went to a match on Saturday night and it was an amazing experience. I wasn’t expecting too much since I’d been to Muay Thai events in Chiang Mai before, but this historic stadium is on a completely different level.
The lights, sound, intense fights, and electric atmosphere were spectacular. There are fun interactive games between rounds, plus free-flow beer🍺 which makes the night even better!
Even if Muay Thai isn’t usually your thing, I highly recommend going at least once. It’s a fantastic way to experience Thai culture and enjoy the unforgettable vibe.

reviews.name: Chris Kinston
reviews.text: What a great night! The venue is amazing and the action was great. We saw 6 fights, sitting at the top (tickets 1000 bht) you can pick your spot and the views were great. We spent half the time sitting, then standing, cheering, dancing. The atmosphere is electric, the light and visual shows are incredible too. It's not cheap, but fully recommended. There were a lot, lot, lot of tourists here, which is of course good as we are too, but I would like to find a more Thai place next time, maybe the Channel 7 stadium, but they opened earlier in the day and we missed that.

reviews.name: Waad Mahmoud
reviews.text: I was hesitant at first, but I’m so glad I decided to come! The matches were exciting, and the whole experience was really fun. You get to watch traditional Muay Thai while enjoying the music and lively atmosphere, which makes the experience even more memorable. Definitely something you should try at least once!

reviews.name: KURI NGUYEN
reviews.text:
An unforgettable experience and easily the best Muay Thai event I’ve ever attended. Watching RWS (Rajadamnern World Series) live was absolutely incredible. The atmosphere was electric, with passionate fans, amazing production, and world-class fighters putting on exciting matches from start to finish.

The stadium itself is well organised, the seating offers great views of the ring, and everything was run professionally. Whether you’re a lifelong Muay Thai fan or watching your first live event, this is an experience you shouldn’t miss.

Overall, this was one of the highlights of my trip to Bangkok. The best, best, best Muay Thai experience ever. I can’t wait to come back and watch another RWS event!

reviews.name: ladda sabaichit
reviews.text:
This place is an absolute must-visit if you’re in Bangkok! The lighting, sound, and overall production are on another level — it feels more like a live show than just a boxing match. The energy in the stadium is incredible, especially with the traditional music rhythms that build up the excitement and pull the crowd into every moment.

What I really loved is how it blends authentic Thai culture with a modern, entertaining experience. You don’t just watch Muay Thai — you feel it. The atmosphere is electric, and it’s easy to get caught up in the cheering and emotions of each fight.

There are quite a lot of international visitors here, along with some locals, which makes it a really fun and diverse crowd. The venue itself is clean, well-organized, and smoke-free, which makes the experience even more enjoyable.

If you’re even slightly interested in Muay Thai, I highly recommend coming here. It’s exciting, immersive, and honestly one of the coolest cultural experiences you can have in Thailand.

reviews.name: Longy
reviews.text:
We attended the Wednesday night Traditional fights and loved it.  It's worth noting that there are different styles/promotions depending on the night you attend.  Can't wait to check out Sunday night.  We were very impressed with the skill, speed, athleticism and durability of the fighters.  They fought hard but with respect, which suited us fine.

There was a cool AV show between the two cards which was both entertaining and informative.  Between bouts they put the antics of the crowd up on the big screen, which was fun.

Was the crowd mostly tipsy tourists?  Yes.
Did they pump in fake crowd noise to improve the atmosphere?  Yes.
Was it a relatively expensive night out?  Yes.
Will we be back for more?  Absolutely.

reviews.name: G Brown
reviews.text:
A brilliant experience worth an evening. I've been to Thai boxing events before but never here. I booked online and came just after 6 pm (I think I may have missed some part of it).

We sat the the main stadium so nothing fancy, but it was absolutely fine and we had a great view. The matches start around 6pm and seems to go on for at least 4+ hours (we left at 10pm) and you'll get to see lots of fights and can eat at the event with service right in your seat. It's easy to get invested in one of or two of the fighters - and the locals take the atmosphere up a notch as they bet and cheer on their fighters.

The stadium itself is amazing, the intermission they give you a brief history of the stadium and the sport. Visually excellent.

Don't miss.

reviews.name: DJ TEDDY
reviews.text:
An absolute must-visit for anyone traveling to Bangkok—whether you're a die-hard martial arts fan or just looking for a truly authentic Thai cultural experience. Seeing a fight at the historic Rajadamnern Stadium is an entirely different level of intensity compared to watching on TV.
​Why it’s a 5-star experience:
​The Atmosphere: From the moment you walk in, the energy is palpable. You are surrounded by the true heartbeat of the sport. The live sarama (traditional music) that speeds up as the fighters engage adds an incredible layer of tension and excitement that you just don't get elsewhere.
​World-Class Skill: You are witnessing the absolute pinnacle of Muay Thai. The technical level, the speed, the clinch work, and the sheer heart these athletes display is breathtaking. You’ll see fights ranging from rising prospects to seasoned veterans, all fighting with elite precision.
​The Venue: As one of the oldest and most prestigious stadiums in the country, the architecture and history are special. Even the way the crowd reacts—the roar during a big kick or a clinch—makes you feel like part of something legendary.
​Pro-Tips for Visitors:
​Get close: Try to book ringside or second-tier seats if you can; being close enough to hear the connection of the strikes is worth every cent.
​Arrive early: Soak up the pre-fight rituals (Wai Kru Ram Muay). It’s a beautiful, respectful display of tradition before the combat begins.
​Stay hydrated: It gets hot and humid, especially when the stadium is packed, so grab some water at the concessions.
​If you are in Bangkok, don't miss this. It’s loud, it’s intense, and it’s arguably the most authentic combat sports experience in the world.

reviews.name: Eric Lee
reviews.text: I’m not even sure if anyone would ever rate this less than five stars! This place is amazing because almost every seat has a great view of the Muay Thai fights! The gift store is also amazing. My only advice is always trying to get tickets in advance for the big fights that happens normally on Saturdays! Best experience for the entire Bangkok vacation!

reviews.name: Melly
reviews.text:
A must visit attraction in BKK
A 3h  show with a lot entertainment and History about Thailand and the culture of Muai Thai. My family was seated the first time in the ring side section which was the closest to the ring, but did not like how you basically look up the entire time.
I did some research and booked the club class section 8-9 and we got the best view.
The only downside are people selling F&B walking back and forth between your view and in between rows. I guess that is also a comfort for visitors to not have to get up to grab a drink and miss anything.

reviews.name: World Commentator
reviews.text:
I have no complaints about the stadium or the fights. The event itself was great.

My complaint is about your parking staff.

I paid 100 THB for parking, but your staff asked me to get out of my car and drove my car without my permission. I was fully capable of parking it myself. Why did your staff need to drive my personal vehicle?

What made me even more upset was that it was raining heavily. Your staff sat inside my car for about two minutes while I was standing outside in the rain waiting. He did not explain anything or even open the door. Why was he sitting in my car? What was he doing?

After that, my car was left dirty. Everyone has different standards for keeping their car clean. Your staff should respect customers' property.

This is not acceptable service. This is a matter of respect and professionalism.

Rajadamnern Stadium is one of the oldest and most famous Muay Thai stadiums in Thailand. I expected much better management and much better staff behavior.

Again, I have no problem with the fights or the venue. My only complaint is the parking service and the attitude of your staff.

I would like an explanation and a sincere apology for what happened.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear World Commentatorop,

Thank you for visiting Rajadamnern Stadium and for taking the time to share your review. We are pleased to hear that you enjoyed the event and the fights, but we are truly sorry to learn about your experience with our parking service.

We sincerely apologize for the frustration and inconvenience you experienced. We understand your concerns regarding your vehicle being driven without a clear explanation, the lack of communication from our parking staff, the inconvenience of having to wait in the rain, and the care shown toward your personal property. We recognize that these concerns relate to the level of professionalism and respect that every guest should expect during their visit.

Your feedback has been well noted and will be carefully reviewed with the relevant team as we continuously work to improve the overall guest experience and ensure our service standards are consistently upheld.

If you're willing to share any additional details, such as the date and time of your visit or any other relevant information, please contact us at at info@rajadamnern.com. This will help us investigate the matter thoroughly.

We sincerely apologize once again and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future and provide you with a much better experience.

Best regards,
Rajadamnern Stadium

reviews.name: Rick Eiseman
reviews.text:
This was a fun experience. A stadium full of foreigners experiencing Muay Thai fighting. Very much like a WWE experience with lights and sounds and walk up music. They spend part of the evening educating on the history of Rajadamnern Stadium and Muay Thai fighting. That was great to learn but I would find it boring night after night is I went regularly. Make me think this is all about foreigners and nothing about local fight scene.
The action was intense and blood was spilled and I definitely gained more interest in Muay Thai fighting. The history of the stadium and fighting was great to learn and added to the experience since I learned a lot to include how scoring is determined.
I would go again for sure.

reviews.name: Sachin Kundra
reviews.text:
Rajadamnern Muay Thai Stadium in Bangkok is an absolute must visit if you want to experience the true spirit of Thailand. The atmosphere inside the stadium is electric from the moment you walk in, you can feel the energy building with the crowd, the music, and the anticipation of each fight. It’s not just a sporting event; it’s a cultural experience that gives you a deeper appreciation of Muay Thai and its history.

The fights themselves are intense, skillful, and incredibly entertaining. Each match showcases discipline, technique, and raw power, keeping you fully engaged throughout the night. The traditional music played during the fights adds an authentic touch, making the experience even more immersive.

The seating is well organized, and no matter where you sit, you still get a good view of the action. Staff are helpful, and the overall organization is smooth, even with large crowds.

Whether you’re a fan of combat sports or just curious to try something unique, Rajadamnern Stadium delivers an unforgettable night. It’s one of those experiences that stays with you long after you leave Bangkok.

reviews.name: Pam Duncan
reviews.text: Came here 25 years ago and the stadium experience has improved since then. 25 years ago it was a no-frills event. It is an 80 year old stadium with lots of history and they have updated with live cameras, two screens showing the live action, club lights and strobes, stadium tvs around the arena for ads and setting the mood and displaying facts about the sport, updated bathrooms, and a projection show displayed on the ceiling and screens around to tell a bit of the history of the sport and culture. They have also made the evening interactive— getting people up on their feet to dance by giving out free Tshirts in the middle of the evening, playing (mostly) American songs loudly, kiss cam, a bottoms up cam, and more, overall making this a party and theatric entertainment type of evening playing towards foreigners though Thai locals still come to watch the fights. We came on a Thursday for the traditional Muay Thai fights. Our first visit, we sat ring side and was unique to watch things up close but as the fight moves around the ring to the other side, you can’t see what is happening and depending on where you are seating, you may not have a view of the TV without turning your head. Note: if you sit ring side, you can also get splattered with the water and sweat the fighters have on them. This time we got Club Class which is section 8 and 9, and received Row B- which is perfect eye level. I am on the short side so the ring’s ropes got in my way of seeing the fighters’ faces sometimes but I just ducked my view. I prefer Section 8 and 9 over ring side because I can see all the action. The VIP section but it doesn’t seem worth it with the cost. In VIP, you get to sit behind a counter and have an individual chair but the counter height looks too high and you don’t get a view of the ring and tv on the background at the same time depending on which VIP section. Tshirts and Muay Thai shorts sold in the official souvenir shop are expensive. Take pictures for your memories. On Thursday: Doors open at 5, first fight at 6, and the projection show on the ceiling at 8:15pm. The main fights start after the projection show.

reviews.name: EmMarco Pro
reviews.text:
One of the highlights of my Bangkok trip. The atmosphere was electric from the moment I walked in. The fights were exciting, the production was professional, and the crowd energy made every match feel important.

Even if you’re not a hardcore Muay Thai fan, the experience is worth it. The stadium is clean, organized, and easy for tourists to enjoy. Watching Thailand’s national sport live in such an iconic venue was unforgettable.

Highly recommended if you’re visiting Bangkok and want an authentic Thai experience.

reviews.name: Jackie Fiedler
reviews.text:
Awesome experience!

Great views from all the seats, immersive visuals, live music.  The MC was very engaging and entertaining.  Servers were attentive and food/drinks were reasonable.
Great marches!

Very happy we got to experience this!

reviews.name: Beverly Hollberg
reviews.text:
Sat in the Leo section, arrived about 5:15 and pretty much had our choice of seats. The Leo section is sitting on concrete, but the view is good and you’re next to the local Thai betting section. We sat front row, but I’d recommend sitting maybe halfway up for a better view. Also - eat before hand as the food is pricy (290 baht for a burger, 180 baht slice of pizza) and not good.
Large beer 280 baht, cocktails 220 baht.
So - it’s a fun experience but if you’re planning on eating and drinking for a 5.5 hour long night of fights be prepared to spend a lot!

reviews.name: Toms Arackal
reviews.text:
Went there for a Muay Thai experience today. The stadium was great and the immersion experience was awesome. The staff were awesome as well, everyone from the ticket counter, seating staff as well as the food and beverage staff all did their part very well.

The food was decemt, however the pop corn was all soggy and not good.

All the Muay thai matches were also awesome.

reviews.name: Anthony P
reviews.text:
Visiting the Rajadamnern Muay Thai Stadium was a highlight of my trip. Being at the historic birthplace of this sport creates a unique and powerful atmosphere that you won't find anywhere else.
The matches are high-energy, and I was particularly impressed by the modern production and great technology used in the arena. A standout feature was the interaction with the audience—the fun games and activities during the breaks kept everyone engaged and the spirits high.
The at-seat service was also excellent, allowing me to fully focus on the fights. You are doing a fantastic job keeping the tradition of Muay Thai alive while providing a top-tier modern experience. I’ll definitely be back!

title: Toksen Siprai Massage ICONSIAM - นวดตอกเส้นสีไพร ไอคอนสยาม
ownerDescription:
Are you experiencing pain, soreness, or tension? Find relief with our Toksen Sripai massage. Visit our branches in ICONSIAM, Bang Rak, Rama 2, and Bang Bua Thong.

Book your appointment today and experience the benefits of Toksen Sripai massage.✨
address: The Northeastern Thai House, located on the Ground Floor of ICONSIAM 299 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand
street: The Northeastern Thai House, located on the Ground Floor of ICONSIAM 299 Charoen Nakhon Rd

reviews.name: Haru Thang Zhe Wei
reviews.text:
Tried a unique massage at Toksen Siprai Massage. It’s a traditional tok sen style massage that feels like a gentle hammering technique.
After walking the whole day with a backpack, my shoulders and back were very stiff. Luckily, just opposite Tam Siam Restaurant there is a staircase — go up to the second floor and you’ll find the massage shop.
At first my wife was a bit scared to try because of the hammering sound, but I convinced her. We took a 20-minute session, and surprisingly it felt really good. After the treatment, our shoulders and back felt much more relaxed and the stiffness was gone. We were so relaxed we almost fell asleep! 😌
If you’ve never tried tok sen massage before, they even offer a free trial for a few minutes, so you can experience it first. Definitely an interesting and relaxing experience to try!

reviews.name: Мария Максимовна
reviews.text: I love this place so much!!! We have been there in November and it was a wonderful experience❤️ special thanks to Kittikan Aoi! Our bodies felt incredible after this massage:)

reviews.name: J P
reviews.text: Nat is amazing. Whole staff is great. Best 90min in Bangkok. At first, I didn’t know what kind of massage this was. And not gonna lie, it was painful at times, but it’s all worth it!! My muscles feel new. Amazing Nat!

reviews.name: Rachel P
reviews.text: I walked in to do some shopping and saw this therapy centre. I’ve been suffering with piriformis syndrome and a dropped foot and hadn’t had any treatment for a few weeks so was very pleased to walk in and be seen immediately. The therapist understood my condition and it was a very intense but useful session for me. I would definitely recommend Mr Neng.

reviews.name: Victor Seow
reviews.text: My legs and especially my feet were extremely tired after walking for hours since the morning. I wanted fast relief and here at Toksen Sripai, I got what I needed! Btw, My therapist named Yaya is experienced and truly committed. She knows her stuff!!!

reviews.name: Jamie Serene
reviews.text: Mdm KOUB solved my backache and shoulder ache. She is very attentive and keep checking if I am ok. I done Toksen a few times and she is very experienced. Strongly recommended to try and look for her.

reviews.name: Pauline Wee
reviews.text: I had a 1.5-hour Thai massage treatment at ICONSIAM and was lucky to be attended to by Keng. She was incredibly experienced and highly skilled — her technique was both strong and precise, relieving all the tension in my shoulders and back. The atmosphere was relaxing and clean, and the staff were warm and professional. I left feeling refreshed and completely rejuvenated. Highly recommend asking for Keng if you’re looking for a proper, therapeutic Thai massage!

reviews.name: Sandeep Indraganti
reviews.text: Tried hammer massage with Soangpon for my soaring lower back and Legs. Back pain almost reduced instantly and legs recovering. Worth a try if u come ICONSIAM. Ground floor.

reviews.name: Janella Cruz
reviews.text: I had such an amazing experience at this Thai massage place. The staff were very welcoming, the atmosphere was relaxing, and the massage itself was perfect. The pressure was just right, and they really focused on the areas that needed attention. I left feeling so light and refreshed. Definitely coming back again — highly recommend! 🧘‍♀️✨

reviews.name: Michelle Acosta
reviews.text: It was an amazing experience. I was even able to replace the massager, thanks to Miss Kob. Her massage was really strong and felt incredibly good. Thank you so much for the best experience. Highly recommended massage at Iconisam.

reviews.name: CHOLE
reviews.text: Great spot to relax before or after shopping! Great service from the staff who were all very friendly and welcoming. Very professional treatment and afforable prices! A must try in ICON siam!

reviews.name: Shouq Alkaabi
reviews.text:
I had an excellent massage experience. The staff were exceptionally kind and welcoming. Special thanks to Natty, Fahy.

As a hijabi, I truly appreciated the level of privacy provided, which made me feel completely at ease.

reviews.name: J S
reviews.text:
Great service by Tik and another male colleague. A very unique massage service where they utilise tools (mallet and wedge) to massage any 'tightened' parts of your body. A must try if ever wanting to experience something different and relaxing.

This spot is quite hidden and located upstairs in a wooden-house structure inside SOOKSIAM at ICONSIAM. Before entering, guests are asked to remove their shoes and place them neatly inside a wooden cupboard. Once inside, you can choose your massage duration (15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, etc.) and the targeted area (back, shoulders, legs, full-body, etc.). The environment is surprisingly comfortable due to it being fully air-conditioned with occasional sound of live performances from the nearby stage.

I went for the full-body massage and they would rhythmically tap on your body with a wooden mallet and wedge. By the end of it, my body felt really light and relaxed (almost jelly-like). Following that, they would serve a cup of warm herbal tea and advised me to avoid drinking cold water immediately after (have to wait for few hours before doing so).

reviews.name: Simon Charles
reviews.text:
Just had an amazing toksen massage at Toksen Siprai in Iconsiam. Soang Pon was an expert and very very good. My grand daughter also had traditional Thai massage which she really enjoyed. I would definitely recomend and would visit again if I was staying in Bangkok.
Thankyou Soang Pon and everyone at Tokse Siprai.

reviews.name: A AA
reviews.text: Extraordinary  massage, with unique (Toksen) tacneek that removes the pain and relaxed the body, my wife and myself had a special treatment from the professional Ms. Tik and Ms. keng, thank you so much

reviews.name: Krisna Thiengtham
reviews.text: Therapist named J provided such wonderful service after having long time back pain he knew exactly how to cure it.

reviews.name: Sebastian Blunck
reviews.text:
One of the best massages I’ve ever had. The therapist worked very intuitively and really focused on the areas that needed attention. You can tell they tailor the treatment to your body.
Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Norqusyairy Rejab
reviews.text: I'm a Malaysian and this is my first massage ever I tried 😭😂. I'm 25Y with 50KG body weight, they doit with comfortable and quiet friendly. They will always observe you if you do like pain face/reaction and they will ask you if is it ok to continue or do it slowly. The hammer knock knock thing is not painful unless you have like muscle pain. They easily find "issue/problem" area and will try to fix it straight away but quite pain😭 and end up with relieved. They might hard to communicate but very friendly, I recommend to use a translator to communicate with them. My massager name is Tik if not mistaken, she quite friendly and know how to crack, knock and massage. I really enjoyed it and recommend it to everyone. Also they give like some hot herbal tea for complimentary drinks after the massage.

reviews.name: Alex Honore
reviews.text: Just visiting Thailand, and I had some pain in my scapula that was causing discomfort with coughing and deep breathing.  My family happened to walk by Toksen Sripai and I decided to try it out to help with my pain.  I had J as my therapist, and even with a short session I felt some improvement in my pain.

reviews.name: Johans Wong
reviews.text: I had a short but excellent massage with Keng at Toksen Sripai. Unfortunately, I only had time for a quick session, but she focused on my tennis elbow and it made a difference. I wish I’d had more time to enjoy a full treatment. Thank you so much, and I’ll definitely be back again!

title: DreamHouse Thai Massage (Langsuan)
ownerDescription:
"Let’s come and dream with us"

DreamHouse concept is focusing on relaxing, healing body and mind from a busy day with our treatment therapy. It is a cosy spa that located in the center of Bangkok where people can reach easily. Also, we aim to serve the best spa experience in every step from the first step you entered DreamHouse.

​DreamHouse เป็นสปาสำหรับการนวดคลายความเครียด และทำให้ผ่อนคลายอย่างสบาย ร้านตั้งอยู่ในทำเลใจกลางเมืองเพื่อความสะดวกในการเดินทาง ลูกค้าทุกท่านจะได้สัมผัสความสุข ความสบาย และความประทับใจ ตั้งแต่ก้าวแรกที่เดินเข้ามาถึง
address: 80 Soi Langsuan, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

reviews.name: Abdulla Adel
reviews.text:
The massage was amazing, and they did a really good job. The place itself is absolutely stunning.

However, I just want people to know that the massage area is open, so everyone is seated close to each other. During our massage, another customer told us to be quiet, and we respected that. But after about 10 minutes, she was the one making noise, so I politely asked her to be quiet as well, and then she went silent.

Overall, the experience was great, but just keep in mind that it is an open area where everyone is next to each other.

reviews.name: mewkletigre
reviews.text:
The entire experience was highly average at best. My partner took up a 90min aroma oil massage, but was out of the massage in 1h10min.

I had taken up a 90min foot massage. The first masseuse was horrible, after requesting her to use more strength twice, she proceeded to use a CHOPSTICK to massage my foot. The shop allowed a change of masseuse within the first 15 minutes, which I promptly did. I normally wouldn't, but this is was the most shambolic attempt of a massage I've ever had, a chopstick, seriously?

That being said, the second replacement masseuse was excellent and more than made up for it. No complaints apart from the fact that the massage ended 10 minutes earlier than the 90 mins I had paid for. Perhaps it was the fact that we were late, but this shortened massage time wasn't made known to us.

Not the best, not the worst. They ask people to review the shop, hence the high reviews. Come at ur own risk

reviews.name: Sunny Chang
reviews.text:
Super nice ! You will have a wonderful experience here!
And….
I forgot my expensive necklace after massage.
But they kept it for me.
If I did another place, I’m sure I’ll lose it.
They are trustworthy!

reviews.name: Riny U
reviews.text: Booked a 2 hour Thai body massage on the day of departure and it was amazing! The massage was deep and I felt rejuvenated after it. The masseuse started off with a foot wash, leg massage next and ended with a shoulder and head massage. No oil used, only the strength of their arms and feet. If it feels a little painful, you can request for the strength to be softer. They also provided refreshments before and after the massage. The massage was really 2 hours long, exact on the clock. Worth going for and will come back again when I'm in BKK in the future!

reviews.name: Frieda Chiang
reviews.text: We came to this place through the recommendation by the hotel. We had a 1.5 hours of Thai massage and we had Jit and Noi. They are both amazingly good. My husband and I both had many massages before but we both agreed they are both very outstanding. Debating whether we should come back again tomorrow before we head out.

reviews.name: Scarlett
reviews.text: Came twice during our trip and enjoyed both session, told my masseuse my back was sore and she spent more time on that area. Love the milk and the drink and pineapple at the end

reviews.name: Asyrani Lin
reviews.text:
Not the cheapest price wise, but you get what you paid for. Place is clean and quiet. Ambience you get is calming. Room has its own clean shower facilities when you choose a massage with oil or scrub option. Masseuse is good and very attentive.

Would definitely recommend and come again when I’m in town.

Plenty of parking which is a plus point as well.

reviews.name: Deadprawn
reviews.text: I did not get complimentary 30 mins massage as what other had mentioned, so this review is true and based on my experiences. Chance upon this place for massage. I did shoulder and head massage in the morning with them and then came back for Thai massage in the evening. Overall, I would say this is one of the best quality massage I had in Bangkok! Maybe I am lucky to get experienced masseur for both massage session. The ambient is clean and price is also very reasonable. Really love the Disney  piano music playing in the background 🤣. It was really sweet of them to serve milk before the massage and then tea and pineapple for customer to freshen up after massage! I will definitely come back here again when I visit Bangkok!

reviews.name: Kelsey Chen
reviews.text: The massage environment did not seem very hygienic. During the treatment, the therapist did not even close the curtain, allowing mosquitoes to fly in and buzz around me. In addition, the therapist relied mainly on excessive force. During the 120-minute massage, she appeared to become drowsy and pressed on me painfully with wrong steps. I was left with bruises afterwards. I would not recommend this place.

reviews.name: Mei Hwan Sia PropNex
reviews.text: We have a bad encounter today. We had made a booking at 9.45pm. We were looking forward and arrived earlier to get ready for our foot massage. After sitting and waited, the staff came and informed that the previous customer came late and therefore one of our booking can’t proceed as booked. We were asked to change from foot massage to other types of massage as only one foot massage is available. We felt that was unfair as the previous customer being late should not be affecting the next coming customer schedule. The late customer should be responsible for their own time and shorten his or her time instead of affecting other customer time as our booking is already scheduled. This was indeed very disappointing for us and we had to leave and didn’t get our foot massage. The shop image is very convincing but the system is very unprofessional. The booking system should be reviewed and improved by the management including educating the customer not to be late for their booking time and the staff should also ensure other customers time are precious and respect too. Understood that other massage centres do not allow such unpleasant experience. It was a disappointment for us!

reviews.name: Joey Chong
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at Dream House! The masseur was incredibly skilled and attentive, ensuring every muscle was relaxed during the 2-hour Thai massage session. Their technique was flawless, balancing the perfect amount of pressure with soothing movements. I left feeling completely rejuvenated and at peace. It was the perfect way to rest and unwind. I highly recommend Dream House to anyone looking for a truly relaxing and professional massage experience in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Jason Dunn
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my foot massage at DreamHouse. It's a bit of a hidden gem - literally - because it's down an alley and not easy to see from the street. But it's worth going to because unlike some other places in Bangkok, it matches the pictures and the reviews seem to be from real people.

It looks to be a brand new facility, with everything you would expect, including a front desk for check-in, a nice seating area, air conditioning, and two bathrooms. Everything is clean and professional.

I had a one hour foot massage, and it was a pleasant and relaxing experience. The masseuse was proficient and massaged my feet, ankles, and calves. The majority of the time was spent on my feet, but near the end she did a little work on my arms, shoulders and neck. It was more relaxing than therapeutic, but that's exactly what I wanted.

My coworker had a one hour traditional Thai massage and she said it was excellent and would highly recommend it to others.

All in all, a good value for only 420 Baht. They do have a minimum charge of 500 Baht to use a credit card, so that's something to be aware of. I will certainly come back to try some of their other services!

reviews.name: Richard Z
reviews.text: Very professional foot massage, booked it for an hour and it really helped me loosen my tight muscles after walking around so much. The welcome drink and herbal drink after the massage was a great touch and really helps set the mood. The star lit massage room is also relaxing too and they have super comfy massage chairs. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: AC HK
reviews.text:
Excellent massage! Great service.

We came here two times. First time was for 60 min foot massage and second visit for 60 min Thai massage plus 60 min foot massage.

Massager is so good and plenty of strength. It was a very serious massage at a good value. The facility is also new and clean.

You can book via google maps chat.  Very easy

reviews.name: Nomz77
reviews.text:
Lovely massage place with nice interiors and comfortable/clean facilities.

reviews.name: Huntrix
reviews.text:
4명이 했는데 나만 15분 일찍 끝남. 주인은 진상취급하며 3명이 15분 더 받는거라 우김

Please make sure to check the actual massage time.
When I brought up the issue, the owner treated me like I was just being difficult.

Four of us went for massages three got foot massages, and I had a full-body massage in a separate room. Strangely, my session ended 15 minutes earlier than the others. I was left waiting while everyone else was still getting theirs. It seemed like my therapist either misread the time or just ended early.

When I mentioned it, the owner insisted the time written on their sheet was correct and claimed the others just happened to get longer massages. But that doesn’t make sense does that mean all three therapists gave my family 15 minutes of extra service for free?

In the end, I did get a refund for the missing 15 minutes, but honestly, it wasn’t about the money it was the attitude that bothered me.

As a business owner, when a customer raises a concern, you should try to understand the situation and respond with proper acknowledgment, not pushback.

The massage itself was decent. I live nearby and would’ve become a regular if the owner had handled it better.
Such a shame.

reviews.name: Colins
reviews.text:
I visited this massage salon recently. From the outside, everything looked pretty good and promising. I decided to try their “5-in-1” program, which they advertised as their bestseller.

Unfortunately, the massage was a huge disappointment. It was very painful, and it didn’t feel like the therapist was interested in giving a quality massage at all. She kept getting distracted, looking out the window and chatting with her colleagues instead of focusing on the session. I was clearly uncomfortable, even wincing and reacting to the pain, but she didn’t seem to notice or care.

The chair was extremely squeaky, doors kept slamming, and there was a lot of noise around. On top of that, the air conditioner was blasting, so the room felt uncomfortably cold. It was impossible to relax.

The massage itself felt very chaotic and inconsistent. One hand was treated one way, the other hand completely differently. Some techniques were done once and never repeated, others were changed randomly. There was no sense of structure or balance.

Honestly, I chose this place because of the good reviews, but for me it turned out to be a complete disappointment. I wouldn’t recommend visiting this place. You are probably better off looking for another massage salon.

At the end of the massage, they served me hot tea and even gave me a small balm as a gift. Highly recommended – a relaxing, professional, and pleasant experience.

title: Yunomori Onsen & Spa Sathorn 10
subTitle: ยูโนะโมริ ออนเซ็น แอนด์ สปา สาทร 10
ownerDescription:
Yunomori Sathorn is a wellness spa that combines ancient Japanese onsen bathing culture with traditional Thai massage techniques to create a deeply relaxing experience. We invite you to bathe in healing water sourced directly from the thermal springs of Wat Wangkanai to detoxify and relax the body and enhance the effects of our holistic spa treatments administered by skilled therapists.
Yunomori Onsen & Spa in Sathorn, Bangkok, is a retreat from the hectic pace of city life. Escape for an hour or a day at our onsen, spa, cafe, and beauty clinic and restore your energy and balance. Alongside our onsen and spa is a healthy restaurant, a Garden Lounge, and a rooftop Tea & Sky Lounge, offering a tranquil setting in the middle of the city.

reviews.name: krongkwan Tongmee
reviews.text:
This was my first visit, and I was greeted by a very friendly and smiling reception team. A staff member named Pokky took care of me; they were very welcoming and gave great recommendations for both the onsen and massage packages. Even though I decided to go with just the onsen this time, the service was impressive.
Since it was my first time, the onsen layout was a bit confusing, but the staff at the entrance was very helpful. They provided a bag with large and small towels. Inside, there are various pools, a sauna, and well-organized shower/dressing areas. The overall atmosphere and service are excellent.
After my soak, I spent some time in the resting room, it’s very quiet and perfect for relaxing. They also have a restaurant zone which I didn't get a chance to try this time, but I'll definitely be back for it.
Overall:🙂 I really liked it, and the price is very reasonable. My only minor complaint is that the facility is split between two buildings, which makes the layout a bit confusing to navigate.

Yumonori Onsen & Spa (Sathorn)

reviews.name: Daichi Shoji
reviews.text:
I normally don’t write reviews but this time I was so disappointed due to their services.

I’ve been to the Pattaya branch and loved it so I chose this onsen facility without a doubt. However, the problem that I had here was that I was not allowed to enjoy the onsen after receiving a massage and I was not informed of that when I checked in at the reception. I enjoyed the onsen and saunas for about an hour and I was at the lounge to meet the therapist 5 mins before the session but the lady at the reception abruptly told me that I need to grab all my belongings because I’m not allowed to come back to the onsen area. I understand there are some policies that we need to follow. Even so, this needed to be announced beforehand as I was definitely thinking of going back to the onsen after the massage.

So after the massage, I was guided to the reception to pay tips for the therapist, and then I was asked to leave the facility. I did not even see the other areas like the food lounge area and the relaxing room, which I should have access to. Furthermore, I didn’t even have time to use a bathroom after 90 mins therapy because the therapist rushed to take me to the reception. So I asked the receptionist that I didn’t have a chance to see the remaining areas and she gave me an arm band in a different colour to stay.

Of course my yukata was taken away after the massage therapy and I was the only one exploring the facility in a regular clothing so I didn’t not want to stay even though the relaxing room seemed nice and quiet to rest.

Overall, the warning that I want to give anyone who is thinking to visit this facility, is that if you purchase onsen and therapy package, YOU ARE NOT ALLOWED TO REVISIT ONSEN AREA and EXPECT TO GRAB ALL OF YOUR BELONGINGS BEFORE THE THERAPY AS YOU ARE EXPECTED TO LEAVE AFTER THE SESSION.

but if you are simply purchasing the onsen access, it won’t be an issue.

The onsen facilities and the massage therapy were outstanding.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Daichi Shoji

Best Regards,
Yumonori Onsen & Spa (Sathorn)

reviews.name: Rain S
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with my recent visit to Yunomori Onsen & Spa Sathorn. I have visited Yunomori before, but this experience was far below the standard I expected.

The management was poorly organized, and the staff were unfriendly and lacked professionalism. The overall standard has clearly dropped. The cleanliness was also disappointing. The massage room was dirty and untidy, and even the onsen facilities did not feel clean . For a premium onsen and spa, hygiene should always be a top priority.

I made my reservation well in advance and specifically requested a particular masseur, as well as separate massage rooms for my friend and me. However, neither request was honored. I was informed only at the last minute that my therapist had been changed, without any prior notice or apology. This demonstrated poor communication and a lack of respect for customers’ bookings and preferences.

The service after the massage was equally disappointing. After an aromatherapy oil massage, I expected to be provided with a clean towel before taking a shower. Instead, the staff handed me a cup of tea and the tipping form first. No one offered me a clean towel, and I was left waiting until I eventually had to take a towel myself. To make matters worse, the only towel available appeared to have already been used. It gave me the impression that collecting tips was given more attention than providing basic customer care and ensuring guests were comfortable after their treatment.

What made the experience even more disappointing was that I brought a friend because I wanted her to experience and enjoy a relaxing onsen and 2 hrs massage. Unfortunately, instead of ending our trip on a positive note, the poor service, lack of cleanliness, and unprofessional management left us both with a very disappointing final impression.

Based on my experience, the Sukhumvit branch is significantly better. The facilities are cleaner, the staff are more attentive, and the overall service is much more professional. I sincerely hope the Sathorn branch improves its management, hygiene standards, staff training, cleanliness, and communication with customers, because the current standard does not reflect what customers should expect from Yunomori Onsen & Spa.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Rain S

Thank you for your valuable feedback. We sincerely appreciate your suggestions and will use them to improve our services to provide better experience for all value customers. We hope to welcome you back again soon.

Best Regards,
Yumonori Onsen & Spa (Sathorn)

The quiet zone now have only one floor (It used to be two floors). The roof top never open every time I visited. The only good decision I have made is I have decided not to upgrade and try the spa facilities. It is definitely not worth of value.

I also try Sukhumvit branch to see if there is any difference and I was welcomed by spoiled soft serve that raise food and safety concern. I'm so glad that I have used up all the vouchers so I can enjoy Onsen elsewhere.

reviews.text:
I read some reviews saying that the place wasn't clean or the staffs weren't so nice. Turned out it was very good.

Facilities were clean, the onsen also.
Water temp was around 42°C fyi.
They also have 3 lounging areas. Relaxing and quiet.

reviews.name: Tanukichi
reviews.text:
This was my first visit to Yunomori Onsen’s Sathorn branch, and honestly, I left feeling underwhelmed.

From the start, the cashier was unfriendly and unwelcoming. I’m not sure if it was because I only opted for the onsen day pass instead of their massage service, but his attitude certainly didn’t set a good tone. I’ve tried the massage at their Sukhumvit branch before and wasn’t impressed, so I didn’t see a reason to try it here either.

Once inside the onsen area, I noticed something odd—some patrons were wearing black shorts. I’m not sure if these were provided by the onsen, but it felt strange and out of place. Naturally, you’re supposed to be fully naked in an onsen, and having clothing in the baths makes the experience feel less clean, especially considering detergent residue from the fabric.

On the plus side, the facility itself was clean enough, and they have a nice garden, which adds to the atmosphere. There’s also a restaurant just beyond the garden offering food and chilled drinks, though I didn’t try it this time since I had dinner plans at ICONSIAM.

The rest area is located on the upper floor above the restaurant and was fairly relaxing. They provide a blanket, which is a nice touch, but I would have preferred if they offered something to layer over the pillow for hygiene purposes.

Overall, I’m giving this place 1 star due to the unfriendly cashier, the allowance of shorts in the onsen, and the lack of attention to small but important details. It’s still a decent enough place, but these factors made the experience very much less enjoyable.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear, Ferdiantono Lim

We hope this message finds you well. We apologize for the behavior you experienced during your recent interaction with our team. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of service, and I deeply regret that we fell short in this instance.

Please know that this is not reflective of the values we strive to uphold. We are addressing this matter internally to ensure it does not happen again. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we are committed to making the necessary improvements.

reviews.name: pream warisara
reviews.text:
A quiet and relaxing onsen with a pleasant fragrance. The food at the restaurant was good. Yukyik provided great service.
Overall, it was a nice experience.

reviews.name: Thomas Wollbrauck
reviews.text:
Visited for the first time today and can really recommend this onsen.

Right at reception I was greeted super nicely by Pattakorn – he took his time, explained everything, and was just really friendly.
People like him make the difference.

The onsen itself is beautifully laid out.
There are loads of different pools, so you can easily switch between temperatures and spend a couple of hours here without getting bored.

The sauna is nicely spacious too, and there's free salt available for the steam room – I thought that was a nice touch, haven't seen that everywhere.

The relaxation area is really great.
The lounge chairs are super comfortable, I almost fell asleep on one of them.

At the restaurant I had a fresh coconut afterwards – exactly the right thing after the baths. The garden is also nicely done.

The rooftop bar was unfortunately closed during my visit, which was a bit of a shame, but these things happen.

You can also tell in a few spots that some small repairs wouldn't hurt - nothing dramatic, but noticeable.

Compared to the other Yunomori branch in the Sukhumvit area, this one feels more modern and fresh overall.

Would definitely come back.

Thanks again to Pattakorn for the warm welcome!

reviews.name: Daniil Tretiakov
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, my experience at this onsen was disappointing.

First of all, they do not provide dry towels. After using the baths, this creates obvious discomfort. For a place where guests constantly move between hot water and relaxation areas, this basic service should be standard.

Secondly, their tea policy makes no sense. If you order a teapot, they refuse to bring more than one cup. I may want to share the teapot with someone instead of drinking it alone — that seems completely reasonable. This rule feels unnecessary and not guest-oriented.

In addition, the space organization is confusing. You constantly have to move between different floors and even separate buildings to access various areas. It interrupts the relaxing atmosphere and makes the whole experience less enjoyable.

Overall, I expected a much better level of service and attention to guest comfort. Unfortunately, it did not meet expectations.

reviews.text:
I visited this massage studio twice and I really loved it😍 Every time I come to Thailand, I will choose this place again!
The studio is very clean and relaxing. They have a shower, nice aromatic smells, and you can choose different oils if you want an oil massage. The atmosphere is very comfortable

The therapists are very friendly and professional. They work very well on the muscles and the massage feels very effective. My therapist’s name was Nut, and she was amazing! She worked very carefully and professionally. She is a very good master.

My friends also had massages with other therapists here and they were very happy too👍

I highly recommend this place if you are in Thailand. 🇹🇭 When I come back to Thailand, I will definitely visit this massage studio again!

The place was clean, peaceful, and the staff were friendly and welcoming from start to finish. Great value for money and excellent service throughout.

Max did an amazing job. It’s been a long time since I’ve had a massage this good. His technique was professional, precise and deeply relaxing at the same time. He knew exactly where to apply pressure and how to release all the tension I didn’t even realize I was carrying.

I left feeling lighter, calmer and completely relaxed. It was pure bliss. Thank you, Max, for such a beautiful experience! I will definitely be coming back. 💆🏻‍♀️✨

If a massage ia waht you need, you need to come here!.. you will thank me! Guaranteed!

reviews.text: I have been to Bangkok over 30 times and for the first time I tried out this place since it’s next door to where I stay. Little did I know how good it was! title: Sasiya Thai Massage Sukhumvit 22

reviews.name: Melvin Huang
reviews.text:
I visited this massage shop 3 times in 6 days during my recent trip to Bangkok, and that alone probably says everything.

Conveniently located near Emsphere, it's become my go-to place whenever I need to unwind and recover. The premises are clean, well-maintained, and the prices are very reasonable for the quality of service provided.

What stood out most was the professionalism of the therapists. As someone who runs regularly, I mentioned that I had recently completed a long-distance run and asked them to be careful around my knees. They listened, understood my concerns, and adjusted the pressure accordingly. The treatment was effective, comfortable, and exactly what I needed for recovery.

A special mention to Manager Sky, who was incredibly friendly and helpful throughout my visits. She made thoughtful recommendations based on my needs, without any hard selling, which I really appreciated.

Great service, great people, and a relaxing environment. This will definitely be the first place I visit whenever I'm back in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We’re delighted to hear that our location, cleanliness, service quality, and relaxing atmosphere made such a positive impression. It’s especially rewarding to know that our therapists were able to accommodate your recovery needs after your long-distance run and provide a comfortable, effective treatment.

We truly appreciate your trust and support. We look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit to Bangkok and helping you relax and recover once again. Safe travels and see you soon!

reviews.name: Aizhan Khabyl
reviews.text: I’ve been in this massage place many many times, always good service and massage is the one of the best I’ve ever experienced. All staff is amazing, they know what to do and how to do ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your continued support and for visiting us so many times! We’re truly happy to hear that you consistently enjoy our service and massages. Your kind words about our team mean a lot to us — we’ll be sure to share them with all our staff. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon ❤️

reviews.name: Zhansaya Issatayeva
reviews.text:
I used to really like the massage here. It was always clean and well maintained. Even though the prices are higher than in other places, I came often and recommended this place to my friends.
However, today the massage was not very good. The therapist skipped some parts of my body, and when I asked her to work on the areas she missed, she started asking me to give her good tips. She asked for tips many times and kept watching me while I was drinking tea until I finally left the tips.

The massage was not good enough to deserve tips. I always leave tips when I genuinely like the service, and no one has ever asked me for them anywhere before. I believe tips should be the client’s choice.
I felt very uncomfortable because I was pressured to leave tips, and even a specific amount was mentioned. This was very inappropriate and unpleasant.

Yes, I did leave the tips she asked for, but I will not return here again and I will not recommend this place to anyone.
I give 1 stars because it's clean. The massage was so-so

reviews.name: Annalysse Clements
reviews.text:
I had a foot, neck and shoulder massage and it was so heavenly and great price! The pressure was superb and consistent. The tea was so yummy, would love to know the flavour.
I don’t know my therapists name but she was awesome and I will definitely try to be back or even on my next trip!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 😊 We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed your foot, neck, and shoulder massage, as well as our tea.

Your therapist was Jessy, and we’ll be sure to pass your lovely compliments on to her. She’ll be very happy to hear them! 💆‍♀️✨

We truly appreciate your kind words and look forward to welcoming you back again, whether during this trip or on your next visit to Bangkok. Safe travels and see you again soon! 🙏

reviews.name: สุพิณดา อนุสุวรรณ์
reviews.text: The shop is clean, the service is excellent, and the masseuse is very good and relaxing.The recommended dish, "hot oil," is very comforting.

reviews.name: Joey Bousaid
reviews.text: Very good service, and good massage with good prices. The staff is always friendly.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind feedback! We’re happy to hear you enjoyed the service, massage, and our friendly team. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you again soon!

reviews.name: Jay
reviews.text: Wonderful massage any day of the week. Great service and ambiance . Price was good too. 5/5
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your amazing review! We’re delighted you enjoyed the massage, service, ambiance, and value. Your 5/5 rating means a lot to us. We look forward to welcoming you again anytime!

reviews.name: Elaine Chong
reviews.text: Beautiful, clean and quiet place with calming music for you to relax and enjoy your massage. It’s just opposite the holiday inn hotel. reviews.name: AnA LM
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience here! The shop has such a warm, inviting atmosphere and is kept perfectly clean. The staff are lovely and provide top-tier service with a smile. You get high-end results for a very fair price—definitely give them a try.

reviews.name: Eszter Jakopánecz

Thank you also for your kind words about our staff and atmosphere.  
We look forward to welcoming you again on your next visit!

reviews.name: Slythee Tove
reviews.text: Incredibly relaxing and pleasurable massage. Perfect after a long day and it will ensure a great nights sleep. This salon is recommended. Clean and well maintained.

reviews.name: Josephine Teng

reviews.name: The Sheerkhan

Foot massage for 300 thb 1h!

Massage well done with some neck and shoulder massage to finish. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your wonderful review!

reviews.name: Joan Wong

reviews.name: Chantel Gabriel
reviews.text:
I recently had the most amazing experience at Home Sleep Spa in Bangkok with my husband, and I cannot rave enough about it! From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warm smiles and a tranquil ambiance that instantly put us at ease. We opted for the head massage and facial package for 999 baht, and it was absolutely worth every penny.

The two lovely ladies who took care of us were incredibly professional and attentive, making sure we were comfortable and relaxed throughout the entire treatment. The head massage was so soothing—it really helped relieve all the tension and stress that had built up. The facial was just as amazing, leaving our skin feeling refreshed, rejuvenated, and glowing.

Not only was the service top-notch, but the atmosphere was also peaceful and serene. It truly felt like a little oasis in the heart of Bangkok just walk and say no thank you to the other parlours in the alley and you will walk into an oasis. We left feeling pampered, relaxed, and completely rejuvenated.

If you’re looking for a luxurious and affordable spa experience, I highly recommend Home Sleep Spa. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.name: Neha Mendon
reviews.text:
If you are looking for a high-quality massage that balances the affordability of a street-side shop with the professional atmosphere of a high-end spa, One More Thai Massage at Phloen Chit (Chit Lom branch) is a fantastic choice.  While the exterior looks modest, the interior is surprisingly modern, clean, and infused with a calming herbal aroma that immediately distances you from the Bangkok traffic outside. The Experience
​The Massage: Whether you go for the Traditional Thai Massage or the Aromatic Oil Massage, the therapists are notably professional and consistent. They tend to follow a systematic approach (starting with a soothing foot wash) and are attentive to pressure preferences.
​Signature Touches: One of the highlights is the post-massage treat. You aren't just rushed out; they serve a warm herbal tea accompanied by a mango gummy/candy or small Thai dessert, which is a lovely touch for a mid-range shop.
​Value for Money: With Traditional Thai massages starting around ฿700–800 for two hours, it’s excellent value. It feels much more "premium" than the ฿300 shops without the ฿2,000+ price tag of hotel spas.
I went for the Traditional Thai Massage with Hot Herbal Compress which was fairly good with stretches #ThaiMassage #One #More #Thai #Massage #Phloen #Chit #Sukhumvit

reviews.name: Nasser Al-Naama
reviews.text:
I went to One More Thai Massage (Chit lom) for a quick 30-minute back, neck, and shoulder massage and, to be fair, the massage itself was genuinely very good. The therapist knew what she was doing, the pressure was right, and I left feeling noticeably better physically. The place itself is also clean, well-located near BTS Chit Lom, and clearly popular for a reason.  ￼

What unfortunately keeps happening to me in Thailand, though, is this strange pattern where basic follow-through seems to disappear at the finish line. I had left my power bank at the desk to charge during the massage, and after paying and leaving, nobody remembered to hand it back to me. I only realized once I’d already returned to my hotel and had to rush all the way back before they closed.

The woman at reception was actually lovely and spoke very good English, which honestly stands out because communication barriers can become exhausting here over time. She also mentioned she’d follow up with me regarding a promotional collaboration idea I brought up, but, similarly, nothing ever came of it.

And that’s ultimately my issue. Individually, people are often kind, polite, and well-meaning. But there’s this recurring lack of attentiveness and follow-through that becomes surprisingly draining when you encounter it over and over again across different services and businesses.

So this isn’t really a bad review of the massage itself, because the treatment was good. It’s more frustration with the pattern surrounding the experience. If you go, double-check you’ve collected all your belongings before walking out.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your positive review of One More Thai massage😍 We are glad that you enjoyed our service and look forward to providing you with another relaxing massage experience. Thank you ❤️

reviews.name: U E
reviews.text:
The reception was friendly, and my therapist was also very kind. She even spoke a little English, which is quite rare in Bangkok massage shops. I’ve been to around 8–9 different massage studios in the city, so I’m comparing based on that experience.

The price here is above average. Not extremely high, but definitely not among the cheaper options. For that price point, I would normally expect a higher level of professionalism.

Unfortunately, while my therapist was very nice, she was not properly trained. She pressed hard on areas where she really shouldn’t, such as veins and elbows, which caused pain without any real therapeutic effect. At this level, I would also have expected the standard questionnaire before the massage (to indicate preferred pressure, focus areas, etc.), but that was not provided.

Given these points, I honestly cannot understand the thousands of overly positive reviews this place has. You can find the same or even better quality at a noticeably cheaper price, and if you pay just a little more elsewhere, you’ll receive a much higher-quality massage experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Guest,

Thanks a lot for taking the time to share your thoughts with us.

We’re really happy to hear that you felt welcomed, and that your therapist was kind and tried her best to communicate in English — we know that can make a difference.

At the same time, we’re truly sorry that the massage didn’t meet your expectations. We appreciate your honest comments about the technique and pressure, and we understand how important it is to feel safe and comfortable during a session. Your feedback will definitely help us improve our training and service.

You also made a great point about the pre-massage questions — that should have been done, and we’ll make sure our team follows through on this in the future.

Thanks again for your helpful review. We hope we’ll get the chance to make it up to you next time.

Regards,
One More Thai
