DreamHouse concept is focusing on relaxing, healing body and mind from a busy day with our finest treatment therapies. We are the cosy spa located in the heart of Bangkok where people can reach us easily. Aiming to deliver the best spa experiences, we hope you feel relaxing since the first step you enter DreamHouse.

​DreamHouse เป็นสปาสำหรับการนวดคลายความเครียด และทำให้ผ่อนคลายอย่างสบาย ร้านตั้งอยู่ในทำเลใจกลางเมืองเพื่อความสะดวกในการเดินทาง ลูกค้าทุกท่านจะได้สัมผัสความสุข ความสบาย และความประทับใจ ตั้งแต่ก้าวแรกที่เดินเข้ามาถึง
address: 28 Sukhumvit 20, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Aizi Francisco
reviews.text:
2nd time to try massage in Thailand. This time, went to a pricier massage place. Very aesthetic, peaceful and clean versus the one I tried from the previous night. But the price is 3x - 4x.

As we arrived here almost 11PM, my sister and I tried 1hr Thai massage only. I haven't tried Thai massage before so having no oil was new to me. I feel very stretched. But the whole experience was good.

reviews.name: Crumpled Nomad
reviews.text:
We tried walking into DreamHouse Thai Massage a few times but they were fully booked each time, which shows just how popular this place is. Definitely recommend making a reservation in advance if you’re planning to visit.

The massage center is well-decorated with a cozy atmosphere, and the massage rooms are clean and comfortable, creating a relaxing environment from the moment you step inside.

A thoughtful touch we really appreciated — they served milk before the massage and fruits afterward, adding an extra layer of hospitality to the experience. The masseurs were skilled and provided a solid, rejuvenating massage that truly helped us unwind after days of walking.

Overall, a very pleasant and professional Thai massage experience in Sukhumvit. We would happily return!

reviews.name: R.S.S.Y
reviews.text:
It started when I came with my sister for the first time we really enjoyed it. The place was clean, the price was reasonable, and the masseuses were very professional. We had a great experience.

We came back a second time. I got the same masseuse again, but my sister got a different one who was very unpleasant and seemed angry from the start. When we asked to be in the same room for the massage, she didn’t like it and said it wasn’t possible. After we insisted, she agreed but was clearly upset.

She gave my sister an extremely hard massage for an entire hour without any gentleness and my sister is still in pain! I don’t know what was wrong with that masseuse, but she was just mean! We left very disappointed because of that experience.

reviews.name: Jonathan Guilmette
reviews.text:
Amazing traditional Thai massage place.
Can’t recommend highly enough. Real experts working there.
OUI was super kind and skillful. She fixed my shoulder that was damaged for at least 1 year. Couldn’t raise my arm over my head without pain before going there, after the first time the pain reduced by 90%. I am honestly impressed and happily shocked. 👏🏻🙏🏻

reviews.name: Lucile Charriaut
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at this massage place. Upon arriving, I mentioned to the receptionist that I had neck tension, and my masseuse, Fah, did an outstanding job addressing it—I feel so much better now. The place itself is beautifully designed, with a calm and inviting atmosphere that immediately puts you at ease. I also really appreciated the thoughtful touch of being offered a glass of warm milk before the massage—it was such a comforting start to the experience. Everything was very clean and well-maintained, adding to the overall relaxing vibe. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Jane V
reviews.text:
Nana is very good …. Very experienced

But it stops there…. The rest of the experience was bad…

BUT the (young) masseur who did me was very very very very very bad… It is not bad but it is very bad I spent like two hours of money And worst of all she have to switch with Nana who was massaging other person… She clearly knows she has a problem to that’s why she don’t even dare to come out to see me after the massage…

I have not seen anyone pull my hand four times… Barely any massage on the back and all just simply pressing on the hand in the league very softly and lightly and she doesn’t even press on the pressured points… Nana had to do the twisting for her

After complaining to them they say they will give me free 30 minutes the next time I come on a weekday and the reason why they have so many good reviews on Google is also because they give free extra 30 minutes on weekday.

Decided to bust them out because they did nothing when I file complaint on the lady who wasted two hours of my money which is THB950…. Sorry no refunds nor they would compensate you for their u trained masseurs…

Thanks for the bad experience, massage like nerve massage… will go back to the more reliable Healthland my regular massage place

reviews.name: Jayden P
reviews.text: I had dang as my massage therapist and she was very nice. Also being able to speak the language made the session enjoyable and relaxing. Facility is modern and new. Will be back again to work out the pain in my lower back and arms. Thanks again!

reviews.name: Supattana L
reviews.text:
Great service and clear pricing upfront!
Today was my first time getting a body scrub here. They offer two types: a coconut oil scrub and a salt scrub with an orange scent from HARNN. I chose the one from HARNN.

The therapist, Noi (Nana), started with a 40-minute scrub, then let me shower before applying lotion and giving a gentle massage. The scrub was very thorough — my skin felt super clean, soft, and smooth afterward. The lotion made my skin feel even more hydrated and refreshed.

reviews.name: SALIM ALHMOUDI
reviews.text: Excellent service, relaxing atmosphere, and skilled therapists. Best massage experience!

reviews.name: irene kwok
reviews.text:
Terrible Thai massage experience, strongly avoid this shop in Bangkok!

My family of three booked a 60-min traditional Thai massage here, and the service was extremely unprofessional.
The therapist only spent 5 minutes on my back and feet when I was lying face down, then rushed me to flip over onto my back immediately. There was no proper acupressure or stretching as standard Thai massage should have. She just rubbed lightly on the surface of my skin without targeting any pressure points.
The pressure was inconsistent and erratic—sometimes overly hard and painful, sometimes far too soft to work on muscles. I left with tight muscles and zero relaxation after the full hour. Complete waste of money and time. Do not visit if you want an authentic Thai massage in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Christian Sopp
reviews.text:
After a long travel my body was in real need of some love. I found it a short walk from my hotel and walked in to be greeted by 2 professional women. After agreeing to 1 hour Thai-massage and stating that I had no medical issues I was given a glass of water and some warm milk. Then I proceeded to get my feet washed before I got a seriously great Thai-massage. Not to hard and not to soft. I think i fell asleep a couple of times. Then as i got my shoes, I was served a glass of tea and some pineapple pieces.
All in all a great massage that did wonders for my aching muscles.
I’ll be back next time I’m in Bangkok.

reviews.name: nsybot N
reviews.text:
In contrast to the positive reviews, I had quite a disappointing experience. The place is honestly nice, clean and facilities are good but the massage was a complete let down. I booked in a 1hr foot & 1hr head, shoulder massage. It was all okay at first but then the masseuse started to fall asleep. I had asked her if she wanted to change as she seemed very tired and sleepy however she continued on and began to massage with a lot of force and no technique which was really painful! This went on with her falling asleep multiple times with her elbow pressing on me! This is not my first bad massage experience but this is definitely the first time I did not complete the session and left earlier than intended.

I did share this feedback with the reception staff and they offered to refund 30mins of the massage however I would like to put this review here as a fair warning to others.

reviews.name: Nitchawee C.
reviews.text:
Excellent Thai Massage!

Had an amazing massage with P’Am—my body felt so light and relaxed afterward! The place is clean and beautifully decorated. Great service and high standards. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Eunice Chee
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing massage experience. The therapist didn’t seem to have the proper skills—she wasn’t pressing the right pressure points, and it felt more like she was just rubbing oil on my skin than giving an actual massage.

I gave feedback several times during the session, but there was no improvement. It seemed like she didn’t know where the correct pressure points were.

Overall, I left feeling more stres, disappointed and unsatisfied.

reviews.name: Jim S (Jim’s Adventures)
reviews.text: I’m a repeat customer about 7 times in the past two years. First found this place while staying at Novotel, then when I was staying at at Rembrandt and now Aspiria suites. The staff here are very professional and knowledgeable. The rooms are very clean, I’ve been given scrubs or a bottom cover to wear when getting an oil massage. Prices are very reasonable $35US for a 90 minute Thai massage. Needless to say this review is overdue, thanks for massaging away the aches and pains 🙏

reviews.name: Kenrick Li
reviews.text: Was recommended here from a friend who travels to Bangkok frequently. Just off the busy Sukhumvit area in a really accessible location. The facilities were clean modern designed. Reasonably priced and professional friendly staff. The massage was very relaxing and I fell asleep halfway in. Large shower facilities and non-rushed environment. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Meilyana Xu
reviews.text: Abit on higher end for massage place but the whole place speak for itself

reviews.name: stella taksoko
reviews.text:
tried the thai massage. service was great, the massage itself was a bit too strong for me at first but the masseuse understood english very well therefore adjusted the pressure to my liking.

warm milk was served before the session started, and a bowl of canned pineapples + a cup of cold tea after it ended.

would definitely be back, overall a very good experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you ka! Hope to serve you in the near future :)

reviews.name: 翁嘉鴻
reviews.text:
I choose course for Thai massage 90 minutes, the price is 780 baht. The masseur's skill is really nice. Though I am a little bit tight and stress with my body. I really feel relax after the course. It surly ease my fatigue after long-time walking. I may come again next time.
You can ask for harder or softer to the masseur by your preference. Don't be shy to express your feeling.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you ka! Hope to serve you in the near future :)

reviews.name: Pancerny Misiek
reviews.text:
Really nice place if you are seeking a professional massage services!
Staff is very friendly and experienced.

title: Crown Massage
ownerDescription:
We offer a variety of massage services to help you relax and rejuvenate, including traditional Thai massage, foot massage, oil massage, and hot stone therapy. Our skilled and professional therapists customize each treatment to meet your needs, whether you're relieving stress or easing muscle tension.
We focus on providing high-quality services at affordable prices, using premium oils and hot stones for enhanced relaxation and circulation. Visit us at Nimman Lane 17 for a peaceful, rejuvenating experience. Book your appointment today and enjoy the perfect balance of quality and value!
address: 28/6 Nimmanahaeminda Road, Tambon Su Thep, เมือง Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXV9+VP Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: MUKSAEN
reviews.text:
Amazing experience!
The place is super clean and has a very relaxing atmosphere. The staff was professional and the foot massage was incredible—they hit all the right spots. My feet feel so much lighter now. Highly recommended!

Plus, it’s conveniently located right near After You Dessert Cafe!

reviews.name: Kathy Th
reviews.text:
Must try!! Best Massage in Town.

Staff are friendly and welcoming. The price reasonable, clearly displayed with no hidden charges. I came here with aches and soreness from traveling, and the massage therapist did an excellent job!!

reviews.name: D A
reviews.text:
5/5 Stars – Perfect way to unwind after exploring Chiang Mai!
After a long day of walking around temples and the night market, my feet were screaming for relief. I popped into Crown Massage in Nimman Soi 17 and it was exactly what I needed! The foot massage was fantastic—strong but not painful, really hit all the right pressure points, and left my legs feeling light and relaxed again.
The therapists are skilled and professional, the place has a nice, calm vintage vibe with good music and aromas that help you fully chill out. Best part? The price is super reasonable—great value for such a quality session in a popular area like Nimman.
Highly recommend if you’re looking for an authentic, no-frills Thai foot massage that actually delivers. I’ll definitely be back next time I’m in Chiang Mai! 👣✨

reviews.name: Minkiikii
reviews.text: Without a doubt, this was one of the best spa experiences I’ve ever had. A true sanctuary of relaxation in the heart of Chiang Mai! I will definitely be back.

reviews.name: Dmitrii
reviews.text: It's a good place, it's clean, and it's served with iced tea at the beginning and hot at the end. Thai massage is very good

reviews.name: 아지아지
reviews.text: 2hours of massage was a good exprience for me. Weewee was the best massagist ever. First i thought 2hours of massage is too long but after it ended i wanted more. It’s sad that I am leaving chiangmai today. Servers were all very kind. I will definitely come back to this shop.

reviews.name: Tamara GS
reviews.text:
We had an incredible experience here! From the moment we arrived, everyone was so welcoming and kind. They offered us refreshing drinks before the massage, which was such a nice touch, and after the session we were treated to more drinks and delicious cookies — such lovely hospitality!

The ladies were super professional and attentive. One hour was more than enough to make our bodies feel completely relaxed and renewed. I had some pain in my legs, and without me even mentioning it, my therapist found all the tension spots — it was honestly amazing!

We left feeling so relieved and refreshed. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for a truly relaxing and professional massage experience! 💆‍♀️💆‍♂️✨

Big thanks to the team!

reviews.name: nuttida j.
reviews.text: Very clean place, friendly staff, and the massage was incredibly relaxing. Will definitely come back.

reviews.name: sophia moulson
reviews.text: I had an amazing massage from kwen will definitely be back she took her time and was attentive I enjoyed very much ka

reviews.name: Cass Tam
reviews.text: We came from Hong Kong.  We’d experienced 2 hour’s enjoyable massage time ever.  The shop was very clean and the servers were all very kind and kept smile all the time.  I drove a car to go there and it was convenience to park in the street nearby the shop.  WeI will come back to this shop when I visit Chiang Mai again.

reviews.name: songsit Srisua
reviews.text:
The Vintage massage is another place I highly recommend everyone to try. The staff here are incredibly friendly and approachable, making you feel relaxed and comfortable from the moment you step in. The atmosphere inside is clean and tidy, with a light, refreshing scent that keeps you feeling rejuvenated throughout your visit.

The massage here is excellent. The staff are skilled and have a deep understanding of the customer's body, able to adjust the pressure according to your needs. You can really feel that each technique is aimed at relieving muscle tension and fatigue. After the massage, you feel lighter and much more relaxed.

Overall, this place is perfect for anyone looking for a good massage spot, whether after work or during a day off. If you get the chance, I highly recommend experiencing this wonderful service for yourself. Truly a must-try! 👍😊

reviews.name: Pisit Kaokanoksin
reviews.text: I’ve had a 90-minute aroma massage here at night. That was sooooo good. Absolutely perfect relaxation when you were in Chiang Mai. Just a few minutes walk from Nimman. It was such a great day. I recommended. 😌

reviews.name: Michael Swe
reviews.text: Great service all the way with warm service! Must try if you’re around this area after a tired sightseeing day.

reviews.name: Natalie Cronin
reviews.text:
This was the best massage in Chiang Mai by far. The place is clean (western standards) they are able to customize for you, and everyone is so friendly.
If only I found this place sooner, I would have been back everyday!!!

reviews.name: Alisha
reviews.text: Crown massage nimman has sleek and clean interior. All the staff are professional. Reception staff, very patient and clear with their communication in English.  All the best

reviews.name: J C
reviews.text:
This is a good review.

I think they hired staff who were previously brazilian jiu jitsu champions… every move felt like she was trying to get me to submit. She could probably juice an apple with one hand. Crazy amount of force used and the service was friendly and welcoming, and you really cant ask for more at this price. Very reputable.

reviews.name: Roland van der Lee
reviews.text:
From the moment I walked into this cozy massage parlor in Chiang Mai, I felt completely at ease. The host was incredibly warm and welcoming, making me feel right at home before the massage even began. The atmosphere was peaceful and serene, soft music, calming scents, and a beautifully decorated space that instantly helped me unwind.

The massage itself was one of the best I’ve ever had, professional, attentive, and deeply relaxing. It’s clear they genuinely care about their guests' comfort and well-being. I left feeling refreshed, recharged, and already planning my next visit. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a truly soothing experience in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Helen Bi
reviews.text:
Thai massage is the best at Crown.
Praew is the best, wonderful service, unforgettable👍👍

reviews.name: Pasoot Luengcharoenwatana
reviews.text: Just had a massage here in Chiang Mai and honestly, such a good experience. The place has a calm, relaxing vibe the moment you walk in. Staff were super friendly and welcoming, and the massage itself was great. Definitely worth a visit if you’re looking to unwind.

reviews.name: Lam Nguyen Van
reviews.text: Good place, good staff. Best massage in Chiangmai

title: Silom Sauna
subTitle: สีลม เซาว์น่า
address: 401, 17 Sukhumvit Alley 22, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Raz
reviews.text:
Silom Sauna provides exceptional value for a relaxing male-only retreat. For a 250THB entry, visitors get towels, shorts, flip-flops, and access to hot/cold pools, steam rooms, a gym, and free-flowing fresh fruit and iced tea. It is a highly-rated hideaway from Bangkok's busy streets.

Be aware this is a male-only facility. While shorts are given, many guests sometimes walk around the communal areas unclothed, which is entirely normal here.

Cleanliness: for a local sauna and the price, the cleanliness is acceptable. Yes it's grimey, some guys don't know sauna / shower etiquette, towels are ok but don't look clean (bring your own if you're fussy), I saw one guy spitting on the floor. Oh well, it's all part of the experience. Wear the flip flops ! Save yourself from some foot infections.

When you reach the counter, you'll be given a locker key, towels, and shorts. You can spend as many hours as you like relaxing. The facility features a hot bath, a fantastic cold plunge pool, a lap pool, and a dry sauna and herbal steam room.

Bring personal toiletries for the showers, though basic ones are provided. All you have to do when you're settled in is to go about your own business and relax.

Included in your entry fee are unlimited refills of fresh iced tea, water, and freshly cut seasonal fruit plates.

If you get hungry between steam sessions, the sauna features a small, on-site counter serving well-prepared Thai dishes. Meals are both cheap, well portioned and delicious, making it a perfect spot to spend half a day eating, sweating, and relaxing without breaking the bank. The pork "pad see ew" in the picture costs 100 Baht because I added an extra egg. It's a must order!

Special mention: I appreciate the kindness of the lady at the counter, the staff in the locker rooms and the nice aunty managing the food counter.

It's absolute gold for a Bangkok experience. So go visit Silom Sauna.

reviews.name: BONgüey Brazilian Bar
reviews.text:
Silom Sauna

A really great sauna experience. The facility is spacious, clean, and well-maintained, with a nice pool area that makes it easy to relax and unwind. The staff are friendly and attentive, which makes the overall experience even better. The location is also very convenient and easy to access.

At only 250 baht, it offers excellent value for the quality provided. I was very satisfied and would definitely come back again. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Santa Claus
reviews.text:
Amazing relaxation place. It has dry sauna, steam sauna, cold bath, hot tub and swimming pool. The building is a bit old but maintained clean. Small gym equipped inside and you can use all these facilities for 250THB only in the center of Sukhumvit!
Shorts, bath towel and locker is provided, too.
Really appreciated the owner has kept this place running.

<How to access>
You can either take taxi at BTS Phromphong station or even walk from the station for 20mins. By foot, you should go through Emsphese to avoid heat and sweat. Use exit next to Gourmet Market. From there, just go along Soi22 for 10mins. It's actually close.

reviews.name: chetah
reviews.text:
I mean its not a gay sauna where people go cruising. Just a straight man sauna.
Overall is not that bad for the price with free towel and complimentary food

reviews.name: Stanley Yang
reviews.text: This place is like a scene from out of a 80’s Thai crime movie. It’s such a retro breath of fresh air than those post/luxurious places. Locker is grimey but the worker there is friendly. You get free fruit from the auntie once you sit down. Didn’t try the food and I probably never will. The sauna is great and hot. Guaranteed there is a Thai local manning the temperature with water so it gets super hot. The goal is to smoke you out of the place lol. Hot into the cold bath right after. Been here 2-3 times and will continue to go every time I’m in Bangkok. I fit right in with the locals 😀 .

reviews.name: Angelo Juan O. Ramos
reviews.text:
The OG 80s era Thai-style onsen! This is the branch in Sukhumvit, only 15-20 minute walk from Phrom Phong BTS station, if you do a short cut through Benjasiri Park and the Marriott Hotel.

Free unlimited fruit and cold tea, with a lap pool, hotel and cold pools! The auntie watching over the place is quick and efficient. The wet and dry saunas are quite hot. All in all, a perfect place to relax.

reviews.name: Justin James
reviews.text:
Sauna, hot tub, cold bath, and swimming pool. I think the facilities could definitely use a little attention, but it got the job done and was very near to my hotel on Soi 22.

Price 250thb

Men only.

reviews.name: Basile d'Hauthuille
reviews.text:
Super sauna, very traditional !
You’ll only find moto bikers or Muay Thai or rugby players who are here to rest ;)
Tea is unlimited, you have a free basket of fruit, and you can diner !
It cost 250THB without diner ;)

reviews.name: Jerome Azemar
reviews.text: Fantastic spot. The place is out of time, with old (but clean and working) equipment, helpful staff and chill atmosphere it's a perfect place to relax and spend stressless hours. Sauna and hot water are very hot, just what you expect from an old school spa! Strongly recommended!

reviews.name: A C
reviews.text: Simple place yet does the job well, sauna and steam rooms are at good temperature. Cold and hot water are decent although could be cleaned more regularly. Food is good and has a lot of choices. Toilets need to be improved as it’s very dated. On the whole simple and chill place for 250 baht with free tea, fruits and towels is a good deal!

reviews.name: Thai Hoang
reviews.text: I had a lovely wholesome experience at this local sauna. Greeted by the lovely staff and made my way towards the changing area where they had lockers. You get given free fruit and unlimited tea on arrival once you enter the main seating area of the sauna. The dry sauna itself is excellent and is perfectly hot, they also have the cold plunge and an area for swimming. It’s equipped with toilets and showers also - well worth a trip especially at a bargain price of 270 baht!

reviews.name: Dylan Janis
reviews.text: This place needs to be protected at all costs. Ultimate OG Bangkok era sauna. Seemingly men only unfortunately but you get treated like a king. They serve you complimentary fruit platter and tea, and you can order food they’ll fetch from nearby stall. Sauna hits and you can pour löyly, but very hot even without. Cold water pool and cold high pressure shower, absolute brilliance. Then lounge chair for old school Thai soap operas on TV. This place is just that good

reviews.name: Y O
reviews.text: It's a great hidden local family sauna only for men. Pool, hot and cold water bath, shower, dry and steam sauna for 200 baht. Only notice is that never gave massage here if you want a normal massage. There are many good ones near here offer cheaper but better massage.

reviews.name: Gerard Simpson
reviews.text: Men only. Good value. Hot tub too hot. cold tub could be colder

reviews.name: Justin G
reviews.text:
A hidden gem of Bangkok. Only $250 baht and you get a swimsuit, towel, free UNLIMITED tea, fruit and access to a very good sauna, steam room, cold plunge and swimming pool. There is also a small old gym.

They even have good simple food for about 60-90 baht per meal.

reviews.name: Lush
reviews.text:
The establishment is old but I come here often. Probably more so due to lack of options in Bangkok rather than enjoy coming here.

The sauna is hot and can get very hot.

The cold pool isn’t very cold. Plus, a lot of the old Thai people don’t shower before going in the cold pool, which I personally don’t like.

Definitely worth a try. I’ll continue to keep coming back.

reviews.name: Greg Gregg
reviews.text:
Great place at a good price.
Upon arrival a key to your own personal locker is issued along with a selection of shorts and towels, and a platter of fresh chilled fruit and ice tea.
The Sauna's and swimming pool are spot on.

reviews.name: CL
reviews.text: If you like the run down prison style you should try it. It’s definitely an experience. People are friendly, interesting characters to get to know inside. It didn’t feel clean to me and in the end I prefer pretty places. People don’t use towels in the sauna so the wood is very wet. The water in the cold pool isn’t really cold and it looks not clean. Free fruits but only the watermelon tastes good. Free tea with ice, which is decent. No outdoor area. Towels look not clean, even if washed. Extremely rundown from a western country perspective, but an interesting experience to make and test your flexibility with places like this.

reviews.name: Fone
reviews.text: Thai original sauna this is the best place to relax for 250 this is a steal

reviews.name: Jay Thailand
reviews.text: Cheap and best sauna in Bangkok ,250 baht ,and you will get fruits complimentary and drink tea unlimited,towel unlimited , good Temperature , staff very friendly and staff take care customer very nicely , have everything in dressings room .and food price is very reasonable and very good , Thai food cooking by old lady she have experience many years and she make food very tasty, massage also very good 300 baht private room .very friendly staff massage very good.

reviews.name: Chettapol Prom
reviews.text:
Five stars – truly impressed.
From the moment I walked in, the team demonstrated professionalism and genuine care. The assessment was thorough, explanations were clear and easy to understand, and the treatment was handled with great attention to detail. I felt confident and well taken care of throughout the entire process.
The clinic is clean, well-equipped, and has a calm, welcoming atmosphere.
Thank you to the Reboost Clinic team for the excellent service. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for high-quality physiotherapy care.

reviews.name: Peradas S
reviews.text:
I would not recommend this place for people who genuinely want to relieve muscle pain or are looking for a proper deep tissue massage. However, it may be suitable for those who simply want to relax.

The atmosphere, staff, air quality, and overall scent of the place were all very good. Unfortunately, the massage itself was disappointing. The therapist did not apply sufficient pressure on the muscles; it mostly felt like the touch was only on the skin rather than reaching the muscle layers. Even though I clearly requested a strong pressure level and also indicated “hard” on the intake form, the pressure never improved.

In addition, the massage technique felt unstable. The strokes often spread outward rather than staying focused on the muscle, which made the experience uncomfortable instead of relieving. For this price range, I have never received such a superficial “skin-level” massage at other shops.

Although the owner kindly offered an additional 30 minutes of massage to compensate, the overall experience had already left a negative impression. It was quite disappointing and felt like a waste of money.

reviews.name: F0oD1e
reviews.text:
My recommendation is to avoid this spa.

Came with my wife on our wedding anniversary as a treat. We often do massages and this was our 3rd massage in BKK this trip.

Very hopeful initially looking at the rating and # of reviewers and I must say the ambience is lovely but when we got down to the massage it was terrible.

The therapist basically just bathed us in oil and did single stroke rub the oil back and forth doing the same movement for 20-30times before changing to do the same on a different body part, it was clear that she had little training and very unprofessional. I gave several instructions during the massage for her to change but all to no avail.

After the massage I told the manager about how poor my massage was and asked her point blank whether my therapist (who looked like mid40s - early 50s) was a new staff. She admitted that the therapist only started for 1 year. After that she gave me no further explanation.

Very unprofessional overall and I think it’s a spa to avoid. No amount of ambience can save an establishment that does not place the quality of the massage and customer service as priority.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Please accept our sincerest apologies for this experience, especially as you chose this home to celebrate such a meaningful occasion as your wedding anniversary. We are truly heartened that you appreciated our ambiance, but we are deeply sorry that the technical execution of the massage and our subsequent communication fell short of the high standards we strive to uphold.

At Divana, the heart of service and technical mastery are our top priorities. Your feedback regarding the repetitive technique and the lack of adjustment following your instructions has been shared directly with our Lead Therapist and Management team for immediate review and retraining. We take your comments seriously, as every guest deserves a treatment that is both professional and personalized.

We would value the opportunity to make this right and regain your trust. If your travels bring you back to Bangkok, please reach out to us directly so we can personally oversee your next visit and ensure it reflects the true quality and "mindful healing" Divana is known for. 🌿🤍

We hope to have the chance to welcome you and your wife back for a much improved and truly celebratory experience.

Amazing experience! I came in without an appointment around 4 PM and asked if they could do fantasy-colored highlights for me. I have a LOT of hair, so the process took quite a while, but the whole team was so patient and kind throughout everything! 😭😭

reviews.name: Estela Garrido Sánchez
reviews.text:
My experience was very disappointing.

While my partner and I were having our massage, the two therapists started laughing several times during the session. It really seemed that one of them was laughing because she was interested in my partner, which I found extremely disrespectful, especially with me, his girlfriend, lying right next to him.

What confirmed that feeling was what happened when we were leaving. I turned around and saw the therapist who had been massaging my partner pointing at him while laughing with another colleague. That was the third time they had laughed, and it made me feel very uncomfortable.

On top of that, we were overcharged by 200 baht.

And if they thought the girlfriend wouldn’t notice or wouldn’t say anything, well, here is the girlfriend leaving this review.

Overall, the service was very unprofessional, and it was a very unpleasant experience, especially considering it was my first traditional Thai massage. I would not recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear mrs. Sánchez, I'm sorry you had this experience in our salon. We expect from our therapist a fully professional attitude in which situations like you describe doesn't fit. Once again we apologize for this experience.

reviews.name: Aaron
reviews.text:
We recently visited this spa as a couple, and overall it was a pleasant experience.

The aromatherapy oil massage room ambience exceeded my expectations. It is quiet, relaxing, with dim lighting and music set at just the right volume. Shower facilities are provided, which was a nice touch and added to the overall comfort.

My massage was excellent. The therapist was gentle, attentive, and clearly experienced, paying close attention to my needs throughout the session. However, my wife’s experience with the Thai massage was less enjoyable, as it felt a bit too harsh for her preference.

The receptionist was very patient and polite, attending to our requests professionally. We also appreciated the light refreshments provided after the treatment, especially the mango sticky rice.

Overall, a good spa experience with a relaxing environment and great service, though consistency between therapists could be improved.

reviews.name: StoryMiles
reviews.text:
I was really looking forward to trying Lila Massage Phae Gate after hearing so much about it, but unfortunately, my experience was very disappointing. I arrived at the location around 6 PM, hoping to get a massage. At the entrance, the staff told me they were fully booked until 10:30 PM and that I would need to return after that time. I accepted this at first, thinking it must be a busy evening.

However, while I was still nearby, I noticed something that made me uncomfortable. A few minutes later, some foreign tourists arrived without an appointment (as far as I could tell) and were allowed to sit down and receive service right away. This was surprising and frustrating because I had just been turned away moments earlier. It left me feeling like perhaps I was being ignored or treated differently because of my appearance or nationality — in my case, being Indian — which was very disheartening.

I understand that sometimes there are misunderstandings or priority bookings, but the way this was handled did not feel fair or transparent. It’s possible there was another explanation, but as a paying customer who was ready to use their services, it felt like unequal treatment.

For anyone planning to visit, I strongly recommend making an advance booking and confirming your slot before going, especially if you’re hoping for a walk-in appointment. I truly hope the management looks into this so that all customers, regardless of their background, are treated with the same respect and service.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for taking the time to share your experience with us 🙏
We are truly sorry to hear that your visit to our Phae Gate branch left you feeling disappointed and uncomfortable.
This is absolutely not the experience we want any of our guests to have.

We would like to sincerely clarify that we never prioritise guests based on nationality, appearance, or background.
What likely happened in this case is that the guests you saw being seated were part of:
• a confirmed booking,
• a booking made through a partner platform 
However, we fully understand that from your point of view, it may have looked like unfair treatment — and we deeply apologise for the discomfort it caused you.
Your feelings are valid, and we regret that we did not explain the situation more clearly at the time.

We truly appreciate your feedback, and we will reinforce our communication procedures with our reception team to ensure greater clarity and fairness for all walk-in customers.

If you would consider giving us another chance, we would be grateful for the opportunity to provide you with the warm, respectful, and professional service that every guest deserves.

Thank you again for highlighting this issue.
We hope we can welcome you in the future under better circumstances 🌿💆‍♀️

reviews.name: Claire P
reviews.text:
I'm sharing this feedback in hopes that management can improve their daily operations and training. I came here to relieve muscle soreness after working out, and ordered a body scrub and oil massage combo.

To be fair, the body scrub part was quite nice. However, the oil massage was disappointing. The therapist seemed exhausted, likely due to the high volume of customers. Instead of a proper muscle massage, she was mostly just rubbing and pulling my skin, which felt uncomfortable, and it was a bit painful when she applied force. It didn't help with my sore muscles at all.
The reception was polite and gave me two herbal balms when I gave feedback, but it didn't make up for the poor experience. I know everyone works hard, but as a chain brand, management should schedules more staff during peak times so the therapists aren't overworked and can maintain service quality.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed and thoughtful feedback with us.

We sincerely appreciate your recognition of the body scrub treatment and the professionalism of our reception team.

At the same time, we are truly sorry that the oil massage did not meet your expectations and that it did not provide the muscle relief you were looking for after your workout.

We understand your concerns regarding therapist fatigue and service consistency during busy periods. Maintaining high-quality treatments while ensuring the wellbeing of our therapists is extremely important to us, and your comments regarding staffing and operational planning have been noted carefully.

Constructive feedback such as yours helps us improve, and we genuinely appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with us.

We hope to have the opportunity to provide you with a better experience in the future.

reviews.text: Got an amazing 60min foot massage on a Tuesday afternoon. There was no wait time, staff was welcoming and friendly. Yun, my massage therapist did a fantastic job, my legs feel rejuvenated! The experience was calming even though the pressure applied was strong enough. Will definitely visit again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your valuable feedback and kind words 🙏 We are absolutely delighted to learn that you had an excellent experience with our service, and we sincerely look forward to the pleasure of welcoming you again in the near future 💆‍♀️💜

reviews.name: 詹茜茹
reviews.text: Nice experience! I’ve visited this place twice for different links’s of massage!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

reviews.name: Rebecca Lin
reviews.text: Very good Thai massage , they will take care of your skin, good job , 1800 泰, good

reviews.name: MaKoChi
reviews.text:
I have been to this massage studio several times and am impressed anew every time. The massages are very professional and are tailored individually to the customer's needs. You can tell that the therapists know what they are doing.

The entire team is consistently friendly and accommodating, which makes the experience particularly pleasant. The ambience is beautiful – very clean, peaceful, and with a relaxed atmosphere.

The price-performance ratio is very good; for the quality of the service, the price is more than fair.

Without a doubt: whenever I am in Chiang Mai, I come here! Simply perfect.

reviews.name: The Cat
reviews.text:
This was a very good massage place. The staff were friendly, the massage technique was excellent.
I received a traditional Thai massage, for which you change into adequate clothing in advance.
Not 5 stars because the room temperature was too cold with the AC but since the massage happened in a large common with about 8 people being massaged at the same time, it felt rude to ask them to change it for everyone.

reviews.name: M Maung
reviews.text: Very nice and clean. Professional environment. There are change rooms and lockers. Place setting was beautiful. I had massage here twice. 1st visit for 1 hr was average massage but second visit for 1.5 hr was amazing. I guess it all depends on the person who massage you. They gave you hot tea after a relaxing massage. Very reasonable price at 250 Baht per hour and 350 baht for 1.5 hr massage.

reviews.name: Sung Chang
reviews.text: Visited here 3x during my trip. Simply the best and reasonable rates. Foot massage is incredible, especially after a long day being a tourist. And the full body stretching Thai massage made me fall asleep even though it's painful. So needed. Their second floor feels like you're transported.

reviews.name: Kirstin Schwasnick
reviews.text: Excellent services and price. Staff was friendly, professional and polite. Asked if I was okay frequently throughout massage. I would return!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review 😊💜
We’re delighted that you enjoyed our service and found our team friendly, professional, and attentive throughout your treatment 🌿✨

Ensuring our guests are comfortable during their massage is very important to us, so we’re happy to hear that you appreciated the care and attention from our therapists.

Hearing that you would return is the greatest compliment we could receive. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon! 🙏🏻💜

reviews.name: Similan Milmoe
reviews.text: We always get the best massage here every time we are in Chiangmai, their masseuses  are always great at what they do, place is alway clean. Price is great. We will always coking back

reviews.name: Gunes Tabasya
reviews.text: Everything was perfect; I had a Thai massage, and it was really nice and relaxing. Everyone treated me very well, even though I was soaked from the rain. The place was very clean and nice. I'll be back before I leave Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Mark Aban
reviews.text: Exceptional service from start to finish, from catering us though they're already closing to the Back-neck-shoulder massage (though it felt a full body massage) to free drinking water pre-massage to free rice crackers and mini-herbal inhaler for takeaways for the ultimate experience! Thank you for your gentleness and for your diligent work. JESUS loves everyone of you!

reviews.name: HEE KIM
reviews.text: Good massage. Clean and peaceful. If completing short survey, can get free gift, massage ball small key chain. I got foot massage but the chair was little bit uncomfortable. But we can get foot massage lying on the bed if requested.

reviews.name: Valentina Rampin
reviews.text: Absolutely NEGATIVE experience because I specifically asked for an oil massage, but instead they gave me a traditional Thai massage and only at the end did they rub oil on my back and calves—not even on my thighs because I was wearing their pants and shirt. The massage table didn't have the usual hole for your face to breathe. My husband stopped the massage shortly after because it was painful, and they didn't even ask to make up for it with something else.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We sincerely apologize for this deeply disappointing experience. The treatment you described does not reflect the oil massage you requested, nor the level of comfort, communication, and care we aim to provide. We are especially sorry that your husband experienced pain and that neither of you felt properly supported by our team.

Your feedback is very important to us. Please contact us directly with the branch, visit date, and approximate time so we can investigate this matter thoroughly with the team and take appropriate action. Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

ReHappy Clinic is operated by rehabilitation doctor who's specialist in office syndrome therapy, Headache, Back Pain, Shoulder Pain, Elderly Knee pain, Sport Injury.

reviews.text: My chronic pain on my shoulder got a lot better in a few sessions. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Nan Duangnapa
reviews.text:
Boutique, Cozy yet mighty and super advanced pain management clinic in Bangkok! I’ve been undergoing chronic pain treatments clinics/hospitals/holistic-health across continents; Boston, Seattle, Singapore, yet no one could cure from the root causes like ReHappy!!

Chronic pain is a journey and my heart goes to all the brave souls who are living with physical pains. I’m with you when pain wakes you up at nights and you have important days waiting next.. series of treatments, dosages of pills yet still no lights at the end of the tunnel.. Pains is NOT an in-borne condition, there is a way to cure/handle/manage. I hope this could be your hopeful massage! It is indeed a long journey with disciplines, acceptance and faith. Trust that you can live well again and be Re-Happy again.. guess that is how Dr.Wan named her clinic and it lives up the name. I was lucky to find her and her crews; super professional, a one-stop shop for pains, and no-frills. 100% recommended
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for trusting us with your care. We are truly grateful to be part of your journey to better health. 🥰😍

reviews.name: Reginald Williams
reviews.text: I can only say that my massage was excellent, firm, showing clear evidence of professional training and delivered in a very pleasant way. The space I was in could almost be described as opulent, as can the entryway and waiting area where my wife and I were greeted by pleasant staff, offered refreshing drinks and led to our massage spaces. It should be noted that not all massage spaces are created equal within the premises, as can be seen from the photos. However, my wife was also with her space, one of the curtained off areas, even though it was not so luxurious.

reviews.name: Jim Lim
reviews.text: It is definitely one of the best massage I have ever tried. Nice, clean environment and quiet place. It is priced reasonably. And the main thing is the masseur has great massage skill.  After the massage, my stiff neck condition has improved. When I visited the center in weekday afternoon, it is not crowded. The massage center deserves more customers. Just that it is located in a small alley. Everyone who comes to Bangkok should visit this massage center. It is highly recommended.

reviews.name: J
reviews.text: Facilities are excellent and the massage therapist was very skilled. Best in Bangkok, and much better than those fancy places. Short walk from hotels in the area in Padiphat and Saphan Khwai BTS. If your in the area this is a must try. I'll definitely be coming back here soon!

reviews.name: Darren Zhang
reviews.text:
Great Massage and friendly people. They have individual/couple rooms for treatment. Everything was clean and the service was very professional.

The price was very reasonable given the location and the facilities. You can choose male or female masseurs and book on Line.
(Search google for their Facebook page)

Because we went there on the last day of 2023, we were also invited to join their party. They are just simple happy people😆

Will definitely come back next time when we visit Bangkok.

reviews.name: Wonton Noodle
reviews.text: We got both male massage therapist and it really hit all more sore points. Super worth it and great value for your money. Amazing massage! Definitely would come back. Staff is very friendly. CASH ONLY. NO CREDIT CARD/WECHAT/ALIPAY.

reviews.name: Supanun Nissen
reviews.text:
I’m Thai and came to the massage shop with my partner. We each booked a 2-hour session. The therapist named Wan was excellent — very skilled, able to apply strong pressure, and knowledgeable about traditional Thai line massage. I was very impressed.
The male therapist named Mueang was also very good. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Fiona koh
reviews.text:
I came to this place with very tired body from work, my masseuse was very professional.

Upon entering everyone greeted me well, I felt welcomed.

Full privacy, they’ve advised me to shower before and after massage session. I went for the full body deep tissue, it was all worth the money and time.

I joined their membership on my own they have a 10% discount on the spot.

After the session she asked me to choose my drink, I chose thai milk tea from the menu but I was served coffee instead with a snack. But it’s okay.

Overall I’ll come back to this place again.

reviews.name: Tim Book
reviews.text: Not the first time, it’s best place to have real authentic massage in Thailand! I’ll come again for sure. Esthetic is on top level. My master K. Nan is top tier professional

reviews.name: Kotchakorn Phensuk
reviews.text:
All the staff are nice, kind, and have a great service mindset, especially Khun Whan, who gave me a 1 hour body scrub.

The price is 790 THB, which is reasonable considering the calm environment, clean room, and relaxing scrub.

I’ll probably come back here again for sure👍🏼

reviews.name: Hilal abu dzar
reviews.text: I had a 60-minute foot massage, and my wife had a 90-minute thai massage. We were really happy with the service. They gave us a free drink and snack after the massage.

reviews.text: What a wonderful and relaxing experience. Kind and professional staff. Very happy with the price and the massages.

reviews.text:

reviews.name: Lada Filatova
reviews.text: It was a very good massage. Dimmed light, nice music, great massage technique, cleanness. They also offer you tea or water afterwards. I had Aroma Oil Massage and the pressure was just right, not too harsh and not too mild. They also let me choose an oil out of a few.

reviews.name: Brandon Wong
reviews.text: Top 3 Massages I have had in BKK. Was really good after a strenuous class of muay thai!

reviews.name: Monika Sladká
reviews.text: Lovely place, would definitely recommend!!

reviews.name: Elena
reviews.text: Great service and massage quality. I have tried several massage specialists here in 2026 - everyone is great. Recommended👍

reviews.name: David Poppell
reviews.text: Very consistent place for a foot massage. Same music every time, cool temp, quiet, and most masseurs are good at their craft. I've had a few not great massages but most are quite good. I keep coming back because the overall experience is worth it.

reviews.name: Karolina L
reviews.text:
I went there because of the reviews but I was disappointed. I agreed to have a message done by a male as I dont think it should be an issue in a professional place.
But I felt really uncomfortable and tense as there were some comments like "maybe you sleep here and I sleep with you".
The massage was ok but because of the experience I would not recommend it to any women visiting solo. Or choose a female.

reviews.name: ywdwsk w.
reviews.text: Nice massage , I did a massage from one guy at there Is really help me better after I got painful on my back. After I did it I feel oh my gosh Why I didn’t that before. for sure I will back to get shoulder massage again. And one things a women who sitting and hangout in front of the store she told me about the promotion 50% on top for every package if you come on 12.00-15.00hrs. on Mon-Fri available until 25th December /Christmas this year. And all staff really friendly.

reviews.name: Elaine Hill
reviews.text: The place is super clean and really well kept, it’s nice and quiet in a quirky building. You can use line to book, though i think walk-ins would be welcome, it’s down an alleyway so it’s maybe quieter than it deserves! I’ve had a couple of really great foot massages followed up by neck and shoulder work - well trained, friendly staff and really good value - recommended and i’ll be back!

reviews.name: Karolina Smulkstyte
reviews.text:
I had such an amazing experience at ChabaPrai Spa. I came in with serious tension in my back and discomfort in my stomach, and honestly didn’t expect such a noticeable difference—but they completely fixed me.

The therapist was incredibly professional, intuitive, and clearly very experienced. She knew exactly where the tension was without me even needing to explain much, and the treatment felt both deeply relaxing and genuinely therapeutic.

What really stood out was how effective it was. My back feels lighter, my body feels more balanced, and even my belly discomfort improved, which I didn’t expect at all.

On top of that, the prices are very affordable for the level of quality you get. It feels like you’re getting high-end treatment without the high-end price tag.

Highly recommend if you want something that actually works—not just a relaxing massage, but real results.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Karolina, thank you so much. We appriciate your wonderful review

reviews.name: Nathaniel Toppelberg
reviews.text: A truly wonderful experience at this spa. It is beautiful, professional, and transparent. Our massage therapists were both highly skilled and attuned. My partner and I came here right after landing in Chiang Mai and received the Duo Package - the perfect remedy after 24 hours of airline travel.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Nathaniel, we appriate your nice review and I agree it's a good remedy after flying for hours towards Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Amanda Curtin
reviews.text: I received a shoulder, neck, back and head massage and my partner received the traditional Thai massage. Ensure you are prepared for firm if you ask for firm. Lovely experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Amanda, thank you so much. We are happy you enjoyed. The pressure of the massage you can adjust. Just let the therapist know if the massage is too strong or to soft

reviews.name: Deanna Lestano WDL
reviews.text: We did the two hour package and it was one of the best spa experiences in Thailand. The therapist knew the pressure points like they’ve known you for years - from foot up to head. Me and my friend went together and she said the same thing too. Could not recommend this place enough.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Deanna, thank you for this very nice review. We are happy you had such a good experience in our Spa

reviews.name: Gianni Lilliu
reviews.text:
Fantastic! Few photos contrary to my habits but I was too ecstatic! We did the traditional Thai massage and the one with essential oils. Two hours of relaxation and cuddling.
Very nice location, the girls are very professional and all the staff puts you very much at ease. Nothing is left to chance: first fill out a form where they ask you if you have any pathologies or something else. Really super!!! Thank you so much!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Gianni, it is good to read that you had a fantastic time in our Spa. That's what we stand for.

reviews.name: Mary Love Gayta
reviews.text: the place was awesome the therapists and staff were very good. I will surely recommend this place when you visit chiangmai and want to have a relaxing spa experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Mary Love, we are happy you enjoyed your visit to our Spa. Thank you for the very nice review

reviews.name: Seana Doughty
reviews.text: My husband and I had a massage together here and it was wonderful. Beautiful, clean and hygienic spa with very friendly and professional staff, most speak great English as well. They treat all the clients like VIP, serving delicious drinks and giving a refreshing foot scrub before the treatment. It’s more expensive than some other options but definitely a level above most of the massage places you pass by on the streets. Make sure to book in advance though because this is not walk-in type of place! I recommend to book at least a day or 2 in advance, or more if possible. Will definitely return I am in Chiangmai again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Seana, we are happy you and your husband enjoyed the massage treatment in our Spa. Thank you so much for reviewing us

reviews.name: federico bolog
reviews.text: An absolutely amazing experience at this fancy massage and spa in Chiang Mai! The ambiance was serene and luxurious, the staff were professional and attentive, and the treatments left me feeling completely rejuvenated. A perfect place to relax and unwind—highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Federico for your nice review

reviews.name: Daria Fudim
reviews.text: Truly an amazing experience! It felt like she could read my body, knowing exactly when to go deep and when to be gentle. Easily one of the top massages I've ever had.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Daria, thank you for this wonderful review. Our therapists are well trained to fulfill the needs of your body.

reviews.name: Dr Hassan Raza
reviews.text:
It was one of the best massages I had in my life. What a luxury feel, the ambience is spot on, v clean and beautifully decorated reception.
I'm impressed by the welcome of the staff. She introduced me to the menu and suggested the best massage for me after having a small chat. They present a form to fill for any symptoms of illness or any health related issue. Also, u have to write which body parts need more work and which one to avoid.
The room was spacious and clean with the latest decor.
The masseuse knew her job well. I was amazed that she got to know which parts were stiff without even asking, just by gentle massaging. Shower and tea with a cookie in the end.
Total amount paid 1000 bhat for 90 mins. I totally recommend this place.

reviews.name: Brian To
reviews.text: This place is exceptional! The moment you walk in, you're greeted by a beautifully relaxing atmosphere that's spotlessly clean and incredibly soothing. The foot massage I got yesterday was so amazing and effective that I woke up today wanting more—so I just had to return for a full-body massage. The environment combined with their skills makes this a 10/10 experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much B rian for visiting our Spa and for this wonderful review

reviews.name: Kis X
reviews.text: Service and massage are wonderful from beginning to end. Staff are welcoming and kind and offered us cold towels to freshen up from the heat outside. Will be coming back here again next time.

reviews.name: Erin Brown-Vandecruys
reviews.text: We just finished our massage here. Beautiful spa and a Very professional and great massage. My boyfriend and I shared a room and got each a Thai massage with oil. The perfect start and end to the massage experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Erin, thank you so much for your wonderful 5 star review

reviews.name: MVDTS YWAM Sheep River
reviews.text: Felt Excellent and rested after my massage. I was welcomed in at the door - served with water and a towel. Atmosphere was inviting and soothing. The host who welcomed me was informative of what was available and recommended according to my need and what I was looking for. Directed me to where the restrooms were right away:  very hospitable. I did not expect my feet to be washed - it was definitely a surprise and given inside slippers, then I was ushered to the massage room which was how a massage room should be - inviting and relaxing.  The one hour aromatherapy oil massage was worth the price. Oil made by them - not sticky.  Grateful I decided to have gotten one for a break. They did this with excellence from the moment I entered til I left.  Highly recommend. - Jenn
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear customer, thank you so much for this wonderful review.

reviews.name: Hells Bells
reviews.text: Best couples massage of our life! Extremely polite and kind staff that gave us excellent massages and left us feeling rejuvenated after lots of walking! Amazing value for what looks and feels like a very high end establishment. Very clean and tidy. Wish we would have come back more than just once! Absolutely worth budgeting for if you are nearby.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Greg, reading your 5-star review makes us proud in what we are doing and providing to our customers. We do whatever we can to provide value for money to our customers. High quality and excellent service is where we stand for. Thank you so much for your review

reviews.name: Olivia
reviews.text: I’ve gotten a lot of Thai massages in Chiang Mai, but this one was hands down the best. The massage therapist really did a thorough job and fully stretched and did a deep massage to help my sore muscles. Highly recommend!

title: Plant Day Spa นวดกดจุดเพื่อสุขภาพ
subTitle: Plantdayspa
ownerDescription:
Escape the busy city life to an organic oasis in the heart of Bangkok. Relax all of your senses and let us pamper you with our 100% natural organic products that your skin will love.

Everything you touch, smell, sense, hear and experience is as real and natural as it gets. A grand departure from the hustle and bustle of busy Bangkok, and well, the chaos of modern-day life!
address: Plant Day Spa, โครงการ Woodberry Common, 15/2 ตึก B, ชั้น 2, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

reviews.name: Fan
reviews.text:
This day spa is easy to find and is located inside a building on the second floor next to a dentist. Stepping inside is like stepping in the nature, the decoration is very beautiful.

While the massage was of good quality, and the room was nice, I felt that the price was very high and maybe too high for the services provided. I paid over 2000 THB for a 90-minute oil massage, which is very expensive.

reviews.name: I Tan Chan
reviews.text: The environment is nice. The massage experts are very friendly and professional. They are offering discount and buy 3 get 1 free so the price is very reasonable. We love this spa and we will definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Sophy Chen
reviews.text: Super good! One of the best massages I’ve had in Thailand. The technique was really amazing. I had the office syndrome massage which helped me release my stress around shoulder areas tremendously. Will recommend to friends and family for sure!

reviews.name: Pawangnittra
reviews.text: P’Napa gives a great massage — not too strong, just the right pressure. Excellent service, friendly and cheerful. The coconut scrub with oil is amazing — it leaves the skin soft with a natural scent. It also exfoliates well; it felt like a lot of dead skin was removed. Highly recommend for massage place around wireless road (BTS Ploenchit)

reviews.name: joner germina
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at Plant Day Spa! The massage was excellent, with skilled therapists who knew exactly how to relieve tension and stress. The ambiance was perfect—calm, relaxing, and beautifully designed to create a peaceful atmosphere. The service was outstanding, with friendly and professional staff who made sure I was comfortable throughout my visit. Overall, it was an exceptional spa experience, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for quality relaxation.

reviews.name: Sherfi Pi
reviews.text: The best massage experience I’ve ever had in Bangkok! Plant Day Spa exceeded all my expectations. The staff is incredibly friendly, attentive, and professional, making sure you feel comfortable from the moment you walk in. The flow of the massage was perfect—so relaxing and rejuvenating. I left feeling completely refreshed and renewed. I highly recommend Plant Day Spa to anyone looking for a high-quality massage experience in Bangkok. I will definitely be returning on my next visit!

reviews.name: Gik Kie
reviews.text:
I received a warm welcome from the moment I stepped in. The atmosphere was relaxing, with soothing aromas. The staff were professional and attentive, ensuring I felt comfortable throughout my treatment.

The aroma oils used were of high quality, enhancing the overall experience. My massage was absolutely amazing—perfect pressure and deeply relaxing. I left feeling refreshed, restored, and already looking forward to my next visit. Highly recommend it to anyone in need of a little self-care and tranquility!

reviews.name: Joshua Diaz
reviews.text: What a great place to de-stress and recover from the bustling city of Bangkok. My fiancé and I booked the couple’s 90 minute aromatherapy, and we couldn’t be happier. Super clean establishment, the hospitality of the staff was fantastic, and overall very professional. I would recommend to anyone in the area to try them out and see for yourself. Thank you again to the people of Plant Day Spa ☺️

reviews.name: wan r
reviews.text: Had an amazing time here. One of the best massages I have ever had. I researched most spas in Bangkok and found this one. The review rating is 4.9, and that really speaks to the quality of this place. I was greeted by friendly staff and pandan tea. My therapist, Namtip, was very skillful. I requested a deep tissue massage as I had shoulder pain. The room was well equipped with shower facilities, a hairdryer, etc. Ended my session with delicious Thai homemade dessert.

reviews.name: Janice L
reviews.text: Walk ins available. I called in advance and they were able to get me scheduled for a message for my desired time. They had some promotions and great prices. I went with the Deep Tissue Oil Massage! It was phenomenal. I had a lot of tightness and tension from traveling, and felt so much better after the message. The staff was so kind. I highly recommend & would return again!

reviews.name: A A
reviews.text: I had amazing experience! I would highly recommend Nang for aromatherapy massage: she has a great technique to work on all painful points and to relax you at the same time. The prices are reasonable and the rooms are clean and have doors (not a curtain as some other places in Bangkok). I went 4 times and had 2 traditional Thai massages and 2 aromatherapy. Each cost 35-50 USD for 90 mins. It will be definitely coming back, as this place is my favorite in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Rosana Kwan
reviews.text: The receptionist Honey is really helpful. I booked one night before Tagthai and go to shop and booked in person. She helped me to arrange the massage the next morning at 10am. The aromatherapy massage for 60mins.  Is really good. The massager makes me relax and the environment is really nice. Will come again next time when I'm in BKK.

reviews.name: WEE. B
reviews.text:
**★★★★★ Incredible Relaxation – A Must-Try!**

I recently visited for a 90-minute deep tissue massage, and it was one of the best massage experiences I’ve ever had. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was serene—soft lighting, calming music, and a welcoming staff.

My therapist was incredibly skilled. She took the time to ask about my problem areas (my shoulders and lower back were killing me from sitting at a desk all day) and tailored the pressure perfectly. She used a mix of deep tissue and Swedish techniques, working out knots I didn’t even know I had. There was no rushed feeling—just steady, therapeutic pressure that left me completely relaxed.

The spa itself was clean and well-maintained, with cozy heated  high-quality oils. After the session, I was offered water.

reviews.name: Hadi Saifi
reviews.text:
I have had really relaxing time here the lady was so detailed and trained and massaged 90 minutes Tok Sen with Thai massage. It’s small spa but I can assure it’s one of the best spa in Bangkok stuff are very friendly and fluent in English.
Room and amenities are clean and very organized. If you wish to come here make sure to call them first for an appointment.
Highly recommending this spa.

reviews.name: Stephanie Moran
reviews.text: Beautiful Thai Massage today. My therapist took excellent care of me checkinv pressure and comfort throughout. She had great skill at her craft and I left feeling released. Thank you so much

reviews.name: Mahendran P
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at the massage parlor! The ambience was inviting and relaxing, creating the perfect atmosphere for a rejuvenating session. The customer service was exceptional. The staff was friendly and attentive throughout my visit. My masseuse was amazing, skilled, and made sure to address my specific needs. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and I would love to visit again!

reviews.name: claire
reviews.text: This place in Bangkok, Thailand is absolutely fantastic! I've been coming here for over 2 years, and the service is consistently top-notch. The massages are beyond amazing and definitely worth the price, even though it's a bit pricey. I can't recommend it enough!

reviews.name: Jeremy L
reviews.text:
This place is wonderful! I received an *amazing* two hour Thai Muscle Relieve Oil Massage by the incredibly professional and lovely therapist Mam for the equivalent of $70 USD, which is a bargain considering the relief I achieved and level of establishment this is. There’s an August Special at the spa and most two-hour therapies are 15-20% off. I felt every tension-point, every knot and any muscle pain I had just melt away by Mam’s professional and *strong* hands/arms/elbows. She literally worked toe to head and every muscle in between to perfection.

The establishment is so clean and welcoming, and the beautiful and kind receptionist gave a thorough description of all therapies on offer (they have a lot!). I was also asked if I had any areas I wish to have special attention given to - I had a severe knot on my right shoulder that Mam melted away with her magic. I’ll definitely be back for another session and I can’t recommend Plant Day Spa enough 🙂🫶🏼

reviews.name: Wai Jing Cheung
reviews.text:
The experience is so fantastic!
Start from the welcome drink and finally have the yummy homemade dessert.
And of cause about the massage, we join the 120 mins package. The massager so great. I choose use the firm strength and she keep using the firm strength to massage me within this 120 min. So relax!

reviews.name: James Proctor
reviews.text: The vibes and massages here are amazing! You'd forget you’re in the middle of the city with to the wooden/jungle-esque decor. The masseuses are extremely professional and very gentle — while constantly checking in. Their scrubs also smell and feel great. Would definitely come here again and bring friends.

reviews.text: Most amazing experience! I am from the US and have been to spas in the US, Costa Rica, Spain and Italy by far this is my new favorite. The three staff members I interacted with were so sweet and friendly. They were also very knowledgeable. I will definitely come back.
