reviews.name: Ilham M Md
reviews.text: We are on a healing sisters' trip. We are very pleased to find this charming place. Healthy, rejuvenating, halal vegetarian food. Nice atmosphere with big trees, potted plants and water fountain. Very friendly hosts. We have almost forgotten what we were arguing about this morning...hehe
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your beautiful words! 💚 We’re truly happy that Rasayana could be part of your healing sisters’ trip.

It means a lot to hear that you enjoyed the healthy halal vegetarian food, peaceful atmosphere, and warm hospitality. And honestly… if Rasayana helped make the morning argument disappear, we’ll gladly take that as one of our best wellness results yet 😄✨

Wishing you and your sisters many more joyful and healing moments together, and we hope to welcome you back again soon.

reviews.name: McKenzie Plante
reviews.text:
We came here straight from a long international flight and it was exactly what our bodies needed. They were so accommodating and fit us in, which we really appreciated after traveling all day. The lymphatic drainage massage was incredibly relaxing, and the woman I had was so sweet and amazing at what she does.

Afterwards, we got to sit in their peaceful oasis-like relaxation area and enjoy tea and fresh juice — such a perfect touch.

A must-visit if you’re looking for a detox or want to treat your body after a long flight!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, McKenzie, for your beautiful review 💚 We’re truly happy we could be a comforting stop for you after such a long international flight.

It means a lot to hear that you enjoyed the lymphatic drainage massage, our peaceful relaxation area, and the little touches like fresh juice and tea afterward ✨ We’ll also make sure to share your kind words with the therapist who took care of you.

Thank you for recommending Rasayana Retreat to fellow travelers looking to recharge and recover. We hope to welcome you back again on your next visit to Bangkok 😊

reviews.name: Johanna G.
reviews.text: It is such a perfect calming oasis in the middle of Bangkok. The second you arrive your nervous system already calms down. They serve such an amazing delicious food, they wash everything with filtered water and the people are sooo friendly there. It is such an wellness Heaven there with all the great raw food and cold pressed juices!!

reviews.name: YU
reviews.text: A spa I’ve been coming back to for years — a place where I can truly reset and relax. My favorite spa in Thailand.

reviews.name: Stephanie Carlson
reviews.text:
What an AMAZING oasis in the middle of Bangkok!! I went to Rasayana Retreat specifically for Chi Nei Tsang abdominal pulse massage. It did not disappoint!!! It was one of the most incredible experiences of my life! I had no idea how much tension I was holding in my belly - and I think my therapist found every bit of it! I felt immense relief in my back tightness and I left feeling taller and with an overall sense of relaxation.
We also ate in the cafe and the food was divine!! We had the mock salmon sushi made from nuts and the veggie sushi. The depth of flavors were surprising and delicious!!
I recommend Rasayana Retreat if you want to experience incredible bodywork, great food and truly wonderful people!! ! Everyone we encountered was kind and generous!! We left feeling like we made new friends and can’t wait to come back again!! Thank you Rasayana for making our trip especially memorable!! 🙏😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Stephanie, thank you so much for this incredibly heartfelt review 💚 Reading your experience truly means the world to us.

We’re so happy the Chi Nei Tsang session brought you such deep relief and relaxation. This therapy is very special to us, and it’s wonderful to hear how much it helped release the tension you had been carrying. We’ll be sure to share your beautiful words with the therapist as well ✨

We’re also delighted that you enjoyed the café — especially the mock salmon sushi and veggie sushi! Hearing that the food, atmosphere, and our team made your trip memorable is the greatest compliment we could receive.

Thank you again for visiting our little oasis in Bangkok. We already look forward to welcoming you back like old friends on your next trip 🙏😊

reviews.name: Stephen Ward
reviews.text: I would highly recommend this place.  I took some classes in healthy smoothie/juice making as well as in almond milk making for a pretty good price!! I can say the almond milk that I made was the best tasting almond milk I ever had and the healthiest as well!!  The smoothie and juice making classes were very beneficial! The type of drinks you will learn quite possibly could add years to your life and are tasty as well.  There is also a spa here as well.  I couldn't indulge because I had a medical appointment but the prices looked pretty reasonable.  I also had a chance to eat some of the food for lunch (which is organic for sure, non-gmo, and vegan), I can say the food was good.  This is the only place in Thailand (and in the world) that I have found that has classes in smoothie and almond milk making(excluding those one in a year classes that come around infrequently and are not well-advertised)!! I would definitely recommend this place as it is a positive life changing experience as far as your diet because let's just say I will drink homemade almond milk for now on and I will make and drink these smoothie/juices at least weekly for my well-being!!!!!

reviews.name: Tamara Palmer
reviews.text: I love Rasayana! I flew from Laos for 3 days just to come here for colon hydrotherapy. They are thorough, kind, knowledgeable about health and I will come back again and again! You should too! I feel like a new woman!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Tamara! 💚 The fact that you traveled from Laos and chose to spend part of your trip with us at Rasayana Retreat truly means a lot. 
We’re so happy you felt well cared for throughout your colon hydrotherapy experience and left feeling refreshed.  Your trust in our team — and knowing you plan to return again — is one of the best compliment we could receive.
 We’re looking forward to welcome you back to Bangkok and Rasayana Retreat again soon! 🌿😊

reviews.name: Miss Jennifer
reviews.text:
I first came to Rasayana in 2014 as a raw foodist. It's absolutely delicious food and I'm glad to see the menu hasn't really changed as of 2024, so all my favourite dishes were available.

I stayed on Sukhumvit 39 just to eat here everyday during my stay in Bangkok. It's so worth it.

In the past I got takeaway to take on the plane home, this time we got takeaway to eat on the long train ride to Surat Thani. We'll be back this week and I'll be ordering more food and takeaway when we depart from Thailand.

I'm absolutely obsessed with this place!

I also highly recommend the Reflexology treatment.

reviews.name: preveena bhagianath
reviews.text:
I tried the Chi Nei Tsang massage for the first time today, and I could genuinely feel the difference afterwards.

My therapist was amazing, and the whole experience was incredible. I’ll definitely be coming back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Preveena! 💚 We’re delighted to that your first Chi Nei Tsang experience was such a positive one and that you could genuinely feel the difference afterwards. 
It’s a very special treatment at Rasayana Retreat, and feedback like this means so much to our therapists.  We hope to welcome you back for another session soon. ✨

reviews.name: Lukas Hörtnagl (Rawluke)
reviews.text:
The best Vegan (rawvegan) restaurant in whole Bangkok by far 👌👍😍 very good and superhealthy food, Smoothiebowls, Detox Juices (even fresh wheatgrass selection) and desserts too good to describe - i strongly recommend you go there.
I come here whenever I am in Bangkok

reviews.name: Rikki Srichankij
reviews.text:
I recently visited Rasayana and was absolutely blown away! This hidden spa in Bangkok is a true oasis amidst the bustling, vibrant city. From the moment you step in, you are transported to a tranquil, tucked-away paradise that feels worlds away from the noise of Bangkok. It's heavenly!

Unlike some spas that can feel sterile and cold, Rasayana is like a warm embrace. The service is top-notch, making you feel incredibly comfortable and relaxed. And the food? Incredible! The raw menu leaves you feeling full, content, and bursting with energy, without that post-meal slump.

I can't wait to go back! Part of me wants to keep this hidden gem a secret, but it's just too amazing not to share. Rasayana is a must-visit!

reviews.name: Holly
reviews.text:
Lady during colonic very helpful & sweet. Arrived hungry & feasted on big menu.
The setting is peaceful; old Banyan tree with plenty of shade. A true retreat in Bangkok
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Holly 💚 We’re so happy you enjoyed both the experience and the peaceful atmosphere under our old banyan tree ✨

It’s wonderful to hear that our therapist made you feel comfortable during your colonic session, and we love that you arrived hungry and got to enjoy the café menu afterward 😊

Thank you for describing Rasayana as “a true retreat in Bangkok” — that means so much to us. We hope to welcome you back again for more rest, nourishment, and relaxation soon!

reviews.name: FRUIT4 JAM
reviews.text: If you are looking for pure raw goodness, Rasayan is the place to visit. Their food is scrumptious- all freshly prepared made to order. The only downside is that the seating is all outside with no air conditioning but they do have fans that do a pretty good job. Good selection on the menu including raw cakes and tarts. We tried the alfredo (yum), always get the sushi and the nacho salad - all very good. Looking forward to revisiting when back in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Sarah Msika
reviews.text:
I went there for experiencing a Chi Nei Tsang (belly massage with deep pressure) and it was a wonderful experience.
It’s very not easy to find this kind of treatment in Bangkok and it’s really well done by professionals.
The massage alternates with herbal warm poultices to enhance the effect.

I can only recommend the place to get holistic treatments.
They also do colonic and other massages that I haven’t tried yet !

For the food side, Rasayana has a raw and vegan restaurant, based on healthy and organic products.

reviews.name: Olga Utiuzh
reviews.text: Fantastic place! One of the best raw food restaurants in the world! Want to come back again and again! Everything was super delicious!

reviews.name: E.
reviews.text:
I did colon hydrotherapy. About 5 minutes into the treatment the hose broke off. I rang the "emergency bell". No answer. Rang it for 10 minutes straight. No answer.

I pulled the tube out of my behind. My excrement ran down my legs.

Dripping with kaka down my legs, I walked over to the lobby and called for help. Finally a chubby woman hobbled to get help.

The treatment itself is so-so. Not very well done. I am still bloated.

Afterwards I get food which is hard to digest. Now I'm bloated again.

It was humiliating, embarrassing and a scam.

reviews.name: Bree Cubrilovic
reviews.text: This is the first time I've ever tried colon hydrotherapy, I was a little nervous about the experience, but they made it very comfortable and the woman facilitating the therapy was available at all times if you needed anything and was very calm and comforting. The facility is very clean and has a lovely ambiance with lemongrass aroma and plants to add to the tranquility. All of the staff are kind and speak English. I chose the half day package, I really enjoyed it. Sauna, massage, colon cleanse and then a raw meal. Feeling great! I'm glad I took the time to give my body the detox and tlc it deserves.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Bree, for sharing your experience so openly 💚 We understand that trying colon hydrotherapy for the first time can feel a little intimidating, so it means a lot to hear that our team helped you feel comfortable, supported, and cared for throughout the session.

We’re also happy you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere, the half day package, and the combination of sauna, massage, cleansing, and nourishing raw food ✨ Your words beautifully capture what we hope guests experience here — a chance to slow down, reset, and give their body the care it deserves.

Thank you again for trusting us with your wellness journey, and we hope to welcome you back to Rasayana Retreat again soon 😊

reviews.name: Joanna Mitchell
reviews.text: Lymphatic Drainage - really good. It was a lighter pressure but she definitely knew what she was doing. I researched after and apparently a light touch is the correct method so it's good to know they are thorough here and doing it properly. The room was lovely and comfortable. Staff very friendly and it is a very beautiful spot, hidden in amongst the busy city. Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Joanna, for your thoughtful review 💚 We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience and even researching the lymphatic drainage technique afterward.

Our therapists are trained to follow the proper gentle-pressure method, so it means a lot to hear that you felt the treatment was both authentic and effective. We’re also happy you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere and caring service from our team.

Thank you again for visiting our little hidden oasis in the middle of Bangkok ✨ We hope to welcome you back again soon.

title: Makkha Health & Spa Bangkok (Sukhumvit 33)

Makkha Health & Spa is one of Bangkok's leading spas, offering a serene escape in the heart of the city. Located on Soi Sukhumvit 33, just 120 meters from Sukhumvit Road and opposite EMSPHERE, our spa is only 1 minute walk from EMSPHERE or a 5-minute walk from BTS Phrom Phong with on-site parking.

Our minimalist design and lush gardens create a tranquil haven. With numerous treatment rooms and an elevator for convenience, we provide an exceptional spa experience.

Our trained Bangkok therapists specialize in providing spa massage services using 100% natural essential oils to engage all five senses. Makkha Health & Spa uniquely blends traditional Thai techniques with modern wellness practices, making it a premier spa destination in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Isabella Lai
reviews.text: Great environment, clean and cozy. The technique of therapist is very good. I booked another 3 hours massage for the next day right after my 1st visit. The manicure next door under the same good are also worth for money. I will definitely visit again and recommend to others. Free pickup service is available upon first come first serve:
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

reviews.name: Starr Davis
reviews.text:
Beautiful atmosphere, Relaxing , modern and smells good.

Very touristy, full of foreign visitors, they also charge a price which is for foreigners
If you are looking for a local massage spot to go to this is not for you

As for the quality of the massage and body scrub, we received it was good, but not exceptional. I’ve had better ones at more local Thai spots.

Service was exceptional. Friend., courteous and attentive. A snack size of mango sticky rice and tea are offered as part of the service…which is wonderful!

Makkha is a chain business, offered in many locations in Bangkok. The pros is that you know what to expect when visited this location.  The con is - definitely over priced …  in my personal opinion.

I do recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for the perfect rating,
We are happy that you had a great experience during your stay!
Hope to see you again soon!
Have a nice day!

reviews.name: RachelDS
reviews.text: From the time we came in they are welcoming inspite us late for few minutes. The therapist are friendly they ensure that you feel safe by checking how are you? Place is clean and relaxing. After the massage we got a treat of sticky mango rice which normally won't find in the most spa places. We also had a small incident, they assist us calmly and made their presence felt thus makes it less stressful. Thank you and keep up the good customer service. Highly recommended. If I happen to be in the area again will definitely acquire the services.😀
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We appreciate you sharing your fantastic spa visit. We hope you departed feeling calm and comfortable, and we hope to see you again soon.
Have a pleasant day.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

 Have a nice day!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful rating. We hope you had a relaxing and memorable time with us.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful rating. We hope you had a relaxing and memorable time with us.

reviews.name: Jessica
reviews.text: So glad I stumbled across this place! I booked a Thai massage followed by a neck, back & shoulder massage, and wow… I left feeling like a completely new person. Super relaxed, light, and just amazing. The staff were lovely, and the little touch of serving mango with sticky rice afterwards made it feel extra special. Honestly, can’t recommend this spot enough! Highly recommend this place!!

reviews.name: Kyuwon Lee
reviews.text: Compared to the Heritage Asoke branch, the rooms and amenities here are a little more outdated. However, the level of quality and service seems to be the same, which is what the experience is mostly about. The staff are friendly and professional all around.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for this review. We appreciate the kind words and we are thankful for choosing us. We are hoping to see you again soon. Have a nice day!

reviews.name: Yun Yi Thiam
reviews.text:
An absolutely delightful experience at Makkha Health & Spa! Initially, we booked online for Asok outlet, but due to some hiccups, we were referred to this location. Their service recovery was excellent, and we are very happy with how smoothly they resolved the issue. 👍🏻

The massage itself was amazing, it left us feeling rejuvenated and relaxed. The entire experience was great. The place is clean, and the staff were friendly, and hospitable.

We opted for the aromatherapy massage, where you get to choose your aroma oil, adding a personal touch to the session. Though the prices are slightly higher compared to other massage places, it’s well worth it for the service, ambience and overall experience.

We were served mango sticky rice and tea after the session, which was a perfect ending to a perfect experience. Will definitely return! Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your experience with us, Yun Yi Thiam! We really appreciate this lovely feedback from you. We are glad that you had an amazing spa experience during your visit. We appreciate the kind words, and recommendation. Hope to see you again soon. Have nice day!

reviews.name: sally tan
reviews.text:

I can only say this is the best in the whole trip. The environment, service and massage exceeds my expectations. I didn’t want the mango sticky rice and the therapist asked if I want to take away. There is also buggy service! Their hand wash/ shower gel smells the best by far I ever had.

I hope the standard service can be maintain regardless how busy they are.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Thank you for taking such good care of us!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review! We're thrilled that you enjoyed the beautiful environment, relaxing massage, and excellent service.

Took on a 90-min session (one package was a full-body Thai oil body massage and the other was a head, shoulder, upper body massage).

We left feeling refreshed. At the end of the session, they provided tea as well. Would definitely come here again if we visit Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review! 😊 We're so happy you enjoyed your experience and felt refreshed. We truly appreciate your kind words and look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit to Bangkok! 💛

reviews.text: Very attentive and thoughtful service from the staff, ensuring you are well taken care of. You’ll be consulted the pressure of the massage before the start of the session and the massage was great. reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind review! We're delighted you enjoyed the massage and our attentive service. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing session after your next Bangkok adventure! 😊🙏

reviews.name: Michał Szymańczak
reviews.text:
Nice atmosphere, friendly staff, comfortable beds, and a pleasant scent. The room was fairly quiet and felt new.
On the downside, the air conditioning blew cold air directly onto my body, which was uncomfortable. I asked for the “strongest massage,” but it was very gentle. Even after multiple requests for more pressure, the improvement only lasted briefly.
My girlfriend had a better experience with a different therapist, so it may depend on the staff.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your honest feedback. We're glad you enjoyed the atmosphere and service. reviews.text: A clean and comfortable massage place with friendly and polite staff. The massage was excellent, relaxing, and tailored to my preferred pressure level. The owner and masseur were both welcoming and professional. Great service at a reasonable price. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Your kind words about our owner and massage therapist mean a lot to us. We truly appreciate your recommendation and support. We look forward to welcoming you back again for another relaxing experience💕🙏

reviews.text:
Highly recommend!
Sharon Thai massage is one the amazing massages that I ever had.
The staff is so polite and cooperative! If you're looking for a best relaxing family massage in Sukhumvit area that's the place you want to visit .
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful recommendation! 😊 We're thrilled you had such a relaxing experience with us. We look forward to welcoming you and your family again on your next visit! 💛

reviews.name: MUNGKORN FF
reviews.text:
I went for an aroma massage with my son, and it was a wonderful experience from start to finish. The reception staff welcomed us warmly and asked about our preferred massage pressure before the session, which I really appreciated.

The massage rooms are private and even include a shower, making the experience even more comfortable. The place was spotless, relaxing, and well maintained. Every staff member greeted us with a smile and made us feel welcome.

I will definitely come back the next time I visit Bangkok. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: KatSven
reviews.text: If I need a foot massage, Sharon will always be my first choice! Besides the fact that it is nice and clean and conveniently located on the soi I live on, the service is outstanding! The manager always make sure I get my favourite masseuse, Khun Boon whom I cannot recommend highly enough. His foot massage is the best in town.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review and continued support! 😊 We're delighted to hear you enjoy our service and that Khun Boon always provides an excellent foot massage. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon! 🙏

reviews.name: Huzaif Mysoorwala
reviews.text: I went here after my wife recommended that I go here. These are her last couple of experiences with the place. I can safely say this was one of the most incredible massage experiences I ever had across my nine trips to Thailand. My therapist was Tida. She is absolutely fantastic, with technique and pressure variations all on point. I was just feeling absolutely overwhelmed with sensation after the session. As I write this review, two days on I still feel great and I'm going to be going for the next few days as well.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re truly honored that your wife recommended us and even happier to hear that your experience exceeded your expectations. We're especially delighted to know that Tida’s technique and attention to pressure made such a lasting impression. Your kind words mean a lot to our team, and we look forward to welcoming you back over the next few days. See you again soon, and thank you for choosing us! 😊🙏

reviews.name: ELLA HUANG
reviews.text: Sometimes the best places are the ones you find by accident. We stumbled upon this shop and had such a great experience. The owner and staff were genuinely kind, attentive, and welcoming. Thank you for making our visit so memorable. We will definitely come back when we're in Thailand again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 😊 We're delighted you found us and had a memorable experience. We truly appreciate your kind words and look forward to welcoming you back on your next trip to Thailand. Safe travels! 🙏

reviews.name: james banks
reviews.text:
My wife and I both had massages here and had such a wonderful experience from start to finish. The place was incredibly welcoming and smelled so calming and peaceful the moment we walked in. We were invited to sit down, given slippers and had our feet washed, which was a lovely touch.

We were then asked how we would like our massages, from soft to firm pressure, which I thought was excellent and very thoughtful. We were taken upstairs to comfortable massage beds, and our therapists were both so kind, warm, and professional.

My wife had a head, shoulder, and back massage, while I had a full Thai body massage. Both treatments were fantastic and we came out feeling completely refreshed and relaxed.

At the end, we were greeted with our belongings, served fresh hot tea and given some beautiful magnets as a thoughtful keepsake. It was such a lovely surprise and the perfect ending to a memorable experience.

All of the staff were amazing throughout. I would highly recommend this place to anyone — absolutely worth it. Thank you to everyone for making our visit so special!

reviews.name: Megan Morris
reviews.text:
I will try to write this review as respectfully and honestly as possible.

I booked the 60-minute Head Spa treatment for 1,600 baht. I chose this place because of its excellent reviews, so I was genuinely surprised and disappointed by my experience.

The treatment started with a kind of ASMR introduction. While this may be enjoyable for some people, I personally found it a bit awkward. The neck massage itself was good, but it lasted much longer than the actual head massage, even though I specifically booked a head spa.

Unfortunately, the head massage was not relaxing. The shampooing was done very aggressively, and at times it was even painful. Instead of focusing on the scalp treatment, the therapist suddenly spent time massaging my arms, which was not mentioned in the treatment description. I would have preferred that this time had been spent on the head massage.

About halfway through the treatment, another staff member came to get the therapist, and she left the room for around seven minutes. During that time I was left lying there with wet hair while the air conditioning was quite cold, which was uncomfortable.

A facial mask was also applied, but it appeared to be a very basic product similar to ones sold in 7-Eleven. My makeup was not properly removed beforehand, and after the treatment I still had to remove leftover makeup and product residue myself. In addition, the mask contained fragrance, which can be irritating for people with sensitive skin and is generally not ideal for a facial treatment.

The conditioner and hair mask were also applied very quickly. This part of the treatment could have been another relaxing massage, but it felt rushed. Overall, there was much less head massage than I expected from a service advertised as a head spa.

The hair drying at the end was fine and done well.

Overall, I left feeling disappointed because the treatment did not match what was advertised or what I expected based on the reviews.

Suggestions for improvement:

* Make sure clients are warm enough throughout the treatment, especially when their hair is wet.
* Ensure the water temperature is comfortably warm.
* Keep the main focus on the head massage and scalp treatment, as that is the service being offered.
* Properly remove all makeup with a gentle, hypoallergenic makeup remover before applying a facial mask.
* Use fragrance-free facial masks whenever possible, especially for clients with sensitive skin.
* Thoroughly remove all mask residue before the client leaves.
* Disinfect all tools between clients.

I hope this feedback is taken constructively, as I believe these changes would significantly improve the experience.

Masseuse lathered me with oil and rubbed me with a forearm most of the time - it was lacking any focus on the tissues and pressure applied was weak. Where she wasn't rubbing me, her massage felt random, lacking pressure and skill. Midway I asked to stop with the oil application and to apply more pressure, she nodded in acknowledgement but continued to apply oil, no change to the pressure. It became clear she couldn't speak English so I thought using Google Translate would help but there is no way to translate a lack of skill and training.

The establishment itself felt more like a regular massage place. For its price and the rating, you'd expect more.

They gave me a 10% discount at the end but that could hardly make up for things.

I do no recommend this place especially because you would be paying a relatively high price for a subpar massage experience that lacks a level of standard and consistency one would expect. My sister had a pleasant experience and said w massages it's a hit or a miss but I think it just shows a lack of consistency. Come if you're comfortable gambling with your money 🤷🏻‍♀️

reviews.text: Lovely spa and massage in Bangkok. Had a pleasant time here. Got a full body scrub and it was very thorough and good. Friendly staff.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your nice review.
We are glad that you liked our Korean body scrub.
Hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Jane Vo
reviews.text: Amaranth Spa & Massage was such a pleasant and wonderful experience! When we walked in, they welcomed us and gave us slippers to wear. We had drinks in our hands and they offered to leave them in the fridge for us, which we thought was really nice. I did their Basic Facial Treatment and I never felt so much relief on my body and my face. It was 1,000 baht and I felt like they did above and beyond to make my experience well worth. They did extractions, face masks, herbal masks, as well as facial and body massages. The level of care they put into each part of the treatment and massages were great! They offered tea and water after our massages too. Their hospitality is amazing! I definitely recommend booking your spa treatments with them! It was so worth it and I would come back again. Thank you Amaranth Spa!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your nice review! We are very glad that you enjoyed our facial treatments. Hope to see you soon again 🙏

reviews.text:
Based on all the other reviews, this place seemed very good. Came here twice during our 6 day trip. First time was great.. but after the 2nd time it was disastrous! Not 5 mins walking back to my hotel, the ligament at my right big toe started to have a sharp pain while walking. I couldn’t put pressure nor bend the metatarsal area. Upon checking, there was some swelling in that area and was very pain to walk. Had to constantly ice to bring down the swelling and get medication and spray to alleviate the pain. Also scheduled to leave Bangkok the next day so this injury didn’t help. Concluded that the masseuse must have pulled and pressed too hard and damaged a nerve or something. Contacted the centre and initially they were apologetic. I asked for a full refund, which they did give. But after a few hours they sent a message to deny that this was their masseuse fault. I’ve done traditional Thai massages many times, and this is the first time it’s happened. She was a bigger lady, and at one point she was standing on my legs ( which I feel is not safe).

a little difficult navigating the location. Two stars because the Staff on WhatsApp were quick to respond, and English was good. Two stars because the ambience was nice and clean. First time was great, that’s why I came back a second time. Unfortunately that 2nd experience left a terrible memory.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We're truly sorry to hear that your second visit did not meet the expectations set by your first experience. It’s concerning that you experienced pain and swelling after your massage, and we sincerely apologize for the discomfort and inconvenience this caused, especially with your travel plans.

We appreciate your recognition of our staff's responsiveness and the quality of your first visit. However, your overall well-being is our top priority, and we regret that our service may have contributed to your injury. While we initially refunded your payment as a gesture of goodwill, we also take your feedback seriously and will review our practices to prevent this from happening again.

We would appreciate the opportunity to further discuss your experience and find a way to address your concerns. Please feel free to reach out to us directly. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Muller,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We sincerely apologize that your second visit did not meet the standard you experienced during your first visit.

We would like to explain that recently we have had many consecutive bookings, so our team may have asked guests to leave promptly after their treatment in order to prepare the treatment room for the next appointment. We sincerely apologize if the way this was communicated made you feel uncomfortable or unwelcome.

We also have a relaxation area where guests are welcome to sit and unwind before or after their massage. However, as our space is relatively limited and there are times when many guests are visiting at once, we occasionally need to ask for our guests' kind cooperation in sharing or moving between seating areas to ensure everyone can enjoy the space comfortably. We sincerely apologize if this caused any inconvenience during your visit.

Regarding the tea service, it is our standard practice to serve tea approximately 10–15 minutes before the massage ends for all guests, allowing them time to enjoy it before finishing their session. We are sorry if this made you feel that you were being rushed.

We truly appreciate your honest feedback, as it helps us improve both our service and communication with our guests.

Thank you again, and we sincerely apologize for any disappointment caused.

reviews.name: marlow
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing! I didn’t book an appointment they had me as a walk in and sat me down straight away, gave me a glass of water and a piece of paper to fill in details and a body chart drawing so I could circle any places I would like them to target more. I got a body scrub treatment first for an hour, left me feeling smooth as a baby. They also have a gorgeous bathroom that you can use and for showering in afterwards. Gave me some cute pjs to change into for the Thai massage. I’ve had normal massages but never a Thai one and for my first experience it went great. You can choose either soft, medium or hard intensity, I chose medium at first but the lady could tell I was uncomfortable so we switched to soft that was better as my muscles were really tight and tender. I feel like she’s given me a new body. Plus had a head massage included at the end that was soo nice. Staff are super friendly and accommodating. Everywhere is clean and tidy. Really recommend.

reviews.name: Nu Yoo
reviews.text: A very relaxing experience. First time coming for the 60min foot massage and I nearly drifted off to sleep several times. Feet feeling brand new after a day of walking around. Highly recommend, and probably will come again before I leave chiangmai

reviews.name: Steve Good
reviews.text: This spa is a gem in Phuket with a beautiful property and incredibly comfortable massage bed and amazing views of the lake. The massage was really great. k polly was really good and very attentive to my needs. She made the experience a 5* so that I’m feeling relaxed. The staff here are friendly and very welcoming and I’m glad I  came here! Definitely coming back or hitting the other locations in Bangkok and Chiang Mai too! Thank you oasis for giving me such a wonderful relaxing massage and experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Steve Good,

Wow, your glowing review just made our entire day! We are absolutely delighted to hear how much you loved the serene lake views, the comfort of our facilities, and your experience at Tropical Retreat Spa! Polly was delighted to hear your kind words—knowing that her attentive care provided you with a truly relaxing 5-star experience is a wonderful compliment for our team!

Whenever you’re ready to recharge again we would be delighted to welcome you. Thank you for being such a wonderful guest, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing and memorable spa escape! 

Warmest regards,
The Oasis Spa Team

reviews.name: Elena
reviews.text:
We visited this beautiful spa to celebrate a birthday, and the experience was amazing from the moment we walked in.

We had the Signature Queen Treatment for 120 minutes, and it was absolutely wonderful. The treatment was relaxing, professional, and exceeded our expectations. Every detail was thoughtfully taken care of.

The spa itself is beautifully designed, with luxurious bathrobes, elegant facilities, and amazing bathrooms that add to the overall experience.

After the treatment, we enjoyed tea and delicious mango sticky rice — the perfect finishing touch to a wonderful afternoon.

A truly exceptional spa experience from start to finish. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We are so grateful for your positive feedback. It brings us great joy to know that you found your treatment both relaxing and professional and that you appreciated the thoughtful details throughout your spa experience. Thank you for choosing to celebrate such a special occasion with us. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing afternoon of pampering.

Warm wishes,
The Oasis Spa Team

reviews.text: A truly relaxing experience in a peaceful atmosphere – a real oasis. Even without an appointment, everything was handled smoothly. The staff explained the promotions clearly and helped me choose the best treatment at a great price. Friendly, professional service, and I would definitely come back. Highly recommended! 🌺
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your glowing 5-star review. We are delighted to know that you had a truly relaxing experience and that the guidance provided by our team on our treatments and promotions enhanced your visit. Your kind words are greatly appreciated, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another exceptional spa experience soon.

reviews.name: Health & Wellness
reviews.text:
Had such an amazing experience at Oasis Spa in Laguna Phuket. From the moment I walked in, Jay at the front desk provided such high-end, attentive concierge service—super welcoming and made everything seamless.
I booked the Deep Calm Recovery, and Polli was absolutely incredible. She truly listened to what my body needed and tailored the massage perfectly. It was the best combination of deep tissue and relaxation—she worked out all my knots with a strong, skilled sports recovery technique, but still kept it calming with aromatherapy.
I actually fell asleep at one point, which says everything 😅 but somehow she still managed to fully work through 2 hours of tension.
Honestly, worth every baht. One of the best massages I’ve had—highly recommend asking for Polli if you want deep tissue done right.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a delight to read your glowing review! We are thrilled that you enjoyed the serene and welcoming atmosphere at Oasis Tropical Retreat Spa. It’s especially rewarding to hear that our staffs made your visit so memorable. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us and serves as a wonderful affirmation of the calming and restorative experience we promise to deliver. Thank you for your support and for recommending our services so highly. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back again soon.

reviews.name: Yuxin Qu (Cynthia Qu)
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing experience at Oasis Spa Tropical Retreat at Laguna.
I booked the Wonderful Oasis. The spa's environment is beautifully designed, a villa in the true tropical paradise. Before the treatment started, the staff guided me through a detailed consultation survey and let me sample various essential oils and body scrubs to find my favorite scent, made the experience feel highly customized.
The 2.5-hour session combining a refreshing scrub, a deeply relaxing hot oil massage, and a facial. Highly recommend this place if you are visiting Phuket.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a joy to read your wonderful feedback! We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the Wonderful Oasis experience and that the villa setting at Oasis Tropical Retreat Spa provided such a relaxing and memorable escape. It’s especially rewarding to know that the personalized scent consultation added a special touch to your visit. Thank you for your kind support, and we would be delighted to welcome you back again soon for another deeply relaxing experience.

reviews.name: Shanie-li Lewis
reviews.text: Honestly the best spa experience I’ve ever had. The customer care was so nice everyone was so welcoming and friendly. My masseuse was very gentle and made sure everything was okay continuously. I have not one bad complaint everything was perfect. They also arranged for us to be transferred too and from the villa at no extra charge. So in conclusion I would definitely recommend this spa to all visitors.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Reading your review was a true pleasure; thank you for sharing it. We are delighted to know that from the moment you arrived at our Tropical Retreat Spa, you were warmly welcomed by our team and that your treatment lived up to your expectations. It is especially wonderful to hear that our complimentary transportation service added to the comfort and convenience of your visit. Your recommendation is truly appreciated, and we look forward to welcoming you back again for another relaxing and memorable spa journey.

reviews.name: Erin S
reviews.text: This is a wonderful spa with the best massage we’ve had in Thailand. We booked 90min aromatherapy hot oil massage for couple and 90min kids body scrub and massage treatment for our kids. They have free round trip transfer to our hotel, even the transport car is so clean and smell beautiful like a spa. Upon arrival, they gave us beautiful pandan drink and cold towel. We were then escorted to our treatment room (2 persons each). The room was beautiful like a luxurious resort. Massage was blissful, even the kids love it! Our massage was combination of swedish, deep pressure and thai massage. The lady put more attention on the areas I requested and worked it really well. I feel so relaxed throughout and after the massage. After the massage, we return to the lounge for a cup of warm herbal tea and a very delicious mango sticky rice. Will definitely return here for more!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are so grateful for your wonderful feedback. We’re delighted to hear that you and your family had a blissful and relaxing experience with us. We truly appreciate your kind comments about the transport, ambiance, and post-treatment refreshments. Thank you for your recommendation, and we look forward to welcoming you again soon.

reviews.name: Amaya
reviews.text:
★★★★★
An absolutely beautiful spa experience from beginning to end.

The Oasis Tropical Retreat Spa in Laguna is a true sanctuary. The setting is peaceful, surrounded by lush greenery, and every detail is carefully designed to make you feel relaxed immediately upon arrival. The welcome was warm and professional, and the staff made me feel genuinely cared for throughout the entire experience.

The treatment itself was exceptional — deeply relaxing, perfectly executed, and tailored with great attention to detail. The therapist was highly skilled, and I left feeling completely refreshed, both physically and mentally.

The atmosphere, service, and overall quality are truly 5-star. If you are looking for a luxurious and authentic spa experience in Phuket, I highly recommend Oasis Spa. I will definitely return.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are absolutely thrilled to read your glowing review! It's fantastic to know that your treatment was exceptional and that you left feeling completely refreshed. Thank you for your high recommendation and for highlighting the care and attention to detail our team provides. Your support is invaluable. We strive to deliver a 5-star atmosphere and service, and your feedback confirms we are on the right track. We can't wait to have you return for another beautiful spa experience.

Next time will definitely book her again.

reviews.text: This place is so nice and calm—the perfect getaway to relax and escape the hustle and bustle. All the staff are friendly, and their pick-up/drop-off service within the Laguna area made visiting so convenient. I also want to give a special thanks to my massage therapist, who made me feel completely relaxed. I booked online and even managed to catch a great promotion!

We are delighted to know that your visit was the perfect getaway and that the warmth and professionalism of our team made such a positive impression. It is especially pleasing to hear that you enjoyed one of our special promotions. Thank you for your kind support. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another exceptional spa experience.

reviews.name: LJ W
reviews.text:
I had the 6-hour treatment, which included the Tropical Retreat Spa Queen of Oasis Massage (2 hours) and the Oasis Experience (4 hours), and it was absolutely AMAZING!
From the moment I arrived, everything felt luxurious. I was picked up by their private driver, which made the experience even more special. My therapist, Marky, took incredible care of me and made sure I was comfortable the entire time.
The services were top-tier—from the body scrub and body wrap to the milk bath, facial, and two-hour massage. My body truly needed this, and I left feeling completely refreshed and pampered.
The staff was warm, professional, and attentive, and the facilities were impeccable. Having my own private villa for the full 6 hours made it feel like a true escape.
Also, don’t skip dessert! The mango sticky rice was so good, I had to order two.
This was one of the best spa experiences I’ve ever had. I will definitely be back and plan to try the Sky Breeze package next time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely appreciate you sharing the highlights of your luxurious 6-hour treatment. It brings us immense joy to hear that from the private pickup to the services in your private villa, every detail contributed to a top-tier experience. We are particularly pleased that our staff, including your therapist Marky, made you feel so well-cared for. Delivering warmth and professionalism is at the heart of what we do. Thank you for your high recommendation; we can't wait for you to return and try the Sky Breeze package.

reviews.name: Cindy Ordonez-Bogart
reviews.text:
Without a doubt, this was the best massage I have ever had in my life.

My husband surprised me with a two-hour deep tissue massage at Oasis Tropical Retreat Spa, and it was an unforgettable experience from beginning to end.

Jane, my massage therapist, was absolutely phenomenal. She took the time to identify all of my tension points and worked on each one with incredible skill and care. Her pressure was perfect, and throughout the entire massage she made sure I was comfortable, relaxed, and well taken care of. Her professionalism, kindness, and attention to detail were exceptional.

I have had massages all over the world—including in Turkey, the United States, Greece, Colombia, and throughout Europe—and I can honestly say this was the finest massage I have ever experienced.

Thank you, Jane, and the entire team at Oasis Tropical Retreat Spa, for such an incredible and unforgettable experience. I will recommend this spa to anyone visiting Phuket and can’t wait to return.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Claude,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We sincerely apologize for your disappointing experience.

We would like to clarify that your appointment was actually delayed by approximately 20 minutes, not one hour. Unfortunately, due to a language misunderstanding, we failed to communicate the waiting time clearly, and we are truly sorry for the confusion this caused.

We completely understand your frustration, and we sincerely apologize for not providing a better experience from the moment you arrived. We take your feedback seriously and will continue improving our communication and scheduling to ensure this does not happen again.

If you would be willing to give us another chance, we would be delighted to offer you a special gesture on your next visit. We truly value your time and trust, and we will do our very best to provide the experience you originally expected.

Thank you again for your honest feedback. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back.

The changing room, shower and seat is top notch so one doesnt have to worry about anything. Overall great place for chill and recovery if you live in south Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We’re really glad you enjoyed the cozy atmosphere, the Chiang Mai coffee, and the full recovery setup. We’ve designed the space to feel personal and calm, so it’s great to hear that came through.

Hope to welcome you back soon for another chill + recharge session!!

reviews.text: We had a fantastic visit to Momiji Spa! We got the Touch of Zen package, and it was incredible. We had never experienced an onset bath before, and were not sure what to expect. The facial was also wonderful, and when we were finished, they had prepared a beautiful platter of fruit and tea for both of us. It was A great experience, and I’m already thinking about booking an appointment for my mom. 🥰

We're also glad you enjoyed the facial and our fruit and tea service. Your kind words mean the world to us, and we would be honored to welcome you—and hopefully your mom—for another memorable spa experience in the future.

reviews.name: Daniel Chun
reviews.text:
Absolutely wonderful experience at Momiji Onsen Spa Krabi. I tried the milk onsen, herbal compress and aroma massage, and the whole treatment was incredibly relaxing from start to finish.

The milk onsen was warm, soothing and left my skin feeling soft and refreshed. The herbal compress was especially comforting, with the heat and herbal aroma helping to ease tension in my body especially after my tough day climbing the stairs of Tiger Cave Temple. The aroma massage by my therapist Sow was excellent—firm enough to relieve tight muscles, yet still very calming and relaxing.

The spa was clean, peaceful and beautifully maintained, and the staff were warm, professional and attentive throughout the entire experience. I left feeling completely refreshed, relaxed and rejuvenated.

One of the best spa experiences I’ve had in Krabi. Highly recommended, and I will definitely return!

We look forward to welcoming you back to Momiji Onsen & Spa Krabi again soon. Thank you for your recommendation!

reviews.name: Naz
reviews.text:
Review:
I visited Momiji Onsen & Spa today. It’s quite expensive, but unfortunately there was no real service. We booked a one-hour massage, but it was disappointing. The experience started with a quick rinse of the feet with a shower head, then the massage began. The therapists didn’t seem to know how to massage properly — they kept moving from one spot to another, sometimes too painful and then suddenly too soft. At one point, the therapist even left the room without saying anything. The air conditioning was also very strong, which made it uncomfortable during the massage. Overall, not worth the money. I won’t be coming back.

reviews.text:
Their masseur is transgender.

Very disappointing experience. The staff were rude and unprofessional from the moment I arrived, which immediately made me uncomfortable. The massage itself was extremely poor and absolutely not worth the money. I’ve had far better massages elsewhere for a much lower price. There was no attention to my needs, and the overall service felt rushed and careless. I would not recommend this place to anyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are genuinely sorry to hear that your visit did not meet your expectations and that you felt the service was rushed or unprofessional. Regarding your comment about our staff, we are proud to be an inclusive workplace. We hire our therapists based on their professional qualifications and dedication to wellness. However, we take your comments regarding the technique and service quality seriously and will use them to improve our training.

reviews.text: Had the best time at Amber Head Spa! My partner and I booked the 90-minute hair spa session and it was so relaxing — the staff were skilled and attentive, the scalp massage was incredible, and the whole space felt calm and clean. A perfect way to unwind after a busy day exploring Bangkok. Highly recommend for couples looking to de-stress together. Will definitely be back! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.name: Jirapa Sangtim
reviews.text: A cozy Vietnamese spa with a relaxing atmosphere and friendly staff. The treatments are authentic, soothing, and reasonably priced. Perfect place to unwind and recharge.💆🏼‍♀️🩵

reviews.name: Tooba Khan
reviews.text:
Today was my second visit to Amber Vietnamese Spa. During my first visit, there was a small miscommunication that meant my session was slightly shorter than expected, but they handled it professionally by adding the missing minutes to my package, which I really appreciated.

Muay was absolutely fantastic. She was incredibly patient and gentle throughout the entire treatment, especially during all the hair care steps. Her touch was soft, relaxing, and the pressure was just right. She made the experience so enjoyable that I’ll definitely be coming back.

The only small suggestion I’d offer is regarding the final hair styling. I have naturally curly 2C–3A hair, and I think the team wasn’t very confident styling that hair type. They were a little hesitant to blow-dry or style it at the end, so I left feeling that the experience didn’t quite finish on the same high note as the rest of the treatment. It might be nice to see a little more familiarity or training with different hair textures so clients with curly hair can enjoy the same great experience from start to finish.

reviews.textTranslated: I don't even want to give a star rating. I got my car washed on Monday, June 23rd, 2025. I saw good reviews, but after using their service, I felt it was terrible. The wash wasn't clean, and the interior vacuuming wasn't good either; dust particles remained. Before the wash, I had just returned from a long trip and had my car checked at the service center (I have proof), and everything was fine. But after the wash, the rear license plate light broke. So I took it back to the service center, and the technician said water had gotten in, possibly from the high-pressure water jets. I asked about their responsibility. Initially, the female administrator was very polite and offered to cover the cost of replacing the light. However, the male administrator (named F) was incredibly rude. He accused my car of being old and broken, blaming the shop. I have proof that the car was checked at the service center before the wash. When I went to the shop to show F the evidence, he wasn't there. I called, and all I wanted was an apology, not just for the unclean wash, but for saying my car was old and broken and blaming the shop. Instead, I received yelling, screaming, and disrespectful language from him. Okay, regarding the unclean wash, the shop said they would replace it. But as long as the admin named F is still working there, I won't be using their services again. I will also inform my friends about this admin's bad behavior.

บริษัทจะนำข้อผิดพลาดที่เกิดขึ้นมาปรับปรุงในงานให้ดียิ่งขึ้น ทางบริษัทยินดีรับผิดชอบความเสียหายที่เกิดขึ้นกับลูกค้าและขอให้ลูกค้านำรถเข้ามาเพื่อแก้ไขข้อบ่งพร่องดั้งกล่าวพร้อมทั้งจะนำคำติชมของลูกค้าไปพัฒนาต่อไป...ขอบคุณครับ

reviews.name: Chompunut Nabamrung
reviews.text:
มาล้างรถ❌
มานั่งเก้าอี่นวด ✅
ล้างที่นี่บริการดี รถเราคันสีน้ำเงิน ล้างทีคุ้มราคา สะอาดมากๆ ชอบสุดคือมีเก้าอี้นวดให้นอนระหว่างรอ🤣 มีไวฟาย รถออกมาเงาวับนึกว่ารถใหม่ไม่กล้าขึ้นเลยค่ะกลัวเลอะ
reviews.textTranslated:
Came to get my car washed ❌
Came to sit in a massage chair ✅
The service here is great. My car is blue, and the wash is worth the price. It's very clean. My favorite part is that they have massage chairs to lie on while waiting 🤣 There's Wi-Fi. The car came out sparkling clean, like a brand new car. I didn't dare get in because I was afraid of getting it dirty.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณสำหรับรีวิวนะคะ

reviews.name: Aumaree Dueanchai
reviews.text: เลือกใช้บริการเพราะเห็นรีวิวดีมาก แต่พอไปใช้บริการแล้วไม่ประทับใจอย่างมาก คุณภาพสวนทางกับราคา ใช้บริการล้างสีดูดฝุ่นแต่สิ่งที่ได้ฝุ่นยังเต็มรถไปหมดเหมือนไม่ได้ถูกเช็ดทำความสะอาดเลย (ตามภาพ) นี่ยังไม่รวมภายนอก เสียความรู้สึก เสียเวลา เสียดายเงิน
reviews.textTranslated: I chose their service because of the great reviews, but I was extremely disappointed after using their service. The quality didn't match the price. I used their car wash and vacuuming service, but the car was still full of dust, as if it hadn't been cleaned at all (as shown in the picture). This doesn't even include the exterior. I'm very disappointed, feel like I wasted my time, and regret spending my money.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ทางร้านต้องขออภัยที่ตอบช้าครับ ก่อนอื่นทางร้านต้องขอโทษลูกค้าในข้อผิดพลาดดังกล่าว และขอขอบคุณในคอมเม้นที่ลูกค้าคอมเม้นมา ทางร้านจะนำข้อผิดพลาดดังกล่าวมาปรับปรุงแก้ไขในงานให้ดีขึ้นครับ ลูกค้าพอจะมีช่องทางการติดต่อกลับได้ทางไหนบ้างครับ เพื่อที่ทางร้านจะได้ให้ลูกค้ากลับมาล้างใหม่โดยไม่มีค่าใช้จ่ายหรือแอดไลน์ มาที่ @vro1149i ทั้งนี้ทางร้านต้องขออภัยลูกค้าไว้ ณ โอกาสนี้ด้วยครับ …ขอบคุณครับ

reviews.name: Supachai J
reviews.text: ดีมากครับคุ้มค่ากับราคา พนักงานทำดี ละเอียดทุกซอกทุกมุมครับ ผมล้างใช้น้ำยา Ultimate และเพิ่มลง wax เพิ่ม 300 รถเงามาก สถานที่ทำดีมีห้องนั่งพักสบาย
reviews.textTranslated: Excellent, worth the price. The staff did a great job, meticulously cleaning every nook and cranny. I had my car washed with Ultimate car wash solution and added wax for an extra 300 baht. The car is incredibly shiny. The place is nice with a comfortable waiting area.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณสำหรับรีวิวนะคะ 😍

reviews.name: Judy Judy
reviews.text: ล้างเร็ว แต่สะอาดเนี๊ยบ ไปห้างหาที่จอดไม่ได้ก็มาล้างรถที่นี่ ล้างมาหลายรอบม่กไม่เคยมีปัญหาอะไรเลยและได้ทำเคลือบแก้วที่นี่ด้วยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: Fast but spotlessly clean. If I can't find parking at the mall, I come here to get my car washed. I've been here many times and never had any problems, and I even got my car ceramic coated here too.

reviews.name: Parattakorn Apirattanaworakul
reviews.text: ทางร้านให้บริการดีมากครับ พนักงานน่ารักมาก ดูแลรถสะอาดครบถ้วนตามความต้องการของลูกค้า แนะนำแนะนำเลยครับ
reviews.textTranslated: The shop provided excellent service. The staff were very friendly and took great care to clean the car thoroughly according to customer requirements. I highly recommend them!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณสำหรับคำรีวิวดีดีเพื่อเป็นกำลังใจให้ทางร้านนะคะ

reviews.name: Chanikarn Park (Liuliu)
reviews.text: ร้านนี้บริการดี สะดวก สะอาด สบาย เวลามาชอปปิ้งก็ได้ง่ายใช้เวลาคุ้มค่า
reviews.textTranslated: This store offers good service, is convenient, clean, and comfortable. Shopping here is easy and makes good use of your time.

reviews.name: KANITHA THAMMACHATSAWAT
reviews.text: ร้านนี้อยู่ที่ Zpell B1 บริการลูกค้าดีมาก/ผู้จัดการร้านอัธยาศรัยดีด้วย/ราคาไม่แพงเมื่เทียบกับบริการที่ได้รับ/เครื่องดื่มรับรองก็มีเยอะ/ของแถมก็น่ารัก
reviews.textTranslated: This shop is located in Zpell B1. The customer service is excellent, the manager is very friendly, the prices are reasonable considering the service, there's a wide selection of drinks, and the freebies are lovely.

reviews.name: Losecter
reviews.text:
ล้างประจำไม่ต่ำกว่า 5-6 ปี ไม่เคยผิดหวังเลยครับ
สะอาดเหมือนได้รถคันใหม่ ประทับใจครับและไม่คิดหรือหล้าจะไปล้่งที่อื่น
reviews.textTranslated:
I've been getting my car washed here regularly for at least 5-6 years and have never been disappointed.
It's as clean as a brand new car. I'm very impressed and I wouldn't go anywhere else for a car wash.

reviews.name: seree watana sriphirom
reviews.text: ออกมาจากวัดป่าคลอง๑๕องครักษ์มาที่ ฟิวเจอร์พาร์ครังสิต มาต่อรถไฟฟ้าสถานี รังสิต
reviews.textTranslated: I left Wat Pa Khlong 15 Ongkharak and went to Future Park Rangsit, then transferred to the BTS Skytrain at Rangsit station.

reviews.name: Paulina Ziarkowska
reviews.text: I found this place through Google Maps and I came already twice. Very peaceful atmosphere where you can get a Thai massage. The facility is very well equipped and the staff here is very friendly. Especially, therapists who are very kind and helpful. Definitely will come back on my next trip to Thailand.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind review!
We are glad to know that you found our message very comforting.
We appreciate and we hope to see you again soon.
Have a nice day!

reviews.name: Ashley Molson
reviews.text: Went here and did the 120 min body scrub and massage package. It was sooooo good. The massage therapist was thoughtful and intentional about the massage and she took time to work through some of my tighter areas. I think I fell into a deep comfortable dream like state and afterwards I felt renewed and refreshed. They also give you a lovely mango sticky rice at the end. The facilities are beautiful and you feel like you’re in a luxury spa environment that’s relaxing and peaceful.  I can’t wait to go back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind words! We’re really happy to hear you had a good experience with us. Hope to see you again soon.
Have a good day!

reviews.name: Komal Jain
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience at Makka Health and Spa. I opted for the Thai balm massage, and it was absolutely excellent! The therapist was incredibly skilled, and the balm added a wonderful soothing element to the treatment that worked out all my tension. The spa itself is spotless, relaxing, and very welcoming. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a top-tier massage! And the best part they give you complimentary mango sticky rice 💗💗
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for giving us 5 stars! 
We are delighted to have been a part of your relaxation day. Whenever you feel tired, please come back and let us take care of you again!

reviews.name: Chestnut
reviews.text: This is my go to place for Thai massage. The therapists are very good skilled, the room is clean. And the mago sticky rice they provide after the massage is really yummy!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your wonderful review! We're thrilled that you enjoyed the beautiful environment, relaxing massage, and excellent service.
Have a nice day!

reviews.name: Tukta B.
reviews.text: The best spa in Bangkok. The Spa is super beautiful. Good therapist, skillful. Good massage bed. The service was awesome. Definitely will be back. My daughter and I loved it ❤️  thank u for the  great service.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind words. We're glad you enjoyed the atmosphere and our service. Hope to see you again soon!
Have a pleasant day.

reviews.text:
Phenomenal experience.

10/10 vibes/environment
8.5/10 massage
9/10 customer service
9/10 mango sticky rice

More high end feel compared to other chains
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your wonderful review! We're thrilled that you enjoyed the beautiful environment, relaxing massage, and excellent service.
Have a pleasant day.

reviews.name: Nicholas Garkusha
reviews.text:
Originally told the masseuse I wanted a "heavy" massage but later asked her to be "soft" instead. Great massage but had to remind her a couple of times to please be soft because she would slowly reverted to giving a heavy massage after a couple of minutes.

Otherwise it was a perfect experience. Loved to extra things they added as part of the experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Nicholas Garkusha,

Thank you very much for your kind review and for sharing your experience with us.

We sincerely apologize that you had to remind the therapist several times regarding your preferred pressure level. Your feedback is very important to us, and we will share it with our team to ensure therapists pay closer attention and maintain the requested pressure consistently throughout the treatment.

We are delighted to hear that you otherwise had a perfect experience and that you enjoyed the extra touches and special details we provide. Your kind words truly mean a lot to us.

We look forward to welcoming you back again for an even more relaxing and seamless experience.

Warm regards,
Makkha Health & Spa Team

reviews.name: Jane Nucum
reviews.text:
Was booking my reservation for four people. I had a previous surgery 8 months ago and ask to avoid ankle. I’m able to walk. My Mother in Law also has issue on left leg, ask to avoid left leg.

After a couple of email, they decided that we should find our way to their facility. Mind you, for the option that we chose for total of four people it would cost about >8,000 baht. In their website booking, cost >1000 baht they offer free shuttle. Why have it as an option?
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jane Nucum,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and disappointment you experienced during the communication and transportation arrangement.

Regarding the complimentary shuttle service, we apologize if our previous communication caused any misunderstanding. We will review this matter and improve our process to ensure that our service information is communicated more clearly to our guests.

We are sorry that your experience before arriving at our facility did not meet your expectations. We truly appreciate your feedback and hope to have another opportunity to welcome you and your family again in the future with a better experience.

Thank you for your understanding and valuable feedback.

Best regard,
Makkha Team

reviews.name: kitehigh
reviews.text:
i dont know other people but my experience was awful.
got one hour of hot oil massage with moderate strength as i asked. the oil smell nice but thats it. the therapist hands had something scratchy, feels like the edge of nails or maybe just hard skin i dont know. but it scratches my skin and was hurt. i told her and she was more careful about it but then she avoided not to give pressure but just rubbing oil on my skin. i know a good therapist knows and you can feel where the muscles get hard when you touch it but she just keep pressing my flesh.
after all, i didnt feel refreshed or relaxed at all. the room was super cold i told her twice but couldn’t help. my body got more stiff than before i was hoping it ends sooner 🙁 i checked where i wanted to concentrate on but i guess she didn’t checked my chart. she missed all the point. 😒
for me, this place was just all about fancy building and calm vibe. nothing about good massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear kitehigh, thank you for sharing your experience. We apologise for the disappointment you and your group encountered during your visit. We take your feedback seriously and address the issue with our massage therapists addressed the issue to ensure improvement.
 Your comments are very valuable to us, and we will continue to refine our service quality to provide a better experience for all our guests. 

If you have any further concerns, please feel free to reach out.
We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future.

Best regard,
Makkha Team

reviews.name: Moni O
reviews.text: Had an excellent massage at Makkha! The Thai & Foot massage were phenomenal! I can’t tell you when I slept off! Also, the snacks at the start and dessert at the end were what I didn’t know I needed! I hope I get to come back 😊😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind words! We’re really happy to hear you had a good experience with us. Hope to see you again soon.
Have a good day!

reviews.name: Иванна Герман
reviews.text: It was absolutely wonderful! I have never experienced such excellent service and high-quality massage anywhere else. You are amazing!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind review!
We're so happy to hear you had a great experience. Thank you for your visit, and we hope to welcome you again soon!

reviews.name: Leong Fook Woh
reviews.text: The massage is good. But the therapist and front desk forget that I am just recover from my surgery ( remarked in the form ). The therapist massage my whole back ( I just choose head, shoulder and feet ) , making me felt uncomfortable. 😳
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Leong Fook Woh,
Thank you very much for sharing your feedback with us. We truly appreciate your kind comment regarding the massage quality.

At the same time, we sincerely apologize for the discomfort you experienced. We are very sorry that our team overlooked the information about your recent surgery, which you had clearly indicated on the form. This is certainly not the level of care and attention we aim to provide, especially regarding guests’ health conditions and selected treatment preferences.

Please be assured that we take your feedback seriously and will review this matter with both our front desk and therapy team to ensure better communication and more careful adherence to guests’ requests in the future.

Once again, we are truly sorry for your experience and thank you for bringing this to our attention. We hope to have the opportunity to serve you better should you choose to visit us again.

Best regards,
Makkha Team

reviews.name: Summer
reviews.text: Very professional Thai massage, the service was excellent and the atmosphere was extremely pleasant. Highly recommended to everyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind review!
We are glad to know that you found our message very comforting.
We appreciate and we hope to see you again soon.
Have a nice day!

reviews.name: Alexandra Valenzuela
reviews.text: Amazing spa, very clean and very detailed in the prep. Massage is very good and very targetted on pressure points. Bonus is the welcome treat and the mango sticky rice at the end. Would highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for choosing our spa and for the rating. We really appreciate it. We are looking forward to seeing you again!

reviews.text: Did a last appt of the night and was very pleased. Massage was excellent. Ambience was wonderful and a dessert to end the massage. What more can you ask.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for using our service. 
It was such a pleasure pampering you for your spa day!
Your positive feedback means a lot to us.

reviews.name: Jee
reviews.text:
recommend booking through Gowabi rather than directly on Maka Health’s website.
After making two reservations directly through their website, I later discovered that the exact same service was 700 baht cheaper on Gowabi, which resulted in a significant overpayment.
What was especially frustrating is that there was no clear notice prior to payment stating that refunds were not allowed. When I requested a cancellation so I could rebook at the correct price, they repeatedly refused without offering any reasonable alternative.
They also did not provide the option to return the overpaid amount as credit for a future booking, which made the situation even more disappointing.
Although I have not received the massage yet, this experience alone has already left me with a very negative impression even before the treatment.
Overall, the way this was handled felt misleading and unfair, and it honestly gave me the impression of a scam.
To avoid the same situation, I strongly recommend checking Gowabi before booking directly through their website.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jee,

Thank you very much for sharing your feedback. We sincerely apologize for the frustration caused by your booking experience.

Prices may sometimes differ between our direct website and third-party platforms such as Gowabi due to promotional campaigns or platform-specific discounts. However, we understand how disappointing it can feel to discover a lower price after booking, and we are sorry this was not clearer at the time of your reservation.

Your feedback is very important to us, and we will review how pricing information and booking conditions are communicated to prevent similar situations in the future. We would also be happy to look into possible goodwill solutions for your reservation if you contact us directly.

We genuinely hope you will still allow us the opportunity to provide you with a relaxing and enjoyable spa experience, and we remain at your service should you need any assistance.

Kind regards,
Makkha Health & Spa Team

reviews.name: Elizabeth Guilford
reviews.text: Honestly disappointed in the experience. Spent 7,000 baht for 2.5 hours of really mediocre massage, facial, and head massage. I would never recommend their facial unless it is the first one to ever do. It was the most nothing facial you could get. Get a sheet mask at the 7-11 and it would be better. The herbal ball massage was pretty bad, hurt many times. Not sure if it is one of those hurt in the moment massages then feel better later but I could not wait for it to be over. As for the head massage, for the few minutes (out of the 30minutes we paid for) she was just pulling my hair. I cannot actually believe any of the 5 stars for this place. Would not recommend to anyone and will not return.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Elizabeth Guilford,
We sincerely apologize for your disappointing experience and truly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback with us. We are very sorry that your visit did not meet expectations, especially when you trusted us with such a special and relaxing experience.

After receiving your review, we have already spoken with the staff members involved to understand what happened, and we will be conducting additional training to ensure better service quality and guest comfort moving forward.

Please accept our heartfelt apologies for any discomfort or disappointment caused during your treatments. Your feedback is very valuable to us, and we are committed to improving. We truly regret that we did not deliver the experience you deserved and hope we may have the opportunity to welcome you again and provide a much better experience in the future.

Best regard,
Makkha spa Team
