reviews.name: Tml
reviews.text:
💆‍♂️A Hidden Gem: Thai Massage Experience💆‍♀️

I visited this amazing Thai massage shop on the early of December. It's located in the bustling city yet so hidden, like a secret treasure.

As soon as I arrived, the surrounding environment caught my eye. There were lush green trees all around, creating a very calming and peaceful atmosphere.

The massage masters here are truly skilled and the shop has 8 VIP rooms on the 2nd and 3rd floors. If you come with a large group, you can upgrade to get more private space. What impressed me most was that the boss was so attentive to the decoration of each room. They hired artists to show their creativity, and every room has its own unique charm.

In conclusion, this 20-year-old massage shop is a must-try. It offers not only great massages but also a wonderful overall experience. 😊

reviews.name: Lynn Tan
reviews.text:
This place was recommended by a friend - but I cannot recommend it. I personally feel what's good is only the spa-like ambience with a pretty garden and relaxing music that helps you to destress. However if I'm honest, the actual skill of the therapists varies significantly from below-average to only barely-acceptable. You can get much better skilled massages almost anywhere else in Thailand, and furthermore the treatment process and service here is wildly inconsistent with zero standardization or training. I visited on 3 occasions with varying experiences:

1) Tried the 2 hour foot massage with neck and shoulder + hot oil. Time spent on the feet was 90 minutes, followed by 30 minutes for the neck and shoulder massage. I personally would not recommend adding on the hot oil as the oil was barely lukewarm and nowhere near "hot", so it really didn't add anything to the experience. Nonetheless this was the only occasion out of my 3 visits where the treatment really lasted the proper 2 hours paid for, and was quite enjoyable.

2) Returned with the husband for a 2 hour foot massage with neck and shoulder - but this time without the hot oil. On this occasion the time spent on the feet was 1 hour instead of 90 minutes, followed by the neck and shoulder massage. I only started my treatment >10mins after my husband because I was asked to change my attire while his treatment started right away, HOWEVER we both ended our sessions at the same time which meant my session lasted <2 hours. My therapist on this occasion was using a lot of brute force to painfully compensate for lack of skill so it was not the best experience on my end. However as my husband thought it was fine, we made an appointment to return again for...

3) a 2 hour Thai massage with hot pack. We paid an extra fee to have a private room. The room itself was fine, but in the first 30 minutes, the two therapists were talking so much to each other in the room that it was impossible to relax. It is honestly more quiet to be out in the "open" area than in the private room, as everyone is quiet in the open space. My therapist this time was OK, HOWEVER she then disappeared for >15 minutes during the 2 hour session while my husband's therapist continued working. My therapist was gone so long that I even had time to check my phone and reply to emails while she was gone 😂Then my therapist returned with the hot packs which presumably she had gone to retrieve, however my session ended at exactly the same time as my husband's even though she had disappeared for >15 minutes, which meant my treatment again lasted far less than 2 hours.

Considering the premium price paid here - you would assume you will get some level of professionalism, integrity and standard, but this was NOT the case. I will not return as the dramatic inconsistency means you just don't know what kind of service you will get. I wanted to love this place but I'm afraid I cannot recommend it at all.

reviews.name: Paul Mackay
reviews.text:
Great massage here. Very nice place. Friendly service, good price. Nice surroundings and have pool also.

*update*
Today i came here for the second time with my girlfriend again. It was so difficult to get the thai massage for one hour. The reception tried to upsell everything else they could. Even saying it wasn't possible for thai massage without the extra herbal compress! We were at the reception for well over 5 minutes discussing it. Whay should be a simple request. It's annoying.  If a customer asks for something specifically, from the menu, its because they know they want that. They dont want an argument before the massage has even started! I hope management will take this onboard. However I will say I have experienced similar situations in Thailand.
Anyway, we *eventually* sorted it.
Then the customer is left thinking about the reception experience during the massage. Rather than relaxing. Massage, quite good. The woman's attitude wasn't so good. So unfriendly, borderline rude. She didn't even smile when I gave a tip, which I didn't want to give, but I gave anyway.
Disappointing, i won't be back here. Changed score 5 to 3.

reviews.name: Sans S
reviews.text:
Last year when I visited Thailand, I truly loved my experience. It is a beautiful place, and one of the highlights for me was enjoying massages in a VIP room. The sessions were relaxing, professional, and very memorable.

This year, I was looking forward to having the same experience, but unfortunately it felt a bit different. The massage techniques did not seem as refined or consistent as before. During one session, the therapist was coughing frequently, and afterward I became sick for nearly a week, which made the experience less comfortable overall. Most flu spread through contact, the mask can only stop saliva droplet.

I want to emphasize that I have great respect for therapists of all ages, and this is not a criticism of anyone personally. My observation is simply about the massage style. Much of the pressure was applied using elbows, knees, or very firm points of contact, rather than the hands and palms. For me, this felt stronger and less soothing than I had hoped, especially on the arms and legs.

Perhaps we were simply unlucky that day and did not get a therapist who matched our expectations. Still, as with any service, one disappointing experience can make you hesitant to return, even when you know the place is capable of doing better.

For the owner, please don’t feel offended by this feedback. It is shared with respect and in the hope that it can help improve the service and maintain the high standards that made the experience so enjoyable in the past.

reviews.name: Kim McKillop
reviews.text: The owner was very kind and went to a lot of effort to fit in 4 of us for a foot massage even though we did not have a booking. We were able to have our massage all together in a beautifully decorated room. The massage ladies provided a terrific service, and I'd love to come back for an oil massage.  It was one of the best foot massages I've had. The environment from the office to the massage room is beautiful and serene. You can forget all about traffic and noise and relax in this lovely environment.

reviews.name: Connor C
reviews.text:
An authentic local place to experience, and an excellent massage if you’re in the area from Chatuchak or Jodd Fairs. Beautiful tropical garden, and a very peaceful, enjoyable massage with experienced and strong masseuses. What I experienced here, was better than all other commercial branch massages I’ve had here. The experience you’d expect at this place would be very local, with very friendly prices.

I booked the head/shoulder massage, and from this experience they have rhythm, strength and it won’t feel like they’re rushing through a routine. The experience for me was relaxing and serene, they were slow and precise with every movement.

The lady at the reception is really bubbly too. They do not have socials or other forms of networking so you’d have to make a phone call/ask your hotel to make a phone call to place a booking.

reviews.name: Serene lim
reviews.text:
Very disappointing first-time experience.
We were told there was space available, but ended up waiting over 30 minutes—even after cleaning our feet and checking in. I came with two friends, who had already started their sessions while I was still left waiting.

When I asked about the delay, they suggested I use the massage chair for a 10-minute Thai massage before proceeding to a private room, even though we clearly came for a full body massage. It felt like they weren’t being honest with us from the beginning.

If they had just been upfront about the wait time or lack of availability, we would have gladly gone somewhere else. Instead, our time was wasted and the experience left a bad impression.

To make things worse, if they didn’t have enough space, why try to push us into using a private room instead of offering the common area? It felt more like upselling than genuine customer service.

reviews.name: Keng Usanee
reviews.text: I've been coming here for over 10 years, and there's a good reason why! The therapists are truly skilled and always listen carefully to what your body needs. Whether I'm dealing with specific muscle tension or just need overall relaxation, they adjust their techniques perfectly. What I really appreciate is that they focus 100% on giving you a great massage experience - no sales pitches for packages during your peaceful treatment time. The professionalism and consistent quality keep me coming back. If you're looking for a reliable massage place where you'll actually get the treatment you need, this is it!

reviews.textTranslated:

I'm speaking the truth so that you can improve. This will improve the customer experience and encourage more patronage. The image of your staff is important to a gas station. Thank you.

reviews.name: Pradap
reviews.text: Last Saturday I had the opportunity to experience the massage service at this newly opened venue, and I was impressed with everything here. Starting from the beautiful and cozy exterior design, I already felt relaxed even before the massage. The welcoming process was attentive and professional, and the customer reception process was well-executed. The interior was also clean and smelled fresh with the aroma of essential oils. On top of that, what impressed me the most was the massage itself, which was very detailed and purposeful. It was not just a random rubbing but a targeted treatment that relieved my back pain. The massage bed also had a heating function, which made me feel warm and comfortable throughout the session. After the massage, they served a unique-tasting beverage that I enjoyed. For those who love massages, you will definitely not be disappointed here.

reviews.name: Praew Panusittikorn
reviews.text:
I've visited Ojisan several times and tried various massage program so I think it's time to write a solid review.
Starting from the booking process, it was convenient by line/call, it was well responsive and pretty fast. For the welcoming process, the reception is very attentive and polite. The place and the massage room is clean and a true relaxing station. I love the program 'Oil Muscle Comforting Massage'; it was the oil massage incorporating sport massage technique which is quite strong but bearable and provide effective result. Therapists I tried are well-trained, professional and provide firm massage pressure. I would recommend therapist 'Eve' if you prefer strong pressure. She is really good at that.
Overall, I love this place very much. The massage quality and service is a lot better than other chained massage places.
The only con for me is the toilet is outside which is shared with other shops in the small community mall so it's not that convenient/clean sometimes.

reviews.name: rahul gupta
reviews.text:
If it were possible to give a negative rating, I absolutely would.
This was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had. The staff seemed more interested in finding ways to charge extra than providing even the most basic hospitality. We requested towels, and instead of simply providing them, they refused unless we paid an additional fee. The same happened when we asked for drinking water—everything came with an extra charge.
To make matters worse, the staff kept calling our room on the intercom, accusing us of creating noise. We were simply sitting in our room talking with friends. We weren’t playing music, using speakers, or disturbing anyone, yet they repeatedly harassed us with unnecessary complaints.
The entire stay felt unwelcoming and frustrating. Instead of making guests feel comfortable, the staff constantly looked for excuses to demand more money. I genuinely regret booking this hotel.
I would strongly advise others to avoid this place and choose almost any other accommodation. Even a hostel with a strict warden would offer a better experience than staying here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear rahul gupta,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback regarding your recent stay at The Grass Serviced Suites. We sincerely regret to learn that your experience did not meet your expectations and appreciate the opportunity to address your concerns.

First and foremost, we would like to apologize that you left our hotel feeling disappointed. Providing a comfortable and pleasant stay for all of our guests is always our highest priority, and we take every comment seriously as it helps us improve our services.

Regarding the additional towels and drinking water, we would like to clarify that the hotel provides amenities and in-room supplies in accordance with the number of registered guests and the standard daily allocation for each reservation. We sincerely apologize that we were unable to accommodate your request for additional complimentary items for you and your friends. Requests beyond the standard provision may be subject to additional charges in accordance with the hotel's policy, which is applied consistently to all guests.

With respect to the noise concern, we understand that this situation may have been frustrating. However, during your stay, the hotel received several complaints from neighboring rooms regarding excessive noise. As we are responsible for ensuring a peaceful and comfortable environment for every guest, our team was required to contact your room and remind the occupants to keep the noise level at an appropriate volume. These actions were taken solely in response to complaints received and in accordance with our standard operating procedures, rather than to inconvenience or single out any guest.

Every member of the team greeted guests with a genuine smile, which made the atmosphere feel very welcoming. The housekeeping service was excellent. My room was cleaned daily and always on time, with fresh sheets and towels replaced regularly. The suite itself was exactly as shown in the pictures — spacious, modern, and very comfortable. It included two air-conditioning units, a comfortable queen-sized bed, a corner lounger, kitchen units (a sink, dishes, large fridge, microwave, tea and coffee-making facilities) and a huge shower.
I also appreciated how quiet and relaxing the property was despite being conveniently located close to shops, restaurants, transport, and the main Pattaya attractions. The Wi-Fi was reliable, the facilities were well maintained, and the overall cleanliness of the hotel was impressive. The staff’s attention to detail and customer service really made the stay stand out.
I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend Grass Serviced Suites to anyone visiting Pattaya looking for comfort, value, and excellent hospitality.

reviews.text:
The private entrance protected by security guards, is shared by another Apartment Building. All the parking spaces are reserved for the other Building.
The Hotel doesn’t have any parking there. I parked in front of the Hotel entrance and inmediately a guard ran over to tell me I could’t be there.
There was no sign indicating the Hotel parking lot. The guard explained that it was outside the property near a 7 Eleven.
Even the cheapest Hotels usually have one or two parking spaces for guests who need to check in. NOT THIS ONE!!
I got out to check in and my wife drove to park the car.
After 20 minutes, since my wife hadn’t returned, one of the employees acompanied me to the parking lot. It was a place with no more than 20 spaces all of which were occupied.
My wife was leaving that lot unaware that I have arrived.
It took her another 20 minutes to rejoin me at the Hotel reception as she was sent to another parking area.
I asked for the Manager but he was not available.
It migh seem like a minor issue but it was a big deal for me as one of my daughters was unwell and needed to rest.
If you are driving think about this, otherwise it is Okay
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Alvaro A Gomez,

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback regarding your recent stay at The Grass Serviced Suites. We sincerely appreciate your comments, as they help us better understand our guests' experiences and identify areas where we can improve.

First and foremost, we would like to extend our sincere apologies for the inconvenience you experienced upon your arrival, particularly regarding the parking arrangements. We understand how frustrating it must have been to encounter confusion about the parking location, especially after a long journey and while traveling with your family.

As our property shares the entrance with a neighboring apartment building, the parking spaces within that area are reserved exclusively for apartment residents. For this reason, our guest parking is located in designated off-site parking areas. We regret that the parking information and directional signage were not clear enough to make your arrival smoother, and we appreciate you bringing this matter to our attention. Your comments have been shared with the relevant departments as we continue to review ways to improve communication and guidance for guests arriving by car.

We are also sorry to learn that your wife experienced additional delays due to the limited availability of parking spaces. We completely understand how this situation became even more stressful given that one of your daughters was unwell and needed to rest as soon as possible. We sincerely regret that your arrival did not reflect the level of comfort and convenience we strive to provide.

Additionally, we apologize that you were unable to meet with the manager during your visit. We understand your desire to discuss the matter at the time, and we regret any disappointment this may have caused.

While we are pleased that you found the overall stay to be acceptable, we are truly sorry that the parking experience overshadowed the beginning of your visit. Your feedback is valuable to us, and we will use it to improve the arrival experience for future guests.

Thank you once again for sharing your experience. We hope you will give us another opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a much smoother and more enjoyable stay.

Best regards,

Front Office Manager

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: We both liked it, but neither of us thinks that we will stay here a second time (considering if we EVER come back to Pattaya). The location is perfect. Away from the busy area with access by walking. ATM, money exchange, and self-service laundry are plus points for us. Cleanliness is undoubtedly good. The kind lady on our floor always asked us if she could come for room service. We took service only one day (mostly a linen change), as we typically like to clean up ourselves. But they are always ready to serve. The breakfast place is super. A yummy buffet with friendly staff can never go wrong.About the room, there's an unplanned small shower. We didn't like it at all. We didn't want a bathtub. But if a 6 ft person struggles with showering, I cannot imagine the struggle of the taller guys/gals. The toilet was always leaking water, a complete waste. If you have any knee injury, I recommend you be cautious, as the place can be slippery.The night shift lady we came across was super unfriendly, the complete opposite of the restaurant staff. The kind we typically can't/don't want to approach even with a smile.And the other negative part is too-relaxed management. Someone got away with vaping in the swimming pool despite designated smoking zones. From the reception to our grab, we couldn't cross with our luggage because every crossing spot was parked by other cars. It definitely left a bitter taste for me.But do I recommend this place? Definitely I do. Fair enough rent, considering everything.

Highly recommend this cooking class - one of the highlights of our trip!

The experience was well-organized from start to finish. Pickup and drop-off were super convenient, and we really enjoyed the market tour - our guide was attentive and explained everything clearly.

The cooking space was clean and well-prepared. All ingredients and tools were ready for us, and the team was incredibly efficient - they even swapped out pans and utensils for us throughout the session to keep everything running smoothly.

A special mention goes to our instructor, Tan - a lovely and kind-hearted lady who was patient, detailed, and truly made the class special. She guided us through every step with such warmth and professionalism.

Just a heads-up - there are quite a lot of mosquitoes around, so be sure to bring insect repellent or wear long sleeves and long pants.

The food we made turned out absolutely delicious, and this experience made our trip truly perfect. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting!

reviews.name: Ardila Ayob
reviews.text:
The best Thai cooking class ever! I highly recommend trying this experience when you're in Chiang Mai. We learned so much from the class, and it was definitely worth the price. We booked it through Klook, and everything was very well organized.

Each participant can choose to cook two dishes, one dessert, and one drink. Before the class begins, the instructor takes you on a tour of their mini farm and introduces the fresh herbs and ingredients used in Thai cooking, which was very interesting.

As someone who loves cooking Thai food, I really enjoyed learning authentic Thai recipes and cooking techniques from the instructors. For Muslim visitors, there's no need to worry. You can choose seafood and tofu for your dishes, and they do not use pork or alcohol. The sauces provided also carry halal certification.

The teachers and staff were friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable. The participants were also very friendly and easy-going, and it was fun interacting with people from different countries.

Best of all, every dish we prepared was absolutely delicious! This was truly one of the highlights of our trip. Highly recommended! 👨‍🍳🇹🇭🍜✨⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.name: Adam Wright
reviews.text:
One of the best experiences I've had in all of Thailand!!! We were picked up directly from our hotel, shown around a local market and given time to explore ourselves and buy what we wanted. We were then brought to their cooking farm, where they showed us around the beautiful gardens, smelling and tasting the wonderful stuff they are growing there.

Then the fun part, we prepared all our dishes with our guide and got to cooking!!! You could choose between a number of great dishes, making three dishes each, and then at the end everyone makes mango sticky rice, and my favourite, a Thai Tea 😎 . Our guide was absolutely amazing, so much fun, but also very informative.

All this for just 1,200 baht, unbelievable value for money. Of you're in Chiang Mai a cooking class is a must, and this is one of the greats!!!

reviews.name: sharifah intan
reviews.text: a must do in here in chiang mai! started the class with a tour at the wet market, and upon reaching the venue, we had a garden tour where we could learn more about the herbs used for cooking thai cuisines. the cooking class itself was so much fun, Instructor Tida was so engaging and helpful. the pace was perfect for beginners. at the end of the session, we were given a cook book. definitely recommend everyone to dedicate 4-5hrs of ur time and try this out!

reviews.name: Christopher Wilcox
reviews.text: We really enjoyed the whole activity. Firstly the chance to wander in the food  market was a treat for all the senses. Our cookery teacher Ploy expertly took us through each step to making our chosen dishes with enough patience and sense of fun that everyday in the group had a smile on their face. The whole set up has been carefully thought out and tastefully designed so that the the indoor and outdoor cooking spaces are surrounded by a kitchen garden. We chose to pay a little extra for the AC version which was an added little luxury , we could maybe have managed without 😋😃🇹🇭

reviews.name: Jessica Kurtz
reviews.text: This is the second time I do the cooking class at Mama Noi because I loved it so much last year! I wanted to bring my friend since she hadn’t been yet. I have to say that although a great experience, everything felt much more rushed this time compared to last year. Which I think is a bit ironic since it’s much lower season in April and it was basically empty. Therefore I think they could have taken their time with everything and not rush us so much. Other than that, a great experience!! I love that they take you to the market as well as walk you through their organic garden. Portions are huge so come hungry!

reviews.name: May Tsiony
reviews.text: Highly recommended! The food was so delicious. You can choose your own 3 main dishes from their menu & complimentary dessert and thai tea . They have vegetarian options as well, so it was perfect since we don’t eat seafood. Just let them know in advance. Ploy our instructor was perfect!!! She was so nice and funny, explaining everything in an interesting way.  One of the best things we did in Chiang mai

reviews.name: Christine Edens
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic evening course at Mamma Noi.

We were picked up from the hotel on time, and firstly taken to a local market where a range of ingredients were shown and explained. We then went to the cookery school and shown around the gardens, again with various herbs and plants explained.

Our teacher was super energetic and fun, and guided us through making several different Thai meals - all of which tasted amazing!

We had a great time and would highly recommend a trip to Mamma Noi!

reviews.name: HK44
reviews.text: What an amazing hands-on experience. Kudos to our "Master Chef" Satong for her energy and guidance teaching us to cook great Thai dishes. You get to choose 3 dishes to prepare. The Tom Yum prawn soup, Khao Soi and Pad Thai we made were exceptional (as good or better than our favourite, highly rated Thai restaurant back home). What a great experience!!

reviews.name: Abby Standish
reviews.text: Had a lovely afternoon at mama Nois cooking school. Such a good value for money, our teacher Mai was so much fun, she had me laughing the whole time. All the food was delicious I would 100% recommend.

reviews.name: Alexander Cillan
reviews.text:
This cooking school was a great experience overall. We really enjoyed the atmosphere, and the teacher was very kind, fun, and made the class engaging. The only downside was that she rushed us a bit at times, asking us to hurry, which made the experience feel less relaxed than we had hoped. We would have loved a little more time between dishes to eat and enjoy the food in a calmer way.

That said, considering everything is done within about five hours, the pace is understandable. Hotel pickup and drop-off were included, we visited a local market, and we cooked five traditional Thai dishes. There was a good selection to choose from, with nine options in total, two of which were mandatory, so it suits most tastes. They also adapted very well to allergies, which was appreciated.

The staff cleaned up quickly while we were eating, so there was no waiting around, and everything ran smoothly.

reviews.name: 陳宜君
reviews.text: This Thai cooking experience was incredibly fun and memorable! Teacher Beauty was cheerful, energetic, and amazingly talented—she could sing, entertain, and create such a lively atmosphere. She made learning to cook feel like pure fun, turning every step into an enjoyable and unforgettable experience. We laughed, learned, and had an amazing time from beginning to end.

reviews.name: Hollie McDonnell
reviews.text:
Today we joined the Mama Noi cooking class and had such an amazing time. Nook was great she bought so much fun & learning to the class allowing us to have so much fun.
The food was amazing would definitely recommend☺️

reviews.name: Emma Scott
reviews.text: Our family of 5 had a great time! My husband cooked with the older kids and I got to take photos and wander the property with my 1 year old  then eat all the spoils!! Mmmmm  This activity got my son to eat Thai food! Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Stephanie Smith
reviews.text:
This was the best experience. They picked us up at our hotel and brought us to a outdoor market. Explained many different Thai vegetables and herbs. Then whisked us off to their cooking school.
It has a beautiful garden. Everything was just wonderful.  The dish options were amazing and Pam our instructor was so helpful and fun.
The food tasted unbelievably delicious.  It is a must do if you have half a day. I highly recommend.  You even get a cookbook with all the recipes to take with you.
Thank-you Mama noi

reviews.name: Artur Rinaldi
reviews.text:
The experience at Mama Noi Thai Cookery School was absolutely wonderful! From start to finish, everything was perfect. I loved visiting the local market to see the fresh ingredients, and exploring their own organic plantation was a highlight—it was fascinating to see where the spices and herbs actually come from.
​A huge shoutout to our instructor, Mai. She was incredibly attentive, funny, and made us feel so welcome and comfortable throughout the entire class. If you want to learn Thai cooking in a beautiful setting with great energy, this is the place!

reviews.name: Leah
reviews.text: We found this through another site that gave it great reviews and I agree this is a great place to take a cooking class. Nook our chef was so great! Fun, interactive and personable. We got to go to the market first to get our supplies, then visited the organic garden at the school and then made three dishes!! Plus Thai tea and mango sticky rice!!! It was so fun! Our other guests were so fun to meet and get to know. They gave us to go boxes for leftovers and a cook book. I would definitely book a half day class. We did the morning which I think is best. Even provide pick up and drop off. Book here and you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.name: LazyDog
reviews.text:
Highly recommend to visit this place if you have any interest of cooking thai food.
I made a reservation just a day before but I was lucky to get my ticket for afternoon class.
We made and learnt three dishes and is able to choose for one menu every categories (soup, stir-fired, curry)
My teacher and co-students were so nice and good.  I can say every moment in this class was so much fun and good. We didn't stop cooking and eating literally XD
If I were in Chiang Mai someday, I would be here once again.

reviews.name: Anett Kreinin
reviews.text:
The best way to get to know more about thai cuisine. The experience from the start to the end was absolutely captivating.

We were picked up at our hotel with the classical thai transportation and the first stop was at a local market where our guide Tida showed us what kind of fruits, meats and vegetables they classically use. We got to look around the market by ourselves also. Then to MamaNoi cookery school! VERY green place! Got to pet turtles, walk around and taste herbs from their own garden! And then it was cooking time! It was captivating and we really liked the hands on experience. And you know what… the food tasted like a goddess fell in your pan👩🏽‍🌾🧚🏽. To finish, we got to make mango sticky rice and thai tea which was a great way to end the experienc.

Staff was soooo helpful, friendly and we really loved it there. Definitely will visit again!!! ❤️🤍💙🤍❤️

reviews.name: Aastrea
reviews.text:
My girlfriend booked a 2-hour foot massage session for 4 pax previously, but I was unable to make it that day, so I returned on another occasion instead. I was genuinely impressed that the receptionist, despite not knowing who I was, immediately remembered there was a client who was supposed to come back within the next few days. She honoured the booking seamlessly and made me feel very welcomed from the moment I arrived.

The entire environment was also incredibly serene, clean, and relaxing. The kind of atmosphere that instantly helps you unwind the moment you step in. It created the perfect escape from the busy shopping areas outside.

I was then assigned to Nom, and she was absolutely amazing. She paid close attention to the areas I mentioned were hurting and did her utmost best to work through all the knots and tension. I left feeling so much better and refreshed, ready to continue my shopping trip comfortably.

Overall, the service exceeded my expectations. Warm, attentive, professional, and paired with such a peaceful ambience from start to finish. I’m very impressed and will definitely be returning to book with Nom again. ❤️❤️❤️

title: Chi, The Spa at Shangri-La Bangkok
ownerDescription: Chi, The Spa features the most luxurious private spa suites in Bangkok, offering guests the luxury of personal space and timelessness. All the spa suites feature their own “spa-within-a-spa” – complete with a Jacuzzi bath, herbal steam and shower, relaxation lounge and changing, toilet and vanity areas, some of which have expansive views of the Chao Phraya River. Chi has private access to the secluded swimming pool and indoor Jacuzzi of the hotel’s luxury Krungthep Wing.
address: 89 Soi Wat Suan Plu, New Road Level 2, Krungthep Wing, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
Embrace the healing essence of traditional Thai wellness with a comforting spa ritual precisely designed to restore balance and rejuvenate the body during the rainy season.

Begin your journey with a 15-minute fresh herbal steam, where the soothing warmth and aromatic botanicals help ease muscle tension, stimulate circulation, and encourage natural detoxification while calming the senses.

Continue with a 45-minute back massage to release built-up tension and restore deep relaxation, before completing the experience with a 60-minute Silk Cocoon Radiance Facial.

This revitalising facial deeply cleanses, hydrates, and replenishes the skin, revealing a fresh, radiant glow.

THB 4,890 nett per adult for a 120-minute treatment.

Available from 1 July to 31 August 2026, daily from 10am to 10pm.

reviews.text:
My beautiful lady friend and I had an absolutely exceptional experience at this spa.

From the moment we arrived, it was clear that every detail had been thoughtfully designed to create a peaceful, restorative, and luxurious experience. The environment itself is beautiful, calming, and clearly built with the guest experience in mind.

My therapist, Dao, and my lady friend’s therapist, Bua, were both outstanding. Their skill, attentiveness, professionalism, and genuine care were evident throughout the entire session. The massage was not rushed, inconsistent, or mechanical. It was thoughtful, intuitive, and delivered with a level of care that made us feel genuinely looked after.

Anyone fortunate enough to find themselves in Dao’s or Bua’s capable hands is in for a special experience.

Yes, this spa costs more than many local alternatives. In my opinion, it is worth every penny. If you’re staying at this hotel, you’ve already chosen an elevated experience. Don’t miss the opportunity to enjoy one of the best parts of it.

The spa experience was perfectly consistent with the exceptional standard of service we’ve enjoyed throughout our stay. And if Dao or Bua happen to be your therapists, I suspect you’ll find yourself wanting to thank them personally for the care they provide.

Highly recommended.

title: CHUPRAN | Health & Massage @Homprung Cafe
ownerDescription:
CHUPRAN is a wellness spa in Bangkok inspired by ancient Siamese healing rituals. We specialize in therapeutic Thai massage, office syndrome recovery, sound healing, herbal therapies, and deep relaxation designed to restore both body and mind.

Located in Bangkok’s historic old town, CHUPRAN offers a calm and comfortable sanctuary for travelers, professionals, office workers, and wellness seekers looking to relieve stress, reduce muscle tension, improve mobility, and recover from fatigue.

Our experienced therapists combine traditional Thai techniques with modern wellness care to support relaxation, pain relief, nervous system recovery, and overall well-being.

Open daily until late night with online booking available.

If you go to Sukhumvit it's 2-3 x the cost - easy walk from BTS Talad Phlu + you can go to one of Bangkok's best night markets on the way home just remember, Durian is not allowed on the BTS (555)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Wow, two years! Thank you for staying with us. We’re so glad you enjoy our services and the convenient location. We'll make sure Nine hears about your shout-out. title: ThaiThai Massage BTS PhromPhong (Sukhumvit 24)
ownerDescription:
- Authentic Traditional Thai massage spa with "Thai Traditional" concept
- Our signature treatment is 5in1 therapy including head, neck, shoulder, hand and foot massage
- Experience relief from backaches, muscle tension or headaches by our traditional massage treatment
- 1 minute walk from BTS Phrompong (exit 6)

Urgent reservation please call 0930506924
Line OA: @thaithaimassage
address: 1 7 Sukhumvit 24 Alley, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Alisa Junrach
reviews.text:
Thaithaimassag is an exceptional massage place that truly stands out. From the warm welcome by friendly staff to the serene, calming atmosphere, every detail is well thought out.

The massage techniques, ranging from traditional Thai to soothing oil massages, are performed with skill, leaving you feeling rejuvenated. The clean, beautifully decorated space adds to the overall experience.

If you’re looking for a perfect spot to unwind, Thaithaimassag is a must-visit! Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Stella da silva
reviews.text: Amazing place, wonderful service, I felt light after the massage.

reviews.name: MERRY ME
reviews.text: The staffs are really friendly and informative. Feeling relax during and after the massage+the atmosphere makes you feel even more relax.

reviews.name: Ubonrat Vijitto
reviews.text: Had an amazing experience at Thai Thai Massage! The atmosphere was relaxing, clean, and very professional. My therapist Nini was excellent — very skilled, attentive, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the session. I left feeling completely refreshed and relaxed. Highly recommend asking for Nini if you visit

reviews.name: Yu L
reviews.text:
I’ve visited this place twice, and the massage therapy hasn't been very good. The quality of the massage therapists is hit or miss, and unfortunately, I wasn't lucky either time.
Most of the staff members were very polite, but one of the elderly female staff who served me was quite rude. I expected a much better experience， because the average price in this area is higher than in Asok.

reviews.name: Travis A.
reviews.text:
HAPPY HOUR 1pm-4pm (100 baht off regular menu)

My 90 minute 4-in-1 (foot, head, neck, shoulder) was 650 baht.

Cute foot spa amongst many in this area. Just a short walk up Soi 24 from Phrom Phong BTS station. Also right across from EMporium Shopping Mall.

This small shop has a beach like vibe. It was clean and the staff were well trained and professional.

I book through GoWabi APP. No pressure but if use my discount code 'travis-1716046' you save ฿100 off your first booking!

reviews.name: lene
reviews.text:
Walked in for a massage after not receiving any reply to my WhatsApp reservation request sent hours in advance. We were told to wait 15 minutes, but after already waiting 20 minutes, we were asked to wait another 15.

What’s unacceptable is that another customer who walked in after us was brought in within 5 minutes, while we were still left waiting with no explanation. The inconsistency and lack of basic queue management felt completely unfair.

There was also no apology for the delay, and the staff continued speaking among themselves in their own language when we were talking to them, which came across as unprofessional and dismissive.

Overall, very poor service and a frustrating experience. I wouldn’t recommend wasting your time here.

reviews.name: Vivian Ho
reviews.text:
The price is much higher than others, and while I can’t deny they have a fancy reception and waiting area, I absolutely cannot accept the condition of the room. The door panel is see-through, and the bottom part is see-through as well. I went alone. When I was shown to the room, a man was taken to his room at the same time. The masseuse didn’t even close the sliding door properly—she left it half open. Then I realized there was another customer in the next room. I quickly closed the sliding door myself, but it couldn’t even be locked!
When I started changing, I noticed that if someone in the next room was standing, they could actually see me changing. I was so scared that I had to kneel down to change my clothes. The massage was just okay, and I felt the masseuse was quite rude and didn’t guide me at all when changing directions.
Overall, it was the worst experience I’ve ever had in Bangkok, especially for my first time. I will not come back to this place again.

reviews.name: Phoebe Chim
reviews.text:
Just had the worst massage experience in Bangkok.
The masseuse was so rude. She pat me instead of asking me to lift my foot up. I was shocked and didn’t feel comfortable and being respected. If you want to relax please go somewhere else. The masseuses here they looked tired and looked like they are forced to work. :(

reviews.name: Kai Lee
reviews.text:
I had the worst massage experience of my life here. A massage is supposed to relieve tension, but I actually left feeling more sore and uncomfortable than before, which has never happened to me after a massage.

The therapist assigned to me was an older guy who seemed very frail and unfortunately did not appear to have the proper technique or strength for a proper massage. The experience felt unskilled and ineffective, and at times quite painful. His nails was scratching my legs when massaging.

I provided feedback to the counter after the session, but the response I received was simply that they would “send him for training.” While I appreciate the acknowledgement, it does not change the very poor experience I had.

Based on this visit, I would not recommend this place if you are looking for a proper massage.

reviews.name: Sofia K
reviews.text:
Good location near BTS Phrom Phong. I booked a foot massage through the Gowabi app. At first I was a little confused because there are two shops on Sukhumvit 24
“Thai Thai Massage” and “Thai Thai Massage Signature located very close to each other.
The massage itself was ok, staff were nice and friendly, and the shop was clean. Overall a decent experience and convenient spot for a quick massage.

reviews.name: Sylvia
reviews.text:
Randomly chanced upon this massage store and decided to give it a try because it’s always crowded (this was before we saw the reviews). Turned out to be one of the best decision on our trip.

I did a 1 hour foot massage and my husband did a 1 hour 4-in-1 which is foot shoulder head and neck.

My masseur for foot was fantastic!! Right amount of strength which really helped to relieve the ache. Lots of focus on the sole of the foot which I enjoyed. They also apply oil for the massage which felt really good.

I like that the Chair could be inclined so very comfortable. They also offered me a change of pants because I was wearing a dress.

Even though the space is open it was quite quiet and relaxing.

Note that they only accept cash here and you get 100baht discount for selected massage if you visit before 3pm.

Highly recommend ! We might just be back again :)

reviews.name: Jessica Hu
reviews.text: came here 3 times during our week staying Bangkok and the experience was amazing each time! we love getting the 5 in 1 massage and the foot massages — service, ambiance, technique were all 10/10. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Sean Goh
reviews.text:
Chanced upon this massage shop in the Phrom Phong area. Since my feet was aching from all the walking, decided to go for an hour of foot massage. In that street along itself, I counted another few more massage shops nearby. The shop has a nice ambience, with soft music playing in the background. The receptionist was friendly and they many many massage package to suits everyone.

I opted for the 60mins foot massage which was 420baht, not the cheapest in Bangkok but still okay. Upon making my payment, i was then ushered to the back of the shop to have my feet clean. The massage felt good, my feet felt more relieved from the sore.

If you happen to be staying around that area, can consider giving their massage a try.

reviews.name: Jamie Wong
reviews.text: Very good. The masseuse my aunt got was named B and she really massaged out every knot from her body.

reviews.name: Sarinya Supphanarapong
reviews.text: Very clean and relaxing place. The massage was really good! The staff are friendly and know what they’re doing. I felt much better after the massage. Will come back again for sure!

reviews.name: Nana
reviews.text:
I am writing to formally express my dissatisfaction with my experience at your massage establishment, which I visited with my husband. From the moment we arrived, the service was unacceptable. Despite being polite and respectful, we were not greeted by the reception staff.

We waited for approximately 30 minutes before I asked about the prices. Instead of providing proper assistance, the receptionist rudely told me to go sit elsewhere and read the prices myself on a sign.

Upon entering, we were completely ignored no eye contact and no greeting. During the massage, the air conditioning was excessively cold, and the therapists rushed through the session in a very unprofessional manner, clearly trying to end the treatment as quickly as possible. Before the massage had even ended, the music and air conditioning were turned off.

We were then asked to exit through the back door. When I requested to use the restroom, I was informed that it was already closed. Everything was handled in a rushed manner to force us to leave immediately. At the end of the session, we were not even given time to drink the tea, as everything was already shut down and a staff member was standing by the door waiting for us to leave.

This experience was extremely disappointing and does not reflect the level of service or respect that should be expected from a professional massage center. I strongly regret this visit and will not be returning. I also feel it is important to share this experience so that future customers are aware of the treatment they may receive.

reviews.name: Viet Huong Nguyen
reviews.text: Amazing service. The facility is clean, modern and well-decorated. Pricing is about 300-400 bhat for Thai massage 60 mins. They give you discount if come before 5p.m (so called happy hours). Staff polite and have good techniques. Thumbs up!

reviews.name: N A
reviews.text:
Randomly went into this massage parlour at 9:30pm and it was the best decision ever. They only take cash but anyways I chose the Deep Tissue Thai Massage with Thai Balm and i was surprisingly impressed the lady masseuse was strong & hit all the right aching spots. I have been to a few other massage places around Bangkok and they were all high end and all disappointing, so glad to suddenly chance upon this massage place which wasn’t expensive and gave me the best massage ever ❤️

Look for a girl named “Tae” , she massaged me so well eventho I didn’t direct her to my aching spots. Blessed to have gotten her on my last night in Bangkok ❤️ she deserves all the tips 👏🏻

reviews.text: Good massage and a beautiful spa environment.

title: Ikigai Spa Bangkok
ownerDescription: Ikigai Spa is a boutique wellness retreat nestled in a tranquil corner of a hotel in the Ari district, Bangkok. Inspired by the Japanese philosophy of "Ikigai"—the pursuit of a meaningful and balanced life—our spa provides an intimate and serene space for relaxation and rejuvenation. We offer personalized treatments, including traditional Thai massages, luxurious facials, and holistic therapies, all designed to restore balance and harmony to the body and mind. Whether you're seeking a quiet escape from the city or a revitalizing experience during your stay, Ikigai Spa offers a sanctuary of peace and well-being in the heart of Bangkok.
address: Craftsman, 34-36 Soi Phahon Yothin 11, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

reviews.name: Ben Wong
reviews.text:
I had the most wonderful experience at Ikigai Spa in Bangkok and cannot recommend it enough. From the moment we stepped inside, we were welcomed into a serene oasis of calm and beauty. The spa’s environment is absolutely stunning — elegant Thai-inspired decor, soft lighting, gentle aromatherapy scents, and incredibly comfortable lounging areas that immediately make you feel relaxed and at home.

We opted for the signature head massage, and it was pure bliss. The therapists are highly skilled and intuitive; their gentle yet effective techniques melted away all our stress and tension. Within minutes, I felt deeply relaxed, and before I knew it, I had drifted off into the most peaceful sleep. My partner had the same reaction — we both woke up feeling refreshed, rejuvenated, and lighter than we had in weeks. The head massage not only eased our headaches but also left us with a profound sense of calm that lasted the rest of the day.

The attention to detail at Ikigai Spa is impressive — from the luxurious linens and premium products to the thoughtful privacy and tranquility of each treatment room. The staff is professional, warm, and genuinely caring, making the entire visit feel personalized and special.

Whether you’re looking for a quick escape or a full day of pampering, Ikigai Spa is the perfect choice in Bangkok. It’s more than just a spa — it’s a true wellness sanctuary. We will definitely be back!

reviews.name: serene
reviews.text:
I’m visiting Bangkok for a trip and decided to try Ikigai Spa, and I’m so glad I did. The atmosphere was peaceful and incredibly relaxing. The receptionist was kind, soft-spoken, and explained everything in detail, which made me feel very comfortable.

The massage was absolutely amazing — firm, accurate, and perfectly tailored. This is by far one of the best and most worthwhile massages I’ve ever had. I walked out feeling fully relaxed and renewed.

reviews.name: Taresa B
reviews.text: Love the calm and cozy ambiance of this place. I immediately feel a sense of peace when stepping into the spa. The receptionist is very polite and friendly. The massage is relaxing and the therapist is attentive. I would definitely come back!

reviews.name: Izzy Chen
reviews.text:
I had an incredible experience at Ikigai Massage that completely changed my perception of what a massage can be.

First, the ambience is beautifully done. The space has a clean Japandi aesthetic, yet still feels warm and thoughtfully decorated. You can tell they pay attention to detail — not just visually, but also in the quality of the items used in the massage rooms, from the bed linens to the towels and robes. The heated bed had excellent cushioning. I often find face-down headrests uncomfortable, especially when deeper pressure is applied, as they can put strain on my throat and chest, but I didn’t experience any discomfort here at all. The headrest felt well-designed and comfortably supportive, and even the towel covering my eyes was gently warmed throughout the session.

The massage itself was, without exaggeration, the BEST I’ve ever had. I went with a friend, and despite our very different pressure preferences (I prefer deep pressure while my friend prefers something lighter), we both walked away feeling exactly the same: completely blown away. I spent the entire 90 minutes (honestly wishing I had booked 120) in awe of the technique. It struck a perfect balance between the art and science of massage.

What stood out most was my masseuse's impeccable execution and precision. The human body isn’t flat or even, yet she was able to apply incredibly consistent pressure seamlessly from my neck through my upper and lower back in a single, fluid motion. Every movement had a purpose that was perfectly executed with patience; not a single movement felt perfunctory.

My masseuse's sense of rhythm and flow was also remarkable — not just within each movement, where every firm press was followed by just the right release to allow me to breathe comfortably, but also in how the entire session was structured. It felt like she had a profound understanding of the human body: she knows how to release all my hidden tensions and guide my body into total relaxation.

I also tend to prefer finger work over elbows or forearms, as larger tools can sometimes lack nuance. But my masseuse demonstrated the same level of control, accuracy, and sensitivity using her elbows, arms, and full body. It completely changed my perspective.

This was a truly unforgettable experience, and I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Bangkok.

reviews.name: Natasha Singthong
reviews.text:
I had a truly wonderful experience at this spa, and from the moment I walked in, I could already feel a deep sense of relaxation. The spa is beautifully decorated, with a calm and elegant design that immediately helps you unwind. Soft lighting, pleasant scents, and thoughtful interior details create a peaceful atmosphere, making it feel like a perfect escape from daily stress as soon as you enter.

One thing I really appreciated was that the price was very reasonable for a hotel spa. Considering the quality of service, the environment, and the overall experience, it felt like great value for money. Many hotel spas tend to be overpriced, but this one strikes a good balance between luxury and affordability, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

The staff truly stood out during my visit. The receptionist was very welcoming, friendly, and professional, which made the check-in process smooth and comfortable. I immediately felt well taken care of. The therapist was also extremely good, skilled, and attentive to my needs. They made sure I was comfortable throughout the session and clearly knew what they were doing, which added a lot of trust and confidence to the experience.

The spa offers a minimum starting duration of one hour, which I think is perfect for fully relaxing and enjoying the treatment without feeling rushed. They also provide options such as Thai massage and oil massage, allowing guests to choose according to their preference and comfort level. This flexibility is a great bonus and makes the spa suitable for different needs.

The massage room was very clean, well-designed, and thoughtfully arranged. I especially loved the layout and the calming ambiance inside the room. Everything felt hygienic, organized, and carefully maintained, which is very important for a spa experience.

Overall, this spa is highly recommended. From the relaxing décor and reasonable pricing to the excellent service and clean, well-designed rooms, everything came together perfectly. I would definitely visit again and recommend it to anyone looking for a quality spa experience in a hotel setting.

reviews.name: Ammz Ref
reviews.text: Everything is soooo professional and attentive. You can relax the minute you walked through the door. The service is exceptional, from online booking to the front staff to the masseuses. Highly recommended!!

reviews.name: Yoyo Zhao
reviews.text:
We have tried 1. hot coconut oil head massage (90mins) and 2. the dry signature head massage (90mins) here, whilst staying at craftsman hotel. Both options are fantastic!
I recommend the hot coconut oil to people who have dry skin, it’s a very rich and nourishing experience.
And if you have a lot of knot and want stronger pressure i recommend the signature option. (This one you won’t have to take clothes off either. )

The rooms are clean, comfortable and private. There’s a shower place and a toilet inside the room, and they have all the essentials like shower cap, comb, hair dryer for you. The staffs are super nice friendly and the communication +booking is super easy! The little tea and biscuits are very sweet too 🩷🌸

reviews.name: Nicha P
reviews.text: We had the 90-minute Ikigai Signature, a warm oil massage with a choice of custom scents. The entire experience was exceptional, and our therapist was truly amazing. We loved every minute of it. Highly recommend if you’re around Ari area, very convenient and there’s parking space (which is rare in Ari😅). The ambiance and atmosphere of the place itself is minimal, clean and calm.

reviews.name: Paninie
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at this spa. The calm and welcoming atmosphere, coupled with their friendly staff, made me feel right at home. The therapist was highly professional and attentive, ensuring my comfort throughout the treatment. I left feeling completely relaxed and highly recommend this spa for anyone seeking quality self-care. I’ll definitely be returning.

reviews.name: Janghoon Jung
reviews.text: The facilities were extremely clean and well-maintained, and the massage was amazing. The staff were very professional and made me feel comfortable throughout the whole experience. I enjoyed it so much that I came back again, and I would definitely recommend this place to others!

reviews.name: Jinnipa Rojsawatsuk
reviews.text: A truly wonderful experience! The staff was polite, respectful, and welcoming from the moment I walked in. My therapist had such a gentle and soothing touch, making the massage deeply relaxing without being overwhelming. Highly recommend! 💗

reviews.name: Sakulrat K
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience with Miss Sony. My favorite part was the heated bed. It was so comfortable and relaxing. Would love to go back again!

reviews.name: Treetip Yamanaka (Fa)
reviews.text: Very good spa experience. Staff are nice and take good care. Massage pressure is just right, very relaxing. Many oils and scrubs to choose. Location is in hotel, easy to come. Will come back again.

reviews.text:
Excellent experience — will definitely come back.
All the staff were incredibly kind and welcoming. The massage was so relaxing that I actually fell asleep. The place was very clean and comfortable, and the location was super convenient.

reviews.name: Onnapa Senapitak
reviews.text:
I’ve visited Ikigai Spa in the Ari area many times, and every visit leaves a great impression on me.

The reception staff are always professional, welcoming, and friendly. It’s especially lovely that they remember my name, even though I don’t visit very often.

The place is clean, beautifully decorated, and creates a very relaxing atmosphere. The therapists are highly professional as well. I usually book a Thai massage or a neck and shoulder massage here — the treatments are excellent, effectively targeting problem areas while still being deeply relaxing.

I would highly recommend this spa to anyone considering it. You won’t be disappointed. Plus, they have parking available, which makes everything even more convenient.😊😊😍

reviews.name: pygmy jikjik
reviews.text: Such a calming place. The atmosphere is peaceful, clean, and well-decorated. The staff are friendly, and the massage was very relaxing. The apple cider vinegar drink is very refreshing!

reviews.name: Nana Chu-ongsakul
reviews.text: The aroma oil scent and scrub scent was wonderful! Atmosphere was so relaxing and refreshing. Would recommend everyone with office syndrome here for therapy sessions.

reviews.name: Chayapa Neeramon
reviews.text: The 90-minute signature massage with hot oil at Ikigai Spa Bangkok was such a beautiful and calming experience. The atmosphere is peaceful, the staff are gentle and attentive, and the massage was perfectly balanced—relaxing yet deeply relieving tension. I left feeling lighter, refreshed, and truly cared for. Highly recommended for anyone needing real rest in the heart of Bangkok 🤍

reviews.name: Arielle Lee
reviews.text: I had facial massage and it was amazing!! The room wasn’t too cold and the bed is heated omg. My facial therapist, Nong, is superb. The pressure was just nice, for both face and body (head, shoulder, neck and even hand) and the experience was so relaxing. The products smell natural and good too. Sadly they don’t sell their facial products..!

reviews.text:
This place works together with Tuk Tuk drivers,

Can’t say nothing about the quality of the massage , but I won’t trust this place.

And their advertising papers don’t have prices

The number of customers. You couldn't see our customers because all of our customers will be in a seperate floor. When you entered the spa you will be in the 1st floor but our customers were on the 2nd floor. 

The price: our price is different because of our masseuse they all have a certification they have done their training which some other spas they don't have that and we provide a private spa and really professional masseuse that's the reason why our prices are different. We can quality that we give you. 

Our employees: Our spa own by a Thai family and we hire varieties of nationality employees uncluding Thai and other.

reviews.text: Tourist trap! Stay away from this place!! They charge you double the price for half the time compared to other decent massage places and the massages are poor. When you choose 1 hour massage it has 15 min. shower time included, which you don’t find out until you get into the elevator after you have paid. So even if you don’t shower there you still pay for it and get a 45 min. massage. Even the one star I gave is too much! (unfortunately can’t give a review without giving it a star). reviews.name: Pratha Agrawal
reviews.text:
After days of walking around Bangkok, I booked the Tranquility Fusion treatment at Sarin Thai Massage & Spa, Langsuan, and it turned out to be exactly what I needed. The combination of traditional Thai massage, foot massage, and warm oil therapy gave me the best of all three worlds.

The session started with a traditional Thai massage that really focused on releasing tension through deep stretches and pressure points. It was firm but never uncomfortable, and I could immediately feel the stiffness in my back and shoulders easing.

The foot massage was incredibly relaxing after spending hours exploring the city. The therapist paid attention to every part of my feet and lower legs, leaving them feeling noticeably lighter and less fatigued.

The warm oil massage was the perfect way to finish. The gentle, flowing movements balanced out the intensity of the Thai massage, helping my muscles completely unwind. It felt soothing rather than rushed, and I walked out feeling refreshed instead of sore.

The spa itself is clean, peaceful, and beautifully maintained. The staff were welcoming from the moment I arrived, and the therapist was skilled, professional, and attentive throughout the treatment. Nothing felt mechanical, it was a genuinely relaxing experience from start to finish.

If you’re looking for a massage that combines therapeutic relief with deep relaxation, I’d definitely recommend the Tranquility Fusion treatment. It’s a wonderful way to recharge after a busy day in Bangkok, and I’d happily return on my next visit.

The WORST massage I've had in Bangkok. Extremely disappointing. Each stroke was inconsistent, either too hard or too soft. I felt so unsafe when she's massaging my neck that I had to stop. Did not finish my 90 mins and there were no follow up from the storekeeper.

I suspect this place is used for a training ground.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Miss Alicia,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are truly sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations. 🙏

We are especially concerned to learn that you felt uncomfortable during the neck portion of the massage and chose to end the treatment early. Customer comfort and safety should always come first and we sincerely apologize that this was not your experience.

We also regret that there was no proper follow-up from our team after you stopped the session. Regardless of the circumstances, we should have checked on your concerns and offered assistance at that moment. For that, we sincerely apologize.

Regarding your comment about our therapists, we would like to clarify that our massage therapists is all certified and undergo training before serving customers independently. However, we fully acknowledge that massage preferences and therapist-client compatibility can vary and it appears that the technique and pressure provided during your session were not suitable for your needs.

Your feedback has been shared with our management team for review, as consistency of pressure, communication during treatment and customer care are areas we continuously work to improve.

We appreciate your honest comments and regret that we were unable to provide the relaxing experience you expected. Thank you for bringing these concerns to our attention. 🙏🙏🙏

Sincerely yours, 
Wellcare Massage - Sukhumvit Branch

reviews.name: Keiko Takano
reviews.text:
WellCare Massage ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had a fantastic massage with Chin and would happily return. Chin was incredibly intuitive, quickly finding areas of tension and adjusting the treatment to exactly what my body needed. She also has excellent strength, providing firm, effective pressure while still making the experience feel relaxing and restorative.

I was able to walk in without a reservation, which was very convenient. However, within the first 30 minutes of my appointment, the place filled up completely, so I would recommend booking ahead if you have a specific time in mind.

The location is also a major plus. It’s conveniently located near Grand Centre Point Terminal, making it an easy choice if you’re staying in the area and looking for a quality massage without traveling far. Professional service, skilled therapists, and great value overall. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Keiko Takano,

Thank you for sharing such a detailed and thoughtful review. We truly appreciate you taking the time to describe your experience. 🙏

We're especially pleased to hear that therapist Chin was able to identify your areas of tension and tailor the massage to your body's needs. Providing personalized care is something we take great pride in and your comments about her intuition, technique and strength will mean a great deal to her.

It's also wonderful to know that you found our walk-in service convenient. As you've noted, our schedule can fill up quickly, especially during busy periods, so your advice about booking ahead is very helpful for future customers.

reviews.name: Marion Athané
reviews.text:
After a long flight from Europe, I was looking for a high-quality massage close to where I was staying, in the Ari neighborhood. The place is easy to reach on foot from my hostel, so I decided to try it and chose the first treatment on the menu: a 1-hour massage including a foot massage (45 minutes) and head and shoulders (15 minutes) for 750 THB (around €20).

I always check reviews before booking, and this spa had excellent ones. I can now say I was not disappointed at all.

Yes, it is more expensive than the typical Thai massage places you can find nearby, but honestly, you would never get something of this quality for that price in France.

The place itself is beautiful, a little oasis in the middle of a busy city. Everything is clean and well maintained. The staff speak some English and are very respectful, no phone calls during the massage, no loud conversations. You are welcomed with a cold drink, the air conditioning is comfortable, you remove your shoes and they provide a clean pair for you. The toilets are also spotless.

There is soft jazz background music, played at just the right volume, and you have your own private cabin, which really adds to the feeling of calm and intimacy. This is clearly not a cheap, rushed massage experience, but a thoughtful and well-designed one.

The massage itself was a very authentic Thai massage. I especially appreciated that the therapist respected my request for a gentler pressure. It helped a lot with blood circulation after a long flight and deeply relaxed my head and shoulders. Seeing the care she put into the head work, I would actually recommend choosing a longer head massage next time.

The treatment ends with a small refreshment, a hot drink and some sweets, which is a lovely final touch. Payment is easy, either by cash or card at the front desk.

I would absolutely recommend this place and would happily come back.

“The best restaurant I’ve ever eaten at.” Thank you, Agent Paula.
We sincerely thank you for your review and for sharing these beautiful photos that perfectly capture the details of your dining experience at Blue Elephant Phuket.
Your words deeply touch us. Being called “the best restaurant I’ve ever eaten at” is one of the greatest compliments we could receive. We are delighted that the quality of the food, drinks, the wine selection offered by our young sommelier Khun Tong, and the service all contributed to making this such a memorable experience. Behind every dish lies the vision of Master Chef Nooror. She has learned precious recipes, techniques, and traditions passed down through generations in her family. Throughout her career, she has dedicated herself to preserving Thai culinary heritage. Today, the Thai culinary heritage lives on in every Blue Elephant restaurant and cooking school, from Phuket Town to the historic Sathorn Road mansion in Bangkok (Surasak Station) and the verdant haven of Sukhumvit 13 (Nana Station).
With us, every dish tells a story, every recipe carries a history, and every meal is designed to celebrate the warmth, generosity, and authenticity that characterize Thai culture.
Thank you again for your recommendation.
