Dear Ahmed Raed, we are especially grateful for the beautiful photographs you shared. They perfectly capture the charm and character of our century-old Phra Pitak Chinpracha Mansion, one of Phuket Town's most treasured heritage landmarks. Surrounded by tropical gardens and elegant Sino-Portuguese architecture, the mansion offers a unique setting where guests can discover the culinary heritage of Thailand in an atmosphere of timeless elegance.
This historic environment is particularly meaningful in Phuket Town, whose rich cultural identity and multicultural heritage contributed to its recognition as a UNESCO Creative Cities Network Creative City of Gastronomy. Khun Raed, for centuries, Phuket was an important trading port where Thai, Chinese, Malay, Indian, and European influences met and enriched one another. One of the most remarkable results of this cultural exchange is Peranakan cuisine, a unique culinary tradition born from the blending of Chinese and Malay cultures and deeply rooted in the history of Phuket.
Our Peranakan menu, created by Master Chef  Nooror , is the result of extensive research into Phuket's culinary heritage and reflects the rich cultural tapestry that has shaped the island's identity over generations. Through these carefully preserved recipes and flavors, guests are invited to experience a unique chapter of Thailand's gastronomic history.
We are delighted to know that you enjoyed our cuisine and appreciated both the authentic flavors and elegant presentation of the dishes. 
A special thank you for recognizing Erwin, Jane, and Aum. We are proud of their dedication to genuine Thai hospitality, and we will be delighted to share your kind words with them. Knowing that they helped make your visit so memorable is the greatest compliment they could receive.

reviews.name: mariam atif
reviews.text:
One of the most delicious meals we had in Phuket with such a beautiful setting in a villa built in 1903, gorgeous Portuguese architecture designed by a family. We loved everything about the experience and Erwin was especially so helpful with deciding what to order, in taking care of us throughout the dinner right till the end.
He was an amazing host and treated us like family and especially considering we were celebrating two 40th birthdays. This was an unforgettable experience ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Khun Mariam,
Thank you for celebrating such a special occasion with us. We are delighted that your two 40th birthdays became part of your Blue Elephant Phuket Town experience.
We are especially happy that you appreciated the unique character of our historic mansion. Built in 1903, this beautifully preserved Sino-Portuguese residence is an important part of Phuket's heritage, reflecting the island's rich cultural history. Dining here is not only about discovering authentic Heritage Thai Cuisine created by Master Chef Nooror, but also about experiencing one of Phuket's most treasured historic landmarks.
Behind the mansion, nestled in our peaceful park, you will also find our Organic Garden. It is visited every day by our chefs and by students from the Blue Elephant Cooking School, who harvest fresh herbs, and traditional Thai ingredients that inspire many of the dishes served in our restaurant. It is a living classroom and an essential part of our commitment to preserving Thailand's culinary heritage.

reviews.name: David 82
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful dinner at Blue Elephant Phuket and everything was simply outstanding.
The Royal Eggplant with organic chicken, eggplant and scallops was absolutely delicious, with perfectly balanced flavors and excellent presentation. The Tom Yum was one of the best we've had, rich, fragrant and full of authentic Thai flavors.
We have to mention also the two incredible desserts: the Mango Cheesecake, fresh and perfectly balanced, and the Pistachio Cake, which was simply superb and the perfect ending to an exceptional meal.
A special thank you to Jane, who looked after us throughout the entire evening. She was warm, attentive, professional and absolutely perfect, making our dining experience even more memorable.
Beautiful historic setting, exceptional food and impeccable service. We will definitely be back and highly recommend Blue Elephant Phuket to anyone looking for a truly special dining experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear David,
Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback regarding your dinner at Blue Elephant Phuket Town! I am delighted to hear that you had such a lovely evening.
The dishes you mentioned, especially the Royal Eggplant and the Tom Yum, truly sound delicious. I am also thrilled that you enjoyed the desserts, particularly the Mango Cheesecake homemade  & Chachoengsao fresh "Nam Dok Mai",  mango cheesecake and the Jasmine Pistachio Cake baked pistachio cake with date palm, egg, coconut, and palm sugar, which are indeed popular choices on our menu.
I will be sure to pass along your thanks to Jane for her exceptional service. She always does her best to ensure every guest enjoys a memorable time.
We would be delighted to welcome you back again soon. Thank you once again for your recommendation!

reviewContext.Group size: 2 people, Suitable for all group sizes

reviews.name: Angela K.
reviews.text:
The venue is undeniably beautiful, elegant, atmospheric, and truly one of the most stunning dining settings in Phuket. Unfortunately, that’s where the positives end.

The food was deeply disappointing. The pad thai was overly sweet, with clumpy noodles that lacked any proper texture. The tiger prawn, charged by weight, felt like a complete miss, at around $50 USD, it was nowhere near worth the price in terms of both quality and taste.

The tom yum soup portion was shockingly small, barely enough for one person, which felt unreasonable given the pricing and expectations.

The biggest letdown was the Phuket cashew chicken. It tasted like generic sweet fried pork you could find anywhere, with nothing distinctive or memorable about it.

Overall, while the setting is impressive, the food quality does not justify the price. I would not recommend dining here if you are looking for authentic Thai food.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Khun Angie, for taking the time to share your experience and for highlighting the beauty, elegance, and charm of our house, which you describe as one of the most beautiful restaurants in PHUKET. 
 At Blue Elephant Phuket, every recipe is prepared with the utmost respect for Thai Heritage Cuisine, defended for more than 45 years by Master Chef Nooror, internationally recognized as an ambassador of Thailand’s culinary heritage.
Our teams carefully select ingredients from Royal Project farms, local producers, organic suppliers, and partners who share our strict standards regarding quality and respect for ingredients. Our absolute priority has always been quality.
 Since many years now  we  welcome  loyal Thai guests, residents, and passionate food lovers who return precisely to experience and share this authentic heritage cuisine created and carried by Master Chef Nooror.
Over many years, the comments collected across our different social media platforms, together with the loyalty and return of many regular guests, reflect the experience and standards that so many visitors continue to appreciate and trust.
It is clear from your comments that   culinary preparations did not correspond to your personal taste nor to your  price expectations on that particular evening. Our absolute priority remains quality.
Wishing you a most enjoyable stay in Phuket  , where satisfaction is  available for all diverse expectations.

reviews.name: Individual Real Estate S.L.
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience at Blue Elephant Phuket. The entire evening felt special from the moment we arrived. The setting is absolutely stunning, a beautiful historic mansion surrounded by an elegant atmosphere that makes the experience unforgettable.

A very special thank you to Namcha, who took care of us wonderfully throughout the dinner. She was extraordinarily attentive, patient, and genuinely kind. She carefully explained the menu and recommended several traditional Thai dishes for us to try, which made the experience even more authentic and enjoyable.

The food was excellent, the service impeccable, and the warmth of the staff truly stood out. We highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Phuket, especially if you want to enjoy authentic Thai cuisine in a spectacular setting.

We hope to see you again soon!

— Aitor, Carmen, Víctor & Mihail (from Barcelona)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Aitor, Carmen, Víctor & Mihail, thank you very much for choosing Blue Elephant Phuket during your stay in Thailand.
We are truly delighted to read that your evening felt special from the very moment you arrived. Your kind words about our historic mansion and its elegant atmosphere mean a great deal to us, as preserving the charm and heritage of this unique setting is an important part of the experience we wish to share with our guests.
A very special thank you as well for your beautiful comments regarding Namcha. Passionate about Thai hospitality, our team takes great pride in introducing guests to the richness of authentic Thai cuisine. We are very happy to know that her explanations and recommendations helped make your culinary journey even more authentic, personal, and enjoyable.
Your compliments about the quality of the cuisine, the impeccable service, and the warmth of our team are sincerely appreciated by all of us, as these are values that are very close to the heart of the team of Master Chef Nooror and the entire Blue Elephant family.
We are especially touched that you would recommend our house to travelers wishing to discover authentic Thai cuisine in a spectacular and historic setting. Reviews such as yours are a wonderful source of motivation for our entire team.
Aitor, Carmen, Víctor & Mihail, It was a true pleasure welcoming you from Barcelona, and we sincerely hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again very soon for another memorable evening at Blue Elephant Phuket Town.

reviews.name: Siss ld
reviews.text:
Everything was absolutely exceptional from start to finish. The welcome was incredibly warm and adorable, and we were delighted with the small complimentary starters. Each dish was beautifully presented and of outstanding quality — truly excellent, refined, and delicious.

A very special thank you to Erwin, who was incredibly, incredibly kind and adorable. He welcomed us so warmly, took great care of us throughout the experience, and made the evening even more memorable. Outstanding service and an unforgettable experience — highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Siss ld thank you for your incredibly enthusiastic and kind review. We are truly delighted to know that your experience was exceptional from start to finish, both in terms of the warm welcome and the quality of our cuisine. Our menu is a true celebration of Thai culinary heritage, inspired and crafted under the guidance of Master Chef Nooror, an iconic figure of Thai gastronomy. Each dish pays tribute to traditional recipes, authentic flavors, and ancestral techniques, elevated through refined and contemporary presentation. We are also very pleased to recommend you the wine pairing experience, thoughtfully curated to accompany each course. This selection is designed with great care by our young sommelier, Khun Tong, whose passion and sensitivity help enhance and balance the flavors of every dish.
A very special thank you for your kind words about Erwin. His warmth, attentiveness, and dedication to service truly reflect our commitment to creating memorable dining experiences.
Siss Id , It was a pleasure to welcome you, and we sincerely hope to have the opportunity to host you again soon for another journey through the heart of Thailand.

reviews.name: Amy Ko
reviews.text: Good atmosphere in a beautiful historical building. Amazing food 🥘 by the chef and great hospitality from our waiter William. I wish you all the best and we will be sure to return when we are in town next
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Amy Ko, we are especially grateful for your recommendation to make a reservation. As Blue Elephant Phuket Town  welcomes guests from around the world every day, booking in advance allows us to offer the very best experience, whether for lunch, dinner, or one of our popular cooking classes, which are often fully booked several days ahead.
Our Blue Elephant Cooking School is much more than a culinary lesson. The experience begins with a guided visit to a traditional local market to discover the herbs, spices, fruits, and vegetables that are at the heart of authentic Thai cuisine. Guests are also invited to visit our Organic Garden, where our chefs carefully select aromatic herbs and seasonal ingredients used daily in our kitchen, ensuring exceptional freshness and authentic Thai flavours.
Dear Amy Ko, back at our historic mansion, the experience continues. Under the guidance of our chefs, guests enjoy a hands-on cooking class and learn to prepare four to five iconic Thai recipes before sharing the delicious meal they have created together. It is a memorable culinary journey into Thailand's rich gastronomic heritage and a wonderful opportunity to discover the culinary philosophy of Master Chef Nooror and her lifelong commitment to preserving and sharing authentic Thai cuisine.
We look forward to welcoming you again soon for another Blue Elephant experience.

reviews.name: Andrew Eldeiry
reviews.text: Everything from the food to the service and the atmosphere were amazing. Highly recommend!! We got the Pearls appetizer (tasting) which was a great decision, the prawn phad thai (biggest prawn I’ve ever eaten), the lamb massaman curry, and the best mango sticky rice from our Phuket trip. Great experience through and through!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much Andrew for your wonderful review and for taking the time to share such beautiful photos of your experience at Blue Elephant Phuket Town. A picture is worth a thousand words, and we are delighted that your photographs capture some of the memorable moments of your culinary journey with us.
We are equally grateful for your recommendation and thrilled that every aspect of your experience—from the food and service to the atmosphere—made such a positive impression during your visit.
We are especially pleased that you chose our famous “Pearls of the Blue Elephant”, a  tasting selection of Blue Elephant starters and salads reflecting today's mood of the Chef. Khun Andrew, this culinary journey is designed to introduce guests to the richness and diversity of our Heritage Thai Cuisine, a philosophy passionately championed by Master Chef Nooror , who has dedicated her life to preserving and sharing Thailand's culinary treasures with the world. It is equally rewarding to know that you enjoyed our Blue Elephant Giant Tiger Prawn Phad Thai, featuring a fresh deep-sea giant tiger prawn from Chanthaburi, organic egg, ground roasted peanuts, and tamarind. As you discovered, the impressive size and exceptional quality of this prawn make it one of the most memorable dishes on our menu. This recipe reflects Master Chef Nooror's commitment to showcasing the finest Thai ingredients while honoring traditional flavors.
We are also delighted that our Lamb Massaman Curry met your expectations and that you found our Mango Sticky Rice to be the best of your Phuket trip. One of Thailand's most iconic desserts, it perfectly combines sweet ripe mango with fragrant coconut sticky rice. At Blue Elephant, Master Chef Nooror pays particular attention to the quality and balance of every ingredient, transforming this beloved classic into a memorable finale to the dining experience.
Thank you once again for choosing Blue Elephant Phuket. We look forward to welcoming you back soon for another journey through Thailand's rich culinary heritage, where every dish tells a story and where Master Chef Nooror's passion for preserving authentic Thai cuisine continues to inspire every member of our team.

reviews.name: Hanna Law
reviews.text: A fantastic dining experience with a high-quality set menu, excellent service from the staff, and amazing cocktails. The atmosphere is beautiful and stylish, making it a perfect spot for photos and special occasions. Every detail was well presented, and the overall experience exceeded expectations. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Khun Hanna Law,
We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the quality of our menu, the attention to detail in the presentation, and the elegant atmosphere of our establishment, designed to celebrate precious moments in a unique setting.

This menu showcases the signature flavors of our restaurant through a refined selection of creations, including Black Diamond Scallops, Doi Kham Eggplant Salad with Tiger Prawns, Phuket Fish Cake, Steamed Aunchan Dumplings, followed by the famous "Pat Pong" Crab Curry, Massaman Lamb inspired by a historic recipe from the Kingdom of Siam, Duck Confit Laab, and Phuket Melinjo Abalone. This culinary journey concludes on a sweet note with our Stars of Siam dessert, a tribute to Thailand's delicate sweet traditions.
Dear Hanna, the handcrafted curry pastes used in many of our recipes are made according to time-honored Thai culinary traditions and are also available in our restaurant shop.
We are also delighted that you enjoyed our cocktail selection. At the Blue Bar, our bartenders offer signature cocktails as well as creations inspired by Thailand's tropical herbs, spices, and fruits. Guests who prefer non-alcoholic beverages can discover a range of refined mocktails, fresh juices, and creative drinks showcasing local flavors.
We hope to welcome you back again very soon for another culinary journey at Blue Elephant Phuket. Town.

reviews.name: marco chau
reviews.text: Erwin, body and William treat us very well. 5 stars for their service, food knowledge, most importantly is their smiles. Also the food is very traditional and delicious, especially the soup, coconut with chicken(free range). Love it. Definitely will come back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you Marco Chau, for your wonderful five-star review and for sharing your unforgettable experience at Blue Elephant Phuket Town.
We are especially delighted to read your compliments to our staff. Your praise for their smiles, attentive service, and knowledge of our traditional Thai cuisine touches us deeply. At Blue Elephant Phuket Town, we believe that true Thai hospitality is expressed not only through flavors but also through the warmth, attentiveness, and friendliness shown to our guests.
We are also very pleased that you enjoyed one of our most comforting and authentic soups:
Maprao Oon Coconut Soup. A succulent soup made with coconut milk, galangal, and fresh young coconut, prepared with free-range chicken.
This recipe reflects our philosophy: preserving the authenticity of Thai culinary heritage while selecting the highest quality ingredients of impeccable origin. Free-range chicken is carefully selected for its incomparable texture and natural flavor, while many of the herbs, vegetables, and spices used in our cuisine come from the renowned Royal Thailand Project farms, established to support sustainable agriculture and the tribal communities of the northern mountains. Fresh galangal, aromatic herbs, and young coconut bring balance, freshness, and elegance to this traditional recipe.

We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back for another memorable evening at Blue Elephant Phuket Town.

reviews.name: Joanne Wynne
reviews.text: Me and my family had such an incredible evening at this restaurant, the food was delicious and presented beautifully. The surroundings were also so wonderful but most of all the service we received was so special. I would like to make a specific mention about our host Erwin, he was so friendly, kind, attentive and extremely welcoming. Thank you to all of those who made our night so special.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

reviews.name: Hachim
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic dining experience at Elephant Blue — a place that truly stands out in Phuket Old Town.

The restaurant is set in a beautiful villa surrounded by lush greenery, creating a peaceful and almost hidden oasis right in the middle of town. The décor is elegant and thoughtfully curated, blending Thai charm with a modern, stylish touch. The outdoor seating area is simply magnificent — perfect for a relaxed and memorable evening.

As for the food, the Tiger prawn Pad Thai was absolutely delicious — perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and easily one of the highlights of the meal. We also tried the lamb dish, which was good in quality and preparation, though slightly under-seasoned for my personal taste.

Prices are on the higher side, but the overall experience — from the ambiance to the quality of the food — makes it worthwhile.

All in all, highly recommended if you’re looking for a special dining spot in Phuket with great atmosphere and standout dishes.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much dear Hachim for your wonderful and detailed 5-star review, and for sharing such a beautiful description of your experience at Blue Elephant Phuket. We are truly delighted that you enjoyed the unique atmosphere of our historic residence, the former Governor’s Mansion, nestled in the heart of Phuket Old Town.
Our teams greatly appreciated your photos and would like to warmly thank you for your beautiful selection, which perfectly reflects the spirit of the house, the gardens, and the unique atmosphere of the place.
Our teams will also be very happy to read your kind words about the garden, the lawn, and the floral decoration. Every single day, our dedicated staff takes great care of the lush greenery, the peaceful surroundings, and the elegant floral arrangements that enhance the charm of this former palace. Preserving the beauty and serenity of this heritage house is part of our daily commitment to offering guests a truly special experience. We are very pleased that you enjoyed the Tiger Prawn Pad Thai, one of our signature dishes, as well as the lamb. The lamb is prepared with refined spices and delicate techniques inspired by Royal Thai cuisine, with a careful balance intended to highlight the natural quality of the meat while keeping the flavors elegant and harmonious.
At Blue Elephant, our curries are at the heart of our culinary identity. These recipes are family creations passed down from generation to generation in the family of Master Chef Nooror, preserving the authentic taste of Heritage Thai Cuisine with the same care and passion for more than 40 years.
To continue the culinary experience at home, we invite you to visit our boutique, where you will find a selection of chef-chosen products, including curry pastes, sauces, and fine ingredients. These products are distributed in many countries around the world and allow our guests to rediscover the flavors of Blue Elephant wherever they are.
We sincerely hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you again soon for another memorable evening in our tropical oasis in Phuket Town.

reviews.name: Amber B
reviews.text:
Blue Elephant turned a lunch for ten into something truly special. From the moment we arrived, Erwin — our remarkable host — made every one of us feel like the only guest in the room, memorizing all ten names and using them warmly throughout service. That level of personal care is rare anywhere, let alone for a large table.
The food is authentically prepared and beyond amazing — honest, traditional cooking with care in every dish. The space itself is stunning, and the energy around our table was pure joy: the kind of laughter you want to hold onto.
Blue Elephant isn’t just a restaurant. It’s where great memories are made and a table of ten can feel like family. Highly, enthusiastically recommended — go, bring your people, and ask for Erwin.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Khun Amber, thank
you so much for your wonderful 5-star review and for the beautiful photo illustrating your experience at Blue Elephant Phuket Town. We are truly delighted to know that your lunch for ten became such a memorable and joyful occasion.
Your kind words about Erwin mean a great deal to us. Creating a warm and personal connection with every guest is at the heart of the Blue Elephant spirit, and we are proud that Erwin helped make your table feel like family. 
It is also a pleasure to read how much you appreciated the authenticity of our Heritage Thai Cuisine, carefully prepared following the recipes and philosophy of Master Chef Nooror, who has dedicated her life to preserving and sharing the richness of Thai culinary traditions around the world.
During your next visit, we would be delighted to invite you and your friends to discover our complete Peranakan Menu. This culinary journey celebrates the fascinating heritage born from the meeting of Chinese and Malay cultures across the old trading routes of Southeast Asia. The Peranakan spirit is about sharing, generosity, family gatherings, colourful flavours, refined spices, and recipes passed down through generations — a beautiful reflection of cultural exchange and conviviality around the table.
Amber, we look forward to welcoming you back very soon to create many more unforgettable memories together

reviews.name: Steph G
reviews.text: This restaurant is an absolute gem! We tried the signature dishes (massaman lamb, chicken dumpling, Tom yum soup and foie gras) and everything was delicious. The presentation and flavor were perfect. Erwin was the most phenomenal host, he was very friendly and kind and made our visit most enjoyable. Thank you Erwin!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Steph G, thank you very much for your wonderful review and for sharing your experience with us. We are delighted to know that you enjoyed your dinner and appreciated several of our signature dishes.
We are especially pleased that you discovered our Massaman curry, one of the most emblematic recipes of Thai heritage cuisine. This dish reflects a long culinary tradition and, at Blue Elephant, it follows a recipe transmitted from generation to generation. For Master Chef Nooror, the art of preparing curry is deeply rooted in family traditions, where the careful balance of spices, slow cooking, and respect for authentic techniques create the rich and comforting flavors that define Massaman. The curries created by Master Chef Nooror are also available in the restaurant boutique and are today distributed in many countries around the world, allowing guests to rediscover the authentic flavors of Thai cuisine at home.
You also mentioned the Foie Gras, a dish that beautifully illustrates the meeting of Thai gastronomy and international influences. This special recipe was originally created by Master Chef Nooror at Blue Elephant Paris, combining the refinement of foie gras with the delicate balance of Thai flavors. Today it remains one of the signature creations that symbolizes the culinary journey of Blue Elephant across cultures.
Many thanks to enjoyed the Tom Yum soup, the famous Thai hot and sour prawn soup that was inscribed on the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity on December 4, 2024, highlighting its importance in Thailand’s culinary heritage.
Dear Khun Steph Thank you as well for sharing your beautiful photos of your experience.
We sincerely look forward to welcoming you again soon for another memorable culinary experience at Blue Elephant Phuket.

reviews.name: Wolfgang Klein
reviews.text: Like a pearl in the noise of Phuket. Amazing location to run away and enjoy the wonderful aspects of this land. Wonderful decorated location with a perfect service and a beautiful selection of the different tastes of Thailand, from seafood to all of the spices. Also they take care of every detail a foodjourney should provide for a guest. Definitly worth a visit if you are in this area and need some time off.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your poetic description of Blue Elephant as “a pearl in the noise of Phuket.”  Dear Wolfgang, we are truly delighted that you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere of our historic mansion and the culinary journey through the diverse flavors of Thailand.
Our team is deeply passionate about Master Chef Nooror, and sharing not only the dishes themselves but also the history and culture behind each recipe. Wolfgang, Thai Heritage Cuisine refers to the preservation of traditional royal and family recipes that have been passed down through generations, reflecting the richness of Thailand’s regional ingredients, spices, and culinary techniques.
This mission is strengthened through the collaboration between Master Chef Nooror and Ajarn Sisamon Kongpan, one of Thailand’s most respected culinary experts and historians. Together, they work to research, preserve, and transmit authentic Thai recipes that are part of the country’s gastronomic heritage. Their shared dedication ensures that these traditional preparations continue to be appreciated by new generations while maintaining their authenticity and cultural significance. To complement these flavors, our young sommelier Khun Tong has curated a refined and diverse wine selection. His collection features wines from Thailand as well as renowned vineyards from around the world, carefully chosen to pair harmoniously with the complex and aromatic flavors of Thai Heritage Cuisine.
Thank you again for your generous recommendation and for sharing your beautiful photos.

reviews.name: AlSharji Mohamed
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience at Blue Elephant Restaurant. The food was excellent, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. The atmosphere was amazing—elegant, relaxing, and authentic. The staff were extremely friendly, kind, and attentive throughout our visit.

A special thanks to Wrein Pop, who took great care of us and provided outstanding service with genuine warmth and professionalism. His effort truly made our dining experience memorable.

Highly recommended, and we will definitely visit again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much Mohamed, for your kind words and for sharing your wonderful experience at Blue Elephant Restaurant. We look forward to welcoming you again soon for another memorable dining journey.

ไปกับพลอย thank you once again for your trust and recommendation.

reviews.name: SleepNoMore S
reviews.text: I had an amazing afternoon at the cooking school cooking 5 dishes, I was the only student so I was lucky to have a private class. My teacher was very patient, welcoming and informative. She also cooked with me at the same time to demonstrate, instead of just telling me what to do.half a day course was 3800TB, including all the food I made for myself.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear " SleepNoMore S,"
Thank you very much for spending your afternoon with us at the Blue Elephant Phuket Town  Cooking School.
We are delighted to know that you enjoyed your half-day cooking experience and that your private class allowed for such a personal and interactive moment with our chef instructor. At Blue Elephant, we believe that Thai cuisine is best transmitted through hands-on learning, observation, tasting, and sharing traditions together in a warm and welcoming atmosphere.
Our cooking classes are designed to introduce guests to the authentic world of Thai Heritage Cuisine created and preserved by  Master Chef Nooror . During the class, guests learn to prepare five traditional Thai dishes step by step, using fresh herbs, spices, curry pastes, and ingredients carefully selected from local markets.
We are especially pleased that you appreciated the teaching style of your instructor. Cooking side by side with our guests, demonstrating each technique in real time rather than simply giving instructions, is an important part of the Blue Elephant philosophy. We want every participant — whether beginner or experienced cook — to feel confident, relaxed, and fully immersed in Thai culinary culture.
The half-day course also includes the pleasure of enjoying all the dishes prepared during the session, making the experience both educational and delicious.
Thank you as well for your beautiful photos, which perfectly illustrate your experience and your comment. They truly capture the atmosphere of the cooking school, the passion behind Thai cuisine, and the special moments shared during the class.
We truly hope to welcome you back soon for another journey into the world of Thai cuisine.

title: Makkha Health & Spa Chiang Mai (Ancient House)
ownerDescription:
Makkkha Health&Spa (Ancient House) is a spa in Chiang Mai styled in traditional Lanna Thai wooden houses. It is built from more than 60 years old wooden houses that have been beautifully renovated and decorated and filled with a warm and local Chiang Mai atmosphere through the spa in Chiang Mai via Thai Lanna wooden house style. Real teak wood is used to decorate this whole wooden house for spa chiang Mai. In front of and around this Chiangmai spa is a shady green garden and added relaxation by the sound of waterfalls around the house. reviews.name: Mayu G.
reviews.text:
I’m a loyal customer of Makkha, during my stay in Bangkok I visited their branches three times in a single week. I’ve always appreciated the warm service and consistent quality that Makkha is known for.

Unfortunately, the experience at this location didn’t meet the standard I’ve come to expect.

- My room was placed right next to the corridor, and there was virtually no soundproofing. Throughout the massage, I could clearly hear staff and customers walking by, talking, and organizing things, which made it difficult to relax.

- The room temperature was set uncomfortably low. By the time we finished, we had to take a hot shower back at the hotel to avoid catching a cold.

- The massage beds felt harder and smaller compared to those at Makkha Asok, and the face hole was quite uncomfortable.

- I also felt that the therapist wasn’t working on the proper acupressure points, and the shoulder massage at the end felt more like pinching rather than applying pressure to the intended points.

That said, the staff were polite and welcoming, and I still appreciate Makkha as a brand. I hope this location can address these issues so the experience matches the excellent standard of the other branches.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear C G,

Thank you very much for taking the time to share such detailed feedback. We truly appreciate your continued trust in Makkha and are grateful that you visited our branches multiple times during your stay in Bangkok. Your loyalty means a great deal to us.

We sincerely apologize that your recent experience at this location did not meet the high standards you have come to expect from Makkha. Please allow us to address your concerns:

• Noise disturbance – We are very sorry that the room placement and noise from the corridor affected your relaxation. We will review our room arrangements and reinforce noise-control protocols with our team.

• Room temperature – Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We will ensure that staff check and adjust room temperatures more carefully according to guest comfort.

• Massage bed comfort – We appreciate your comments and will inspect our equipment to ensure it meets the same standard as other branches.

• Massage technique –  We take your feedback seriously and will address the issue with our massage therapists. Your comments about the need for better training or hiring more skilled professionals are duly noted.

Despite the issues you encountered, we are grateful for your kind words about our staff. We truly value your continued support for Makkha as a brand.

We hope you will allow us another opportunity to welcome you back and deliver the level of service and comfort you know and love. Please feel free to reach out to us directly if there is anything we can do to assist you further.

Warmest regards,
Makkha Team

reviews.text: Excellent massage — it was the best one I’ve ever had in Thailand.

reviews.name: May Khyne
reviews.text:
Excellent service and Thai Massage! Brilliant! Ms Pat (Therapist) is absolutely amazing! Loved her massage and kindness.
The place is very clean and very professional too. Recommended to do 90 mins massage (1.5 hrs)

reviews.name: Ela Ballenas
reviews.text: Amazing massage, first time getting a thai herbal treatment and it was super relaxing. They allow you to shower before the treatment so you’re clean and ready to go right after. Would recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much 🙏 😊

reviews.name: Martha Wilkinson
reviews.text: A must do in Bangkok, I had Nuch she was amazing I reccomend so much. Had the 1 hour Thai massage, I would say go before bed as it’s the perfect wind down

reviews.name: Hana Ranšová
reviews.text: The best foot massage I ever had. You get jasmin tea, hot towel for face and neck. I really recomend this place after a long walk in China Town.

reviews.name: Norman Oehme
reviews.text: We had a wonderful traditional Thai massage at Centre Point Massage at the peak of the midday heat. It's a very clean and cool relaxing atmosphere within the premises in the middle of the Chinatown area of Bangkok.

reviews.name: MY Chong
reviews.text:
Pleasant and nice environment, the pandan tea is nice. The massage is good, I’m enjoying so much. Will intro friend and come back again.
And very kind and nice receptionist.

reviews.name: Will
reviews.text:
Perhaps we are tourist, masseurs are generally not attentive. My masseur was v bad till I got to tell her harder pls. 2 seconds later it was bad to the unfirm gripe and stroke. Can feel that masseur is waiting for time to go by. As I did not feel the comfort I went down recept to ask for an exchange. Wasted and waited for about 5 minutes. First poor massage maybe lasted for 5-10 mins. The new masseur was better but ended at the same time with my friend. Probably total duration is 60mins means in all 60 mins. The first 10-15 mins wasted for poor massage and looking for new masseur was just considered and done.

Thought my masseur was lousy. Friend's masseur was not too good too but she just kept quiet.

Internal deco is good. Aircon is strong. Lady Receptionist is good in English and Chinese and likely Thai. She proceeded to ask for an exchange of masseur without much question.

But likely they did not like us to use GoWabi.

2 stars for environment and receptionist. They had head to head customers but it really wasn't fabulous.

reviews.name: Moi Can
reviews.text: What an amazing experience! I spent the whole night wandering around Chinatown - this place is the best place to relax

reviews.name: Gloria Trinh
reviews.text: Great place for a massage after a long day walking around the temples right in Chinatown. Clean facilities and very nice staff :)

reviews.name: Rhys Evans
reviews.text: Did the one hour Thai massage and it was great, very relaxing and worth the money. Pui was amazing and provided the best service.

reviews.name: Keri Goad
reviews.text: I highly recommend visiting here for anyone, especially if you took a long flight to Bangkok. Every inch of the building and massage rooms are gorgeous and the services are excellent. I mean, you get tea at the start and finish. These are the little extras that also add to this experience. That and the amazingly kind staff.

reviews.name: Jomjai Kankrao
reviews.text: The massage here was great.I went for aroma oil and scrub very nice my skin very soft.They have plenty of choice for different scrubs, oils.Service is great as well.Everyone very nice and kind! Highly recommended 👍

reviews.name: Lukáš Dang
reviews.text: It was the best massage I have ever had. I felt completely relaxed afterwards. Definitely recommend.

title: Sense Massage & Spa Nimman
ownerDescription: ร้านนวดเพื่อสุขภาพ
address: 41 Siri Mangkalajarn Rd, Tambon Su Thep, เมือง Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXXC+7C Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Raphael Bartke
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience for all senses!

Aesthetically very pleasing and attention to all details. Service is precise and very pleasant.

You start with filling a form, where you define your preference and pain areas.

The chicken coup sauna is a stunning experience to get you ready. The body scrub wonderful with great natural fragrances. The warm oil massage calms you down.

Drinks and small snacks served throughout.

Another benefit: you can take a shower afterwards to be ready for a long flight.

reviews.name: Anna Suh
reviews.text:
✨ This was an incredibly satisfying massage experience in every way!!!!!!

The location was convenient, the space was spotless and beautifully maintained 🧼🌿

Most importantly, the therapists were highly skilled — truly professional and perfect in their technique 💆‍♀️💯

If I have time, I would absolutely come back again without hesitation!
This is definitely a place that deserves more than five stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐➕

reviews.name: russiangirl61872
reviews.text: Amazing experience! I had a lady named Pond and she was super friendly! I had an amazing massage as well as getting a scrub and chicken coop steam. It was so much fun and relaxing!! I would definitely recommend coming here. Very friendly and professional

reviews.name: WJ Ang
reviews.text:
Visited Sense Nimman Massage and Spa and had a disappointing experience. We paid for a 2.5-hour package, but the session felt rushed.
Total time spent was about 2 hr 55 min including waiting to purchase the package at counter as there were another group of 2 are in front of us, drinks(welcome and post treatment), changing, and bathing (shared 1 cubicle for 2 pax), which made the actual treatment feel shorter and very rush than expected.
Service flow was not well managed. We were served tea and slippers together, but before even finishing the drink, we were asked to move on.
Privacy was a concern. While my friend was still changing, staff opened the door without knocking when bringing me into the room after I returned from the restroom.
After that, while I was changing, they repeatedly asked if they could come in. Even though we responded “a moment please,” one staff looked in through the door gap while I was still changing. I signaled for them to wait, but within a few seconds, they started knocking again.

Overall, the experience felt rushed and lacked basic privacy. Service flow and staff professionalism need improvement.

reviews.name: 高橋麻美
reviews.text: Step inside outside of the hectic streets and it is true bliss. The spa is clean and everyone is super professional and absolutely lovely, especially the receptionist who welcomed me with a beautiful smile. The therapist was also very skilled and really hit those knots… needed another few hours but alas, they are very popular. The ambience, the aroma and service is like heaven! Thank you🩷

reviews.name: Waritsanan
reviews.text: Next time if I come to Chiang Mai, I will take the massage course again. Everything was perfect except some staff.

reviews.name: Tim Gu
reviews.text: amazing experience for the massage. I choose the signature thai herbal steam in chicken coop. That was the unbelievable experience to relax the body. Recommend!!

reviews.name: yahan huang
reviews.text: I dropped by at noon without a reservation and got a massage right away. The techniques were good, and the ambiance was lovely. However, I’d say the value for money is just average. The steam bath was overpriced—I couldn’t even last half an hour; ten minutes in and I was practically melting. Oh, and the restroom on the first floor is tiny and incredibly inconvenient.

reviews.name: miwako
reviews.text:
Sense Massage and Spa Nimman offers the best experience I’ve had in Chiang Mai. I’ve been coming to Chiang Mai for many years and tried many massage places, but this is truly the most skilled and the cleanest.
This time I took the 2.5-hour massage and jacuzzi (bubble bath) course, and it was absolutely exceptional. I’ve had Thai massage and oil massage here before, but if you’re going to come, I highly recommend choosing this course.
Pure bliss — every time.

reviews.name: Haze Ng
reviews.text:
it’s pretty new and the environment is nice. Price is reasonable.
Staffs were polite.
room to improve with mirror in the room to allow customers grooming up after lying on beds for hours
toilet is too small and strange that without running water to wash hands, just wet towel
massage oil don’t have strong scent of aroma

reviews.name: Kelly
reviews.text: Very relaxing. Really love the interior design here which is calming and very aesthetic. They will let u fill in a form to be notified any injuries and parts that want to be focused on. The massage lady is very gentle n attentive throughout. I felt like all my soreness from these days are all gone. Recommend!

reviews.name: Sharmaine Koh
reviews.text:
I’ve been disappointed at several massage parlours I’ve been to in the last couple of months but Sense REALLY hit the spot 😭 Was in Chiang Mai for the Inthanon 20 trail run and got completely destroyed by the hills - so I opted for a 1h foot massage, and somehow got way more than I bargained for.

This is the first foot massage I ever got LYING DOWN, and in addition to a foot massage, my lovely masseuse (La - I’m so sorry I don’t know how to spell her name 😭) also helped stretch all my limbs, crack my back, and a short head/shoulder massage is included! I was so surprised I nearly left before the massage was over when she left to wash her hands.

The ambience and decor was 100/100, super clean, so beautiful, the staff were so kind, and La was small talking with me about her 30 years of experience in the industry (SHE’S SO AMAZING), PLEASE drop by this spot if you’re in Chiang Mai. And the foot massage is perfect for anyone who’s in the national parks for trail runs or hikes. I actually was sore-muscle-free for the rest of the day, which is a miracle. Thank you so much to La and everybody at Sense Massage for the amazing experience!

reviews.name: Дарима Цыремпилова
reviews.text:
The place itself is absolutely stunning, very relaxing, chic, but also natural and beautiful designed.
Unfortunately can not value the quality of massage at the same level, my masseuse was incredibly in distress, her movements were so chaotic, like she didn't really know what she was doing, not bad, but not peaceful experience at all, despite the music and surroundings.
Unfortunately can not recommend the quality massage here.

reviews.name: Sunisa Sawawasu
reviews.text: The massage was excellent and incredibly relaxing! They welcomed me with a refreshing drink and started with a soothing foot massage, which made the experience even more special. After the massage, I enjoyed a cup of hot tea, leaving me feeling completely rejuvenated. Highly recommend for anyone looking to unwind!

reviews.name: Zoey D
reviews.text: Sense has always offered great experience. On top of that, masseuse Dada is amazing! Just had a 90 minutes oil massage today. And her touch is firm yet gentle. I don’t usually fall asleep during massage but I had a good nap today:)

reviews.name: Mark Pitts
reviews.text:
We like this new spa in the Nimmenhamen area. I had to give it four stars instead of 5 for two reasons.
One, my wife had a few ”hiccups” during her 3 1/2 hour session, and her therapist seemed unapologetic and not very nice to her about the problems. It was not the best experience for her.
I had a great therapist for 3 hours of massage, though.
Second, they don’t take credit cards and didn’t inform us of that until we arrived. I had to run out to an ATM nearby to get the money, which wasn’t a good start. I believe that the other Sense locations do take credit cards, so I was a bit surprised.
Since they have only been open a short time, I imagine that they still have a few things to work out to make everything run smoothly and make the spa experience better for everyone.
We will likely return and try it again sometime soon.
Prices are higher here than other spas in the area, so check their menu for deals and packages.

reviews.name: Victor Lee
reviews.text:
If you don't have time to go for many massages in Chiang Mai, this one is surely the "must-go"!  It has set a very high standard of Thai massage with the comfy environment and superb skill from the massage master.

Don't forget to eat the sugar cane rice cracker served at last, it just marks a wonderful end of the entire experience!

reviews.name: Winnie Li
reviews.text: The place is very quiet and calm. We tried the chicken coop stream and herbal ball massage, so special experience, only can find in Chiang Mai, really liked the lemongrass smelt, feels so relaxing afterwards.

reviews.name: Brooke Dominguez
reviews.text: This massage experience was very relaxing and exactly what my partner and I needed after days of traveling. They wash your feet upon arrival and the massage therapists are very professional, often asking if the pressure is okay for you. I also really enjoyed how you’re welcomed with a drink and sent off with one as well!

reviews.name: W.W
reviews.text: The spa was incredibly beautiful and comfortable, the staff were super friendly, and the massage was absolutely amazing – I'd love to come back!

title: Kleines authentic massage
ownerDescription: นวดเพื่อสุขภาพ
address: 715 Rama IV Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: SamTraveller
reviews.text:
My wife and I went to Kleine’s Authentic Massage while staying just across the street, and it was perfect.
I had a 1-hour Thai massage, and the masseuse applied exactly the right amount of pressure. It was strong enough to feel effective but still relaxing and comfortable.
The place felt clean, professional, and completely legitimate, so no need to worry about any shady service or uncomfortable atmosphere like you might find in some other areas. This is a proper massage place.
The price was also very good at 500 THB. They start with a foot wash, and at the end they serve tea and a cookie, which is a very nice touch.
Honestly, we should have gone every day while we were staying nearby. Great service, great value, and a very relaxing experience. Also, don’t be stingy with the tip — the ladies work hard and definitely deserve it.
Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Colin Choo
reviews.text:
wonderful experience at Bangkok Kleines Authentic Massage. The atmosphere is cozy, clean, and truly relaxing — perfect after a long day in the city.

Special thanks to Fon, my masseuse, who was incredibly skilled and attentive. She has a gentle yet firm technique that melts away tension, and she checked in often to make sure the pressure was just right. You can really feel her professionalism and care throughout the session.

Making a reservation is easy too — just add them on LINE: @kleinesmassage. Highly recommended for anyone looking for an authentic, rejuvenating massage in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Desirae Johnson
reviews.text: Fon was absolutely amazing! This salon is across the street from my hotel so I gave it a try after a quick Google review search. Well those reviews did not lie. The place was very clean, service was professional and excellent! I walked in and floated out after my 1 hour massage. It was thee best foot massage in my life. Thank you Fon, I will be back! If you a looking for a wonderful experience, this is your place.

reviews.name: Nathalie Schneider
reviews.text: I had a full body oil massage and it was amazing. The best massage I had in Thailand so far. She knew exactly where to apply pressure so that it was still a good massage but didn’t hurt. Totally recommend

reviews.name: Ms Hasnawati
reviews.text:
Full body oil massage 90 mins + foot spa 30 mins…Very very good massage..recommend
( aom )shes good strong firm her massage technique very good..than you xx

reviews.name: John Blease
reviews.text: This is the best massage I’ve ever had in my life!! Went for a 30min foot massage, straight back in next day for a 2hr full body. Both incredible - great staff and hospitality. Loved it, highly recommended.

reviews.name: Anjeli Love
reviews.text:
Sure! Here’s a realistic and thoughtful 5-star review:

I can confidently say that the Thai massage I received at Kleine’s Authentic Massage was one of the best I’ve ever had in my life! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was warm, welcoming, and truly calming. The attention to detail in both the setup and the massage itself made the entire experience feel incredibly special.

Kleine is a master of her craft. She skillfully combined deep pressure and stretching techniques to relieve all my tension while keeping the experience relaxing and rejuvenating. I left feeling completely renewed—my body lighter, my muscles relaxed, and my mind at ease.

I also appreciated how attentive my massue was, constantly ensuring the pressure was perfect and that I was comfortable throughout. If you’re looking for an authentic and transformative Thai massage, this is absolutely the place to go. I’ll definitely be back and highly recommend it to anyone seeking a true wellness experience!

reviews.name: Mika Michal Schwartz
reviews.text:
I love this place,
All of the masseuses in here are professional, attentive and present.
It's clean, and have a quiet and pleasant atmosphere.

reviews.name: SK
reviews.text: One of the best thai massages. Clean, professional and friendly. Go before 5pm for a quite time. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: April Ridsdale
reviews.text: One of the best massages I've ever had. The 120 minute Thai and foot massage is the best and well worth the cost. We stayed at the Valia hotel and it was a short walk. Great deal and a reommended way to escape the mid-day heat.

reviews.name: SY LC
reviews.text: Worth visiting. Very clean, new and not dingy looking like the rest although the price is little higher. All the masseuse were good and attentive.

reviews.name: Bec
reviews.text: Tuo was wonderful in my massage. I highly recommend coming here after a long day of walking around Bangkok.

reviews.name: Rickard Shen
reviews.text: One of the few massage places that looked professional and clean. The massage was great and felt both soothing and loving, so an experience for both the body and soul.

reviews.name: Lewis McLaren
reviews.text: Best massage in Bangkok. All staff are amazing and friendly

reviews.name: Ella K.
reviews.text: A very professional and clean massage studio with fair prices. The room was set up for two, and there were clean clothes provided to change into. We really enjoyed our massages — thank you so much!

reviews.name: Charles Kim
reviews.text: I showed up without an appointment but they were able to book one for me.  The place was clean and staff were very friendly and professional.  The lady who gave me the herbal oil massage was fantastic.  She gave me one of the best massages that I will remember forever.  They served a nice herbal tea and a snack once the session was over.  I would highly recommend this place to anyone who is looking for an authentic Thai massage.

reviews.name: Robby Preugschat
reviews.text:
Small place with a coffee shop attached to it .. get a coffee and one excellent foot massage .. they know their stuff and are good at it .. foot massages are just wicked and well worth the small cost .. they know their Thai massage and are good at it ..
over a month period had several foot massages per week .. just perfect 👍
Recommend this place and their staff highly

reviews.name: Coral Jones
reviews.text:
As others have mentioned … this truly is authentic and highly recommended if you are in need of rejuvenation!

The atmosphere is a soothing balm. The environment is clean and the staff are very friendly, as well as professional. The chocolate tea at the end is also a delicious treat!

Excellent value and  some of the best treatments I’ve ever had!

reviews.name: daniel
reviews.text: I have to say I was very Impressed by the quality and attention. Was there with my gf and we both had great experienced women who worked us really well. Place is clean with peaceful atmosphere. They are changing sheets after use which is great  Went there twice and will come back again. One hour oil massage was 800. Worth to pay a bit extra for sure.

reviews.name: Kristi Love
reviews.text: The best Thai massage in Bangkok!! Wonderful ambiance, very clean, and everyone is so nice. Worth every penny! Completely upgraded experience compared to others. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Eon Wang
reviews.text:
A very pleasant spa experience in Chiang Mai Old City. The space feels calm, clean, and well designed, with warm lighting, wood details, and a relaxing atmosphere from the moment you walk in.

The massage was comfortable and more on the gentle, relaxing side rather than very strong pressure. The whole process felt well organized, and the staff were polite and attentive. I also appreciated the tea service and the mango sticky rice after the treatment, which was a lovely little touch.

It is more expensive than a simple local massage shop, but the overall environment and service make it feel more like a full spa experience. I would recommend making a reservation in advance, especially if you want a specific time slot.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your thoughtful and detailed review. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere, gentle massage experience, and the mango sticky rice after your treatment. Your kind words truly mean a lot to our team at Makkha Health & Spa. We hope to welcome you back again for another peaceful and relaxing visit in Chiang Mai.🙏🏻🤍

reviews.name: Ann Bui
reviews.text: Makkha health and spa was over the top exceptional. We loved the cleanliness and the hospitality they gave us. From the time we enter to after the massage every thing was so well thought out. Thank you for your hospitality and service.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your lovely feedback. It means a lot to our team, and we hope to see you again.🫶🏻

reviews.name: Yong Yu
reviews.text: Pure perfection, beautiful facility and amazing staff, I really enjoyed my body scrub and Thai massage, ended with a mango sticky rice dessert as a wrap :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your wonderful review! We're thrilled that you enjoyed the beautiful environment, relaxing massage, and excellent service.
Have a pleasant day.

reviews.name: Tommy Ng
reviews.text: Cozy environment and the most important thing is clean!!! Very good customer services and good manner of all the staffs. After massage, mango sticky rice served, satisfied!😃
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for choosing our spa. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back again.

reviews.name: Bego Bernardez
reviews.text:
Had an amazing experience at Makkha Health & Spa. The place is beautiful, spotless, and very relaxing.

The massage was excellent—one of the best we’ve had. The therapists were very skilled, professional, and really paid attention to what we needed. We left feeling completely relaxed.

The staff were incredibly kind and welcoming throughout. They even arranged a car to pick us up from our hotel and offered the same service on the way back, which made everything super easy.

We were greeted with tea on arrival and finished with delicious mango sticky rice, such a nice touch.

Highly recommend—would definitely come back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review!

We’re truly delighted to hear that you had such a relaxing and memorable experience with us. It’s especially rewarding to know that you enjoyed the massage and found our therapists to be skilled and attentive to your needs—this is exactly the experience we aim to provide for every guest.

We’re also glad that our team, including the complimentary transfer service and our welcome tea and mango sticky rice, helped make your visit even more comfortable and special.

Your kind recommendation means a lot to us, and we truly look forward to welcoming you back again soon.

Warm regards,
Makkha Health & Spa Team

reviews.name: Sam Liew
reviews.text:
We had a disappointing premium experience to this branch during our Chiang Mai trip. We booked high-priced 120-minute treatments

· (120 MIN) AROMA OIL MASSAGE + THAI HERBAL BALL MASSAGE - 2,780 THB
· (120 MIN) THAI MASSAGE + AROMA OIL MASSAGE - 2,420 THB

Unfortunately, the quality did not match the price. The therapists seemed to be merely going through the motions. Despite my clear requests to focus on specific areas of tension, these concerns were not attended to. My wife had a similarly poor experience with her treatment.

While the environment, refreshments, and free pickup service were good, the core massage service was poor.
Massage Quality: ⭐️⭐️
Facilities & Service: +⭐️
Total: ⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback, and we sincerely apologize that your massage experience did not meet the premium standard you expected. We’re sorry the requested focus areas were not properly addressed. Your comments have been shared with our team, and we will improve our training and service quality to ensure better, more attentive treatments.🙏🏻

reviews.name: E. Lee
reviews.text:
I stopped by Makkha Health & Spa (Rachadamnoen) for a final massage before heading to the airport, and it was nothing short of perfect. I had a one-hour aromatherapy massage with jasmine oil, which smelled incredibly luxurious.

My therapist, Pang, had a wonderful balance of firm pressure and delicate technique — strong enough to be effective, but never painful.

The private room had its own shower, which was a big plus. I could freshen up before the massage and wash off the oil afterward (note: showers are available only with oil massages, other treatments may require an extra charge). The shower area was spotless and well-maintained, with high-quality amenities.

Before and after the massage, they served delicious snacks, tea, and mango sticky rice — a lovely touch that made the whole experience feel even more special. I’m truly grateful for such a relaxing and uplifting end to my trip. I’ll definitely come back next time I’m in Chiang Mai.

Also, they accept credit cards — super convenient!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review! 
We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed the aromatherapy massage and appreciated Khun Pang’s technique, the private shower, and our little treats. It means a lot to us. 
Have a safe flight, and we hope to welcome you back in Chiang Mai soon!

reviews.name: Sophia Off Duty
reviews.text:
The decor and environment are lovely, and the staff service is quite good.

However, to be honest, 2,000 THB for a massage is quite expensive for this area. I personally don't feel it's worth the price as there are so many other options nearby.

My therapist was very
professional and tried her best, but she had small hands, and I personally prefer a therapist with larger hands for better pressure. While the service was professional, I wouldn't return because you can easily get three massages elsewhere for the same price.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your detailed feedback 🙏🏻
We’re glad to hear you enjoyed our decor, environment, and the professionalism of our staff.

We understand your concern regarding pricing. Our rates reflect the quality of our products, trained therapists, and overall experience we aim to provide. That said, we truly appreciate your perspective and will continue working to ensure our services deliver the best possible value.

Regarding the pressure and therapist preference, we’re sorry it didn’t fully match your expectations. We do our best to tailor each session, and we will continue improving our consultation process to better meet individual needs.

Thank you again for your honest feedback, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future.

reviews.name: Sarah Eve
reviews.text: We have just been travelling for the last three weeks and this was the best massage throughout our entire trip, So much so that we had to go back twice in the space of four days. Would highly recommend!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review! We’re so happy you enjoyed your experience and hope to welcome you again soon.🤍

reviews.name: Judy Fung
reviews.text: Service, attention and all complete massage therapy was excellent performed
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for sharing your wonderful experience with us.
We hope to have a chance to serve you again.
Have a good day :)

reviews.name: Christine M.
reviews.text: A very relaxing massage experience. The venue itself is beautifully designed, with plenty of wood elements and a calm atmosphere. My Thai massage was excellent, the therapist identified all my tension points and addressed them effectively.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind review 
We’re delighted you enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere and your Thai massage. Our therapists will be very happy to hear your feedback!

We look forward to welcoming you again soon.🤍

reviews.name: Shih Ruby
reviews.text:
Very good experience of the Aroma oil massage❤️
It’s a very lovely place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you somuch for your amazing rating! We’re so happy you enjoyed your visit. See you again soon!🙏🏻

reviews.name: Maria Saba
reviews.text: This is my second Makkha experience, with my first being in Bangkok and my second in Chiang Mai. Both times I did the Thai massage, and both times I left feeling like I was floating. Plus such lovely facilities and staff. Would recommend !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Maria, Thank you so much for visiting us again and for your wonderful review! We are absolutely thrilled to hear that you had such a fantastic experience at both our Bangkok and Chiang Mai branches. Providing consistent, high-quality service across all our locations is always our top priority. We look forward to welcoming you back for a third exceptional experience soon!

reviews.name: Pek Yong Tan
reviews.text:
Good massage experience.
A bit more pricy but worth it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind review 🤍
We’re happy to hear you enjoyed your massage experience with us. We truly appreciate your support and hope to welcome you again for another relaxing visit soon.

reviews.name: Alyona Konysheva
reviews.text: Amazing spa! The facilities, the design of the place, the professional spa specialists, the products that been used during the treatments and a relaxing ambiance overall made my spa experience here unforgettable. I will definitely be back here next time I’m in Chiang Mai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for choosing our spa and for the rating. We really appreciate it. We are looking forward to seeing you again!
Have a nice day!🤍

reviews.name: Man Chaun Yuen
reviews.text:
Be aware!! They provide gifts in return for a review.

——

Picked the aroma oil massage, had better massages in the past. Also felt like the therapist was sometimes just pinching certain random areas to simulate the massage feeling but not actually putting pressure on the muscle. It’s a complete experience, you get a treat and drink before and mango sticky rice and tea after. Also the availability of showers is nice. However for me the massage is the most important part which they have failed to deliver on. For the price it’s definitely not worth it and recommendable as in the same area there are so much better places to get massages for much cheaper.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Man Chaun Yuen,
We sincerely apologize for this unpleasant experience during your service.
The team has taken note of the issue that was reported and will talk with the employees to find a solution.

We are urgently working to improve and train massage therapists to strengthen their skills.
We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future.
Have a pleasant day!

reviews.name: Carman Chow
reviews.text: I went with my daughter to this branch on 27 Jan.  I hv paid THB1,000 cash being for deposit.  Both of us selected 120 mins treatment n cost THB 5,360 which I paid by debit card.  I was realise the staff didn’t return the deposit to me after we finished the treatment. I sent them message about this matter n I’ve got a reply the staff returned to me when we arrived their shop.  I was wondering why they didn’t collect back the receipt if they hv returned the deposit to me.  I tried to ask them checking CCTV but they said the day we went aldy washed over.  This is totally unacceptable n pls don’t go this shop! They are cheating people.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Carman Chow,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and confusion regarding your deposit refund.

After reviewing the situation with our branch team, we understand there may have been a mistake in the refund process and a lack of clear documentation when returning the deposit. We truly regret the frustration this has caused.

To resolve this matter fairly, we are happy to arrange a refund of the deposit amount to you. Our team has contacted you to request your bank details so we can process the transfer as soon as possible.

We have also reinforced our procedure so that deposit receipts will always be collected upon refund to prevent similar situations in the future.

We sincerely apologize again for your experience and appreciate your understanding. We hope to have another opportunity to welcome you in the future and provide the service experience you deserve.

Kind regards,
Makkha Health & Spa Team

reviews.name: Ed Younger
reviews.text: There are so many choices to get pampered in this area of old Chiangmai - this is by far the best.  So relaxing and clean with excellent service from the moment you enter the premises.  They even pick up and dropped off to our hotel. Oh mango and sticky rice is a bonus!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We look forward to welcoming you again.
Have a lucky day!

reviews.name: Jung식하
reviews.text: I came here with a severe headache, and it was quite relieved, but it would have been better if they had used a wider range of techniques and a faster pace. I paid an additional 500 baht for a head massage, but it was so short and unprofessional that I probably wouldn't order it next time. The masseuse was friendly and the facilities were comfortable. However, even after requesting temperature adjustment, I was still very cold. The excessive use of Tiger Balm made me feel even colder.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear  Jung식하,
Thank you for sharing your honest feedback. We’re glad to hear that your headache was somewhat relieved.
However, we sincerely apologize that the head massage did not meet your expectations in terms of duration and professionalism. 
Your comments are important to us, and we will review them carefully with our team to improve our techniques and customer comfort.

We hope you will consider giving us another chance to provide a better and more satisfying experience in the future.

Warm regards,
Makkha Health & Spa Team

title: Holme Thai Massage (โฮลเม่ส์นวดเพื่อสุขภาพ)
ownerDescription:
Welcome to Holme Thai Massage! Immerse yourself in a rejuvenating experience with our authentic Thai massage services. Our skilled masseuse offer a range of treatments, including traditional Thai massage, foot massage, back & shoulder massage, oil massage, all designed to promote relaxation, relieve stress, and enhance your well-being. We pride ourselves on creating a serene environment where you can escape the hustle and bustle of daily life.
We recommend making a reservation.
address: 69 Ti Thong Rd, Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

reviews.name: Rohini Bhose Desai
reviews.text: We got the Thai massage. The masseuses were very skilled professionals and got the right knots and tension points! The place was neat and clean, and the service was efficient and hospitable. Nit, who worked on me, was very adept and knew just the right amounts of pressure to apply without overdoing it. (My joints feel like new even after all the walking around we did all week.) The tea and cookies after the treatment were a nice touch too :) The prices are also very reasonable. Will definitely come back here again.

reviews.name: Sam
reviews.text: Chanced upon this massage place as I was nearby and it turns out to be amazing! The place is clean and staff are very friendly and polite. Reasonably priced too!

reviews.name: Heather Konold
reviews.text: We just were in Thailand on a trip with friends and stopped by this massage place. It was actually our first stop after landing there. We loved it so much we came back 3 different times! The best massages and sweetest ladies. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Ac Chiang
reviews.text: So lucky to find Holme Thai Massage.  My strong  muscle has been released so much.  I recommend you come to try.

reviews.name: H TT
reviews.text:
This was honestly the best massage experience I’ve ever had. I went for 60mins full-body oil massage, and it completely exceeded my expectations.

In the past, massages I’ve had either missed the right pressure points or the pressure just didn’t feel quite right. But this time, everything was perfect. The pressure was just right, and every part of my body felt properly taken care of.

The staff were all very friendly, and the environment was clean, bright, and relaxing. There was even the sound of flowing water in the background, which made it incredibly soothing—I actually ended up falling asleep during the session.

Highly recommended!!!

reviews.name: Trần Ngọc Xuân Thư
reviews.text: Highly recommended for tourists who walk alot in Thailand to try foot massage. The skill is chef kiss!!

reviews.name: Sreesh
reviews.text: It was a divine experience! The masseuse Mumu has the touch of a grandmother, she removed pains and stiffness from my body which I didn't know existed. The atmosphere was very calming with dim lights and light music playing in the background. I recommend the 90mins massage where she really takes time to work through all the muscles and tendons. Definitely worth it!

reviews.name: Lindsay Konold
reviews.text: Just spent 2 weeks in Thailand and visited 3 times! We had a Thai massage and 2 oil massages. Both were fantastic!! The staff was so nice and easy to work with! Loved the sugar foot scrub before each massage and the tea and cookie after. Would definitely come back again!

reviews.name: Pablo Parra
reviews.text: I booked an aroma massage, and it was excellent. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a true Thai massage experience. If you’ve been walking around a lot while traveling, treat yourself—you deserve it. Excellent value for money.

reviews.name: Sam The man
reviews.text:
We took 1.5 hr oil Thai massage 580 baht

It’s not what I was expecting since I saw oil and figured relax and aroma kinda style but they told me in advance and I’ve like it ! Not too much pain and was good for the body so I will call it a relax Thai style with oil !

The feet wash was quality scrubb stuff and table with a hole ! Ac and good smell add to the experience from the entrance !

reviews.name: Ryan Konold
reviews.text: The staff was very nice and very professional. The massages were all excellent (I had 3). The Thai massage was a little rough for me--not because they did it wrong but because I'm a wimp and my body isn't used to it. The oil massage was much more relaxing.

reviews.name: yuki
reviews.text:
The place is very clean and comfortable.
The masseuse were all very professional and their massaging technique was so good. I really enjoyed my 90min thai body and leg session.

I really recommend this place. I will come back again

reviews.name: Kasia Holysz
reviews.text: I wanted to try this place for a while until I finally did! My foot massage was splendid and the service overall was top notch. I will be coming back as I enjoyed it so very much. The pressure was just right and my masseuse knew what to do and enrich areas to avoid! Fabulous! I will be back.

reviews.name: Irene Vicente
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve ever had! The women working here are super nice and professional. We did a lot of research to find a good affordable thai massage and this was a truly amazing experience. I highly recommend it to everyone.

reviews.name: hogual
reviews.text: "I didn't have high expectations since I just picked this place randomly, but it was surprisingly amazing. They focused on my stiff shoulders, and I feel so much better. Highly satisfied!"

reviews.name: Maya
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a relaxing yet thorough massage while in Bangkok, this is the place!

The team are lovely, professional and very talented at what they do. Opting for the 90 minute Thai herbal oil massage before my flight home was the best decision 😊

reviews.name: Artem Kovtun
reviews.text:
The best massage in Bangkok for me. Will come back again for sure🙏🙌
Clean, good service and cute owner 👍

reviews.name: napat wongkasetsin
reviews.text: Staff is very friendly and nice. The massage is cheap and calming .

reviews.name: Alistair Clamp
reviews.text: Absolutely best massage in Bangkok, came for a 90 min Thai massage and it was fantastic, firm but relaxing and their technique was phenomenal. Would highly recommend. Very clean and professional, they give you clothes to wear etc.

reviews.name: Matthew Theijssen
reviews.text: Wonderful massage. Nit was super attentive and found all the niggles I was experiencing. The whole team are very kind and the atmosphere is very pleasant. We’ll definitely be back before we leave.

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience! The massage was incredibly relaxing, and the therapists were so professional and skilled. reviews.text: I had a wonderful Thai massage experience. The environment was clean, peaceful, and relaxing, with a calming atmosphere throughout. I highly recommend this place.

reviews.name: Maxe millus
reviews.text:
If you’re staying at G Nimman, Retreat Nimman is a must-visit—it's just a one-minute walk away and easily offers one of the best massages in the area. The pricing is incredibly reasonable and right in line with nearby shops, but the service feels far more premium.
The experience was seamless from start to finish. The receptionists were warm and professional, clearly explaining the packages and offering great personal recommendations. I started with a refreshing welcome drink and a luxurious warm foot soak, followed by an incredible full-body oil massage that melted away every bit of the day’s stress. To top it all off, they served a delicious dessert and warm tea, which was the perfect "cherry on top" to a flawless session. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a high-quality escape!

reviews.text: The massage here is absolutely amazing! My body has never felt this relaxed before 💖 The staff are incredibly accommodating and helpful in every way 🥰 I loved my experience here. 999999/10 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We truly appreciate your lovely feedback. It’s wonderful to know that you enjoyed our service and atmosphere. We hope you’ll come back again soon😊

reviews.name: Akkaraya Sawaengha
