title: BRADBURY・Bradbury / World’s Noisiest Massage / Massage Shop
ownerDescription:
BRADBURY, “the world’s loudest massage,” in Ekkamai, Bangkok, blends full LED lights, powerful sound, and authentic Thai massage for a one-of-a-kind experience. The popular Four-Hand massage, with two therapists at once, relaxes you from head to toe while you enjoy music, lights, and live shows. Complimentary slushies, soft-serve, and limited gifts make it even more unforgettable.
BRADBURY・ブラッドバリー / 世界一うるさいマッサージは、バンコク・エカマイ（トンロー至近）にある、新感覚のリラクゼーション＆ナイトライフスポットです。天井・壁一面を覆うフルLEDと迫力のサウンド、日本人監修の本格タイマッサージが融合し、他では味わえない唯一無二の体験をお届けします。特に人気の「フォーハンド（2人同時施術）」は、足から頭・肩・上半身までを贅沢にほぐしながら、光と音楽のエンターテインメントを満喫。施術中にはショーやダンスもあり、インスタ映えも抜群。くつろぎつつエンタメを楽しめる特別空間も魅力です。施術後には無料のスラッシー＆アイスソフトクリームを提供し、来店記念のオリジナルサンダルやライトバンド（数量限定）もプレゼント。バンコクで非日常のマッサージを楽しむならBRADBURYへ。
address: 1221/6 Sukhumvit 61, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: You K
reviews.text:
If you walk straight from Ekkamai BTS for about five minutes, you’ll see a very colorful building ahead of you. And once you step inside… well, “colorful” becomes a serious understatement.

I went in the middle of the day, and perhaps everyone was on a break because the place was completely empty. I peeked inside, and eventually someone who didn’t look particularly thrilled to see me appeared. I gave my reservation name, took off my shoes, chose the color of my flip-flops, and they put my belongings into a box.

Then came the experience.

First, I sat on a huge golden chair that looked like it belonged to some kind of king while they washed my feet. Then, for reasons I still don’t fully understand, I was required to take a photo in a golden tuk-tuk. I was there alone, so this was slightly awkward. Apparently, however, the photo was an essential part of the journey and there was no moving forward without it. I honestly wished one of the staff had just jumped into the picture with me!

After waiting for a while, suddenly a huge gong was struck as if a major show was about to begin, and I was taken up to the third floor.

The projection mapping was genuinely impressive and transformed the whole room into different scenes. As entertainment, it was very well done. I chose the massage pressure and a drink, and the concept seemed to be that you sit on the sofa, the show begins, and your massage starts at the same time.

However, before I even sat down, there were already two extremely enthusiastic people there. I’m still not sure whether they were customers, friends of someone working there, or what exactly was going on. The dancers and staff seemed much more focused on entertaining those two, everyone was screaming and having a fantastic time together, and I basically felt like I had accidentally walked into someone else’s private party. 😂

As advertised as “the world’s loudest massage,” yes, it is LOUD. There was music blasting and dancing happening right in front of me. At first, even the massage was being performed to the beat of the music, which honestly irritated me a little. I came for a massage, not choreography.

Thankfully, the dancing only lasted around 10 minutes. Once the dancers disappeared and only the projection mapping remained, the massage became a normal massage — and actually, it was very good. The therapist was skilled and I really enjoyed that part.

The mysterious two-person party also disappeared fairly quickly after all the dancing, so to this day I have absolutely no idea what that was about.

After the massage, you go back downstairs and receive ice cream. You also get to keep the flip-flops you chose at the beginning, which is a nice little souvenir.

Overall, it’s definitely an unusual experience and there are some genuinely impressive entertainment elements. But between the awkward solo tuk-tuk photo, the mysterious private-party atmosphere, and feeling rather left out of the main excitement, my experience was a bit too strange for me.

I can now officially say I have experienced “the world’s loudest massage.”

Once was enough.

ไม่มีนวด คอ บ่า หัว เหมือนร้านอื่นๆ ร้านนี้เป็นร้านแรกที่เจอแบบนี้ เคยใช้บริการหลายที่เหมือนกันแทบจะทุกร้าน  เก้าอี้นวดไม่เห็นนอนนวดเป็นฟูกเรียงกันหลายเตียงมีแค่ม่านกั้น หน้าเคาเตอร์คุยเสียงดัง ไม่ผ่อนคลาย รบกวนลูกค้า พนักงานงานนวด ดีเงียบ ไม่คุย
reviews.textTranslated:
The foot massage was okay, I didn't specify where to focus, and there was no foot washing, just a warm towel to wipe my feet.
There was no neck, shoulder, or head massage like other shops. This is the first shop I've encountered like this. I've used many places before, almost every shop has had this kind of massage. The massage chairs weren't actually massages; they were just mattresses lined up with only curtains separating them. The people at the counter were talking loudly, which wasn't relaxing and disturbed customers. The massage therapists themselves were quiet and didn't talk.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณที่มาใช้บริการค่ะ

reviews.name: K
reviews.text: นวดดีมากๆๆๆๆ แนะนำเลย วันนี้มานวดไทยออย 1.30ชม ราคา600 บาท ซื้อเเพคเกจ 5000 เเถม 1000 บาท คุ้มมากๆ มีที่จอดกันฝนด้วย แนะนำพี่โบตั๋น ค่า
reviews.textTranslated: The massage was amazing! Highly recommend. Today I had a 1.30 hour Thai oil massage for 600 baht. I bought a package for 5000 baht and got a 1000 baht discount – super worth it! There's also covered parking. I highly recommend Botan.

reviews.name: llMaMuSiCll
reviews.text: ชาเย็นดี ทำถึง ครัวซองอร่อย หอมมากๆ ขนมปอเปี๊ยะสูตรคุณแม่ แจ่มมาก
reviews.textTranslated: The iced tea is good and well-made. The croissants are delicious and very fragrant. The spring rolls, made with mom's recipe, are fantastic.

reviews.name: Golffy Lifestyle
reviews.text: ร้านนวดอยู่หัวมุมพอดีมีที่จอดรถบริการลูกค้า
reviews.textTranslated: The massage shop is right on the corner and has parking available for customers.

reviews.name: Poy Wantinee
reviews.text: ร้านนี้นวดดีมากค่ะ ขนาดย้ายบ้านไกลจากร้านนวดนี้แล้ว ยังต้องกลับมานวด พี่ๆหมอนวด นวดดีมากๆค่ะ สถานที่สะอาดมีที่จอดรถ แนะนำให้จองล่วงหน้าก่อนไปนะคะ
reviews.textTranslated: This massage shop is very good. Even though I moved far from this massage shop, I still come back for a massage. The masseuses are very good. The place is clean and has parking. I recommend booking in advance before going.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากค่ะ มีโอกาสแวะมาใช้บริการอีกครั้งนะคะ

reviews.name: sirinan asingsamanan
reviews.text: ดีมากก สบายตัวสุด น้ำหนักนวดดี พี่หมอนวดใส่ใจถามว่าเจ็บมั้ย (คงเห็นว่าเราอาจจะไม่ไหวในบางจุด) บรรยากาศร้านดี สะอาด สบาย ผ่อนคลาย
reviews.textTranslated: Excellent! So relaxing. The massage pressure was perfect. The masseuse was attentive and asked if I was in pain (probably noticed I might not be able to handle certain spots). The shop atmosphere was nice, clean, comfortable, and relaxing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณคุณลูกค้านะคะ ยินดีให้บริการค่ะ

reviews.name: Su P.
reviews.text: ร้านนวดใกล้บ้าน​ สะอาด​ บริการดี​ นวดดีสบายๆ​สะสวด​ มีที่จอดรถ​ 👍👍เยี่ยมๆค่ะะ​แนะนำ
reviews.textTranslated: Massage shop near my house. Clean, good service, great and relaxing massage. Convenient location. Parking available. 👍👍 Excellent! Highly recommend.

reviews.name: ปาลิลน์อินฟูล
reviews.text: ถ้าปวดเมื่อยจะทนไปทำไม ในเมื่อร้านนวดก็ไกล้บ้านไปเลยซิค่ะ ร้านไม่ใหญ่มากที่จอดรถยนต์น้อยแต่เรานั่งวินไปเลยไม่ใช่ปัญหา😄 โทรไปถามก่อนว่ามีคิวว่างมั๊ย walk in เข้าไปตอนนี้ได้หรือเปล่าน้องที่รับสายบอกได้ ไปถึงก็เลือกคอบ่าไหล่1ชม. ราคา 350 บาท ร้านเปนเบาะเรีบงกันเอาผ้าม่านกั้น 4-5 เตียงได้ ว่ากันด้วยเรื่องฝีมือการนวดคือดีตามมาตรฐานเน้นดีลงเส้นถูกที่ปวดแนะนำว่าควรเลือก90 นาทีเปนต้นไปเพราะ1ชม.ไม่เคยพอ🤣 จบชม.ก็จ่ายเงินมีแอดไลน์ร้านเพื่อสะสม ชม. ถึงกี่ชมไม่รู้เค้าบอกไม่ทันฟังจะได้ฟรี1ชม. จบการรีหวิวแต่เพียงเท่านี้
reviews.textTranslated: Why endure aches and pains when there's a massage shop close to home? It's not a very big shop with limited parking, but we took a motorbike taxi, so it wasn't a problem 😄. We called ahead to ask about availability and if walk-ins were allowed, and the person who answered said yes. Upon arrival, we chose a 1-hour neck, shoulder, and back massage for 350 baht. The shop has 4-5 massage beds arranged with curtains separating them. Regarding the massage skills, they were good, meeting standard expectations. They focused on the right pressure points and relieved pain. I recommend choosing a massage of 90 minutes or more because 1 hour is never enough 🤣. After the hour, we paid and added the shop's LINE account to accumulate hours of massage. I didn't catch how many hours you need to accumulate to get a free hour. That concludes my review.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณคุณลูกค้ามากๆเลยนะคะ  ❤️

reviews.name: Chalinee Amy
reviews.text:
มานวดไทยที่ร้านนี้บ่อยกับนวดกับหมอพี่หนึ่ง นวดเก่งมากๆ ทั้งรีเล็กซ์ ทั้งนวดรักษา
ตัวร้าน - สะอาดสะอ้าน เป็นเบาะนวดแบบไทย กั้นม่าน อาจจะส่วนตัวน้อยหน่อยสำหรับผู้ต้องการแบบห้องกั้น
ราคา เริ่มที่ชมละ 300 บาท
หมอนวด มีทั้งชายหญิง นวดดีทุกๆ คนเลยค่ะ โดยเฉพาะพี่หนึ่ง ฝีมือดี หายเมื่อยสุด!
ที่จอดรถ หน้าร้านจอดได้ 4 คัน
รับ walkin แต่บางทีก็เต็ม โทรมาถามคิวก่อนสักนิดก็ดีค่ะ
สรุปแล้วแนะนำเลย 🫶🥰
reviews.textTranslated:
I often come to this Thai massage shop, especially with masseuse P'Nung. She's incredibly skilled, offering both relaxing and therapeutic massages.
The shop itself is clean and tidy, with traditional Thai massage mats and curtains separating the massage areas. It might be a little less private for those who prefer a private room.
Prices start at 300 baht per hour.
The masseuses are both male and female, and they're all excellent, especially P'Nung. Her skills are amazing and relieve all my aches and pains!
Parking is available in front of the shop for 4 cars.
Walk-ins are accepted, but it can sometimes be full. It's best to call and check availability beforehand.
In summary, I highly recommend it! 🫶🥰

reviews.name: จรรยพัฒน์ รุ่งรัตน์ธวัชชัย
reviews.text: มานวดร้านนี้ประจำ สะอาด บรรยากาศดี แบ่งโชนการยริการเป็นสัดส่วน ร้านมีบริการดีมากค่ะ หมอนวดทุกท่านนวดดีมาก สุภาพ เรียบร้อย ประทับใจ เป็นลูกค้าประจำแล้วค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I'm a regular customer at this massage parlor. It's clean, has a great atmosphere, and the service areas are well-divided. The service is excellent; all the masseuses are very skilled, polite, and courteous. I'm very impressed and have become a regular customer.

reviews.name: Nutjaree Boonyaudomsart (Pla)
reviews.text: นวดดีมากค่ะ บริการจากพนักงานทคุณหมอนวดดีมากๆค่ะ แนะนำเลย ไม่ผิดหวัง ราคาเมื่อเทียบกับการนวดถือว่าคุ้มมากๆค่ะ แนะนำให้จองคิวมาก่อนนะคะ ตอนนี้เป็นลูกค้าประจำไปแล้ว
reviews.textTranslated: The massage was excellent! The service from the massage therapists was superb. I highly recommend it; you won't be disappointed. The price is very reasonable considering the quality of the massage. I recommend booking in advance. I'm a regular customer now!

reviews.name: Niti
reviews.text: สะอาดมาก หมอมีฝีมือ นวดสบายตัวเเละใจ
reviews.textTranslated: Very clean. The masseuse is skilled. The massage is very relaxing for both body and mind.

reviews.name: Manusak Khamloi
reviews.text:
สะอาด พนักงานสุภาพ นวดดี
แต่อยากให้อัพเดทโปรโมชั่นให้ลูกค้าเป็นระยะระยะ
บางทีลด บางทีไม่ลด ลูกค้าไม่ทราบก่อนล้วงหน้า

แต่โดยรวมดี เป็นที่ที่มาบ่อยมากๆ
reviews.textTranslated:
Clean, polite staff, good massage.
However, I wish they would update customers on promotions periodically.
Sometimes there are discounts, sometimes there aren't, and customers aren't informed in advance.

Overall, it's good. It's a place I come to very often.

reviews.name: pakkanun intaravicha
reviews.text: จัดคิวแย่ค่ะ จองไว้แล้วพอมาถึงบอกไม่มีคิว นวดดีนะคะ แต่การบริการแย่มาก
reviews.textTranslated: The scheduling system is terrible. I had a reservation but when I arrived, they said there were no available slots. The massage itself is good, but the service is awful.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ทางร้านและเจ้าของร้าน ต้องขออภัยเป็รนอย่างสูงด้วยนะคะ ที่เค้าเตอร์ได้จัดคิวผิดพลาด  ขออภัยเป็นอย่างสูงค่ะ

reviews.name: Thaphanut Vimolkej
reviews.text:
นวดดี มีท่ายืดเหยียดร่างกายที่แปลกกว่าที่อื่น และตรงจุด

บรรยากาศร้านผ่อนคลาย สะอาด มีการกั้นห้องนวดและโซนนั่งรอเป็นสัดเป็นส่วน

การจองคิวและบริหารหมอนวดเป็นระบบดี มีให้แสกนคิวอาร์เพื่อสะสมแต้ม
reviews.textTranslated:
The massage is good, with unique and targeted stretching techniques.

The atmosphere is relaxing and clean, with massage rooms and waiting areas clearly separated.

The appointment booking and masseuse management system is efficient, and there's a QR code for collecting points.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากค่ะ

reviews.name: Kwanchai Khotyotha
reviews.text: บริการดี พนักงานนวดสุภาพ และมืออาชีพ
reviews.textTranslated: Good service, the massage therapists are polite and professional.

title: Unchan Health Massage
address: หมู่ ชั้น3 C. P. Tower, เลขที่ 313 Si Lom Rd, สีลม Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
street: หมู่ ชั้น3 C. P. Tower, เลขที่ 313 Si Lom Rd

reviews.name: Leslie Harriet
reviews.text: Many years ago I was introduced to them through colleagues and they never disappoint.  All these years the owners still lovingly manage this place (and still remember my name and my preference).  Every masseuse I’ve met has been kind.  And certain days I still see a queue of customers waiting for their favourite masseuse.  It’s always a pleasure to visit Unchan and it’s one of my “musts” when in BKK.  Just bliss….

reviews.name: Ashley C.
reviews.text:
I’ve been here a few times before and usually had good experiences. Unfortunately, my most recent visit was really disappointing because I was assigned a very bad massage therapist.
She was quite unprofessional and pressed the wrong areas several times. The massage was not relaxing at all, and I had to ask her to stop a few times because what she was doing was uncomfortable. Her touch was very rough, when I needed to change positions, she moved my leg very suddenly and forcefully, unlike other therapists here who are usually gentle and guide you slowly. At one point, she even had to press on my back to help herself stand up from the bed….

reviews.name: Kaia Nguyen
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the massage here. The techniques are very professional, the prices are reasonable, and this will likely become my favorite massage place in Thailand. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Jean Kraus
reviews.text: I just got an hour head/shoulder/ neck massage at this location. Very good! It’s above 7/11  , go up escalator on the third floor. Easy to find! Great prices!

reviews.name: AYMERIC LACROIX
reviews.text: A hidden gem in CP tower for massage. Masseuses are highly skilled and the techniques used are some of the best in Bangkok. Quiet and nice place to go for a relaxed afternoon. Please call to book in advance.

reviews.name: Mai Supnithi
reviews.text: A Thai massage place in CP building. Pretty good masseur to relieve office syndrome. The masseur quality is 3.5 out of 5.

reviews.name: Joanna Kim
reviews.text: I called to make our reservation. We tried foot massage and thai massage. The second day was supposed to be head/neck/shoulder but we ended up getting the thai massage for some reason 🤷🏻‍♀️ They were both very good. I would have returned if we stayed nearby longer. Of note, my partner developed moderate allergic reaction after the massage, although I was totally fine.

reviews.name: Ilaria Najim
reviews.text: I came here without a reservation so we had to wait 40 min before our massage. We got neck and shoulder and feet massage and both were nice. The ladies that work there use a lot of strength on your nerves so if you’re not used to that kind of massage you might feel a bit painful. The place has a wonderful smell of balsamic oil, with soft lights, price for 30 min massage 200 baht each (around 5.50 euro) which is a bit more expansive than other places, but still cheap compared to Europe prices!

reviews.name: kim야바바
reviews.text:
It was one of the best massage parlors in Bangkok I've been to.
First of all, the skills of the masseuses are above intermediate level.
The boss also seems to be very meticulous about the masseuses.
If you order 90 minutes, the service is fully filled without wasting a bit.
It is one of the few massage parlors where you can fully enjoy 90 minutes. The 120 baht tip is not worth it at all.
I highly recommend it.

reviews.name: Joan Marie
reviews.text: We have been here almost everyday since we stayed in Silom for a couple of days! I can’t stress enough how skilled and wonderful the ladies are in this spa. I’ve been to several health massages around the city but our time at Unchan has still been the most memorable. You will leave the spa relieved and feeling like you’ve released 10 years of stress! We will definitely be back every time we visit Bangkok! Very easy to find too and don’t forget to book ahead.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks

reviews.name: 鄭翔元（Shawn Cheng）
reviews.text: Highly recommend massage location. Environment is clean, quiet and private. Better make a reservation before visit, usually fully booking.

reviews.name: ah siao
reviews.text:
Massage place is located in a office tower/mall. Went on a weekday afternoon and place is quite full with locals doing foot/neck massage. Price is slightly cheaper than other massage place.

Tried their body oil massage twice. First time was good but second time a different messue fail to press on the spots for a proper oil message. I asked for a change after 45 mins (took a 1.5hrs massage). I should have asked for a change much earlier. Anyway Tim took over and did a great job for the remaining 45mins.

reviews.name: Keef Chan Fitness
reviews.text: My fifth time. Never once was I disappointed with the quality of the massage here! Therapist was super skillful to knead out all the knots and aches in my muscles. Place may be basic but it doesn't matter when every therapist is so excellent!

reviews.name: Giuseppe Mayart
reviews.text: I recently went for a foot and leg massage, expecting a relaxing experience. Instead, it felt like someone just lazily applied lotion to my feet and legs. No pressure, no technique—just a half-hearted rub. It was like paying for a service I could do better myself at home. Total letdown!

reviews.name: Keith Keith
reviews.text:
A good massage parlour if ever there was one. The boss was amiable. The masseur, Mdm Rin really managed the strength well and pressed on the right points to relieve your tensed muscle and deliver pleasant sensory experience.
Nice ambience. Reservation is highly recommended.

reviews.name: Andrew Fletcher
reviews.text:
I've been living in Thailand over a year and been to dozens of massage places. This is the best massage I have ever had. Thank you, Unchan 🙏

Note to customers: recommended to call ahead to reserve your spot

reviews.name: Robert Woollard
reviews.text: Don't bother with any of the loud, street-side massages with touts outside in Silom. This place is a little hidden in a corporate looking building, but massage was fantastic, very professional and very well priced. Wish we had of found it earlier so we could have gone back!

reviews.name: Magdalena Boguska
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing service! We got feet massage, which included massage of calves and little shoulders and head massage. It was probably one of the best massages I’ve got and the prices are really affordable (300
Bhat for 1hr massage). It is on the 3rd floor of cp tower

reviews.name: Surasak Watthanayontkit
reviews.text: Previously located in Silom complex building. After Silom complex went on the big renovation (many years ago), the shop moved to CP tower. Good massage services at a reasonable price. It’s a good idea to make a phone call to book a reservation slot in advance, especially in the evening of working day.

reviews.name: Mike C
reviews.text:
Fantastic spot. A little hard to find. Go into the office/shops complex and take the escalator up to the 3rd floor and it’s right there.

Was able to walk in at 19:00 and get seen in 5 minutes for a foot massage. Such a hidden gem.

title: MANJAI SPA
subTitle: Manjai Spa & Massage 만짜이 마사지 マンジャイスパ&マッサージ มั่นใจสปา & มาสสาจ
ownerDescription:
Manjai Spa is located near central Sukhumvit,
offering authentic Thai massage by certified therapists.
We provide a clean, professional, and trustworthy environment with no adult services.
Experience genuine relaxation and expert care in a healing space designed for you.

만짜이 스파는 수쿰윗 중심부 인근에 위치하여 편리하게 방문하실 수 있으며,
태국 보건부에서 인증한 정식 자격 마사지사들이 정통 태국 마사지를 정직하고 건전하게 제공합니다.
정식 자격을 갖춘 전문가들이 운영하며,
퇴폐적인 서비스는 일체 제공하지 않는, 건전하고 신뢰할 수 있는 스파입니다.
진정한 휴식과 피로 회복을 위한
고객 한 분 한 분을 위한 힐링 공간으로서,
전통과 전문성을 바탕으로 믿음직한 서비스를 약속드립니다.

マンジャイ・スパはスクンビット中心部近くにあり、
資格を持つセラピストによる本格的なタイマッサージを提供します。
風俗サービスは一切なく、清潔で信頼できる環境です。
お客様のための癒しの空間で、真のリラクゼーションをご体感ください。
address: 265/2 Soi Sukhumvit 31, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Wilfred Spykerman
reviews.text:
Great customer service . I couldnt massage as they only had beds but the owners were very understanding.

I was served hot tea while waiting for my wife to finish her massage instead.

Owner is Korean so lots of Koreans came here. Was chatting a lot with tourists about the various places in Bangkok and was very helpful to other tourists needing some basic thai interpretation.

Wife praised the massage given . Hopefully I can try next time as I was too full to lie down for a proper massage 😅

Big signboard in front of the building so you cant miss it.

reviews.name: Ömer Faruk Akpınar
reviews.text:
This is my second time here. I came t9 this place because everyone was mentioming that it is a proper family place where couples are prefering to come and there is no funny business. I loved the service so much that I decided to come here again.
Before everything the cleaning is immaculate. The massage rooms have very convenient showers, wardrobes, quick charging points for your mobile and earphones. And there is a little ring hanging on the door so if someone enters or exist you will know. The staff are really professional and they are carrying that amazing Thai hospitality. It is not a price/performance place because you get way more than what you pay. With the advise of the previous masseuse I selected thai aroma this time and AOF did a great job for my stiffes muscles. I travel a lot. I came to Thailand maybe 10-15 times and visited many other Asian destinations. In all of these countries, this is the number one by providing real massage, super clean environment and detail oriented service. Especially for people who loves Thailand and wants a real massage experience.

reviews.name: Khady Faye
reviews.text:
After trying several massage places in Bangkok, this was by far the best experience my husband and I had.

The welcome was exceptional: water upon arrival, a coffee foot scrub, comfortable slippers, and tea with delicious banana chips after the massage.

The Thai massage itself was incredible. The therapists were highly professional, skilled, and very attentive to detail. The private room, the comfortable outfit provided, and the dim lighting during the treatment really made all the difference and created a truly relaxing experience.

We highly recommend this place and will definitely come back on our next trip to Bangkok!

reviews.name: David Alummoottil
reviews.text: I would consider this a higher end massage parlor and would recommend to others! We got the 90 min thai/oil massage for 1000 baht and was pleasantly surprised with the quality of service. We were able to take a quick shower beforehand and then changed into clothes they provided. They then ask what level of strength we'd want and they do a good job pushing your body but not making it unbearably painful. Also a small thing I appreciated was the bed had the opening at the end of the bed to rest your face in when laying on your stomach.

reviews.name: Jonathan Sun
reviews.text:
Second visit to this hidden gem in Thailand. The massage therapists here are highly skilled and professional.

No surprises that many Korean customers love this place and return here for massage sessions regularly.

The boss is also really friendly and welcoming to everyone. If you are looking for a quality massage in Thailand with great value then this is the place to visit.

You won't leave disappointed! 10/10.

reviews.name: Siri
reviews.text:
I had a 2-hour Thai/Aroma massage and it was absolutely amazing. The massage therapist spoke some English,enough to communicate clearly what she wanted me to do, and I felt comfortable throughout.

The massage itself was one of the best I’ve ever had. The therapist was very skilled and intuitive, combining Thai techniques with aromatic oil massage in a way that was both relaxing and energizing. I felt completely renewed afterward.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a great massage experience with kind and professional service. I’ll definitely return!

reviews.name: Travis A.
reviews.text:
Very nice, clean and professional.

I opted for the Thai Stretch and definitely got my money worth. My therapist was very strong and thorough.

Booked and paid in advance through the GoWABI app. No pressure, you can my discount code 'travis-1716046' to save ฿100 on your first booking.

reviews.name: Cinry Lei
reviews.text:
Hands down the best Thai massage I had in BKK so far. It’s a high praise given I lived here for 6mo and have treatments at least twice a week.

Very very solid in all aspects, can’t beat the quality given this price range. From service flow, environment, to even snacks offered at the end, everything is carefully designed.

Masseuses are clearly very well trained, great technique and very well-trained. Better than most more expensive places I’ve been too.

Overall a place I know I will come back frequently from very 1st visit. And will for sure recommend to my friends visiting.

Gotta admit that Koreans really understand how to do it well! (Disclaimer: I’m not Korean)

reviews.name: Lee heesub
reviews.text: It was an exceptional experience at Manjai. All the stiffness from gym is now gone. Will definitely revisit as many times as I can while I stay in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Michelle Lee
reviews.text:
Good place to go after a long day walk!

The store is clean!

The owner is a Korean 아저씨， very polite and gentle. The masseuse was very welcoming and professional .

I ordered Thai Massage every time I go.

Highly recommended!!!

Try to make reservations before going, sometimes they are fully booked !

reviews.name: Darina Todorova-van Dijk
reviews.text:
Great massages!
I got aroma therapy with hot oil and my husband a back a shoulders massage.
The ladies know how to do their job! Very professional services. Highly recommended!
Very good price.
A nice warm tea and banana chips are served after the message.
Useful to know: Cash only, no cards are accepted. There is an ATM not too far from Manjai Spa

reviews.name: NaMi HI
reviews.text: This is a massage shop run by a Korean owner.  He has a firm management mindset that values ​​massage techniques. I recommend that you visit once. And the name of the staff with fantastic massage skills is Pok.

reviews.name: Taewon Kang
reviews.text: Affordable prices, amazing massage, and a very kind Korean owner. Highly recommend! I’m definitely coming back. Special thanks to Mem for the great massage!

reviews.text:
Here’s a polished review you can use:

⸻

I had a wonderful experience at this spa. The atmosphere was clean, calming, and very welcoming. I came in with a sprained ankle, and Som did an amazing job helping relieve the pain—her technique and care made a huge difference. I highly recommend booking with Som if you visit. Overall, a very good experience and I’ll definitely be returning!

reviews.name: Kaan
reviews.text: I had a very good massage experience here. Interior is clean, the after massage drink is so nice. My following critic is for this region general not particularly for this place but it becomes a concern if you are willing to visit here: I’m quite picky about the personal hygiene and I don’t like sharing personal items like slippers with someone else so if you’re like me, bring your own and have the peace of mind. Otherwise the therapists are friendly, welcoming and they do their best to provide a nice spa experience.

reviews.name: Geo Martinez
reviews.text:
I live in the same building as this spa.

I have use this spa 2x since I have been here.
90 min Thai Stretch massage (deep tissue) and 1 hour Aroma oil massage. Both were great! I highly recommended giving this place a try.  Super clean and professional staff.

reviews.name: Preksha Bokaria
reviews.text: Felt more like a torture than massage! Kept telling the masseuse to reduce pressure but she reduced for 30 seconds and increased again. Worst massage experience

reviews.name: Jasen & Esther Brooks
reviews.text:
Amazing, honestly terrific!

I was in Thailand for over 12 days and had about 5 massages in that time, mostly from the conference centre where we were running a conference. We then travelled into Bangkok city for a small test at a new hotel, and decided to have another message, after seeing the really good reviews we decided to try it.

Oh my... They worked miracles on my injured shoulder!

When I arrived, I'd had 2 months of physiotherapy, 7-8 massages and was only seeing a small improvements... After one 2 hour session here, I had gone from half the range of movement with pain to almost complete movement, with a little pain. I cannot adequately describe the difference!

If we didn't have to fly home the day after, I would have definitely been back every 2-3 days.

reviews.name: Hee Kim
reviews.text:
Great massage place with clean facility and well-trained masseuse who cares about whole condition such as proper temperature and light while getting massage.
I totally recommend Thai massage which relaxes all of muscle and relieve stress with perfect pressure.

reviews.name: Wonki Jun
reviews.text: Absolutely love this place! Go get a Thai massage😌

title: Pookie Massage

reviews.name: Ivana Vukšić
reviews.text: If you want a real massage this is the place. Miss Pookie is doing this for 18 years and she knows what she is doing. I have my masseur back home for last 15 years and she is the only one ever that came close to his quality and knowledge about human anatomy. I'm so happy that I stopped by here before my flight. It made my travel much easier and pain free.

reviews.name: Brini Fischer
reviews.text: Today, the two of us went for a massage, one Thai massage and one oil massage. Both were excellent, highly recommended! The women were very friendly and immediately identified and treated any tension. A real insider tip!

reviews.name: Sara Camarero
reviews.text: I trully enjoyed my oil massage. It was perfect to end my trip in Thailand. The staff and owner were very kind and friendly. Definitely recommended.

reviews.name: Si L
reviews.text: Great massage at a great price. Lovely ladies!!

reviews.name: Alexandre Germouty
reviews.text: Just wow, I have tried other massage around the area, but Pookie Massage was the BY FAR, the very best one I had in Thailand. My body feels light and relieved from all the pain. Thank you so much for your kindness and your skills. I highly recommend this place, you won't be disappointed !!

reviews.name: Garry Ward
reviews.text: Amazing strong massages from Pookie and the other ladies here. Great atmosphere  lots of laughter! I've had Thai oil and foot massages, all very good. It might be painful sometimes  but it's that exquisite pain that leads to a great feeling of relief 😌  I've had a lot of good massages in a lot of places in Thailand, but I will always come back here. And Pookie is lovely!

reviews.name: Jasper Pearson
reviews.text: The best Thai massage I've ever had, and I've had a few over the years! 250 baht for an hour of intense massage, and a cup of tea at the end. It's worth the effort to go there even with the road works outside.

reviews.name: Tiana H
reviews.text: Pookie is so nice! We were there a couple minutes before open but she welcomed us in and the masseuses were there not too long after. Amazing feet wash and curtains for privacy. 400 bhat for coconut oil massage. Very worth it!

reviews.name: Zeba
reviews.text: I have been coming here for years. I always have the best therapeutic massages here! Pookie is a fantastic, well trained therapist. You just have to tell her where the pain is, and she treats it very well. The place is authentic and clean. I am looking forward to my next trip to BKK :)

reviews.name: H C
reviews.text:
I loved it here! The massage was very good and they are very kind, they gave me lemon grass tea and bananas by the end of my massage. It’s a very authentic place, not so touristy and they also do laundry!!!
A good idea to relax while you clean your clothes.

reviews.name: Valérie Larose
reviews.text:
Very kind ladies who give you the best care. 🩷 Many thanks to Pim who has given me the massage of my life! It was very healing and nurturing. If she was living in Belgium I would go back everytime I could afford a massage.

Thank you for your lovely energy! Keep it up over there! All the best!

Love 🪷
Valérie

reviews.name: Levi Seul (MoonCake90)
reviews.text: Great place to get a massage, funny and friendly workers who put a smile on your face. Had a great time, never felt this good after a massage. If my review got you to go here please show them my picture and tell them I will come there next time I visit Bangkok.

reviews.name: C C
reviews.text: One of the best massages I've ever had. Nice and clean establishment. Reasonably priced! Definitely give that a go when you're around! 5*

pookie was the nicest - such a kind and funny human being!
we also enjoyed the massages; if you‘re in the neighbourhood makes sure to come by pookies place, it will be worth it

reviews.name: James Walsh

The masseuse who did our massage was very experienced and flexible to focus on the body parts where we wanted more massaging and the experience was authentic. Highly recommended. We will definitely have our massage here again if we come back to Bangkok.

Very recommended!

The service was great, and the atmosphere in the spa was very relaxing. The massage room was private and even had a personal shower, which I really liked.

reviews.name: Lalita Kennedy
reviews.text:
I always love coming to ThaiThai Massage Tropical! The spa is clean, beautiful, and so relaxing from the moment you walk in. The staff are friendly and professional, and the massages are consistently amazing. Every therapist I’ve had has been skilled and attentive, helping me feel refreshed and renewed every time.

This has become one of my favorite massage spots in Bangkok, and I always make time to visit when I’m here. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a great massage and excellent service! 😊💆‍♀️🇹🇭

reviews.name: WENDY Lui
reviews.text: The shop is 5mins walk from Asok BTS, nice and clean environment. And the aromatherapy massage is excellent ~ Therapists Na and Ya have magic hands and great massage skills, my friend and I felt so relaxed after massage. Thank you!

reviews.name: Faraz
reviews.text: The best in town. As always I visit here it's the best and with real  professionalism. Very good and relaxing. It's really a true massage .

reviews.name: Kelvin Shi
reviews.text: We chose the Thai Body Massage, and it was absolutely amazing! After taking a red-eye flight, we were exhausted, but the massage completely relieved our fatigue and left us feeling refreshed and relaxed. It was the perfect way to start our Bangkok trip. The therapists were highly professional, and the whole experience was comfortable from beginning to end. Definitely one of the best massages we’ve ever had. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Federico Serafini
reviews.text: Amazing Thai Thai Heritage massage, definitely worth the money. People are very nice and friendly and the massage is great and helpful for some muscles and pain.

reviews.name: sharnell louis
reviews.text: I had the Thai Thai signature Thai Full Body Massage with Thai floral balm! It was a spectacular experience! I would definitely come back! It was a wonderful way to end my last night in Bangkok!!

reviews.name: Yiren Wang
reviews.text:
Terrible experience.
This is the third massage place I went on this Bangkok trip. I went to Let’s Relax and the other ThaiThai massage (the one next block actually) before this. So I do think I know what the whole process is.
I chose the 90-minute Thai massage and it was good from the beginning. Yet, when I started to feel sleepy and maybe fall asleep a little, I could tell she was using way less strength. Then later when my leg was on her lap, I could clearly tell she was only touch my lap, not putting any strength on it. After around 3-4 minutes, I asked to put more pressure and it was normal again.

Also she kept talking to her coworker during the massage which is disappointing. (I went with a family member so there were to lady in the room)

My experience at the other ThaiThai massage place was amazing so you can still give it a try! But just aware this could happened.

I know one person cannot represent the whole massage place, but I think ppl deserve to know that terrible experience could still happened even with a good rating…

按完以後隔天還非常痛，真的是氣到來留言…

The toilet is within the building where it is located. Definitely want to go back.

reviews.name: Travelling Darryl
reviews.text:
Edited: Two different massages.
1. Just had an amazing 2 hour Thai massage with Geng.  Asked for medium pressure and received what I ordered.

I have been a thai massage therapist in 🇨🇦 for 14 years and I would say he is in my top 2 male Thai therapists ever.

Great technique and lots of advanced stretching that I love.

Absolutely book him.  So good.

2.

4 weeks later, I wanted to try a ‘hot aroma (lemongrass) oil’ massage to see the differences to North American style.

Had this with the gentle and warm Ni.  It was a mix of Thai massage & Swedish massage throughout.

Even though Swedish is not my favourite massage ever, I thoroughly enjoyed the warm oil on my skin, the smell of lemongrass and the gentler touch for relaxation.

I slept for 9.5 hours after, so it did its job.

Thank you krup krup 🙏.

reviews.name: cindy liu
reviews.text:
I NEVER leave negative reviews, but this was a disaster.

My boyfriend and I booked a 90-minute Deep Tissue Massage with warm oil, costing around 1,800 THB per person. After reading all the great reviews, we were excited to try this place. Unfortunately, my experience was nothing like I expected.

My therapist simply did not have the skills required for a deep tissue massage. At end turned out she is only a traine for 1800 baht massage. She couldn’t locate the pressure points and mostly just applied excessive force, repeatedly pushing up and down my muscles in a very rough way. Her fingernails frequently scratched my skin, and throughout the session she seemed to be rushing through every technique as if she had a flight to catch. I didn’t feel relaxed at any point during the massage.

This was honestly the worst deep tissue massage I’ve had in Chiang Mai. ( we had hundreds of good massages so we know what we talking)

If this massage had cost only 600 THB, I probably wouldn’t have said anything. But at 1,800 THB per person, it’s more expensive than places like Oasis, Makkha, or dasy the famous places in town, yet the quality wasn’t even close.

Halfway through the session, I couldn’t help to asking my therapist whether she was actually performing a deep tissue massage or just a regular oil massage. She didn’t understand English and called the receptionist over. The receptionist asked if I wanted to switch therapists. I asked how much time was left, and she told me about 10–15 minutes. Since I thought there wasn’t much time remaining, I decided not to switch.

However, I later realized there were actually around 30 minutes left, after the massage, the receptionist asked for my feedback. I honestly explained my experience, but no solution or compensation was offered—they simply just apologized.

Charging such a premium price while delivering a service of this quality is extremely disappointing. I left feeling very let down, and unfortunately I cannot recommend this place for anyone looking for a genuine deep tissue massage.

My experience at Mookda Spa was absolutely next level  truly one of the best spa experiences I’ve ever had. I indulged in 3.5 hours of pure bliss, starting with a hot coconut oil head massage that was so soothing it melted all my stress away. This was followed by a full-body mango and coconut scrub that left my skin soft, glowing, and completely renewed. Then came the traditional Thai massage  perfectly balanced, firm yet relaxing and to finish it all off, a calming blow dry that made me feel refreshed and ready for the evening.

Mookda is more than just a spa it’s a true retreat for the mind, body, and soul. If you’re visiting Thailand, this place is an absolute must. I can’t thank the incredible therapist enough for their care and amazing work. I’ll be dreaming about this experience for a long time!

I booked the Loft Thai Signature Spa, and it was a thoroughly enjoyable experience. Although the therapist appeared petite, her technique was both strong and precise, without any compromise in pressure. The entire treatment was deeply relaxing and well-executed.

reviews.name: Bryan Amrabadi
reviews.text:
A Memorable Spa Experience at Loft Thai - Nakhon in Bangkok

Today, my wife and I celebrated our wedding anniversary and late honeymoon with a luxurious spa experience at Loft Thai - Nakhon in Bangkok. After thorough research into the countless spa and massage options in the city—rightfully known as the massage capital of the world—I came across glowing reviews for Loft Thai and decided to book their signature Emerald Elephant Elite package for couples. At $700 USD, it was their most comprehensive offering, and we were eager to see if it lived up to the hype.

Our appointment was at 1:00 PM, and from the moment we arrived, the professionalism and warm ambiance of the place exceeded all expectations. Located in a busy part of the city, the exterior initially gave us some doubts, but stepping inside was like entering an oasis of calm. We were warmly greeted, offered a refreshing cold drink, and given an explanation of the products used during the treatments. They carefully asked about any allergies or preferences, adding a personal touch to the experience.

We started by selecting our preferred oils for the massage before being guided to the treatment room. The setup was immaculate and inviting, immediately putting us at ease. After changing into robes, our session began with a 90-minute full-body scrub. It was pure bliss—I fell asleep twice during the treatment! Following the scrub, we had a shower and prepared for the massage, which turned out to be the best massage of my life. The skilled hands of the therapists worked wonders, leaving me deeply relaxed and utterly rejuvenated.

The final phase of our package was a facial and skin treatment, which left my skin feeling incredible—soft, smooth, and glowing. I lost track of how many times I drifted off during the session, a testament to how relaxing and enjoyable it was.

After the treatments, we were served delicious tea and sweets, a perfect end to the experience. As a thoughtful gesture, the staff presented us with a special honeymoon gift. I must give a special mention to Pan and Cat, the two therapists who looked after us with such care and professionalism. Their expertise and attention to detail made the experience truly unforgettable.

Loft Thai - Nakhon provided an experience I will cherish forever. I now understand why it receives such stellar reviews, and I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone seeking a world-class spa and massage experience in Bangkok.

Thank you, Loft Thai team, for making our special day even more memorable.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing such a detailed and heartfelt review of your experience at Loft Thai - Nakhon! We are deeply honored that you chose to celebrate such a special occasion—your wedding anniversary and late honeymoon—with us.

Your kind words about our Emerald Elephant Elite package truly warm our hearts. We are delighted to know that the experience exceeded your expectations, from the personalized service and calming ambiance to the skilled treatments by Pan and Cat. Your description of falling asleep during the treatments is the highest compliment, as it reflects the relaxation we strive to provide for every guest.

We’re thrilled that the facial and massage left you feeling rejuvenated, and that you appreciated the thoughtful touches, like the tea, sweets, and honeymoon gift. Creating unforgettable memories for our guests is our ultimate goal, and it’s incredibly rewarding to know we succeeded on your special day.

Your recommendation means the world to us, and we look forward to welcoming you and your wife back in the future for another world-class spa experience. Thank you once again for your glowing review—it inspires us to continue delivering excellence!

The massage I received was an absolute revelation, a masterclass in the art of Thai massage that left me in awe. Every touch was precise, every movement intentional, as the skilled therapist seemed to melt away not just the tension in my muscles, but the stress of the entire week. It was as if time itself paused, allowing me to immerse fully in this deeply rejuvenating experience. If you're looking for a place that doesn’t just offer a massage, but a journey into blissful relaxation, this is where you need to be. I walked out feeling reborn, and I cannot recommend it enough.

they provided complimentary pickup and drop-off service as part of package, which made the experience completely hassle-free and very convenient from my hotel. The spa itself has a calm, clean, and soothing ambiance, perfect for unwinding. Upon reaching the places, staff was very welcoming and I was served with a quick bites and a drink. They explained all packages thoroughly and gave me time to decide.

My therapist (Ms. Meeng, not sure if name is correctly spelled) was highly professional and attentive, ensuring comfort throughout the session. At first glance, I expected a very gentle approach, but I was pleasantly surprised by her strength and thoroughness during the massage. The pressure was perfect, and the overall experience left me completely relaxed and refreshed. The scrub was refreshing, the massage deeply relaxing. The facial treatment was especially rejuvenating and never felt rushed—in fact, it put me into a deep, restful sleep. therapist used very minimal herbal products but msaasaged face almost 45 minutes, rellay made remerkale difference on my skin. Everything was well-paced and thoughtfully executed.

The staff were polite, welcoming, and clearly well-trained. Overall, it was a premium spa experience that delivered exactly what it promised. I would highly recommend this spa to anyone visiting Kata who is looking for quality relaxation and professional service.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Your remarks about the welcoming and accommodating staff really highlight their commitment to providing excellent customer service. It’s great to hear that Ms. Min tailored your treatment to your needs, ensuring you felt comfortable throughout the session. The combination of the body scrub, massage, and facial sounds like a perfect choice for relaxation and rejuvenation.

I appreciate how you described the attention to detail during your treatment, especially how the facial left a remarkable difference on your skin and allowed you to fully unwind. Your experience of feeling well taken care of will surely encourage others to consider visiting the spa.

Thank you again for your lovely recommendation. We hope you have the chance to visit again in the future for another relaxing escape!

reviews.text:

The area is super quiet and welcoming, with much greenery around.

However, I didn't like the technique my masseuse was using. He was always giving a sign that he is tired by stopping and stretching his neck. ( I can imagine that they always overworked with such a demand.)

After the massage they offer the tea with a cookie. But the tea was also cold.

reviews.text: Great massage place. I came here twice during my stay. I had foot massage+food scrub, my therapist was very professional! Nice atmosphere with kind staffs!

reviews.text: Had an amazing experience at Kim Massage and Spa! The place is clean, relaxing, and beautifully maintained. The atmosphere is calm with soothing music and great attention to detail. Prices are reasonable for the quality of service provided. One of the best massages I’ve had in Phuket — highly recommended for anyone looking to unwind and recharge!

reviews.name: Natalia
reviews.text: This place in an oasis of calm and peace in the midst of the hot and busy town. All the massages we had were excellent, firm, skilfully done. It’s clean and beautiful interior. Would definitely come back.

reviews.name: Kristen Yang
reviews.text:
I noticed that they have quite a number of branches, and this number 9 branch was really aesthetic and spacious.

Foot massage: opted for the foot massage, and I was pleasantly surprised when they used a foot scrub to remove all the dead skin. As a frequent massage goer in Malaysia, I haven’t experienced foot scrub as part of the massage, so this was a nice bonus for me!

Strength: However, I felt that the strength of the massage could be improved as it wasn’t as strong as I’m used to.

Body massage: For the body massage, they led us to a private room upstairs, which was comfortable and soothing. I found that the aroma oil they let us pick wasn’t as strong - the scent wasn’t noticeable enough during the massage. (I chose lavender)

Overall, it was a pleasant experience, and I would give it 5 stars for the ambiance and comfort. Additionally, the staff were friendly and welcoming, which added to the positive experience. However, in terms of the massage + strength itself, I would rate it around 3.5 stars.

reviews.name: Jacinda Siew
reviews.text:
Therapist Fon is the most talented and skilled masseuse I’ve ever had in my life - considering I do sports massage, physiotherapists sports massage, TCM tui na etc very regularly at least once a week for the last few years all across Southeast Asia.

K.Fon combines active release technique, Thai massage deep stretch, deep tissue massage all in one.

I did a 1.5 hour Thai massage with firm pressure after tennis, my body felt completely brand new the next day.

Even my Whoop band recovery score went up into the 80s the next morning because I slept so well the night after her massage.

If you are a sports person and need someone to go deep into those knots, Fon’s got you! Cannot recommend her enough. (In fact maybe I shouldn’t recommend her so much, it’d be hard to get her when I need her) 😂 but honestly, she is super deserving of all the kudos!

The ambience, facilities, and all the whole service crew are just Thai-standards - 10/10!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We’re absolutely thrilled to hear how much you enjoyed your 1.5-hour Thai massage with K. Fon, and that her unique blend of active release technique, deep stretches, and firm pressure left your body feeling brand new after tennis. Hearing that your Whoop recovery score shot up into the 80s the next morning is such a fantastic metric and an awesome testament to her skill! We will be sure to pass along your amazing kudos to Fon. reading a review like yours will completely make her day (and don't worry, we'll always do our best to save a slot for you when you return) 

It’s also wonderful to know that you enjoyed our ambience, facilities, and the rest of our service team. Thank you for choosing Pinewood and for entrusting us to help you unwind and recover. We very much look forward to welcoming you back again soon :)

Warmly,

Pinewood Team

reviews.text:
Ambience wise, the place is relaxing and looks luxurious. They provide you with pre&post treatment snacks too! You should buy their cookie!

As per my experience, I held this place to a higher standard because of the “spa experience” however, the quality of massage was just decent. It didn’t stand out as my masseuse didn’t have proper technique. She didn’t massage my feet that much even though I highlighted that I want this area to be focused on. She was also a bit rough in handling the towels when placed around you. Still worth the visit!

reviews.name: Арина Костюченко
reviews.text:
The best massage of my vacation! I will definitely come back.

I would like to express my gratitude to the entire staff of the salon! I visited this place throughout my vacation, and I never regretted the time I spent there. It was not just a pleasant experience, but a true salvation after long walks and busy days of sightseeing.

I would especially like to mention the incredible staff. The receptionists always greeted me with a warm smile, offered me tea or water, and helped me find a convenient time, even when there seemed to be no "windows" in the schedule. The masters are professionals: they feel the body, perfectly choose the force of pressing and work with the very areas that require attention. The atmosphere inside is conducive to complete relaxation: dim light, pleasant music and fragrances.

Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Arina,

Thank you so much for your beautiful and detailed review. Hearing that this was the best massage of your vacation is such a wonderful thing to hear, and we’re really happy it left such a strong impression on you.

It truly means a lot that you chose to visit us throughout your stay, and we’re so glad we could be a place of comfort after your busy days. It’s especially lovely to hear your kind words about our reception team and therapists—we’ll be sure to share this with them.

We’re also so happy you enjoyed the atmosphere and that everything came together to help you fully relax. We truly appreciate you sharing your photos as well—they mean a lot to us.

Thank you for entrusting us to help you unwind, we hope to welcome you back soon!

Warmly,
Pinewood Team

reviews.name: Katherine Ghayle
reviews.text: It was my first visit here and I had a wonderful experience. The ambience is beautiful and calming — the moment you step in from the busy street outside, you instantly feel relaxed and at ease. We chose the 2-hour Classic Pinewood package, and it was absolutely worth it. After the session, we felt completely relieved, refreshed, and deeply relaxed. We will definitely come back to try their onsen next time. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Alfonso Guerra
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience at Pinewood Kata Onsen and Spa. We booked two hours and chose a full body scrub followed by their signature 5 step facial treatment, and it was perfect from the moment we arrived.

Tik and Arpa took exceptional care of us throughout the visit. We were welcomed with a presentation of the different scents available for both the body scrub and the facial mask, which immediately made the experience feel personalised and special. After a short foot massage, we were taken to the treatment room.

Everything was carried out with great care, professionalism, and attention, creating a very relaxing experience. At the end, we were invited to enjoy a hot cup of tea and were even given a beautiful handmade elephant as a souvenir, which we really appreciated.

We are genuinely sad that we didn’t discover this place earlier, as we would certainly have come back more than once. Highly recommended for anyone spending a few days in Phuket. This spa is an absolute gem!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Alfonso,

Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed and thoughtful review. We’re so happy to hear that your visit felt special from the moment you arrived and that the body scrub and signature facial came together into a relaxing and well-balanced experience.

It’s lovely to know that the scent selection, the foot massage, and the care throughout the treatment helped make everything feel personal. We will be sure to pass on your kind words to Tik and Arpa — reading reviews such as this one truly makes our day and means a lot to us as a team. We also appreciate you sharing the photos of the lobby, treatment rooms, and foot wash area; it’s always a pleasure for us to see the space through our guests’ eyes.

Thank you again for your kind words and for choosing Pinewood and entrusting us to help you unwind. Reading reviews such as yours mean so much to us! We hope to welcome you back again on a future visit :)

Warmly,
Pinewood Team

reviews.name: HappyGina Foodie
reviews.text: My day 3 in Phuket and the best massage so far (I had one each day minimum). Very relaxing setting and you can feel the vibes once you walked into the door. Quiet rooms too, good massage skills and very friendly staff.  Would recommend to visit (WhatsApl to book) if you're in Kata area!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Gina,

Thank you so much for your lovely review. We’re really happy to hear that your experience with us stood out during your time in Phuket—that’s such a wonderful thing to hear.

It’s great to know you enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere, the quiet rooms, and the care from our team. We’re so glad everything came together for a comfortable visit.

Thank you as well for your recommendation, and for sharing your photos—they really mean a lot to us.Thank you for entrusting us to help you unwind, we hope to welcome you back soon!

Warmly,
Pinewood Team

reviews.name: Νεοκλής Βασιλειάδης
reviews.text:
P R O F E S S I O N A L S!

The best massage experience me and my wife ever had in Kata!
We found this place from the reviews of other customers and all of the them were 100% TRUE!

We booked from the previous day to be sure!
The lady in reception was really good and explained to us all the details, the ladies for the massage were really professional & the place was the most beautiful, clean and relaxed you can find in Kata Beach.

Will be back for sure again during our stay! Congrats to everyone!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Neoklis,

Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a detailed, kind and enthusiastic review, and for the lovely photos as well! We’re truly happy to hear that your visit with your wife felt so special and that the experience lived up to what you’d read beforehand.

It’s wonderful to know that everything felt smooth from booking to reception, and that the care, professionalism, and overall atmosphere made your time with us so enjoyable. We really appreciate you highlighting both the front desk and the therapists, as well as the space itself. Knowing that you plan to return during your stay is exactly the kind of experience we hope to create.

Thank you for choosing Pinewood and for entrusting us to help you unwind together. We very much look forward to welcoming you back again soon :)

Warmly,
Pinewood Team

reviews.name: Fanie Simon
reviews.text: On my top 3 massage list of my life. Rung, the massuse was very experienced and did take care of the spaces that needed work. The space is beautiful. The obly annoying thing was a guy waiting dor his massage warching videos super loud on insta- I feel in a SPA space, the team should male the cuatomers aware to not do that there. You come and pay for relaxation and not other people terrorising your space with loud phone noise… exept from that the experience was perfect!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Fanie,

Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed review, and for sharing your photo with us as well. We are truly honored to hear that your visit made it into the top 3 massages of your life! It’s wonderful to know that Rung took such great care of you and targeted the areas that needed attention, and that you enjoyed our space.

We also sincerely appreciate your honest feedback regarding the loud video playing in the waiting area. We completely agree with you, a spa should always be a quiet, serene environment dedicated to relaxation. We apologize that this interrupted your calm, and we have reminded our reception team to gently prompt guests to keep mobile device volume off or use headphones in our shared spaces moving forward.

Thank you again for choosing Pinewood and for trusting us to help you unwind. We hope to welcome you back for an entirely flawless, peaceful visit next time!

Warmly,

Pinewood Team

reviews.name: Brian Yegela
reviews.text: It was an amazing experience. My wife and I did a 90 minute thai oil massage and it was very detailed and our masseuses hit every knot. We would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great massage experience in Phuket.

reviews.name: Tay Kai Wei
reviews.text: I think this is the first place I went that has 5 star rating and they deserved it. Overall massage experience is really good and professional, environment is really nice and the charges are very affordable, definitely one of the top massage spot in Kata beach.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Tay,

Thank you so much for your thoughtful review. We’re really happy to hear that your experience lived up to your expectations and that you felt it truly deserved the rating, that’s such a wonderful thing to hear :)

It’s lovely to know you enjoyed the massage, the environment, and found the experience both professional and good value. We’re so glad everything came together for you.

We also truly appreciate you sharing your lovely photos—they mean a lot to us. Thank you for entrusting us to help you unwind, we hope to welcome you back soon!

Warmly,
Pinewood Team

reviews.name: Kirsty Mason
reviews.text: Enjoyed my experience at Pinewood today with a two hour massage. Lovely surroundings. Reception staff checked in my needs prior to massage and then the therapist worked well with what I wanted, checking on me occasionally as we went. Good central location in Kata.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Kirsty,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us, and for sharing the lovely photos! We’re so pleased to hear that you enjoyed your visit and that the consultation beforehand, along with the therapist’s attentiveness, helped tailor the treatment to your needs.

It’s also wonderful to know you appreciated the surroundings and found our location convenient during your time in Kata.

Thank you for entrusting us to help you unwind, we hope to welcome you back soon!

Warmly,
Pinewood Team

reviews.name: TaeHun Kim
reviews.text:
The facilities were very clean and well-maintained.
Especially, the massage therapists were very attentive and detailed, so I was able to relieve my fatigue really well. I highly recommend this place to others too~!! 🙂

reviews.name: Wenqing Chang
reviews.text: It’s been very good experience and I do love the smell of the aroma I chose neroli and it smelt good. The 90min hot oil massage is amazing with good environment and a complete procedure from toe to head. Felt relaxed and comfortable afterwards.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Wenqing,

Thank you so much for your lovely review. We’re really happy to hear you enjoyed the 90-minute hot oil massage and that the experience felt complete and relaxing from start to finish.

It’s especially nice to know you loved the neroli aroma—it’s such a beautiful and soothing choice. We’re glad it added to your overall experience. We also truly appreciate you sharing your photos—they mean a lot to us.

Thank you for entrusting us to help you unwind, we hope to welcome you back soon!

Warmly,
Pinewood Team

reviews.name: Александра Брнн
reviews.text: The atmosphere is absolutely peaceful and safe❤️ love the place and will come back again (hope) 🙏🏻 thank you for my first Thai massage✨ I’m so relaxed and fresh….🤌🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Alexandra,

Thank you for taking the time to share your lovely review and for the photos as well — we always enjoy seeing the spa through our guests’ perspective.

We’re so happy to hear that your first Thai massage left you feeling relaxed and refreshed, and that the atmosphere made you feel comfortable and at ease. It means a lot to our team to know that your experience was such a positive one.

Thank you for entrusting us to help you unwind. We would be delighted to welcome you back again on your next visit :)

Warmly,
Pinewood Team

reviews.name: Laura Camacho
reviews.text:
I visited Pinewood Spa in Phuket and tried their four-hand massage. It was a very relaxing and enjoyable experience. The two therapists worked in perfect synchronization, which made the massage feel unique and more immersive than a regular one. The pressure was well-balanced, and I left feeling refreshed and completely relaxed.
The atmosphere of the spa was calm and pleasant, adding to the overall experience. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to try a four-hand massage in Phuket.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Laura,

Thank you so much for your thoughtful review. We’re really happy to hear you enjoyed the four-hand massage—it’s such a unique experience, and it’s lovely to know the synchronization and flow made it feel special for you.

It’s also great to hear the pressure felt well-balanced and that you left feeling refreshed and completely relaxed. We’re so glad the calm atmosphere added to your overall experience.

We truly appreciate your recommendation, and also your beautiful photos—they mean a lot to us. Thank you for entrusting us to help you unwind, we hope to welcome you back soon!

Warmly,
Pinewood Team

reviews.name: Rafael Ktistakis
reviews.text:
Stayed in Phuket roughly one month, visited multiple massage places (Kho Phi Phi, Kho Lanta, Phuket town). That’s the only one I kept coming back. I visited this one 3 times and always were leaving with a great feeling of relaxation which I couldn’t achieve on any other massage place I did visit. Maybe it’s subjective but both myself and my wife were pretty happy with this place. So much on our last day in Thailand we took a taxi to drive back for one last time :).

Would suggest give it a try 100% and you wouldn’t be disappointed.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Rafael,

Thank you for taking the time to share such a thoughtful review and for the photo as well — we always enjoy seeing little glimpses from our guests’ visits!

We’re truly happy to hear that after trying several massage places during your travels, you chose to return to us multiple times. It means a lot to the team to know that both you and your wife consistently left feeling relaxed and satisfied with your experience.

The fact that you even took a taxi to visit us one last time before leaving Thailand is something we really appreciate — it’s a wonderful compliment for our whole team. Your recommendation means a great deal to us.

Thank you for entrusting us to help you unwind during your time in Phuket. We hope to welcome you both again on a future visit :)

Warmly,
Pinewood Team

reviews.name: Валера туруруру
reviews.text: Amazing service. Very relaxing massage. I took classic thai massage and it's really nice. Great atmosphere. At the end they serve tea and hot towels. Definitely should go!

reviews.name: Aibek Akmatov
reviews.text: Best service on Phuket, very caring and friendly. This place's entourage is not as simple as all the places we visited, though the price is same. I had 90 minutes aromatherapy massage, my masseuse was very professional.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Aibek,

Thank you so much for your very kind and detailed review (and the lovely photos!) We are immensely proud to hear you consider this the "Best service on Phuket," and we are thrilled you appreciated the caring and friendly nature of our team.

It is particularly rewarding to know that the atmosphere of our center—the entourage—stood out positively compared to other places you visited. We believe in offering an elevated experience without compromising value.

We are delighted that you enjoyed your 90-minute aromatherapy massage and found your masseuse to be very professional.

We appreciate your kind words and hope to welcome you back for another relaxing session soon! : ) 

Warmly, 
Pinewood Team

reviews.name: Gordon Mok
reviews.text: MUST!!! went there twice, price is higher (like double the price) than other local massage places but the vibe and service are so worth the money. it’s the best in Karon/Kata area.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Gordon,

Thank you so much for your thoughtful review. We’re really happy to hear you came back to visit us again—that truly means a lot.

We also appreciate your honest note on pricing, and we’re glad you felt the overall experience, service, and atmosphere made it worthwhile. Hearing that it’s the best in the Karon/Kata area is such a great thing to hear. We also truly appreciate you sharing your lovely photos—they capture the experience beautifully.

Thank you for entrusting us to help you unwind, we hope to welcome you back soon!

Warmly,
Pinewood Team

reviews.name: Ирина Воробьева
reviews.text: Great massage, returned with a friend with great pleasure. The atmosphere of complete relaxation. The massage was done by different masters and everything is excellent. I really liked the Ice master. I heartily recommend that we go home.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Irina,

Thank you so much for your lovely review. We’re really happy to hear you enjoyed your experience enough to return again with a friend—that means a lot to us.

It’s wonderful to know you felt the atmosphere was truly relaxing and that both therapists provided such a great experience. We’re especially glad to hear you enjoyed your session with Ice—we’ll be sure to share your kind words. We also truly appreciate you sharing your photo—it means a lot to us.

Thank you for entrusting us to help you unwind, we hope to welcome you back soon!

Warmly,
Pinewood Team

reviews.name: Rissa Rahmanita
reviews.text: The place is clean and nice, we hd to book in advance by coming in person the day before. The room was also very comfortable, me and my husband share the room so we can be together during our session (60 mins, different treatment). We are also receiving free transport from our hotel before the masaage, and they are dropping us to other place after so kudos for service! Kind staff, good & relaxing ambiance, highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review!  We're delighted to hear you enjoyed the relaxing ambiance, comfortable rooms, and our complimentary transport service at Oasis Spa (Pattaya, Jomtien). Your recommendation means a lot to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing spa journey.

reviews.name: Kenny Kim
reviews.text: I had an amazing full-body massage at Oasis Spa Pattaya. The atmosphere was peaceful and relaxing, the facilities were spotless, and the staff were incredibly kind and professional. My therapist adjusted the pressure perfectly and helped relieve all the tension in my muscles. It was one of the most relaxing experiences of my trip. I highly recommend Oasis Spa to anyone visiting Pattaya. I'll definitely come back next time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a pleasure it is to read your wonderful feedback. Thank you for choosing Oasis Spa during your visit to Pattaya and for taking the time to share your experience. We are delighted to know that you found our spa to be a peaceful and professional retreat. Creating exceptional and memorable spa experiences for every guest is at the heart of what we do, and it is truly rewarding to know that you enjoyed both the tranquil ambiance and the attentive care provided by your therapist. We sincerely appreciate your kind support and look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing spa experience soon.

reviews.name: Pawangnittra
reviews.text: I’ve been a fan of Oasis Spa for over 10 years! This is my first time visiting Oasis Pattaya, and the service from all the staff was perfect. What I love most is the exceptional service and the wonderful people. The massage techniques are truly expert. I will definitely come back again when I travel to Pattaya. A solid 10/10 for the overall experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Wow, your wonderful feedback truly made our day! We are so thrilled to hear about your fantastic first visit to our Oasis Spa in Pattaya, especially from a loyal fan of over 10 years. It's fantastic to know that our team's exceptional service and expert massage techniques earned a "solid 10/10." We sincerely appreciate you sharing this and eagerly await your return.

reviews.name: Ksenia Fadeeva | DOLCE VITA GROUP
reviews.text: If I’m not mistaken - it’s the oldest spa in Pattaya. And it represents the full spirit of true Thai hospitality and great quality in body care. That’s an amazing place. 4 hands massage - is the best, it’s unbelievable how 2 people can move so smooth and synchronic, it’s more like an art, sometimes it seemed to me that it was one person…. with 4 hands 😅 I really love this place. And treat myself and my love ones sometimes 🥰
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a pleasure it is to read your comments! We are thrilled that you enjoyed the unique and artful experience of our Four-Hand Massage at the Oasis Spa Pattaya. Your description of the massage as a seamless and synchronized performance truly captures the essence of what we aim to provide. Thank you for your kind words and for sharing your experience. We sincerely appreciate your support and look forward to the opportunity to welcome you back for another moment of peace and rejuvenation.

reviews.name: Xixi Cheng
reviews.text: I took my clients to the Oasis. I knew it would be good because I went to the one in Chiangmai. It was also very good. Their massage therapists are consistently good, well trained. Don’t go to Let’s Relax. That is the worst chain ever. I really recommend Oasis. My therapist was Yada. She was very attentive, listened to my feedback, and gave me a positive and soothing experience!!!  And the Mango sticky rice was great after!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review!  We're delighted that you and your clients enjoyed your experience at Oasis Spa Pattaya. It's especially meaningful to hear that you've experienced our consistent quality across different branches, from Chiang Mai to Pattaya. I'll make sure to pass along your compliments to Khun Yada - she'll be thrilled to know her attentive service made such a positive impression. We're glad you enjoyed our complimentary mango sticky rice too! We look forward to welcoming you back for another soothing spa journey soon.

reviews.name: Arvind .Jayakumar
reviews.text: We had a very relaxing spa experience. Right from the welcoming till the end of the session, the hospitality was too good. The therapists did an amazing job, the techniques were so good that made the body completely releaxed. The ambience adds calming sensation to the entire process. Will definitely come back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback!  We're delighted to hear that you had such a relaxing experience at Oasis Spa Pattaya. reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review and for choosing Oasis Spa Pattaya twice! We're thrilled to hear you had amazing experiences with us. We’re committed to maintaining the high standards you've experienced and look forward to welcoming you back again soon.

reviews.name: wakagashira
reviews.text: This was an incredible spa experience for my husband and me. The place itself is located in a beautiful, quiet, green area, planted with plants. The staff gave us a warm welcome with cold hibiscus tea and offered to fill out a questionnaire with our service preferences and any necessary information about ourselves that would be useful to the specialists. In the room itself, we were given a gift for our honeymoon. The spa itself was filled with mango products: peeling, wrapping, and a full-body massage, including a head massage. After each treatment, we showered in a comfortable environment, and disposable linens were changed each time. The service itself was incredibly gentle and caring. At the end of the spa, we were treated to our favorite mango sticky rice and delicious tea. We want to come back again and again. The price is reasonable, but it's not a cheap pleasure
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely appreciate you sharing such a detailed and glowing review of your experience. It brings us great joy to know that you enjoyed the serene atmosphere, the thoughtful honeymoon touches, and the mango-themed treatments our team prepared especially for you. Your kind feedback is a wonderful encouragement to our team and affirms our commitment to creating exceptional and memorable spa experiences for every guest. We look forward to welcoming you both back for another relaxing spa experience in the future.

reviews.text: The experience from beginning to end was beautiful. We did wonderful oasis package that had us floating on cloud nine upon completion. Bonus was the complimentary transfer service. They also provide pick up and drop off service which I appreciate that very much.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review and for being a loyal customer for over four years! reviews.text: The best spa experience I’ve ever had. Stress free from the moment my ride picked me up to the moment I was dropped off. Transportation provided, beautiful peaceful atmosphere and friendly smiling staff. The mango and sticky rice treat at the end was an amazing finish.

reviews.name: Aaron Sim
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience at Oasis Spa Pattaya. The service was excellent and the masseuse was highly skilful and very attentive to my needs. reviews.text: Lovely venue, treatment and staff were excellent. We had the Wonderful Oasis "his/his" treatment, that lasted 2.5h. reviews.text:

A big thank you to Ana and Laila for making my visit so memorable. I highly recommend Oasis Spa in Pattaya to anyone looking for a premium spa experience, and I will definitely visit again.
