title: Chivarome Massage
ownerDescription:
Chivarome is an old Thai word meaning "to take pleasure in the things that you do." In this busiest of times, we can all understand why this word is no longer used. But here at Chivarome Massage, Chivarome is not just a name.

Our skilled therapists, masters of ancient Thai massage, tailor each treatment to harmonize body, mind, and spirit. Choose from an array of luxurious massages, including traditional Thai, aromatic oil, and hot herbal compress therapies.

At Chivarome Massage, escape the ordinary and embrace the extraordinary. Step into an oasis of tranquility that is Chivarome Massage located on Kata Beach Road in Karon, Phuket and step into a sanctuary inviting you to rediscover harmony in both body and spirit.
address: 70 Kata Rd Kata Beach, Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83100, Thailand
plusCode: R892+W4 Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Lava
reviews.text:
The place is clean and the massage was good — it was almost a 5-star experience. Unfortunately, my husband’s masseuse had quite a bit of an attitude. He was very sassy, constantly rolling his eyes and was a little rude in certain ways from the get-go.

I also felt that he seemed uncomfortable with the fact that we had a baby with us, as though it bothered him but I don’t want to assume that was the reason. Either way, it did make the experience less comfortable for us.

We still tipped them as a thank you, but unfortunately, we wouldn’t be going back.

reviews.name: Nicole Gao
reviews.text:
Pros: This massage shop stays open until midnight, unlike most nearby stores that close at 10 or 11 PM, which is really convenient for people who come late. Two of my friends had an amazing experience here. Their therapists were professional with perfect pressure to relieve tight muscles and tendons, and the oil massage was relaxing enough that both of them fell asleep during the session. Another friend got a foot massage and said the therapist had plenty of strength.

However, I got a totally different experience with my therapist. I arrived close to 11 PM as one of the last customers of the day, and my therapist seemed drowsy and half-hearted the whole time. Most of the session was just her spreading oil on my body without any deep pressure on my stiff muscles. Her technique was unrefined—she couldn’t even target basic acupoints like my temples correctly. What’s more, the therapist had noticeable bad breath, which made the close-contact massage uncomfortable. My friend who had the foot massage also mentioned that despite strong pressure, the therapist missed many correct acupressure points.

Overall, the quality varies wildly depending on which therapist you get. Some are skilled, while others are tired and unprofessional. Take this review as a balanced reference before booking.

reviews.name: JK JK
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely fantastic experience at Chivarome Massage. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was calm, welcoming, and beautifully relaxing. The staff were incredibly professional and made me feel comfortable right away.

The massage itself was exceptional, the therapist clearly knew exactly what they were doing and tailored the treatment perfectly to my needs. Every movement felt intentional, and I left feeling completely refreshed, relaxed, and re-energized.

What really stood out was the attention to detail and the genuine care for customer satisfaction. It wasn’t just a massage, it was a full experience of relaxation and well-being.

I would highly recommend Chivarome Massage to anyone looking for high-quality service and a truly soothing escape. I will definitely be coming back!

reviews.text:

The massage itself was very poor quality — no technique, no pressure control, no professionalism at all. I left feeling more stressed than when I arrived.

reviews.name: Gaya B
reviews.text:
A serene spa, with very clean and simple yet effective decor, and a window that looks into a lush yet small garden of greenery.

It took me a few tries to be able to get into their schedule, because I kept being told that they were booked.

So I finally schedule an appointment with enough advanced notice, and I walk to my appointment, in a secure community space on a street that is mostly residential.

Inside, the space is medium sized with a few chairs for foot massage and some mats for Thai massage. There are only two therapists working there.

The lady who worked with me was booked immediately after me with another customer. They leave no time between customers. It’s strange that there are so few therapists; the space feels empty, which is fine for a more prestigious type of feeling I suppose if that’s your thing.

The massage itself is phenomenal, with cozy seats, and a therapist with a firm well-placed touch. The mat massage is good and effective, but the lotion carries a strong perfumed odor that my skin does not agree with. If you have sensitive skin, do not choose a massage with lotion. There is also a strong detergent smell to the clothing they have you wear and the sheets used on the massage mats.

Be aware that the timing is tight, and you need a reservation. You can WhatsApp or call them to schedule. Show up early for your reservation so you can have time to change into their clothing before the massage. It’s a peaceful place with nice music playing, with a nice, calm essence.

reviews.name: kee tee
reviews.text:
This is an excellent sauna.

The location is a bit tricky to find, but if you follow the narrow road, New Saton Sauna will appear.

There's construction going on and various buildings on the premises, but just head straight ahead (the buildings on the grounds are probably related to New Saton Sauna).

Payment is after use. (300B) The staff will guide you to a locker, where you'll receive a rental towel and rental shorts. After that, you're free to enjoy.

Water and tea are free.

You can apparently eat there too, but I ordered delivery via Grab.
I also requested dishes and cutlery with the delivery, but they were just dumped into a plastic bag lol.😂

When I was struggling, a sauna staff member lent me dishes and a spoon (truly grateful).

I got a foot massage for 300B. The massage room had locals chatting and napping, but I felt right at home and comfortable 😊

⭐️The facilities are wonderful, but above all, the staff's hospitality is incredible. I don't understand Thai, but they try their best to assist me.

I'll definitely go again.

The entrance is 300 thb

reviews.text:
I’m actually a bit hesitant to leave this review because I selfishly want to keep this place a secret to myself!

Wynn Spa is tucked away in a quiet cul-de-sac right near the Ploenchit Station, making it a perfect escape from the city's hustle. Service-wise, they were excellent—consistent with the high standards of the area—but what really sets them apart is how convenient they are to deal with. It is incredibly easy to book a session via WhatsApp or Line, which I really appreciated.

The aesthetic of the spa is lovely and serene. From the moment you walk in, the setup feels calming and high-end (the foot soak station is beautiful!). As a solo female traveler, I felt completely comfortable and safe here.

Perhaps the best part? They are not pushy at all about trying to sell you packages or memberships. You can just relax and enjoy your treatment without the sales pitch. Highly recommend if you’re in the area!

title: GRACE SPA
ownerDescription:
Tired and unhappy with regular boring life? Pamper yourself at Grace Spa Pattaya.

We are designed to provide spa and massage services in a luxurious and tranquil atmosphere, where the weary mind, body, and soul can relax and replenish.

Ours is a classical and elegant Thai spa with world-class facilities and extensive treatment rooms.

Our Thai massage spa in Pattaya is a rejuvenating place, designed to bring you back into the perfect state of balance.

Our restorative spa treatments are really effective for all age groups.
(Note: Persons who are under medical treatments must consult doctors before taking services)

All this has helped us create a niche for ourselves, and become one of the best Thai massage spas in Pattaya.
address: 202 266 หมู่ที่ 9 Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
plusCode: WVPW+MJ Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri, Thailand

reviews.name: CT
reviews.text:
Great option if you are looking for a high quality, private, slightly unique massage experience.

I booked a 3hr package priced at just over thb3,000.  This is significantly more expensive than the corner shops, but that’s not what this is.  My reviews reflect value for money and whether I’d return - and I certainly would. Overall one of the best options in Pattaya between high end luxury (resort) and corner shop options.

Why I enjoyed my experience:
- Greeted upon arrival, walked to lobby
- Like some other massage shops, they ask you to identify pressure level and areas to avoid / focus on, my Thai is terrible and I appreciate sharing preferences visually
- Massage room (unique) - the business is largely open air with private single room buildings (each unit also has bathroom with shower / tub and toilet)
- Great massage

Things to note:
- My package included body scrub. In some places in the world (Korea) this is an aggressive exfoliation process that borders on uncomfortable. This was the opposite, apply exfoliant and massage. Relaxing for sure, but my preference is a happy medium between this and feeling like my skin is being sanded off.
- Thai massage itself was excellent, only a couple painful moments - ofc ymmv and I’m sure they will adjust force upon request
- Given the individual massage room / buildings I was initially worried about mosquitoes - few things can ruin a relaxing massage than getting bit every 5 minutes - I wasn’t bit once (I went mid-day)

Some minor things I would change:
- An exfoliation glove (personal preference as I’m sure many would find the body scrub great as is)
- My package included a ‘milk’ bath - the tub is big, slippery, and was filled to a point where my abs were engaged nearly the full time to keep my head above the suds: slightly less water or some grip would have made this more relaxing

Other than that, this was a highly enjoyable and relaxing experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your amazing review! It means the world to our team. We look forward to seeing you again whenever you're in Pattaya.

reviews.text: I have visited Pattaya 4x's and came upon this jewel! Loved this place. Secluded and cabin like feel. You can go solo or with a partner. It's a little more expensive than others but you will get what you pay for and this place is worth every cent.

reviews.name: Tingly Tinky
reviews.text:
The service is good. Need to book and pay a deposit in advance. The staff speak politely. The shop is very small and doesn’t have space for washing your feet or storing shoes.

The masseuse applies strong pressure, using elbows and working quite quickly. Personally, I prefer a slower, more focused massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We would also like to thank you for your comments regarding the space and facilities. We will take your suggestions into consideration as we continue to improve our shop.

We truly appreciate your support and hope to welcome you again in the future.

reviews.name: m h
reviews.text:
We visited Hani Spa on March 22 at 4:00 p.m. for a 2-hour oil massage for two people. The price was cheap at 950 baht, and the high reviews made us expect a decent experience. Unfortunately, it turned out to be one of the worst massages I have had in Bangkok.

The massage itself was very poor. The pressure was far too weak, the technique felt unskilled, and much of the session barely felt like a proper massage at all. A low price is not an excuse for such poor quality.

What made it even worse was the therapists’ behavior. During the treatment, the two therapists kept whispering to each other and laughing. My companion understood enough to realize that they were talking about us and even making rude comments while giving the massage. That is unbelievably unprofessional and completely unacceptable.

Bad massage, bad manners, and a very unpleasant experience overall. We will not return, and I would not recommend this place to anyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear m h
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We sincerely apologize that your experience did not meet expectations.
We are very sorry to hear that the massage quality and therapist behavior were not up to standard. This is not the level of service we aim to provide, and we take your comments very seriously. We will review this matter with our team immediately, especially regarding professionalism and communication during treatments.

Your feedback is very important to us, and we are genuinely grateful that you brought this to our attention. We deeply regret that we failed to meet your expectations and that your visit turned into such an unpleasant experience.
We hope you might give us another chance in the future to provide you with the quality and respect that you deserve.
Sincerely,
Hani Spa Team

reviews.text: Very nice spa in front of Central Ladprao. I had aroma therapy massage and my friend had Thai massage. Khun Tommy and khjn Gade were very friendly and professional. They always asled us if yhe pressure were ok. Will definitely come back :)

reviews.text: The best massage I've ever had in my entire life. I get a yearly health fund to get massages from work, so I've gotten 100+ massages in my life from 25+ different clinics in various cities. HANI SPA

reviews.name: Lynn Tan
reviews.text: Did a one hour foot massage and it was so comfortable that I had a snooze. Thank you to Lily for making it so comfortable. We will probably be back again for a body massage and scrub. 1 hour foot massage cost THB300 (equivalent to about SGD12). So worth it ! They give you tea and biscuit sticks after the session. Amazing 🤩

reviews.name: Yeongwoo Jeon
reviews.text:
dropped by PALM SPA & MASSAGE today and was genuinely impressed.

From the warm greeting at the entrance to the skilled hands of the masseuse, everything was perfect.

The staff are extremely friendly and professional, and the massage was incredibly refreshing and effective – it really relieved all the tension in my shoulders and back.

The room was clean and comfortable, with a nice relaxing vibe. If you're in Bangkok and want a proper, strong massage without any disappointment, this is the place to go.

5 stars! Looking forward to my next visit

reviews.name: Brintha Anandan
reviews.text: I walked into the spa with zero expectations but left with a genuinely positive experience. It will easily be one of the best places I have done my massages and will be returning back tomorrow. Please give this place a try!!

reviews.name: Jun Xiang Ng
reviews.text:
Had amazing experience here.
Came back 6 times throughout my 5 day trip.
Sarah has very good technique and is very skilled, do ask for her.
The space was very clean, and environment was very conducive. Very relaxing. With lots of different options for different therapy.

reviews.name: David Audrey Chong
reviews.text:
A massage place that’s easily missed if not for Google Maps, but definitely worth discovering!

The front desk was friendly and accommodating, especially when I requested an adjustment to my package. The masseur was skilled and did a great job — the 1.5-hour body massage was so relaxing that I actually dozed off a few times! I woke up feeling refreshed and thoroughly relaxed.

The environment was pleasant and comfortable as well. The only slight downside during my visit was the renovation happening at the neighbouring unit, with some construction noise occasionally waking me up. Hopefully, once the renovation is completed, it’ll be an even more peaceful experience.

Overall, a great massage experience with friendly service and a skilled masseur. I’d definitely consider coming back!

reviewContext.Services: Spa packages, Body scrub, Massage therapy, Massage

reviews.name: Kayla Woods
reviews.text: Excellent experience, this is the first place I’ve found that will/knows how to do pregnancy massage. I was able to receive a body scrub, massage and facial massage (and yes they do a full facial) at 16 weeks pregnant! They were really considerate, laying me on my side, giving extra support, going light in required areas but still giving a good deep massage around shoulders. We loved it! Also a great price

reviews.name: Jcct
reviews.text: Lovely ambience and comfortable environment. My son and I both love it! The massage therapists were very friendly and skilful. At the end of massage, we were served tea and a light snack. Great value in this area for great service. Mimi did oil massage, head massage and foot massage for me. She's careful and gentle. My son has been going for thai massage and we have been coming 3 days in a row. ❤️ it here so much!👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻😊😊😊

reviews.name: Nattaya Chamnankit
reviews.text: This was my first time here. I opted for a 1-hour Thai massage and a 30-minute oil massage. The masseuse, named P'Bua, was amazing; her massage was perfect, hitting the right spots, and very relaxing. The service was excellent. I highly recommend her. I will definitely come back again.🥰

reviews.name: Wai Meng Yap
reviews.text: Place is hidden away from the busy street. It is also quiet. Prices are comparable across all the places along the street, but I chose this since some of the guests I met in Club Med recommended it. I opted for a 1.5 hour Thai massage with herbal compress. Must say the masseur I have could identify my pain points really well. She also has much more strength than the masseurs I come across in Bangkok previously! This is a popular joint for tourists, I think, especially those from SG and Malaysia.

reviews.name: Fiona Osmani
reviews.text: The best Thai massage I have ever had! Me and my boyfriend went to Palm for our first day in Thailand and it was THE BEST MASSAGE. The atmosphere, the staff and a huge mention to Bebe and Nida they did an amazing job! Definitely coming back

reviews.name: Alejandro Rivera
reviews.text:
I’ve been travelling for a while and this completely restored my energy. The therapist was excellent with pressure points and technique — genuinely one of the best sports massages I’ve ever received.

The staff were super friendly, professional, and welcoming from start to finish.

Thank you — I’ll definitely be back in a couple of days.

reviews.name: Nabiha Durrani
reviews.text: as somebody who goes to massage almost every month, this is by far the best massage i’ve ever had!! thanks to masseuse, Mimi, she is very professional, always smiling and has the best, smooth service. place is very clean and smells good too.

reviews.name: Nicole Gao
reviews.text:
This massage shop doesn’t have fancy luxurious decor, but the massage experience is absolutely outstanding, highly recommend their oil massage!
My friend and I got private rooms deep inside the shop, quiet and isolated from street noise. Soft calming background music played throughout the session, creating a super soothing, sleepy atmosphere perfect for unwinding.
All therapists here are well-trained with consistent professional skills—both my friend and I had incredible massages. The oil massage hit the perfect balance: gentle yet firm enough to reach tight muscles and acupoints precisely. Every knot and stiff tendon was fully worked out, leaving us totally refreshed and free of all-day fatigue after the treatment.
I also love how thoughtful the therapists are. When shifting positions or adjusting their stance during the massage, they move extremely lightly like a feather, never bumping or causing any discomfort at all.
Compared to other massage parlors where therapist quality varies wildly, this place delivers reliable, skilled service every time. If you want a genuine therapeutic oil massage to release body tension, this spot is a solid choice!

reviews.name: Clara Wai Yeng Chong
reviews.text:
We could have missed this massage place which was just across the road from our resort. It’s inside a building and it’s on the 2nd floor. So you want to walk across a restaurant inside the building to find the stairs.
The massage place is spacious and clean.
We had a wonderful one hour oil massage for 500 THB. It was slightly more expensive than other massage places but it’s worth the money. The masseuse was very good. We were delighted with the service that we returned the following day with a couple whom we met in our resort.
They too were delighted with their massage. I had a foot massage which was really good but was interrupted by some loud spoken customers from the same resort who was on a video call without any consideration for other customers who were enjoying the tranquility and comfort of a massage.
Great massage place! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Enzo Gabler
reviews.text: Wow, top three best massages of my life, I love strong deep tissue massages and Sarah ( the masseuse) was incredible, great pressure, I got the Thai massage, lots of great stretches aswell, Sarah was very experienced. highly recommend!

reviews.name: Yoyo Cheung
reviews.text: SO GOOD I came here 4 days consecutively! I tried foot massage, aroma oil massage, virgin coconut massage and body scrub - the therapists did amazing in all items. The pressure intensity was on point and their service was great. Environment was not the fancy kind but was clean. Shout out to Anjali for the amazing massage!!

reviews.name: Maria De La Paz Gaitan
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience with everyone at Palm Massage & Beauty. Specially with Eva!! I love her. She is incredibly professional, kind, and truly talented. From the moment the session started, I felt completely comfortable and cared for.

She paid close attention to what my body needed. You can tell she genuinely cares.
I highly recommend Eva to anyone looking for an exceptional massage!

reviews.name: Moti Atal
reviews.text:
​⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolute Perfection! Bestt Massage in Kata Beach!
​If you are looking for the ultimate relaxation experience in Kata Beach, look no further than Palm Massage! The atmosphere is incredibly clean, welcoming, and peaceful.
​A special, massive thank you to Sara and Joy! They are absolutely amazing at what they do. They are highly skilled, professional, and attentive to exactly what your body needs. Whether you need deep tissue relief or just want to unwind, they know exactly how to deliver the perfect massage. Their warm energy and bright smiles made the experience even more special.
​We left feeling completely rejuvenated and like a brand new people. We will definitely be coming back here every time we visit Kata!
​Highly, highly recommended! 🌴✨

reviews.name: nilesh agarwal
reviews.text:
Getting massaged by someone literally named Luck at Palm Spa & Massage Kata — and then feeling totally melted — that’s a holiday win right there.
If Luck gave you that smooth, flowing pressure with just the right touch during the aroma massage, you definitely found a skilled therapist. Those are the ones you remember.
If you go back:
Ask for Luck specifically
Book a longer session next time 😌
Maybe try aroma + hot oil combo
Sounds like your Phuket relaxation level is 100/10 ✨.

reviews.name: Dakota Townsend
reviews.text: Bua and Joy were amazing! My husband and I both got 1.5 hour massages. 30 mins of mine was a facial and it was all so relaxing! Favorite massage we’ve gotten in Thailand! Love!

reviews.name: Hong Shou
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing spa experience! 💆‍♀️✨ I had such a relaxing and wonderful time at Diana Spa in Bangkok. The massage was incredibly comfortable, and I felt all the tiredness disappear almost immediately. The staff were super nice, friendly, and attentive, and the atmosphere was beautiful, clean, and relaxing.

I really enjoyed the whole experience and would definitely come back again. Highly recommended! ❤️

reviews.name: Kimaji Mil
reviews.text: Had a session at Divana and I must say I was quite blown away by the service and quality of the massages. Me and wife decided to treat ourselves to the 100 mins spa special (which consists of a 40 mins body scrub and 60 mins aromatherapy massage). The receptionist was polite and welcomed us when we arrived with a cool drink and towel, right after he sat us down. He then explained the spa programme and asked in detail what are our preferences in terms of oils to be used. After that, we were introduced to the masseuse who then conducted our massages very well, helping to ease our muscle tension after a body scrub. Am happy this was my first massage in Thailand, will definitely visit again!

reviews.name: Prachi Agarkar
reviews.text:
Had the BEST experience here. I got a 2 hours scrub spa and massage and it was the best. Just once try a spa lime Divano and experience luxury massages and spa in Bangkok and not just the ones that are roadside. You’ll realise how better the experience is!!
The ambience is great and staff is excellent and courteous
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind recommendation! We are absolutely thrilled to hear that you had the best experience with our 2-hour scrub and massage treatment.

It is always our greatest honor to welcome you to our Heritage House, a historic 90-year-old White Wood House that formerly served as the private palace of HRH Prince Narisara Nuwattiwong. We take immense pride in preserving this unique legacy to provide a private sanctuary of Wellness in Harmony, ensuring a level of care and tranquility.

We are glad you appreciated our peaceful ambience and the courtesy of our team. We look forward to welcoming you back to our spa in Soi Somkid again soon.

reviews.name: RachelEnergy 레이첼에너지
reviews.text: Had the best experience ever. The Rose House is a beautiful private to get a massage. I booked on KKDAY. The treatment was 120 minutes of a full body scrub followed by an aromatic oil massage, ending with a milky bath with roses. The best spa day ever to pamper yourself.

reviews.name: Matilda Hellberg
reviews.text: A lovely experience with aroma oil massage and body scrub. I was treated with care and attention to the concerns I had coming here. The spa offers a tranquil and serene hideaway among the busy Bangkok streets. I can warmly recommend to anyone who wants a truly relaxing experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review and for your warm recommendation! We are thrilled to hear that our aroma oil massage and body scrub provided the perfect escape for you. 😊✨

At divana, we believe in delivering The Art of Holistic Wellness by treating every guest with personalized care and attention. We are delighted that you found our Soi Somkid sanctuary to be a tranquil and serene hideaway amidst the vibrant energy of Bangkok. Knowing that you felt well-cared for is the greatest reward for our team.

We look forward to welcoming you back for another journey of Wellness in Harmony very soon!🌿🙏

reviews.name: Yuns J
reviews.text: I have always seen this on social media and finally got to try! It was worth booking via KKDAY! The place is clean, calm, and the staff are so friendly and professional. My whole body feels relaxed and just the luxury spa day that anyone can imagine!

reviews.name: Cassie “Cassie” Zhang
reviews.text: The building itself is surrounded by green with a beautiful design of a real tree inside the reception. The moment you walk in you will feel zen, peace and calm. Massage was outstanding, every staff very friendly. My body feels very good after the massage.

reviews.name: Katherine Lau
reviews.text: Very good massage here. Highly recommend to you guys. Nice environment, friendly staff , happy experience when i every time been here ☺️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
It is such a pleasure to read about your happy experience!

We are delighted that you enjoyed our friendly staff and the relaxing environment we strive to maintain for every guest.  We take great pride in offering a sanctuary of Wellness in Harmony within our Colonial Style Architecture. It is our honor to welcome you into this Heritage White House, which carries the legacy of being the former palace of HRH Prince Narisara Nuwattiwong.

We look forward to welcoming you back for another wonderful visit soon!

reviews.name: Tiffany J.B.
reviews.text:
Beautiful, stunning spa. Smells amazing. The front desk is so professional. The care before with a cold drink and scented towel and care after with pineapple and bananas was a nice sweet touch with warm tea.  There are so many scents to choose from its almost difficult to choose.

I love the massage room and sound of natural water around me. I got the lymphatic massage and I would give it an 8 out of 10 as the technique could use more work. The overall massage 8 out of 10 because I kept explaining my pressure needs and it was a bit too rough for me in my shoulder area. I would still come back and try another massage and see. But I absolutely loved the experience overall.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderfully detailed review and for highlighting the aspects of your visit that made it special! 😊✨

We are thrilled that you enjoyed the stunning ambiance of our Soi Somkid sanctuary, from the signature scents to our professional front desk team and the thoughtful "sweet touches" like our cold refreshments and fruit service. We believe these details are essential to The Art of Holistic Wellness.

Regarding your feedback on the lymphatic massage, we truly appreciate your honesty. We strive for perfection, and your comments about the pressure and technique have been shared with our lead therapist for immediate review and further training. We want to ensure that every stroke is perfectly tailored to your needs.

We are so glad that, despite the massage technique not being a perfect 10, you still loved the overall experience and plan to return. We look forward to welcoming you back and providing an experience that is 10/10 in every way, bringing you back to total Wellness in Harmony. 🌿🛁

reviews.name: Bini Bunny
reviews.text: I’ve been going to Divana every year for 5 years. The place is so very peaceful. You really will fall asleep when you get your head on their pillows! The massage will lul you to asleep. And their lotions are good too!

reviews.name: Tracy Leung
reviews.text: It’s already my 2nd visit here at Divana. I had the honeymoon escape package with buy one Get one free discount. The package include massage, scrub and spa. The price range is on the pricier side but definitely worth it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for choosing to visit us for the 2nd time! We are thrilled to hear that you found our Honeymoon Escape package to be a worthwhile investment in your well-being.

While our price range reflects a premium experience, we strive to ensure every moment, from the scrub to the signature massage, delivers The Art of Holistic Wellness. Performing these treatments within our 90-year-old White Wood House (the former palace of HRH Prince Narisara Nuwattiwong) allows us to offer a level of Wellness in Harmony that is truly unique to our Soi Somkid location.

We are glad you could take our special promotion and look forward to welcoming you back for a 3rd visit to our Colonial Style sanctuary!🌹✨

reviews.name: V Y
reviews.text: relaxing, incredibly soothing spa experience I’ve ever had. From the moment I walked in, every touch, scent, and sound melted my stress away. Pure bliss—I left feeling like a whole new person. Can’t recommend it enough!

reviews.text: 3rd time here and still enjoy the spa treatment experience so much. Highly recommend their 310 mins package, can go klook checkout their promotion. The full body spa treatment with milky+rose bath at the end is so dope. It is just another level of pure relaxation!

We look forward to your 4th visit for another journey of Wellness in Harmony in our Colonial Style heritage home.🌹✨

reviews.name: Wenz C
reviews.text: Beautiful sanctuary tucked away in busy Bangkok city. Had the best 2 hours rest of this trip under skilled hands of Divana's therapist. The post treatment refreshments were awesome as well. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: TiKoh
reviews.text:
First time here and I’m already in love 💖
The alley might look a bit deep and slightly “are we lost?” (Soi Somkid next to Central Chidlom), but trust me—once you’re in, totally worth the mini adventure.

Inside is a whole different universe compared to the main road. It’s a gorgeous spa with a very obvious rose obsession (in a good way). The moment you open the door—BOOM—rose scent attacks your nose (politely). Beautiful, quiet, calm, and zen-level peaceful.

Plenty of rooms too, and here’s a fun detail: each room has its own name. Different languages, same meaning—rose. Fancy much? 🌹

The massage? Chef’s kiss. I went for the fragrant oil massage and asked for extra strong, because my body is basically one big knot. Heavy but relaxing, melting away all the tension until your body says “okay, I give up.” Add the lovely aroma and… yeah, lights out. I was gone 😴

Parking is available, or you can park at Central Chidlom and have the spa pick you up—because yes, they’re that nice.

reviews.name: NaNa.KinKin
reviews.text: The overall experience at the spa is great. The receptionist was helpful and the therapist was also lovely. They served mango sticky rice after the treatment which was very delicious.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for sharing your wonderful feedback! We are absolutely delighted to hear that you had an overall great experience and that our receptionist, therapists, and complimentary mango sticky rice made your day special. 
For your next visit to Soi Somkid, we invite you to explore more of our signature treatments surrounded by the peaceful atmosphere of our beautiful Signature Rose Garden.

reviews.name: Charlin Quek
reviews.text: The location is very convenient and easy to get to. This is my second visit to Divana, and I really enjoy the relaxing ambiance—the massage was excellent as well.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your continued trust and for choosing us for your second visit. It is truly an honor to be part of your wellness journey once again.

We are delighted to hear that you find our Soi Somkid sanctuary both convenient and accessible - a peaceful oasis right in the heart of the city. Providing an excellent massage within a relaxing ambiance is the essence of The Art of Holistic Wellness that we strive to deliver to our returning guests.

We look forward to welcoming you back for your third visit at divana Scentuara Spa soon. 🌿✨

reviews.name: Jasstina Teh
reviews.text: Amazing massage therapist and the service is very good. The staffs are friendly and helpful ❤️

reviews.name: Nathan Tang
reviews.text:
Another astonishing experience with my family here!

The environment is so relaxing. Staffs are all nice and helpful. Service level of Divana has never let me down. The lady who massaged us is very skilful and an absolute veteran! All the tension in the muscle faded away after the treatment!

We came here two years ago, still surprise me after two years. Will definitely visit again whenever the appointment is available for me!!!

Highly recommend!!!

reviews.name: Arlene P. T.
reviews.text:
The place is beautiful, set in a house surrounded by garden.

They are very professional, after I had posted about my experience here (explained below), they did look into it and called me up to apologise and offered something in return.
Just the thought that they cared enough to take action was reassuring.  They went on top of that to offer me something in return.  They took great care of me.  I’m thankful. I really did think it’s not the company’s fault and didn’t ask for anything in return. But thank you!

I requested “light” on the pressure from masseuse and more concentration on my back/shoulder part.  They circled my requests and crossed what I asked them to exclude.
This is normal procedure for all spa massagers.
The masseuse put too much pressure on my calfs so much so I had to tell her to go easy.  She also spent quite a lot of time there too.
When she was on my back, she also put too much pressure so much so that I have to ask her again to go easy.
Then my back-shoulder part, she only spent a few seconds there!!
She must have forgotten my request.
Then she asked where I wanted to exclude.   This means she also forgot about that too.
i’ve been to Central Embassy’s Divana like 6-7 times last year and none of the Masseus messed up my requests.

After the staff out front saw the points that I gave her he asked me what happened where I explained to him and then he went and got me a hand cream and was apologetic about what I experienced.  I’m grateful, but I think it will be best if the Manager would look into this messeuse and do something about it.
Like she can have my request inside the room with her so she can take a look if she forgets?
